Having regard to the fact that Apprentice Mo is not currently approved to ride at Happy Valley, the Stewards decided that the appropriate penalty was for his licence to ride in races to be suspended for a period to expire on Sunday, 2 October 2016 on which day he may resume race riding (3 Hong Kong racedays).  The commencement of the suspension was deferred until after the Sha Tin racemeeting on Sunday, 11 September 2016.  During this period, there are three racemeetings scheduled to be conducted at Sha Tin Racecourse.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards had regard to the fact that whilst this was the first day on which Apprentice Mo was riding in Hong Kong, he had gained considerable overseas riding experience and also that the interference, sustained predominantly by BLIZZARD, was significant.
Passing the 500 Metres, DIVINE BOY raced tight inside DASHING FELLOW.
Rounding the Home Turn, BLIZZARD got its head up when being checked away from the heels of PACKING PINS.
Passing the 150 Metres, DASHING FELLOW shifted in and was awkwardly placed outside the heels of DIVINE BOY.
Throughout the race, I'M IN CHARGE travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned regarding the performance of DUNDONNELL, Z Purton stated that rounding the first turn after the 900 Metres DUNDONNELL commenced to hang out and became unbalanced in its action.  He said after being taken wider passing the 800 Metres DUNDONNELL continued to hang out and at no stage was he able to get the horse to be properly balanced.  He added DUNDONNELL, in particular, hung out rounding the Home Turn which was in contrast to the manner in which it trialed in the lead up to today's race when it performed quite tractably.  He said in the early part of the Straight DUNDONNELL continued to be awkward in its action and as he had concerns regarding the manner in which DUNDONNELL was travelling, he eased it down in the latter part of the Straight.  A veterinary inspection of DUNDONNELL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of DUNDONNELL was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, DUNDONNELL will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial around a bend and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of DASHING FELLOW immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
LUCKY YEAR and KEY WITNESS were sent for sampling.

When being mounted in the Parade Ring, HARBOUR VICTORY became very fractious, reared and fell over, resulting in C Y Ho being dislodged and sustaining an injury to his right leg.  Acting on veterinary advice that HARBOUR VICTORY was not suitable to race, that horse was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  C Y Ho was transported to hospital and consequently was unable to fulfil his remaining riding engagements.  HARBOUR VICTORY will be required to undergo a satisfactory parade test prior to its next race start and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
TRAVEL AMBASSADOR began very awkwardly, got its head up and lost a considerable amount of ground.  Before being allowed to race again, TRAVEL AMBASSADOR will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.
FIONNâS CITY began only fairly.
MASSIVE MOVE and ART OF SUCCESS bumped at the start.  After this, ART OF SUCCESS got its head on the side and shifted out, resulting in PERPETUAL JOYANCE being inconvenienced.
Passing the 500 Metres, UNIQUE JOYFUL shifted in and bumped the hindquarters of DIAMOND BIT which became unbalanced and then lay out, resulting in UNIQUE JOYFUL being hampered.
Approaching the 300 Metres, PEACE COMBINATION was crowded for room outside BEAUTY MASTER which, after initially being taken out marginally by MASSIVE MOVE, then got its head on the side and shifted out away from that horse.
Passing the 300 Metres, WINNING TALENT was crowded for room between DIAMOND BIT and FIONNâS CITY which shifted out.  FIONNâS CITY was then shifted in abruptly to relieve the tightening to WINNING TALENT.
C P POWER was unable obtain clear running over the final 100 Metres and consequently was not able to be properly tested.
When questioned, D Whyte stated that just prior to the start being effected MR POTENTIAL turned its head to the left which resulted in the horse being slow to begin.  He said he rode MR POTENTIAL along in the early stages to make up lost ground, however, the horse was reluctant to stretch out and gave him the impression that it did not appreciate the kickback.  He said he was reluctant to shift MR POTENTIAL away from the outside rail towards the middle of the track despite the kickback so as to take advantage of the outside barrier draw.  He added, despite being ridden along in the early and middle stages, MR POTENTIAL did not improve its position and it was only over the latter stages of the race that the horse made some ground to get closer to the main body of the field.  A veterinary inspection of MR POTENTIAL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that SIGHT SEEING had sustained a cut into the right hind leg.
BEAUTY MASTER and ART OF SUCCESS were sent for sampling.

AUDACITY was crowded for room on jumping between TEAM SWEET and FOREVER ACCURATE which shifted in.
Shortly after the start, GAINFULJET and REGENCY BABY bumped, resulting in both horses becoming badly unbalanced.
From the outside barrier, SUPER SWEET ORANGE was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After the 1200 Metres, SUPER SWEET ORANGE got its head up on a number of occasions when proving difficult to settle.
After the 800 Metres, SMART SALUTE was left racing wide and without cover.
Near the 500 Metres, WORLD RECORD got its head on the side and shifted out towards the heels of SUPER SWEET ORANGE.
Shortly after entering the Straight, DIVINE DIYA was steadied when disappointed for running between TEAM SWEET and EQUITY DOCTRINE.
The Stewards inquired into the reason for Apprentice K K Chiong being dislodged from SUPER MAN passing the 350 Metres.  After taking evidence from Apprentice Chiong, in the presence of her allocated trainer, Mr K W Lui, N Callan (GAINFULJET) and Apprentice H N Wong (SMART SALUTE), it was established that rounding the Home Turn Apprentice Chiong attempted to shift SMART SALUTE out and improve between that horse and GAINFULJET where there was insufficient room.  After being disappointed for running, SUPER MAN then continued to race close to the heels of GAINFULJET and SMART SALUTE when held up for clear running.  SUPER MAN was consequently checked for some distance when unable to improve and passing the 350 Metres clipped the heels of SMART SALUTE and blundered badly, resulting in Apprentice Chiong being dislodged.  Apprentice Chiong was advised that she must show better judgement than she did on this occasion when positioning her mounts to obtain runs.  When Apprentice Chiong was dislodged from SUPER MAN, WORLD RECORD, which was following, was severely checked out away from the heels of that horse.  ROCK THE TREE, which was racing outside WORLD RECORD, was inconvenienced and AUDACITY, which was following SUPER MAN, was also hampered in consequence.  A veterinary inspection of SUPER MAN immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, SUPER MAN will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  After the race, Apprentice Chiong was examined by the Club's medical officers and passed fit to fulfil her remaining race riding engagements.
Near the 250 Metres, TEAM SWEET raced in restricted room between EQUITY DOCTRINE and FOREVER ACCURATE which shifted in marginally.
A veterinary inspection of WORLD RECORD immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
TEAM SWEET, RUN FORREST and REGENCY BABY were sent for sampling.

GOLD TALENT was withdrawn on 2.9.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (sore right fore tendon) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter BEST REWARD (Apprentice H N Wong).  Before being allowed to race again, GOLD TALENT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
HAPPY FIERY DRAGON began only fairly.
EMPIRE OF MONGOLIA, which was fractious in the barriers, began awkwardly and lost ground.
From a wide barrier, ROUNDABOUT was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
FOREVER POSH lost its right hind plate in the early stages.
After the 1300 Metres, G-ONE UNION got its head up when being steadied to obtain cover.
Near the 950 Metres, RICHCITY FORTUNE momentarily raced in restricted room inside SMILING GLORY which got its head on the side and shifted in.
Near the 800 Metres, G-ONE UNION got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of FOREVER POSH.  RICHCITY FORTUNE, which was following, was inconvenienced in consequence.
RICHCITY FORTUNE was held up for clear running passing the 300 Metres.
Passing the 100 Metres, SMILING GLORY shifted in abruptly, resulting in its rider having to stop riding and straighten his mount.
In the Straight, FOREVER POSH lay out under pressure.
Throughout the race, TRENDIFUL travelled wide and without cover.
Apprentice H T Mo was spoken to regarding the amount of whip he used on EMPIRE OF MONGOLIA in the Straight when that horse was out of contention.
When questioned, J Moreira (SMILING GLORY) stated that, from barrier 10, he had been asked to positon his mount behind the leaders with cover if possible.  He said after initially riding his mount along out of the barriers it became apparent to him that a number of horses were also being ridden to obtain forward positions and he felt that to continue riding his mount along would likely have resulted in SMILING GLORY having to race very wide and possibly without cover.  He said he therefore elected to steady his mount shortly after the start and obtain a position with cover closer to the rail.  He said he was initially not able to shift across behind G-ONE UNION as that horse was also being steadied to obtain cover.  He said approaching the 1000 Metres he attempted to improve between G-ONE UNION and RICHCITY FORTUNE to obtain a more forward position, however, he was unable to obtain this position without causing interference to RICHCITY FORTUNE and therefore he elected to steady his mount and race behind G-ONE UNION which resulted in the horse racing further back in the field than he had hoped.  He added SMILING GLORY raced greenly throughout the race and he recommended to connections that they consider adding blinkers to the horse's gear in its future starts.
A veterinary inspection of FOREVER POSH, G-ONE UNION and SMILING GLORY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SMILING GLORY, ROUNDABOUT and BOLD STITCH were sent for sampling.

Whilst in the saddling stalls, FISH N' CHIPS had its right front plate refitted.  FISH N' CHIPS was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
LOOKS LIKE THE CAT shifted out abruptly on jumping despite the efforts of its rider, resulting in FLYING FORCE and DIAMOND DRAGON being badly crowded for room inside FISH N' CHIPS.
BEAUTY CONNECTION began awkwardly.
Approaching the 800 Metres, MR RIGHT got its head on the side and lay out, resulting in EASY TOUCH being awkwardly placed outside the heels of MR RIGHT.
Passing the 600 Metres, ENDEARING lost ground when reluctant to maintain its position between MR RIGHT and FLYING FORCE.
Passing the 400 Metres, MR RIGHT shifted in and inconvenienced DIAMOND DRAGON.
Approaching the 200 Metres, WINFULL PATROL was steadied when momentarily crowded for room outside FLYING FORCE (D Whyte).  D Whyte was advised to exercise more care.
Passing the 150 Metres, DIAMOND DRAGON was shifted in away from the heels of FISH N' CHIPS to obtain clear running.
After the race, J Moreira stated that LUCKY CELEBRITY did not feel comfortable in its action at any stage of the race and even after the race did not feel as though it was stretching out properly.  A veterinary inspection of LUCKY CELEBRITY immediately following the race, including an endoscopic examination, showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, LUCKY CELEBRITY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of MR RIGHT and WINFULL PATROL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
WINFULL PATROL, ADVENTURER and LOOKS LIKE THE CAT were sent for sampling.

FABULOUS NOVEMBER, which was fractious in the barriers, was slow to begin.
Despite being ridden along in the early stages, CAREFREE LET GO failed to muster speed.
ELITE SPIRIT shifted out at the start and hampered ORIONIDS.
From the outside barrier, LOTUS BREEZE was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Near the 1050 Metres, RADIANT STEED was steadied when crowded for room inside IRON BOY which was taken in by CHARITY GLORY which in turn was taken in momentarily by MULTIMAX (Apprentice K K Chiong).  Apprentice Chiong was reprimanded and advised to ensure that she leaves comfortable racing room for runners to her inside in future.  CAPE THE FAITH, which was following, got its head up when being steadied away from the heels of RADIANT STEED in consequence.
Making the first turn after the 900 Metres, ELITE SPIRIT was steadied when racing in restricted room between LOTUS BREEZE and RADIANT STEED, both of which shifted slight ground.
Near the 850 Metres, CHARITY GLORY was steadied away from the heels of ORIONIDS.
Over the final 200 Metres, GREEN CARD was not able to obtain clear running and consequently was not properly tested.
Near the 50 Metres, CAREFREE LET GO raced tight inside EXPEDITE which shifted in under pressure, resulting in its rider having to stop riding and straighten.
Over the concluding stages, IRON BOY raced in restricted room between MULTIMAX which shifted out marginally under pressure and CHARITY GLORY (N Rawiller) which shifted in.  Due to CHARITY GLORY shifting in, N Rawiller stopped riding and straightened his mount.
Close to the finishing line, CAPE THE FAITH raced tight inside ORIONIDS which got its head on the side and shifted in, resulting in its rider having to stop riding and straighten.
Throughout the race, SUNNY ORIENT travelled wide and without cover and in the Straight gave ground.
A veterinary inspection of SUNNY ORIENT and CAREFREE LET GO immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GREEN CARD, MULTIMAX and CHARITY GLORY were sent for sampling.

YORKSHIRE DALES began awkwardly.
PEOPLE'S KNIGHT began only fairly.
From wide barriers, BABA MAMA and ENORMOUS HONOUR were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Near the 1250 Metres, YORKSHIRE DALES got its head up and became unbalanced.
Passing the 300 Metres, SMART BOY, JOYFUL MOMENTS and CHEERFUL BOY raced tight.
Passing the 200 Metres, CHEERFUL BOY was bumped by JOYFUL MOMENTS which was momentarily crowded for room outside SMART BOY.
Over the final 200 Metres, BABA MAMA got its head on the side and lay in under pressure.
After the race, N Rawiller (ENORMOUS HONOUR) stated that his mount was reluctant to stretch out during the race.  A veterinary inspection of ENORMOUS HONOUR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
When questioned, Apprentice H T Mo stated that he had been asked to position CHEERFUL BOY behind the leaders if possible from a wide barrier.  He said in the early stages he was left racing wide and without cover and for this reason he allowed his mount to improve to race outside the leaders after the 800 Metres.  He added however that he was unable to cross BEAUTY KINGDOM which resulted in CHEERFUL BOY being forced to race three wide and without cover throughout.
After the race, J Moreira (PEOPLE'S KNIGHT) reported that although he was required to race in a three wide position, he was able to maintain cover throughout the race.  He said PEOPLE'S KNIGHT travelled reasonably well in the early and middle stages, however, he was required to shift out into a four wide position around BALAY BALAY near the 600 Metres as that horse commenced to give ground.  He added shortly after this PEOPLE'S KNIGHT came under heavy pressure and, despite being ridden out, was disappointing in its failure to finish off the race.  A veterinary inspection of PEOPLE'S KNIGHT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of PEOPLE'S KNIGHT was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, PEOPLE'S KNIGHT will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of JOYFUL MOMENTS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
BABA MAMA and SMART BOY were sent for sampling.

FORMULA GALORE was withdrawn on 6.9.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right hind) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter FORZA AVANTI (Y T Cheng).  Before being allowed to race again, FORMULA GALORE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
FORZA AVANTI began awkwardly and lost its right front plate shortly after the start.
GREAT SPEED was crowded for room on jumping between SMART GAIN and SHINING CHAMPION which shifted in.  In this incident, SMART GAIN became unbalanced after being bumped on the hindquarters by GREAT SPEED.
Shortly after the start, INTELLECTUAL GLIDE was steadied away from the heels of IDYLLIC WIND which shifted out.
From wide barriers, OPTIMISM and KING OF SMARTS were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After the 700 Metres, IDYLLIC WIND got its head on the side and lay out and making the turn near the 550 Metres was awkwardly placed inside the heels of GIDDY GIDDY.
Near the 650 Metres, SMART GAIN was awkwardly placed close to the heels of GIDDY GIDDY.
Passing the 250 Metres, FORZA AVANTI was shifted out away from the heels of FOREVER FUN.
Close to the finishing line, SHINING CHAMPION was bumped by GREAT SPEED (T H So) which shifted in under pressure.  T H So was reprimanded and reminded of his obligation to stop riding and straighten his mounts when they commence to shift ground.
Throughout the race, FORZA AVANTI travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, N Rawiller stated that he was instructed to have FOREVER FUN in a forward position.  He said FOREVER FUN began awkwardly and then, despite being ridden along in the early stages, did not show the anticipated early speed.  He said the race was run at a particularly quick tempo in the early stages which resulted in FOREVER FUN racing further back in the field than had been intended.  A veterinary inspection of FOREVER FUN immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, FOREVER FUN will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned regarding the performance of RUGBY DIAMOND, Apprentice K K Chiong stated that after having to be ridden along in the early stages to obtain the lead, RUGBY DIAMOND travelled well in the middle stages.  She said RUGBY DIAMOND appeared to be travelling well rounding the Home Turn, however, shortly after entering the Straight came under pressure and then did not respond to her riding and was disappointing.  A veterinary inspection of RUGBY DIAMOND immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of OPTIMISM immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ORIENTAL FANTASIA and GREAT SPEED were sent for sampling.
<8/9/2016  Additional Veterinary Report>FOREVER FUN, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time it was lame in its right front leg.  FOREVER FUN was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer K L Man this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be also lame in its right hind leg.  As previously advised, FOREVER FUN will be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.

BORN TO RACE and RISING POWER began only fairly.
MASTER GOLD shifted in at the start and bumped PENNY LANE.  After this, MASTER GOLD and ST YAZIN, from the outside barriers, were shifted across behind runners.
GENTILIS began only fairly, shifted out at the start and bumped ROCKET LET WIN.  GENTILIS was then steadied after becoming unbalanced a short distance later when crowded for room between ROCKET LET WIN and EMPEROR VICTORY which shifted out marginally.  This resulted in GENTILIS racing back in the field.  Then making the first turn near the 1050 Metres, GENTILIS commenced to prove very difficult to settle, got its head up, shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of ROCKET LET WIN which became unbalanced.  GENTILIS continued to prove very difficult to settle for some distance after this and was very awkwardly placed close to the heels of ROCKET LET WIN.
In the early stages, PENNY LANE was left racing wide and without cover and after the 800 Metres was ridden along in an attempt to obtain a more forward position.
Near the 1000 Metres, RISING POWER got its head up when being steadied away from the heels of GENTILIS when that horse was awkwardly placed inside the heels of ROCKET LET WIN.
Making the turn near the 550 Metres, EMPEROR VICTORY and MISSION POSSIBLE raced tight.
A veterinary inspection of GENTILIS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FLYING MONKEY and MISSION POSSIBLE were sent for sampling.

HIGH SPEED METRO and SPEEDY WALLY bumped at the start.
MIGHTY WONGCHOY shifted out on jumping and inconvenienced PRECIOUS GEM.
Shortly after the start, DRAGON GLORY bumped MI SAVVY BOY.
From the outside barrier, BEST JADE TRIUMPH was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Approaching the 1000 Metres, PRECIOUS GEM was left racing wide and without cover and after the 900 Metres was allowed to improve its position closer to the lead, however, continued to race wide and without cover.
Approaching the 800 Metres, SPEEDY WALLY got its head up when being checked away from the heels of FLYING MACHINE.
Approaching the Home Turn, GLAMOROUS RYDER was awkwardly placed behind SAFARI MAGIC.
Rounding the Home Turn, DRAGON GLORY was hampered when crowded for room outside FLYING MACHINE which shifted out away from the heels of MIGHTY WONGCHOY.
Approaching and passing the 250 Metres, FLYING MACHINE raced tight inside PRECIOUS GEM which shifted in under pressure.  Then passing the 200 Metres, MIGHTY WONGCHOY, which was giving ground, was eased when crowded for room inside FLYING MACHINE which continued to race tight inside PRECIOUS GEM which again got its head on the side and shifted in further after being bumped by ISLAND FLYER which shifted in marginally under pressure.  After this, PRECIOUS GEM continued to race with its head on the side and lay in.
Passing the 250 Metres, YEUNG SING was shifted out across the heels of FLYING MACHINE to obtain clear running.
A veterinary inspection of FLYING MACHINE and MIGHTY WONGCHOY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FLYING MACHINE, SPEEDY WALLY and ISLAND FLYER were sent for sampling.

Just prior to the start being effected, BEST TANGO became fractious.  GRAND HARBOUR, which was in the stall immediately adjacent to BEST TANGO, also became fractious and lunged at the front gate, resulting in the gates opening.  After travelling a short distance, GRAND HARBOUR was restrained by its rider and returned to the Start where it was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said, in his opinion, it was suitable to race.
NEWSWIRE FREE began awkwardly, resulting in its rider, N Callan, becoming unbalanced.  A short distance later, NEWSWIRE FREE was steadied when bumped by SUPER SPRINTER which was taken out by MAC ROW.
GLORY STAR and LIGHTNING AND GOLD bumped at the start.
RAPID TRIUMPH was slow to begin.
From the outside barrier, BEST TANGO was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, SUPER SPRINTER momentarily raced in restricted room inside LIGHTNING AND GOLD which was taken in by NOBLE DE MAN which, when being steadied to allow SPARKLING SWORD to cross, got its head on the side and lay in.
After the 450 Metres, SUPER SPRINTER raced tight between NOBLE DE MAN and LIGHTNING AND GOLD which shifted out.
LIGHTNING AND GOLD lost its right front plate near the 400 Metres.
In the early part of the Straight, NOBLE DE MAN lay in under pressure.
Approaching the 300 Metres, RAPID TRIUMPH shifted in away from the heels of FAITHFUL BOY and then raced tight inside that horse approaching the 250 Metres.  FAITHFUL BOY was then steadied away from the heels of NEWSWIRE FREE when bumped by RAPID TRIUMPH passing the 250 Metres when that horse shifted out to obtain clear running.
Passing the 300 Metres, LIGHTNING AND GOLD and SUPER SPRINTER bumped due to SUPER SPRINTER shifting in and LIGHTNING AND GOLD attempting to shift out from behind GLORY STAR.
Near the 50 Metres, RAPID TRIUMPH raced in restricted room inside NEWSWIRE FREE.
When questioned regarding the improved performance of SUPER FORM, Trainer A T Millard stated that prior to its racing career commencing in Hong Kong, the horse had experienced considerable front tendon issues which resulted in him not being able to have the horse as fit as he would have liked.  He said following the off season, he had been able to give SUPER FORM a better preparation which included two barrier trials.  He added whilst SUPER FORM did fail on one occasion last season on a "Good to Yielding" track, he believed the rain affected track tonight had suited SUPER FORM given that the horse was much fitter than it was when racing on a similar surface last season.
When questioned, Apprentice K K Chiong (NOBLE DE MAN) stated that after the 1000 Metres she was following GLORY STAR and had SUPER SPRINTER positioned to her inside.  She said although there was a gap ahead of NOBLE DE MAN to improve its position to be racing closer to GLORY STAR, she felt that she would have had to ride NOBLE DE MAN along at that time to make up this ground.  She said as she was reluctant to ride her mount aggressively at this time, SUPER SPRINTER was then able to improve its position slightly and then shift NOBLE DE MAN out approaching the 800 Metres.  She said as SUPER SPRINTER was shifting out, she attempted to ride NOBLE DE MAN forward to prevent that horse from being able to shift away from the rail, however, she was unable to do so and this resulted in NOBLE DE MAN being forced into a three wide position without cover for the remainder of the race.  Apprentice Chiong conceded that, in retrospect, she should have ridden NOBLE DE MAN along prior to the 900 Metres so as to maintain a margin over SUPER SPRINTER and prevent that horse from shifting out.  She was advised that in future she should ride her mounts with more judgement that she did on this occasion so that she is able to maintain advantageous positions.
A veterinary inspection of GRAND HARBOUR, SUPER SPRINTER and FAITHFUL BOY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SUPER SPRINTER, SUPER FORM and GLORY STAR were sent for sampling.

HELEN'S CHOICE lost ground when crowded for room on jumping between GLOBE TROTTER and GOLDEN GLORY which shifted out.  In this incident, GLOBE TROTTER became unbalanced when bumped by HELEN'S CHOICE and racing tight inside YO-YO DA.
When being steadied to obtain a position with cover, SHARP HUNTER was crowded for room shortly after the start between VICTORY MARVEL and LONDON MASTER, both of which shifted ground.
From the outside barriers, WINNING STAR and ROYAL SPIRIT were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
J Moreira (GLORY HORSIE) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 900 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of YO-YO DA, causing that horse to be checked and to lose the running to which it was rightfully entitled.  J Moreira was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 18 September 2016 and to expire on Thursday, 22 September 2016 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, J Moreira was fined $60,000.
After the 800 Metres, SHARP HUNTER shifted out away from the heels of VICTORY MARVEL when proving difficult to settle.  After this, SHARP HUNTER continued to prove difficult to settle
Approaching the 700 Metres, ROYAL SPIRIT momentarily raced tight between SHARP HUNTER and VICTORIUS which got its head on the side and shifted out despite the efforts of its rider.
Rounding the Home Turn, ROYAL SPIRIT was awkwardly placed close to the heels of YO-YO DA.
The performance of HELEN'S CHOICE, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, HELEN'S CHOICE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned, Apprentice K K Chiong stated that prior to the 500 Metres SUPREME FLIGHT was in a position racing behind the leader GOLDEN GLORY which showed far superior speed in the early stages and was able to cross SUPREME FLIGHT.  She said after the 500 Metres she observed that LONDON MASTER was laying out and therefore she positioned SUPREME FLIGHT to take advantage of a run which she anticipated would develop between LONDON MASTER and GOLDEN GLORY.  She said rounding the Home Turn LONDON MASTER did shift out which momentarily provided a run between that horse and GOLDEN GLORY, however, before SUPREME FLIGHT was able to improve into this position, LONDON MASTER then shifted in, resulting in SUPREME FLIGHT being disappointed for the run.  She added SUPREME FLIGHT was then not able to improve to the outside of LONDON MASTER due to GLORY HORSIE laying in and therefore she was again disappointed for running between those horses.  She said she was therefore obliged to shift to the outside of GLORY HORSIE and it was only after the 200 Metres that SUPREME FLIGHT was able to obtain clear running.  After viewing the videos, Apprentice Chiong was advised that her explanation was accepted.
When questioned regarding the performance of YO-YO DA, N Callan stated that he had ridden the horse in some of its work leading up to tonight's race including in a barrier trial.  He said based on the manner in which the horse had been working, it was anticipated that YO-YO DA would run well.  He added it was also felt that YO-YO DA would be able to obtain a good trailing position behind what was anticipated to be good speed and this would suit the horse.  He said in the early stages he was able to obtain a forward position and although the horse encountered interference near the 900 Metres, it was able to recover from this and travelled strongly in the middle stages.  He added after coming under pressure after the 500 Metres YO-YO DA did not respond to his riding and was most disappointing in the manner in which it weakened in the Straight.  He said although YO-YO DA did not feel sore after the race, it did not appear to be stretching out comfortably.  A veterinary inspection of YO-YO DA immediately following the race did not show any significant findings other than the horse had lost its right hind plate (near the 400 Metres) and had sustained wounds to the back of its right hind leg.  The performance of YO-YO DA, which finished near the rear of the field, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, YO-YO DA will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of VICTORIUS immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, VICTORIUS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of, GOLDEN GLORY and HELEN'S CHOICE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
VICTORY MARVEL and SHARP HUNTER were sent for sampling.

REGENCY KING was slow to begin.
CHATER LEGEND was crowded for room shortly after the start between HO HO FEEL and LOTUS STRIKES BACK which shifted in.
Close to the finishing line, JOLLY GENE was awkwardly placed behind CHATER LEGEND which was awkwardly placed close to the heels of HO HO FEEL.
For the majority of the race, JOLLY GENE travelled wide and without cover.
Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the riding of Y T Cheng (LUCKY HAMMER), 5th placegetter, over the concluding stages did not affect the horseâs finishing position, he was nonetheless reminded of his obligation to ride his mounts out at least hands and heels to the end of the race where circumstances permit.
When questioned, K Teetan stated that, from barrier 11, he was asked to ride GOLDEN SLEEP with cover in a position behind midfield.  He said he was able to be successful on SUPER FORM in Race 4 after that horse was ridden back in the field and it was felt that horses racing up on the pace had not been able to close off in the earlier races.  He said it was also felt that tonightâs race would be run at a strong tempo and therefore it would be in the best interests of GOLDEN SLEEP not to be ridden forward from a wide barrier as it may result in the horse having to race wide given there were a number of horses drawn better than GOLDEN SLEEP which had previously shown good speed.  He said he was initially able to shift GOLDEN SLEEP across behind runners to follow JOLLY GENE, however, the horse commenced to prove difficult to settle and got its head up after the 1000 Metres when being checked away from the heels of JOLLY GENE.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of KING OF MONGOLIA, J Moreira stated that, from the inside barrier, he was able to obtain a good trailing position behind the leader LUCKY HAMMER and KING OF MONGOLIA travelled well in the early and middle stages.  He said he was able to shift away from the rail rounding the Home Turn and he expected KING OF MONGOLIA to finish off the race well, however, the horse came under pressure after the 300 Metres and then was disappointing in the manner in which it failed to respond to his riding in the Straight.  He added he had ridden KING OF MONGOLIA on two occasions previously and the horse did not let down tonight as it had on those occasions.  A veterinary inspection of KING OF MONGOLIA immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
KING OF MONGOLIA, HO HO FEEL and HAPPY CONTENDER were sent for sampling.

Just prior to the start being effected, FIVE UP HIGH became fractious and as the start was effected reared, losing a significant amount of ground.  Before being allowed to race again, FIVE UP HIGH will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.
From wide barriers, FANTASTIC FEELING and SUNNY WIN were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
FLYING TOURBILLON travelled wide and without cover until near the 800 Metres after which THE SHOW was left racing wide and without cover.
Shortly after entering the Straight, HANG'S DECISION shifted out and bumped THE SHOW.
Approaching the 250 Metres, THE SHOW was steadied away from the heels of HANG'S DECISION which, after being taken out by GRACE HEART, then shifted out further away from that horse.
HANG'S DECISION and LUCKY PROFIT were sent for sampling.

From the outside barrier, PABLOSKY got its head up on a number of occasions when being steadied in order to be shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After the 700 Metres, HIGH FIVE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of HAMMER KING after initially being taken out by TRAVEL RENYI.
Rounding the Home Turn, MAJESTIC ANTHEM was awkwardly placed close to the heels of TRAVEL RENYI.
At the entrance to the Straight, BULLISH SMART was disappointed for running between RIGHTEOUS and ALMABABY which shifted in after initially laying out rounding the Home Turn.
Passing the 300 Metres, HIGH FIVE shifted to the outside of HAMMER KING after being disappointed for running inside that horse which got its head on the side and shifted in.  After this, HAMMER KING continued to lay in under pressure in the Straight.
When questioned, Y T Cheng stated that he had been instructed to take up a forward position on ALMABABY in accordance with the horse's usual racing pattern.  He said he rode ALMABABY aggressively in the early stages, however, making the first turn was left racing very wide and in between RIGHTEOUS and HELLA HEDGE, both of which were also being hard ridden.  He said after having made a lot of use of ALMABABY in the early stages, he felt that he would have had to make too much further use of his mount to clear RIGHTEOUS on his inside and therefore he elected, making the first turn, to steady his mount and obtain a position with cover.  He said making the turn approaching the 1000 Metres ALMABABY became unbalanced when crowded for room between RIGHTEOUS and HELLA HEDGE which lay in.  He added after making the first turn he was unable to obtain cover and consequently was left racing in a three wide position outside the leader.  He said making the Home Turn ALMABABY got its head on the side and hung out.  He said he then balanced ALMABABY up and rode the horse out in the Straight, however, it gave ground.
When questioned, Apprentice K K Chiong (CHARITY JOY) stated that she had been asked to ride the horse behind the leaders if possible, however, she was not to ride it aggressively to do so as it had proved difficult to settle in some of its previous races.  She said after beginning only fairly CHARITY JOY was crowded for room between RIGHTEOUS and HAMMER KING which was taken out by MAJESTIC ANTHEM which resulted in the horse being placed further back in the field than had been intended.  She said making the first turn she was reluctant to ride her mount along given her instructions and therefore she allowed the eventual winner BLOCKER DEE to cross CHARITY JOY approaching the 1000 Metres and elected to follow that horse throughout the race.  She said, despite riding CHARITY JOY along near the 400 Metres, BLOCKER DEE showed  a superior turn of foot and she was not able to follow that horse into the Straight.  She added at the entrance to the Straight she shifted her mount to the outside of runners and CHARITY JOY then finished off the race satisfactorily.  The Stewards will question Mr C S Shum, the trainer of CHARITY JOY, prior to the races at the Sha Tin Racecourse on Sunday, 11 September 2016 prior to this matter being concluded. 
BLOCKER DEE and MR BOGART were sent for sampling.

On arrival at the Start, STORM KID, which was keen during the preliminary and took charge of its rider for a short distance, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed fit to start.
SHOWING CHARACTER was crowded for room on jumping between PERFECT SMART and ALL TOGETHER, both of which shifted ground.
LEAN JOURNEY began awkwardly and was then shifted across behind runners to obtain a position closer to the outside rail in the early stages.
Passing the 900 Metres, ALL TOGETHER got its head on the side, shifted out and bumped MIGHTY GAINS.  ALL TOGETHER then became unbalanced and shifted in, resulting in SHOWING CHARACTER being hampered.
Also passing the 900 Metres, RICCO RICCO was steadied away from the heels of KING'S STEED.
For some distance after the 700 Metres, RICCO RICCO was awkwardly placed close to the heels of KING'S STEED and passing the 500 Metres was directed in away from the heels of MIGHTY GAINS.
Passing the 400 Metres, KING'S STEED was steadied away from the heels of SHOWING CHARACTER which, when attempting to improve to the outside of ALL TOGETHER, was taken out by that horse.
LEAN JOURNEY was held up for clear running passing the 350 Metres and then had difficulty obtaining clear running after the 200 Metres.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that RICCO RICCO had bled from both nostrils. 
A veterinary inspection of FAST ROCKET immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
LEAN JOURNEY, ACE KING and PERFECT SMART were sent for sampling.

UNIQUE JOYOUS was checked on jumping when crowded for room between DASHING KING and BALAY BALAY which shifted out.
From the outside barriers, AMAZING AGILITY and WINNIE'S HONEY were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the 1500 Metres, BALAY BALAY shifted out and bumped DASHING KING.
Approaching the 700 Metres, WINNIE'S HONEY was awkwardly placed close to the heels of AMAZINGLY.
WINNAM and AMAZINGLY were held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Passing the 400 Metres, WINNIE'S HONEY was shifted to the inside of AMAZINGLY when that horse drifted out under pressure.
Approaching the 100 Metres, WINNIE'S HONEY, which was closing off well, was shifted out away from the heels of INDUSTRIALIST WAY and then near the 50 Metres shifted out further away from the heels of WINNAM.
After the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on RHODE ASSASSIN at the request of Trainer C S Shum.  The Veterinary Surgeon reported that this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, RHODE ASSASSIN will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of DASHING KING and UNIQUE JOYOUS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CALIFORNIA JOY and REDWOOD BABY were sent for sampling.

UNIQUE AWESOME began awkwardly.
HAPPY WAY WINNER began only fairly.
PEARL WIN shifted out at the start, resulting in DASHING SUPER and FAIRY TWINS being hampered.
Shortly after the start, AMBITIOUS HEART was steadied to obtain a position with cover.
From the outside barriers, CLEVER SPIRIT, GORGEOUS AGAIN and VICTOR EMPEROR were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Approaching the 1000 Metres, AMBITIOUS HEART got its head up on a number of occasions when proving difficult to settle.
Making the first turn near the 900 Metres, UNIQUE AWESOME was eased away from the heels of UNIQUE JOYFUL which shifted in.
Near the 350 Metres, AMBITIOUS HEART was shifted away from the heels of DASHING SUPER to obtain clear running.
When questioned, Mr R Gibson, the trainer of PLANET GIANT, stated that he had instructed M L Yeung to ride PLANET GIANT more patiently today than is usual due to the horse having drawn barrier 8 and being first up.  He said he felt that were PLANET GIANT to be ridden along to obtain a forward position, the horse would then not be able to finish off its race.  He said he had hoped that PLANET GIANT would be able to obtain cover, however, the circumstances of the race resulted in PLANET GIANT being left racing in a midfield position without cover.  Mr Gibson was advised of the requirement to ensure that horses are ridden in such a manner so that they can finish off their race the best they are able, irrespective of whether they are first up or otherwise.
A veterinary inspection of CLEVER SPIRIT and PLANET GIANT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FAIRY TWINS and RUMINARE were sent for sampling.

On arrival at the Start, D Whyte, the rider of GLORY SUNSHINE, expressed concern regarding the horse's action.  GLORY SUNSHINE was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was lame in the left hind leg and accordingly was not suitable to race.  Acting on this advice, GLORY SUNSHINE was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  Before being allowed to race again, GLORY SUNSHINE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
DYNAMIC VOYAGE began only fairly and was then ridden along to obtain a forward position.
Shortly after the start, FANTASTICLIFE lost ground when crowded for room between PERFECT TIMING and BERNARD'S CHOICE, both of which shifted ground.
From the outside barrier, GOOD FOR YOU was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the 700 Metres, AMBITIOUS SPEEDY and CASH COURIER bumped.
Throughout the race, DASHING FORTUNE and CASH COURIER travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned regarding her riding of SILVER GATSBY, particularly in the Straight, Apprentice K K Chiong stated that she had been instructed to try and lead if possible.  She said she rode SILVER GATSBY aggressively in the early stages, however, the horse did not show sufficient early speed to be able to lead and SILVER GATSBY was obliged to travel behind the speed.  She said, despite again being ridden along approaching the 700 Metres, SILVER GATSBY was reluctant to maintain its position between JIMSON THE FAMOUS and DASHING FORTUNE and the horse gave ground at this time.  She added she again commenced to ride SILVER GATSBY along rounding the Home Turn and attempted to shift out away from behind DASHING FORTUNE to obtain clear running in the early part of the Straight.  She said as she did this, GOOD FOR YOU improved its position to the inside of SILVER GATSBY.  She said due to BERNARD'S CHOICE being positioned to the outside of DASHING FORTUNE, she was not able to shift to the outside of DASHING FORTUNE and was then held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight.  She said a run developed between BERNARD'S CHOICE and DASHING FORTUNE near the 300 Metres, however, SILVER GATSBY was unable to improve into the run prior to DASHING FORTUNE shifting out.  She said SILVER GATSBY was then held up for clear running behind DASHING FORTUNE for a short distance after this.  When questioned as to why she did not shift in to obtain clear running inside DASHING FORTUNE, Apprentice Chiong stated that at that time she was racing just to the outside of DASHING FORTUNE and was unaware that there was clear running to the inside of that horse.  Apprentice Chiong was advised that, in the opinion of the Stewards, she should have been more alert to the fact that clear running had developed to the inside of DASHING FORTUNE.  She was further advised to ensure that she positions her mounts so as to ensure that they are given every opportunity to obtain clear running.
A veterinary inspection of CASH COURIER and SILVER GATSBY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GOOD FOR YOU and SNOWHOOVES were sent for sampling.

SALSA BROTHERS began only fairly.
WINNING VIBE began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped MODERN FORTUNE.  MODERN FORTUNE was then shifted across behind runners.
DR RACE was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
From the outside barrier, ROYAL PARTNER was taken across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the 900 Metres, A BEAUTIFUL was awkwardly placed close to the heels of BO DUKE.
After the 800 Metres, SALSA BROTHERS raced keenly.
Approaching the 200 Metres, ROYAL PARTNER was shifted out across the heels of A BEAUTIFUL after being disappointed for running inside that horse.
Over the final 150 Metres, A BEAUTIFUL was not able to obtain clear running and consequently was not able to be tested.
Over the concluding stages, FURIOUS PEGASUS was awkwardly placed close to the heels of SMILING GLORY and consequently was not able to be properly ridden out all the way to the end of the race.
Throughout the race, WINNING VIBE and I'M THE WON FOR U travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of A BEAUTIFUL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A BEAUTIFUL, SMILING GLORY and LANSBURY were sent for sampling.

After being loaded, INVENTION MASTER became fractious, reared and momentarily sat down.  INVENTION MASTER was removed from the barriers and examined by the Veterinary Officer who said the horse was suitable to race.  Before being allowed to race again, INVENTION MASTER will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.
DIVINE DIYA shifted out at the start and bumped EXCELLENCE, resulting in DIVINE DIYA losing ground.
Shortly after the start, SOUL ACHIEVER was steadied and shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
GREAT TOPLIGHT travelled keenly in the early stages.
From a wide barrier, FIONN'S CITY was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Despite being aggressively ridden in the early stages, FORTUNE GIGGLES failed to muster speed.
After the 1200 Metres, FIONN'S CITY commenced to prove very difficult to settle and shifted out abruptly away from the heels of SOUL ACHIEVER, resulting in FORTUNE GIGGLES being taken wider.  FIONN'S CITY continued to prove difficult to settle after this and travelled wide and without cover.  Having regard to FIONN'S CITY's previous racing history, the Stewards ruled that prior to being permitted to race again, that horse will be required to barrier trial satisfactorily around a bend.
DIVINE DIYA lost its left front plate passing the 1100 Metres.
Approaching the 500 Metres, EXCELLENCE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of DIVINE DIYA.
Approaching the 300 Metres, EXCELLENCE shifted out and bumped PACKING STARCRAFT.
INVENTION MASTER was unable to obtain clear running from the 300 Metres until passing the 150 Metres at which time the horse was shifted out across the heels of MAGNETISM to obtain clear running.
Throughout the race, CHEERFUL FRAME travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of LONDON CITY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
REWARDING FLYER and MAGNETISM were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE CHINESE RECREATION CLUB CHALLENGE CUP (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
NOBLE DE BOY was withdrawn on 10.9.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter LOOK ERAS (Apprentice H N Wong).  Before being allowed to race again, NOBLE DE BOY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
As the start was effected, GOLDEN DEER became fractious and then began awkwardly, losing a considerable amount of ground.  Before being allowed to race again, GOLDEN DEER will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.
Shortly after the start, ORIONIDS was crowded for room between LOTUS BREEZE and EASY TOUCH which was taken out by VARA PEARL.
From a wide barrier, HAPPY CHEERS was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Making the turn after the 800 Metres, ORIONIDS commenced to prove difficult to settle and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of TRAVEL SUCCESSOR.
Rounding the Home Turn, ORIONIDS was again awkwardly placed behind TRAVEL SUCCESSOR.
Passing the 300 Metres, EASY TOUCH was momentarily awkwardly placed outside the heels of LOTUS BREEZE (T H So) which shifted out under pressure.  T H So was advised to exercise more care.
Approaching the 100 Metres, LOTUS BREEZE briefly raced tight inside LUCKY DAY.
Throughout the race, LOOK ERAS travelled wide and without cover.
The Stewards considered an application lodged by Z Purton, the rider of CHEVALIER STAR to be declared a non-runner.  After taking evidence from Jockey Purton, Mr J Moore, the trainer of CHEVALIER STAR, and Mr A Speechley, the Starter and after viewing the official videos, it was established that after being placed in the barriers, a blindfold was applied to CHEVALIER STAR which is customary practice as that horse has a history of barrier issues.  The Stewards heard evidence that the blindfold was to be removed late in an attempt to prevent the horse from becoming fractious.  The Stewards found however that as the start was effected, the blindfold was still in the process of being removed from CHEVALIER STAR and was across the eyes of that horse at the relevant time.  Having regard to CHEVALIER STAR's normal racing pattern of racing up on speed, the Stewards ruled that CHEVALIER STAR had not been afforded a fair start and accordingly that horse was declared a non-runner.
A veterinary inspection of CHEVALIER STAR and GOLDEN DEER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of LOOK ERAS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
REGENCY DARLING, LUCKY DAY and LOTUS BREEZE were sent for sampling.

Trainer D Cruz was fined the sum of $3,000 for presenting HEALTH WISE in the Parade Ring with the incorrect bit.  The bit was changed prior to the horse racing.
AMAZING ALWAYS shifted out at the start and bumped the hindquarters of HIT A HOME RUN which became unbalanced.
CIRCUIT FORTUNE shifted out at the start and hampered HEALTH WISE.
SUPERNATURAL and GOLD DRAGON bumped at the start.
In the early stages, RED PEONY travelled keenly.
HEALTH WISE lost its left hind plate near the 1200 Metres.
The performance of HEALTH WISE, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, HEALTH WISE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned, B Prebble (AZTEC EMPIRE) stated that, from the outside barrier, he had been instructed to obtain a forward position with cover if possible as the connections did not want the horse pushed along to obtain the lead given that there were a number of horses which had been ridden in forward positions in their previous races.  He said in the early stages he attempted to shift AZTEC EMPIRE across to obtain a position with cover behind the speed, however, because of the make-up of the field in the early stages, AZTEC EMPIRE was left racing wide, nonetheless he was able to initially find some cover behind EQUITY DOCTRINE.  He said he did give consideration to going forward on AZTEC EMPIRE approaching the 1000 Metres as the tempo of the race was not strong, however, as he did this, ABLE DEED, the leader of the race, shifted away from the rail which resulted in UNIQUE HAPPIEST being taken wider.  He added for this reason he did not believe that it was appropriate to ride forward as AZTEC EMPIRE may still have been required to race wide as it was unlikely that the leaders would hand up and allow AZTEC EMPIRE to obtain the lead.
A veterinary inspection of HEALTH WISE and HIT A HOME RUN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ABLE DEED and UNIQUE HAPPIEST were sent for sampling.

When in the saddling stalls, MINT MASTER lost its right hind plate.  Despite the efforts of the farriers, MINT MASTER, due to its fractious nature, was unable to be reshod and accordingly the horse was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.
After being loaded, SEA RUBY became fractious and lunged at the front gates, resulting in the horse getting down in the barriers.  SEA RUBY was removed from the barriers and examined by the Veterinary Officer who said the horse was lame in its right hind leg and had sustained a wound over the right knee and accordingly was not suitable to race.  Acting on this advice, SEA RUBY was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  In this incident, Apprentice H N Wong was dislodged from SEA RUBY without incident.  Apprentice Wong was subsequently examined by the Club's medical officers and passed fit to fulfil his remaining race riding engagement.  Before being allowed to race again, SEA RUBY will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  
TIANHUANG and LAUGH OUT LOUD were crowded for room on jumping between BRIGHT STRIKE and DIAMOND MASTER which shifted out.
GOAL FOR GOLD lost its right front plate in the early stages.
Near the 900 Metres, BRIGHT STRIKE was steadied away from the heels of DIAMOND MASTER which shifted out after being crossed by SKY HERO.
Passing the 900 Metres, NORTHERN FALLS got its head on the side and lay in, resulting in LAUGH OUT LOUD being crowded onto TIANHUANG which became unbalanced after being bumped by LAUGH OUT LOUD.  In this incident, NORTHERN FALLS also became badly unbalanced.
Throughout the race, DEJA VU travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, O Bosson stated that he had been instructed to lead on DIAMOND MASTER, however, he was given the option that if another horse was intent on leading, he could hand up so as not to get caught in a speed battle.  He said after beginning well he rode DIAMOND MASTER along to obtain a forward position on the rail.  He said it then became apparent to him that after travelling a short distance SKY HERO was being aggressively ridden to obtain the lead and having regard to the fact that he had been given the option to hand up, he elected to allow SKY HERO to cross and assume the lead, however, DIAMOND MASTER immediately commenced to travel keenly and for this reason he allowed the horse to switch to the outside of SKY HERO.  He added DIAMOND MASTER then travelled comfortably outside SKY HERO in the middle stages.  Trainer P F Yiu stated that it had been intended for DIAMOND MASTER to lead, however, he confirmed that he had given Jockey Bosson the option to steady DIAMOND MASTER if the rider of another runner was intent on leading.
The Stewards opened an inquiry into the tactics adopted by Y T Cheng on STARTLING POWER.  After taking evidence from Jockey Cheng and Mr T K Ng, the trainer of STARTLING POWER, the Stewards adjourned the inquiry until a date to be fixed.  The Stewards also adjourned an inquiry into other aspects of evidence tendered during the course of this hearing until a date to be fixed.
A veterinary inspection of STARTLING POWER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
A veterinary inspection of TIANHUANG immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SKY HERO and GOAL FOR GOLD were sent for sampling.

JUN HUO and ALL YOU WISH began only fairly.
Shortly after the start, JUN HUO was steadied when crowded for room between HORSE OF FORTUNE and I'M IN CHARGE (C Y Ho) which shifted in.  C Y Ho was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he leaves sufficient racing room for runners to his inside in similar circumstances.
From a wide barrier, SERGEANT TITANIUM, after initially being ridden along, was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Making the first turn near the 900 Metres, ROMANTIC TOUCH was steadied away from the heels of TWIN DELIGHT (K C Leung) which shifted in when not sufficiently clear.  K C Leung was severely reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is properly clear when shifting ground in similar circumstances.
ALL YOU WISH had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Near the 250 Metres, JUN HUO raced tight between BORN IN CHINA and PACKING LLAREGYB which got its head on the side and shifted out under pressure.
Passing the 200 Metres, JUN HUO and BORN IN CHINA were steadied when momentarily crowded for room between PACKING LLAREGYB and JOYFUL TRINITY (J Moreira) which shifted in.  J Moreira was advised to exercise more care.
Close to the finishing line, ROMANTIC TOUCH raced in restricted room between JOYFUL TRINITY and TWIN DELIGHT, both of which shifted ground.  In this incident, J Moreira was obliged to straighten JOYFUL TRINITY.
Throughout the race, BORN IN CHINA and PACKING LLAREGYB travelled wide and without cover.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that JUN HUO was lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, JUN HUO will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of BORN IN CHINA immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, BORN IN CHINA will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
TWIN DELIGHT and JOYFUL TRINITY were sent for sampling.

PRECIOUS GEM began awkwardly and shortly after the start was steadied away from the heels of HAPPY FRIENDSHIP which shifted out.
From a wide barrier, WINASWEWISH was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Despite being ridden along in the early stages, DRAGON BACHELOR failed to muster speed and throughout the race travelled wide and without cover.
Approaching the 1400 Metres, CROATIA (K C Ng) got its head on the side and shifted out towards the heels of WINASWEWISH which shifted in before being directed back out to relieve the pressure to CROATIA.  After the race, K C Ng reported that CROATIA hung out throughout the race and proved difficult to ride.  A veterinary inspection of CROATIA immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, CROATIA will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial around a bend and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned, C Schofield stated that MY CUP OVERFLOWS commenced to hang out rounding the first turn and after the 1400 Metres the bit pulled through the horse's mouth as a result of the manner in which it was hanging out.  He said MY CUP OVERFLOWS continued to hang out for the remainder of the race and consequently he was not able to test the horse which resulted in MY CUP OVERFLOWS becoming detached from the field.  A veterinary inspection of MY CUP OVERFLOWS immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its right front leg.  Having regard to MY CUP OVERFLOWS' previous racing history, the Stewards ruled that it must undergo a series of satisfactory consecutive barrier trials around a bend and be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.
After the race, O Doleuze was not able to offer any explanation for the disappointing performance of THIS IS GLADIATOR.  He said although the horse had previously raced on the All Weather surface, in his opinion, THIS IS GLADIATOR did not appear to appreciate the surface and the tempo of the race.  A veterinary inspection of THIS IS GLADIATOR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Before being allowed to race again, THIS IS GLADIATOR will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of HAPPY FRIENDSHIP immediately following the race found that horse to have an epiglottic entrapment.
MIGHTY WONGCHOY and JIMSON THE FAMOUS were sent for sampling.
<19/9/2016 Additional Veterinary Report>MY CUP OVERFLOWS, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time it was lame in its right front leg.  MY CUP OVERFLOWS was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer R Gibson this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be also lame in its left hind leg.  As previously advised, MY CUP OVERFLOWS will be required to perform satisfactorily in a series of consecutive barrier trials around a bend and be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.

PAKISTAN STAR was slow to begin.
From a wide barrier, ACTUARIAT was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
CITRON SPIRIT was also steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Despite being vigorously ridden along in the early stages, TEN FLAMES failed to muster speed.
RUN FORREST made the first turn near the 900 Metres awkwardly.
Making the turn after the 900 Metres, KA YING KID got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of COLOSSUS.  TEN FLAMES, which was following KA YING KID, commenced to prove very difficult to settle and after being checked away from the heels of KA YING KID got its head on the side and shifted onto the heels of AMBER DRAGON.
After the 900 Metres, RADIANT STEED was left racing wide and without cover.
CITRON SPIRIT was badly held up for clear running from rounding the Home Turn until passing the 250 Metres.
In the Straight, SUPER LEADER hung in and proved difficult to ride.
Passing the 150 Metres, RADIANT STEED was shifted to the outside of KA YING KID after being disappointed for running inside that horse.  RADIANT STEED was then steadied passing the 100 Metres when disappointed for running between KA YING KID which shifted out and SUPER LEADER which continued to hang in.
A veterinary inspection of RUN FORREST immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PAKISTAN STAR and MARVEL HERO were sent for sampling.

MANFUL STAR was withdrawn on 16.9.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (injury to left knee) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter ROCK THE TREE (H W Lai).  Before being allowed to race again, MANFUL STAR will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After being loaded into the barriers, JING JING WIN became fractious and momentarily sat down.  JING JING WIN was removed from the barriers and examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.  Before being allowed to race again, JING JING WIN will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.
Also after being loaded into the barriers, GAINFULJET became fractious and reared on several occasions.  Before being allowed to race again, GAINFULJET will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.
RICHCITY FORTUNE shifted out on jumping and bumped UNIQUE AWESOME which became unbalanced.
HASTILY FEET and BOSSIEE began only fairly.
EVERYONE'S CHOICE (T H So) began awkwardly and got its head up on a number of occasions.  T H So was advised to ensure that he gives his mounts sufficient rein so that they are able to jump cleanly.
Shortly after the start, KINGSTON JUMBO shifted in and bumped GAINFULJET which became unbalanced.
From the outside barriers, ROCK THE TREE and JUMBO HAPPINESS were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
UNIQUE AWESOME was also steadied in the early stages to obtain cover.
Making the turn after the 900 Metres, JING JING WIN was momentarily awkwardly placed close to the heels of GAINFULJET when being steadied to obtain a position outside that horse.
Throughout the race, KINGSTON JUMBO travelled wide and without cover and after the 700 Metres got its head on the side and lay out when racing ungenerously.
Passing the 400 Metres, WINNING BOY and RICHCITY FORTUNE raced tight as WINNING BOY shifted out to obtain clear running.
After the race, O Doleuze explained that rounding the Home Turn he shifted BOSSIEE away from the rail and positioned that horse to improve between RICHCITY FORTUNE and KINGSTON JUMBO.  He said however passing the 350 Metres, as he was riding BOSSIEE along to improve its position, his right stirrup leather came loose, resulting in him losing the use of this iron for the remainder of the race.  He said as a consequence he was then not able to ride out BOSSIEE.  Jockey Doleuze's evidence was supported by the video coverage of the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection of BOSSIEE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
JING JING WIN and WINNING BOY were sent for sampling.

On jumping, DIAMOND FRIENDS blundered badly, resulting in its rider, O Bosson, being dislodged.
GOOD FIT began only fairly.
DASHING SUPER shifted out at the start and bumped SALSA BROTHERS.
When being steadied from a wide barrier to obtain a position with cover, ELECTRONIC PHOENIX was bumped by GOOD FIT which was taken out by CHEERFUL FRAME.
From a wide barrier, RISING POWER was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Despite being ridden along in the early stages, CHEERFUL FRAME failed to muster speed and after the 1400 Metres was left racing wide and without cover.  Then after entering the Back Straight near the 1200 Metres, CHEERFUL FRAME was allowed to improve its position to race outside the lead.
Near the 1600 Metres, RISING POWER was steadied away from the heels of SPINNING DANCER (Z Purton) which shifted in when not properly clear.  Z Purton was advised to exercise more care when shifting ground.
Passing the 1500 Metres, TRUE COMMENT was steadied away from the heels of DASHING SUPER which shifted in when racing tight to the inside of SALSA BROTHERS.  SPINNING DANCER, which was following, was steadied away from the heels of TRUE COMMENT in consequence.
After the 1300 Metres, TRUE COMMENT got its head on the side and lay out.
Near the 1150 Metres, ELECTRONIC PHOENIX was hampered and taken wider by the riderless DIAMOND FRIENDS.
At the 300 Metres, DASHING SUPER was checked when crowded for room inside CHEERFUL FRAME (Apprentice K K Chiong) which shifted in as the riderless DIAMOND FRIENDS, which was positioned to the outside of CHEERFUL FRAME, drifted in.  Apprenticed Chiong was advised that whilst the Stewards appreciated that she was in an awkward position at this time, she was nonetheless asked to do her best in difficult circumstances to prevent causing interference to other runners.
After the 200 Metres, DRAGON HARMONY was hampered when carried out by the riderless DIAMOND FRIENDS.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of DASHING SUPER, B Prebble stated that he was asked to obtain a forward position on DASHING SUPER and for this reason he rode the horse aggressively out of the barriers.  He said after obtaining the lead passing the 1400 Metres, DASHING SUPER travelled satisfactorily until pressured by CHEERFUL FRAME and the riderless DIAMOND FRIENDS passing the 800 Metres.  He said when this happened, he had to ride DASHING SUPER along to prevent CHEERFUL FRAME from crossing his mount and this resulted in DASHING SUPER having to make an extended run.  He added DASHING SUPER was under heavy pressure rounding the Home Turn and although the horse was badly checked at the 300 Metres, it was well beaten at that time.  He said he had previously ridden DASHING SUPER from a position behind the lead and the horse had closed off the race well and for this reason he was of the opinion that, unless DASHING SUPER is able to obtain an easy lead, the horse may be better suited by being ridden off the pace.  A veterinary inspection of DASHING SUPER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
The Stewards opened an inquiry into Y T Chengâs handling of MASTER GOLD.  After taking evidence from Jockey Cheng, Mr L Ho, the trainer of MASTER GOLD, Dr P Schiff, Veterinary Officer, who reported that MASTER GOLD was found to be lame in its right front leg after the race as well as Dr P Curl, Executive Manager, Veterinary Regulation, the Stewards adjourned the inquiry until a date to be fixed.  Before being allowed to race again, MASTER GOLD will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of SALSA BROTHERS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of SALSA BROTHERS, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, SALSA BROTHERS will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
DASHING SUPER, GOOD FIT and ELECTRONIC PHOENIX were sent for sampling.

BEAR CHUM, which was fractious in the barriers, began only fairly and then was bumped by GRACYDAD which shifted out.
MASSIVE MOVE shifted out at the start and bumped the hindquarters of GLORY HORSIE.
LONDON MASTER and HAPPY SOUND bumped on jumping.
After passing the 600 Metres, EMPIRE OF MONGOLIA lost ground when reluctant to hold its position due to tightening between TEN SPEED and LONDON MASTER which shifted out away from BEAR CHUM.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of BEAR CHUM, K Teetan stated it had been anticipated that whilst BEAR CHUM would be suited by races over a longer distance than todayâs event, the horse would nonetheless be able to show sufficient early speed to obtain a forward position.  He said it was also anticipated that LONDON MASTER and HAPPY SOUND, which were drawn immediately outside BEAR CHUM, would obtain leading positions and therefore he was asked to obtain a position with cover behind those horses.  He said LONDON MASTER did not show the anticipated early speed and for this reason BEAR CHUM was left racing without cover in the early stages.  He said after the 900 Metres BEAR CHUM was struggling to keep pace with the tempo of the race and he had to niggle at the horse in an endeavour to maintain as forward a position as possible.  He said BEAR CHUM was not able to travel on the bridle and was always under pressure.  He added, due to the quick early tempo of the race, he anticipated that BEAR CHUM might be able to close off the race well, however, although the horse stayed on one-paced in the run to the line, in his opinion, BEAR CHUMâs finishing effort was disappointing in the circumstances.  He did say that, in his opinion, BEAR CHUM would be suited by stepping up in distance in its future races.  A veterinary inspection of BEAR CHUM immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
When questioned regarding the performance of WONDERFUL CHASER, Z Purton stated that at its only race around a turn last season, WONDERFUL CHASER was disappointing and that the horse had again been disappointing in its barrier trial around a turn in the lead up to todayâs race.  He said in that trial the horse had obtained a good position, however, gave ground rounding the Home Turn which he attributed at the time to the horse not being comfortable going around bends.  He said although connections of WONDERFUL CHASER believed that the horse would be suited by a longer distance than the 1000 Metres of todayâs race, due to the manner in which it had performed last season and again in the trial, it was decided to run WONDERFUL CHASER on the straight course as this would provide the horse with the best opportunity to finish off the race.  He added WONDERFUL CHASER began only fairly and he had to ride the horse aggressively in the early stages in an endeavour to obtain as forward a position as possible.  He said WONDERFUL CHASER did not appreciate the strong tempo of the race and was always under pressure to maintain its position.  He said, despite being hard ridden throughout the race, WONDERFUL CHASER did not close off the race and disappointed him as it finished off the race only one-paced.  A veterinary inspection of WONDERFUL CHASER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of GRACYDAD immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
BEAR CHUM, HAPPY SOUND and TEN SPEED were sent for sampling.

GORGEOUS AGAIN, which was fractious in the barriers, was slow to begin and lost a considerable amount of ground.  Before being allowed to race again, GORGEOUS AGAIN will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.
GLORIOUS SUN began very awkwardly and made heavy contact with the outside of its barrier stall, resulting in its rider, O Doleuze, becoming badly unbalanced and losing the use of his left stirrup iron for a short distance.  As a result of this incident, GLORIOUS SUN lost a significant amount of ground and consequently became detached from the field.  Before being allowed to race again, GLORIOUS SUN will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.
WORLD RECORD was steadied away from the heels of TRIUMPHANT LIGHT on jumping as a result of that horse shifting in.
TRAVEL AMBASSADOR was hampered on jumping when steadied away from the heels of AMRITSARIA which was taken out by SMART SALUTE.  After this, SMART SALUTE was ridden along, however, failed to muster speed.
Despite being hard ridden in the early stages, HOUSE OF LUCK failed to muster speed.
From the outside barrier, IMPERIAL GALLANTRY was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 1000 Metres, HOUSE OF LUCK raced in restricted room inside TEAM SWEET.
After the 1000 Metres, SMART SALUTE was left racing wide and without cover.
Near the 900 Metres, TRIUMPHANT LIGHT was left racing wide and without cover.
The performance of AMRITSARIA, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, AMRITSARIA will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of TRIUMPHANT LIGHT and SMART SALUTE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
IMPERIAL GALLANTRY and TEAM SWEET were sent for sampling.

PAKISTAN BABY began only fairly.
FABULOUS NOVEMBER began awkwardly.
Shortly after the start, GREEN CARD was momentarily crowded for room between KITAYA and CAREFREE LET GO, both of which shifted ground.
LANG TAI SING shifted in at the start and bumped GOLDEN SUN which was steadied when crowded onto RAGING BULL.
After the 900 Metres, TEAM FORTUNE got its head on the side and shifted out towards the heels of RAGING BULL.  Then passing the 800 Metres, TEAM FORTUNE was momentarily awkwardly placed close to the heels of KITAYA.
Approaching the 600 Metres, IRON BOY commenced to travel keenly and got its head up when racing close to the heels of OCEAN ROAR.
Near the 350 Metres, FABULOUS NOVEMBER was shifted in away from the heels of TEAM FORTUNE in an attempt to obtain clear running.  Then passing the 250 Metres, FABULOUS NOVEMBER was severely checked away from the heels of firstly KITAYA and then OCEAN ROAR as those horses gave ground.
Passing the 200 Metres, CAREFREE LET GO was awkwardly placed outside the heels of RAGING BULL which shifted out marginally.
Throughout the race, RAGING BULL and LOVELY DELOVELY travelled wide and without cover.
GREEN CARD and IRON BOY were sent for sampling.

DRAGON MASTER shifted out at the start and bumped BIG BANG BONG which in turn shifted out and bumped GOLDEN CHOPSTICKS.
OUR HERO began only fairly, shifted out on jumping and bumped the hindquarters of FLYING FORCE.
SPEEDY ACHIEVER began awkwardly and shortly after the start was bumped by DIAMOND DRAGON which was taken out by BEAUTY MASTER which got its head on the side and shifted out despite the efforts of its rider.
Passing the 300 Metres, DRAGON MASTER was directed in away from the heels of BEAUTY MASTER which shifted in away from WINFULL PATROL.
Over the final 200 Metres, WINFULL PATROL raced with its head on the side, lay out and proved difficult to ride.
After the race, C Schofield was not able to provide any explanation for the disappointing performance of LOOKS LIKE THE CAT.  He said the horse did not travel comfortably at any stage and consequently did not finish off its race.  A veterinary inspection of LOOKS LIKE THE CAT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
A veterinary inspection of RED KYLIN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
DRAGON MASTER and BEAUTY MASTER were sent for sampling.

On jumping, JOYFUL PARK was crowded for room between VERBINSKY and BEAUTY PRINCE which, after beginning awkwardly, shifted in.  A short distance after the start, JOYFUL PARK was steadied when further crowded for room between VERBINSKY and BEAUTY PRINCE which was taken in by NITRO EXPRESS.
Shortly after the start, VERBINSKY and RUBY COAST bumped.
From a wide barrier, SKY KING was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Despite being vigorously ridden along in the early stages, ENORMOUS HONOUR failed to muster speed.
