Near the 1250 Metres, VERBINSKY was awkwardly placed behind HEALTHY JOYFUL which, after crossing VERBINSKY, was then steadied.
In the early part of the Straight, BEAUTY PRINCE and NITRO EXPRESS raced tight as BEAUTY PRINCE shifted out into clear running.
Throughout the race, SILVERFIELD travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, D Whyte stated that it had been explained to him that in its two races last season AMBITIOUS PINS had lay in and for this reason he was asked to ride the horse where it was comfortable but to obtain cover if possible.  He said after beginning well he steadied AMBITIOUS PINS to obtain cover and shortly after the start the horse commenced to lay in.  He said for this reason after the 1000 Metres he again steadied AMBITIOUS PINS and shifted the horse behind runners to obtain a position on the rail as he felt that this would assist it in racing more tractably.  He added in the middle stages he had to niggle at AMBITIOUS PINS to maintain its position and rounding the Home Turn he was able to improve inside RUBY COAST when that horse shifted out.  He said he immediately placed AMBITIOUS PINS under pressure and the horse commenced to finish off the race.  He added approaching the 200 Metres, despite being ridden along, AMBITIOUS PINS was reluctant to improve its position inside CHEERFUL BOY which lay in when commencing to give ground.  He said after improving inside that horse, he had to stop riding AMBITIOUS PINS approaching the 100 Metres to shift the horse to the outside of METALLIC STAR as AMBITIOUS PINS lay in and was reluctant to shift out.  He said after obtaining clear running to the outside of METALLIC STAR near the 100 Metres, AMBITIOUS PINS then closed off the race strongly.  Trainer R Gibson stated that as AMBITIOUS PINS' best run overseas prior to coming to Hong Kong had been over 1600 Metres, it was felt that even with the blinkers applied today, the horse would not have sufficient early speed to take up a forward position and for this reason he asked Jockey Whyte to ride it where it was comfortable.  He said he was also mindful that AMBITIOUS PINS had lay in in its previous races in Hong Kong.  He added that he would now consider stepping AMBITIOUS PINS up in distance and following the addition of blinkers, consideration would also be given to riding the horse in a prominent position if circumstances permitted.
A veterinary inspection of SKY KING and CHEERFUL BOY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
VERBINSKY, BEAUTY PRINCE and MOLLY'S JADE STAR were sent for sampling.

PERPETUAL TREASURE was bumped on jumping by ARCHIPPUS which was taken out by GO BABY GO.
Near the 300 Metres, COUNTRY MELODY was held up for clear running behind CHARITY JOY.  COUNTRY MELODY was then unable to obtain clear running over the final 100 Metres and consequently was not able to be fully tested.
Passing the 200 Metres, ARCHIPPUS was crowded for room between PERPETUAL TREASURE and DRAGON GENERAL which shifted in.
After the race, DISCIPLES TWELVE was found to have a small amount of blood in both nostrils.  An endoscopic examination was performed on DISCIPLES TWELVE which did not reveal any blood in the trachea and accordingly the horse was not deemed to have bled.
RACING SUPERNOVA and ADVENTURER were sent for sampling.

BLAZING PASS began only fairly.
PO CHING TREASURE and AZTEC EMPIRE bumped at the start.
GOLD DRAGON, which began only fairly, was steadied shortly after the start when WEALTHY FORTUNE was taken in by AUTUMN GOLD which in turn was taken in by BO DUKE which got its head on the side and shifted in.  After this, despite being ridden long, WEALTHY FORTUNE failed to muster speed after racing tight inside AUTUMN GOLD which, from a wide barrier, was then steadied a short distance later and shifted across behind runners.
Shortly after the start, MAC ROW shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of PO CHING TREASURE.
Passing the 900 Metres, WEALTHY FORTUNE was shifted out in an endeavour to improve and after this travelled wide and without cover until after the 600 Metres.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, GOLD DRAGON raced tight between SMART UNION and WEALTHY FORTUNE.
Rounding the Home Turn, GOLD DRAGON was crowded for room between PO CHING TREASURE and GLORY STAR which was taken out by AZTEC EMPIRE (O Doleuze) which shifted out.  As the Stewards could not be comfortably satisfied to the necessary degree that GOLD DRAGON had properly established running to the outside of GLORY STAR prior to being crowded for room, O Doleuze was severely reprimanded and advised that in similar circumstances he must make every endeavour to prevent his mounts from shifting ground.
Passing the 150 Metres, SMART UNION raced tight inside AZTEC EMPIRE.
When questioned regarding the improved performance of BO DUKE, Trainer P F Yiu stated that the horse's win tonight was not anticipated.  He said BO DUKE had been somewhat disappointing and for this reason he had varied the distances and the riders engaged to partner the horse in order to have it find form.  He said he did not anticipate that there would be much pace in the race and therefore he instructed, M Chadwick, the rider of BO DUKE, to go forward in the hope that the horse would be able to obtain a soft lead and therefore would be able to finish off its race.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of GLORY STAR, T H So stated that after obtaining a position outside the leader after passing the winning post on the first occasion, GLORY STAR then travelled well and he anticipated that the horse would close off the race well.  He said however that GLORY STAR came under pressure after the 500 Metres and he was unable to prevent AZTEC EMPIRE from improving its position underneath GLORY STAR and taking his mount out rounding the turn.  He added, despite being placed under heavy pressure in the Straight, GLORY STAR did not respond to his riding and was disappointing in the manner in which it failed to close off the race.  A veterinary inspection of GLORY STAR immediately following the race found that horse to have sustained a small cut to the right hind fetlock, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
A veterinary inspection of GOLD DRAGON immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, GOLD DRAGON will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
GLORY STAR, BO DUKE and AZTEC EMPIRE were sent for sampling.

KERKENI and LOYAL CRAFTSMAN were crowded for room on jumping between GLORY SUNSHINE and SWEET BEAN which began awkwardly and then was taken out marginally by CHOICE EXCHEQUER.
From a wide barrier, HIGH SPEED METRO was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
For some distance approaching the winning post on the first occasion, LOYAL CRAFTSMAN was steadied when attempting to improve inside SWEET BEAN (C Y Ho) where there was doubtful room.  C Y Ho was advised to be aware of the position of other runners when shifting ground in similar circumstances.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, MI SAVVY BOY was left racing wide and without cover.
Making the turn after the 1100 Metres, SWEET BEAN and MI SAVVY BOY bumped.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, HIGH SPEED METRO was steadied away from the heels of LOYAL CRAFTSMAN when racing tight inside SPICY SIAM.
Near the 450 Metres, LOYAL CRAFTSMAN was hampered when steadied away from the heels of ISLAND FLYER (O Bosson) which shifted out to improve.  O Bosson was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is properly clear when shifting ground in similar circumstances.
Rounding the Home Turn, DRAGON GLORY raced tight between SWEET BEAN and WIN CHANCE which, when commencing to shift to the outside of CHOICE EXCHEQUER, was taken out further by that horse.
Near the 100 Metres, ISLAND FLYER was inconvenienced by MALAYAN PEARL which was directed out by WIN CHANCE.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of ISLAND FLYER, O Bosson stated that it had been intended for the horse to be ridden in a forward position, however, ISLAND FLYER did not show any early speed despite being ridden along and this resulted in the horse racing much further back in the field than intended.  He said when racing on the rail, ISLAND FLYER was inclined to lay in as it had done in a number of its races.  He added he shifted ISLAND FLYER out after the 500 Metres in order to improve into the race and immediately on straightening the horse hung in and proved difficult to ride.  A veterinary inspection of ISLAND FLYER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of MI SAVVY BOY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CHOICE EXCHEQUER and SWEET BEAN were sent for sampling.

THE FULL BLOOM was slow to begin.
COUR VALANT began awkwardly.
EVEREST was crowded for room on jumping between ST YAZIN and SUPREME FLIGHT which shifted in.
From the outside barrier, WORLD CITY was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 900 Metres, GLOBE TROTTER was checked after getting its head on the side and shifting in towards the heels of PROMPT EXPRESS which also shifted out.
Also passing the 900 Metres, EVEREST was checked away from the heels of ST YAZIN.
Rounding the Home Turn, WORLD CITY was taken wider after shifting out to avoid the heels of GOLDEN GLORY which got its head on the side and lay out.
For some distance after the 300 Metres, VICTORY MARVEL was hampered when improving into tight running inside PROMPT EXPRESS.
Passing the 300 Metres, MASSIVE MILLENNIUM was shifted to the outside of SUPREME FLIGHT after being disappointed for running inside that horse.
Approaching the 250 Metres, EVEREST was hampered when disappointed for running between THE FULL BLOOM and GOLDEN GLORY which shifted in.
A veterinary inspection of PROMPT EXPRESS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
MASSIVE MILLENNIUM and VICTORY MARVEL were sent for sampling.

ENTRUSTING was slow to begin.
HARBOUR VICTORY began awkwardly and lost ground.
KING BOUNTIFUL began only fairly.
CASA MASTER shifted out at the start and bumped the hindquarters of MR KOOL.  After this, despite being vigorously ridden along, CASA MASTER failed to muster speed.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, RED PEONY was steadied away from the heels of SUPER SWEET ORANGE which became badly unbalanced after momentarily racing tight inside MR KOOL which got its head on the side and shifted in.
Passing the 1300 Metres, BORN TO RACE was left racing wide and without cover and after the 1100 Metres was allowed to stride forward to race outside the lead.

When questioned regarding his riding of BORN TO RACE over about the final 200 Metres, C Y Ho stated that leading up to this point BORN TO RACE had raced tractably outside SPARKLING SWORD.  He said however passing the 200 Metres as BORN TO RACE commenced to establish a margin over SPARKLING SWORD, his mount immediately commenced to hang in and he had to apply pressure to the outside rein to prevent the horse from shifting in as he was not sufficiently clear of SPARKLING SWORD which had GOOD CHOICE improving to its inside.  He said he attempted to ride BORN TO RACE out vigorously with the whip in the right hand whilst continuing to apply pressure to the outside rein to prevent BORN TO RACE from shifting in and causing interference to SPARKLING SWORD.  He added he had a number of looks to his inside as he wanted to establish whether he was clear of SPARKLING SWORD so that he could then ride his mount out more vigorously.  He said after crossing SPARKLING SWORD near the 80 Metres, BORN TO RACE then continued to lay in and he was obliged to put the whip away and ride BORN TO RACE out hands and heels as the horse was continuing to lay in towards GOOD CHOICE.  He said the reason for looking to his inside on a number of occasions during this period of the race was solely to establish whether he was clear of SPARKLING SWORD so that he could ride BORN TO RACE out fully.  After viewing the video and considering Jockey Ho's evidence, his explanation was accepted.
A veterinary inspection of CASA MASTER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
SUPER SWEET ORANGE, GOOD CHOICE and BORN TO RACE were sent for sampling.

The Stewards tonight inquired into the reason for the withdrawal of SIR JOHN from this race.  Evidence was taken from Mr W Y So, the trainer of SIR JOHN, Mr C K Chung, assistant trainer allocated to Mr Soâs stable, Dr P Curl, Executive Manager, Veterinary Regulation, and Dr A Sidhu, clinical veterinary intern.  Mr So pleaded guilty to a charge of Rule 50(2) in that as the trainer of SIR JOHN, he did fail in his responsibility for all matters pertaining to the running of his stable by permitting SIR JOHN to be administered dexamethasone on Monday, 19 September 2016 which is within the prescribed clear day withdrawal period and which resulted in the horse having to be withdrawn from this race.  For this breach, Mr So was fined the sum of $20,000.  Mr Chung was advised that a report in respect of this matter would be forwarded to the Clubâs Stables Management for their consideration.  The Stewards advised Dr Sidhu that they found no fault with his actions in relation to this matter and that he had fulfilled all the obligations required of a treating veterinarian.

When questioned, M L Yeung stated that although HAYMAKER generally races in midfield or just in advance of midfield, due to the horseâs good barrier, he was asked to have it racing in about 4th or 5th position if possible.  He said prior to the race he expected GRAND HARBOUR and ARM RUNDA to take up forward positions and for YOURTHEONEFORME, which was drawn immediately to the inside of HAYMAKER, to take a trailing position behind those horses.  He said therefore he felt that he would be able to cross with YOURTHEONEFORME and assume a position one horse off the rail which would have been in accordance with his instructions.  He said after initially being ridden along, both ARM RUNDA and YOURTHEONEFORME did not continue forward as he anticipated and when he observed YOURTHEONEFORME being steadied in an attempt to obtain a trailing position behind ARM RUNDA passing the 1100 Metres, he elected to remain racing outside that horse in order to be shifted in when YOURTHEONEFORME was taken in behind ARM RUNDA.  He said however YOURTHEONEFORME was not able to be sufficiently steadied to obtain the position behind ARM RUNDA and as a consequence HAYMAKER was left racing in a three wide position outside that horse making the first turn.  He added HAYMAKER was then left racing without cover near the 900 Metres.  M L Yeung was advised that, in the opinion of the Stewards, his riding of HAYMAKER, particularly approaching and passing the 1100 Metres, when it was apparent that both ARM RUNDA and YOURTHEWONFORME were not being ridden to obtain forward positions, lacked judgement and initiative.  He was further advised to ensure that he rides his mounts in such a manner so as to comply to instructions wherever possible and moreover, to avoid covering unnecessary ground.
When questioned regarding his riding of OUR HONOUR in the early stages, C Schofield stated that as OUR HONOUR was resuming after an injury enforced lay-off, he was asked to ride the horse where it was comfortable so as to ensure that it was able to finish off the race.  He said OUR HONOUR began very well and he did consider going forward, however, he noticed that a number of runners to the inside of OUR HONOUR were being hard ridden in the early stages and he formed the view that he would have had to make some use of OUR HONOUR to cross those runners to his inside and given that OUR HONOUR had not started since January, he did not believe that this would be in the best interests of the horse as it would not have provided OUR HONOUR with the best opportunity to finish off the race.  He said for this reason he elected to steady his mount in an attempt to obtain a position with cover.  He said after viewing the video and having regard to how well OUR HONOUR began, he felt that in retrospect it may have been more advantageous to press forward given that, after initially being ridden along, ARM RUNDA and YOURTHEONEFORME did not continue on which would have provided OUR HONOUR the opportunity to obtain a forward position without having to be unduly pressured.  The Stewards advised C Schofield to always be alert to the circumstances of the race so that horses are able to take up advantageous positions.  A veterinary inspection of OUR HONOUR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.

Approaching the 900 Metres, HAPPY FIERY DRAGON was awkwardly placed close to the heels of POWER DRAGON which was being steadied in an attempt to obtain cover.  POWER DRAGON was however obliged to travel wide and without cover throughout the race.
Rounding the Home Turn, HAPPY FIERY DRAGON and REWARDING FLYER were hampered and taken wider by MEGATRON (N Callan) which shifted out.  N Callan was advised to exercise more care.
At the entrance to the Straight, SUPERIOR BOY was awkwardly placed close to the heels of REWARDING FLYER.
Over the final 150 Metres, SUPERIOR BOY (O Doleuze) lay in under pressure, proved difficult to ride and passing the 50 Metres shifted in and bumped HOME RUN which became unbalanced.  O Doleuze was advised that whilst the Stewards accepted that SUPERIOR BOY was proving difficult to ride, given he was riding the horse with the whip in the left hand as it was shifting in, he should ensure that he rides with more care in similar circumstances.
When questioned, S Clipperton stated that it had been intended for REWARDING FLYER to be ridden in a forward position as it was at its last start when successful, however, it was anticipated that todayâs race would be run at a faster tempo than at its most recent start.  He said after beginning awkwardly, he rode his mount along, however, it soon became clear that REWARDING FLYER was not showing sufficient pace to be able to obtain a forward position and therefore, after passing the 1300 Metres, he steadied REWARDING FLYER and shifted that horse across behind runners to obtain cover.
A veterinary inspection of POWER DRAGON immediately following the race found that horse to have sustained a small cut to the inside of the left hind heel.
A BEAUTIFUL, HOUSE OF FUN and SUPERIOR BOY were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE PO LEUNG KUK CENTENARY CUP (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
TIANHUANG began only fairly and then shortly after the start was crowded for room between SUN TOUCH and NOBLE ALPHA which was taken out by TIMELY ARRIVED.  After this, despite being aggressively ridden, TIANHUANG failed to show any early speed and became detached from the field for the majority of the race.  The performance of TIANHUANG was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, TIANHUANG will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Approaching the 900 Metres, DEJA VU was bumped by SUN TOUCH which got its head on the side and shifted in away from TEAM FORTUNE.
Shortly after entering the Straight, SKYROCKETS was awkwardly placed between BEAUTY CONNECTION and DEJA VU when attempting to improve into tight running between those horses.
Close to the finishing line, SKYROCKETS was shifted out away from the heels of DEJA VU.
When questioned regarding his riding of SUN TOUCH in the early part of the Straight, T H So stated that after having to be ridden along for a considerable distance in the early stages, his mount, which was left racing wide and without cover from the 600 Metres, commenced to lay in at the entrance to the Straight.  He said at the same time BEAUTY CONNECTION shifted out to his inside which obliged him to immediately stop riding his mount and shift SUN TOUCH out to avoid the heels of BEAUTY CONNECTION.  He added after this he was able to place the horse under full pressure for the remainder of the race.  T H So was advised that his explanation would be reported, however, he should ensure that, wherever possible, he is able to ride his mounts out to the best of his ability.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of BEAUTY CONNECTION, J Moreira stated that after obtaining a forward position in the early stages, he allowed TEAM FORTUNE to cross BEAUTY CONNECTION at the 600 Metres to provide his mount with cover.  He said when this happened BEAUTY CONNECTION appeared to resent the kickback and came off the bridle which prompted him to immediately shift BEAUTY CONNECTION to the outside of TEAM FORTUNE.  He said however that, despite being shifted out into clear running, BEAUTY CONNECTION was very disappointing in its failure to finish off the race.  A veterinary inspection of BEAUTY CONNECTION immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of TIANHUANG and LANSBURY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
BEAUTY CONNECTION, TEAM FORTUNE and HARBOUR ALERT were sent for sampling.
<26/9/2016  Additional Veterinary Report>TIANHUANG, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  TIANHUANG was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer J Moore this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right hind leg.  As previously advised, TIANHUANG will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.

JADE FORTUNE was slow to begin.
From a wide barrier, SUNNY ORIENT was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the 1100 Metres, AVELLINO was momentarily crowded for room inside HARD BALL GET which was awkwardly placed inside the heels of LOOK ERAS.  After this, AVELLINO proved difficult to settle and got its head up passing the 1000 Metres when awkwardly placed close to the heels of LOTUS BREEZE and tight inside HARD BALL GET.
Making the turn after the 900 Metres, AEROSPEED was bumped and taken wider by AVELLINO which got its head on the side and hung out.  This resulted in AEROSPEED racing wide and without cover.
Near the 850 Metres, HARD BALL GET lost ground when momentarily tightened for room between LOTUS BREEZE and CHARITY GLORY, both of which shifted slight ground.
CHARITY GLORY travelled wide and without cover until near the 600 Metres.
Near the 350 Metres, LOTUS BREEZE and CHARITY GLORY raced tight as LOTUS BREEZE shifted out into clear running.  LOTUS BREEZE and CHARITY GLORY then again raced tight passing the 200 Metres and over the concluding stages made contact on a number of occasions due to CHARITY GLORY laying in under pressure.
Approaching the 200 Metres, SEE ME NOW was awkwardly placed inside the heels of OCEAN ROAR.  SEE ME NOW continued to race tight inside OCEAN ROAR until approaching the 100 Metres due to OCEAN ROAR shifting in when giving ground.
Over the concluding stages, JADE FORTUNE raced tight inside LOOK ERAS which was tiring.
When questioned regarding his riding of WINFIELD, D Whyte stated that he had been instructed to have the horse travelling comfortably in a midfield position if possible.  He said WINFIELD began only fairly and he therefore had to ride the horse along in the early stages in an attempt to obtain a more prominent position.  He said approaching the 1000 Metres AEROSPEED was racing to his outside and in advance of WINFIELD and he was unable to continue improving to the outside of AVELLINO.  He said therefore he positioned WINFIELD behind AVELLINO and then took WINFIELD to the rail to save ground passing the 900 Metres.  He said near the 800 Metres he noticed N Callan, the rider of AVELLINO, hit that horse down the left shoulder with the whip as it was apparent that AVELLINO was hanging out.  He said near the 700 Metres he shifted WINFIELD out to follow AVELLINO and considered following that horse in order to shift to its outside rounding the Home Turn.  He said however that he observed AVELLINO continue to hang out and this was particularly the case rounding the Home Turn.  He said he therefore elected to improve to the inside of AVELLINO and obtain runs to that horseâs inside if it continued to hang out as he anticipated.  He added at the entrance to the Straight he rode WINFIELD along to improve between HARD BALL GET and AVELLINO, however, AVELLINO was straightened at that time and as HARD BALL GET was shifting out to improve its position, he had to check WINFIELD when disappointed for running between those horses.  He said he then switched WINFIELD to the inside of HARD BALL GET to follow LOTUS BREEZE, a horse that he considered to be a strong chance in the race.  He said he rode WINFIELD along and near the 200 Metres shifted it to the inside of LOTUS BREEZE as there was clear running available to the inside of that horse due to OCEAN ROAR giving ground.  He said passing the 100 Metres he shifted WINFIELD to the inside of MULTIMAX to obtain clear running, however, he was able to ride his mount along throughout this time of the race.  When questioned as to why he did not improve to the outside of CHARITY GLORY approaching the 200 Metres, D Whyte stated that due to the positioning of HARD BALL GET, he felt that this was a tight run at best and that any shift from either CHARITY GLORY or HARD BALL GET would result in him being hampered and he also felt that it was a better option to obtain inside runs as he was able to ride his mount out at all times and continue its momentum.  D Whyte was advised that his explanation, particularly in respect of his riding near the 200 Metres, would be reported.  He was further advised that whilst he was able to continue to test WINFIELD after electing to shift to the inside on that horse near the 200 Metres, nonetheless it was also available for WINFIELD to improve its position between CHARITY GLORY and HARD BALL GET and accordingly, he should ensure that he is alert to runs as they become available.  A veterinary inspection of WINFIELD immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of AVELLINO immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
WINFIELD, LOTUS BREEZE and MULTIMAX were sent for sampling.

UNIQUE JOYOUS was slow to begin.
PACKING DRAGON shifted out at the start and bumped EASY HEDGE which was taken out onto SMART BOY.
Despite being ridden along in the early stages, SKY KING failed to muster speed and near the 1500 Metres got its head up when momentarily crowded for room inside UNICORN (K C Leung) which shifted in.  K C Leung was advised to exercise more care when shifting ground in future.
VANILLA and AMAZING AGILITY were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the 1000 Metres, METALLIC STAR got its head up when travelling keenly and awkwardly placed close to the heels of BEAUTY LOVE.
KIRAM had some difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the riding of D Whyte (KIRAM), 6th placegetter, over the concluding stages did not affect the horse's finishing position, he was nonetheless reminded of his obligation to ride his mounts out at least hands and heels all the way to the end of the race where circumstances permit.
When questioned, B Prebble stated that in discussions with Mr W Y So, the trainer of SMART BOY, it was felt that today's race would be run at a good tempo and that, from the outside barrier, he may be able to obtain a position behind the speed with cover.  He said having these instructions he allowed SMART BOY to begin and, as anticipated the tempo of the race was good due to a number of horses being ridden to take up forward positions.  He said however that due to the make-up of the field in the early stages and, in particular the positioning of PACKING DRAGON which began very well also from a wide gate, he was left racing very wide.  He said he attempted to shift in behind HAPPY PLACE after the 1400 Metres, however, due to EASY HEDGE being ridden along to his inside, he was unable to obtain this position.  He said when PACKING DRAGON improved its position in advance of HAPPY PLACE, SMART BOY was then left racing four wide and without cover and for this reason he allowed the horse to continue forward in the hope that it would be able to shift in closer to the rail.  He added after the 900 Metres he anticipated that BEAUTY LOVE would be steadied to permit SMART BOY to shift in which would have allowed him to race one horse off the rail outside ABLE DEED, however, when that horse continued to hold its position, SMART BOY was then left racing three wide and without cover for the remainder of the race.
When questioned, C Y Ho stated that, as is usual, he was asked to take up a forward position on BEAUTY LOVE.  He said travelling along the Back Straight he positioned BEAUTY LOVE about a half length behind ABLE DEED so as to ensure that BEAUTY LOVE was able to settle and did not travel keenly.  He said approaching the 900 Metres SMART BOY improved to his outside and he initially intended to allow SMART BOY to continue on rather than be caught wide in a speed battle inside that horse and to the outside of ABLE DEED.  He added passing the 900 Metres SMART BOY shifted in and raced tight outside of BEAUTY LOVE and when SMART BOY was then taken out to relieve the tightening, BEAUTY LOVE commenced to travel keenly and he was unable to steady BEAUTY LOVE to get cover behind SMART BOY.  He said because of the manner in which BEAUTY LOVE travelled after the 900 Metres and due to the tempo of the race, BEAUTY LOVE was then not able to finish off the race and weakened in the Straight.  A veterinary inspection of BEAUTY LOVE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
After the race, K Teetan stated that after obtaining the lead in the early stages, ABLE DEED initially travelled well, however, when BEAUTY LOVE and SMART BOY improved to the outside of ABLE DEED after the 900 Metres, his mount commenced to travel keenly and consequently did not finish off the race and weakened noticeably in the Straight.  A veterinary inspection of ABLE DEED immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of HAPPY PLACE immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of mucus in the horse's trachea.
EASY HEDGE, AMAZING AGILITY and UNICORN were sent for sampling.

SILVER GATSBY shifted in on jumping, resulting in MI SAVVY BOY being taken in onto MIZZEN GREY which in turn shifted in and bumped the hindquarters of SAFARI MAGIC.
Despite being ridden along in the early stages, DASHING FORTUNE failed to muster speed.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, PERFECT TIMING was steadied when tightened for room between MIZZEN GREY and DASHING FORTUNE which shifted in.  When DASHING FORTUNE was shifted out to relieve the tightening to PERFECT TIMING, that horse made contact with MANHATTAN STRIKER.
Approaching the 1000 Metres, FLYING MACHINE was left racing wide and without cover.
Near the 1000 Metres, DASHING FORTUNE was checked away from the heels of MANHATTAN STRIKER when taken out marginally by MIZZEN GREY which shifted out when being steadied away from the heels of SAFARI MAGIC.
Approaching the 800 Metres, LAUGHING LORD commenced to over-race and shifted out away from the heels of SILVER GATSBY and as a result made contact with MANHATTAN STRIKER.  LAUGHING LORD and MANHATTAN STRIKER then raced tight for some distance and made contact on a number of occasions which resulted in MANHATTAN STRIKER being forced out into a four wide position.
After the 500 Metres, SILVER GATSBY and LAUGHING LORD made contact as SILVER GATSBY attempted to shift out away from the heels of FOUR FOUR FIVE which was commencing to give ground.  SILVER GATSBY was then steadied for some distance when unable to shift to the outside of the heels of FOUR FOUR FIVE.
Rounding the Home Turn, MIZZEN GREY had to be checked when unable to proceed between MI SAVVY BOY and FOUR FOUR FIVE which shifted in slightly when giving ground.
Approaching the 200 Metres, PERFECT TIMING had to be shifted in when disappointed for running between FOUR FOUR FIVE and MIZZEN GREY which shifted out.
Approaching the 100 Metres, SAFARI MAGIC had to be directed to the outside of LAUGHING LORD to find clear running.
The performance of FOUR FOUR FIVE, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, FOUR FOUR FIVE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned, O Doleuze stated that although obliged to race three wide throughout the early stages, MANHATTAN STRIKER was able to maintain cover.  He said however that after receiving contact from LAUGHING LORD near the 800 Metres, MANHATTAN STRIKER dropped the bit and came under pressure.  He said, despite being hard ridden from the 500 Metres, MANHATTAN STRIKER gave ground and then weakened badly in the Straight.  He added he did not test the horse over the concluding stages as he felt that something may have been amiss with MANHATTAN STRIKER.  He said the only excuse he could offer was that MANHATTAN STRIKER may have been adversely affected by making repeated contact with LAUGHING LORD in the middle stages.  A veterinary inspection of MANHATTAN STRIKER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of MANHATTAN STRIKER, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, MANHATTAN STRIKER will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
FLYING MACHINE, MI SAVVY BOY and SAFARI MAGIC were sent for sampling.

The Stewards were advised by Dr E N M Ho, the Club's Acting Head of Racing Laboratory, that a pre-race urine sample taken from a horse declared to run in tonight's racemeeting was found to contain the prohibited substance diclofenac.  It was subsequently established that the pre-race urine sample was taken from VICTORIUS trained by Mr Y S Tsui.  The Stewards acceded to a request from Mr Tsui to withdraw VICTORIUS from this race.  Accordingly, VICTORIUS was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  The Stewards ordered for a further urine sample to be taken from VICTORIUS under post-race conditions.  The matter was adjourned until a date to be fixed.
GENTILIS shifted out at the start and hampered LOVE CHUNGHWA.
After travelling a short distance, WHOâSTHEDUDE was steadied and shifted across behind runners to find cover.
DIAMOND MYSTERIOUS lost its right hind plate near the 1000 Metres.
GENTILIS lost its left hind plate at the 700 Metres.
Approaching the 600 Metres, GENTILIS commenced to lay out and bumped GRACYDAD.
Passing the 600 Metres, PLANET GIANT shifted in and brushed the running rail.
Passing the 150 Metres, PLANET GIANT, which was closing off fairly, had to be checked to avoid the heels of GENTILIS which shifted out suddenly when commencing to give ground.
When questioned regarding his riding of BORN DRAGON, O Doleuze stated that he was instructed to ride the horse in a forward position, however, it began slowly.  He said he allowed BORN DRAGON to gather momentum in the run to the first turn and approaching the 1000 Metres he anticipated being able to shift in and obtain cover behind NATURAL TEAM.  He said however that as he attempted to take up this position, BORN DRAGON commenced to race ungenerously which obliged him to check the horse out away from the heels of NATURAL TEAM.  He further stated that BORN DRAGON then got its head on the side and continued to race ungenerously which obliged him to allow the horse to stride forward along the Back Straight in order to have it race more tractably.  He said as he joined the leaders GENTILIS and GRACYDAD approaching the 600 Metres, he was hopeful of being able to clear GRACYDAD, however, at this stage GRACYDAD maintained its position which prevented him from being able to cross that horse and obliged BORN DRAGON to remain racing three wide and without cover.  He said BORN DRAGON then came under pressure before the Home Turn and weakened in the Straight.
When questioned, Apprentice K K Chiong stated that having been instructed to ride DIAMOND MYSTERIOUS in a forward position, she rode the horse along from the barriers, however, it failed to show any early speed and settled much further back in the field than had been intended.  She said DIAMOND MYSTERIOUS travelled satisfactorily and then closed off the race only fairly, but, in her opinion, the horse would derive benefit from its first up start this campaign.  A veterinary inspection of DIAMOND MYSTERIOUS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
When questioned, Z Purton stated that he was able to assume the lead on GENTILIS as instructed.  He said although the pace in the early and middle stages was moderate, the horse, which was wearing blinkers for the first time, tended to over-race when challenged firstly by GRACYDAD and at a later stage BORN DRAGON.  He further stated that GENTILIS was rather disappointing in the manner in which it compounded in the Straight.  A veterinary inspection of GENTILIS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of GENTILIS was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, GENTILIS will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
GENTILIS, WHOâSTHEDUDE and LOVE CHUNGHWA were sent for sampling.

When parading behind the barriers, N Rawiller expressed concern regarding the action of THE RAINBOW.  THE RAINBOW was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said the horse was lame in its left front leg and as such was not suitable to race.  Acting on this advice, THE RAINBOW was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  Before being allowed to race again, THE RAINBOW will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
THANKSGIVING jumped out at the start, resulting in WIN IT being hampered when crowded onto NOBLE DE MAN.
From wide barriers, GERONIMO MEADOW and MONEY MAN were shifted across behind runners in the early stages to obtain cover.
After travelling a short distance, SPEEDY WALLY lay in away from SOUL ACHIEVER and made contact with CHEERFUL FRAME.
On the turn near the 1050 Metres, CHEERFUL FRAME, which was pulling hard, shifted out and raced tight against LIGHTNING AND GOLD.
Due to the slow pace, SPEEDY WALLY shifted out away from the heels of THANKSGIVING approaching the 600 Metres and raced wide and without cover from that point.
On the Home Turn, CHEERFUL FRAME was steadied when racing in restricted room inside THANKSGIVING which lay in as it commenced to give ground.
Approaching the 250 Metres, GERONIMO MEADOW made contact with NOBLE DE MAN when improving into a narrow run between NOBLE DE MAN and LIGHTNING AND GOLD.
For the majority of the race, NOBLE DE MAN was left racing wide and without cover.  A veterinary inspection of NOBLE DE MAN immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  The performance of NOBLE DE MAN, which weakened in the Straight and finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, NOBLE DE MAN will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the riding of B Prebble (GERONIMO MEADOW), 6th placegetter, over the concluding stages did not affect the horse's finishing position, he was nonetheless reminded of his obligation to ride his mounts out at least hands and heels to the end of the race where circumstances permit.
A veterinary inspection of CHEERFUL FRAME immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SPEEDY WALLY, GRACEFUL KINGDOM and SOUL ACHIEVER were sent for sampling.

Soon after the start, OPTIMISM was steadied when crowded for room between NOVEL START and MIGHTY GAINS which shifted out.
INTELLECTUAL GLIDE jumped in at the start and made contact with PROPEL REPEL.
From wide barriers, FORMULA GALORE and GREAT SPEED were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
KING OF SMARTS lost its left hind plate near the 1100 Metres.
INTELLECTUAL GLIDE travelled very keenly in the early and middle stages and consequently was obliged to travel wide and without cover throughout the event.
After the 250 Metres, NOVEL START and INTELLECTUAL GLIDE bumped on several occasions as they were giving ground.
Close to the finishing line, MIGHTY GAINS raced in restricted room to the inside of GIDDY GIDDY (O Doleuze) which shifted in under pressure.  O Doleuze was advised to make more effort to keep his mounts straight.
GREAT SPEED, SHINING CHAMPION and FORMULA GALORE were sent for sampling.

THE FULL BLOOM began awkwardly, bumped the hindquarters of OCTAL LUCK and lost ground at the start.
TRENDIFUL jumped in at the start and made contact with PROMPT EXPRESS.
From wide barriers, OCTAL LUCK and NASHASHUK were shifted across behind runners in the early stages to obtain cover.
After the 700 Metres, TRENDIFUL was left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 600 Metres, NASHASHUK got its head up and became awkwardly placed when racing tight between C P POWER and FUNNY BUDDIES.
After the 250 Metres, THE FULL BLOOM was shifted to the outside of the heels of FUNNY BUDDIES which shifted in under pressure.
Passing the 200 Metres, O Bosson (LUCKY SEVEN) had his whip knocked from his grasp by the whip of Apprentice H N Wong (RUGBY DIAMOND).
Over the final 100 Metres, FUNNY BUDDIES was inclined to lay in under pressure.
After leaving the 100 Metres, PROMPT EXPRESS was accidentally struck across the nose by the whip of K C Leung (LYRIC ACE).
When questioned, S Clipperton stated that PEACE COMBINATION was ridden forward in accordance with its normal racing pattern, however, had difficulty going with the early pace and as a consequence he was unable to prevent LUCKY SEVEN from crossing PEACE COMBINATION near the 600 Metres.  He said once crossed by LUCKY SEVEN, PEACE COMBINATION travelled satisfactorily, however, came under pressure well before the Home Turn and then proved very disappointing with its finishing effort.  A veterinary inspection of PEACE COMBINATION immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of OCTAL LUCK immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
VERY RICH MAN and C P POWER were sent for sampling.

From a wide barrier, WINNIE'S HONEY was steadied and shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
O Doleuze (HAPPY CONTENDER) was severely reprimanded for allowing his mount to shift in and cause momentary crowding to GREEN DISPATCH and HO HO FEEL just after passing the winning post on the first occasion.  It was established that just prior to receiving crowding, HO HO FEEL jumped a shadow of the winning post and was unbalanced at the time when it received brief tightening.
After passing the winning post on the first occasion, JOLLY GENE was left racing wide and without cover.
At the 1300 Metres, WINNIE'S HONEY was steadied away from the heels of AMAZINGLY.
Soon after entering the Straight, WINNIE'S HONEY got its head on the side and was reluctant to shift out from behind GREEN DISPATCH and as a consequence was checked away from the heels of that horse.
AMAZINGLY broke down in the left front leg after passing the 200 Metres.
Approaching the 150 Metres, ALLCASH was hampered when obliged to shift out away from the heels of WINNIE'S HONEY (C Y Ho) which shifted out under pressure.  C Y Ho was severely reprimanded and advised to exercise far more care in similar circumstances.
When questioned regarding the performance of HO HO FEEL, K C Leung stated that he was obliged to ride the horse along in the early stages to maintain a relatively forward position from an inside draw.  He said HO HO FEEL travelled well throughout the race, however, failed to respond to his riding in the Straight and was disappointing.  He said the only explanation he could offer was that the horse may not have appreciated being pushed into a forward position early and may appreciate being ridden more patiently.
When questioned regarding the tactics adopted on HAPPY CONTENDER, O Doleuze stated that in discussion with Trainer R Gibson, it was decided to ride the horse in a forward position despite the fact that it had raced well at its last start when ridden patiently.  He said this decision was reached after assessing that apart from the anticipated leader HAPPY SPIRIT, there was no follow-up speed and therefore it was felt that HAPPY CONTENDER could assume a forward position which was in keeping with the manner in which the horse had been previously ridden to advantage.
HAPPY SPIRIT and WINNIE'S HONEY were sent for sampling.

ALL GREAT FRIENDS was withdrawn on 27.9.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter EXCEL ONESELF (S Clipperton).  Before being allowed to race again, ALL GREAT FRIENDS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
On jumping, VICTORY FOLLOW ME and NAVAS were crowded for room between CIRCUIT KING and MOMENTUM LUCKY, both of which shifted ground.
From wide barriers, BOTH LUCKY, RAINBOW FIGHTER and THE SHOW were shifted across behind runners in the early stages to obtain cover.
After passing the 1000 Metres, NAVAS and MISSION POSSIBLE bumped which resulted in both horses becoming badly unbalanced.
After being steadied away from the heels of CIRCUIT KING which shifted in at the 650 Metres, MOMENTUM LUCKY shifted out on the turn at the 600 Metres and bumped EXTREMELY FUN.
In the early part of the Straight, MISSION POSSIBLE was inclined to lay in towards the hindquarters of HANGâS DECISION.  Then passing the 250 Metres, MISSION POSSIBLE was awkwardly placed behind EXTREMELY FUN which was giving ground.
For the majority of the race, EXCEL ONESELF travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, Apprentice K K Chiong stated that having instructions to lead on WONDERFUL JOURNEY, she rode the horse along in the early stages to maintain its positon inside CIRCUIT KING which was also ridden positively.  She said upon reaching the first turn near the 900 Metres, WONDERFUL JOURNEY commenced to over-race and near the 850 Metres became unbalanced when it shifted in towards the running rail.  She said WONDERFUL JOURNEY then continued to race very fiercely throughout the middle stages despite her best endeavours to have the horse settle in the lead.  Apprentice Chiong was advised that whilst the Stewards accepted that she had made sufficient endeavour to restrain WONDERFUL JOURNEY in the lead, she must do all in her power to ensure that her mounts are rated in such a manner so that they are able to finish off their race.
When questioned, O Doleuze (RAINBOW FIGHTER) stated that in the early part of the Straight he improved to be racing behind NAVAS but was unable to shift to the outside of that horse due to the positioning of EXCEL ONESELF.  He said whilst there was a narrow run to the inside of NAVAS, he could detect EXTREMELY FUN weakening quickly and also observed MISSION POSSIBLE shifting out to his inside.  He said thereafter RAINBOW FIGHTER was not able to be tested as he could not shift to either the inside or the outside of NAVAS due to the positioning of EXCEL ONESELF and MISSION POSSIBLE.
When questioned, N Callan stated that he had to ride aggressively in the early stages in order for EXTREMELY FUN to take up a customary forward position.  He said due to the fast tempo of the race, EXTREMELY FUN was not able to travel on the bit and came under pressure prior to the Home Turn before weakening in the Straight.  A veterinary inspection of EXTREMELY FUN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of CIRCUIT KING and MISSION POSSIBLE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, both horses were unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
BOTH LUCKY and HANGâS DECISION were sent for sampling.
<29/9/2016  Additional Veterinary Report>EXTREMELY FUN, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  EXTREMELY FUN was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer L Ho this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, EXTREMELY FUN will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Apprentice K K Chiong (TRAVEL FIRST) was fined the sum of $2,000 for presenting herself to weigh out in the incorrect colours.
After beginning awkwardly, SPEEDY LONGWAH shifted in and bumped SICHUAN DAR which was crowded onto the hindquarters of ISHVARA which became unbalanced.
From wide barriers, AMBITIOUS CHAMPION and PHOTON WILLIE were steadied and shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
At the 1550 Metres, SICHUAN DAR was steadied away from the heels of ISHVARA which was taken out by TRAVEL FIRST.
After being hard ridden in the early stages to take up a forward position, SEEDY LONGWAH was steadied away from the heels of SUPER LIFELINE approaching the winning post on the first occasion.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, DIVINE BOY got its head up when being steadied to take up a trailing position behind BASIC TRILOGY.
After being left racing wide and without cover, BASIC TRILOGY and MAGICAL BEAUTY were allowed to improve into leading positions approaching the 1000 Metres to race closer to the rail.
In the early part of the Straight, MAJESTIC ANTHEM was inclined to lay in and proved difficult to ride.
Near the 150 Metres, AMBITIOUS CHAMPION, which was closing off the race strongly, was hampered when crowded for room between DIVINE BOY which shifted in slightly under pressure and MAGICAL BEAUTY which, when tiring, shifted out away from TRAVEL FIRST (Apprentice K K Chiong).  A short distance later, MAGICAL BEAUTY, which was unbalanced after having made contact with AMBITIOUS CHAMPION, was checked away from the heels of TRAVEL FIRST which shifted out.  Apprentice Chiong was severely reprimanded and advised that whilst there was some circumstances involved in this incident, she should have made more of an effort to keep her mount on a straight course.
Apprentice H N Wong reported that he was instructed to ride ISHVARA in a forward position, however, after being bumped heavily on the hindquarters by SICHUAN DAR on jumping, the horse became badly unbalanced and then was not able to show the necessary speed to race in a forward position as was intended.  He said after settling in a midfield position behind SPEEDY LONGWAH, ISHVARA was shuffled back in the middle stages and was forced back to a position near to the rear of the field.
When questioned, Apprentice K K Chiong stated that after being crossed by BASIC TRILOGY at the 1000 Metres, TRAVEL FIRST commenced to travel a little keenly, therefore she elected to shift to the outside of BASIC TRILOGY where TRAVEL FIRST settled well and travelled comfortably throughout the middle stages.
When questioned, Z Purton stated that MAGICAL BEAUTY was caught very wide in the early stages which obliged him to press forward after the 1200 Metres to find a position closer to the rail.  He said after shifting in and assuming a position one horse away from the rail near the 1000 Metres, MAGICAL BEAUTY was immediately forced back out into a three wide position without cover when TRAVEL FIRST shifted out around the leader BASIC TRILOGY.  He added that along the Back Straight he was unable to shift in and find cover which resulted in MAGICAL BEAUTY racing three wide and without cover throughout the middle stages.  He said as a consequence MAGICAL BEAUTY came under heavy pressure in the early part of the Straight and, despite suffering interference near the 150 Metres, the horse was well beaten at that stage.  He said he did not test MAGICAL BEAUTY over the concluding stages given the horse had dropped out of contention.  A veterinary inspection of MAGICAL BEAUTY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of SPEEDY LONGWAH immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SICHUAN DAR and DYNAMISM were sent for sampling.

HAPPY CENTURY was slow to begin.
POLYMER LUCK began very awkwardly and lost ground at the start.
After making contact with ATOMIC BLAST at the start, MAJOR CONNECTION then shifted out and bumped BRILLIANT MONKEYS which became unbalanced.
When being steadied away from the heels of SHOW MISSION approaching the 700 Metres, ATOMIC BLAST shifted out and made contact with FANTASTICLIFE.
BRILLIANT MONKEYS was left racing wide and without cover near the 700 Metres.
Throughout the middle stages, MAJOR CONNECTION lay out.
Over the final 200 Metres, MAJOR CONNECTION raced with its head on the side and lay out.
FANTASTICLIFE had difficulty obtaining clear running after passing the 200 Metres.
Approaching the 150 Metres, SHOW MISSION was shifted in away from the heels of CONSISTENT to obtain clear running.
A veterinary inspection of BRILLIANT MONKEYS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GOOD METHOD and POLYMER LUCK were sent for sampling.

BEAUTY ONLY was shifted across behind runners soon after the start.
On the first turn after passing the 900 Metres, BRILLIANT SHINE got its head up, shifted out and became awkward on the heels of HORSE OF FORTUNE.  JOYFUL TRINITY, which was following, shifted in away from the heels of BRILLIANT SHINE, resulting in BEAUTY ONLY being momentarily crowded for room.
After the 700 Metres, CONTENTMENT commenced to travel keenly and shifted out off the heels of BEAUTY FLAME into a three wide position without cover.  This resulted in HORSE OF FORTUNE being taken wider.
J Moreira (JOYFUL TRINITY) was reprimanded for allowing his mount to shift in abruptly passing the 200 Metres, resulting in HORSE OF FORTUNE being hampered when carried in.
Approaching the 100 Metres, SECRET WEAPON was steadied away from the heels of HORSE OF FORTUNE which shifted out.
Throughout the race, HORSE OF FORTUNE travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned regarding his riding of BEAUTY ONLY rounding the Home Turn, Z Purton stated that approaching the Home Turn he was following HELENE PARAGON.  He said approaching the 500 Metres he observed that S Clipperton, the rider of HELENE PARAGON, had commenced to shift ground away from the rail and he felt that this would present BEAUTY ONLY with an opportunity to improve its position inside HELENE PARAGON.  He said however that HELENE PARAGON then moved back in slightly to maintain its position behind the leader DASHING FELLOW and as a consequence he had to steady BEAUTY ONLY in order to improve to the outside of HELENE PARAGON.  He added he rode the horse in a hands and heels fashion in the early part of the Straight and near the 200 Metres had to stop riding briefly when he observed HORSE OF FORTUNE being carried in by the winner JOYFUL TRINITY.  He said he then continued to ride BEAUTY ONLY hands and heels and the horse closed off well.
When questioned, C Schofield stated that, from barrier 11, he had been asked to ride PACKING PINS positively as it was felt that with a number of on-pace runners, the field may break up due to a fast early pace.  He said however after being pushed along for the first 100 Metres when horses to the inside of PACKING PINS, primarily ROMANTIC TOUCH and HORSE OF FORTUNE, were being ridden along and due to the make-up of the field, he felt that had he continued to press forward, PACKING PINS would have been forced to race wide.  He said he therefore steadied PACKING PINS and shifted in behind ROMANTIC TOUCH to obtain a trailing position.  He said PACKING PINS travelled relatively comfortably throughout the middle stages, however, when brought to the outside and placed under pressure in the Straight, PACKING PINS did not respond as he anticipated it would and proved disappointing.  C Schofield added that, in his opinion, PACKING PINS appeared to race âflatâ.  A veterinary inspection of PACKING PINS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
After the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on BRILLIANT SHINE at the request of Trainer C H Yip.  The Veterinary Surgeon reported that this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, BRILLIANT SHINE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
JOYFUL TRINITY and BEAUTY ONLY were sent for sampling.

ALMABABY jumped out at the start, causing crowding to FLYING TOURBILLON, KEY WITNESS and LINE SEEKER.  In this incident, KEY WITNESS lost ground.
From wide barriers, GONNA RUN and LAND GRANT were steadied and shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After passing the 1000 Metres, MALMSTEEN was steadied away from the heels of EROICO which improved to the inside of the heels of LINE SEEKER.
The Stewards inquired into the interference suffered by DISCIPLES TWELVE at the 650 Metres.  After taking evidence from K Teetan (DISCIPLES TWELVE), H W Lai (MALMSTEEN) and Z Purton (LINE SEEKER), it was established that whilst Z Purton endeavoured to maintain a three wide position outside the heels of FLYING TOURBILLON, LINE SEEKER lay in marginally at that stage of the race, resulting in  MALMSTEEN being crowded onto DISCIPLES TWELVE which was severely checked.  TURF SPRINT, which was following, was hampered in consequence and shifted out, resulting in LAND GRANT being taken wider.  In all the circumstances, the Stewards took no further action other than to advise Z Purton to ensure that he leaves comfortable racing room for runners to his inside in similar circumstances.
Passing the 500 Metres, EROICO was steadied away from the heels of ALMABABY.
Upon straightening, ALMABABY shifted out around the heels of GO BABY GO and raced tight against MYTHICAL EMPEROR.
Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the riding of Z Purton (LINE SEEKER), 4th placegetter, over the concluding stages did not affect the horse's finishing position, he was nonetheless reminded of his obligation to ride his mounts out at least hands and heels all the way to the end of the race where circumstances permit.
When questioned, C Schofield stated that he was instructed to ride MR BOGART positively and take up a relatively forward position, however, in the run to the first turn he felt that to have continued forward would have resulted in MR BOGART being caught four wide and without cover.  He said therefore, at the 900 Metres, he shifted across behind LINE SEEKER, which he considered to be one of the main dangers, where MR BOGART travelled comfortably with cover throughout the middle stages.  He said however that when the pace quickened rounding the Home Turn, MR BOGART dropped the bit, was one-paced and did not respond to his riding for some distance.  He added however that MR BOGART found the line strongly over the final 200 Metres and, in his opinion, it is looking for a distance longer than that of today's event.
A veterinary inspection of ALMABABY immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, ALMABABY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of FLYING TOURBILLON immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
TURF SPRINT and MR BOGART were sent for sampling.

CASA MASTER lost its right front plate near the 650 Metres.
Over the final 50 Metres, UNIQUE HAPPIEST and AZTEC EMPIRE raced tight and made contact on several occasions due to AZTEC EMPIRE shifting in marginally.
A veterinary inspection of LIGHTNING AND GOLD immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
UNIQUE HAPPIEST and AZTEC EMPIRE were sent for sampling.

G-ONE UNION, Standby Declared Starter, was withdrawn on 29.9.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left hind).  Before being allowed to race again, G-ONE UNION will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
HIGH VOLATILITY turned its head to the left as the start was effected and consequently lost ground.
At the 1250 Metres, GO BEAUTY GO was steadied to avoid the heels of DRAGON WARRIOR which shifted in.
Rounding the Home Turn, COOL AND NEAT was awkwardly placed behind GO BEAUTY GO and was unable to improve.
The performances of AEROLUMINANCE and GREENERY FORTUNE, which finished tailed out, were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, AEROLUMINANCE and GREENERY FORTUNE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned regarding the improved performance of KINGâS MAN, Trainer P F Yiu stated that although KINGâS MAN had benefited from the experience of two race starts towards the end of last season and had matured somewhat during the off season break, the horseâs winning performance today came as a surprise to connections.
After the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on WORLD RECORD at the request of Trainer A T Millard.  The Veterinary Surgeon reported that this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, WORLD RECORD will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
DRAGON WARRIOR, KINGâS MAN and COOL AND NEAT were sent for sampling.

BALAY BALAY and WINNAM were shifted across behind runners soon after the start to obtain cover.
After the 1300 Metres, LUCKY SEVEN STARS was left racing wide and without cover and then approaching the first turn was allowed to stride forward to race in a more prominent position nearer to the rail.
C Schofield, the rider of the 5th placegetter, HOLMES LEGEND, was questioned regarding his riding of the horse over the concluding stages.  C Schofield stated that HOLMES LEGEND was racing truly under pressure in the Straight, however, when MARVEL HERO advanced past his mount approaching the 50 Metres, that horse shifted in towards HOLMES LEGEND which, as a consequence, got its head on the side and was inclined to lay in.  He said as he was aware there were runners positioned to his inside, he tested the horse as best as he was able whilst endeavouring to prevent causing any tightening to those runners.  C Schofield's evidence was accepted.
A veterinary inspection of WINNAM immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CHEERFUL BOY and CALIFORNIA JOY were sent for sampling.

EMPIRE OF MONGOLIA and SEASONS KING were steadied and shifted across behind runners soon after the start to obtain cover.
Approaching the 1100 Metres, WINNING BOY was steadied away from the heels of VICTORIUS which shifted out.
After the 1000 Metres, FOREVER ACCURATE was left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 900 Metres, WINNING BOY got its head up when being steadied away from the heels of VICTORIUS which shifted in.
After being crossed by SEA JADE, RUMINARE was steadied away from the heels of that horse at the 800 Metres.
In the middle stages, EMPIRE OF MONGOLIA got its head on the side and lay out when racing greenly.
Over the final 200 Metres, WINNINGLI shifted ground when giving ground under pressure.
When questioned regarding his riding of HAPPY WAY WINNER, M L Yeung stated that the horse settled back in the field and after being pushed along rounding the Home Turn, he brought HAPPY WAY WINNER to the outside of UNIQUE AWESOME at the entrance of the Straight where it commenced to make some ground.  He said although HAPPY WAY WINNER was inclined to lay out slightly, he continued to ride the horse hands and heels and slapped it with the whip down the shoulder on a number of occasions.  When questioned as to why he did not use the whip behind the saddle in the latter part of the Straight, M L Yeung stated that he felt the horse was at its top and was giving its best, therefore he continued to ride the horse hands and heels.  M L Yeung was advised that his explanation would be reported, however, he must ensure that he tests his mounts in such a fashion so that his riding does not come under notice.  A veterinary inspection of HAPPY WAY WINNER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of SEASONS KING immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
RUMINARE, SEA JADE and FOREVER ACCURATE were sent for sampling.

After beginning awkwardly and making contact with LUCKY GUY, ENDEARING then shifted in, resulting in CAPE THE FAITH which began awkwardly being further hampered.
CALL ME AWESOME began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of CAREFREE LET GO.
On the first turn at the 850 Metres, CALL ME AWESOME (K C Leung) shifted out, resulting in ORIONIDS being hampered and taken wider.  K C Leung advised that CALL ME AWESOME then hung out throughout the middle stages and he was unable to get the horse to relax whilst racing in the lead.  He said as a consequence CALL ME AWESOME was beaten soon after straightening and then weakened in the Straight.  A veterinary inspection of CALL ME AWESOME immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Passing the 500 Metres, LAUGH OUT LOUD was steadied when momentarily tightened for room between LOVELY DELOVELY and GORGEOUS KING which shifted out slightly.
CAREFREE LET GO was held up for a short distance in the early part of the Straight.
Also in the early part of the Straight, LAUGH OUT LOUD was awkwardly placed outside the heels of GORGEOUS KING.
When placed under pressure in the Straight, ORIONIDS raced greenly and was inclined to hang out.
When questioned regarding his riding of ROUNDABOUT in the Home Straight, particularly in the early part of the Straight, D Whyte stated that after discussions with connections prior to its last start win, it was felt that ROUNDABOUT gives its best when able to be brought to the outside as the horse is reluctant to improve between runners.  He said it was decided to ride ROUNDABOUT in exactly the same manner as its last start by going back from its outside barrier and bringing the horse to the extreme outside on straightening.  He said on straightening he brought ROUNDABOUT to the outside and rode the horse in a hands and heels fashion in the early part of the Straight and similar to last start, the horse let down well and commenced to close off strongly.  He said that he continued to ride ROUNDABOUT hands and heels before pulling the whip near the 150 Metres as ROUNDABOUT continued to close off well.  D Whyte was advised that his explanation would be reported, however, he must ensure that he does not give his mounts too much to do.
IRON BOY and LUCKY GUY were sent for sampling.

At declaration time, S Clipperton was declared as the rider of both PABLOSKY and TONYBOY.  It was established that S Clipperton had a firm commitment to ride PABLOSKY.  As such, the Stewards permitted C Schofield to be substituted as the rider of TONYBOY.  For this declaration error, Trainer T P Yung was fined $2,000.
IâM IN CHARGE was withdrawn on 30.9.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter WHITE MAGIC (C Y Ho).  Before being allowed to race again, IâM IN CHARGE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
From wide barriers, BACK IN BLACK and WHITE MAGIC were steadied and shifted across behind runners soon after the start.
After passing the 400 Metres, CLEVER BEAVER attempted to shift out around the heels of BULLISH SMART to improve inside PABLOSKY, however, was prevented from doing so when PABLOSKY maintained its position.  CLEVER BEAVER was then switched back to the inside, however, between the 200 Metres and the 50 Metres was badly held up behind MARVEL TRIBE and unable to improve before obtaining a narrow run to the inside of that horse over the concluding stages.
Passing the 100 Metres, MIDNIGHT RATTLER (J Moreira) was shifted out to improve into tight running between PABLOSKY and HAMMER KING.  As MIDNIGHT RATTLER established running to the outside of the heels of PABLOSKY, it was inclined to lay out and made contact with HAMMER KING which resulted in HAMMER KING racing tight between MIDNIGHT RATTLER and BACK IN BLACK and being steadied over the concluding stages.  J Moreira was advised to ensure that he exercises due care in similar circumstances.  Also over the concluding stages, J Moreira was unable to fully test MIDNIGHT RATTLER as he endeavoured to relieve the tightening to HAMMER KING when also racing close to the heels of NEW ASIA SUNRISE.
DUKEDOM was inclined to lay in under pressure in the Straight.
SMART DECLARATION travelled wide and without cover throughout the race and in the Straight gave ground.
A veterinary inspection of TONYBOY and MARVEL TRIBE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MARVEL TRIBE, NEW ASIA SUNRISE and PABLOSKY were sent for sampling.
<3/10/2016  Additional Veterinary Report>MARVEL TRIBE, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  MARVEL TRIBE was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer K W Lui yesterday morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, MARVEL TRIBE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Whilst Jockey Chadwick was entitled to recognition for a good riding record, nonetheless given the high degree of carelessness in this incident and the severity of the interference, he was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 19 October 2016 and to expire on Thursday, 3 November 2016 on which day he may resume race riding (5 Hong Kong racedays).
Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the riding of N Callan (NOT LISTENINâTOME) 5th placegetter, over the concluding stages did not affect the horseâs finishing position, he was nonetheless reminded of his obligation to ride his mounts out at least hands and heels all the way to the end of the race where circumstances permit. 
A veterinary inspection of NOT LISTENINâTOME immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of DOMINEER immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its right front leg, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.  Before being allowed to race again, DOMINEER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
NOT LISTENINâTOME, AMAZING KIDS and AMBER SKY were sent for sampling.

BABA MAMA was withdrawn on 30.9.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (substantial amount of mucopus in trachea on scoping after track work) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter PEOPLE'S KNIGHT (N Callan).  Before being allowed to race again, BABA MAMA will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
From a wide barrier, ROYAL ELITE was shifted across behind runners in the early stages to obtain cover.
Passing the 900 Metres, HO IN ONE commenced to over-race and shifted out off the heels of DR LISTENING.
On the first turn near the 900 Metres, PEOPLE'S KNIGHT was checked away from the heels of METALLIC STAR (T H So) which shifted in.  T H So was advised that whilst the Stewards acknowledged that the shift from METALLIC STAR was marginal, nonetheless he was severely reprimanded and advised to ensure that runners to his inside are afforded comfortable racing room.
METALLIC STAR lost its right front plate near the 550 Metres.
After being held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight, POWER OF ONE was shifted to the inside of BOLD STITCH when that horse shifted out passing the 300 Metres.  After being tested for a short distance, POWER OF ONE was then steadied when held up behind DR LISTENING and BOLD STITCH which were commencing to give ground.  POWER OF ONE remained held up and was unable to be fully tested in the run to the finishing line.

ROYAL ELITE was then unable to obtain clear running over the concluding stages and as a consequence was not able to be fully tested.
Passing the 300 Metres, MODERN TSAR was shifted to the outside of WUSHU CHAMPION to obtain clear running.
METALLIC STAR and VICTORY DAY were obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the race.
