A veterinary inspection of DR LISTENING immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, DR LISTENING will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of BOLD STITCH immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, BOLD STITCH will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
DR LISTENING, SENSATION and VICTORY DAY were sent for sampling.

SWEET BEAN and KERKENI began only fairly.
From the outside barrier, EQUITY DOCTRINE was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, KERKENI raced tight inside HOLY STAR which got its head on the side and shifted in away from ENJOY THE GAME.
Approaching the 1100 Metres, EQUITY DOCTRINE momentarily became unbalanced when racing tight inside BEST JADE TRIUMPH.
After the 450 Metres, HOLY STAR was crowded for room between YEUNG SING and ENJOY THE GAME which gave ground abruptly after travelling wide and without cover throughout.
KERKENI was held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Passing the 200 Metres, LOYAL CRAFTSMAN raced in restricted room inside FRESH AND FRESH which shifted in when giving ground.
Approaching the 100 Metres, BEST JADE TRIUMPH was directed in away from the heels of MALAYAN PEARL to obtain clear running.
When questioned regarding his riding of BEST JADE TRIUMPH after the 600 Metres, B Prebble stated that as YEUNG SING improved its position forward behind FRANCE VALOUR approaching the 500 Metres, he did give consideration to shifting out to follow that horse, however, he believed that as the horse was carrying top weight, he felt it was a better option to obtain inside runs rather than having to cover extra ground by following YEUNG SING which was racing in about a four wide position.  He said at the 400 Metres HOLY STAR came back in the face of BEST JADE TRIUMPH when that horse was crowded for room which resulted in him having to check BEST JADE TRIUMPH at this time.  He said this incident was exacerbated by the fact that BEST JADE TRIUMPH was also wanting to lay out.  He added after having to check away from the heels of HOLY STAR, he shifted BEST JADE TRIUMPH in and the horse then ran home well.  B Prebble was advised that his explanation would be reported, however, in the opinion of the Stewards, he should have shifted BEST JADE TRIUMPH out to follow YEUNG SING into the Straight which would have provided his mount with the opportunity to shift to that horseâs outside into clear and uninterrupted running.  B Prebble was further advised to ensure that he affords his mounts the best opportunity to improve into the race so that they can finish off their race as best as they are able.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that BEST JADE TRIUMPH had sustained a superficial wound to the inside of the left hock.
A veterinary inspection of KERKENI immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SWEET BEAN and MALAYAN PEARL were sent for sampling.

HAYMAKER began only fairly.
HAPPY BEAUTY was crowded for room on jumping between KIM GLORY and GOLDEN GLORY, both of which shifted ground.
WORLD CITY began awkwardly and, from a wide barrier, was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
NEVER BETTER was steadied in the early stages from a wide barrier and shifted across behind runners.
VICTOR EMPEROR made the turn near the 1000 Metres awkwardly when racing inside the heels of FINE ROCK.
Near the 400 Metres, WORLD CITY raced tight between HAYMAKER and MIDNITE PROMISE.
Rounding the Home Turn, HAYMAKER was awkwardly placed inside the heels of HAPPY BEAUTY.
Passing the 400 Metres, GOLDEN GLORY, which was inclined to lay out throughout the race, momentarily raced in restricted room between KIM GLORY and AMAZING FEELING which shifted out to obtain clear running.
Passing the 300 Metres, WORLD CITY was shifted to the outside of HAPPY BEAUTY to obtain clear running.
Near the 150 Metres, HAPPY BEAUTY was shifted in away from the heels of GAINFULJET which was momentarily awkwardly placed outside the heels of VICTOR EMPEROR which shifted out under pressure.
Throughout the race, KIM GLORY and GOLDEN GLORY travelled wide and without cover.
FINE ROCK and FLYING MONKEY were sent for sampling.

When being re-saddled at the start, E-SUPER sustained a minor cut to the left hind leg.  E-SUPER was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
DIGITAL PIONEER and DIAMOND MASTER began only fairly.
STARTLING POWER shifted out on jumping, resulting in RADIANT STEED and ELITE SPIRIT being hampered.
VERBINSKY shifted in shortly after the start and bumped GOLDEN CHOPSTICKS.
From the outside barrier, PRESIDENTPARAMOUNT was steadied shortly after the start and shifted across behind runners.
Near the 1000 Metres, ELITE SPIRIT was checked away from the heels of RADIANT STEED which shifted out making the turn.
Near the 850 Metres, WHY WHY momentarily raced in restricted room inside VERBINSKY which got its head on the side and lay in.
Passing the winning post, DIAMOND MASTER jumped a shadow.
Throughout the race, MR RIGHT travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, N Callan stated that he was asked to ride E-SUPER in a similar fashion to when he rode the horse to success towards the end of last season when, from a similar barrier, he rode it along in the early stages to clear runners to his inside and then obtained a trailing position behind the leader.  He said in accordance with his instructions, he rode E-SUPER along in the early stages of tonightâs race so as to clear runners to his inside.  He said approaching the 1100 Metres he observed that ENREACHING was also being ridden along and he felt that that horse was being ridden to cross DIAMOND MASTER which was racing on the rail.  He said he therefore steadied E-SUPER in order to be shifted in to race outside ENREACHING after which he intended to steady E-SUPER and allow MR RIGHT, which was racing to the outside of E-SUPER, to cross his mount, thereby obtaining cover.  He said however that ENREACHING did not cross DIAMOND MASTER and as he steadied E-SUPER, his mount commenced to over-race and would not settle.  He said making the turn after the 1000 Metres E-SUPER, when continuing to travel keenly, shifted out abruptly, resulting in the horse making the turn wide and MR RIGHT also being taken wider.  He added because of this he was not able to take up a trailing positon behind ENREACHING as VERBINSKY had obtained this position and E-SUPER was continuing to travel keenly.  He said therefore he was unable to steady E-SUPER and allow MR RIGHT to improve around his mount which resulted in E-SUPER having to race wide and without cover throughout.  A veterinary inspection of E-SUPER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
VERBINSKY and PRESIDENTPARAMOUNT were sent for sampling.

After being loaded, ACE KING reared on a number of occasions, resulting in S Clipperton being dislodged without incident.  Before being allowed to race again, ACE KING will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.
WILD BOY shifted out at the start and bumped OCTAL LUCK.
From wide barriers, KIROV and SMART SALUTE were steadied shortly after the start and shifted across behind runners.
Near the 1150 Metres, ROCKET LET WIN, which was ridden along after beginning only fairly, was crowded for room inside WILD BOY which was taken in by OCTAL LUCK.
At the entrance to the Straight, ACE KING, which had its head on the side and was laying out, was bumped by OCTAL LUCK which shifted out into clear running.
Passing the 300 Metres, WILD BOY raced tight between YO-YO DA and ACE KING which was racing tight outside OCTAL LUCK.  Then passing the 150 Metres, WILD BOY, after continuing to race tight, was hampered when further crowded for room between YO-YO DA and ACE KING, both of which shifted slight ground.
Near the 250 Metres, ARM RUNDA shifted in and bumped LONDON MASTER, resulting in LONDON MASTER becoming unbalanced.
Passing the 200 Metres, YOURTHEWONFORME was steadied and shifted to the outside of SHARP HUNTER when disappointed for running between that horse and YO-YO DA which shifted out.

The Stewards deferred the declaration of weighed-in whilst they considered if GRACEFUL KINGDOM had been afforded a fair start.  Evidence was taken from C Schofield, Mr P F Yiu, the trainer of that horse, and Mr A Speechley, the Starter.  After taking evidence from all parties and after viewing the video, it was established that after being loaded into the barriers, GRACEFUL KINGDOM had a blindfold applied.  Prior to the start being effected, the blindfold was removed by the starting gate handler, however, just prior to the gates opening the starting gate handler attempted to straighten the head of GRACEFUL KINGDOM with the same hand in which he was carrying the blindfold.  This resulted in the blindfold partially covering the left eye of GRACEFUL KINGDOM.  As the Stewards were of the opinion that in attempting to assist GRACEFUL KINGDOM, the starting gate handler had inadvertently impacted upon that horseâs ability to begin with the field as a result of the horseâs vision being partially impaired, it was determined that GRACEFUL KINGDOM had not been afforded a fair start and accordingly the horse was deemed to be a non-runner.

When questioned regarding his riding of SUPER TURBO in the Straight, Z Purton stated that rounding the Home Turn he was following TRAVEL SUCCESSOR which at this time shifted out to obtain clear running and in doing so raced tight inside VICTORY MARVEL.  He said as he anticipated that TRAVEL SUCCESSOR would shift in in the early part of the Straight to race outside REGENCY DARLING, he therefore elected to position his mount behind REGENCY DARLING to take advantage of a run that appeared to be opening up between that horse and FISH Nâ CHIPS to his inside.  He said along the Back Straight he had noted that REGENCY DARLING had raced with its head on the side and therefore he felt that it was more likely that a run would continue to develop between REGENCY DARLING and FISH Nâ CHIPS rather than outside of REGENCY DARLING and inside TRAVEL SUCCESSOR.  He said, as he anticipated, after the 300 Metres TRAVEL SUCCESSOR shifted back in when racing tight inside VICTORY MARVEL which meant that there was no run between TRAVEL SUCCESSOR and REGENCY DARLING.  He said passing the 250 Metres the run to the inside of REGENCY DARLING appeared to be continuing to become available, therefore he shifted his mount to the inside of REGENCY DARLING to take advantage of this run when it developed.  He said as he did this, TRAVEL SUCCESSOR shifted out which resulted in a run becoming available between that horse and REGENCY DARLING, however, at this time he had committed to improving inside the heels of REGENCY DARLING.  He added in order to attempt to obtain the run which had developed to the outside of REGENCY DARLING, he would have had to check SUPER TURBO and lose momentum and therefore he felt it was a better option to continue to wait for the run between REGENCY DARLING and FISH Nâ CHIPS.  He said passing the 200 Metres REGENCY DARLING shifted out, resulting in a tight run developing between that horse and FISH Nâ CHIPS, therefore he rode his mount along to obtain this run.  He said however that a short distance later REGENCY DARLING and FISH Nâ CHIPS both shifted ground, resulting in the run closing and SUPER TURBO again being badly held up for clear running.  He further stated that as the run between those horses did not open up sufficiently for SUPER TURBO to improve its position, SUPER TURBO continued to be badly held up for the remainder of the race and consequently was not able to be tested.  After considering Jockey Purtonâs evidence and after viewing the video, the Stewards accepted his explanation and took no further action.

When questioned, N Rawiller stated that, as usual, he was instructed to lead on GO BABY GO and to find the outside rail if possible.  He said after being placed in the barriers, GO BABY GO became very fractious and threw its head around on a number of occasions.  He said this resulted in GO BABY GO being slow to begin as the start was effected and shifting in abruptly, causing crowding to GRACE HEART.  He said he was then obliged to correct GO BABY GO in an endeavour to alleviate the tightening to GRACE HEART.  He said because of this GO BABY GO settled well back in the field and horses which are noted to go forward in their races around GO BABY GO, namely DRAGON MASTER, GALLANT ROCK and BEAUTY MASTER were all able to quickly assume leading positions.  He said having in mind that he had been asked to find the outside rail, albeit in the lead, after GO BABY GO was slow to begin, he elected to shift it out to race near the outside rail and to follow DRAGON MASTER during the race as he anticipated that this horse would be a strong chance.  He said although there was an opportunity after the 800 Metres to shift GO BABY GO away from the outside rail and improve to the inside of DRAGON MASTER and possibly follow BEAUTY MASTER, he believed he would have had to ride GO BABY GO along to do this and having in mind how far from the finish this opportunity was available, he did not believe it was in the best interests of GO BABY GO to come off the bridle so far from the end of the race.  He added therefore he elected to follow DRAGON MASTER as the race was being run at a very good tempo and GO BABY GO was travelling comfortably.  He said he improved to the outside of DRAGON MASTER when that horse shifted in to improve around GALLANT ROCK, however, GALLANT ROCK gave ground abruptly and for this reason he had to switch out away from that horseâs heels at the 200 Metres and continued to follow DRAGON MASTER through.  N Rawiller was advised that whilst the Stewards accepted that the pre-race instructions had been made redundant by the manner in which the horse began, causing it to race well back in the field, nonetheless in their opinion, there was an opportunity for GO BABY GO to improve its position without having to be unduly pressured to race behind the eventual winner BEAUTY MASTER.  He was further advised to ensure that he remains alert to opportunities to obtain more advantageous positions wherever those circumstances permit.  A veterinary inspection of GO BABY GO immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of GALLANT ROCK, Apprentice K K Chiong stated that the horse travelled strongly in the early and middle stages, similarly to when she had ridden the horse to success in the past.  She said however that at the 300 Metres GALLANT ROCK came under significant pressure and then gave ground abruptly from this point to finish at the rear of the field.  She said whilst GALLANT ROCKâs run ended at the 300 Metres, it was somewhat concerning that the horse gave ground so abruptly.  Mr A T Millard, trainer of GALLANT ROCK, stated that as the horse had raced on a number of occasions towards the back end of last season, he believed it was not necessary to trial the horse in the lead up to todayâs race.  He said the manner in which GALLANT ROCK weakened could be attributed to the horseâs run ending when placed under pressure.  A veterinary inspection of GALLANT ROCK immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of GALLANT ROCK was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, GALLANT ROCK will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
BEAUTY MASTER and THOR THE GREATEST were sent for sampling.

SIMPLY INVINCIBLE began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped UP AND COMING, causing both horses to become unbalanced.
From the outside barrier, STAR MAJESTIC was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Despite being vigorously ridden along, SUPREME PROFIT failed to muster speed and passing the 1500 Metres was shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
In the middle stages, MIGHTY MAVERICK proved difficult to settle and travelled keenly and near the 1000 Metres, when continuing to prove difficult to settle, was steadied away from the heels of CALIFORNIA DISEGNO (M Chadwick) which shifted in when not properly clear.  M Chadwick was severely reprimanded.
PACKING LLAREGYB was unable to obtain clear running in the early part of the Straight and approaching the 300 Metres shifted to the outside of MIGHTY MAVERICK into clear running, causing HARBOUR MASTER to be crowded for room inside TOP ACT.  Then approaching the 200 Metres, HARBOUR MASTER was steadied away from the heels of PACKING LLAREGYB (N Rawiller) which shifted out under pressure.  In this incident, TOP ACT was bumped by HARBOUR MASTER.  N Rawiller was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he makes every endeavour to keep his mounts on a straight course.
Throughout the race, TOP ACT travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned regarding the performance of SIMPLY INVINCIBLE, C Schofield stated that as the horse had been performing best when allowed to relax in the early stages, he shifted SIMPLY INVINCIBLE across behind runners in the early stages and it then travelled comfortably.  He said he followed RENAISSANCE ART throughout the race as he expected this horse would be a strong chance in the race and after the 500 Metres commenced to shift out with that horse to obtain clear running.  He said SIMPLY INVINCIBLE initially had some difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight, however, after obtaining clear running then finished off the race only one-paced.  He added although SIMPLY INVINCIBLE again had some difficulty obtaining clear running approaching and passing the 200 Metres, nonetheless the horse was disappointing in his view.
When questioned regarding the performance of SERGEANT TITANIUM, B Prebble stated that it was anticipated todayâs race would be run at a good tempo and therefore, from a wide barrier, he should have SERGEANT TITANIUM racing where it was comfortable.  He said, as anticipated, the race was run truly and SERGEANT TITANIUM travelled very comfortably in a three wide position with cover behind UP AND COMING.  He said he shifted SERGEANT TITANIUM to the outside of runners rounding the Home Turn to allow the horse to wind into the race and SERGEANT TITANIUM initially quickened satisfactorily.  He said although SERGEANT TITANIUM then finished off the race only one-paced in the Straight, he was not overly disappointed in the performance of the horse as it had previously performed below expectations second up in its campaign.  He further stated he believed that SERGEANT TITANIUM would be better suited by races over a longer distance than that of todayâs event.  A veterinary inspection of SERGEANT TITANIUM immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
A veterinary inspection of RENAISSANCE ART immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
SERGEANT TITANIUM, LUCKY GIRL and ULTIMATE GLORY were sent for sampling.

GREEN CARD shifted in at the start and bumped HARBOUR NOVA.
PAKISTAN BABY, CAPE THE FAITH and CHARITY GLORY were all badly crowded for room between FLYING FORCE and DIAMOND DRAGON which, after initially being directed out by FABULOUS NOVEMBER, then shifted further away from that horse.  After this, PAKISTAN BABY, CAPE THE FAITH and CHARITY GLORY were all shifted across behind runners.
Also from a wide barrier, GOLDEN DEER was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Approaching the 1000 Metres, CAPE THE FAITH got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of HARBOUR NOVA.
Passing the 900 Metres, GREEN CARD was steadied away from the heels of RIGHT CALL (Apprentice K K Chiong) which shifted in when not properly clear.  Apprentice Chiong was reprimanded and advised to ensure that she is sufficiently clear when shifting ground in similar circumstances.
DIAMOND DRAGON lay out in the middle stages.
FABULOUS NOVEMBER had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight and passing the 300 Metres was shifted out across the heels of DIAMOND DRAGON.
HARBOUR NOVA was held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight and passing the 200 Metres made contact with LANG TAI SING to obtain clear running between that horse and FAIRY TWINS.
N Callan (FAIRY TWINS) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that approaching and passing the 100 Metres he permitted his mount to shift out when not clear of HARBOUR NOVA, causing that horse to lose the running to which it was rightfully entitled and to be badly hampered.  N Callan was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 16 October 2016 and to expire on Thursday, 20 October 2016 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, N Callan was fined $20,000.  Following this incident, HARBOUR NOVA was then held up for clear running behind FAIRY TWINS and LANG TAI SING until just prior to the finishing line.
When questioned regarding the performance of GREEN CARD, D Whyte stated that as horses which were racing on the speed in previous races today appeared to be advantaged, he was asked to ride GREEN CARD in about 4th or 5th position if possible.  He said the connections of GREEN CARD did not want to give away too much ground to the front runners in todayâs race having regard to the horse carrying 132 lbs.  He said when GREEN CARD began well, he was able to obtain a forward position without having to pressure the horse.  He said he did give consideration to shifting in to race behind FIVE UP HIGH in the early stages, however, he did not believe that horse would take him into the race, therefore he elected to ride forward of FIVE UP HIGH in order to possibly obtain a position in advance of LANG TAI SING.  He said however that that horse was ridden along to maintain its position and this resulted in GREEN CARD racing in a three wide position without cover throughout the race.  He added whilst GREEN CARD did not finish off the race over the concluding stages, he contributed this to the fact that the horse was obliged to cover ground rather than being ridden in a more forward position than it had previously.  A veterinary inspection of GREEN CARD immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
LANG TAI SING and FAIRY TWINS were sent for sampling.

WINASWEWISH was slow to begin.
AMBITIOUS SPEEDY shifted in at the start and bumped SPICY DOUBLE.
Shortly after the start, SPICY DOUBLE, AMBITIOUS SPEEDY and HIGH SPEED METRO were steadied to obtain a position with cover.
Also shortly after the start, PRECIOUS GEM shifted in and bumped the hindquarters of MI SAVVY BOY which became unbalanced.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, RACINGFORPLEASURE raced tight between PRECIOUS GEM and SILVER GATSBY which shifted in marginally.
After the 1300 Metres, HAPPY CENTURY proved difficult to settle.
Approaching the 1100 Metres, SPICY DOUBLE commenced to prove difficult to settle and shifted out away from the heels of MI SAVVY BOY.
Rounding the Home Turn, HAPPY CENTURY, which was under pressure, was momentarily steadied when awkwardly placed between SILVER GATSBY and GLORY SUNSHINE.  PRECIOUS GEM, which was following, shifted out away from the heels of HAPPY CENTURY and WINASWEWISH, which was following HAPPY CENTURY, was steadied away from the heels of that horse in consequence, resulting in RACINGFORPLEASURE being taken wider.  MI SAVVY BOY, which was following RACINGFORPLEASURE, was hampered in consequence.  After this, HAPPY CENTURY gave ground abruptly.
Passing the 300 Metres, SPICY DOUBLE was shifted to the inside of SAFARI MAGIC after being disappointed for running between that horse and HAPPY CENTURY which was giving ground.  The performance of HAPPY CENTURY, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, HAPPY CENTURY will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned, D Whyte stated that he had to make considerable use of SILVER GATSBY in the early stages to obtain a forward position.  He said after passing the winning post on the first occasion it was left racing wide and without cover and he did consider improving forward to obtain a position closer to the rail in the middle stages, however, he felt that given the amount of use he had made of SILVER GATSBY in the early stages, this would be detrimental to the horseâs chance, therefore he elected to have the horse remain balanced albeit racing wide and without cover.
When questioned regarding the performance of MI SAVVY BOY, C Schofield stated he had hoped that MI SAVVY BOY would be able to obtain a reasonably prominent position, however, he would have had to ride his mount aggressively in the early stages in an attempt to have it obtain a more forward position and therefore it settled slightly further back than had been hoped.  He said MI SAVVY BOY never travelled comfortably and was always being niggled at to maintain its position.  A veterinary inspection of MI SAVVY BOY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of AMBITIOUS SPEEDY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
WINASWEWISH and SAFARI MAGIC were sent for sampling.

K C Leung (ALL TIMES LUCKY) was fined the sum of $3,000 for failing to declare a probable 2 lb overweight on the horse at the time of declaration.
TREASURE AND GOLD began only fairly and shortly after the start was shifted across behind runners.
From a wide barrier, ALL TIMES LUCKY was also shifted across behind runners shortly after the start.
Making the turn near the 1050 Metres, IDYLLIC WIND was steadied to obtain a positon closer to the rail.
After initially being ridden along from a wide barrier, KING OF SMARTS was left racing very wide making the turn near the 1000 Metres and was then steadied to obtain a positon nearer to the rail with cover.
ORIENTAL FANTASIA travelled wide and without cover until after the 600 Metres.
Passing the 200 Metres, ALL TIMES LUCKY was steadied when crowded for room between NOBLE BUDDIES and REAL SUPREME, both of which shifted ground.
Approaching the 100 Metres, TREASURE AND GOLD was bumped on the hindquarters by NOBLE BUDDIES which was momentarily eased away from the heels of REAL SUPREME which shifted in under pressure.
When questioned, B Prebble (SHOWING CHARACTER) stated it was felt that tonightâs race would be run at a good tempo and therefore the field may string out.  He said he was therefore asked to obtain a position with cover if possible, however, not to get too far out of its ground if circumstances permitted.  He said approaching the turn near the 1000 Metres it appeared as though SHOWING CHARACTER would be able to obtain a position with cover behind REAL SUPREME and outside FORZA AVANTI, however, SHOWING CHARACTER was racing too keenly and he was unable to get the horse to steady sufficiently to shift across behind REAL SUPREME.  He said this resulted in the horse racing very wide and without cover throughout the race.  He added it is his intention to suggest to connections that they may wish to consider removing the blinkers from SHOWING CHARACTER in its future starts to help the horse settle better as it is currently travelling too keenly in its races.  A veterinary inspection of SHOWING CHARACTER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
N Rawiller stated that after having to have made considerable use of RUGBY DIAMOND in the early stages to cross to the lead after the 1000 Metres, the horse initially travelled very keenly and proved difficult to settle.  He said however that after the 800 Metres when ORIENTAL FANTASIA improved its position around RUGBY DIAMOND, his mount commenced to travel better, however, it shortened stride noticeably in the early part of the Straight and for this reason he eased it down over the final 200 Metres.  A veterinary inspection of RUGBY DIAMOND immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, RUGBY DIAMOND will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
FORZA AVANTI and IDYLLIC WIND were sent for sampling.

BALAY BALAY was slow to begin.
SO CAFFE was crowded for room on jumping between LUCKY HAMMER and PEARL WARM WARM, which shifted out after beginning awkwardly.
COLOSSUS was crowded for room on jumping between BEAUTY LOVE and LITTLE ISLAND, both of which shifted ground, this resulted in all three horses becoming unbalanced.
From the outside barriers, JOYFUL PARK and CHATER LEGEND were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Approaching the winning post on the first occasion, COLOSSUS was awkwardly placed close to the heels of PEARL WARM WARM.
Passing the 1300 Metres, BALAY BALAY shifted out away from the heels of SO CAFFE, resulting in JOYFUL PARK losing ground when crowded for room inside CHATER LEGEND.
Approaching and passing the 800 Metres, CHATER LEGEND was awkwardly placed close to the heels of COLOSSUS which was travelling keenly and racing close to the heels of PEARL WARM WARM.
At the entrance to the Straight, MISSION POSSIBLE and SO CAFFE raced tight inside PEARL WARM WARM which shifted in.
When questioned regarding her riding of BEAUTY LOVE, Apprentice K K Chiong stated that she had been instructed to lead on the horse if possible.  She said after shifting in to race outside the leader LUCKY HAMMER passing the winning post on the first occasion, she felt that the rider of LUCKY HAMMER was steadying his mount and as she had been instructed to lead, she felt that there was an opportunity to improve her position on BEAUTY LOVE around LUCKY HAMMER and assume the lead.  She said after improving forward of LUCKY HAMMER at the 1200 Metres, that horse maintained its position to the inside of BEAUTY LOVE and it was not until after the 900 Metres that BEAUTY LOVE was able to cross LUCKY HAMMER which resulted in the tempo of the race being much quicker than she had anticipated when she elected to improve forward of LUCKY HAMMER.  Apprentice Chiong agreed that LUCKY HAMMER was travelling more keenly than she thought during the race and, in retrospect, she should have continued to maintain the position outside LUCKY HAMMER.  Apprentice Chiong was reprimanded for her riding of BEAUTY LOVE from after the 1200 Metres and advised to ensure that she rides her mounts with appropriate judgement so that they can finish off their races as best as they are able in the circumstances.
When questioned, C Schofield stated that approaching the Home Turn MISSION POSSIBLE was placed on the rail and following LUCKY HAMMER.  He said at this time PEARL WARM WARM was racing to the outside of LUCKY HAMMER and marginally behind that horse.  He said whilst it was available to him to shift away from the rail and follow PEARL WARM WARM, he did not believe at the time this would place him in a better position than he had at that point.  He said with the worked back rail in operation, he anticipated that clear running would eventuate at the top of the Straight which it ultimately did.  He said however that by not shifting away from the rail, this allowed SO CAFFE to improve its position quickly to the outside of MISSION POSSIBLE passing the 400 Metres.  He added had he have shifted out at this time, whilst this may have prevented SO CAFFE from improving its position, it would not have improved the position of MISSION POSSIBLE which was why he elected to remain racing behind LUCKY HAMMER.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that COLOSSUS was a âroarerâ which had previously been reported.
A veterinary inspection of LUCKY HAMMER immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, LUCKY HAMMER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SO CAFFE and LITTLE ISLAND were sent for sampling.
<13/10/2016  Additional Veterinary Report>After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that COLOSSUS was a âroarerâ which had previously been reported.  COLOSSUS was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer J Moore this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, COLOSSUS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

LETSGOFREE began awkwardly and shortly after the start was crowded for room between GRACYDAD and MASSIVE MILLENNIUM which shifted out.
MASSIVE POWER shifted out at the start and bumped the hindquarters of SUPREME FLIGHT.  After this, MASSIVE POWER was crowded for room between HOT HOT PEPPER and SUPREME FLIGHT which shifted in.
From the outside barrier, FORMULA GALORE was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Approaching the 700 Metres, MASSIVE MILLENNIUM was awkwardly placed outside the heels of HASTA LA VISTA.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, MASSIVE MILLENNIUM raced in restricted room between HASTA LA VISTA and COUR VALANT which, when travelling keenly, was awkwardly placed inside the heels of GOLDEN GLORY which travelled wide and without cover throughout the race.
Shortly after entering the Straight, HASTA LA VISTA was shifted out away from the heels of HOT HOT PEPPER when that horse was shifted to the inside of SUPREME FLIGHT.
Near the 250 Metres, MASSIVE MILLENNIUM was shifted out away from the heels of COUR VALANT which shifted in.
Near the 150 Metres, MASSIVE MILLENNIUM was checked when attempting to obtain clear running between GRACYDAD and NATURAL TEAM which shifted out marginally.  In this incident, GRACYDAD became unbalanced after being bumped by MASSIVE MILLENNIUM.
After obtaining a tight run between PROMPT EXPRESS and COUR VALANT (N Callan) approaching the 100 Metres, HASTA LA VISTA raced tight inside COUR VALANT which shifted in marginally.  COUR VALANT then got its head on the side and hung in under pressure, resulting in HASTA LA VISTA being taken in onto PROMPT EXPRESS, causing that horse and SUPREME FLIGHT to be crowded for room close to the finishing line and HASTA LA VISTA not being able to be ridden out all the way to the end of the race.  Close to the finishing line, COUR VALANT was also unable to be ridden out as N Callan attempted to correct COUR VALANT.  N Callan was severely reprimanded and advised that whilst the Stewards conceded that COUR VALANT was hanging in and proving difficult to ride, nonetheless in similar circumstances he would be expected to make more of an effort to prevent his mount from shifting ground than he did on this occasion. 
Over the concluding stages, MASSIVE POWER was awkwardly placed close to the heels of MASSIVE MILLENNIUM and consequently was not able to be ridden out all the way to the end of the race.
A veterinary inspection of HOT HOT PEPPER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HOT HOT PEPPER, FORMULA GALORE and COUR VALANT were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE JCI HONG KONG SENATE CUP (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
NITRO EXPRESS began very awkwardly, shifted out at the start and made heavy contact with the hindquarters of CLASSIC EMPEROR, causing NITRO EXPRESS to be checked and lose ground.
Shortly after the start, ENORMOUS HONOUR and INDUSTRIALIST WAY bumped due to both horses shifting ground.
From the outside barriers, ACTUARIAT and BEAUTY PRINCE were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After the 1400 Metres, ROYAL PARTNER was left racing wide and without cover.
When ACTUARIAT improved its position around BEAUTY PRINCE passing the 900 Metres, ACTUARIAT was taken wider by BEAUTY PRINCE which then shifted to the outside of JOYFUL MOMENTS.  This resulted in ACTUARIAT racing wide and without cover for the remainder of the race.
At the entrance to the Straight, JOYFUL MOMENTS momentarily raced tight between BEAUTY PRINCE and ENORMOUS HONOUR.
For some distance approaching the winning post, JOYFUL MOMENTS was awkwardly placed inside the heels of CLASSIC EMPEROR when attempting to obtain tight running between that horse and CHEERFUL BOY.
Close to the finishing line, JOYFUL MOMENTS was then steadied when unable to improve between CHEERFUL BOY and CLASSIC EMPEROR which shifted in.
When questioned, Apprentice H N Wong stated that he had been asked by Mr C S Shum, the trainer of CHEERFUL BOY, to commence to shift away from the rail after the 500 Metres as it appeared as though a number of horses from earlier races had been advantaged by being positioned closer to the middle of the track.  He said passing the 500 Metres he commenced to work away from the rail and then particularly at the entrance to the Straight shifted CHEERFUL BOY out further in compliance with his instructions.
A veterinary inspection of JOLLY GENE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ROYAL PARTNER, NITRO EXPRESS and INDUSTRIALIST WAY were sent for sampling.

VERY RICH MAN, which was fractious in the barriers, lifted its front feet off the ground as the start was effected and consequently was slow to begin.
JUMBO HAPPINESS began only fairly and shortly after the start was shifted across behind runners.
Shortly after the start, C P POWER momentarily raced tight between TRENDIFUL and LYRIC ACE which shifted out.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, C P POWER shifted out away from the heels of TRENDIFUL and bumped MASSIVE MOVE, which throughout the race travelled wide and without cover, resulting in that horse becoming unbalanced and being taken wider.
Passing the 400 Metres, C P POWER was steadied when attempting to obtain tight running between TRENDIFUL and MASSIVE MOVE.
Passing the 150 Metres, JUMBO HAPPINESS, which was closing off the race well, was shifted out away from the heels of C P POWER which lay out under pressure.
After the race, H W Lai (HAPPY SOUND) said that the horse, which was having its first start at Happy Valley tonight, was reluctant to stretch out despite being ridden along throughout the race, did not feel comfortable in its action and became unbalanced on a number of occasions.  A veterinary inspection of HAPPY SOUND immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Following the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that TRENDIFUL had bled from both nostrils.
Also following the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on C P POWER at the request of Trainer A Millard.  The Veterinary Surgeon reported that this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, C P POWER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of LYRIC ACE immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, LYRIC ACE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of VERY RICH MAN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
C P POWER, JUNZI and BEAUTY CONNECTION were sent for sampling.

As the start was effected, ENTRUSTING lifted its front feet off the ground and consequently was slow to begin.
WEALTHY FORTUNE was crowded for room on jumping between AUTUMN GOLD and KING BOUNTIFUL, both of which shifted ground.
From the outside barrier, SUPER FORM was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Near the 1700 Metres, the buckle of N Rawillerâs (SMART UNION) right stirrup leather broke, resulting in the stirrup iron coming loose and N Rawiller being severely disadvantaged for the remainder of the race.  After the race, the Stewards, in the presence of N Rawiller, inspected the stirrup leathers used by Jockey Rawiller in this race and found this gear to be relatively new and in good condition.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, AZTEC EMPIRE was left racing wide and without cover.
Approaching the 600 Metres, SUPERNATURAL was momentarily crowded for room between TRUE COMMENT and AZTEC EMPIRE which improved its position into the lead.
Approaching and passing the 600 Metres, CASA MASTER and SPEEDY WALLY raced tight and making the turn after the 600 Metres CASA MASTER raced in restricted room between SPEEDY WALLY and THE RAINBOW.
Shortly after entering the Straight, TRUE COMMENT was bumped by AZTEC EMPIRE which lay in.
In the Straight, SPEEDY WALLY raced with its head on the side and lay in under pressure.
A veterinary inspection of WEALTHY FORTUNE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of CASA MASTER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
SPEEDY WALLY and AUTUMN GOLD were sent for sampling.

Whilst in the saddling stalls, GREAT CHARM had its left front plate refitted.  GREAT CHARM was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
HAPPY CHEERS began awkwardly and shortly after the start was bumped by BLAZE STAMINA which shifted out after also beginning awkwardly.  A short distance after this, BLAZE STAMINA was awkwardly placed inside the heels of GO BABY GO which was bumped by GREAT CHARM which shifted in after also being bumped by CHEVALIER STAR.
From the outside barriers, FANTASTIC FEELING and LOVELY DELOVELY were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Approaching the 1000 Metres, BLAZE STAMINA raced tight inside GREAT CHARM which got its head on the side and shifted in away from GRAND HARBOUR.
At the entrance to the Straight, SUPER TURBO was shifted out across the heels of BLAZE STAMINA.
SUPER TURBO had difficulty obtaining clear running approaching the 200 Metres.
Approaching the 150 Metres, GREAT CHARM and WHOâSTHEDUDE raced tight between SUPER TURBO which shifted out and SPEEDY ACHIEVER which shifted in after being bumped on the hindquarters by WHOâSTHEDUDE.
D Whyte (FANTASTIC FEELING) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that over the concluding stages he permitted his mount to shift in, resulting in WHOâSTHEDUDE being hampered and taken in across the rightful running of SUPER TURBO, causing that horse to be checked when taken across the heels of GO BABY GO.  D Whyte was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 30 October 2016 and to expire on Thursday, 3 November 2016 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards took into account D Whyteâs good race riding record.  Because of this incident, WHOâSTHEDUDE was unable to be ridden out to the end of the race.
For the majority of the race, GREAT CHARM travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of COURAGEOUS BROTHER immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, COURAGEOUS BROTHER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
WHOâSTHEDUDE, FANTASTIC FEELING and CHEVALIER STAR were sent for sampling.

SUPER EURO STAR, which was fractious in the stalls, will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test before being allowed to race again.
CARRY TO WIN and FIONN'S CITY were slow to begin.
RED SUN and AMBITIOUS HEART were crowded for room on jumping between SEA JADE and DON WONGCHOY which shifted out away from FANTASTIC FABIO.  In this incident, SEA JADE became unbalanced when bumped on the hindquarters by RED SUN and also when bumped by STARLOT which got its head on the side and shifted in.
Passing the 600 Metres, FANTASTIC FABIO was awkwardly placed close to the heels of PREMIERE.
CARRY TO WIN had some difficulty obtaining clear running after the 400 Metres and near the 200 Metres was steadied after momentarily racing in restricted room between DON WONGCHOY and FANTASTIC FABIO which shifted in.
K C Leung (AMBITIOUS HEART) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 50 Metres he permitted his mount to shift out under pressure when not clear of CARRY TO WIN, causing that horse to be checked away from the heels of AMBITIOUS HEART.  K C Leung was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 26 October 2016 and to expire on Monday, 31 October 2016 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, K C Leung was fined $20,000.
Close to the finishing line, S Clipperton, the rider of SEA JADE, stopped riding his mount when FIONN'S CITY shifted out abruptly in advance of SEA JADE away from the heels of PREMIERE.
When questioned regarding the performance of SEA JADE, S Clipperton stated that the horse, which was coming back in distance from the 1200 Metres to the 1000 Metres, was not as comfortable over the straight course as it was at its last start around the bends.  He said because of this he recommended to connections after the race that they consider stepping the horse back up in distance in its future races.
The Stewards questioned M L Yeung regarding his riding of FIONN'S CITY particularly over the final 200 Metres.  M L Yeung stated that after being instructed to have his horse in as forward a position as possible, he rode his mount aggressively in the early stages including slapping it down the shoulder with the whip, however, FIONN'S CITY did not show any early speed which resulted in the horse racing at the rear of the field.  He said he rode the horse continuously throughout the early and middle stages as FIONN'S CITY was showing no interest in racing and was not responding to his riding.  He said because of this at the 600 Metres he commenced to use the whip on FIONN'S CITY in an endeavour to have it finish off the race.  He said, despite using the whip on a number of occasions, FIONN'S CITY did not respond to his riding until passing the 200 Metres at which time the horse commenced to pick up ground.  He said when FIONN'S CITY gained ground rapidly, he stopped using the whip on the horse to direct it in away from the heels of SEA JADE to improve into a tight run which was some distance in advance of FIONN'S CITY between SEA JADE and STARLOT.  He said FIONN'S CITY would not respond to his riding and despite him directing the horse's head inwards, FIONN'S CITY would not shift in away from the outside rail and it was not until FIONN'S CITY improved onto the heels of SEA JADE that the horse then shifted in away from behind that horse.  He added after shifting to the inside of SEA JADE approaching the 50 Metres, he commenced to use the whip in the right hand on FIONN'S CITY to improve into a run which was available between PREMIERE and CHEER WIN.  He said he was then not able to use the whip on the horse as FIONN'S CITY, of its own accord, shifted out onto the heels of PREMIERE, resulting in him having to check severely away from the heels of that horse until he was able to shift FIONN'S CITY to the outside of PREMIERE.  He said at all stages over the final 200 Metres he was not able to control FIONN'S CITY which, despite his best endeavours, took charge of him.  After having considered the evidence of Jockey Yeung, viewed all the available footage and after also considering the horse's previous history in which it had been stood down on two occasions out of three races for proving difficult to manage, the Stewards advised Jockey Yeung that they would report his explanation.  Trainer C S Shum was advised that FIONN'S CITY would be required to barrier trial to the satisfaction of the Stewards before being permitted to race again and that an apprentice jockey would not be permitted to ride the horse.  He was further advised that the Stewards would monitor the racing manners of FIONN'S CITY closely in its future starts so as to ensure that the horse does not present a safety risk.
SEA JADE, CHEER WIN and PREMIERE were sent for sampling.

Just prior to the start being effected, ARCHIPPUS became fractious and then was slow to begin.
Shortly after the start, RACING SUPERNOVA was crowded for room between HAPPY YEAH YEAH and MY LITTLE FRIEND which shifted out.  The tightening to RACING SUPERNOVA was exacerbated when HAPPY YEAH YEAH shifted in when bumped on the hindquarters by RACING SUPERNOVA.  This resulted in RACING SUPERNOVA losing ground and racing towards the rear of the field.
Approaching the 800 Metres, RACING SUPERNOVA momentarily raced in restricted room between HAPPY YEAH YEAH and MY LITTLE FRIEND which got its head on the side and shifted out despite the efforts of its rider.
Passing the 400 Metres, RACING SUPERNOVA was shifted to the outside of MALMSTEEN after being disappointed for running between that horse and COUNTRY MELODY.
ARCHIPPUS was unable to obtain clear running until over the final 300 Metres and consequently was not able to be tested.
Passing the 200 Metres, SMART DECLARATION was crowded for room between GOLDEN HARVEST and TRIUMPHANT JEWEL which shifted out marginally.
Passing the 100 Metres, RACING SUPERNOVA raced tight between CHARITY JOY and HELLA HEDGE which was racing tight outside BAD BOY.
Over the concluding stages, RACING SUPERNOVA raced close to the heels of ADVENTURER.
RACING SUPERNOVA, ADVENTURER and BAD BOY were sent for sampling.

PAKISTAN STAR shifted in at the start and bumped HAMMER KING.
LUCKY DOUBLE EIGHT and GORGEOUS KING made heavy contact on jumping, causing both horses to become badly unbalanced.
From the outside barrier, HIGH AND MIGHTY was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Throughout the early and middle stages, SPICY SURE travelled strongly in the lead.
Approaching the 900 Metres, SOLAR HEI HEI commenced to prove difficult to settle and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of SPEEDY LONGWAH.
At the 900 Metres, MERION was awkwardly placed close to the heels of MR BOGART.
Passing the 500 Metres, SOLAR HEI HEI and TRAVEL DATUK raced tight as SOLAR HEI HEI shifted out into clear running.
At the entrance to the Straight, HIGH AND MIGHTY was shifted in away from the heels of SANTA FE SUN.
Near the 350 Metres, SPEEDY LONGWAH shifted out and bumped GORGEOUS KING, causing both horses to become unbalanced.  LUCKY DOUBLE EIGHT, which was following, was shifted out away from the heels of GORGEOUS KING passing the 300 Metres.
Passing the 150 Metres, HIGH AND MIGHTY was momentarily awkwardly placed close to the heels of MERION which shifted out.
S Clipperton (HIGH AND MIGHTY) was reminded of his obligation to ride his mounts out to the best of his ability all the way to the end of the race.
After the race, C Y Ho (LUCKY DOUBLE EIGHT) reported that his saddle shifted forward rounding the Home Turn.
MR BOGART and PAKISTAN STAR were sent for sampling.

PERFECT TIMING and SHOW MISSION bumped on jumping.
POLYMER LUCK began awkwardly.
DOUBLE POINT shifted out at the start when being ridden along, resulting in BLISS CARTEL being hampered and taken out onto PRINCE FALCON which lost ground when crowded for room inside WINGOLD.  WINGOLD shifted out after being bumped by PRINCE FALCON, resulting in ENJOY THE GAME being crowded for room inside PERFECT TIMING.
From a wide barrier, ATOMIC BLAST was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 1400 Metres, WINGOLD commenced to prove difficult to settle and got its head up after shifting in away from NOVEL START and became awkwardly placed outside the heels of DOUBLE POINT.  After this, WINGOLD continued to prove difficult to settle and got its head up for some distance before being left racing wide and without cover passing the 900 Metres.
BLISS CARTEL lost its right front plate near the 850 Metres.
In the early part of the Straight, CASH COURIER and SHOW MISSION raced tight.
Passing the 400 Metres, PERFECT TIMING was bumped by GARLIC YEAH which attempted to shift to the outside of WINGOLD into clear running.  This resulted in GARLIC YEAH being awkwardly placed close to the heels of WINGOLD for a short distance.
Passing the 300 Metres, POLYMER LUCK commenced to hang in and shifted ground, resulting in SHOW MISSION being bumped.  POLYMER LUCK then continued to hang in and proved difficult to ride and over the concluding stages shifted in, resulting in CASH COURIER being awkwardly placed inside the heels of POLYMER LUCK.
A veterinary inspection of NO LAUGHING MATTER immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm.  Before being allowed to race again, NO LAUGHING MATTER will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
PRINCE FALCON and POLYMER LUCK were sent for sampling.

LAUGH OUT LOUD was crowded for room on jumping between GOOD METHOD and WINNING VIBE which shifted out.  In this incident, GOOD METHOD became unbalanced after being bumped on the hindquarters by LAUGH OUT LOUD.
From wide barriers, HASTILY FEET, ROCK THE TREE and BEST EFFORT were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
SUNNY WIN was also steadied in the early stages to obtain a position closer to the rail.
Approaching the 1200 Metres, LAUGH OUT LOUD was checked when crowded for room between MEISTERSTUECK which at this time got its head up when steadied to allow ARGENTUM to cross and inside AMRITSARIA which got its head on the side and shifted in away from BEST HOPE.  DARING FIT, which was following LAUGH OUT LOUD, shifted in away from the heels of that horse, resulting in HASTILY FEET being crowded for room before DARING FIT was shifted out to relieve the tightening to HASTILY FEET.  As the Stewards were satisfied that this incident was primarily due to the racing manners of AMRITSARIA shifting in away from BEST HOPE rather than being directed inwards by that horse, no further action was taken.  After this, LAUGH OUT LOUD proved difficult to settle and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of AMRITSARIA approaching and passing the 1100 Metres.
AMRITSARIA lost its left front plate near the 1100 Metres.
After the 900 Metres, BEST HOPE was left racing wide and without cover.
Approaching the 500 Metres, SUNNY WIN was bumped and taken wider by LAUGH OUT LOUD which shifted out into clear running.
Rounding the Home Turn, HASTILY FEET was awkwardly placed close to the heels of MEISTERSTUECK.
In the early part of the Straight, DARING FIT had some difficulty obtaining clear running.
Near the 400 Metres, BEST EFFORT was shifted in away from the heels of MEISTERSTUECK to obtain clear running.
Passing the 300 Metres, MEISTERSTUECK shifted out abruptly when being ridden along.  After this, MEISTERSTUECK raced with its head on the side and was inclined to lay out under pressure.
A veterinary inspection of LAUGH OUT LOUD and BEST HOPE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HOUSE OF FUN, ARGENTUM and GOOD METHOD were sent for sampling.

HURRICANE KID knuckled over badly at the start and consequently lost ground.
WAYFOONG VINNIE began awkwardly.
Near the 1100 Metres, WAYFOONG VINNIE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of WINNINGLI.
Making the turn near the 700 Metres, MEGATRON got its head on the side, shifted out abruptly and lost ground when being checked away from the heels of HEARTS KEEPER.
For the majority of the race, FINE ROCK travelled wide and without cover and making the turn after the 700 Metres got its head on the side and lay out.
Passing the 600 Metres, HURRICANE KID was awkwardly placed behind FURIOUS PEGASUS.
Shortly after entering the Straight, HURRICANE KID was shifted out away from the heels of FURIOUS PEGASUS.
Following the race, B Prebble was dislodged from SUPER MAN without incident.
After the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on HURRICANE KID at the request of Trainer P O'Sullivan.  The Veterinary Surgeon reported that this examination showed a substantial amount of mucus in the horse's trachea.
A veterinary inspection of FINE ROCK immediately following the race found that horse to have sustained a small superficial wound to the right hind coronet.
SUPER MAN and I'M THE WON FOR U were sent for sampling.

PLENTY OF SPEED and SNOWHOOVES began awkwardly and lost ground.
From the outside barriers, THUNDER DASH and BE THERE AHEAD were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Approaching the 900 Metres, SNOWHOOVES was left racing wide and without cover.
Approaching the 300 Metres, FANTASTICLIFE was steadied when disappointed for running between JIMSON THE FAMOUS and PLAIN BLUE BANNER which shifted out.  FANTASTICLIFE was then held up for clear running behind JIMSON THE FAMOUS which shifted out after the 300 Metres, resulting in a run becoming momentarily available between PLAIN BLUE BANNER and JIMSON THE FAMOUS.  FANTASTICLIFE was then awkwardly placed close to the heels of JIMSON THE FAMOUS approaching the 200 Metres when that horse shifted back in.  Near the 100 Metres, FANTASTICLIFE had difficulty obtaining clear running and consequently was not able to be properly tested.
For some distance approaching the 200 Metres, PLAIN BLUE BANNER raced in restricted room between LE PEGASE and FRIENDS FOREVER when obtaining tight running between those horses.  Then near the 200 Metres, FRIENDS FOREVER shifted in slightly, resulting in PLAIN BLUE BANNER becoming unbalanced when crowded for room.  In this incident, FRIENDS FOREVER also became unbalanced when bumped on the hindquarters by PLAIN BLUE BANNER.  As FRIENDS FOREVER was shifted out to relieve the tightening to PLAIN BLUE BANNER, it bumped the hindquarters of JIMSON THE FAMOUS which became unbalanced.  Passing the 100 Metres, FRIENDS FOREVER was then awkwardly placed outside the heels of PLAIN BLUE BANNER.
In the Straight, EVERYDAY LETTUCE gave ground abruptly and finished tailed out.  A veterinary inspection of EVERYDAY LETTUCE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of EVERYDAY LETTUCE was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, EVERYDAY LETTUCE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After the race, K C Leung (BE THERE AHEAD) stated that his mount shortened stride noticeably after the 700 Metres and as the horse did not feel comfortable in its action, he eased it down after the 600 Metres.  A veterinary inspection of BE THERE AHEAD immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  The performance of BE THERE AHEAD was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, BE THERE AHEAD will be required to perform competitively in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of DANEWIN EXPRESS, J Moreira stated that his mount was fractious in the barriers and kicked out on a number of occasions.  He said because of this DANEWIN EXPRESS jumped awkwardly and was slow to begin.  He said after having to ride his mount along for some distance in the early stages to obtain a position close to the rail, DANEWIN EXPRESS did not travel comfortably at any stage of the race and after being placed under pressure in the early part of the Straight, it only gave him a limited response before weakening over the final 200 Metres.  A veterinary inspection of DANEWIN EXPRESS immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, DANEWIN EXPRESS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of SNOWHOOVES immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
DANEWIN EXPRESS, PLAIN BLUE BANNER and JIMSON THE FAMOUS were sent for sampling.

IMPERIAL SEAL was withdrawn on 15.10.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter CIRCUIT FORTUNE (Apprentice H T Mo).  Before being allowed to race again, IMPERIAL SEAL will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
On arrival at the Start, M Chadwick expressed concern regarding the action of ROYAL SPIRIT.  ROYAL SPIRIT was examined by the Veterinary Officer who found the horse to be lame in its right front leg and accordingly was not suitable to race.  Acting on this advice, the Stewards ordered the withdrawal of ROYAL SPIRIT.  Before being allowed to race again, ROYAL SPIRIT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
AMAZING ALWAYS shifted out at the start and bumped UNICRON JEWELLERY, resulting in that horse becoming unbalanced.
GORGEOUS AGAIN and INVENTION MASTER bumped at the start.
Shortly after the start, BLAZING PASS and RED HORSE bumped.
Making the first turn near the 900 Metres, COOL AND NEAT was awkwardly placed close to the heels of INVENTION MASTER.
UNICRON JEWELLERY was held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight when attempting to improve between RED HORSE and XINJIANG YARN where there was insufficient room.
VICTORY MASTER was held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Approaching the 150 Metres, XINJIANG YARN was hampered when taken in by INVENTION MASTER (J Moreira) which shifted ground before being corrected by its rider.  J Moreira was advised that in similar circumstances he would be expected to react quicker to his mounts shifting ground than he did on this occasion.
Approaching the 100 Metres, Z Purton, the rider of TRAVEL AMBASSADOR, was obliged to stop riding his mount due to being awkwardly placed close to the heels of UNICRON JEWELLERY.
Over the concluding stages, UNICRON JEWELLERY was awkwardly placed outside the heels of INVENTION MASTER.
For the majority of the race, CIRCUIT FORTUNE travelled wide and without cover.
INVENTION MASTER lost its left front plate after the race.
A veterinary inspection of COOL AND NEAT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
INVENTION MASTER, VICTORY MASTER and XINJIANG YARN were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE CHINESE GENERAL CHAMBER OF COMMERCE CUP (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
As the start was effected, HO HO FEEL lifted its front feet off the ground and was slow to begin.
EASY HEDGE began awkwardly.
Shortly after the start, UNIQUE JOYOUS was crowded for room between RAZOR QUEST and ASHKIYR, both of which shifted ground.
Approaching and passing the 1300 Metres, GREEN DISPATCH raced tight inside SKY KING which was awkwardly placed inside the heels of HOLMES LEGEND.
CLOUD NINE lost its right hind plate near the 1100 Metres.
For some distance in the early part of the Straight, AMAZING AGILITY and UNIQUE JOYOUS raced tight and bumped as AMAZING AGILITY shifted out into clear running.
GREEN DISPATCH, HO HO FEEL and LOTUS STRIKES BACK were all held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight.
For some distance approaching and passing the 300 Metres, REDWOOD BABY was held up for clear running and near the 200 Metres was steadied away from the heels of CLOUD NINE after being unable to improve between that horse which was taken out by GREEN DISPATCH and ALLCASH.
Approaching the 250 Metres, AMAZING AGILITY was awkwardly placed outside the heels of GENERAL SHERMAN which shifted out under pressure.
Passing the 200 Metres, ALLCASH was awkwardly placed inside the heels of SKY KING.
Passing the 100 Metres, EASY HEDGE was momentarily steadied away from the heels of LOTUS STRIKES BACK (S Clipperton) which shifted in.  S Clipperton was advised to exercise more care.
Passing the 50 Metres, ALLCASH and SKY KING raced tight between CLOUD NINE and HO HO FEEL.
The Stewards will interview J Moreira, the rider of EASY HEDGE, regarding the disappointing performance of the horse prior to Race 1 at the Happy Valley racemeeting on Wednesday, 19 October 2016.
A veterinary inspection of SKY KING and EASY HEDGE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
EASY HEDGE, GREEN DISPATCH and LOTUS STRIKES BACK were sent for sampling.

SUN TOUCH began only fairly.
OUR FOLKS shifted out at the start and hampered VICTORY FOLLOW ME.
From a wide barrier, DISCIPLES TWELVE was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 800 Metres, TEAM FORTUNE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of SEA RUBY when SEA RUBY was steadied in an attempt to obtain cover.  SEA RUBY was however obliged to race wide and without cover throughout the middle stages before being eased out of the race rounding the Home Turn.  After the race, B Prebble stated that his mount felt sore and he was reluctant to continue to ride it out in the Straight.  A veterinary inspection of SEA RUBY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of SEA RUBY was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, SEA RUBY will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Approaching the 600 Metres, DISCIPLES TWELVE got its head on the side and lay out towards the heels of VICTORY FOLLOW ME.
Passing the 150 Metres, DISCIPLES TWELVE was shifted out away from the heels of OUR FOLKS which, after initially being directed out by SUN TOUCH, then shifted out further.
When questioned regarding his riding in the Straight, S Clipperton stated that after racing on the rail throughout the early and middle stages, he shifted SUN TOUCH out rounding the Home Turn and then in the early part of the Straight was able to direct SUN TOUCH to the outside of SKY HERO which was racing in advance of SUN TOUCH.  He said as soon as he did this, SUN TOUCH got its head on the side and commenced to hang in and was reluctant to remain racing to the outside of SKY HERO.  He added he used the whip in the right hand in an endeavour to have SUN TOUCH straighten up, however, when he did this, the horse hung in and shifted back in behind SKY HERO near the 200 Metres.  He added he balanced SUN TOUCH up so as to prevent the horse from continuing to hang in and then was able to shift the horse back to the outside of SKY HERO near the 100 Metres.  He said as he was concerned that SUN TOUCH would continue to hang in, he again balanced the horse for a number of strides before commencing to ride it out vigorously to the end of the race.  S Clipperton was advised that the Stewards accepted that his mount was proving difficult to ride due to its inclination to hang in, however, he must, wherever possible and even in difficult circumstances, ride his mounts out to the best of his ability so as to obtain the best possible placing.
SKY HERO, TEAM FORTUNE and HARBOUR ALERT were sent for sampling.

LOOK ERAS began awkwardly and then was crowded for room on jumping between DEJA VU and MOLLY'S JADE STAR, both of which shifted ground.  After this, LOOK ERAS was shifted across behind runners.
ENDEARING was crowded for room on jumping between PEOPLE'S KNIGHT which shifted out after beginning awkwardly and HARD BALL GET which shifted in.  After this, HARD BALL GET was steadied and shifted across behind runners.
WINFIELD began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped BEAUTY FLARE, resulting in WINFIELD losing ground.
From the outside barrier, AEROSPEED was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 1300 Metres, WINFIELD raced in restricted room inside BEAUTY FLARE which got its head on the side and lay in despite the efforts of its rider.
Approaching the 1100 Metres, FIVE UP HIGH shifted out and was momentarily awkwardly placed close to the heels of HEALTHY JOYFUL.  MARVEL HERO, which was following, was inconvenienced in consequence.
Approaching the 1000 Metres, FIVE UP HIGH commenced to prove very difficult to settle and was checked away from the heels of DEJA VU.  Then making the turn passing the 900 Metres, FIVE UP HIGH shifted out away from the heels of DEJA VU, resulting in MARVEL HERO being checked away from the heels of FIVE UP HIGH.  ENDEARING, which was racing outside FIVE UP HIGH, was directed out due to the racing manners of FIVE UP HIGH.  After this, ENDEARING was allowed to improve its position into the lead and MARVEL HERO was taken into a position very wide and without cover by WINFIELD which shifted to the outside of DEJA VU.
Approaching the 500 Metres, WINFIELD and MARVEL HERO raced tight.  Then a short distance after this, WINFIELD was awkwardly placed close to the heels of FIVE UP HIGH.
Rounding the Home Turn, METALLIC STAR and MOLLY'S JADE STAR raced tight and bumped as METALLIC STAR improved into tight running between ENDEARING and MOLLY'S JADE STAR.
WINFIELD had some difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight.
HEALTHY JOYFUL was held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Approaching the 350 Metres, METALLIC STAR was awkwardly placed outside the heels of ENDEARING which shifted out under pressure.
M L Yeung (DEJA VU) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that passing the 250 Metres he failed to make sufficient endeavour to prevent his mount from shifting out when not clear of WINFIELD, resulting in that horse having to be checked and losing the running to which it was rightfully entitled.  M L Yeung was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 23 October 2016 and to expire on Thursday, 27 October 2016 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, M L Yeung was fined $15,000.
Approaching the 200 Metres, FIVE UP HIGH, MARVEL HERO and MODERN TSAR all raced tight between DEJA VU and AEROSPEED, both of which shifted ground.
After the race, D Whyte was dislodged from MODERN TSAR without incident.
When questioned regarding the performance of WINFIELD, Z Purton stated that he was not able to obtain clear running in the early part of the Straight and when the run presented itself between DEJA VU and FIVE UP HIGH after the 300 Metres, WINFIELD commenced to improve into the run only fairly.  He said he then had to check WINFIELD passing the 250 Metres which resulted in the horse losing any momentum that it had.  He said he was not able to say how well WINFIELD would have finished off the race, however, at the time that the interference occurred, WINFIELD was not travelling strongly.  A veterinary inspection of WINFIELD immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of MARVEL HERO and MODERN TSAR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HEALTHY JOYFUL and MOLLY'S JADE STAR were sent for sampling.

NOBLE BUDDIES was slow to begin.
INNOVATIVE WINNER began only fairly.
O'SOCOOLE was crowded for room on jumping between MAJOR CONNECTION and ALL TOGETHER whish shifted out.  In this incident, MAJOR CONNECTION became unbalanced after bumping with O'SOCOOLE.  
SAFARI MAGIC and SHOWING CHARACTER bumped at the start.  After this, SHOWING CHARACTER was shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 950 Metres, O'SOCOOLE shifted out and bumped MAJOR CONNECTION.
Making the first turn, ALL TOGETHER shifted out and bumped O'SOCOOLE.  MAJOR CONNECTION, which was following ALL TOGETHER, shifted in away from the heels of that horse, resulting in ST YAZIN being momentarily crowded for room.  After this, MAJOR CONNECTION raced close to the heels of ALL TOGETHER.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, INNOVATIVE WINNER lost ground when crowded for room between SHOWING CHARACTER and NOBLE BUDDIES which shifted out marginally.
Passing the 300 Metres, MAJOR CONNECTION and GOOD LUCK MAN raced tight as MAJOR CONNECTION attempted to shift to the outside of O'SOCOOLE.
Throughout the race, O'SOCOOLE travelled wide and without cover.
ST YAZIN and GIDDY GIDDY were sent for sampling.

At declaration time, Z Purton was declared as the rider of both DRAGON BACHELOR and SWEET BEAN.  It was established that Z Purton had a firm commitment to ride DRAGON BACHELOR.  As such, the Stewards permitted C Y Ho to be substituted as the rider of SWEET BEAN.  For this declaration error, Trainer C Fownes was fined $2,000.
MIGHTY WONGCHOY and FRANCE VALOUR began only fairly.
THIS IS GLADIATOR began awkwardly and then bumped with DRAGON BACHELOR which shifted out.
Despite being ridden along in the early stages, MIGHTY WONGCHOY failed to muster speed.
From the outside barriers, SWEET BEAN and MIZZEN GREY were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Making the turn after the 1000 Metres, MIGHTY WONGCHOY commenced to prove difficult to settle and shifted out away from the heels of EQUITY DOCTRINE and consequently was left racing wide and without cover.  Then making the turn after the 600 Metres, MIGHTY WONGCHOY was taken wider still by THIS IS GLADIATOR which shifted out.
Near the 550 Metres, MIZZEN GREY was awkwardly placed close to the heels of MIGHTY WONGCHOY.
Near the 250 Metres, WIN CHANCE and THIS IS GLADIATOR raced tight as WIN CHANCE improved into tight running between that horse and ISLAND FLYER.  Then approaching the 200 Metres, WIN CHANCE was shifted out away from the heels of ISLAND FLYER to obtain clear running.
Passing the 250 Metres, DRAGON BACHELOR, which was giving ground, was bumped by FLYING MACHINE which improved into tight running between that horse and FRESH AND FRESH which shifted in when also commencing to give ground.
After the race, Apprentice K K Chiong reported that MIGHTY WONGCHOY stumbled shortly after passing the winning post and therefore she dismounted from the horse.  A veterinary inspection of MIGHTY WONGCHOY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FLYING MACHINE and CHOICE EXCHEQUER were sent for sampling.

WILD BOY was slow to begin and shortly after the start was shifted across behind runners from a wide barrier.
Also from a wide barrier, SMART SALUTE was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
RICHCITY FORTUNE began awkwardly and shortly after the start was steadied away from the heels of SECRET AGENT after being taken in by YO-YO DA which in turn was taken in by FOREVER POSH.  In this incident, YO-YO DA was also steadied away from the heels of FOREVER POSH (D Whyte) which was then straightened by its rider.  D Whyte was advised to exercise more care in similar circumstances.
EMPIRE OF MONGOLIA shifted in shortly after the start and bumped MODERN FORTUNE.
When being ridden along to obtain a forward position, FUNNY BUDDIES got its head on the side and lay in approaching and making the turn after the 1100 Metres.  FUNNY BUDDIES subsequently travelled wide and without cover for the majority of the race.
After the 900 Metres, FOREVER POSH travelled keenly and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of HIGH VOLATILITY.
Close to the finishing line, FOREVER POSH was steadied away from the heels of WILD BOY (J Moreira) which shifted in.  J Moreira was advised to exercise more care.
A veterinary inspection of FUNNY BUDDIES immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HIGH VOLATILITY and WILD BOY were sent for sampling.

Shortly after the start, WINNING TALENT was crowded for room between GREAT TOPLIGHT and DASHING SUPER which shifted in.
From wide barriers, LOVE CHUNGHWA, WINNER ST PAUL'S and NEVER BETTER were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Approaching the 1100 Metres, DASHING SUPER was steadied to obtain a position with cover close to the rail.
Passing the 1000 Metres, NASHASHUK momentarily raced tight between ELECTRONIC EMPIRE and GREAT TOPLIGHT which shifted in.
Passing the 850 Metres, NASHASHUK was steadied to avoid the heels of GREAT TOPLIGHT (O Doleuze) which shifted in when not properly clear.  O Doleuze was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is sufficiently clear when shifting ground in future.
Approaching the 800 Metres, LOVE CHUNGHWA momentarily raced in restricted room inside WINNING TALENT.
After the 800 Metres, NASHASHUK proved very difficult to settle and got its head up for some distance when awkwardly placed close to the heels of GREAT TOPLIGHT.
Rounding the Home Turn, HAYMAKER raced tight outside WINNING TALENT which shifted out into clear running.
Passing the 200 Metres, HAYMAKER was crowded for room between NEVER BETTER and WINNING TALENT which shifted out.
Near the 150 Metres, the whip of Z Purton (ELECTRONIC EMPIRE) was knocked from his grasp by the whip of M L Yeung (OCTAL LUCK).
Close to the finishing line, OCTAL LUCK raced in restricted room inside GREAT TOPLIGHT.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that WINNING TALENT was lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, WINNING TALENT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
NASHASHUK, SUPREME FLIGHT and LOVE CHUNGHWA were sent for sampling.

TEAM SWEET and NORTHERN FALLS bumped at the start.
From the outside barrier, ROYAL PARTNER was steadied and shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
In the early stages, KA YING KID was ridden along and approaching the winning post on the first occasion, when racing wide, was steadied and shifted across behind runners in an attempt to obtain a position close to the rail, however, for the majority of the race remained racing wide and without cover.
In the early and middle stages, MR POTENTIAL travelled keenly in the lead.
Rounding the Home Turn and in the early part of the Straight, ROYAL PARTNER got its head on the side and lay out.  Then passing the 300 Metres, ROYAL PARTNER, which was continuing to hang out, was shifted in away from the heels of TEAM SWEET.
Also passing the 300 Metres, DINOZZO was momentarily crowded for room inside A BEAUTIFUL which shifted in before being directed back out to relieve the tightening to DINOZZO.
Passing the 200 Metres, TEAM SWEET was checked out across the heels of NORTHERN FALLS to obtain clear running.
After the race, J Moreira (A BEAUTIFUL) explained that approaching the 200 Metres his saddle shifted considerably to the right hand side, placing him at a disadvantage.  Passing the 150 Metres, A BEAUTIFUL was then severely checked when crowded for room between DINOZZO which was attempting to improve between A BEAUTIFUL and WAH MAY BABY (D Whyte) which shifted out and INVENTOR.  The crowding to A BEAUTIFUL was compounded by INVENTOR (N Rawiller) which, after shifting in under pressure, then became unbalanced and was turned in across the rightful running of A BEAUTIFUL after being heavily bumped on the hindquarters.  The Stewards were satisfied that whilst Z Purton, the rider of DINOZZO, was committed to the run between WAH MAY BABY and A BEAUTIFUL, that horse had not properly established running outside WAH MAY BABY and as such D Whyte was reprimanded and reminded of his obligation to immediately stop riding and straighten his mounts when they shift ground.  Further, N Rawiller was advised that whilst the contribution of INVENTOR was exacerbated by being turned in due to the contact on its hindquarters by A BEAUTIFUL, nonetheless he should have stopped riding his mount sooner than he did.  Accordingly N Rawiller was also reprimanded.  After this incident, J Moreira was unable to test A BEAUTIFUL due to his saddle having shifted.
