Close to the finishing line, DINOZZO raced tight inside INVENTOR, obliging the rider of that horse to stop riding and straighten INVENTOR in order to prevent that horse from shifting in further.
A veterinary inspection of MR POTENTIAL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A BEAUTIFUL, WAH MAY BABY and INVENTOR were sent for sampling.

SUPER SPRINTER was crowded for room on jumping between EXPECTATOR which shifted in and HOLY UNICORN which shifted out marginally and then was taken out further by UNLEASHED DRAGON.
From wide barriers, RISING POWER, EXCELLENCE and HAPPY AND HEALTHY were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
UNLEASHED DRAGON lost its left hind plate after the 1300 Metres.
Passing the 1100 Metres, GO GO WIN was left racing wide and was then allowed to stride forward.  GO GO WIN then travelled wide and without cover until after the 800 Metres at which time the horse was able to shift in to race outside the lead.  CHEERFUL FRAME was then left racing wide and without cover from this point.
For some distance approaching and passing the 1100 Metres, RISING POWER got its head up when proving very difficult to settle and awkwardly placed close to the heels of HOLY UNICORN.
For some distance after the 800 Metres, HAPPY AND HEALTHY raced in restricted room when improving into tight running between EXPECTATOR and RISING POWER which shifted out.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, EXPECTATOR was crowded for room inside HAPPY AND HEALTHY which remained racing tight inside RISING POWER.
Near the 550 Metres, SUPER SPRINTER was checked away from the heels of UNLEASHED DRAGON which came under pressure and commenced to lose ground.  SUPER SPRINTER was then awkwardly placed behind UNLEASHED DRAGON until the entrance to the Straight.
Approaching the 150 Metres, HOLY UNICORN was shifted out away from the heels of UNLEASHED DRAGON which shifted ground when weakening.
Close to the finishing line, GO GO WIN and PENNY LANE raced tight as GO GO WIN shifted in under pressure.
A veterinary inspection of UNLEASHED DRAGON immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SUPER SPRINTER, PENNY LANE and GO GO WIN were sent for sampling.

BOLSHOI BALLET, which was being steadied in order to obtain cover from a wide barrier, was further steadied when crowded for room between STARTLING POWER which shifted out and WHO ELSE BUT YOU which was taken in by RHODE ASSASSIN which was also shifted across behind runners from the outside barrier in the early stages.
FIVE UP HIGH began only fairly and shortly after the start, when being ridden along, raced tight between ENREACHING and CHOICE TREASURE.
FIVE UP HIGH lost its right hind plate after the 1000 Metres.
After being crossed by EXCEL ONESELF passing the 900 Metres, VERBINSKY commenced to prove difficult to settle and shifted out away from the heels of EXCEL ONESELF after being awkwardly placed behind that horse.  Then, when racing without cover, VERBINSKY continued to travel keenly and was unable to be steadied sufficiently to resume its position behind EXCEL ONESELF.  This resulted in VERBINSKY having to race wide and without cover.
Approaching the 600 Metres, STARTLING POWER commenced to prove difficult to settle and was checked away from the heels of TRENDY WIN.
After the 500 Metres, BOLSHOI BALLET got its head on the side and lay out.
Approaching the 200 Metres, K C Leung (RHODE ASSASSIN) dropped his whip.
A veterinary inspection of CHOICE TREASURE and EXCEL ONESELF immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
VICTORY MARVEL and WHO ELSE BUT YOU were sent for sampling.

PRESIDENTPARAMOUNT shifted out at the start, resulting in SWEET HOME and EXPEDITE being hampered.
Shortly after the start, HANG'S DECISION shifted out and bumped OUTLAWED, resulting in both horses becoming unbalanced.
From wide barriers, GOLDEN CHOPSTICKS and BOTH LUCKY were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, EXPEDITE raced in restricted room inside GOLDEN CHOPSTICKS which got its head on the side and lay in towards the heels of SWEET HOME.
In the middle stages, PRESIDENTPARAMOUNT travelled keenly.
Passing the 500 Metres, PRESIDENTPARAMOUNT shifted out away from the heels of HAPPY BAO BEI when continuing to travel keenly.
Passing the 300 Metres, NAVAS momentarily raced tight inside HAPPY BAO BEI which shifted in.
For some distance after the 200 Metres, BALAY BALAY and SWEET HOME raced tight.
Approaching the 50 Metres, SWEET HOME and PRESIDENTPARAMOUNT raced tight between BALAY BALAY and HANG'S DECISION which shifted in abruptly before being corrected by its rider.  Then over the concluding stages, HANG'S DECISION raced with its head on the side and lay in.
When questioned, S Clipperton explained that he had been asked to ride NUMERO UNO in a forward position if the horse began well, however, if it did not begin well as it had done in some of its races in the past, he should take the horse across behind runners and obtain a position with cover.  He said after being placed in the barriers, NUMERO UNO became fractious and wanted to get its head down on a number of occasions.  He said as a consequence NUMERO UNO then began only fairly and, from the wide barrier, he believed that he would have had to do too much work to obtain a forward position and therefore, in accordance with his instructions, he elected to take NUMERO UNO across behind runners to a position closer to the rail making the first turn.
A veterinary inspection of BOTH LUCKY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of IMPERIAL FIGHTER immediately following the race found that horse to have bled from both nostrils.
HANG'S DECISION, NAVAS and HAPPY BAO BEI were sent for sampling.

DYNAMIC VOYAGE was withdrawn on 22.10.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter GOLDEN GUNNERS (Apprentice K K Chiong).  Before being allowed to race again, DYNAMIC VOYAGE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SLEDGE HAMMER began only fairly.
Shortly after the start, INTELLECTUAL GLIDE was steadied and shifted across behind runners.
Also shortly after the start, PARENTAL SPIRIT shifted in and bumped STARRY STARLIES.
Despite being vigorously ridden in the early stages, PLANET GIANT failed to muster speed and then was checked shortly after the start.
Apprentice H T Mo (ORIENTAL FANTASIA) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 1100 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of PLANET GIANT, causing that horse to be checked and to lose the running to which it was rightfully entitled.  Apprentice Mo was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Saturday, 12 November 2016 and to expire on Monday, 21 November 2016 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  During this period, there are two racemeetings scheduled to be conducted at Sha Tin Racecourse.  
After attempting to improve between MIGHTY GAINS and GOLDEN GUNNERS where there was insufficient room for some distance in the early part of the Straight, STARRY STARLIES was steadied and shifted to the inside of MIGHTY GAINS when unable to improve.
Throughout the race, MIGHTY GAINS, GOLDEN GUNNERS and ORIENTAL FANTASIA travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of FLYING CAPTAIN, O Doleuze stated that with MIGHTY GAINS racing to the outside of FLYING CAPTAIN in the early and middle stages, FLYING CAPTAIN did not relax and then, making the turn after the 700 Metres, got its head on the side and lay out.  He said FLYING CAPTAIN had trialed on two occasions in the lead up to today's race and on the most recent occasion it trialed without blinkers.  He said having in mind the manner in which FLYING CAPTAIN travelled keenly today, he did suggest to connections that they consider removing the blinkers from FLYING CAPTAIN in its future starts to see whether it will relax better in its races.  A veterinary inspection of FLYING CAPTAIN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that ORIENTAL FANTASIA had sustained a wound to the inside of the right hind cannon.
A veterinary inspection of PLANET GIANT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of GOLDEN GUNNERS immediately following the race found that horse to have bled from both nostrils.
FLYING CAPTAIN, MIGHTY GAINS, CONSISTENT and SLEDGE HAMMER were sent for sampling.

MCQUEEN began very awkwardly and got its head up on a number of occasions on jumping.  Then despite being ridden along in the early stages, MCQUEEN failed to muster speed.
Despite being ridden along in the early stages, TOP ACT failed to muster speed.
UP AND COMING lost ground when crowded for room on jumping by ISHVARA which shifted out.  After this, UP AND COMING was ridden along to improve its position and for some distance approaching and passing the 1600 Metres raced tight inside PACKING LLAREGYB.
From wide barriers, DYNAMISM, RENAISSANCE ART and STAR MAJESTIC were all steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Shortly after the start, D Whyte (STAR MAJESTIC) lost the use of his right stirrup iron for a short distance.  As D Whyte was adjusting his foot in the stirrup iron, STAR MAJESTIC shifted in, resulting in RENAISSANCE ART being taken in and crowding the room of DYNAMISM.
Approaching the 1500 Metres, MCQUEEN got its head up when proving difficult to settle and after the 1200 Metres was left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 900 Metres, STAR MAJESTIC was left racing wide and without cover. 
When questioned, Z Purton stated that he was instructed to make his run on RENAISSANCE ART before the Home Turn in an attempt to put the horse into the race earlier than in recent starts.  He said whilst RENAISSANCE ART did make some ground rounding the Home Turn, the horse was under heavy pressure and did not quicken as he hoped it would.  He said he rode RENAISSANCE ART out in the early part of the Straight, however, after the 250 Metres the horse became unbalanced in its action and commenced to give ground.  He said therefore he eased it out of the race over the concluding stages.  A veterinary inspection of RENAISSANCE ART immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Before being allowed to race again, RENAISSANCE ART will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of LUCKY GIRL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ANTICIPATION and EASTERN EXPRESS were sent for sampling.

On arrival at the Start, the tongue tie fitted to HAPPY AGILITY was adjusted.
HAPPY AGILITY began awkwardly.
When being steadied to obtain a position with cover passing the 1100 Metres, ARM RUNDA got its head up and travelled keenly.  Then passing the 1000 Metres, ARM RUNDA was awkwardly placed outside the heels of CLEVER SPIRIT.
After the 600 Metres, GENTILIS was awkwardly placed close to the heels of FOREVER ACCURATE.
Passing the 350 Metres, MAGIC STAR was bumped by ARM RUNDA which was taken out by HAPPY WAY WINNER.
Approaching the 300 Metres, HAPPY WAY WINNER was awkwardly placed outside the heels of RADIANT STEED.
Approaching the 200 Metres, GENTILIS got its head up when being corrected after being shifted out towards the heels of GAINFULJET.
Throughout the race, HAPPY AGILITY travelled wide and without cover.
The performance of KINGSTON JUMBO, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, KINGSTON JUMBO will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned, C Schofield stated that he was advised to ride DOUBLE DOWN, which was having its first race start today, in about a midfield position if possible.  He said DOUBLE DOWN began awkwardly and shifted out, resulting in the horse making contact with the hindquarters of NOBLE DE LOVE.  He said a short distance after the start DOUBLE DOWN had to be eased when crowded for room between MAGIC STAR and NOBLE DE LOVE which shifted in and this resulted in DOUBLE DOWN racing back in the field.  He said he pushed his mount along after this to take up a position closer to the main body of the field, however, when racing tight inside ARM RUNDA after the 900 Metres, DOUBLE DOWN was reluctant to maintain its position and lost ground passing the 800 Metres.  He said he again rode DOUBLE DOWN along hands and heels to have the horse balanced up, however, DOUBLE DOWN raced very greenly and was inclined to get its head up and shift ground approaching the Home Turn.  He added when ARM RUNDA shifted out rounding the Home Turn, he pushed his mount along to improve inside ARM RUNDA and DOUBLE DOWN again got its head up and shifted ground.  He said because DOUBLE DOWN was racing greenly, he was reluctant to immediately start riding his mount along as he felt it would be in the horse's best interests for it to be properly balanced.  He said he then commenced to ride DOUBLE DOWN along passing the 400 Metres and commenced to use the whip in the right hand on the horse approaching the 300 Metres.  He said after this DOUBLE DOWN continued to race greenly, however, closed off the race strongly.  C Schofield was advised that whilst the Stewards were satisfied that DOUBLE DOWN raced quite greenly, nonetheless rounding the Home Turn and in the early part of the Straight he should have ridden the horse with more endeavour.  He was further advised to ensure that he rides his mounts in such a manner so that they are not left with too much to do.  A veterinary inspection of DOUBLE DOWN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of ARM RUNDA immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HAPPY AGILITY and CLEVER SPIRIT were sent for sampling.

Whilst in the saddling stalls, SMILING CHARM had its right front plate refitted.  SMILING CHARM was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
DRAGON WARRIOR began only fairly and then shortly after the start was steadied away from the heels of GOOD FOR YOU which shifted out.
As the start was effected, SUPER TALENT lifted its front feet off the ground and consequently lost ground.
GOLDIE FLANKER shifted out at the start and bumped the hindquarters of SPICY KAKA.  After this, GOLDIE FLANKER was shifted across behind runners.
O Doleuze (SMILING CHARM) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 1100 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of GOLDIE FLANKER, causing that horse to be checked when it lost its rightful running and to blunder after striking the heels of SMILING CHARM.  O Doleuze was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 6 November 2016 and to expire on Thursday, 10 November 2016 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, O Doleuze was fined $10,000.  For some distance after this, GOLDIE FLANKER proved very difficult to settle and had to be checked away from the heels of SMILING CHARM.  GOLDIE FLANKER then shifted out making the turn after the 900 Metres towards the heels of WONDERFUL CHASER, resulting in GOLDIE FLANKER being awkwardly placed close to the heels of that horse.
After the 900 Metres, GOOD FOR YOU was steadied away from the heels of SMILING CHARM which was taken in by KING'S MAN.
Rounding the Home Turn, WONDERFUL CHASER was bumped and taken wider by GOOD FOR YOU which shifted out into clear running.
In the early part of the Straight, DRAGON WARRIOR was badly held up for clear running and near the 250 Metres was shifted out away from the heels of HONG KONG CAPTAIN.
Approaching and passing the 300 Metres, SUPER TALENT shifted out to obtain clear running.
TRIUMPHANT LIGHT was held up for clear running until passing the 300 Metres.
When commencing to give ground, MY BLESSING was steadied passing the 300 Metres when momentarily crowded for room between KING'S MAN and SMILING CHARM which shifted out.
Passing the 250 Metres, KING'S MAN was shifted in away from the heels of GOOD FOR YOU which shifted in under pressure.
Passing the 100 Metres, KING'S MAN was eased away from the heels of GOOD FOR YOU (B Prebble) which shifted in when not properly clear.  B Prebble was advised to exercise more care.
For the majority of the race, MY BLESSING travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, S Clipperton stated that in pre-race discussions, it was felt that today's race lacked a genuine leader and that there was an opportunity for SPICY KAKA to overcome its wide barrier by being ridden in a forward position.  He said SPICY KAKA had only had the one race start and whilst the horse made ground from the rear of the field on that occasion, SPICY KAKA's ability to be ridden in a forward position was unknown at this time and therefore it was felt that SPICY KAKA would be able to obtain a prominent position without having to have too much use made of it in the early stages.  He said after initially having to ride the horse along, he was able to cross the field comfortably and SPICY KAKA then travelled nicely in the middle stages.  He said however that the horse immediately came under pressure rounding the Home Turn and then did not respond to his riding and weakened out of the race.  Mr J Moore, the trainer of SPICY KAKA, confirmed that it had been intended for the horse to be ridden in a forward position because of the lack of anticipated speed in the race.  He said following SPICY KAKA's disappointing performance, he would give consideration to altering the horse's gear, primarily with a view to removing the blinkers, and would also have the horse ridden in a more conservative manner in its future starts.  A veterinary inspection of SPICY KAKA immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of DRAGON WARRIOR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
DRAGON WARRIOR, SMILING CHARM and GOOD FOR YOU were sent for sampling.

BEST EFFORT was slow to begin.
SUPER CLAN and GO BEAUTY GO bumped heavily at the start.
FUN MANAGER began awkwardly and then was bumped by VOLITATION which shifted in.
NAMJONG INVINCIBLE and MR PICASSO bumped on jumping.
From wide barriers, UNBEATABLE GUTS and LUCKY SEVEN STARS were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Approaching the 500 Metres, NAMJONG INVINCIBLE raced tight between SUPERIOR BOY and ROYALE ELEGANCE which shifted out away from the heels of INVISIBLE.
For the majority of the race, SUPERIOR BOY travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of UNBEATABLE GUTS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MR PICASSO, VOLITATION and SUPERIOR BOY were sent for sampling.

WAH MAY FRIEND shifted out at the start and hampered SILLY BUDDIES.
From wide barriers, HERO LOOK and SECRET COMMAND were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Approaching the 700 Metres, LINE SEEKER was left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 250 Metres, CAGA FORCE collapsed, resulting in K C Leung being dislodged.
After the race, Apprentice H N Wong, the rider of PABLOSKY, stated that he was instructed to have PABLOSKY in about 3rd or 4th position if the horse did not show sufficient speed to lead.  He said, despite being hard ridden for some distance in the early stages, PABLOSKY did not show as much early speed as it had done in most of its previous races and consequently got further back in the field than had been intended and was required to race very wide.  A veterinary inspection of PABLOSKY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PERPETUAL TREASURE and WAH MAY FRIEND were sent for sampling.  Samples were also taken from CAGA FORCE.

After being loaded, LOVE SHOCK reared on a number of occasions.  Before being allowed to race again, LOVE SHOCK will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.
FAVOURITISM, which was leaning on the inside of its barrier, began awkwardly and lost ground.
DIAMOND DRAGON was slow to begin.
BRING IT ON and CAPE THE FAITH began only fairly.
SHAMAL began only fairly and then was ridden along in the early stages to take up a forward position.
Making the first turn after the 900 Metres, DIAMOND DRAGON was checked and lost ground after shifting out abruptly across the heels of BRING IT ON.  When DIAMOND DRAGON shifted out, FAVOURITISM was severely hampered and taken very wide.  The racing manners of DIAMOND DRAGON were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, DIAMOND DRAGON will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial around a bend.
Passing the 300 Metres, SHAMAL raced in restricted room between MULTIMAX and ORIONIDS which lay in.
Approaching the 200 Metres, ROUNDABOUT was shifted out to obtain clear running.
N Rawiller, the rider of FAVOURITISM, was advised to ensure that he rides his mounts out with sufficient vigour irrespective of whether they are able to run in the placings.
Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the riding of S de Sousa (DIAMOND KING), 3rd placegetter, over the concluding stages did not affect the horse's finishing position, he was nonetheless reminded of his obligation to ride his mounts out at least hands and heels all the way to the end of the race where circumstances permit.
A veterinary inspection of FAVOURITISM and MULTIMAX immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
JING JING WIN and STARSHIP were sent for sampling.

THEWIZARDOFOZ was slow to begin.
From wide barriers, AMAZING KIDS and DUNDONNELL were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
For some distance after the 1000 Metres, DASHING FELLOW commenced to prove very difficult to settle and got its head up on a number of occasions when awkwardly placed close to the heels of AEROVELOCITY.
Over the final 300 Metres, AEROVELOCITY hung in and proved difficult to ride.
Throughout the race, BLIZZARD travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, J Moreira stated that after having to shift THEWIZARDOFOZ out in the early part of the Straight to obtain clear running, the horse did not quicken into the gap and then did not close off as expected.  A veterinary inspection of THEWIZARDOFOZ immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea and also found the horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, THEWIZARDOFOZ will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Following the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that DOMINEER was lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, DOMINEER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
LUCKY BUBBLES and AMAZING KIDS were sent for sampling.

FLARING SPEED was withdrawn on 22.10.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter AVELLINO (N Callan).  Before being allowed to race again, FLARING SPEED will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SMART BOY was crowded for room on jumping between UNICORN and SIMPLY INVINCIBLE which shifted in.
From a wide barrier, KIRAM was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
ROYAL ELITE and RUBY COAST were also steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners to obtain a position closer to the rail.
BABA MAMA was held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Passing the 350 Metres, THUNDER STOMP was checked when crowded for room between BABA MAMA (N Rawiller) which shifted out away from the heels of ABLE DEED in an attempt to obtain clear running and SEMPITERNAL (S de Sousa) which shifted in.  Both N Rawiller and S de Sousa were reprimanded and advised that, in similar circumstances, they would be expected to exercise more care than they did on this occasion.
Approaching the 200 Metres, SEMPITERNAL was momentarily steadied away from the heels of BABA MAMA which shifted out.
UNICORN lost its right front plate after the race.
When questioned, Mr D J Hall, the trainer of SIMPLY INVINCIBLE, stated that upon reflection, he did not believe that SIMPLY INVINCIBLE was as disappointing at its last start as he first thought.  He said unlike today when SIMPLY INVINCIBLE was able to have clear running in the early part of the Straight after racing three wide with cover throughout the early and middle stages, last start SIMPLY INVINCIBLE was not able to obtain a clear run in the early part of the Straight.  He said he felt that as a consequence SIMPLY INVINCIBLE lost its momentum and was not able to finish off as strongly as it did today.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of CALIFORNIA JOY, D Whyte stated that the horse travelled very well in a position behind the leaders and he expected it would sprint well when asked in the Straight.  He said after obtaining clear running inside SENSATION at the entrance to the Straight, when that horse shifted out, he immediately became concerned with the manner in which CALIFORNIA JOY was going to close off as it did not quicken.  He said when placed under heavy pressure, CALIFORNIA JOY did not respond and was particularly disappointing in the manner in which it weakened over the final 200 Metres.  He added the horse, in his opinion, raced "flat" today.  A veterinary inspection of CALIFORNIA JOY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
UNICORN, RUBY COAST, SIMPLY INVINCIBLE and BABA MAMA were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE ORIENTAL WATCH 55TH ANNIVERSARY SHA TIN TROPHY (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
RAPPER DRAGON was withdrawn on raceday morning by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right hind).  Before being allowed to race again, RAPPER DRAGON will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
FLAME HERO was crowded for room on jumping between HELENE PARAGON and BLAZING SPEED, both of which shifted ground.
HELENE HAPPY STAR began only fairly.
From the outside barrier, BEAUTY ONLY was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Near the 650 Metres, BEAUTY ONLY was checked away from the heels of HELENE HAPPY STAR.
PACKING PINS was held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Passing the 150 Metres, JOYFUL TRINITY momentarily raced in restricted room between BEAUTY ONLY and BLAZING SPEED which was taken out by DESIGNS ON ROME.  Then, over the concluding stages, BLAZING SPEED was awkwardly placed outside DESIGNS ON ROME which drifted out under pressure.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of CONTENTMENT, B Prebble stated that when enjoying a good run behind the speed, CONTENTMENT travelled strongly in the early and middle stages.  He said however that after being placed under pressure rounding the Home Turn, CONTENTMENT became unbalanced in its action, as it did at its first start back this campaign.  He said CONTENTMENT then gave ground noticeably in the Straight and, in his opinion, the horse did not feel comfortable in its action once off the bridle.  A veterinary inspection of CONTENTMENT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Before being allowed to race again, CONTENTMENT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of JOYFUL TRINITY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
JOYFUL TRINITY, DESIGNS ON ROME and BLAZING SPEED were sent for sampling.

From the outside barrier, ABLE TALENT was shifted across behind runners shortly after the start.
A short distance after the start, YOURTHEWONFORME was momentarily crowded for room between LUCKY SEBRING and WORLD CITY which shifted in.
Approaching the 1150 Metres, STRATUM POWER was crowded for room between GREAT SPEED and OPTIMISM which got its head on the side and shifted out despite the efforts of its rider.
After being vigorously ridden along to obtain a forward position, CHANS DELIGHT commenced to buck near the 1150 Metres, resulting in the horse losing a considerable amount of ground.  OPTIMISM, which was being shifted in in order to obtain a trailing positon behind CHANS DELIGHT, was directed out away from the heels of that horse when it lost ground and then making the turn after the 1100 Metres got its head on the side and lay out.  After this, OPTIMISM continued to race with its head on the side.  A veterinary inspection of CHANS DELIGHT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Before being allowed to race again, CHANS DELIGHT will be required to barrier trial to the satisfaction of the Stewards.
WORLD CITY lost its right hind plate near the 1100 Metres.
Shortly after entering the Straight, GREAT SPEED was shifted to the inside of MANHATTAN STRIKER to obtain clear running.  GREAT SPEED then had difficulty obtaining clear running passing the 200 Metres.
Over the concluding stages, GREAT SPEED was awkwardly placed inside the heels of FOREVER FUN and consequently was not able to be properly tested all the way to the end of the race.
After passing the winning post, FOREVER FUN (Apprentice H N Wong) shifted in, resulting in GREAT SPEED being checked.  Apprentice Wong was severely reprimanded and advised that he must, in similar circumstances, ensure that he remains attentive to his mounts shifting ground so as not to place other horses or riders in a dangerous position.  
GREAT SPEED, WORLD CITY and MANHATTAN STRIKER were sent for sampling.

DASHING FORTUNE was crowded for room on jumping between SPICY DOUBLE and PERFECT TIMING (S Clipperton) which shifted out.  As S Clipperton attempted to correct PERFECT TIMING, that horse continued to shift out abruptly, resulting in DASHING FORTUNE being severely checked and losing considerable ground.  SPICY DOUBLE was also hampered when bumped on the hindquarters by DASHING FORTUNE.  MASTER PINNACLE, which was racing to the outside of SPICY DOUBLE, was also hampered in consequence.  After this, PERFECT TIMING continued to run out abruptly and lost a considerable amount of ground.  As PERFECT TIMING had previously been barred for similar racing behaviour, that horse will be required to undergo a series of consecutive satisfactory barrier trials before being permitted to race again.
Shortly after the start, THIS IS GLADIATOR was steadied away from the heels of LAUGHING LORD which, after initially being taken out by MUTUAL JOY, then shifted out further away from that horse.
Approaching the 1300 Metres, SPICY DOUBLE proved very difficult to settle and got its head up when being checked away from the heels of MUTUAL JOY which, when being steadied to obtain cover, also proved difficult to settle.  After this, SPICY DOUBLE continued to be awkwardly placed close to the heels of MUTUAL JOY for some distance.
Passing the 1100 Metres, BERNARDâS CHOICE (Apprentice K K Chiong) commenced to travel keenly and shifted out away from the heels of DOUBLE POINT.  YEUNG SING and MASTER PINNACLE, which were following BERNARDâS CHOICE, then improved to the inside of that horse approaching the 1000 Metres.  Then passing the 1000 Metres, BERNARDâS CHOICE shifted back in to resume its positon behind DOUBLE POINT which resulted in YEUNG SING and MASTER PINNACLE being crowded for room.  Apprentice Chiong was advised to be alert to her mounts shifting ground which provides the opportunity for horses to improve their position.
Passing the 900 Metres, YEUNG SING commenced to travel keenly and shifted out away from the heels of BERNARDâS CHOICE.  After this, YEUNG SING travelled wide and without cover.
S de Sousa (MUTUAL JOY) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that passing the 450 Metres he permitted his mount to shift out when not clear of MI SAVVY BOY, resulting in that horse being checked when crowded for room inside LAUGHING LORD.  S de Sousa was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 6 November 2016 and to expire on Thursday, 10 November 2016 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).
Approaching the 250 Metres, LAUGHING LORD shifted in and bumped MUTUAL JOY.
Passing the 200 Metres, SPICY DOUBLE was awkwardly placed inside the heels of SHOW MISSION when improving into tight running inside that horse.
After the 200 Metres, THIS IS GLADIATOR was shifted out to obtain clear running and near the 100 Metres shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of DOUBLE POINT which became unbalanced.
Passing the 50 Metres, THIS IS GLADIATOR raced in restricted room between DOUBLE POINT and LAUGHING LORD, both of which shifted ground.  Then over the concluding stages, THIS IS GLADIATOR was awkwardly placed inside the heels of DOUBLE POINT.
After passing the 50 Metres, BERNARDâS CHOICE got its head on the side and lay in under pressure.
Over the concluding stages, SPICY DOUBLE raced with its head on the side and was inclined to lay out.
A veterinary inspection of MI SAVVY BOY and PERFECT TIMING immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SPICY DOUBLE, MUTUAL JOY and DOUBLE POINT were sent for sampling.

BEST TANGO shifted out at the start, resulting in YOU HAVE MY WORD being crowded for room out onto the hindquarters of LIGHTNING AND GOLD.
SPARKLING SWORD shifted out at the start on jumping, resulting in MIDNITE PROMISE being crowded for room.
SPINNING DANCER got its head up shortly after the start when being steadied to obtain a position with cover.
From wide barriers, MONEY MAN and DIGITAL PIONEER were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, LIGHTNING AND GOLD was steadied to avoid the heels of MIDNITE PROMISE which was racing tight inside PEARL WIN.  After this, MIDNITE PROMISE raced tight inside PEARL WIN which lay in away from THANKSGIVING.  PEARL WIN then travelled wide and without cover throughout the race.
For some distance after the 1300 Metres, SPARKLING SWORD travelled keenly and proved difficult to settle in the lead.
Passing the 600 Metres, THANKSGIVING commenced to give ground abruptly, resulting in MIDNITE PROMISE being awkwardly placed close to the heels of that horse before being able to shift out away from behind THANKSGIVING after the 500 Metres.  THANKSGIVING continued to give ground abruptly, resulting in SPINNING DANCER being severely checked passing the 400 Metres.  A veterinary inspection of THANKSGIVING immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm.  Before being allowed to race again, THANKSGIVING will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of YOU HAVE MY WORD immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of YOU HAVE MY WORD, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, YOU HAVE MY WORD will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of SPINNING DANCER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
NEWSWIRE FREE and SPARKLING SWORD were sent for sampling.
<27/10/2016  Additional Veterinary Report>THANKSGIVING, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm.  THANKSGIVING was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer D Cruz this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its left front leg.  As previously advised, THANKSGIVING will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.

KERKENI was slow to begin and from the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
WINASWEWISH was slow to begin.
Near the 2100 Metres, MISTRAL got its head on the side and shifted out despite the efforts of its rider, resulting in PRECISIONCRAFTSMAN being badly crowded for room onto SUPERNATURAL which became badly unbalanced.  After this, MISTRAL continued to lay out.
Near the 1700 Metres, MAC ROW was severely checked when crowded for room inside SMART UNION (N Rawiller) which improved to be racing inside the heels of WIN IT which, after shifting out marginally rounding the Home Turn, then shifted in to resume its position.  In this incident, KERKENI, which was following MAC ROW, was hampered in consequence.  N Rawiller was advised that whilst the Stewards recognised that he steadied his mount during this incident in an attempt to prevent the tightening to MAC ROW, nonetheless he was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he does not place his mounts in positions where interference is likely to occur.
Approaching the 1100 Metres, MAC ROW got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of BO DUKE.
Making the turn near the 600 Metres, MISTRAL, which was inclined to lay out, and PRECISIONCRAFTSMAN were crowded for room inside SMART UNION which was taken in by WINASWEWISH (O Doleuze).  KING BOUNTIFUL, which was following, was hampered in consequence.  O Doleuze was severely reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is properly clear of other runners when shifting ground in similar circumstances.
Near the 450 Metres, MISTRAL shifted out and bumped KING BOUNTIFUL which was racing tight inside WIN IT, resulting in MISTRAL becoming unbalanced and losing ground.  The performance of MISTRAL, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, MISTRAL will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Rounding the Home Turn, KING BOUNTIFUL was checked away from the heels of PRECISIONCRAFTSMAN before being shifted out into clear running.
Near the 250 Metres, KING BOUNTIFUL and KERKENI brushed.
Passing the 250 Metres, WIN IT was shifted in away from the heels of MAC ROW.
When questioned, D Whyte (SUPERNATURAL) stated that the horse travelled comfortably in a forward position until approaching the 700 Metres when the tempo of the race quickened.  He added that the horse immediately came under pressure and after this did not respond to his riding and was most disappointing.  A veterinary inspection of SUPERNATURAL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of SMART UNION immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
KING BOUNTIFUL, BO DUKE and WINASWEWISH were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE HONG KONG COUNTRY CLUB CHALLENGE CUP (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
JUN HUO was withdrawn on 25.10.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (sore left front tendon).  Before being allowed to race again, JUN HUO will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
On arrival at the Start, AMBITIOUS CHAMPION had its right front plate refitted.  AMBITIOUS CHAMPION was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
Just prior to the start being effected, TWIN DELIGHT became very fractious and then was slow to begin, resulting in the horse settling back in the field.
HELENE SUPER STAR began awkwardly.
From the outside barrier, SERGEANT TITANIUM was steadied shortly after the start and shifted across behind runners.
Approaching the 800 Metres, SERGEANT TITANIUM shifted out to improve and subsequently raced wide and without cover.
AMBITIOUS CHAMPION shifted out at the entrance to the Straight and bumped ALL YOU WISH.
Shortly after entering the Straight, HARBOUR MASTER was awkwardly placed outside the heels of HELENE SUPER STAR when racing tight inside SICHUAN DAR which got its head on the side and shifted in.
Approaching the 100 Metres, SICHUAN DAR was steadied away from the heels of HARBOUR MASTER (J Moreira) which shifted out into clear running.  J Moreira was severely reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is properly clear when shifting ground in future.
After the race, C Y Ho (SICHUAN DAR) stated that the horse was not able to quicken when the tempo of the race increased approaching the Home Turn.  He said, in his opinion, SICHUAN DAR is better suited in races which are run in a more genuine tempo than that of tonight's event.  A veterinary inspection of SICHUAN DAR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of ALL YOU WISH immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SICHUAN DAR, HARBOUR MASTER and SUPER LIFELINE were sent for sampling.

Shortly after the start, TRUMP, which was being steadied to obtain a position with cover, was crowded for room between BEAUTY CONNECTION and DIAMOND MASTER which shifted out.
Shortly after the start, TIMELY ARRIVED shifted out and bumped TRAVEL COMFORTS.
From the outside barrier, ELITE SPIRIT was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Making the turn near the 600 Metres, OCEAN ROAR became unbalanced after being momentarily crowded for room inside BEAUTY CONNECTION which shifted in marginally.  DIAMOND MASTER, which was following BEAUTY CONNECTION, was awkwardly placed close to the heels of that horse in consequence.
Also making the turn after the 600 Metres, TRUMP raced in restricted room inside THOR THE GREATEST.
Passing the 200 Metres, THOR THE GREATEST was momentarily awkwardly placed close to the heels of OUR HERO.
Passing the 100 Metres, TRAVEL COMFORTS was bumped by MR RIGHT which got its head on the side and lay in under pressure.
TRUMP had some difficulty obtaining clear running after the 100 Metres.
Throughout the race, TRAVEL COMFORTS travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of DIAMOND MASTER immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm and also an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, DIAMOND MASTER will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
BEAUTY CONNECTION, MOMENT OF POWER and TRUMP were sent for sampling.

During the preliminary, JE PENSE was kicked by PEARL WARM WARM.  JE PENSE was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said that the horse had sustained a cut to the inside of the left front cannon and accordingly was not suitable to race.  Acting on this advice, the Stewards ordered the withdrawal of JE PENSE.  Before being allowed to race again, JE PENSE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
THE SYLPH began awkwardly and got its head up on jumping.
BEAUTY PRINCE began only fairly.
When being steadied to allow MASTER CERAMIBO to cross approaching the 1300 Metres, SUPER FLUKE got its head on the side and lay in, resulting in WUSHU CHAMPION being crowded for room.  BEAUTY LOVE, which was racing to the outside of SUPER FLUKE, proved difficult to settle, got its head on the side and shifted in abruptly away from INDUSTRIALIST WAY, resulting in BEAUTY LOVE being severely checked away from the heels of SUPER FLUKE.  This resulted in VARA PEARL being badly crowded for room and then being severely checked between BEAUTY LOVE and HAPPY PLACE.  When VARA PEARL was checked, it shifted out abruptly, causing BEAUTY PRINCE, which was following, to be badly hampered and taken wider.  As the Stewards were of the opinion that the racing manners of BEAUTY LOVE had caused this incident, no further action was taken.
Near the 1000 Metres, BEAUTY LOVE got its head on the side, shifted out and was checked after racing tight to the inside of INDUSTRIALIST WAY (O Bosson) which shifted in marginally.  Having regard to the racing manners of BEAUTY LOVE prior, during and after this incident, O Bosson was afforded the benefit of the doubt, however, he was advised to ensure that he leaves comfortable racing room for runners to his inside at all times.
For some distance approaching and passing the 900 Metres, BEAUTY LOVE proved very difficult to settle and shifted ground on a number of occasions when being checked to avoid the heels of INDUSTRIALIST WAY.  THE SYLPH, which was following, was hampered in consequence.  BEAUTY LOVE got its head on the side and lay out making the turn near the 600 Metres.  The racing manners of BEAUTY LOVE were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, BEAUTY LOVE will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial around a bend.
Shortly after entering the Straight, HAPPY PLACE was shifted in away from the heels of CARE FREE PRINCE to obtain clear running.
For some distance after the 200 Metres, BEAUTY LOVE had some difficulty obtaining clear running outside INDUSTRIALIST WAY.
Passing the 150 Metres, HAPPY PLACE raced tight inside CARE FREE PRINCE which shifted in under pressure.  
A veterinary inspection of WUSHU CHAMPION and BEAUTY LOVE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SUPER FLUKE and PEARL WARM WARM were sent for sampling.

SOCCER BRAVE stood flat-footed as the start was effected and consequently lost a significant amount of ground.  Before being allowed to race again, SOCCER BRAVE will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.
LE PEGASE shifted in at the start and bumped THUNDER DASH which became unbalanced.
DUTCH WINDMILL began awkwardly and bumped THUNDERSTROKE shortly after the start.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, DUTCH WINDMILL was awkwardly placed close to the heels of REAL SUPREME which was being steadied to obtain a position with cover.
Throughout the race, THUNDERSTROKE travelled wide and without cover and commenced to give ground near the 550 Metres.  When THUNDERSTROKE commenced to give ground near the 550 Metres, FAITHFUL BOY was obliged to shift wider to improve around that horse.  A short distance later, MEDIC SWORDSMAN was awkwardly placed close to the heels of THUNDERSTROKE.  A veterinary inspection of THUNDERSTROKE immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of mucus in the horse's trachea.  The performance of THUNDERSTROKE, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, THUNDERSTROKE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Throughout the race and particularly in the Home Straight, DUTCH WINDMILL lay in and proved difficult to ride.
A veterinary inspection of REAL SUPREME immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of REAL SUPREME, which also finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, REAL SUPREME will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of FAITHFUL BOY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
BLISS CARTEL, CASH COURIER and LUCKY BALL were sent for sampling.

HAPPY SURVEYS and LITTERATEUR were slow to begin.
HIT THE BID began only fairly and then shortly after the start lost ground when crowded for room between CHARITY JOY and FLYING TOURBILLON which shifted out.
From the outside barrier, MIDNIGHT RATTLER was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 650 Metres, APOLLO'S CHOICE shifted in and bumped BACK IN BLACK.
Passing the 350 Metres, HAPPY SURVEYS was shifted to the inside of TURF SPRINT after being disappointed for running between that horse and BULLISH SMART which shifted in when commencing to give ground.
Passing the 300 Metres, HIT THE BID was shifted to the outside of FLYING TOURBILLON after being disappointed for running inside that horse.
Passing the 100 Metres, BACK IN BLACK raced tight outside DRAGON GENERAL which shifted out.  Over the concluding stages, BACK IN BLACK then shifted out away from DRAGON GENERAL, resulting in APOLLO'S CHOICE being hampered.
Passing the winning post, FLYING TOURBILLON jumped a shadow and became unbalanced.
Throughout the race, BULLISH SMART travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of TURF SPRINT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
BLOCKER DEE and FLYING TOURBILLON were sent for sampling.

FRANCE VALOUR was withdrawn on 29.10.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore foot abscess) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter HOLY STAR (Apprentice H N Wong).  Before being allowed to race again, FRANCE VALOUR will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SWEET BEAN was slow to begin.
Shortly after the start, ISLAND FLYER was bumped by GLAMOROUS RYDER which shifted out.
From the outside barrier, BEST JADE TRIUMPH was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
For some distance approaching the winning post on the first occasion, MI SAVVY BOY raced tight inside ISLAND FLYER which improved into tight running inside HOLY STAR.
Passing the 1100 Metres, ISLAND FLYER was left racing wide and without cover.
For some distance approaching and passing the 800 Metres, HIGH SPEED METRO travelled keenly and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of SWEET BEAN.
MY FOLKS commenced to give ground from the 500 Metres and finished tailed out.  A veterinary inspection of MY FOLKS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of MY FOLKS was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, MY FOLKS will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Passing the 300 Metres, HOLY STAR was awkwardly placed outside the heels of RACINGFORPLEASURE.
Near the 150 Metres, HIGH SPEED METRO was shifted to the outside of CHOICE EXCHEQUER to obtain clear running.
Passing the 150 Metres, ISLAND FLYER was inconvenienced when racing outside the heels of MALAYAN PEARL which shifted out under pressure.
Approaching the 100 Metres, MI SAVVY BOY was shifted out away from the heels of RACINGFORPLEASURE.
A veterinary inspection of GLAMOROUS RYDER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SWEET BEAN and HIGH SPEED METRO were sent for sampling.

Despite being hard ridden in the early stages, BLAZE STAMINA failed to show speed and subsequently became detached from the field.  BLAZE STAMINA then finished tailed out.  A veterinary inspection of BLAZE STAMINA immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its left front leg.  The performance of BLAZE STAMINA was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, BLAZE STAMINA will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
O Bosson (GRACE HEART) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that passing the 1000 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of LAMAROSA, resulting in that horse being taken in across the rightful running of SILVER SPUN which was checked and lost the running to which it was rightfully entitled.  Further, he permitted his mount to continue to shift in near the 950 Metres, resulting in LAMAROSA having to be checked away from the heels of GRACE HEART.  THE SUPREME, which was following SILVER SPUN, was inconvenienced in consequence.  O Bosson was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 20 November 2016 and to expire on Thursday, 24 November 2016 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In the circumstances, the Stewards did not believe that it was appropriate for a monetary penalty to be imposed.
Passing the 900 Metres, RAGING BULL was awkwardly placed close to the heels of WONDERFUL JOURNEY.
Approaching the 600 Metres, RAGING BULL was awkwardly placed outside the heels of RAINBOW FIGHTER.
Passing the 300 Metres, TRAVEL SUCCESSOR was awkwardly placed inside the heels of CHEVALIER STAR (S Clipperton).  For some distance after this, TRAVEL SUCCESSOR continued to race in restricted room inside CHEVALIER STAR and passing the 200 Metres was steadied away from the heels of that horse which shifted in.  S Clipperton was reprimanded and reminded of his obligation to keep his mounts on a straight course.
After the 200 Metres, PENANG HALL was checked when disappointed for running between GRACE HEART and CHEVALIER STAR.  After this, PENANG HALL was unable to obtain clear running behind those horses and consequently was not able to be tested.
At the 50 Metres, WONDERFUL JOURNEY, which was giving ground, was checked when crowded for room between RAINBOW FIGHTER and THE SUPREME which at this time was attempting to obtain clear running to the outside of SILVER SPUN (K Teetan) which shifted out under pressure.  In this incident, THE SUPREME was steadied and shifted to the inside of SILVER SPUN. SILVER SPUN lost its right hind plate during this incident.  Although the Stewards were satisfied that THE SUPREME had not established rightful running to the outside of SILVER SPUN, K Teetan was reprimanded and reminded of his obligation to make every endeavour to prevent his mounts from shifting ground.
Throughout the race, WONDERFUL JOURNEY travelled wide and without cover.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that CHEVALIER STAR had bled from both nostrils.
A veterinary inspection of TRAVEL SUCCESSOR and WONDERFUL JOURNEY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
WONDERFUL JOURNEY, LAMAROSA and CHOICE TREASURE were sent for sampling.
<31/10/2016  Additional Veterinary Report>After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that CHEVALIER STAR had bled from both nostrils.  CHEVALIER STAR was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer J Moore this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, CHEVALIER STAR will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

SUM WIN DRAGON lost its left front plate in the holding stalls and its right front plate in the saddling stalls.  After both plates were refitted, SUM WIN DRAGON was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
On arrival at the Start, the tongue tie carried by SUNNY WIN was reapplied.
SUM WIN DRAGON shifted in at the start and bumped ASHKIYR.
Shortly after the start, JOY PLUS FUN was hampered when crowded for room between WILD BOY and HOUSE OF LUCK which shifted in despite the efforts of its rider.
From a wide barrier, SPEEDY WALLY was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Approaching the winning post on the first occasion, LANSBURY was steadied away from the heels of WORKS OF ART.
For some distance approaching the winning post on the first occasion, GRACEFUL KINGDOM (C Schofield) got its head on the side and hung in.  Then passing the winning post on the first occasion, GRACEFUL KINGDOM continued to hang in, despite the efforts of its rider, resulting in HOLY UNICORN being taken in across the rightful running of HOUSE OF LUCK which was severely checked.  WILD BOY, which was following, was checked away from the heels of that horse and JOY PLUS FUN, which was following WILD BOY, was also severely checked and lost ground.  SPEEDY WALLY, which was following JOY PLUS FUN, was also inconvenienced in consequence.  The Stewards were satisfied that C Schofield had made every endeavour to prevent his mount from shifting ground and therefore no further action was taken.
Approaching the 400 Metres, SPEEDY WALLY hung in and proved reluctant to shift to the outside of JOY PLUS FUN.  After this, SPEEDY WALLY continued to hang in and proved difficult to ride.
Over the concluding stages, LANSBURY shifted in under pressure.
In the Straight, GRACEFUL KINGDOM lay in under pressure.
A veterinary inspection of WILD BOY and HOUSE OF LUCK immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SUNNY WIN and LANSBURY were sent for sampling.

As the start was effected, BEAR CHUM bounded in the air and consequently was slow to begin.
PACKING GO GO shifted out on jumping and bumped SIGHT SEEING.
Despite being ridden along in the early stages, DIAMOND MYSTERIOUS failed to muster speed and shortly after the start was shifted across behind runners.
Also from a wide barrier, AMAZING FEELING was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Making the first turn near the 1000 Metres, COUR VALANT was left racing wide and without cover and after the 900 Metres was allowed to improve its position to assume the lead near the 600 Metres.
Near the 950 Metres, POWER DRAGON was awkwardly placed close to the heels of SMILING GLORY.
Passing the 600 Metres, POWER DRAGON was left racing wide and without cover.
At the entrance to the Straight, SIGHT SEEING was shifted out across the heels of POWER DRAGON to obtain clear running.
QUANTUM DASH had some difficulty obtaining clear running passing the 250 Metres.
S de Sousa (POWER DRAGON) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that passing the 250 Metres he permitted his mount to shift out when not clear of SIGHT SEEING, causing that horse to be checked and to lose the running to which it was rightfully entitled.  S de Sousa was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 23 November 2016 and to expire on Monday, 28 November 2016 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, S de Sousa was fined $20,000.
Passing the 200 Metres, AMAZING FEELING was shifted to the outside of KIROV to obtain clear running after being disappointed for running between that horse and ROBUST MOMENTUM which shifted out after being bumped by SIGHT SEEING.
Approaching the 100 Metres, SMILING GLORY was bumped by BEAR CHUM which shifted to the inside of POWER DRAGON to obtain clear running.
Close to the finishing line, BEAR CHUM shifted in and was awkwardly placed outside the heels of COUR VALANT and consequently was unable to be ridden out all the way to the end of the race.
When questioned, K Teetan stated that, from barrier 8, he was asked to ride OCTAL LUCK with cover unless the horse began very well and was able to take up a forward position without having to be made use of.  He said OCTAL LUCK began satisfactorily, however, he believed that he would have had to ride the horse along to obtain a forward position, therefore he steadied OCTAL LUCK in the early stages and obtained a position with cover behind midfield.  The Stewards will interview Mr A Lee, the trainer of OCTAL LUCK, regarding the tactics adopted on that horse prior to the Sha Tin racemeeting on Wednesday, 2 November 2016.  After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that OCTAL LUCK had bled from both nostrils.
When questioned regarding the performance of SMILING GLORY, C Schofield stated that the horse was able to obtain a prominent position in the early stages without having to be ridden along and SMILING GLORY then travelled well in the early and middle stages.  He said he felt the tempo of the race was not fast and SMILING GLORY, which had the blinkers applied today, did not over-race and, due to these factors, he expected the horse to finish off the race well.  He said however, after travelling strongly rounding the Home Turn, he placed SMILING GLORY under pressure in the early part of the Straight and the horse did not quicken as he expected it would.  He said SMILING GLORY commenced to give ground after the 200 Metres and over the last 50 Metres in particular was very disappointing.  C Schofield added that SMILING GLORY's best form of late had been on the All Weather surface.  A veterinary inspection of SMILING GLORY immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of mucus in the horse's trachea.
A veterinary inspection of POWER DRAGON immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
KIROV and AMAZING FEELING were sent for sampling.
<31/10/2016  Additional Veterinary Report>After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that OCTAL LUCK had bled from both nostrils.  OCTAL LUCK was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer A Lee this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right hind leg.  Before being allowed to race again, OCTAL LUCK will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

As the start was effected, GREAT JOY lifted its front feet off the ground and consequently was slow to begin.
OSCAR MIRACLE was slow to begin and then was checked shortly after the start when crowded for room between SUPER SPRINTER which shifted out marginally and ELEGANT TAPESTRY which shifted in.
GIANT TURTLE shifted in at the start and inconvenienced WEALTHY FORTUNE.
Shortly after the start, SUPER SWEET ORANGE was steadied and shifted across behind runners.
FINE ROCK (C Y Ho) travelled keenly in the lead.  After the race, C Y Ho reported that his mount also lay out throughout the race and in the Straight hung out and proved difficult to ride.
Approaching the 800 Metres, SUPER SWEET ORANGE travelled keenly and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of WEALTHY FORTUNE.
At the entrance to the Straight, GREAT JOY was awkwardly placed close to the heels of GOOD CHOICE.
Over the concluding stages, WEALTHY FORTUNE raced tight inside GOOD CHOICE.
The performance of ELEGANT TAPESTRY, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, ELEGANT TAPESTRY will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of PEARL FURU immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SUPER SPRINTER, RAPID TRIUMPH and GIANT TURTLE were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE HONG KONG GOLF CLUB CENTENARY CUP (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
PHOTON WILLIE was withdrawn on 29.10.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (inappetence) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter PRECISION KING (N Rawiller).  Before being allowed to race again, PHOTON WILLIE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
TRAVEL FIRST began only fairly and shortly after the start was steadied away from the heels of PRECISION KING which shifted out.
Shortly after the start, JOYFUL MOMENTS was crowded for room between SUPEROI and ULTIMATE GLORY which shifted out.
From wide barriers, LAND GRANT, PACKING GENIUS and WINSTONâS LAD were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
At the entrance to the Straight, SUPEROI was shifted out away from the heels of LITTLE DRAGON.
S Clipperton was advised that his riding of SUPEROI in the early part of the Straight had come under notice.  He was further advised to ride his mounts out with sufficient vigour to ensure that his riding is not open to query.
A veterinary inspection of HIGH AND MIGHTY and LAND GRANT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PIKACHU, PRECISION KING and CHEEKY TOO were sent for sampling.

Shortly after the start, APACHE SPIRIT raced tight between DRAGON DANCE and SUNNY DRAGON which shifted out.
After initially being steadied from a wide barrier to obtain a position with cover, FAIRY TWINS was then ridden along after the 1000 Metres to improve its position.
CHIU CHOW KID was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 1100 Metres, APACHE SPIRIT was crowded for room between SUNNY DRAGON and WHO'STHEDUDE which got its head on the side and shifted in.  WHO'STHEDUDE was then directed out to relieve the tightening to APACHE SPIRIT.  After this, WHO'STHEDUDE lost its right front plate.
After the 1000 Metres, HAPPY BAO BEI got its head up when being steadied to allow MASTER VIKING to cross.
Approaching the 700 Metres, HAPPY BAO BEI again got its head up when awkwardly place close to the heels of MASTER VIKING.
ALL GREAT FRIENDS travelled wide and without cover until near the 500 Metres.
Approaching the 250 Metres, WHO'STHEDUDE shifted out and bumped SUNNY DRAGON.
S Clipperton (CHIU CHOW KID) was reminded of his obligation to ride his mounts out at least hands and heels to the end of the race where circumstances permit.
The performance of DRAGON DANCE, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, DRAGON DANCE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of SUNNY DRAGON, DRAGON DANCE and MASTER VIKING immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
WHO'STHEDUDE, MOLLY'S JADE STAR and APACHE SPIRIT were sent for sampling.
<31/10/2016  Additional Veterinary Report>The Clinical Veterinary Surgeon reported that ALL GREAT FRIENDS was lame in its right front leg on the morning after racing.  Before being allowed to race again, ALL GREAT FRIENDS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

PREMIUM CHAMPION began only fairly.
HOLMES LEGEND shifted out shortly after the start and inconvenienced HAPPY CONTENDER.
From wide barriers, LOTUS STRIKES BACK and VICTORY BOYS were steadied and shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After being crossed by PACKING DRAGON after the 1300 Metres, UNIQUE HAPPIEST proved difficult to settle and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of that horse for a short distance.
After initially racing outside of RAZOR QUEST, ALLCASH was ridden along after the 1300 Metres in an attempt to prevent that horse from shifting out.  However, RAZOR QUEST was able to shift out from behind UNIQUE HAPPIEST at this time which resulted in ALLCASH having to be steadied near the 1100 Metres to obtain a trailing position behind RAZOR QUEST.
Rounding the Home Turn, EASY HEDGE was awkwardly placed behind HOLMES LEGEND and HAPPY SPIRIT.
Passing the 200 Metres, EASY HEDGE was shifted to the outside of RAZOR QUEST after being disappointed for running between that horse and HAPPY SPIRIT.
Throughout the race, SEMPITERNAL travelled wide and without cover and commenced to give ground from the 500 Metres.  A veterinary inspection of SEMPITERNAL immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of mucus in the horse's trachea.  The performance of SEMPITERNAL, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, SEMPITERNAL will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After the race, O Doleuze stated that he was not able to offer any explanation for the disappointing performance of HAPPY CONTENDER.  He said the horse did not travel comfortably at any stage of the race and was then disappointing in its failure to respond to his riding.  A veterinary inspection of HAPPY CONTENDER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that RAZOR QUEST had sustained a cut to the inside of the left hind cannon.
A veterinary inspection of UNIQUE HAPPIEST immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PACKING DRAGON and VICTORY BOYS were sent for sampling.

EVERYONE'S CHOICE began awkwardly and lost ground.
PROPEL REPEL was slow to begin.
ALL TOGETHER shifted in at the start and bumped GOOD VIEW DELIGHTS.  After this, despite being vigorously ridden along, ALL TOGETHER failed to muster speed and then making the turn approaching the 600 Metres got its head on the side and lay out.
PLENTY OF SPEED lost its right hind plate near the 850 Metres.
Throughout the race, PLENTY OF SPEED and GOOD LUCK MAN travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of PLENTY OF SPEED immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SNOWHOOVES and EVERYONE'S CHOICE were sent for sampling.

On arrival at the Start, it was noted that GRAND HARBOUR had blood in its mouth.  GRAND HARBOUR was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
MY BLESSING and FURIOUS PEGASUS began only fairly.
HAY GO LUCKY began awkwardly and bumped the outside of its barrier, resulting in the horse beginning only fairly.  Then, despite being ridden along in the early stages, HAY GO LUCKY failed to muster speed and shortly after the start was steadied away from the heels of THE RAINBOW which shifted out.
YOUNG EMPIRE shifted out at the start and bumped LONDON CITY.  After this, LONDON CITY, despite being ridden along, failed to muster speed and shortly after the start was shifted across behind runners.  LONDON CITY was however left racing wide and without cover approaching the 700 Metres when proving difficult to settle.
Despite being vigorously ridden along approaching and passing the 700 Metres, THE RAINBOW was unable to maintain its position.
When endeavouring to improve into tight running between BORN DRAGON (J Moreira) and HEARTS KEEPER approaching the 400 Metres, GAME OF FUN was checked when BORN DRAGON shifted out marginally and HEARTS KEEPER improved to the inside of the heels of GRAND HARBOUR.  The Stewards accepted that the shift from BORN DRAGON was not a great one, however, J Moreira was advised to exercise more care when attempting to position his mounts in similar circumstances.
In the early part of the Straight, GAME OF FUN got its head on the side and hung in.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of TRILLION TREASURE, N Callan stated that after riding his mount hard in the early stages to obtain a forward position, he steadied TRILLION TREASURE to allow YOUNG EMPIRE to cross as that horse was being ridden to obtain the lead.  He said after being crossed by YOUNG EMPIRE, he then allowed TRILLION TREASURE to improve its position to race to the outside of the hindquarters of YOUNG EMPIRE.  He said his mount then travelled comfortably in the middle stages, however, he was obliged to start riding TRILLION TREASURE along earlier than what he had hoped when GRAND HARBOUR improved to the outside of TRILLION TREASURE passing the 500 Metres.  He said after being placed under pressure in the early part of the Straight, TRILLION TREASURE initially quickened well, however, after being headed by GRAND HARBOUR prior to the 200 Metres, TRILLION TREASURE then commenced to give ground and shortened stride noticeably over the final 100 Metres.  A veterinary inspection of TRILLION TREASURE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of TRILLION TREASURE, a last start winner, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, TRILLION TREASURE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that THE RAINBOW had bled from both nostrils.
BORN DRAGON, HEARTS KEEPER and GRAND HARBOUR were sent for sampling.

When LUCKY PLACE initially proved reluctant to enter the All Weather Track, O Doleuze dismounted from that horse.
JIMSON THE FAMOUS shifted in at the start and bumped AMBITIOUS SPEEDY.
EQUITY DOCTRINE (N Rawiller) shifted out at the start, resulting in HAPPY FRIENDSHIP bring checked when taken out across the heels of FRESH AND FRESH.  The Stewards were satisfied that N Rawiller had made sufficient endeavour to correct his mount.
SAFARI MAGIC began only fairly.
NOVEL START stumbled on jumping and after this was shifted across behind runners.
When being steadied to obtain a position with cover from a wide barrier, FLYING MACHINE got its head up on a number of occasions.
After the 1300 Metres, AMBITIOUS SPEEDY was left racing wide and without cover.
EQUITY DOCTRINE was held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight.
After being held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight, when improving between JIMSON THE FAMOUS and FRIENDS FOREVER, EQUITY DOCTRINE shifted out abruptly approaching the 100 Metres when being ridden along.  N Rawiller then stopped riding EQUITY DOCTRINE with the whip and attempted to straighten the horse.  As the Stewards were of the opinion that EQUITY DOCTRINE had shifted out too abruptly for N Rawiller to have made any better attempt to straighten his mount, no further action was taken, however, N Rawiller was cautioned against using the whip on his mounts in rapid succession as he did on this occasion just prior to EQUITY DOCTRINE shifting out abruptly.
Approaching the 300 Metres, NOVEL START was momentarily held up for clear running.
A veterinary inspection of LUCKY PLACE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FLYING MACHINE and EQUITY DOCTRINE were sent for sampling.

EMPIRE OF MONGOLIA was difficult to load and then began only fairly.  Before being allowed to race again, EMPIRE OF MONGOLIA will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.
SEASONS KING was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Despite being ridden along in the early stages, REWARDING FLYER failed to muster speed.
Making the turn after the 700 Metres, HURRICANE KID was awkwardly placed close to the heels of I'M THE WON FOR U.
Passing the 350 Metres, I'M THE WON FOR U was bumped by GENEROUS BOBO (N Rawiller) which, after initially being awkwardly placed close to the heels of LOOKS LIKE THE CAT which shifted out, then shifted out further away from the heels of that horse.  N Rawiller was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he does not make undue contact with other horses when improving his position.
Close to the finishing line, GENEROUS BOBO shifted out towards I'M THE WON FOR U, obliging its rider, N Rawiller, to momentarily stop riding and straighten his mount.
For the majority of the race, I'M THE WON FOR U travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned regarding the performance of BOSSIEE, J Moreira stated that he had been asked to ride the horse positively from the outside barrier.  He said after being placed in the barriers, BOSSIEE was quite relaxed and when the start was effected, despite being ridden along, BOSSIEE did not show any early speed and for this reason he shifted the horse across behind runners which resulted in it racing towards the rear of the field.  He said making the first turn BOSSIEE commenced to travel keenly and he had to shift the horse out away from the heels of CONFUCIUS SPIRIT.  He said after this BOSSIEE got its head on the side and hung out and, despite being placed under heavy pressure rounding the Home Turn, was disappointing in its failure to respond to his riding.  A veterinary inspection of BOSSIEE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of SEASONS KING immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its left hind leg.  Before being allowed to race again, SEASONS KING will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
I'M THE WON FOR U, GOLDEN SUN and GENEROUS BOBO were sent for sampling.
<3/11/2016  Additional Veterinary Report>After the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on GOLDEN SUN at the request of Trainer A T Millard.  The Veterinary Surgeon reported that this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horseâs trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, GOLDEN SUN will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

JOYFUL PARK began only fairly and from the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
PRESIDENTPARAMOUNT shifted out at the start and bumped BIG BANG BONG  A short distance after the start, BIG BANG BONG was steadied when crowded for room between PRESIDENTPARAMOUNT which continued to shift out and VICTORY MARVEL.
Approaching the 950 Metres, PRESIDENTPARAMOUNT was momentarily crowded for room inside STAR SUPERIOR (O Doleuze) which shifted in before being straightened.  A short distance later, PRESIDENTPARAMOUNT was steadied away from the heels of STAR SUPERIOR which shifted in when not properly clear.  O Doleuze was severely reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is properly clear when shifting ground.
Approaching the 300 Metres, HELLA HEDGE and HARBOUR ALERT bumped.
Throughout the race, HARBOUR ALERT travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned regarding the performance of VICTORY MARVEL, Z Purton stated that the horse, which was having its first start on the surface tonight, travelled only fairly during the race.  He said when travelling behind horses, VICTORY MARVEL appeared to resent the kickback and making the first turn near the 700 Metres shifted out and was awkwardly placed inside the heels of SKY MAN.  He said after this VICTORY MARVEL came off the bridle and he had to ride his mount along in an endeavour to have the horse maintain its position.  He added whilst VICTORY MARVEL was somewhat awkwardly placed outside the heels of STAR SUPERIOR in the Straight, his mount was not finishing off the race and, in his opinion, was disappointing.  A veterinary inspection of VICTORY MARVEL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
When questioned regarding the performance of CALL ME AWESOME, N Rawiller stated that approaching the 900 Metres he steadied CALL ME AWESOME as he was aware that STAR SUPERIOR, which was racing in advance of CALL ME AWESOME, was shifting in.  He said when he did this, CALL ME AWESOME commenced to prove difficult to settle and got its head up for some distance.  He said after being crossed by STAR SUPERIOR near the 800 Metres, CALL ME AWESOME continued to travel keenly and making the first turn near the 700 Metres shifted out and bumped PRESIDENTPARAMOUNT.  He said after this CALL ME AWESOME continued to lay out making the turns and near the 500 Metres was awkwardly placed inside the heels of VICTORY MARVEL.  He added when placed under pressure in the Straight, CALL ME AWESOME did not close off the race.  A veterinary inspection of CALL ME AWESOME immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, CALL ME AWESOME will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of PRESIDENTPARAMOUNT immediately following the race found that horse to have bled from both nostrils.
TEAM FORTUNE and FISH Nâ CHIPS were sent for sampling.

AUTUMN GOLD was withdrawn on 1.11.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (coughing) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter TOP ACE.  Before being allowed to race again, AUTUMN GOLD will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
GORGEOUS AGAIN was slow to begin.  Before being allowed to race again, GORGEOUS AGAIN will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, DRAGON HARMONY jumped a shadow on the track and became unbalanced.
After passing the winning post on the first occasion, GERONIMO MEADOW broke down in its left front leg.
