When GERONIMO MEADOW broke down, that horse shifted out abruptly, resulting in TOP ACE being severely hampered, striking the heels of GERONIMO MEADOW and blundering badly, causing its rider, C Schofield, to be dislodged.  C Schofield was subsequently examined by the Club's medical officers and passed fit to fulfil his remaining race riding engagements.
Approaching the 500 Metres, GOOD FIT was shifted out away from the heels of GOLD DRAGON.
Rounding the Home Turn, IMPERIAL CONCORDE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of ENTRUSTING when being shifted to the outside of that horse.
Passing the 400 Metres, ENTRUSTING raced tight inside MASTER GOLD.
Near the 300 Metres, IMPERIAL CONCORDE (S de Sousa) was steadied when crowded for room between GOLD DRAGON and KITAYA which, when giving ground abruptly, shifted out marginally away from MASTER GOLD.  S de Sousa stated after being awkwardly placed close to heels rounding the Home Turn and again passing the 300 Metres, IMPERIAL CONCORDE did not finish off the race thereafter and was disappointing.  A veterinary inspection of IMPERIAL CONCORDE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ENTRUSTING had difficulty obtaining clear running approaching the 200 Metres.
MASTER GOLD was awkwardly placed inside the heels of DIAMOND FRIENDS for some distance approaching the 200 Metres.
Passing the 200 Metres, DIAMOND FRIENDS was bumped by MASTER GOLD.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that TOP ACE had bled from both nostrils.
A veterinary inspection of KITAYA immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of KITAYA, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, KITAYA will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of GOLD DRAGON immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
WILLIE WAY and MASTER GOLD were sent for sampling.  Samples were also taken from GERONIMO MEADOW.

OUR FOLKS blundered badly at the start and then was checked when crowded for room between CIRCUIT KING and SUPER MAN which shifted out.
HARBOUR NOVA was crowded for room on jumping between DISCIPLES TWELVE and GRAND PLUS which was hampered when taken out by CIRCUIT KING.  In this incident, DISCIPLES TWELVE became unbalanced after being bumped on the hindquarters by HARBOUR NOVA.
Passing the 700 Metres, DISCIPLES TWELVE, which was reluctant to improve into tight running inside OUR FOLKS, was checked when crowded for room by OUR FOLKS which got its head on the side and shifted in away from HARBOUR NOVA despite the efforts of its rider.  As the Stewards were satisfied that there was no carelessness involved in this incident, no further action was taken.
Rounding the Home Turn, STAR OF YAN OI was awkwardly placed close to the heels of STARTLING POWER and then after being shifted out away behind that horse raced tight inside BOLD STITCH.
At the entrance to the Straight, GRAND PLUS and CHARITY GLORY bumped.
Throughout the race, GREEN CARD travelled wide and without cover and in the Straight gave ground.
After the race, J Moreira expressed concern regarding the racing manners of GRAND PLUS as the horse shifted ground on a number of occasions and was difficult to manage.  A veterinary inspection of GRAND PLUS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was very fractious during the examination. 
A veterinary inspection of GREEN CARD immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SUPER MAN and STAR OF YAN OI were sent for sampling.

TURIN PEARL blundered badly at the start.
As the start was effected, LUCKY HAMMER lifted its front feet off the ground and then a short distance later was bumped by ELECTRONIC PHOENIX which shifted out.  Despite being ridden along, LUCKY HAMMER was then slow to muster speed and making the turn near the 1500 Metres was awkwardly placed close to the heels of SILLY BUDDIES.
From a wide barrier, IMPERIAL GALLANTRY was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After the 1200 Metres, SILVERFIELD was left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 1100 Metres, LUCKY HAMMER was checked away from the heels of SILLY BUDDIES which was steadied to allow DEJA VU to cross.  ELECTRONIC PHOENIX, which was following LUCKY HAMMER, was hampered in consequence.
Also passing the 1100 Metres, POSITIVE FORCE commenced to prove very difficult to settle and had to be checked away from the heels of GOLDEN SLEEP.
Approaching the 1000 Metres, GOLDEN SLEEP commenced to prove difficult to settle and shifted out away from the heels of GOAL FOR GOLD.
After the 800 Metres, SILLY BUDDIES came under pressure and drifted back in the field.  LUCKY HAMMER, which was following, was taken back through the field as a consequence.
Making the turn near the 700 Metres, MAJESTIC ANTHEM was momentarily crowded for room between GOAL FOR GOLD and DEJA VU, both of which shifted slight ground.
Passing the 600 Metres, VANILLA got its head on the side and hung out.
For some distance in the early part of the Straight, MAJESTIC ANTHEM had to be checked away from the heels of SILVERFIELD.  BISHOPâS LEAP, which was following, was held up for clear running in consequence.
When questioned, U Rispoli (IMPERIAL GALLANTRY) said at no stage of the race did his mount travel comfortably.  He said initially he felt the horse may not have been handling the kickback, however, despite being aggressively ridden throughout, IMPERIAL GALLANTRY would not improve its position and in the Straight did not close off the race to finish at the rear of the field.  A veterinary inspection IMPERIAL GALLANTRY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of IMPERIAL GALLANTRY was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, IMPERIAL GALLANTRY will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of POSITIVE FORCE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of POSITIVE FORCE, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, POSITIVE FORCE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
ELECTRONIC PHOENIX, TURIN PEARL and MAJESTIC ANTHEM were sent for sampling.
<3/11/2016  Additional Veterinary Report>The Clinical Veterinary Surgeon reported that BISHOPâS LEAP was lame in its right front leg with a tendon injury on the morning after racing.  Before being allowed to race again, BISHOPâS LEAP will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

WINGOLD began only fairly and then shortly after the start was crowded for room between THUNDER DASH which began very awkwardly and shifted out and FANTASTICLIFE which was bumped by INNOVATIVE WINNER
ATOMIC BLAST shifted out at the start and bumped LUCKY BOLE.
From the outside barrier, PLAIN BLUE BANNER was steadied shortly after the start and shifted across behind runners.
Despite being ridden along in the early stages, SILVER GATSBY failed to muster speed.
Passing the 400 Metres, WINGOLD was shifted out across the heels of TREASURE AND GOLD.  Then passing the 300 Metres, WINGOLD was shifted to the outside of FANTASTICLIFE when disappointed for running between that horse and TREASURE AND GOLD.
For the majority of the race, both BRILLIANT MONKEYS and LUCKY BOLE travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of BRILLIANT MONKEYS immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  The performance of BRILLIANT MONKEYS, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, BRILLIANT MONKEYS will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
FANTASTICLIFE and WINGOLD were sent for sampling.

After being loaded into the barriers, SO FAST became fractious and reared on a number of occasions.  Before being allowed to race again, SO FAST will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.
As the start was effected, FIGHT HERO reared and got its left front leg over into the adjourning stall, resulting in the horse taking no part in the race.  Having regard to FIGHT HEROâs previous record in respect of its barrier manners, the Stewards ruled that the horse must undergo a series of not less than three consecutive barrier trials before being allowed to race again.
GORGEOUS KING was crowded for room on jumping between MYTHICAL EMPEROR and ARCHIPPUS which shifted out.  After this, GORGEOUS KING was shifted across behind runners.
HERO LOOK shifted out at the start and bumped the hindquarters of HEALTHY JOYFUL which became unbalanced.
From a wide barrier, WHITE MAGIC was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Approaching the 800 Metres, MY DARLING was awkwardly placed close to the heels of MARVEL TRIBE.
Passing the 400 Metres, HEALTHY JOYFUL shifted out away from the heels of SOLAR HEI HEI.
Near the 350 Metres, LUCKY DOUBLE EIGHT was shifted in away from the heels of ARCHIPPUS to obtain clear running.
For some distance passing the 200 Metres, GORGEOUS KING was held up for clear running and had to be steadied when unable to shift out from behind MARVEL TRIBE due to WHITE MAGIC racing to its outside.
Passing the 50 Metres, MARVEL TRIBE momentarily raced in restricted room inside WHITE MAGIC which got its head on the side and shifted in.
Close to the finishing line, HEALTHY JOYFUL shifted in towards SOLAR HEI HEI, resulting in its rider having to correct HEALTHY JOYFUL.
Throughout the race, ARCHIPPUS travelled wide and without cover and in the Straight gave ground.
JOLLY BANNER and MY DARLING were sent for sampling.

JOLLY JOLLY began only fairly.
BABA MAMA was crowded for room on jumping between ARIZONA BLIZZARD which shifted out after being bumped by BEAUTY KINGDOM and MAMBO ROCK which was taken in by VICTORY DAY.  After this, BABA MAMA was shifted across behind in the early stages.
CLASSIC EMPEROR jumped in at the start, resulting in SHAMAL being crowded for room outside MAGNETISM.
Passing the 1300 Metres, POWER OF ONE and MAGNETISM raced tight.
BEAUTY KINGDOM lost its left hind plate passing the 1300 Metres.
Approaching the 1200 Metres, FRIENDS OF NANJING and MAMBO ROCK were badly crowded for room between ROMAN IMPERO which shifted out after being crossed by ARIZONA BLIZZARD and VICTORY DAY (C Williams) which, when proving difficult to settle, shifted in.  Whilst the Stewards found that this incident was a result of the shift from both ROMAN IMPERO and VICTORY DAY, C Williams was advised to ensure that he does his best to prevent his mounts from shifting ground, even in difficult circumstances.
MAMBO ROCK lost its right front plate near the 1100 Metres.
Passing the 1100 Metres, JOLLY JOLLY commenced to prove very difficult to settle and had to be checked away from the heels of OUTLAWED for some distance.  POWER OF ONE, which was following, was severely checked away from the heels of JOLLY JOLLY in consequence.  At the same time, ARIZONA BLIZZARD, when racing tight outside JOLLY JOLLY, commenced to prove difficult to settle and got its head up for some distance.  MAGNETISM, ROMAN IMPERO and FRIENDS OF NANJING, which were following, were hampered in consequence.
For some distance approaching the 900 Metres, MAGNETISM raced in restricted room between NOBLE ALPHA and POWER OF ONE which was travelling keenly and awkwardly placed behind JOLLY JOLLY which continued to prove difficult to settle and was racing close to the heels of OUTLAWED.
After the 900 Metres, ARIZONA BLIZZARD was left racing wide and without cover.
MAGNETISM had some difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight and passing the 200 Metres was awkwardly placed close to the heels of VICTORY DAY which shifted out.  Over the concluding stages, MAGNETISM was again awkwardly placed outside the heels of VICTORY DAY.
Passing the 300 Metres, BABA MAMA was briefly held up when racing tight inside OUTLAWED which shifted in marginally.
When questioned, C Schofield stated that he had been asked to ride FRIENDS OF NANJING in about a midfield position and if possible shift the horse to the outside of runners in the Straight as it had previously been successful when making its run outside of horses.  He said after being placed into the barriers, FRIENDS OF NANJING was fractious and then as the start was effected lifted its front feet off the ground and began only fairly.  He said he then rode his mount along in the early stages in an endeavour to make up lost ground.  He said passing the 1300 Metres he was positioned to the outside of ROMAN IMPERO and he expected that horse to shift over closer to the inside running rail.  He said however that ROMAN IMPERO remained racing away from the rail due to MAGNETISM being positioned on its inside and therefore FRIENDS OF NANJING was left racing wider than he had anticipated.  He said after being crowded for room approaching the 1200 Metres, he then shifted FRIENDS OF NANJING across to obtain a position closer to the rail, however, FRIENDS OF NANJING raced ungenerously in the early stages and for some distance approaching and passing the 1000 Metres had to be checked away from heels.  He added in the early part of the Straight he was following BABA MAMA and as he felt that this horse would close off strongly, he elected to follow that horse through rather than attempting to shift FRIENDS OF NANJING out and risk being held up for clear running.  A veterinary inspection of FRIENDS OF NANJING immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
A veterinary inspection of VICTORY DAY, MAMBO ROCK and MAGNETISM immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
BABA MAMA and BEAUTY KINGDOM were sent for sampling.

REGENCY BO BO began very awkwardly and lost ground.
AUDACITY shifted out at the start and bumped the hindquarters of ENCHANTED FEELING.  After this, AUDACITY was shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 900 Metres, REGENCY BO BO, which was inclined to lay out, was steadied away from the heels of STARLOT (U Rispoli) which shifted in.  U Rispoli was advised to exercise more care.
SUPER EURO STAR, which travelled wide and without cover throughout the race, made the first turn awkwardly and shifted out.
Passing the 150 Metres, LOOK ERAS was shifted to the outside of CHEER WIN after being disappointed for running between that horse and SEA JADE, both of which shifted ground.
Passing the 100 Metres, RED SUN was shifted in away from the heels of SUPER EURO STAR.
When questioned, Apprentice K K Chiong stated that she had been asked to have GENEROUS HEART racing where it was comfortable and although the horse had not begun well in some of its barrier trials in the lead up to todayâs race, it was hoped that it may be able to obtain a midfield position.  She said GENEROUS HEART was crowded for room on jumping between STARLOT and CHEER WIN which both shifted ground and was then steadied away from the heels of STARLOT near the 1150 Metres.  She said this resulted in GENEROUS HEART being further back in the field than had been hoped.  She said after the 700 Metres she shifted GENEROUS HEART to the outside of RED SUN and commenced to improve around that horse and after the 600 Metres rode her mount along to make up ground on the main body of the field.  She added she shifted GENEROUS HEART to the outside of runners in the Straight and then the horse finished off the race strongly.  Apprentice Chiong was advised that her comments would be reported, however, she must ensure that, wherever possible, she does not allow her mounts to get too far out of their ground.
A veterinary inspection of ARM RUNDA and STARLOT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SEA JADE, REGENCY BO BO and CHEER WIN were sent for sampling.

HARMONY PARTNERS blundered badly at the start and then was checked away from the heels of EVEREST which shifted out after being bumped by ACCLAIMED LIGHT which shifted ground after being bumped by SOARING WYVERN.
GOLDEN ACHIEVER began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped GREAT TREASURE.
From wide barriers, AMAZING ALWAYS, RADIANT STEED and WORLD RECORD were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
After initially being awkwardly placed close to the heels of HAPPY BEAUTY passing the 1200 Metres, GOLDEN ACHIEVER was checked away from the heels of that horse after HAPPY BEAUTY shifted out marginally.
Near the 800 Metres, HAPPY WAY WINNER was left racing wide and without cover.
SOARING WYVERN was badly held up for clear running from on straightening until approaching the 200 Metres,  SOARING WYVERN was then unable to obtain clear running over the final 100 Metres.  C Williams (SOARING WYVERN) stated that although a tight run was available in advance of SOARING WYVERN over the concluding stages, both ROBUST MOMENTUM and MEISTERSTUECK were shifting ground at that stage and therefore he was reluctant to improve into this tight running.  He said because of this he was not able to fully test SOARING WYVERN out over the concluding stages.
H W Lai (GREAT TREASURE) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that approaching and passing the 350 Metres he permitted his mount to shift out when not clear of HAPPY WAY WINNER, resulting in that horse being checked and losing the running to which it was rightfully entitled.  H W Lai was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 16 November 2016 and to expire on Monday, 21 November 2016 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, H W Lai was fined $10,000.
When questioned, Apprentice K K Chiong stated that she had been instructed to lead on SNOW SLIDER.  She said the horse did not show as much early speed as she anticipated and she had to ride SNOW SLIDER along for a considerable distance to clear runners to its inside and it was not until near the 1300 Metres that she was able to desist from riding the horse along.  She said it was apparent to her that MEISTERSTUECK was being ridden along to obtain the lead as that horse showed more natural early speed than SNOW SLIDER.  She said she felt that she would have had to ride SNOW SLIDER aggressively to prevent MEISTERSTUECK from crossing SNOW SLIDER and, given the amount of work she had done on the horse in the early stages, she believed it would be in the horseâs best interests to steady SNOW SLIDER and then shift to the outside of MEISTERSTUECK.  She said after being crossed by MEISTERSTUECK, SNOW SLIDER commenced to travel keenly and when she attempted to shift to the outside of MEISTERSTUECK passing the 1000 Metres, HAPPY BEAUTY maintained its position to her outside and this resulted in SNOW SLIDER having to continue to race behind MEISTERSTUECK.  Apprentice Chiong was told that whilst the Stewards accepted that she had to ride SNOW SLIDER hard for some distance in the early stages, on this occasion the interests of SNOW SLIDER would have been better served by allowing the horse to race to the inside of MEISTERSTUECK and forcing that horse to go forward of SNOW SLIDER rather than steadying her mount.  When SNOW SLIDER attempted to shift to the outside of MEISTERSTUECK, HAPPY BEAUTY became unbalanced when bumped.  ROBUST MOMENTUM, which was following SNOW SLIDER, was inconvenienced in consequence.  A veterinary inspection of SNOW SLIDER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of RADIANT STEED immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, RADIANT STEED will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
ROBUST MOMENTUM, GREAT TREASURE and EVEREST were sent for sampling.

After being bumped by VICTORY MACHINE on jumping, CONVINCIBLE was then steadied to obtain cover.
From a wide barrier, BRILLIANT DREAM was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After the 800 Metres, GOLDEN CHOPSTICKS was left racing wide and without cover.
At the 400 Metres, HAMMER KING shifted in and bumped ORIONIDS.
Passing the 400 Metres, HARRIER JET was bumped and taken out by VICTORY MACHINE (S Clipperton) which shifted around the heels of HAMMER KING to obtain clear running.  S Clipperton was advised to exercise due care in similar circumstances.  Then passing the 300 Metres, HARRIER JET was steadied when crowded for room between VICTORY MACHINE and LOVE SHOCK, both of which shifted ground.
In the Straight, ORIONIDS raced greenly, lay out under pressure and near the 300 Metres got its head on the side, shifted out and bumped HAMMER KING.
When questioned, N Rawiller stated that shortly after entering the Straight he attempted to direct BRILLIANT DREAM out from behind GOLDEN CHOPSTICKS to make its finishing run.  He said however that passing the 400 Metres BRILLIANT DREAM lay in and was reluctant to shift out from behind GOLDEN CHOPSTICKS.  He said he then had to make a more concerted effort to shift BRILLIANT DREAM out from behind GOLDEN CHOPSTICKS and as he did this, GOLDEN CHOPSTICKS shifted out under pressure, resulting in BRILLIANT DREAM having to be checked out away from the heels of that horse.
When questioned, J Moreira stated that, in his opinion, LOVE SHOCK did not race disappointingly.  He said the horse had improved from its first up run and he believed that it would again take further improvement out of todaysâ race.  A veterinary inspection of LOVE SHOCK immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of HAMMER KING, HARRIER JET and LANG TAI SING immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
LOVE SHOCK, LUCKY GUY and ORIONIDS were sent for sampling.

BUMBLE BABY began only fairly and then was bumped by GAINFULJET which shifted out.
As the start was effected, ACE KING lifted its front feet off the ground and consequently was slow to begin.  This resulted in ACE KING racing towards the rear of the field.
AUTOPAY began awkwardly and then was steadied away from the heels of HAPPY GAINS which shifted out.
HAPPY GAINS lost its right front plate on jumping.
Approaching and passing the 600 Metres, AUTOPAY commenced to race ungenerously and lay out.  Then passing the 300 Metres, AUTOPAY again got its head on the side and lay in under pressure.  AUTOPAY was unable to obtain clear running for some distance approaching and passing the 100 Metres.
For some distance passing the 600 Metres, ACE KING commenced to prove very difficult to settle and was awkwardly placed outside the heels of ART OF SUCCESS.  Then after the 500 Metres, ACE KING was badly held up for clear running when continuing to travel keenly.  Approaching and passing the 200 Metres, ACE KING was again steadied when disappointed for running between GLORY HORSIE and BUMBLE BABY.  ACE KING was then directed in away from the heels of BUMBLE BABY to obtain clear running.
Approaching and passing the 400 Metres and again near the 300 Metres, STARLIGHT raced tight outside HAPPY GAINS.  Then after obtaining clear running outside HAPPY GAINS, STARLIGHT commenced to finish off the race well, however, was checked away from the heels of HAPPY SOUND passing the 100 Metres.  STARLIGHT was then unable to obtain clear running for the remainder of the race and was not able to be tested.
Close to the finishing line, HAPPY GAINS was awkwardly placed outside the heels of PEACE COMBINATION which was taken out by BUMBLE BABY.
When questioned regarding the performance of JUNZI, N Callan stated that the horse showed more pace in the early stages than he anticipated and therefore he was able to take advantage of that speed to obtain a prominent position.  He said JUNZI came under pressure near the 500 Metres, was one-paced and struggled to maintain its position after the 300 Metres.  He said after being momentarily held up for clear running approaching the 200 Metres, he shifted JUNZI to the outside of runners and was then able to place the horse under pressure.  He said he was surprised that JUNZI was then able to finish off the race better than it had been earlier in the race.  He added because of the way JUNZI finished off the race, he recommended to connections that they consider stepping the horse up in distance for its next race start.  A veterinary inspection of JUNZI immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of GAINFULJET immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PREMIERE, BUMBLE BABY, ACE KING and PEACE COMBINATION were sent for sampling.

LUCKY SEVEN STARS began awkwardly and got its head up when being steadied in order to be shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
GLORY STAR began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped the hindquarters of FANCY MUSIC.  GLORY STAR was then crowded for room between FANCY MUSIC and ARGENTUM which shifted in after being bumped by WONDERFUL CHASER.  After this, WONDERFUL CHASER was steadied and shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
Despite being ridden along in the early stages, GLORY STAR failed to muster speed and raced back in the field.
Passing the 1300 Metres, LUCKY SEVEN STARS momentarily raced in restricted room inside FANCY MUSIC.
After the 800 Metres, LITTLE FANTASY was left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 600 Metres, UNBEATABLE GUTS was shifted out away from the heels of GLORY STAR which in turn was shifted out from behind LITTLE FANTASY after being awkwardly placed behind that horse.  When taken wider, UNBEATABLE GUTS was then ridden along to improve its position.
LUCKY SEVEN STARS had some difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Passing the 300 Metres, FANCY MUSIC was awkwardly placed close to the heels of DASHING SUPER which was giving ground.
Passing the 250 Metres, as GO BEAUTY GO was shifting out to improve into a tight run between ARGENTUM and UNICRON JEWELLERY, GO BEAUTY GO bumped the hindquarters of UNICRON JEWELLERY which shifted in marginally.  This resulted in UNICRON JEWELLERY becoming unbalanced and shifting in further, causing GO BEAUTY GO to be buffeted for room between UNICRON JEWELLERY and ARGENTUM.  After this, GO BEAUTY GO had difficulty obtaining clear running and after being able to improve between ARGENTUM and UNICRON JEWELLERY approaching the 150 Metres, GO BEAUTY GO was then checked when crowded for room between ARGENTUM which shifted out after being bumped on the hindquarters by GO BEAUTY BO and UNICRON JEWELLERY (J Moreira) which hung in under pressure.  As the Stewards were satisfied that J Moreira had made all reasonable endeavours to prevent UNICRON JEWELLERY from shifting in at this time, no further action was taken.
Passing the 200 Metres, DASHING SUPER, which was continuing to give ground, was steadied away from the heels of LUCKY SEVEN STARS which shifted out to obtain clear running.
A veterinary inspection of UNBEATABLE GUTS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
BLAZING PASS and UNICRON JEWELLERY were sent for sampling.

CLEVER SPIRIT lifted its front feet off the ground as the start was effected, began awkwardly and bumped DIAMOND BIT which shifted out.  After this, both DIAMOND BIT and CLEVER SPIRIT were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Shortly after entering the Straight, HASTILY FEET was shifted out away from the heels of GOLDEN GLORY.
HIT A HOME RUN had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Near the 150 Metres, DASHING DART was awkwardly placed inside the heels of FOREVER POSH which lay in under pressure.  After this, FOREVER POSH continued to lay in under pressure.
Passing the 100 Metres, HIT A HOME RUN again had difficulty obtaining clear running.
When questioned, L Corrales stated that he had been instructed to try and lead on GOOD METHOD if possible.  He said however that the horse lifted its front feet off the ground as the start was effected and consequently lost ground.  He said he had to ride GOOD METHOD along in the early stages to obtain as forward a position as possible.  He said after the 1200 Metres he was able to shift in to race one horse off the rail following RED HORSE and passing the 1100 Metres RED HORSE got its head up on a number of occasions.  He said when he steadied GOOD METHOD away from the heels of RED HORSE, GOOD METHOD immediately commenced to hang out and he was unable to prevent the horse from shifting out passing the 1000 Metres into a tight three wide position.  He said as he was attempting to shift GOOD METHOD back in behind RED HORSE, FOREVER POSH improved its position quickly to be racing inside GOOD METHOD and therefore he was not able to shift GOOD METHOD in as he would have had caused interference to FOREVER POSH.  He added near the 750 Metres GOOD METHOD was crowded for room between DASHING DART and FOREVER POSH which commenced to prove difficult to settle and shifted out away from the heels of RED HORSE.  He said these factors resulted in GOOD METHOD having to race three wide for the majority of the race and further back in the field than had been intended.  A veterinary inspection of GOOD METHOD immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of mucus in the horseâs trachea.
A veterinary inspection of DIAMOND BIT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
BEAT THE CLOCK and HASTILY FEET were sent for sampling.
<7/11/2016  Additional Veterinary Report>DIAMOND BIT, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  DIAMOND BIT was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer Y S Tsui this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, DIAMOND BIT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

RENAISSANCE ART and EASTERN EXPRESS bumped at the start.
THE ALFONSO shifted out at the start and bumped ANTICIPATION.
From the outside barrier, HELENE PARAGON was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
When the pace slackened after the 1200 Metres, a number of runners were hampered including HELENE PARAGON which proved very difficult to settle and had to be checked away from the heels of THE ALFONSO; FLAME HERO was awkwardly placed behind SECRET WEAPON which was being steadied away from the heels of RENAISSANCE ART; ANTICIPATION was consequently left racing wide and without cover and was allowed to improve its position around the field, however, was left racing wide and without cover for the remainder of the race.
After the 1000 Metres, EASTERN EXPRESS was awkwardly placed behind ROMANTIC TOUCH which was being steadied away from the heels of HELENE SUPER STAR.
For some distance in the early part of the Straight, SECRET WEAPON, which was inclined to lay in, had difficulty obtaining clear running and passing the 150 Metres was held up for a run behind EASTERN EXPRESS.
Approaching the 300 Metres, HELENE PARAGON was held up for clear running.
Passing the 100 Metres, ROMANTIC TOUCH, which was giving ground, was steadied when crowded for room between GUN PIT and HARBOUR MASTER which was taken out by SECRET WEAPON which improved into tight running between HARBOUR MASTER and EASTERN EXPRESS.
Over the concluding stages, EASTERN EXPRESS was awkwardly placed outside the heels of HORSE OF FORTUNE which shifted out marginally.
EASTERN EXPRESS, HORSE OF FORTUNE and HELENE PARAGON were sent for sampling.

GLENEALY PRIZE was slow to begin.
VICTORY FOLLOW ME began only fairly.
KING OF MONGOLIA lost its right front plate on jumping and its left front plate after the 1200 Metres.
Shortly after the start, as HANGâS DECISION was being shifted in across behind SUPERIOR BOY, that horse shifted out marginally, resulting in HANGâS DECISION striking the heels of SUPERIOR BOY and blundering badly.
From a wide barrier, ENORMOUS HONOUR was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
HARD BALL GET was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Near the 950 Metres, HARD BALL GET was awkwardly placed close to the heels of KING OF MONGOLIA.
Near the 900 Metres, SUPERIOR BOY was left racing wide and without cover.
Rounding the Home Turn, ENORMOUS HONOUR was shifted out away from behind JADE FORTUNE.  HARD BALL GET, which was following ENORMOUS HONOUR, was forced to shift out away from the heels of that horse in consequence.
Passing the 350 Metres, HARD BALL GET was brushed by ENORMOUS HONOUR which was taken out by JADE FORTUNE which in turn was directed out by SUPERIOR BOY.  ENORMOUS HONOUR then raced in restricted room and near the 250 Metres was steadied when unable to maintain its position between JADE FORTUNE and HARD BALL GET which shifted in marginally.
Passing the 250 Metres, C Williams, the rider of GLENEALY PRIZE, momentarily stopped riding when improving between SEE ME NOW and SUNNY ORIENT which had its head on the side and was laying in.
Passing the 200 Metres, KING OF MONGOLIA was awkwardly placed inside the heels of THE SHOW which drifted in.
A veterinary inspection of SUPERIOR BOY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
VOLITATION, WINNERâS WAY and KINGSFIELD were sent for sampling.

After leaving the Parade Ring, ABLE TALENT took charge of its rider and made heavy contact with the running rail, resulting in M Chadwick being dislodged.  ABLE TALENT then proceeded to the Start riderless.  Acting on veterinary advice that ABLE TALENT was not suitable to race, that horse was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  Before being allowed to race again, ABLE TALENT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  M Chadwick was subsequently examined by the Clubâs medical officers and passed fit to fulfil his remaining race riding engagements.
SHOWING CHARACTER shifted in at the start and bumped TELECOM BOOM.
DOUBLE MASTER began awkwardly and shifted in towards the hindquarters of GIDDY GIDDY.
Shortly after the start, SMART SALUTE was awkwardly placed outside the heels of PERFECT SMART which shifted out.
Despite being vigorously ridden along in the early stages, KIM GLORY was slow to muster speed.
GIDDY GIDDY lost its left front plate near the 850 Metres.
Making the turn passing the 600 Metres, NOBLE BUDDIES (K Teetan), which for some distance had been ridden along to maintain its position inside the heels of SHOWING CHARACTER, was checked as SHOWING CHARACTER shifted in marginally when racing tight inside GIDDY GIDDY which shifted in after initially racing with its head on the side and wanting to shift away from DOUBLE MASTER and then shifting in further after being brushed by DOUBLE MASTER which shifted in marginally.  K Teetan was advised that, in the opinion of the Stewards, this incident was entirely avoidable had he have shown more judgement than he did on this occasion given the positioning of NOBLE BUDDIES in relation to horses to his outside.
Near the 450 Metres, PERFECT SMART became unbalanced after being bumped by SHOWING CHARACTER which got its head on the side and lay in when racing tight inside GIDDY GIDDY.
Passing the 150 Metres, SMART SALUTE raced tight outside TELECOM BOOM which shifted out to obtain clear running.
Throughout the race, GIDDY GIDDY and DOUBLE MASTER travelled wide and without cover.
After the race, N Callan reported that PERFECT SMART did not travel comfortably at any stage of the race and did not respond to his riding when placed under pressure in the Straight.  A veterinary inspection of PERFECT SMART immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, PERFECT SMART will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of GIDDY GIDDY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GIDDY GIDDY, SPARKLING TALENT and SMART SALUTE were sent for sampling.

MEDIC SWORDSMAN proved difficult to load.  Before being allowed to race again, MEDIC SWORDSMAN will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.
MEDIC SWORDSMAN was crowded for room on jumping between DOUBLE POINT and GOOD LUCK MAN which shifted in.
From the outside barriers, SPICY DOUBLE, MASTER PINNACLE and CASA MASTER were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Approaching the winning post on the first occasion, SHOW MISSION was bumped by DUTCH WINDMILL which lay in away from GOOD LUCK MAN.  After passing the winning post on the first occasion, DUTCH WINDMILL was then left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, YEUNG SING and MEDIC SWORDSMAN raced tight.
After the 1200 Metres, GOOD LUCK MAN travelled keenly in the lead.
Approaching the 800 Metres, SPICY DOUBLE commenced to travel keenly and was checked away from the heels of YEUNG SING.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, SPICY DOUBLE got its head on the side and shifted out when racing close to the heels of CHARITY PLENTY and as a consequence bumped YEUNG SING which was racing tight inside CASA MASTER.  After this, SPICY DOUBLE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of CHARITY PLENTY for some distance.
Rounding the Home Turn, DASHING FORTUNE raced tight inside JIMSON THE FAMOUS.
At the entrance to the Straight, SPICY DOUBLE was steadied away from the heels of DOUBLE POINT.
Shortly after entering the Straight and again near the 200 Metres, JIMSON THE FAMOUS and SHOW MISSION raced tight due to SHOW MISSION laying in.
In the early part of the Straight, MASTER PINNACLE lay in.
SPICY DOUBLE had some difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight and then approaching the 200 Metres was directed in away from the heels of DASHING FORTUNE to improve.  Passing the 200 Metres, SPICY DOUBLE was shifted further to the inside of GOOD LUCK MAN to obtain clear running.
YEUNG SING was held up for a run in the early part of the Straight and approaching the 200 Metres was directed to the outside of CASA MASTER to obtain clear running.
Over the concluding stages, SPICY DOUBLE got its head on the side and hung out, obliging its rider to stop riding and correct his mount.
A veterinary inspection of JIMSON THE FAMOUS and DOUBLE POINT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SPICY DOUBLE, CASA MASTER and YEUNG SING were sent for sampling.

RISING POWER was crowded for room on jumping between MEGATRON and SUPERNATURAL which shifted out.  After being bumped on the hindquarters by RISING POWER, MEGATRON shifted in abruptly, resulting in RISING POWER being checked.  After this, SUPERNATURAL was ridden along, however, was slow to muster speed.
BORN TO RACE began awkwardly.  After this, BORN TO RACE was ridden along in an attempt to obtain a more forward position.
From wide barriers, PRINCE FALCON and PACKING GO GO were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After travelling a short distance, KIRAM was awkwardly placed outside the heels of WORKS OF ART.
Approaching and passing the 1200 Metres, SUPERNATURAL hung out and then making the turn near the 950 Metres shifted out and bumped KIRAM.  MONEY MAN and PRINCE FALCON, which were following, were hampered in consequence.  SUPERNATURAL then continued to race with its head on the side and lay out and making the turn after the 600 Metres hung out across the heels of KIRAM and was checked.  BORN TO RACE, which was racing to the outside of SUPERNATURAL, was taken wider in this incident.  SUPERNATURAL continued to hang out until entering the Home Straight.  The racing manners of SUPERNATURAL were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, SUPERNATURAL will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial around a bend.
Passing the 900 Metres, KIRAM raced very close to the heels of TRAVEL AMBASSADOR which was awkwardly placed behind SOUL ACHIEVER.  TRAVEL AMBASSADOR was then shifted out away from the heels of SOUL ACHIEVER near the 850 Metres and was allowed to improve its position into the lead.
Passing the 500 Metres, PACKING GO GO and PRINCE FALCON raced tight as PACKING GO GO improved into tight running outside MONEY MAN.  PACKING GO GO was then awkwardly placed close to the heels of MONEY MAN rounding the Home Turn when racing tight inside PRINCE FALCON which became unbalanced.
Passing the 300 Metres, MONEY MAN was shifted to the outside of MEGATRON after being disappointed for running inside that horse.  MONEY MAN then had difficulty obtaining clear running approaching and passing the 200 Metres.
Passing the 150 Metres, PACKING GO GO, which was closing off the race, was crowded for room between HAPPY FIERY DRAGON and SUPERNATURAL which shifted in marginally under pressure.  In this incident, HAPPY FIERY DRAGON was bumped by PACKING GO GO.
A veterinary inspection of BORN TO RACE and TRAVEL AMBASSADOR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
WORKS OF ART and KIRAM were sent for sampling.

On arrival at the Start, Z Purton expressed concern regarding HAYMAKERâs action.  HAYMAKER was examined by the Veterinary Officer who, after the necessary consultations, said the horse was suitable to race.
YO-YO DA and ST YAZIN bumped on jumping.
From the outside barriers, SHARP HUNTER, ALL MY GAIN and EXPEDITE were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Making the first turn near the 1050 Metres, HAYMAKER was awkwardly placed close to the heels of ST YAZIN.
After the 900 Metres, ST YAZIN commenced to prove very difficult to settle and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of FORZA AVANTI which was racing close to the heels of WINNINGLI.  ST YAZIN was then checked away from the heels of FORZA AVANTI passing the 850 Metres, shifted out and bumped FORMULA GALORE which became unbalanced and was taken wider.  HAYMAKER, which was following, was checked away from the heels of FORMULA GALORE in consequence.
Passing the 100 Metres, EXPEDITE was shifted out away from the heels of WINNINGLI to continue improving.
Approaching the 50 Metres, FORZA AVANTI shifted out under pressure and brushed HAYMAKER.
Throughout the race, PACKING PEGASUS travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of FORMULA GALORE, J Moreira stated that after his mount was bumped on a number of occasions by ST YAZIN passing the 850 Metres, FORMULA GALORE then commenced to travel keenly and because of this he was not able to steady the horse to shift in behind ST YAZIN.  He said rather than continue to try and obtain this position, he elected to remain racing outside ST YAZIN as he was of the opinion that this may result in FORMULA GALORE being too far out of its ground.  He said prior to the turn after the 600 Metres FORMULA GALORE came off the bridle and he had to ride the horse along for some distance approaching and passing the 500 Metres in an endeavour to have it maintain its position.  He added after shifting to the outside of PACKING PEGASUS after the 400 Metres, FORMULA GALORE gave a limited response to his riding, however, in the Straight was disappointing in the manner in which it weakened out of the race.  Mr C Fownes, the trainer of FORMULA GALORE, was unable to offer any explanation for the disappointing performance of FORMULA GALORE as the horse had done particularly well since its last start success.  He said he had checked FORMULA GALORE after the race and he was not able to identify any reason for the horseâs disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection of FORMULA GALORE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of FORMULA GALORE was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, FORMULA GALORE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned regarding the performance of FORZA AVANTI, U Rispoli stated that after riding his mount along in the early stages to obtain a good position, FORZA AVANTI was then awkwardly placed close to the heels of runners after the 900 Metres when the tempo seemed to slacken marginally.  He said however that after the 800 Metres FORZA AVANTI raced more kindly and he was happy with the manner in which the horse had travelled up to rounding the Home Turn.  He said he placed FORZA AVANTI under pressure after the 400 Metres, however, the horse did not respond to his riding and was disappointing in the manner in which it failed to finish off the race.  He added whilst FORZA AVANTI may not have been suited by rising in class tonight, he suggested to the connections that they may wish to consider stepping FORZA AVANTI up in distance as the horse took some time to muster speed in the early stages and then over-raced and therefore a race over a slightly longer distance may allow the horse to travel better in the run than it did tonight.  A veterinary inspection of FORZA AVANTI immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FORMULA GALORE, SHARP HUNTER and YO-YO DA were sent for sampling.

DARING FIT was withdrawn on 8.11.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (coughing) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter LOVE CHUNGHWA (B Prebble).  Before being allowed to race again, DARING FIT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
BUDDY BUNDY shifted in at the start and bumped HASTA LA VISTA which in turn shifted in and bumped NEVER BETTER.
LOVE CHUNGHWA began awkwardly.
From wide barriers, FUN MANAGER, SHINING CHAMPION and ROYALE ELEGANCE were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
HIGH VOLATILITY raced wide and without cover until near the 800 Metres after which FUNNY BUDDIES was left racing wide and without cover.
Shortly after entering the Straight, NEVER BETTER was shifted in away from the heels of BREEDERSâ STAR to obtain clear running.
ROYALE ELEGANCE was unable to obtain clear running over the final 200 Metres and consequently was not able to be properly tested.
Passing the 150 Metres, FUN MANAGER was shifted out away from the heels of HASTA LA VISTA which was shifted to the inside of HIGH VOLATILITY.
Near the 50 Metres, YOURTHEWONFORME and SECRET AGENT raced tight.
Close to the finishing line, LOVE CHUNGHWA raced in restricted room between BUDDY BUNDY and BREEDERSâ STAR when attempting to improve into tight running between those horses.  Consequently LOVE CHUNGHWA was not able to be fully tested over the concluding stages.
After the race, Z Purton stated that, in his opinion, HIGH VOLATILITY did not appreciate tonightâs firm racing surface.  He said when the horse was successful last start, it was on a rain affected surface.  A veterinary inspection of HIGH VOLATILITY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
NEVER BETTER, BREEDERSâ STAR and BUDDY BUNDY were sent for sampling.

ACTUARIAT bounded in the air at the start and then was hampered by DASHING KING which shifted in.
MR PELE was slow to begin.
DINOZZO and INVENTOR bumped at the start.
From the outside barrier, PREMIUM CHAMPION was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
An inquiry into the reason for SURE PEACE being checked and CLOUD NINE being hampered passing the winning post on the first occasion was adjourned until a date to be fixed as Apprentice H N Wong, the rider of DASHING KING, had been transported to hospital after this race.  GENERAL SHERMAN, which was following SURE PEACE, was checked in consequence and MR PELE, which was following GENERAL SHERMAN, was hampered.  When the inquiry resumes, evidence will also be taken from N Rawiller, the rider of INVENTOR.
The Stewards opened and immediately adjourned an inquiry into the reason for DASHING KING falling passing the 400 Metres, resulting in its rider, Apprentice H N Wong being dislodged.  In this incident, U Rispoli was dislodged from MR PELE when that horse was severely checked and GENERAL SHERMAN was also severely checked.  ACTUARIAT, INDUSTRIALIST WAY and PREMIUM CHAMPION were also severely hampered.  After suffering interference in this incident, INDUSTRIALIST WAY and PREMIUM CHAMPION were eased down.  When the inquiry resumes, evidence will also be taken from C Schofield, the rider of CLOUD NINE, and Z Purton, the rider of DINOZZO.
Approaching the 200 Metres, CLOUD NINE raced in restricted room between DINOZZO and INVENTOR which shifted out marginally under pressure.
A veterinary inspection of MR PELE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that an endoscopic examination of WINNAM showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea and also found the horse to be a âroarerâ and lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, WINNAM will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
PACKING DRAGON and DINOZZO were sent for sampling.  Samples were also taken from DASHING KING.

Whilst in the holding stalls, SPEEDY ACHIEVER had its right front plate refitted.  After this plate was refitted, SPEEDY ACHIEVER was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
On arrival at the Start, Z Purton reported that E-SUPER coughed on a number of occasions when proceeding to the barriers.  E-SUPER was examined by the Veterinary Officer who, after the necessary consultations, said the horse was suitable to race.  An endoscopic examination conducted on E-SUPER after the race did not reveal any significant findings.
BOLSHOI BALLET and ROUNDABOUT both began awkwardly.
From the outside barrier, APACHE SPIRIT was shifted across behind runners in the early stages after being slow to jump.
Near the 1000 Metres, BOLSHOI BALLET got its head on the side and shifted out across the heels of NAVAS (C Schofield) which was racing tight to the outside of BOLSHOI BALLET.  As the Stewards could not be satisfied that NAVAS shifting in had been the cause of the incident rather than BOLSHOI BALLET hanging out, C Schofield was afforded the benefit of the doubt, however, he was advised to ensure that he leaves comfortable racing room for runners to his inside in future.
From approaching the 900 Metres until after passing the 700 Metres, SPEEDY ACHIEVER proved very difficult to settle and had to be checked away from the heels of TIMELY ARRIVED.
Near the 850 Metres, APACHE SPIRIT was momentarily crowded for room inside BOLSHOI BALLET which shifted in before being directed back out to relieve the tightening.
Approaching and passing the 700 Metres, APACHE SPIRIT travelled keenly and got its head up on a number of occasions.
Passing the 300 Metres, NAVAS was held up for clear running when attempting to improve into tight running between SUPER LEADER and SPEEDY ACHIEVER.
Over the final 100 Metres, IâM A WITNESS had difficulty obtaining clear running and close to the finishing line raced tight inside ROUNDABOUT which raced in restricted room between IâM A WITNESS and TIMELY ARRIVED.  Consequently IâM A WITNESS, ROUNDABOUT and TIMELY ARRIVED were not able to be fully tested over the concluding stages.
Passing the 50 Metres, E-SUPER was steadied away from the heels of EXTREMELY FUN as a result of WHO ELSE BUT YOU getting its head on the side and hanging out under pressure.  Consequently, J Moreira, the rider of WHO ELSE BUT YOU, was obliged to stop riding and straighten his mount.
EXTREMELY FUN and WHO ELSE BUT YOU were sent for sampling.

BACK IN BLACK shifted out at the start and made heavy contact with HAPPY YEAH YEAH, resulting in both horses becoming unbalanced.  Then, from a wide barrier, BACK IN BLACK was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Shortly after the start, BORNTOACHIEVE and TRAVEL DATUK were crowded for room between GOLDEN HARVEST and YOU READ MY MIND which shifted in.  In this incident, BORNTOACHIEVE bumped the hindquarters of GOLDEN HARVEST which became unbalanced.
Passing the 1000 Metres, BACK IN BLACK got its head on the side and shifted out towards the heels of TRAVEL DATUK.
Passing the 150 Metres, BACK IN BLACK was shifted in away from the heels of GOLDEN HARVEST which shifted in under pressure.
Near the 100 Metres, BORNTOACHIEVE was shifted out away from the heels of HAPPY METEOR which was giving ground.
Approaching the 50 Metres, FLYING TOURBILLON was directed in away from the heels of CHARITY JOY which was shifting out under pressure.
M Chadwick (CHARITY JOY) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that approaching the 50 Metres he permitted his mount to shift out when not clear of BLOCKER DEE, causing that horse to be checked and to lose the running to which it was rightfully entitled.  M Chadwick was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 30 November 2016 and to expire on Monday, 5 December 2016 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards took into consideration M Chadwickâs good race riding record.
Throughout the race, HAPPY YEAH YEAH travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of BACK IN BLACK immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Z Purton will be interviewed regarding the disappointing performance of BACK IN BLACK prior to the Sha Tin racemeeting on Saturday, 12 November 2016.
BLOCKER DEE, VERBINSKY and CHARITY JOY were sent for sampling.

GLAMOROUS RYDER was withdrawn on 11.11.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame both fore).  Before being allowed to race again, GLAMOROUS RYDER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
DANEWIN EXPRESS began very awkwardly and, from the outside barrier, was shifted across behind runners shortly after the start.
ENJOY THE GAME was also steadied shortly after the start and shifted across behind runners.
Near the 1800 Metres, WIN CHANCE was momentarily tightened for room between BEST JADE TRIUMPH and HOLY STAR which shifted in.  HOLY STAR was then directed back out to relieve the tightening to WIN CHANCE.
Approaching the 1600 Metres, MY FOLKS commenced to travel keenly and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of HIGH SPEED METRO.
CHOICE EXCHEQUER was unable to obtain clear running until passing the 300 Metres.
LOYAL CRAFTSMAN was unable to obtain clear running until passing the 200 Metres.
Near the 150 Metres, WIN CHANCE, which was giving ground, was momentarily eased away from the heels of BEST JADE TRIUMPH which was taken in by HIGH SPEED METRO.
Close to the finishing line, MALAYAN PEARL was directed in away from the heels of BEST JADE TRIUMPH which in turn shifted in away from HIGH SPEED METRO.
When questioned, K Teetan stated that he had been asked to obtain a forward position on HOLY STAR.  He said near the 1600 Metres he was racing to the outside and slightly behind the leader MALAYAN PEARL and he was content to maintain this position, however, after the 1600 Metres the rider of MALAYAN PEARL steadied the horse and appeared to be attempting to obtain cover with MALAYAN PEARL.  He said therefore he allowed HOLY STAR to continue forward in order to cross MALAYAN PEARL.  He said he had to ride his mount along at this time, but having in mind the way MALAYAN PEARL was being steadied, it was likely that he would just be able to improve his position forward of MALAYAN PEARL and cross into the lead without having to pressure his horse.  He added however that MALAYAN PEARL was not able to be steadied and maintained its position inside HOLY STAR and therefore he was obliged to continue to race outside that horse and slightly in advance of MALAYAN PEARL until after the 1000 Metres at which time he was able to steady HOLY STAR to race directly to the outside of MALAYAN PEARL.
After the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on HOLY STAR at the request of Trainer D J Hall.  The Veterinary Surgeon reported that this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horseâs trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, HOLY STAR will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Also after the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on MALAYAN PEARL at the request of Trainer D Cruz.  The Veterinary Surgeon reported that this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horseâs trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, MALAYAN PEARL will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Following the race, it was reported that DANEWIN EXPRESS had sustained a wound to the right stifle.
A veterinary inspection of WIN CHANCE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HIGH SPEED METRO and MY FOLKS were sent for sampling.

CLASSIC EMPEROR put its head down on jumping and began awkwardly.
CITRON SPIRIT was crowded for room on jumping between THUNDER STOMP and HAPPY PLACE which shifted out.
From a wide barrier, AMBITIOUS PINS was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Approaching the 1300 Metres, THUNDER STOMP shifted out away from the heels of HAPPY PLACE, resulting in AMBITIOUS PINS being inconvenienced when taken wider.
Approaching the 1100 Metres, PRAWN BABA was shifted out away from the heels of CHEERFUL BOY which was over-racing.
After the 800 Metres, STARSHIP got its head on the side and lay out, resulting in the horse racing wide and without cover.
When questioned, O Doleuze stated that he was asked to ride CHEERFUL BOY in a forward position, however, connections were mindful that CLASSIC EMPEROR would most likely also be ridden in a forward position and had the assistance of a claiming apprentice.  He said therefore if CLASSIC EMPEROR pressed forward as anticipated, he should not engage in a speed battle with that horse, rather take a sit behind CLASSIC EMPEROR and obtain the âbox seatâ.  He said, as anticipated, CLASSIC EMPEROR was ridden aggressively in the early stages to obtain the lead and he therefore commenced to steady CHEERFUL BOY prior to the 1200 Metres to allow that horse to cross.  He said when he did this, CHEERFUL BOY commenced to over-race and then after being crossed by CLASSIC EMPEROR approaching the 1100 Metres CHEERFUL BOY then raced close to the heels of that horse for a short distance.  He added, bearing in mind the manner in which CHEERFUL BOY raced today, he suggested to connections that they consider bringing CHEERFUL BOY back in distance to allow the horse to settle better in the run so that it can finish off its races stronger than it did on this occasion.
A veterinary inspection of STARSHIP and AMBITIOUS PINS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CITRON SPIRIT, CLASSIC EMPEROR and PRAWN BABA were sent for sampling.

race_name: PANASONIC FRONT LOADING WASHING MACHINE HANDICAP
incident_report:
BONITO was slow to begin.
PRINCE HARMONY, which was fractious in the barriers, lifted its front feet off the ground as the start was effected, began awkwardly and consequently lost ground.
From the outside barriers, MASTER STEED and LETSGOFREE were both shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Approaching the 1100 Metres, ROYALE ELEGANCE got its head on the side and lay in across the heels of HOUSE OF FUN.
Passing the 1100 Metres, FLYING GODSPELL was shifted out away from the heels of HOT HOT PEPPER as that horse crossed into the lead.  In this incident, FLYING GODSPELL shifted out, resulting in LONDON MASTER shifting out away from FLYING GODSPELL and bumping UNIQUE JOYFUL.
Approaching the 1000 Metres, CARRY TO WIN commenced to prove difficult to settle and got its head up for some distance when being steadied to allow HOT HOT PEPPER to cross.
Approaching the first turn near the 900 Metres, PRINCE HARMONY shifted out away from the heels of UNIQUE JOYFUL when proving difficult to settle, resulting in ROYALE ELEGANCE being inconvenienced and momentarily taken wider.
After the 900 Metres, UNIQUE JOYFUL was left racing wide and without cover.
After the 300 Metres, CARRY TO WIN was disappointed for running inside HOT HOT PEPPER which shifted in marginally.
Near the 150 Metres, BRIGHT STAR was shifted to the inside of CARRY TO WIN after being disappointed for running between that horse which shifted out and LONDON MASTER.
Passing the 100 Metres, LONDON MASTER was shifted in away from the heels of FLYING GODSPELL.
HOUSE OF FUN and MASTER STEED were sent for sampling.

MIGHTY WONGCHOY began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of CONSISTENT, causing both horses to become badly unbalanced.  After this, MIGHTY WONGCHOY was ridden along, however, failed to muster speed.
As the start was effected, AMBITIOUS SPEEDY bounded in the air and then, from a wide barrier, was shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
Also from wide barriers, ATOMIC BLAST and RACINGFORPLEASURE were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
DRAGON BACHELOR and DRAGON HARMONY bumped shortly after the start.
In the early stages, STARRY STARLIES was steadied to obtain cover.
For some distance approaching and passing the 1100 Metres, STARRY STARLIES commenced to prove difficult to settle and got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of PLANET GIANT.
Approaching the 800 Metres, COMMANDANT (N Rawiller) was shifted out in an attempt to improve between DRAGON HARMONY and PLANET GIANT which was then ridden along to maintain its position.  When COMMANDANT shifted out, EQUITY DOCTRINE improved its position to be racing tight between COMMANDANT and CONSISTENT.  Then near the 700 Metres, COMMANDANT was checked and EQUITY DOCTRINE hampered when COMMANDANT was unable to remain racing between DRAGON HARMONY and PLANET GIANT which became unbalanced after being bumped on the hindquarters by COMMANDANT.  STARRY STARLIES, which was racing outside COMMANDANT and GARLIC YEAH, which was following COMMANDANT, were badly hampered in consequence.  N Rawiller was advised to ensure that he exercises more care when attempting to improve into tight running in future.
Passing the 600 Metres, GARLIC YEAH was momentarily crowded for room inside COMMANDANT which shifted in marginally after coming under pressure.
Rounding the Home Turn, EQUITY DOCTRINE raced tight between PLANET GIANT and CONSISTENT which shifted to the outside of LUCKY BALL when that horse was commencing to give ground.  LUCKY BALL then continued to give ground, resulting in MIZZEN GREY and AMBITIOUS SPEEDY both being badly hampered when held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight.  LUCKY BALL subsequently finished tailed out.  A veterinary inspection of LUCKY BALL immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.  Before being allowed to race again, LUCKY BALL will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Approaching the 100 Metres, MIZZEN GREY momentarily raced in restricted room inside GARLIC YEAH which shifted in.
Close to the finishing line, DRAGON HARMONY raced tight inside CONSISTENT.
The Stewards questioned Apprentice K K Chiong regarding her riding of MIGHTY WONGCHOY from after the 1400 Metres until near the 700 Metres.  Apprentice Chiong stated that after racing directly to the inside of EQUITY DOCTRINE after the 1500 Metres, she commenced to steady her mount when racing tight inside that horse which was racing tight inside runners to its outside.  She agreed with the Stewards that there was an opportunity for her to continue to maintain her position rather than steady MIGHTY WONGCHOY which resulted in MIGHTY WONGCHOY being checked out across the heels of EQUITY DOCTRINE approaching the 1200 Metres after that horse continued to race tight inside GARLIC YEAH.  Apprentice Chiong was also questioned regarding her failure to maintain her position inside MIZZEN GREY for some distance after the 1200 Metres.  She again agreed that, in retrospect, she should have made more endeavour to maintain her position on MIGHTY WONGCHOY which would have prevented MIZZEN GREY from being able to cross MIGHTY WONGCHOY prior to the 1000 Metres.  Apprentice Chiong was also spoken to regarding MIGHTY WONGCHOY not racing closer behind MIZZEN GREY when there was an opportunity to do so for some distance after the 800 Metres.  Apprentice Chiong, in the presence of her allocated trainer, Mr K W Lui, was advised that her failure to hold her position for a significant portion of this race had come under notice and she was further advised that she must ride her mounts in such a manner so that they are able to maintain as prominent a position as is possible in the circumstances.  A veterinary inspection of MIGHTY WONGCHOY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
EQUITY DOCTRINE and CONSISTENT were sent for sampling.

VICTOR EMPEROR began only fairly and then shortly after the start was crowded for room between HOME RUN and AMRITSARIA which shifted out.
FRUITFUL LIFE and NAMJONG INVINCIBLE bumped at the start and then were both crowded for room between EASTERN PROWESS and LONDON CITY which shifted in after being bumped by HONG KONG CAPTAIN.
After travelling a short distance, HOME RUN was steadied after racing tight between VICTOR EMPEROR and SUPER SWEET ORANGE.
After the 1300 Metres, AMRITSARIA got its head up and raced keenly when being steadied to obtain cover.
After the 1200 Metres, EASTERN PROWESS got its head up when over-racing and awkwardly placed close to the heels of INVISIBLE.
Passing the 900 Metres, SUPER SWEET ORANGE was awkwardly placed behind VICTOR EMPEROR.
Making the first turn after the 900 Metres, EASTERN PROWESS, which was racing greenly, got its head on the side and shifted out away from the heels of INVISIBLE, resulting in NAMJONG INVINCIBLE being taken wider.  After this, NAMJONG INVINCIBLE remained racing wide and without cover.
After the 800 Metres, SUPER CLAN was left racing wide and without cover.
Rounding the Home Turn, VICTOR EMPEROR raced in restricted room inside AMRITSARIA.
A veterinary inspection of NAMJONG INVINCIBLE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HOME RUN and SUPER TALENT were sent for sampling.

BEST HOPE was withdrawn on 11.11.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter GOLD DRAGON (C Schofield).  Before being allowed to race again, BEST HOPE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
ELECTRONIC PHOENIX began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped the hindquarters of TRUE COMMENT which became unbalanced.
ELECTRONIC PHOENIX lost its right front plate shortly after the start.
From wide barriers, GO SANDY GO, ROYAL SPIRIT and SPEEDY WALLY were all steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Despite being vigorously ridden along in the early stages, LUCKY HAMMER failed to muster speed and then when left racing very wide making the first turn was steadied and shifted in to obtain cover.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, SUM WIN DRAGON was momentarily eased away from the heels of MASTER GOLD.
SUM WIN DRAGON lost its right hind plate near the 1400 Metres.
Passing the 1300 Metres, SPEEDY WALLY was shifted out away from the heels of GOLD DRAGON.  SPEEDY WALLY was then left racing wide and without cover near the 1000 Metres.
Near the 1250 Metres, ROYAL SPIRIT proved very difficult to settle, got its head up on a number of occasions and became unbalanced when checked.
Approaching the 1200 Metres, SUM WIN DRAGON commenced to prove very difficult to settle and got its head up when being checked away from the heels of MASTER GOLD.
After entering the Back Straight near the 1100 Metres, FLYING PROSPERITY became very unbalanced after shifting in towards the rail of its own accord.
Approaching the turn near the 700 Metres, SUM WIN DRAGON again got its head up when awkwardly placed behind MASTER GOLD.  ELECTRONIC PHOENIX, which was following SUM WIN DRAGON, was steadied away from the heels of that horse in consequence.
IMPERIAL CONCORDE (S de Sousa) was held up for clear running rounding the Home Turn and near the 400 Metres was checked away from the heels of FLYING PROSPERITY which came under pressure.  IMPERIAL CONCORDE shifted out away from the heels of FLYING PROSPERITY and bumped the hindquarters of FURIOUS PEGASUS after the 400 Metres.  IMPERIAL CONCORDE was then held up for clear running and after attempting to improve between FLYING PROSPERITY and FURIOUS PEGASUS where there was insufficient room was checked near the 250 Metres and shifted to the outside of FURIOUS PEGASUS to obtain clear running.  When IMPERIAL CONCORDE was checked, FLYING PROSPERITY, which was giving ground abruptly, was also hampered.  S de Sousa was told that whilst the Stewards accepted that FLYING PROSPERITY giving ground had played a significant part in this incident, nonetheless he must exercise more care when attempting to improve into runs which are not properly available.
For the majority of the race, DIAMOND FRIENDS travelled wide and without cover.
Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the riding of S de Sousa (IMPERIAL CONCORDE), 5th placegetter, over the concluding stages did not affect the horseâs finishing position, he was nonetheless reminded of his obligation to ride his mounts out at least hands and heels all the way to the end of the race where circumstances permit.
ELECTRONIC PHOENIX and MASTER GOLD were sent for sampling.

POMPADOUR was slow to begin.
SOUTHERN EXPRESS began only fairly.
SOARING WYVERN shifted out at the start and bumped GOLDIE FLANKER.  Then from wide barriers, SOARING WYVERN, GOLDIE FLANKER and GOOD CHOICE AHEAD were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
REWARDING FLYER shifted out at the start and bumped the hindquarters of KA YING KID.
Passing the 1100 Metres and again near the 1050 Metres, SOUTHERN EXPRESS was awkwardly placed inside the heels of DOUBLE DOWN.  DOUBLE DOWN was then shifted out to relieve the tightening to SOUTHERN EXPRESS, however, SOUTHERN EXPRESS continued to race greenly and shifted ground on a number of occasions of its own accord.  KA YING KID, which was racing to the inside of SOUTHERN EXPRESS, was hampered in consequence.
Passing the 1000 Metres, SOUTHERN EXPRESS was steadied away from the heels of DOUBLE DOWN which, when racing keenly, was steadied to allow PEARL WIN to cross.
Approaching the 900 Metres, KA YING KID raced tight inside IMPERIAL SEAL after that horse was bumped by GOOD FOR YOU which was then shifted out to relieve the tightening.
Apprentice K K Chiong (METALLIC STAR) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that passing the 900 Metres she permitted her mount to shift in when not clear of DOUBLE DOWN, causing that horse to be checked and to lose the running to which it was rightfully entitled and WINNING VIBE, which was racing inside DOUBLE DOWN, to be severely hampered.  In the circumstances, the Stewards deemed it appropriate for Apprentice Chiongâs licence to ride in races to be suspended for a period to commence on Wednesday, 7 December 2016 and to expire on Monday, 12 December 2016 on which day she may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, Apprentice Chiong was fined $12,500.
After the 900 Metres, DOUBLE DOWN and GOOD FOR YOU were left racing wide and without cover.
Approaching the 600 Metres, SOUTHERN EXPRESS shifted out when continuing to race greenly and awkwardly placed close to the heels of WINNING VIBE.
REWARDING FLYER had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight.
SOUTHERN EXPRESS was unable to obtain clear running in the early part of the Straight and approaching the 200 Metres attempted to improve between GOOD FOR YOU and DOUBLE DOWN where there was insufficient room, resulting in SOUTHERN EXPRESS bumping the hindquarters of GOOD FOR YOU.  Then near the 150 Metres, SOUTHERN EXPRESS was steadied when disappointed for running between GOOD FOR YOU and DOUBLE DOWN (C Schofield) which shifted out.  Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that SOUTHERN EXPRESS had not properly established running between GOOD FOR YOU and DOUBLE DOWN at this time, C Schofield was advised to ensure that he makes every endeavour to prevent his mounts from shifting ground.
Passing the 150 Metres, GOLDIE FLANKER was shifted out away from the heels of firstly SOUTHERN EXPRESS and then GOOD FOR YOU to obtain clear running.
SOUTHERN EXPRESS, KA YING KID and SOARING WYVERN were sent for sampling.

race_name: PANASONIC SMALLER HEAT-PUMP AIR CONDITIONER HANDICAP
incident_report:
HROVAT was withdrawn on 11.11.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right hind) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter ENDEARING (S de Sousa).  Before being allowed to race again, HROVAT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
BEAUTY MASTER was slow to begin and consequently raced back in the field.
EL SHERIF began only fairly.
GO BABY GO began only fairly and then was bumped by GRACE HEART which shifted out after beginning awkwardly.  After this, both GO BABY GO and GRACE HEART were ridden along, however, failed to muster speed.
CELESTIAL NOVA began only fairly and shortly after the start was crowded for room between HERE WE COME and ENDEARING which began awkwardly and shifted in.
Shortly after the start, FORTUNE BO BO shifted out and bumped TRAVEL SUCCESSOR.
Near the 500 Metres, GO BABY GO was crowded for room outside GRACE HEART which, after initially getting its head on the side and shifting out away from ENDEARING, then raced tight outside that horse.  ENDEARING was then shifted in to relieve the tightening to GRACE HEART and GO BABY GO.
Approaching the 300 Metres, DIAMOND LEGEND was crowded for room between EL SHERIF and BEAUTY MASTER which got its head on the side and hung out.  BEAUTY MASTER continued to hang out for the remainder of the race and proved difficult to ride.
Near the 150 Metres, GO BABY GO was shifted in away from the heels of HERE WE COME which was hampered by ENDEARING (S de Sousa) which shifted out when not quite clear.  S de Sousa was advised to exercise more care.
Over the concluding stages, WATER DIVINER and FORTUNE BO BO raced tight.
S de Sousa, the rider of the 4th placegetter, ENDEARING, was severely reprimanded for failing to ride his mount all the way to the finishing line.  As the Stewards were satisfied that S de Sousa had only failed to ride ENDEARING out over about the last stride of the race, they could not be comfortable that his riding had affected the horseâs placing, however, he was told to ensure that he rides his mounts out all the way to the end of the race to the best of his ability.
A veterinary inspection of GO BABY GO immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
BEAUTY MASTER, WATER DIVINER and FORTUNE BO BO were sent for sampling.

SPICY SURE was slow to begin and after this was shifted across behind runners in the early stages from a wide barrier.
TWIN DELIGHT and SUPER LIFELINE bumped at the start.  Then despite being ridden along in the early stages, both TWIN DELIGHT and SUPER LIFELINE failed to muster speed.
MY LITTLE FRIEND and ALL YOU WISH were steadied in the early stages to obtain cover.
Approaching the 1100 Metres, BLIZZARD got its head up on a number of occasions when proving difficult to settle.
Near the 950 Metres, EROICO shifted out away from the heels of MR BOGART.  FRIENDS OF KA YING, which was following, was steadied in consequence, resulting in BLIZZARD, which was following FRIENDS OF KA YING and continuing to prove difficult to settle, being awkwardly placed close to the heels of that horse.
Passing the 900 Metres, SUPER LIFELINE was awkwardly placed behind TWIN DELIGHT.
APOLLOâS CHOICE was held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight and passing the 250 Metres attempted to improve into tight running between ALMABABY and WAH MAY FRIEND.  Passing the 200 Metres, APOLLOâS CHOICE was disappointed for running inside WAH MAY FRIEND which got its head on the side and shifted in away from MR BOGART.  APOLLOâS CHOICE was then awkwardly placed close to the heels of WAH MAY FRIEND which shifted out marginally.
Passing the 200 Metres, FRIENDS OF KA YING was tightened for room between BLIZZARD and EROICO, both of which shifted ground.
Passing the 150 Metres, ALL YOU WISH was bumped and taken wider by SUPER LIFELINE which improved quickly to be racing close to the heels of FRIENDS OF KA YING which shifted out marginally.
For the majority of the race, FRIENDS OF KA YING travelled wide and without cover.
The Stewards considered an application from Jockey N Rawiller and Trainer C S Shum for CIRCUIT LAND to be declared a non-runner.  After taking evidence from Jockey Rawiller, Mr Shum and Mr A Speechley, Starter and after viewing the videos, it was established that after being placed in the barriers CIRCUIT LAND became fractious.  CIRCUIT LAND then stood satisfactorily for a short amount of time, however, as the start was effected reared abruptly, resulting in the horse losing a considerable amount of ground.  As the Stewards were of the opinion that CIRCUIT LAND had caused its own difficulties, in the circumstances that horse was found to have been afforded a fair start and accordingly was deemed to be a runner.  Before being allowed to race again, CIRCUIT LAND will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.
After the race, it was reported that TWIN DELIGHT had sustained a small cut to the inside of its left front cannon and MR BOGART had sustained abrasions to the right hind tendon.
A veterinary inspection of CIRCUIT LAND immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
