The Stewards deferred the declaration of weighed-in as they were of the prima facie view that an incident had occurred over the concluding stages of the race which cast doubt on whether WAYFOONG VINNIE should be declared the winner.  After viewing the videos, a protest/objection on behalf of the connections of COUR VALANT (J Moreira) was not proceeded with.  It was established that at the entrance to the Straight WAYFOONG VINNIE was racing directly behind COUR VALANT, the second placegetter and improved its position to be racing on terms with that horse at about the 75 Metres.  It was also found that WAYFOONG VINNIE then shifted in and bumped COUR VALANT approaching the 50 Metres and again passing the 50 Metres with WAYFOONG VINNIE subsequently being declared to have won the race by a neck margin over COUR VALANT.  Having regard to the manner in which both horses were finishing off the race, the proximity of the incident to the winning post and the margin between the horses at the end of the race, the Stewards were satisfied that, despite shifting in and making contact with COUR VALANT on two occasions, WAYFOONG VINNIE would have won the race irrespective.  Therefore the Stewards believed that there were insufficient grounds to proceed with a formal protest/objection and accordingly weighed-in was declared on the numbers semaphored by the Judge.  Whilst it had no bearing on the Stewardsâ decision not to proceed with the matter, J Moreira did not lodge a formal protest/objection on behalf of the connections of COUR VALANT.
N Rawiller (WAYFOONG VINNIE) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that passing the 50 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in, resulting in that horse making contact with COUR VALANT on two occasions and causing COUR VALANT to be taken in across the rightful running of HAY GO LUCKY over the concluding stages, causing HAY GO LUCKY to be checked, clip the heels of COUR VALANT and stumble, resulting in M Chadwick being dislodged from HAY GO LUCKY.  N Rawiller was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 7 December 2016 and to expire on Wednesday, 28 December 2016 on which day he may resume race riding (6 Hong Kong racedays).
Acting under the provisions of Rule 101(3), the Stewards were satisfied that no part of Jockey Chadwick had made contact with the ground prior to the winning post and accordingly HAY GO LUCKY was deemed to have carried the weight and HAY GO LUCKYâs position as notified by the Judge was confirmed.

He said he had to continually niggle at FINE ROCK in an endeavour to have the horse maintain its positon and FINE ROCK did not travel comfortably for the majority of the race.  He said when the pace quickened rounding the Home Turn, FINE ROCK was left flat-footed and then did not respond to his riding in the Straight.  He added, in his opinion, the horse would be better suited over a distance longer than that of tonightâs race.  A veterinary inspection of FINE ROCK immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

A veterinary inspection of AUTUMN GOLD immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.

Just prior to the start being effected, HO HO FEEL became fractious and as the start was effected lifted its front feet off the ground and was slow to begin.  HO HO FEEL was then shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
LOTUS STRIKES BACK shifted out at the start and bumped PACKING GENIUS.
SHARP SAILOR began awkwardly.
From a wide barrier, FULL GLORY was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Approaching the 1700 Metres, JOLLY GENE was left racing wide and without cover and was then allowed to improve its position passing the 1600 Metres.  JOLLY GENE continued to travel wide and without cover until after the 1200 Metres at which stage it was able to assume the lead.
PREMIUM CHAMPION was left racing wide and without cover after the 1200 Metres.
Near the 750 Metres, SHARP SAILOR became unbalanced when awkwardly placed close to the heels of EASY HEDGE.
At the entrance to the Straight, HO HO FEEL was shifted in away from the heels of PACKING GENIUS to obtain clear running after being held up for a run behind that horse rounding the Home Turn.
Passing the 300 Metres, EASY HEDGE was steadied away from the heels of HOLMES LEGEND when unable to obtain clear running between that horse and HAPPY CONTENDER.
For some distance approaching and passing the 100 Metres, EASY HEDGE was badly held up for clear running after again being disappointed for running between HOLMES LEGEND and HAPPY CONTENDER.
S de Sousa (ALLCASH) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that for some distance approaching and passing the 100 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in, causing SHARP SAILOR to be badly crowded for room, to be checked and lose the running to which it was rightfully entitled.  S de Sousa was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 14 December 2016 and to expire on Sunday, 18 December 2016 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, S de Sousa was fined $22,500.
A veterinary inspection of FULL GLORY and ABLE DEED immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
EASY HEDGE, REDWOOD BABY and ALLCASH were sent for sampling.

DESMIOS was slow to begin.
GREEN CARD began awkwardly.
Shortly after the start, THE SHOW shifted out and bumped CONVINCIBLE.
From wide barriers, CAPE THE FAITH and GOLDEN SLEEP were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
For some distance passing the 1300 Metres, CAPE THE FAITH got its head up when proving difficult to settle.  CAPE THE FAITH then continued to prove difficult to settle for some distance and passing the 800 Metres got its head on the side and shifted out towards the heels of WINNERâS WAY.
Near the 800 Metres, DRAGON DANCE was left racing wide and without cover and subsequently finished tailed out.  As this was the second occasion from two race starts in Hong Kong that DRAGON DANCE had finished tailed out, it will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a series of barrier trials and be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.
Passing the 400 Metres, THE SHOW was bumped and taken wider by DRAGON MASTER which shifted out to obtain clear running.  After this, DRAGON MASTER lay out under pressure and proved difficult to ride.
AEROSPEED lay out rounding the Home Turn and when under pressure in the Straight, resulting in its rider having to stop riding and straighten on occasions and consequently was not able to be fully tested.
Passing the 300 Metres, GOLDEN SLEEP shifted out abruptly away from the heels of SMART BOY.
Passing the 150 Metres, THE SHOW was awkwardly placed close to the heels of DRAGON MASTER which shifted out.
Approaching the 100 Metres, DESMIOS was shifted in away from the heels of AEROSPEED.
After the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on AEROSPEED at the request of Trainer P OâSullivan.  The Veterinary Surgeon reported that this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, AEROSPEED will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of DRAGON MASTER, CAPE THE FAITH and DRAGON DANCE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
VOLITATION and WINNERâS WAY were sent for sampling.

At declaration time, J Moreira was declared as the rider of both MILITARY ATTACK and HELENE HAPPY STAR.  It was established that J Moreira had a firm commitment to ride MILITARY ATTACK.  As such, the Stewards permitted H Bowman to be substituted as the rider of HELENE HAPPY STAR.  For this declaration error, Trainer J Moore was fined $2,000.
ANTICIPATION and MILITARY ATTACK bumped at the start.
HELENE SUPER STAR began awkwardly.
Near the 1800 Metres, EASTERN EXPRESS was awkwardly placed close to the heels of BLAZING SPEED.
Near the 650 Metres, DESIGNS ON ROME and FLAME HERO were taken wider by EASTERN EXPRESS which shifted out to improve.
Approaching the 100 Metres, M Chadwick (HELENE SUPER STAR) dropped his whip.
In the Straight, EASTERN EXPRESS lay in under pressure and proved difficult to ride.
After the race, J Moreira dismounted from MILITARY ATTACK.  MILITARY ATTACK was examined by the Veterinary Officer who reported the horse was lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, MILITARY ATTACK will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned, K Teetan (DESIGNS ON ROME) stated that todayâs race was run at a good tempo in the early stages and he was hoping that the pace would ease after the 1000 Metres as it did at its last start when DESIGNS ON ROME was successful.  He said however that, unlike at its most recent start, the tempo of the race did not slacken and DESIGNS ON ROME, despite having quickened nicely after the 800 Metres, was not able to improve into the race as well as he had anticipated it would.  He added, in his opinion, DESIGNS ON ROME did not weaken badly in the Straight, rather the horse finished off the race one-paced which he attributed to the tempo of todayâs race.  A veterinary inspection of DESIGNS ON ROME immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
DESIGNS ON ROME, SECRET WEAPON and FLAME HERO were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE BOCHK WEALTH MANAGEMENT JOCKEY CLUB MILE
incident_report:
GIANT TREASURE began only fairly.
Passing the 1400 Metres, CONTENTMENT was steadied away from the heels of BEAUTY FLAME (S de Sousa) which shifted in when not quite clear.  S de Sousa was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is properly clear when shifting ground.
Rounding the Home Turn, PACKING PINS raced tight outside BEAUTY ONLY which shifted out to obtain clear running.
Near the 250 Metres, HELENE PARAGON, which had been held up when unable to obtain clear running, improved into a tight run between ROMANTIC TOUCH and CONTENTMENT (B Prebble) which shifted in after being corrected.  When HELENE PARAGON continued to improve into the run, CONTENTMENT shifted out marginally, resulting in HELENE PARAGON being crowded for room between CONTENTMENT and ROMANTIC TOUCH.  When crowded, HELENE PARAGON got its head on the side and lay in across the heels of CONTENTMENT, resulting in HELENE PARAGON being badly checked.  GUN PIT, which was racing to the inside of HELENE PARAGON, was hampered in consequence.  B Prebble was advised that whilst there were a number of circumstances associated with this incident, primarily his shift out on CONTENTMENT being marginal and also that he stopped riding CONTENTMENT and straightened his mount, nonetheless he must ensure that he makes every endeavor to prevent his mounts from shifting ground.
Throughout the race, PACKING PINS travelled wide and without cover.
After the race, it was noted that CONTENTMENT had sustained a small cut to the outside of the left hind cannon.
When questioned regarding the performance of GIANT TREASURE, C Soumillon stated that GIANT TREASURE was unsettled in the Parade Ring and then did not proceed to the Start as strongly as it normally does.  He said GIANT TREASURE travelled only fairly in the race and when placed under pressure in the Straight did not respond to his riding and was disappointing.  A veterinary inspection of GIANT TREASURE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SUN JEWELLERY, BEAUTY ONLY and ROMANTIC TOUCH were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE BOCHK WEALTH MANAGEMENT JOCKEY CLUB SPRINT
incident_report:
DUNDONNELL and LUCKY YEAR were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 700 Metres, DUNDONNELL and LUCKY YEAR raced tight.  In this incident, DUNDONNELL turned its head to the left and attempted to savage LUCKY YEAR.  This was brought to the attention of Mr C Fownes, the trainer of DUNDONNELL.
Approaching the 600 Metres, STRATHMORE was bumped and taken wider by AEROVELOCITY which shifted out.
Near the 350 Metres, AEROVELOCITY got its head on the side and shifted out.
NOT LISTENINâTOME and LUCKY BUBBLES were sent for sampling.

WHITE MAGIC was withdrawn on 19.11.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter SUPREME PROFIT (D Whyte).  Before being allowed to race again, WHITE MAGIC will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
PAKISTAN STAR was crowded for room on jumping between SERGEANT TITANIUM and JOLLY CONVERGENCE which shifted in abruptly despite the efforts of its rider.
HAPPILABABY began only fairly and then was bumped by SUPREME PROFIT which shifted in.
From a wide barrier, HIGH AND MIGHTY was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Also from the outside barriers, MERION and GONNA RUN were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
S Clipperton (HIT THE BID) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 1350 Metres he angled his mount in when not clear of SANTA FE SUN, resulting in that horse being taken in onto HAPPILABABY, causing both HAPPILABABY and SANTA FE SUN to be badly crowded for room.  S Clipperton was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 11 December 2016 and to expire on Thursday, 15 December 2016 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards took into account S Clippertonâs good race riding record.
Making the turn after the 900 Metres, HIT THE BID, which was travelling keenly, was awkwardly placed close to the heels of SIMPLY INVINCIBLE.
At the entrance to the Straight, SANTA FE SUN raced in restricted room between MERION and PAKISTAN STAR (M Chadwick) which shifted out.  M Chadwick was severely reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is sufficiently clear when shifting ground in similar circumstances.
For some distance after the 300 Metres, PAKISTAN STAR shifted out under pressure, resulting in M Chadwick changing his whip into his left hand near the 150 Metres.  PAKISTAN STAR then drifted in under pressure over the concluding stages.
Over the concluding stages, SANTA FE SUN was unable to properly establish clear running when attempting to improve into a tight run between MERION and PACKING LLAREGYB and consequently was not able to be fully tested.
For the majority of the race, PACKING LLAREGYB travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of SANTA FE SUN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of HAPPILABABY immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm.  Before being allowed to race again, HAPPILABABY will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SIMPLY INVINCIBLE and PAKISTAN STAR were sent for sampling.

GIDDY GIDDY began only fairly.
JIMSON THE FAMOUS began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped DOUBLE MASTER.  JIMSON THE FAMOUS then lost ground when crowded for room between DOUBLE MASTER which shifted in when unbalanced and GREAT SPEED which shifted out marginally.  In this incident, GREAT SPEED also became unbalanced when bumped on the hindquarters by JIMSON THE FAMOUS.
NOBLE BUDDIES and EVERYDAY LETTUCE bumped on jumping,  EVERYDAY LETTUCE then shifted out and crowded KING OF SMARTS onto KIM GLORY.
From wide barriers, SHOWING CHARACTER and ORIENTAL FANTASIA were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 800 Metres, EVERYDAY LETTUCE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of KIM GLORY (O Murphy) which shifted in when not properly clear.  O Murphy was advised to ensure that he is sufficiently clear when shifting ground.
Approaching the first turn near the 600 Metres, ALL TOGETHER shifted out to prevent the crowding to KIM GLORY to its inside.  This resulted in GIDDY GIDDY being inconvenienced.
Passing the 600 Metres, NOBLE BUDDIES got its head up when being checked away from the heels of EVERYDAY LETTUCE.
Rounding the Home Turn, ORIENTAL FANTASIA was awkwardly placed close to the heels of ALL TOGETHER.
Near the 150 Metres, ORIENTAL FANTASIA was steadied as it was attempting to improve to the outside of EVERYDAY LETTUCE which shifted out and away from GREAT SPEED after initially being brushed by that horse.
Approaching and passing the 100 Metres, IDYLLIC WIND had difficulty obtaining clear running between DOUBLE MASTER and KIM GLORY.
Over the concluding stages, IDYLLIC WIND and KIM GLORY raced tight.
Throughout the race, GIDDY GIDDY and ALL TOGETHER travelled wide and without cover.	
IDYLLIC WIND, DOUBLE MASTER and GREAT SPEED were sent for sampling.

SOCCER BRAVE was slow to begin.
LUCKY SEBRING began awkwardly.
Despite being ridden along in the early stages, WIN CHANCE failed to muster speed.
For some distance approaching the winning post on the first occasion, TELEPHATIA proved very difficult to settle and got its head up repeatedly when being steadied at the rear of the field.
Near the 1500 Metres, SOCCER BRAVE got its head up on a number of occasions when being steadied in an attempt to obtain cover.  After the 1300 Metres, SOCCER BRAVE was left racing wide and without cover.
Approaching the 1300 Metres, VIVACIOUS WINNER got its head on the side and lay out towards the heels of CHOICE EXCHEQUER when proving difficult to settle.
SWEET BEAN shifted out marginally away from the heels of VIVACIOUS WINNER making the turn near the 950 Metres.  WIN CHANCE, which was following SWEET BEAN, attempted to improve of its own accord into tight running inside SWEET BEAN and had to be checked away from the heels of that horse approaching the 900 Metres.
Passing the 900 Metres, TELEPHATIA was shifted out away from behind SOCCER BRAVE and allowed to improve its position outside the lead.
Passing the 300 Metres, SWEET BEAN raced tight inside ISLAND FLYER which hung in.
A veterinary inspection of SOCCER BRAVE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SWEET BEAN, CHOICE EXCHEQUER and TELEPHATIA were sent for sampling.

FUN MANAGER shifted in at the start and bumped RUGBY DIAMOND.  FUN MANAGER, which was being steadied to obtain cover, was then crowded for room a short distance after the start between INVISIBLE which shifted in away from ST YAZIN and RUGBY DIAMOND which shifted out after being bumped by NATURAL TEAM.
SUNNY ORIENT began awkwardly and shortly after the start was bumped by ARM RUNDA which shifted out.
From wide barriers, INVISIBLE and SKY TREASURE were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the 1000 Metres, INVISIBLE was steadied away from the heels of DASHING DART.  When DASHING DART was ridden along after the 800 Metres, INVISIBLE was shifted out from behind that horse, however, was unable to improve between DASHING DART and SKY TREASURE.
GRACYDAD travelled wide and without cover until after the 600 Metres.
DIAMOND MYSTERIOUS (Apprentice K K Chiong) had some difficulty obtaining clear running passing the 100 Metres and near the 75 Metres was directed to the outside of ARM RUNDA to obtain a run.  When DIAMOND MYSTERIOUS shifted out, SUNNY ORIENT was shifted out away from the heels of that horse.  Apprentice Chiong was advised to exercise more care in similar circumstances.
Over the concluding stages, BUDDY BUNDY was steadied when crowded for room inside GRACYDAD (J Moreira) which shifted in.  J Moreira was reprimanded and advised to exercise more care than he did on this occasion.
Close to the finishing line, INVISIBLE and DASHING DART raced tight.
When questioned, H W Lai stated that he had been instructed to lead on NATURAL TEAM if possible.  He said in accordance with his instructions, he rode his mount hard for some distance in the early stages and on entering the Back Straight had hoped to be able to cross BUDDY BUNDY to his inside.  He said however that that horse, after the 900 Metres, continued to maintain its position and he had two glances to his inside to ascertain whether the rider of that horse would steady to allow NATURAL TEAM to cross.  He said when it became apparent that BUDDY BUNDY would remain racing to his inside, he had two further looks to his inside to see whether it was possible to obtain a position behind BUDDY BUNDY as the tempo of the race was, in his opinion, good at this time.  He added when he established that it was not possible for him to steady sufficiently to obtain a position behind BUDDY BUNDY, he then remained racing to the outside of that horse.  H W Lai was advised that his explanation would be reported, however, he was warned against the practice of looking around unnecessarily in races.
A veterinary inspection of NATURAL TEAM and RUGBY DIAMOND immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GRACYDAD, ST YAZIN and ARM RUNDA were sent for sampling.

ROCKET LET WIN began only fairly.
GOOD MATE and ROBUST MOMENTUM were checked on jumping when crowded for room between SHINING CHAMPION and POWER DRAGON which shifted out abruptly.  After this, SHINING CHAMPION along with WILD BOY were shifted across behind runners from wide barriers.
THE CHAMP began awkwardly and shortly after the start shifted out towards the heels of RICHCITY FORTUNE.
Passing the 1100 Metres, TRIUMPHANT LIGHT got its head up on a number of occasions when being steadied to obtain cover.  THE CHAMP, which was racing inside TRIUMPHANT LIGHT and behind RICHCITY FORTUNE, also commenced to prove very difficult to settle and after the 1050 Metres got its head on the side, shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of TRIUMPHANT LIGHT which became unbalanced.  THE CHAMP then lay out and for some distance after the 1000 Metres was awkwardly placed close to the heels of SIGHT SEEING, resulting in THE CHAMP losing ground near the 950 Metres.  SPEEDY ACHIEVER, which was following THE CHAMP, was inconvenienced in consequence.
For some distance after the 1000 Metres, GLENEALY PRIZE and ROBUST MOMENTUM raced tight.
Approaching the 800 Metres, GLENEALY PRIZE was awkwardly placed outside ROBUST MOMENTUM and close to the heels of POWER DRAGON which travelled wide and without cover throughout the race.
Approaching the 100 Metres, ROCKET LET WIN was shifted in away from the heels of TRIUMPHANT LIGHT.
When questioned regarding the performance of TRIUMPHANT LIGHT, D Whyte stated that the horse, which was wearing blinkers for the first time tonight, commenced to over-race making the first turn, primarily as a result of THE CHAMP shifting out to his inside.  He said he was satisfied with the manner in which TRIUMPHANT LIGHT relaxed after entering the Back Straight and he was able to follow the eventual winner SIGHT SEEING throughout the race.  He added rounding the Home Turn and in the early part of the Straight SIGHT SEEING quickened, however, TRIUMPHANT LIGHT was not able to sprint with that horse and then, despite being placed under heavy pressure in the Straight, was disappointing in the manner in which it weakened, particularly over the final 100 Metres.  A veterinary inspection of TRIUMPHANT LIGHT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of POWER DRAGON immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SIGHT SEEING and SPEEDY ACHIEVER were sent for sampling.

ACCLAIMED LIGHT was checked on jumping when crowded for room between MIDNITE PROMISE and SUPER CLAN which shifted out abruptly.
VICTORY FOLLOW ME shifted in at the start and bumped the hindquarters of HELEN'S CHOICE.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, MIDNITE PROMISE shifted in and bumped SIR JOHN.
Approaching the 1300 Metres, SUPER CLAN momentarily raced tight inside ACCLAIMED LIGHT which was awkwardly placed inside the heels of MEGATRON.  VICTORY FOLLOW ME, which was being shifted in to obtain a position behind SUPER CLAN, was checked out away from the heels of that horse, resulting in SPINNING DANCER being hampered.
Approaching the 1100 Metres, MIDNITE PROMISE got its head up and raced ungenerously for a short distance.
In the early and middle stages, HELEN'S CHOICE travelled very wide and passing the 800 Metres was allowed to stride forward to race outside the lead.
Making the turn passing the 600 Metres, MEGATRON got its head on the side and shifted in towards the heels of BEST EFFORT.
Near the 100 Metres, SUPER CLAN was severely checked when disappointed for running between WINNINGLI and MIDNITE PROMISE which got its head on the side and shifted in away from ACCLAIMED LIGHT which shifted in marginally to improve inside the heels of HELEN'S CHOICE which was giving ground.  As the Stewards were satisfied that SUPER CLAN had not established running between WINNINGLI and MIDNITE PROMISE and further that there was no carelessness exhibited by the riders of either MIDNITE PROMISE or ACCLAIMED LIGHT, no further action was taken.
Passing the 100 Metres, DIGITAL PIONEER momentarily raced tight inside SIR JOHN which, when giving ground abruptly, drifted in before being straightened.
SUPER SPRINTER and SPINNING DANCER were sent for sampling.

MISSION POSSIBLE was withdrawn on 22.11.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter GRACE HEART (S Clipperton).  Before being allowed to race again, MISSION POSSIBLE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
GRACE HEART shifted out on jumping and bumped CHARITY KINGDOM.
BEAUTY PRINCE was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
From the outside barriers, RED MARVEL and MAMBO ROCK were also steadied shortly after the start and shifted across behind runners.
O Murphy (INDUSTRIALIST WAY) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 950 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of CHARITY KINGDOM, causing that horse to be crowded for room, to clip the heels of INDUSTRIALIST WAY and be checked.  O Murphy was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 7 December 2016 and to expire on Monday, 12 December 2016 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards took into account Jockey Murphy's good race riding record.
After the 600 Metres, CALIFORNIA JOY got its head on the side and lay out.  INDUSTRIALIST WAY improved its position to be racing tight inside the heels of CALIFORNIA JOY and outside BEAUTY PRINCE.  INDUSTRIALIST WAY then raced in restricted room between BEAUTY PRINCE and CALIFORNIA JOY for some distance.
At the entrance to the Straight, CHARITY KINGDOM was steadied when disappointed for running between INDUSTRIALIST WAY and NITRO EXPRESS which shifted in.
Passing the 300 Metres, RED MARVEL was shifted in away from the heels of GRACE HEART which, when commencing to give ground, momentarily raced tight inside WINSTON'S LAD which shifted in.
Passing the 150 Metres, RED MARVEL and ENORMOUS HONOUR improved into tight running inside BEAUTY PRINCE (Z Purton).  Then passing the 100 Metres, BEAUTY PRINCE shifted in marginally, resulting in RED MARVEL shifting in and bumping ENORMOUS HONOUR, causing that horse to become badly unbalanced and shift out, resulting in RED MARVEL being crowded for room between BEAUTY PRINCE and ENORMOUS HONOUR passing the 50 Metres.  As the Stewards found that BEAUTY PRINCE had only shifted in marginally under pressure, Z Purton was reprimanded and advised that in similar circumstances he must make every endeavour to ensure that his fellow riders have comfortable racing room. 
Passing the 100 Metres, INDUSTRIALIST WAY was shifted in away from the heels of WINSTON'S LAD to continue improving.
A veterinary inspection of TRENDY WIN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of TRENDY WIN, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, TRENDY WIN will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
NITRO EXPRESS, ENORMOUS HONOUR and BEAUTY PRINCE were sent for sampling.

On arrival at the Start, the tongue tie fitted to SUNNY WIN was replaced.
CHOICE TREASURE, which was fractious in the barriers, began only fairly and then shortly after the start was crowded for room between BIG BANG BONG and SUPER FLUKE which shifted in and brushed BIG BANG BONG.
Shortly after the start, SUPER FLUKE was steadied after being crowded for room inside HAPPY SPIRIT (N Callan) which shifted in before being directed out abruptly to relieve the tightening to SUPER FLUKE.  N Callan was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he makes every endeavour to prevent his mounts from shifting ground.
From the outside barriers, ACTUARIAT and TRAVEL DATUK were shifted across behind runners shortly after the start.
After the 1000 Metres, SUNNY WIN was left racing wide and without cover and after the 800 Metres was allowed to improve its position to race outside the lead near the 600 Metres.
Approaching the 900 Metres, BIG BANG BONG commenced to prove difficult to settle and was checked away from the heels of SILLY BUDDIES.
HAPPY SPIRIT lost its left hind plate after the 400 Metres.
At the entrance to the Straight, SILLY BUDDIES shifted out and bumped BIG BANG BONG.
T H So (SUNNY WIN) was cautioned against raising his whip arm above the height of his shoulder.
A veterinary inspection of BIG BANG BONG and CHOICE TREASURE  immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
THE SYLPH, SUNNY WIN and HAPPY SPIRIT were sent for sampling.

GIANT STARS was withdrawn on 22.11.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter SUPER TURBO (B Prebble).  Before being allowed to race again, GIANT STARS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
On arrival at the Start, K Teetan expressed concern regarding the action of SILVER SPUN.  SILVER SPUN was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said that he could detect no obvious abnormalities with the horse.  After consulting with Jockey Teetan, SILVER SPUN was found to be suitable to race.
FABULOUS NOVEMBER, which was restless in the stalls, was slow to begin and then from a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners.
Also from wide barriers, CROWN AVENUE and SUPER TURBO were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Near the 1050 Metres, HARRIER JET was severely checked and VICTORY MACHINE (S Clipperton) checked when crowded for room between MR RIGHT which became badly unbalanced after being bumped heavily on the hindquarters by VICTORY MACHINE and BEAUTY CONNECTION which was racing tight to the inside of WONDERFUL JOURNEY which got its head on the side and lay in away from THOR THE GREATEST which at this time was also shifting in.  RIGHT CALL, which was following, was hampered in consequence.  Whilst this incident was one of some significance, the Stewards were not able to attribute blame to any one rider who, in their opinion, had ridden carelessly in this incident, rather the Stewards found that the incident occurred as a result of BEAUTY CONNECTION, WONDERFUL JOURNEY and THOR THE GREATEST all being inclined to lay in when racing very wide making the first turn.  As such, no action was taken other than to issue a general warning to all riders to ensure that they make every endeavour to prevent their mounts from shifting ground, particularly in circumstances which existed in this incident.  After the race, S Clipperton stated that after being badly crowded, VICTORY MACHINE appeared to lose confidence and would not stretch out fully.
After the 1000 Metres, C Schofieldâs saddle shifted forward, resulting in him having little control over BEAUTY CONNECTION.  BEAUTY CONNECTION was then eased out of the race after the 600 Metres.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, FABULOUS NOVEMBER hung out across the heels of SUPER TURBO and was severely checked.
Approaching the 200 Metres, OUR HERO shifted out and bumped HARRIER JET which became unbalanced.  OUR HERO and HARRIER JET then raced tight for some distance.
A veterinary inspection of CROWN AVENUE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
A veterinary inspection of SILVER SPUN immediately following the race revealed that horse to be lame in its right hind leg and also to be a âroarerâ which had previously been reported.  The performance of SILVER SPUN, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, SILVER SPUN will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of MR RIGHT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of BEAUTY CONNECTION immediately following the race found that horse to have sustained an abrasion above the left hock and a minor wound to the inside of the right hind fetlock.
VICTORY MACHINE, SUPER TURBO and WONDERFUL JOURNEY were sent for sampling.

GOOD CHOICE AHEAD was slow to begin.
CHEERS CONQUEROR began only fairly and then was crowded for room between ENCHANTED FEELING and DARING HEART which shifted out.
FANTASTIC FABIO and SPICY KAKA bumped at the start.
From a wide barrier, AMBITIOUS HEART was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Near the 1150 Metres and again approaching the 1000 Metres, SPICY KAKA shifted in and bumped GOOD CHOICE AHEAD.
FANTASTIC FABIO lost its left front plate near the 1100 Metres.
In the early stages, SOUTHERN EXPRESS was left racing very wide and approaching the 900 Metres was allowed to stride forward and race outside the lead near the 700 Metres.
After the 700 Metres, LOOK ERAS was left racing wide and without cover.
Approaching the 500 Metres, AMBITIOUS HEART shifted out away from the heels of GENEROUS HEART.
Rounding the Home Turn, GENEROUS HEART was shifted out away from the heels of DARING HEART which shifted out after being awkwardly placed behind LOOK ERAS which was obliged to shift out away from the heels of BEAR CHUM.
H W Lai (DARING HEART) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that passing the 400 Metres he permitted his mount to shift out when riding along and when not clear of GENEROUS HEART, causing that horse to be checked, to clip the heels of DARING HEART and blunder.  When GENEROUS HEART was checked, that horse shifted in abruptly, resulting in ENCHANTED FEELING being severely hampered when taken in across the heels of SPICY KAKA.  H W Lai was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 7 December 2016 and to expire on Monday, 12 December 2016 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, H W Lai was fined $10,000.
Approaching the 350 Metres, DARING HEART was hampered when shifted out away from the heels of LOOK ERAS (N Rawiller) which shifted out under pressure.  N Rawiller was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he makes every endeavour to keep his mounts on a straight course.
T H So (FANTASTIC FABIO) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that approaching and passing the 300 Metres he permitted his mount to shift out when not clear of LUCKY KINGDOM, resulting in that horse being severely hampered and taken out across the running of SOUTHERN EXPRESS which was severely checked near the 250 Metres when crowded for room inside BEAR CHUM.  CHEER WIN, which had been unable to obtain clear running in the early part of the Straight, was checked in consequence and shifted out, resulting in SPICY KAKA becoming unbalanced and shifting out and in turn bumping DARING HEART.  T H So was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Saturday, 17 December 2016 and to expire on Friday, 23 December 2016 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards took into account T H Soâs good race riding record.
Passing the 50 Metres, GOOD CHOICE AHEAD was steadied when disappointed for running inside CARRY TO WIN (O Murphy) which shifted in under pressure.  O Murphy was advised to ensure that he makes every endeavour to keep his mounts straight.  GOOD CHOICE AHEAD was then held up in the run to the finishing line and consequently was not able to be tested.
After the race, it was reported that LUCKY KINGDOM had sustained an abrasion to the left forearm.
A veterinary inspection of CHEER WIN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of SOUTHERN EXPRESS immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, SOUTHERN EXPRESS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SOUTHERN EXPRESS, LOOK ERAS and AMBITIOUS HEART were sent for sampling.

HARBOUR NOVA was withdrawn on 26.11.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter UNIQUE JOYOUS (D Lane).  Before being allowed to race again, HARBOUR NOVA will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
FRIENDS OF NANJING began very awkwardly and then blundered on jumping, resulting in the horse losing ground.  From a wide barrier, FRIENDS OF NANJING was then shifted across behind runners.
Also from a wide barrier, MAGNETISM was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
When BEAT THE CLOCK was shifted across behind EASY TOUCH passing the 1300 Metres, EASY TOUCH became unbalanced.  After the race, it was reported that EASY TOUCH had sustained a small wound to the outside of the left hind cannon.
Near the 650 Metres, GOLDEN SLEEP was bumped by ROMAN IMPERO which shifted out when travelling keenly and awkwardly placed behind PEOPLE'S KNIGHT.
Approaching the 350 Metres, LUCKY DOUBLE EIGHT was shifted to the outside of EASY TOUCH to obtain clear running after initially being disappointed for a run inside that horse.
Passing the 200 Metres, ROMAN IMPERO was shifted out away from the heels of GOLDEN SLEEP.
Throughout the race, BEAT THE CLOCK travelled wide and without cover.
PEOPLE'S KNIGHT and BEAT THE CLOCK were sent for sampling.

SUPER TURBO was withdrawn on 24.11.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (inappetence) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter SPEEDY LONGWAH.  Before being allowed to race again, SUPER TURBO will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
PIKACHU began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped the hindquarters of FLYING MOOCHI, resulting in PIKACHU losing ground.
TURF SPRINT shifted out at the start and bumped MIGHTY MAVERICK.
Apprentice H T Mo (FLYING MOOCHI) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that approaching the 1100 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of SUPER LEADER, causing that horse to be taken in onto TURF SPRINT which resulted in that horse losing its rightful running and being checked.  Apprentice Mo was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Saturday, 17 December 2016 and to expire on Wednesday, 28 December 2016 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  During this period, there are two racemeetings scheduled to be conducted at Sha Tin Racecourse.
After the 900 Metres, MIDNIGHT RATTLER was left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 800 Metres, UNIVERSAL UNION was checked away from the heels of ULTIMATE GLORY.
SUPER LEADER lost its left front plate after the 700 Metres.
For some distance passing the 350 Metres, JOLLY JOLLY attempted to improve inside the heels of FLYING MOOCHI where there was insufficient room.  Then near the 300 Metres, JOLLY JOLLY was steadied after being disappointed for running inside FLYING MOOCHI.
FLYING MOOCHI lost its right hind plate at the 300 Metres.
Passing the 200 Metres, SICHUAN DAR was shifted to the outside of BABA MAMA to improve.  SICHUAN DAR then momentarily raced in restricted room between ULTIMATE GLORY and BABA MAMA.
A veterinary inspection of SPEEDY LONGWAH immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm and an endoscopic examination also showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, SPEEDY LONGWAH will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination..
A veterinary inspection of JOLLY JOLLY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
BABA MAMA, JOLLY BANNER and MIGHTY MAVERICK were sent for sampling.

race_name: CHEVALIER COLD STORAGE AND LOGISTICS HANDICAP
incident_report:
FANTASTICLIFE began only fairly and then lost ground shortly after the start when crowded for room between GAINFULJET and EVERYONE'S CHOICE which shifted in.
AMAZING ALWAYS and BERNARD'S CHOICE bumped at the start.
From wide barriers, MAGIC STAR, TREASURE AND GOLD and LUCKY PLACE were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
At the entrance to the Straight, DYNAMIC VOYAGE was bumped by NO LAUGHING MATTER which was taken out by EVERYONE'S CHOICE.
WINGOLD was held up for clear running until passing the 300 Metres.
After the 300 Metres, AMAZING ALWAYS had some difficulty obtaining clear running..
Passing the 150 Metres, Apprentice H T Mo (FREE NOVEMBER) dropped his whip.
Near the 125 Metres, BERNARD'S CHOICE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of FREE NOVEMBER.
Approaching the 100 Metres, NO LAUGHING MATTER lay in and bumped EVERYONE'S CHOICE.
Throughout the race, KING WINSA travelled wide and without cover.
After the race, it was noted that WINGOLD had sustained a cut to the outside of the right hind heel.
FANTASTICLIFE, KING WINSA and WINGOLD were sent for sampling.

ART OF SUCCESS began awkwardly and then shortly after the start lost ground when crowded for room between EXPONENTS and YOU KNOW WHO which shifted out.
STARLIGHT and STAR OF PATCH bumped on jumping.
ROYALE ELEGANCE was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Approaching the 300 Metres, STAR OF PATCH shifted out and bumped STARLIGHT.  STAR OF PATCH got its head on the side and again shifted out approaching the 200 Metres, resulting in STARLIGHT being steadied away from the heels of that horse.  In this incident, STARLIGHT shifted out, resulting in GLORY HORSIE being taken out onto KWAICHUNG BROTHERS which became unbalanced when racing in restricted room inside EXPONENTS.  STAR OF PATCH then hung out for the remainder of the race and proved difficult to ride.
At the 100 Metres, YOU KNOW WHO was steadied when momentarily crowded for room between GOLDEN GLORY which shifted in away from the heels of FOX SUNTER and EXPONENTS which shifted to the outside of BUMBLE BABY to continue improving.
Over the concluding stages, GOLDEN GLORY and EXPONENTS raced tight.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that FOX SUNTER had bled from both nostrils.
A veterinary inspection of STARLIGHT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ACE KING and PREMIERE were sent for sampling.

LITTLE GIANT was withdrawn on 25.11.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left front foot) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter HAPPY AGILITY.  Before being allowed to race again, LITTLE GIANT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
HAPPY AGILITY began only fairly,
PROUD SKY began only fairly and shortly after the start shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of HONEST HORSE which became unbalanced.
From the outside barrier, FAVOURITISM was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the 1100 Metres, PROUD SKY was steadied away from the heels of HONEST HORSE.
In the early stages, PROUD SKY raced greenly and making the first turn approaching the 900 Metres shifted out and raced tight inside FAVOURITISM. 
Making the first turn approaching the 900 Metres, HAPPY AGILITY shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of CONVINCIBLE.  HAPPY AGILITY then raced tight inside CONVINCIBLE and near the 800 Metres was awkwardly placed close to the heels of TOP SCORE.
Near the 650 Metres, PAKISTAN BABY commenced to travel keenly and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of CONVINCIBLE.
Near the 300 Metres, Apprentice H T Mo (GO BABY GO) dropped his whip.  As this was the second occasion during this racemeeting that Apprentice Mo had dropped his whip, he was spoken to regarding this matter.
Near the 100 Metres, FAVOURITISM was steadied away from the heels of TOP SCORE (N Rawiller) which shifted in.  N Rawiller was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he makes every endeavour to keep his mounts on a straight course.  N Rawiller was further advised that this was the second occasion during this race meeting that he was spoken to regarding allowing his mounts to shift ground under pressure.
A veterinary inspection of HONEST HORSE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HAPPY AGILITY and CONVINCIBLE were sent for sampling.

The Veterinary Officer advised that on arrival at the barriers RESPECT was found to have a significant amount of mucopus at both nostrils.  Acting on the advice from the Veterinary Officer that RESPECT was not suitable to race, that horse was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  Before being allowed to race again, RESPECT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
DON WONGCHOY was slow to begin.
HASTILY FEET began only fairly.
CONFUCIUS SPIRIT and FINE ROCK bumped at the start.
Shortly after the start, GENEROUS BOBO was brushed by PERPETUAL JOYANCE which shifted out.
Near the 900 Metres, HASTILY FEET was steadied away from the heels of FURIOUS PEGASUS which shifted out away from FINE ROCK after being bumped by that horse.
Passing the 900 Metres, SUPER EURO STAR raced tight inside HEARTS KEEPER (S Clipperton) which shifted in.  S Clipperton was advised to exercise more care when shifting ground.
Near the 800 Metres, FINE ROCK shifted out marginally and bumped FURIOUS PEGASUS which became unbalanced and in turn shifted out, causing SUPER EURO STAR to be crowded for room inside GENEROUS BOBO.
Passing the 400 Metres, HURRICANE KID and PERPETUAL JOYANCE raced tight.  For a short distance after this, HURRICANE KID was awkwardly placed behind PROMPT EXPRESS.
Throughout the race, GENEROUS BOBO travelled wide and without cover.
Z Purton stated that when under pressure in the early part of the Straight FINE ROCK, which had lost its right front plate near the 1100 Metres, commenced to lay out.  He said as FINE ROCK was well beaten at this time, he did not continue to ride the horse out over the final 100 Metres.  Z Purton was advised that, wherever circumstances, permit, to ride his mounts out at least hands and heels to the end of the race.  A veterinary inspection of FINE ROCK immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HURRICANE KID, PERPETUAL JOYANCE and HASTILY FEET were sent for sampling.

JOY PLUS FUN was checked and BLAZING PASS hampered when crowded for room between KINGâS MAN which shifted out after beginning awkwardly and bumping BLAZING PASS and FANCY MUSIC which was taken in by WONDERFUL CHASER.
From the outside barriers, FANCY MUSIC, WONDERFUL CHASER and UNIQUE AWESOME were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the 1300 Metres, BLAZING PASS shifted out abruptly away from the heels of WONDERFUL CHASER after being ridden along, resulting in UNIQUE AWESOME being bumped and taken wider.  After this, UNIQUE AWESOME was left racing and without cover.
Passing the 800 Metres, GO BEAUTY GO was awkwardly placed close to the heels of SMILING CHARM.
Passing the 350 Metres, KINGâS MAN got its head on the side and shifted in away from CASH COURIER.  Then passing the 300 Metres, KINGâS MAN was awkwardly placed close to the heels of DRAGON WARRIOR which, when commencing to give ground, shifted out under pressure.  KINGâS MAN then raced tight outside DRAGON WARRIOR passing the 200 Metres.
Passing the 150 Metres, DRAGON WARRIOR was momentarily eased away from the heels of GO BEAUTY GO (Z Purton) which shifted out under pressure.  Z Purton was advised to exercise more care.
In the Straight, SPEEDY WALLY raced with its head on the side, hung in and proved difficult to ride.
After the race, K Teetan (BLAZING PASS) reported that todayâs race was run at a different tempo to that at its last start when the horse was successful.  He said because of the circumstances of todayâs race, in particular the tempo of the race over the final 800 Metres, BLAZING PASS was not able to make ground and was disappointing.  A veterinary inspection of BLAZING PASS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
UNICRON JEWELLERY and GO BEAUTY GO were sent for sampling.

J Moreira (HARBOUR MASTER) was fined $2,000 for failing to initially weigh out with a girth.
PRECISION KING was crowded for room on jumping between SUPER LIFELINE and FRIENDS OF KA YING which shifted out.  In this incident, SUPER LIFELINE became unbalanced after being bumped by PRECISION KING.
ALL YOU WISH and PHOTON WILLIE were steadied across behind runners in the early stages.
After initially being hard ridden in the early stages in an attempt to obtain a forward position, CIRCUIT HASSLER was shifted across behind runners to find cover after the 1400 Metres, however, was unable to obtain cover and raced wide throughout.
Approaching the 1300 Metres, CIRCUIT HASSLER was bumped by CIRCUIT LAND which was taken out by SERGEANT TITANIUM.
Approaching the 1100 Metres, PHOTON WILLIE got its head up when travelling keenly.
Approaching the 800 Metres, RENAISSANCE ART was awkwardly placed close to the heels of CIRCUIT HASSLER.
ALL YOU WISH was held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Approaching the 300 Metres, GONNA RUN, which was inclined to lay in, was awkwardly placed close to the heels of PRECISION KING (Apprentice H T Mo) which was giving ground.  Apprentice Mo was severely reprimanded regarding the amount of whip he used on PRECISION KING when that horse was clearly out of contention.
When questioned, Z Purton (RENAISSANCE ART) stated that in the early part of the Straight he rode his mount along to improve between PHOTON WILLIE and CIRCUIT HASSLER when racing behind CIRCUIT LAND.  He said CIRCUIT LAND sprinted well in the early part of the Straight and he was not able to quicken with that horse.  He said PHOTON WILLIE, which was racing to the inside of RENAISSANCE ART, also quickened at this time and established a margin over RENAISSANCE ART.  He said PHOTON WILLIE then commenced to lay out under pressure and he felt that had he have continued to ride RENAISSANCE ART along, PHOTON WILLIE may shift out and as RENAISSANCE ART was not travelling well at this time, he elected to steady his mount and directed it to the inside of PHOTON WILLIE into clear running.  Z Purton was advised that his explanation would be reported, however, he must ride his mounts to ensure that they are able to maintain their positions where circumstances permit.  A veterinary inspection of RENAISSANCE ART immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
A veterinary inspection of PRECISION KING immediately following the race found that horse to have bled from both nostrils.
GONNA RUN and SOLAR HEI HEI were sent for sampling.

ARIZONA BLIZZARD's arrival at the Start was delayed due to that horse shifting its right front plate which required the horse to be replated.
APACHE SPIRIT began awkwardly and lost ground.
ARIZONA BLIZZARD was slow to begin.
Shortly after the start, STAR OF YAN OI was crowded for room between GRAND HARBOUR and STARTLING POWER, both of which shifted ground.
Making the turn approaching the 700 Metres, SKY HERO momentarily raced in restricted room inside HARBOUR ALERT which got its head on the side and shifted in despite the efforts of its rider.
At the 400 Metres, STARTLING POWER was awkwardly placed close to the heels of GOLDEN SUN which was taken out by ARIZONA BLIZZARD.
At the entrance to the Straight, STAR OF YAN OI was awkwardly placed outside the heels of DILLY.  Then close to the finishing line, STAR OF YAN OI raced tight inside ARIZONA BLIZZARD.  SKY HERO, which was racing to the inside of STAR OF YAN OI, was momentarily inconvenienced in this incident.
ARIZONA BLIZZARD hung in over the final 200 Metres and proved very difficult to ride.
Throughout the race, GOLDEN SUN travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of HARBOUR ALERT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of LORD SINCLAIR immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer".
ARIZONA BLIZZARD and STAR OF YAN OI were sent for sampling.

At declaration time, O Murphy was declared as the rider of both CLUB LIFE and KA YING KID.  It was established that O Murphy had a firm commitment to ride CLUB LIFE.  As such, the Stewards permitted C Schofield to be substituted as the rider of KA YING KID.  For this declaration error, O Murphy was fined $2,000.
PREMIUM CHAMPION, Standby Declared Starter, was withdrawn on 26.11.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right hind).  Before being allowed to race again, PREMIUM CHAMPION will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
UNICORN was checked and RUBY COAST hampered when crowded for room on jumping between MARVEL HERO and AVELLINO which got its head on the side and shifted in away from PRAWN BABA despite the efforts of its rider.
Z Purton (PRAWN BABA) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that passing the 1450 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of AVELLINO, resulting in that horse being taken in across the rightful running of MARVEL HERO which was checked and lost its rightful running.  Z Purton was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 14 December 2016 and to expire on Sunday, 18 December 2016 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards took into account Z Purton's good race riding record.
Near the 1350 Metres, C Y Ho (BEAUTY LOVE) adjusted his left foot in the stirrup iron.
After the 900 Metres, STARSHIP was left racing wide and without cover.
MARVEL HERO had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight.  After this, MARVEL HERO was unable to obtain clear running until passing the 150 Metres.
Passing the 300 Metres, THUNDER STOMP was shifted in away from the heels of KA YING KID.
KA YING KID was held up for clear running from passing the 300 Metres until near the 150 Metres at which time the horse was steadied after being disappointed for running between UNIQUE HAPPIEST and BEAUTY LOVE which was giving ground.  Then over the concluding stages, KA YING KID was awkwardly placed close to the heels of STARSHIP and consequently was not able to be properly tested.
Near the 250 Metres, MARVEL HERO was steadied when crowded for room between STARSHIP and WHOOP WHOOP which was taken out by UNIQUE HAPPIEST which, after initially being directed out by BEAUTY LOVE (C Y Ho), then shifted out away from that horse.  C Y Ho was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he straightens his mounts sooner than he did on this occasion.
After the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on AVELLINO at the request of Trainer P O'Sullivan.  The Veterinary Surgeon reported that this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, AVELLINO will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of UNICORN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
UNICORN, HAPPY PLACE and PRAWN BABA were sent for sampling.

YOURTHEWONFORME began only fairly.
LEAN JOURNEY and ALL TIMES LUCKY bumped at the start.
INTELLECTUAL GLIDE shifted out at the start and bumped SNOWHOOVES.  After this, from a wide barrier, INTELLECTUAL GLIDE was shifted across behind runners.
SHOWING CHARACTER began slowly and from a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners.
Also from the outside barrier, TELECOM BOOM was shifted across behind runners.
Shortly after the start, MANHATTAN STRIKER was momentarily eased away from the heels of GLORY SUNSHINE.
Approaching the 1100 Metres, INTELLECTUAL GLIDE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of MANHATTAN STRIKER when being shifted behind that horse.
Passing the 1000 Metres, LEAN JOURNEY got its head up when travelling keenly and awkwardly placed behind SMART GAIN.
Near the 450 Metres, INTELLECTUAL GLIDE and MANHATTAN STRIKER raced tight.
Passing the 50 Metres, TELECOM BOOM was shifted in away from the heels of YOURTHEWONFORME to continue improving.
Close to the finishing line, TELECOM BOOM got its head on the side and shifted in towards SMART GAIN.
Passing the winning post, SHOWING CHARACTER jumped a shadow on the track.
For the majority of the race, NO LAUGHING MATTER travelled wide and without cover and in the Straight hung in and proved difficult to ride.
A veterinary inspection of NO LAUGHING MATTER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of GLORY SUNSHINE immediately following the race found that horse to be mildly lame in its left front leg.
SNOWHOOVES, SHOWING CHARACTER and FOREVER FUN were sent for sampling.
<1/12/2016  Additional Veterinary Report>GLORY SUNSHINE, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time it was mildly lame in its left front leg.  GLORY SUNSHINE was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer W Y So this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, GLORY SUNSHINE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

YEUNG SING was withdrawn on 29.11.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter MASTER PINNACLE (K Teetan).  Before being allowed to race again, YEUNG SING will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
C Schofield was warned for having used the whip on GOLDEN PARTNERS on two occasions behind the barriers.  C Schofield was placed on notice that should he offend in the future, consideration will be given to penalizing him.
GOLDEN PARTNERS was slow to begin.
VIVACIOUS WINNER began awkwardly and shortly after the start was shifted across behind runners.
From the outside barrier, ISLAND FLYER began awkwardly and shifted out abruptly shortly after the start.  ISLAND FLYER then raced wide and without cover until passing the 1000 Metres.
Shortly after the start, DOUBLE POINT was tightened for room between MY BLESSING and MASTER PINNACLE which shifted out.
Approaching the winning post on the first occasion, VIVACIOUS WINNER, after being ridden along, was steadied when racing tight to the inside of SAFARI MAGIC which was racing tight inside MASSIVE POWER (S Clipperton) which shifted in.  Then passing the winning post on the first occasion VIVACIOUS WINNER got its head up when travelling keenly and overreacted to being steadied.  S Clipperton was advised that whilst the racing manners of VIVACIOUS WINNER had contributed to this incident, nonetheless he must ensure that he leaves comfortable racing room for runners to his inside in similar circumstances.
Passing the 1000 Metres, LAUGHING LORD was left racing wide and without cover.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, ROCK THE TREE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of MASSIVE POWER.
Passing the 450 Metres, VIVACIOUS WINNER was checked when attempting to improve between ROCK THE TREE and SAFARI MAGIC where there was insufficient room.
Passing the 300 Metres, VIVACIOUS WINNER was shifted to the inside of MASTER PINNACLE.  Then passing the 200 Metres, VIVACIOUS WINNER was directed out away from the heels of NOVEL START to continue improving and in doing so shifted out and bumped MASTER PINNACLE.
Near the 250 Metres, MY BLESSING became unbalanced when crowded for room between ISLAND FLYER and DOUBLE POINT (J Moreira) which shifted in before being directed out by its rider.  J Moreira was reprimanded and advised that he would be expected to react quicker to his mounts shifting ground than he did on this occasion.
Approaching and passing the 100 Metres, NOVEL START was awkwardly placed behind ISLAND FLYER which was giving ground.
A veterinary inspection of LAUGHING LORD, ISLAND FLYER and FRIENDS FOREVER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
DOUBLE POINT and ROCK THE TREE were sent for sampling.

O Murphy (YO-YO DA) was fined the sum of $2,000 for presenting himself to be weighed out with the incorrect saddle cloth number.
EASTERN PROWESS began only fairly.
From the outside barrier, NEVER BETTER was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Making the turn near the 1000 Metres, EMPEROR VICTORY got its head up and shifted out towards the heels of SUPERIOR BOY (O Doleuze) which was shifting in when not properly clear.  Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the racing manners of EMPEROR VICTORY had contributed to this incident, O Doleuze was nonetheless reprimanded and told to ensure that he is sufficiently clear when shifting ground in similar circumstances.
Making the turn near the 950 Metres, NEVER BETTER was awkwardly placed close to the heels of WINNING BOY.
Near the 450 Metres, EMPEROR VICTORY was steadied when crowded for room between HAPPY FIERY DRAGON and MASTER STEED (N Rawiller) which shifted out marginally around the heels of SUPERIOR BOY.  N Rawiller was advised that whilst the amount of ground he shifted was not great, nonetheless it had the effect of placing EMPEROR VICTORY in restricted room.  N Rawiller was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is sufficiently clear when shifting ground in similar circumstances.
Over the final 50 Metres, NEVER BETTER raced tight outside WINNING BOY.
Throughout the race, HAPPY FIERY DRAGON travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, D Whyte state that, from barrier 11, it had been intended for SMILING GLORY to be ridden in a forward position.  He said as the start was effected SMILING GLORY lifted its front feet off the ground and was then awkwardly placed inside the heels of NEVER BETTER which began well from the outside barrier.  He said due to the manner in which SMILING GLORY began and its position in the field shortly after the start, he did not believe it was in the horse's best interests to be ridden along and therefore he shifted SMILING GLORY across behind runners in the early stages.  He added he was able to follow NEVER BETTER in the run, however, SMILING GLORY did not show the same turn of foot rounding the Home Turn and then was disappointing in the manner in which it failed to close off the race.
After the race, it was reported that MASTER STEED had sustained an overreach wound to the outside of the right front heel.
A veterinary inspection of DOUBLE DOUBLE and RED SUN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performances of DOUBLE DOUBLE and RED SUN, which finished tailed out, were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, DOUBLE DOUBLE and RED SUN will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
MASTER STEED, YO-YO DA and WINNING BOY were sent for sampling.

After being placed in the barriers, DAZZLE reared and momentarily got its front feet on top of the front gates, resulting in S Clipperton being dislodged.  DAZZLE was removed from the barriers and examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
Just prior to the start being effected, MASSIVE MILLENNIUM became fractious.  Then as the start was effected, MASSIVE MILLENNIUM bounded in the air and consequently was slow to begin.
NOTED PERFORMER began only fairly.
JUMBO HAPPINESS and MR PICASSO bumped at the start.  JUMBO HAPPINESS was then hampered when crowded for room between SPARKLING TALENT and MR PICASSO which shifted out.
GREAT SKY and DAZZLE bumped at the start.
DARING FIT began awkwardly and then became unbalanced after being bumped by LOVE CHUNGHWA.
From a wide barrier, LOVE CHUNGHWA was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 1000 Metres, MASSIVE MILLENNIUM commenced to prove very difficult to settle, got its head on the side and shifted out, resulting in JUMBO HAPPINESS being crowded for room inside NOTED PERFORMER.
After the 800 Metres, DAZZLE was left racing wide and without cover and in the Straight gave ground.  The performance of DAZZLE, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, DAZZLE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Near the 50 Metres, DARING FIT shifted in and away from GRACEFUL KINGDOM which got its head on the side and lay in, resulting in DARING FIT being checked away from the heels of HASTA LA VISTA which shifted out marginally.  LOVE CHUNGHWA, which was following DARING FIT, was awkwardly placed outside the heels of that horse in consequence.
When questioned, Mr J Moore, the trainer of SEA JADE, stated that after being successful when leading over 1200 Metres, SEA JADE was then disappointing when dropped back in distance to 1000 Metres the following start.  He said at its next start SEA JADE, back over 1200 Metres, had again disappointed him in the manner in which it finished off the race over the final 200 Metres after leading.  He said as the horse did not finish off the race on that occasion, at its most recent start he instructed T Berry to ride SEA JADE more patiently in the hope that it would then be able to close off.  He said on this occasion it was hoped that SEA JADE would be able to obtain a position behind the leader, however, due to the makeup of the field, SEA JADE was obliged to race in a three wide position with cover.  He added as SEA JADE did not run up to expectations at its last start, he elected to bring the horse to Happy Valley for the first time to see if it would be able to close off better with a shorter straight.  He said when SEA JADE drew well and with there being no other established leaders in the race, he instructed Z Purton to lead on SEA JADE tonight given that the tempo of the race was not likely to be strong.  Mr Moore was advised that his explanation would be reported, however, he must ensure that, wherever circumstances permit, horses trained by him are ridden in a consistent manner.
A veterinary inspection of MR PICASSO, LOVE CHUNGHWA and DAZZLE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SEA JADE and HASTA LA VISTA were sent for sampling.
<1/12/2016  Additional Veterinary Report>DAZZLE, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  DAZZLE was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer A T Millard this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right front leg.  As previously advised, DAZZLE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.

Whilst in the saddling stalls, EXCELLENCE had its left hind plate readjusted.  EXCELLENCE was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
ASHKIYR was slow to begin.
GREAT JOY began only fairly and then shortly after the start was awkwardly placed close to the heels of EXPECTATOR which shifted out.
From wide barriers, EXCELLENCE, SUPER FORM and CASA MASTER were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Also from the outside barrier, KING BOUNTIFUL was shifted across behind runners in the early stages, however, passing the winning post on the first occasion was left racing wide and without cover and then was obliged to continue racing wide and without cover for the remainder of the race.  KING BOUNTIFUL consequently gave ground in the Straight.
Near the 1600 Metres, BEST REWARD and EXPECTATOR bumped due to both horses shifting ground.
After the 1600 Metres, ASHKIYR was steadied when racing tight inside GOOD CHOICE which was racing tight inside GREAT JOY which shifted in briefly.  EXCELLENCE, which was racing to the outside of ASHKIYR, was awkwardly placed close to the heels of that horse when ASHKIYR shifted out across the heels of GOOD CHOICE.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, CASA MASTER got its head up when racing tight between ASHKIYR and KING BOUNTIFUL.
Approaching the 600 Metres, GREAT JOY raced in restricted room between KING BOUNTIFUL and BEST REWARD which shifted out to improve.
GOOD CHOICE was not able to obtain clear running from near the 300 Metres until passing the 150 Metres.
A veterinary inspection of ASHKIYR and KING BOUNTIFUL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of CASA MASTER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
PEARL FURU and GREAT JOY were sent for sampling.

From the outside barriers, BALAY BALAY, EL SHERIF and GOLDEN DEER were all steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
When being steadied to obtain cover passing the 1100 Metres, SHARP HUNTER got its head up on a number of occasions when proving difficult to settle.
Passing the 1000 Metres, EL SHERIF was awkwardly placed close to the heels of TRAVEL SUCCESSOR.
Approaching the 600 Metres, WAYFOONG VINNIE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of CHARITY GLORY which got its head on the side and lay in when awkwardly placed inside the heels of ALL GREAT FRIENDS.  FLYING FORCE, which was following WAYFOONG VINNIE, got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of that horse in consequence.
Near the 250 Metres, WAYFOONG VINNIE was bumped by IRON BOY which shifted to the outside of CHARITY GLORY to obtain clear running.
From approaching the 200 Metres until passing the 150 Metres, LUCKY DAY raced in restricted room when improving into tight running between EXTREMELY FUN and ALL GREAT FRIENDS.
After the race, it was noted that CHARITY GLORY had sustained a laceration to the outside of the right hind cannon and multiple abrasions to the back of the right hock.
WAYFOONG VINNIE, LUCKY DAY and CHARITY GLORY were sent for sampling.

SHARP SAILOR began awkwardly.
From wide barriers, VANILLA and ROYAL PARTNER were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Despite being ridden along in the early stages, BEAUTY FLARE failed to muster speed and for the majority of the race travelled wide and without cover.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, INVENTOR was crowded for room inside SILVERFIELD (K Teetan) which got its head on the side and shifted in away from CLOUD NINE.  K Teetan was advised to ensure that he makes every endeavour to prevent his mounts from shifting ground in similar circumstances.
Passing the 1300 Metres, CLOUD NINE shifted in and bumped SILVERFIELD which became unbalanced.
Passing the 400 Metres, LOTUS STRIKES BACK was awkwardly placed close to the heels of INVENTOR.
Also passing the 400 Metres, SHARP SAILOR raced in restricted room between POSITIVE FORCE and INVENTOR.  Then rounding the Home Turn, SHARP SAILOR and INVENTOR raced very tight as SHARP SAILOR continued to improve into tight running between that horse and POSITIVE FORCE which commenced to give ground.
A veterinary inspection of INVENTOR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was not able to be scoped due to being fractious.
DINOZZO and VICTORY BOYS were sent for sampling.

CELESTIAL NOVA began awkwardly.
BRING IT ON began only fairly.
From wide barriers, STAR SUPERIOR and PENANG HALL were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Making the first turn, FANTASTIC FEELING was steadied away from the heels of WONDERFUL JOURNEY which shifted in.
Making the turn after the 1000 Metres, CELESTIAL NOVA raced tight between ALWAYS WIN and VICTORY MARVEL.  COURAGEOUS BROTHER, which was following CELESTIAL NOVA, was shifted out away from that horse, resulting in STAR SUPERIOR being inconvenienced.
Approaching the 750 Metres, FANTASTIC FEELING was awkwardly placed close to the heels of I'M A WITNESS.
When questioned, N Rawiller stated that with the blinkers removed tonight, he had been asked to ride HAPPY BAO BEI in about 5th or 6th position with cover if possible.  He said shortly after the start it appeared as though VICTORY MARVEL may be able to obtain a position close to the rail as a gap had opened up to that horse's inside and he positioned HAPPY BAO BEI to take advantage should that eventuate.  He said to ensure that HAPPY BAO BEI was in a position to take advantage of this opportunity, he gave the horse a slap down the shoulder with the whip passing the 1100 Metres.  He said however that VICTORY MARVEL was left racing in a three wide position approaching the 1000 Metres when CELESTIAL NOVA improved to the inside of that horse.  He added passing the 1000 Metres VICTORY MARVEL was able to shift in to a position one horse off the rail which left HAPPY BAO BEI racing in a three wide position without cover outside CELESTIAL NOVA.  He said CELESTIAL NOVA shifted out after the 700 Metres, resulting in HAPPY BAO BEI being taken wider and consequently HAPPY BAO BEI was ridden further back in the field than had been intended and without cover throughout.  Mr Y S Tsui, the trainer of HAPPY BAO BEI, will be interviewed prior to the Sha Tin racemeeting on Sunday, 4 December 2016 regarding the instructions that were issued to Jockey Rawiller for tonight's race.
A veterinary inspection of WHO ELSE BUT YOU immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
WHO ELSE BUT YOU, WONDERFUL JOURNEY and I'M A WITNESS were sent for sampling.

RUGBY DIAMOND and NO LAUGHING MATTER bumped on jumping.
POWER DRAGON and STARRY STARLIES began only fairly.
SOCCER BRAVE began awkwardly.
When being steadied to obtain cover approaching and passing the 800 Metres, BORN DRAGON proved very difficult to settle and got its head up for some distance.
Making the turn near the 700 Metres, FLYING CAPTAIN was left racing wide and without cover.
Near the 75 Metres, ATOMIC BLAST was shifted out away from the heels of POWER DRAGON and then passing the 50 Metres was directed out away from the heels of BORN DRAGON to obtain clear running.
A veterinary inspection of FLYING CAPTAIN and PARENTAL SPIRIT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SLEDGE HAMMER and GIDDY GIDDY were sent for sampling.

At declaration time, K C Leung was declared as the rider of both CHARITY JOY and TRIUMPHANT JEWEL.  It was established that K C Leung had a firm commitment to ride CHARITY JOY.  As such, the Stewards permitted D Lane to be substituted as the rider of TRIUMPHANT JEWEL.  For this declaration error, Trainer D Cruz was fined $2,000.
From a wide barrier, ARCHIPPUS was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
MALMSTEEN was crowded for room on jumping between MR GENUINE and TEAM FORTUNE which shifted in.
MR GENUINE was unable to obtain clear running until passing the 200 Metres.
Throughout the race, WAH MAY FRIEND and DRAGON GENERAL travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of MALMSTEEN, S Clipperton stated that the horse, which was having its first race start on the All Weather surface today, was never comfortable and he had to ride it aggressively for a considerable distance in the early stages in an endeavour to obtain a forward position.  He said MALMSTEEN did not travel well at any stage of the race and appeared to him not to be suited by the pressure of the race with other runners being similarly ridden to obtain forward positions.  He said having this in mind, he recommended to connections that they give consideration to returning the horse to a turf race and perhaps stepping it up in distance to allow MALMSTEEN the opportunity to obtain a forward position without having to be hard pressed to do so.  A veterinary inspection of MALMSTEEN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
When questioned, D Whyte stated that it had been intended for TEAM FORTUNE to be ridden behind the speed if possible.  He said however he had to ride his mount in the early stages to prevent being crossed by FLYING TOURBILLON and after doing this he allowed TEAM FORTUNE to cross MALMSTEEN to its inside as that horse was being hard ridden and did not appear to be showing the same early speed as TEAM FORTUNE.
A veterinary inspection of HAPPY METEOR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ARCHIPPUS and TEAM FORTUNE were sent for sampling.

On arrival at the barriers, K Teetan (DRAGON GLORY) reported that the horse coughed on one occasion on the way to the Start.  DRAGON GLORY was examined by the Veterinary Officer who, after the necessary consultations with the jockey, found that horse to be suitable to race.
After being loaded into the barriers, PLENTY OF SPEED became very fractious and got its head down.  PLENTY OF SPEED was removed from the barriers and examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
COMMANDANT shifted in at the start and hampered MIGHTY WONGCHOY.
MIZZEN GREY shifted out on jumping and bumped SWEET BEAN.  After this, MIZZEN GREY failed to muster speed despite being ridden along.
HAPPY FRIENDSHIP began awkwardly.
From wide barriers, RAINBOW GOLD, GORGEOUS AGAIN and KERKENI were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
A short distance after passing the winning post on the first occasion, DRAGON HARMONY jumped a shadow on the track.
Passing the 1400 Metres, TELEPHATIA got its head up on a number of occasions when awkwardly placed inside the heels of MIGHTY WONGCHOY.
Throughout the race, PLENTY OF SPEED travelled wide and without cover and in the Straight gave ground.  The performance of PLENTY OF SPEED, which, together with RAINBOW GOLD, finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, PLENTY OF SPEED and RAINBOW GOLD will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Also throughout the race, DRAGON GLORY travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of HAPPY FRIENDSHIP, KERKENI, RAINBOW GOLD and PLENTY OF SPEED immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
DRAGON HARMONY and FAITHFUL BOY were sent for sampling.
<5/12/2016  Additional Veterinary Report>HAPPY FRIENDSHIP, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.
