HAPPY FRIENDSHIP was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer D E Ferraris this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, HAPPY FRIENDSHIP will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

WIN FOR CHARITY was slow to begin.
GOBI STORM began awkwardly.
From the outside barriers, FORTUNE BROTHERS and CURLING LUXURY were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the 1100 Metres, AUTOPAY and GOOD COMPANION bumped.
After being steadied to allow HOT HOT PEPPER to cross, AUTOPAY commenced to prove difficult to settle and got its head on the side when awkwardly placed close to the heels of that horse for some distance approaching the 900 Metres.
After the 900 Metres, WIN FOR CHARITY was awkwardly placed close to the heels of MONEY BOY.
Near the 650 Metres, AUTOPAY again got its head on the side when being steadied away from the heels of FOREVER ACCURATE.  After this, AUTOPAY continued to race awkwardly with its head on the side.
Passing the 600 Metres, GOBI STORM was awkwardly placed behind SWEET HOME.
Approaching and passing the 300 Metres, GOOD COMPANION was steadied when crowded for room between MONEY BOY and SWEET HOME, both of which shifted ground.
When questioned, C Schofield stated that he had been asked to ride HAPPY SOUND in a positon with cover from a wide barrier to ensure that it would see out the 1200 Metres of todayâs race.  He said after beginning well he steadied HAPPY SOUND and after travelling a short distance he was racing wide with a considerable number of horses inside HAPPY SOUND.  He said he felt that at this stage to have cleared runners to his inside, he would have had to ride HAPPY SOUND along which may have resulted in the horse racing in a forward position without cover.  He said he therefore elected to steady HAPPY SOUND in an attempt to obtain cover, however, due to the circumstances of the race HAPPY SOUND was left racing wide and without cover for the majority of the race.  Mr A Lee, the trainer of HAPPY SOUND, said he had hoped that HAPPY SOUND would be ridden in about 5th or 6th position with cover as he believed that over 1200 Metres the horseâs best chance to see out the distance would be by not having to be ridden forward out of the barriers to overcome the wide barrier.  He said whilst he had not instructed C Schofield on where HAPPY SOUND should be placed in the field other than asking him to obtain cover, he was surprised that HAPPY SOUND got as far back in the field as it did, however, he accepted C Schofieldâs reasons for this.  Mr Lee was advised to ensure that he provides his riders with clear instructions on the manner in which he wants horses ridden whilst also providing them with the opportunity to show judgement and initiative when those instructions are not able to be executed.  A veterinary inspection of HAPPY SOUND immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MONEY BOY, FOREVER ACCURATE and HOT HOT PEPPER were sent for sampling.

HIT A HOME RUN began awkwardly and then, from the outside barrier, was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Shortly after the start, HURRICANE KID shifted in and bumped HEARTS KEEPER.
KINGSTON JUMBO (K C Leung) was crowded for room a short distance after the start between GAME OF FUN and IâM THE WON FOR U.  In this incident, GAME OF FUN became unbalanced after being bumped on the hindquarters by KINGSTON JUMBO.  When questioned, K C Leung stated that, despite being hard ridden for some distance in the early stages, KINGSTON JUMBO did not stretch out and did not feel comfortable in its action.  He said the horse continued to give ground despite being ridden along and as he felt that all was not well with the horse, he eased it down making the first turn near the 700 Metres.  A veterinary inspection of KINGSTON JUMBO immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.  The performance of KINGSTON JUMBO, which also finished tailed out at its previous start, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, KINGSTON JUMBO will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a series of consecutive barrier trials and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Despite being aggressively ridden for a considerable distance in the early stages, TRILLION TREASURE failed to muster speed.
Passing the 50 Metres, GLOBE TROTTER, which was commencing to give ground, was momentarily crowded for room between HURRICANE KID which shifted in marginally and INVISIBLE which shifted out when closing off the race strongly.
Throughout the race, GLOBE TROTTER travelled wide and without cover.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that GAME OF FUN was lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, GAME OF FUN will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of TRILLION TREASURE, GLOBE TROTTER and IâM THE WON FOR U immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ELITE SPIRIT and FLYING GODSPELL were sent for sampling.

LUCKY SEVEN STARS began awkwardly and was slow to begin.
MR POTENTIAL began only fairly.
Shortly after the start, GOLD DRAGON was momentarily crowded for room between LANSBURY and MASTER GOLD.  A short distance after this, from wide barriers, LANSBURY and GOLD DRAGON were steadied and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, LUCKY SEVEN STARS became unbalanced when crowded for room inside EXPEDITE which, despite the efforts of its rider, got its head on the side and shifted in marginally.
Also making the first turn after passing the winning post on the first occasion, WEALTHY FORTUNE was bumped by SURE PEACE which was racing tight inside IMPERIAL CONCORDE which got its head on the side and shifted in away from MR POTENTIAL.
After the 1400 Metres, LANSBURY was awkwardly placed close to the heels of SURE PEACE which got its head up when being steadied away from the heels of EXPEDITE.
Throughout the race, MASTER GOLD travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, N Rawiller stated that after wanting to lay in during the early part of the race, EXPEDITE commenced to race ungenerously and hang out approaching the 1200 Metres.  He said he consequently changed the whip over to the left hand to straighten the horse and after this EXPEDITE raced more tractably.
MASTER GOLD and FLYING MACHINE were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE PENINSULA GOLDEN JUBILEE CHALLENGE CUP (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
Just prior to the start being effected, SMART DECLARATION became fractious and then as the start was effected was slow to begin.
BEAUTY MASTER began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of HELLA HEDGE which became unbalanced, shifted out and bumped CALL ME AWESOME.
Passing the 700 Metres, CALL ME AWESOME momentarily raced in restricted room between APPLAUSE and BEAUTY MASTER which got its head on the side and lay out before being corrected by its rider.
Passing the 200 Metres, FORTUNE BO BO shifted in abruptly away from BEAUTY MASTER after being brushed by that horse, resulting in LUCKY WAN FENG, which was racing tight outside HELLA HEDGE, clipping the heels of FORTUNE BO BO and blundering badly.  THE SUPREME and SMART DECLARATION, which were following LUCKY WAN FENG, were hampered in consequence.  As the Stewards were satisfied that this incident was attributable to FORTUNE BO BO shifting in abruptly and that J Moreira had reacted to the shift as quickly as possible, in the circumstances no further action was taken.  A veterinary inspection of LUCKY WAN FENG immediately following the race found that horse to have sustained a cut to the inside of the left front fetlock.  Before being allowed to race again, LUCKY WAN FENG will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Approaching the 100 Metres, SUPER WISE raced tight outside CALL ME AWESOME.
When questioned regarding his riding of AMAZING RACE particularly over the final 400 Metres, C Y Ho stated that, from an inside barrier, he shifted the horse across behind runners in the early stages to obtain a position closer to the outside rail.  He said passing the 600 Metres he had hoped that runs would become available in front of AMAZING RACE, however, when those runs did not eventuate, he commenced to direct AMAZING RACE back to the inside approaching the 300 Metres.  He added he was held up for a short distance after the 300 Metres behind GALLANT ROCK and outside KING MORTAR and had to wait for KING MORTAR to improve its position so that he could continue to shift in.  He said when KING MORTAR did go forward of AMAZING RACE approaching the 200 Metres, he was able to immediately direct his mount to the inside of that horse.  He said over the final 200 Metres AMAZING RACE hung out and proved difficult to ride and for this reason he had to straighten the horse on a number of occasions.  C Y Ho was advised that his explanation would be reported, however, he must make every endeavour to ensure that his horses are able to obtain clear running at the earliest available opportunity.
A veterinary inspection of SUPER WISE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
D B PIN and FAIRY TWINS were sent for sampling.

When being saddled, it was noted that SOARING WYVERN was lame in its right front leg.  Acting on the advice from the Veterinary Officer that SOARING WYVERN was not suitable to race, that horse was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  Before being allowed to race again, SOARING WYVERN will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
GREAT TREASURE was slow to begin and then shortly after the start was shifted across behind runners from a wide barrier.
From the outside barrier, HARMONY PARTNERS was shifted across behind runners shortly after the start.
Making the turn approaching the 900 Metres, WISKY commenced to travel strongly and shifted in when being steadied away from the heels of GOOD METHOD, resulting in HOUSE OF LUCK being badly crowded for room.
WORLD RECORD travelled wide and without cover until near the 600 Metres.
Rounding the Home Turn, WISKY was steadied when disappointed for running inside VICTORY DUKE.
GOOD METHOD had some difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight and then for some distance approaching and passing the 300  Metres raced tight, along with WISKY, between VICTORY DUKE and DASHING SUPER, both of which shifted marginal ground.  Then approaching the 250 Metres, WISKY and GOOD METHOD were both steadied when unable to maintain their positions between VICTORY DUKE and DASHING SUPER which was giving ground.
A veterinary inspection of VICTORY DUKE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
WORLD RECORD and CARE FREE PRINCE were sent for sampling.

Whilst in the saddling stalls, GO GO WIN had its right front plate refitted.  GO GO WIN was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
NORTHERN FALLS shifted out at the start and bumped TURIN PEARL which began awkwardly.
WUSHU CHAMPION jumped awkwardly and was shifted across behind runners shortly after the start.
Also from a wide barrier, SEE ME NOW was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
For some distance after the 900 Metres, SEE ME NOW travelled keenly and passing the 800 Metres was checked away from the heels of WUSHU CHAMPION.
N Rawiller (NORTHERN FALLS) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that passing the 800 Metres he failed to make sufficient endeavour to prevent that horse from shifting in, resulting in MAJESTIC ANTHEM being crowded for room and consequently being checked and losing the running to which it was rightfully entitled.  N Rawiller was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Thursday, 12 January 2017 and to expire on Thursday, 19 January 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, N Rawiller was fined $60,000.
For the majority of the race, TURIN PEARL travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, K C Leung stated that he had been instructed to ride DEJA VU in a positive manner towards the lead.  He said whilst he was riding his mount along in the early stages there were a considerable number of horses which were drawn more favourably than DEJA VU which were also being ridden along and he believed that he would have had to make too much use of DEJA VU to obtain the position as instructed.  He said therefore passing the winning post on the first occasion he elected to steady DEJA VU and shift that horse across behind runners to obtain a position closer to the rail.  A veterinary inspection of DEJA VU immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
After the race, the Veterinary Surgeon reported that MAJESTIC ANTHEM had a sore left eye.
A veterinary inspection of NORTHERN FALLS immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  The performance of NORTHERN FALLS, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, NORTHERN FALLS will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of TURIN PEARL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PEOPLEâS KNIGHT and RED MARVEL were sent for sampling.

KINGSFIELD began only fairly and then shortly after the start was crowded for room between VICTORY DAY which shifted in and HARD BALL GET which was taken out by A BEAUTIFUL.
SEASONS BLOOM was checked and CALIFORNIA WHIP crowded for room shortly after the start between EXCEL ONESELF and DIAMOND KING which shifted out abruptly.
Shortly after the start, SUNNY WAY was awkwardly placed outside the heels of JADE FORTUNE.
Approaching the 1100 Metres, DIAMOND KING was momentarily crowded for room inside CALIFORNIA WHIP which was taken in by A BEAUTIFUL.
For some distance approaching and passing the 1100 Metres, VICTORY DAY shifted ground on a number of occasions and got its head up when proving very difficult to settle.
Passing the 1100 Metres, HARD BALL GET proved difficult to settle and got its head up for some distance.
Passing the 300 Metres, HAPPY JOURNEY was shifted in away from the heels of EXCEL ONESELF.
When questioned regarding the performance of KINGSFIELD, D Whyte stated that after becoming badly unbalanced at the start, KINGSFIELD was able to take up a forward position without having to do too much work.  He said whereas KINGSFIELD had previously been proving difficult to settle in the lead, today the horse travelled comfortably in a position just behind the lead.  He said rounding the Home Turn KINGSFIELD got its head on the side and lay out and he was unable to prevent EXCEL ONESELF from shifting out away from the heels of A BEAUTIFUL.  He added KINGSFIELD came under pressure in the early part of the Straight and then, despite being ridden out, gave no response and did not appear to stretch out comfortably.  He said KINGSFIELD gave ground quickly after the 200 Metres and was disappointing.  A veterinary inspection of KINGSFIELD immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Before being allowed to race again, KINGSFIELD will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After the race, O Murphy (FASHION MAESTRO) reported that his mount was making an abnormal breathing noise during the race.  A veterinary inspection of FASHION MAESTRO immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of FASHION MAESTRO, which also finished tailed out at its previous start, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, FASHION MAESTRO will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a series of consecutive barrier trials and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SEASONS BLOOM and CALIFORNIA WHIP were sent for sampling.

ALWAYS WONGCHOY was slow to begin.
Shortly after the start, RACINGFORPLEASURE and KINGâS STEED raced tight inside DUTCH WINDMILL which shifted in.
Also shortly after the start, PERFECT TIMING and MY BLESSING bumped.
From wide barriers, FANTASTICLIFE and SPICY DOUBLE were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, KINGâS STEED got its head up when proving very difficult to settle and awkwardly placed close to the heels of LE PEGASE.  KINGâS STEED continued to prove difficult to settle and approaching the 1300 Metres shifted out when being checked away from the heels of LE PEGASE.  RACINGFORPLEASURE and SPICY DOUBLE, which were following KINGâS STEED, were hampered in consequence.
For a considerable distance passing the 1300 Metres, due to the tempo of the race slackening, PERFECT TIMING commenced to prove difficult to settle and shifted out abruptly away from the heels of ALWAYS WONGCHOY.  PERFECT TIMING then got its head up and shifted out further before being shifted back in to join the main body of the field passing the 1200 Metres.
For some distance after the 1200 Metres, SPICY DOUBLE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of ALWAYS WONGCHOY.
After the 1200 Metres, MY BLESSING was left racing wide and without cover.
After the 1100 Metres, RACINGFORPLEASURE travelled keenly and was awkwardly placed behind KINGâS STEED.
Approaching and passing the 900 Metres, KINGâS STEED again over-raced and was checked away from the heels of LE PEGASE.  RACINGFORPLEASURE, which was following, was inconvenienced in consequence.  Near the 850 Metres, KINGâS STEED then shifted out away from the heels of LE PEGASE, resulting in ALWAYS WONGCHOY being badly crowded for room inside MY BLESSING.  RACINGFORPLEASURE and SPICY DOUBLE were again hampered in consequence and FANTASTICLIFE taken wider.
Passing the 200 Metres, VIVACIOUS WINNER was steadied away from the heels of DUTCH WINDMILL (O Doleuze) which shifted in when not properly clear.  O Doleuze was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he endeavours to keep his mounts straight.
After the race, it was reported that BLISS CARTEL had sustained wounds to its right hock.
A veterinary inspection of SPICY DOUBLE immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, SPICY DOUBLE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SPICY DOUBLE, DUTCH WINDMILL and BLISS CARTEL were sent for sampling.

On arrival at the Start, C Y Ho expressed concern regarding the action of ALMABABY.  ALMABABY was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said that, after the necessary consultations, the horse was suitable to race.
ALMABABY was slow to begin.

When questioned, M Barzalona stated that he had been instructed to lead on PACKING DRAGON as the horse had performed best when ridden in this manner.  He said passing the winning post on the first occasion he shifted across to race outside KING GENKI and he expected that horse would be steadied which would allow PACKING DRAGON the opportunity to take up the running.  He said he afforded the rider of KING GENKI the opportunity to steady his mount for some distance after the 1300 Metres as he did not want to ride PACKING DRAGON along at this time to clear that horse as the tempo of the race was already quick.  He said he steadied PACKING DRAGON after the 1200 Metres as he was aware the race was being run at a quick tempo, however, he was unable to steady his mount sufficiently to be able to shift across to race behind KING GENKI.  He added he therefore was obliged to continue to race outside KING GENKI and he attempted to steady the tempo as much as possible to allow PACKING DRAGON the opportunity to finish off the race.
When questioned, M Chadwick stated that he had been instructed to take up a forward position on KING GENKI and if the rider of PACKING DRAGON, the anticipated leader of the race, was intent on leading, he should steady KING GENKI and take a trailing position behind that horse.  He said on the way to the barriers KING GENKI proved difficult to restrain and it was not until he was able to follow another horse that KING GENKI proved more manageable.  He said passing the winning post on the first occasion he shifted in to race on the rail and he attempted to steady KING GENKI in order to allow PACKING DRAGON to cross.  He added KING GENKI is a big horse with a long stride and he was reluctant to apply too much pressure on KING GENKI to prevent that horse from losing momentum.  He said although he realized that the race was being run at a fast tempo, he had hoped that PACKING DRAGON would continue forward of KING GENKI to prevent him from having to overly restrain his mount to obtain a trailing position.  He said when PACKING DRAGON continued to race outside KING GENKI, he was not able to steady the horse any more than he was without breaking the horseâs stride, therefore he allowed KING GENKI to remain racing inside PACKING DRAGON.  M Chadwick was advised that, in the opinion of the Stewards, having regard to the tempo of the race in the early and middle stages, he should have made far more endeavour to steady the tempo and attempt to obtain a trailing position behind PACKING DRAGON, particularly given his instructions.  He was advised to ensure that he rides his mounts in such a manner so as to provide them with every opportunity to finish off their race.
The Stewards will interview J Moreira, the rider of WINNIEâS HONEY, regarding the performance of the horse prior to the Sha Tin racemeeting on Sunday, 11 December 2016.

The Stewards opened an inquiry into the tactics adopted on LUCKY GIRL.  S de Sousa stated that during the week he had a number of discussions with Mr C H Yip, the trainer of LUCKY GIRL, regarding the manner in which the horse should be ridden in todayâs race.  He said Mr Yip advised him that both he and the owner of LUCKY GIRL had been disappointed with the manner in which the horse had finished off its last two races when leading, in particular at its last start when the horse was well beaten after dictating the tempo of the race.  He said therefore it was decided to ride LUCKY GIRL from off the speed as the horse had previously been successful and had generally performed well when being ridden in this manner by him.  He said in these discussions he had agreed that LUCKY GIRL may be suited by being ridden more patiently as the horse had weakened when ridden by him after racing in the lead over 1800 Metres at Sha Tin on 23 October 2016.  Mr Yip stated that following its last start when the horse was ridden by a claiming apprentice and had not finished off its race, the owner of LUCKY GIRL had directed him to attempt to obtain the services of S de Sousa in todayâs race given that the horse had raced successfully when ridden by him in the past.  He said the owner had also requested for LUCKY GIRL to be ridden from about a midfield position if possible as he was disappointed that the horse was beaten 5 lengths after appearing to have been able to run the race at its own tempo.  Mr Yip advised that in the Parade Ring he informed the owner that todayâs race appeared to lack genuine speed and would likely not be run at a genuine tempo, however, the owner confirmed that the horse should be ridden patiently if at all possible.  S de Sousa stated that after being able to obtain a position around midfield, LUCKY GIRL would not settle and after over-racing did not finish off the race.  The Stewards adjourned the inquiry until a date to be fixed at which time the owner of LUCKY GIRL will be requested to appear.  S de Sousa and Mr Yip were advised that the Stewards would consider the evidence provided thus far as well as review the horseâs previous races prior to the resumption of the inquiry.  A veterinary inspection of LUCKY GIRL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

At the entrance to the Straight, BIG ORANGE and ONE FOOT IN HEAVEN raced tight.
Near the 350 Metres, BIG ORANGE, which was continuing to giving ground, was eased away from the heels of ONE FOOT IN HEAVEN which shifted in.
NUOVO RECORD was not able to obtain clear running until passing the 300 Metres.
Passing the 100 Metres, BENZINI was shifted in away from the heels of ONE FOOT IN HEAVEN which shifted in.
For the majority of the race, SMART LAYER travelled wide and without cover.
The performances of HELENE HAPPY STAR and ANTICIPATION, which finished tailed out, were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, HELENE HAPPY STAR and ANTICIPATION will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After arriving back in quarantine after the race, GARLINGARI was reported to be lame in the right front leg.
A veterinary inspection of SILVERWAVE and HELENE HAPPY STAR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SATONO CROWN and HIGHLAND REEL were sent for sampling.

PURE SENSATION was withdrawn on raceday morning by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore foot).
STRATHMORE began awkwardly.
From the outside barrier, SIGNS OF BLESSING was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
When being steadied in the early stages to be shifted across to obtain cover, AMAZING KIDS got its head up on a number of occasions.
B Melham (REBEL DANE) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that for some distance approaching and passing the 1000 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of TAKEDOWN, resulting in that horse being unnecessarily crowded for room and becoming unbalanced.  LUCKY BUBBLES, which was racing to the inside of TAKEDOWN, was hampered as a result.  B Melham was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 18 December 2016 and to expire on Thursday, 5 January 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (4 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards took into consideration the status of this race.
Passing the 1000 Metres, STRATHMORE was bumped by NOT LISTENINâTOME which got its head on the side when racing tight inside AEROVELOCITY.
K Teetan (SUPER JOCKEY) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 900 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of AEROVELOCITY, resulting in that horse being taken in across the rightful running of NOT LISTENINâTOME which was severely checked and lost the running to which it was rightfully entitled.  K Teetan was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 18 December 2016 and to expire on Thursday, 5 January 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (4 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, K Teetan was fined $40,000.
Approaching the 600 Metres, RED FALX was crowded between GROWL and LUCKY BUBBLES (B Prebble) which shifted out.  B Prebble was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he leaves comfortable racing room for other runners in similar circumstances.  After this, LUCKY BUBBLES was checked when awkwardly placed close to the heels of TAKEDOWN,
At the entrance to the Straight, GROWL and RED FALX were taken wider by LUCKY BUBBLES which shifted out into clear running.
Passing the 200 Metres, after initially being brushed by REBEL DANE, TAKEDOWN shifted out away from the heels of that horse and bumped BIG ARTHUR.
Near the 150 Metres, SUPER JOCKEY raced tight inside AEROVELOCITY which got its head on the side and lay in under pressure.
Just prior to the finishing line, AMAZING KIDS was shifted out away from the heels of AEROVELOCITY and then passing the winning post raced tight inside LUCKY BUBBLES which shifted in for some distance under pressure.
Throughout the race, REBEL DANE, BIG ARTHUR and GROWL all travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of BIG ARTHUR immediately following the race found that horse to have sustained a small cut to the inside of the right front fetlock.
A veterinary inspection of RED FALX immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
AEROVELOCITY and LUCKY BUBBLES were sent for sampling.

On arrival at the barriers, D Whyte expressed concern regarding the action of BORN IN CHINA.  BORN IN CHINA was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was lame in its left front leg and accordingly was not suitable to race.  Acting on this advice, BORN IN CHINA was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  Before being allowed to race again, BORN IN CHINA will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
DUNDONNELL was slow to begin.
RACING SUPERNOVA began only fairly.
From the outside barriers, LUCKY YEAR and BLIZZARD were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
KEY WITNESS was left racing wide and without cover after the 1100 Metres.
Passing the 1000 Metres, BLIZZARD was awkwardly placed close to the heels of CIRCUIT LAND.
Making the turn after the 900 Metres and again passing the 800 Metres, DUNDONNELL got its head up when proving very difficult to settle.
Passing the 500 Metres, DUNDONNELL again got its head up and shifted out abruptly away from the heels of RACING SUPERNOVA.
Passing the 400 Metres, CIRCUIT LAND was awkwardly placed inside the heels of LUCKY YEAR.  CIRCUIT LAND then raced tight between LUCKY YEAR and SIMPLY INVINCIBLE which shifted out marginally when held up for clear running behind RAPPER DRAGON.  SIMPLY INVINCIBLE was then unable to obtain clear running until approaching the 200 Metres.
Near the 150 Metres, KEY WITNESS momentarily raced tight inside BLIZZARD which lay in before being shifted out to relieve the tightening.
Close to the finishing line, DASHING FELLOW (K Teetan) and MR BOGART (Z Purton) raced tight.  Z Purton was spoken to regarding comments he directed towards K Teetan after passing the winning post.
A veterinary inspection of CIRCUIT LAND immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
BLIZZARD and MR BOGART were sent for sampling.

LOGOTYPE and SATONO ALADDIN were slow to begin.
HELENE PARAGON began awkwardly and lost ground.
GIANT TREASURE was slow to begin and then shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
From the outside barriers, BEAUTY ONLY and ABLE FRIEND were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After the 1100 Metres, ROMANTIC TOUCH was left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 650 Metres, HELENE PARAGON and BEAUTY ONLY raced tight.
HELENE PARAGON had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight.
LOGOTYPE was also held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Passing the 200 Metres, PACKING PINS, which was giving ground, was steadied when crowded for room between GIANT TREASURE which shifted out marginally and COUGAR MOUNTAIN (D OâBrien) which shifted in.  D OâBrien was advised to exercise more care in similar circumstances.
A veterinary inspection of SUN JEWELLERY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ABLE FRIEND, BEAUTY ONLY and HELENE PARAGON were sent for sampling.

When commencing to be saddled up outside the Parade Ring, A SHIN HIKARI got loose from its handlers and then trotted unattended for a short period.  After being recaptured, A SHIN HIKARI was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
On arrival at the Start, Z Purton informed the Veterinary Officer that SECRET WEAPON had made a number of unusual noises whilst proceeding to the Start.  Accordingly, the girth and tongue tie carried by SECRET WEAPON were loosened.  SECRET WEAPON was then trotted up in front of the Veterinary Officer who advised that Z Purton was completely comfortable with the action of the horse and that it had not made any further abnormal noises.  Accordingly, SECRET WEAPON was passed suitable to race.
As the start was effected, MAURICE bounded in the air and became unbalanced, resulting in MAURICE losing ground.
DESIGNS ON ROME was slow to begin.
From a wide barrier, QUEENS RING got its head up on a number of occasions when being steadied in order to be shifted across behind runners.
Approaching the 1400 Metres, LOVELY DAY shifted in and brushed the running rail.
Passing the 1200 Metres, MAURICE was bumped by GUN PIT which shifted in after being brushed by QUEENS RING.
SECRET WEAPON was unable to obtain clear running from passing the 400 Metres until near the 250 Metres.
Passing the 200 Metres, HORSE OF FORTUNE and BLAZING SPEED bumped on two occasions, causing both horses to become unbalanced.
Passing the 50 Metres, HORSE OF FORTUNE raced tight inside BLAZING SPEED.
A veterinary inspection of A SHIN HIKARI immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MAURICE and SECRET WEAPON were sent for sampling.

On arrival at the Start, concern was raised regarding the action of MYTHICAL EMPEROR.  MYTHICAL EMPEROR was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said after the necessary consultations that the horse was suitable to race.
BORNTOACHIEVE began awkwardly and then was hampered by MR STUNNING which shifted out.
MYTHICAL EMPEROR and HIT THE BID bumped on jumping.
A short distance after the start, CLEVER BEAVER blundered.
From a wide barrier, HEROIC GURU was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Near the 1100 Metres, MYTHICAL EMPEROR (Apprentice H T Mo), which was being ridden along, shifted out abruptly, resulting in HIT THE BID being taken out across the running of LINE SEEKER which was checked.  Apprentice Mo was advised that in similar circumstances he should make every endeavour to keep his mounts on a straight course.
Near the 850 Metres, MYTHICAL EMPEROR was steadied to avoid the heels of MR STUNNING (J Moreira) which shifted in when not quite clear.  J Moreira was advised to ensure that he is properly clear when shifting ground in future.
Passing the 800 Metres, MALMSTEEN got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of CLEVER BEAVER.
Throughout the race, BORNTOACHIEVE travelled wide and without cover and after the 800 Metres NEW ASIA SUNRISE was similarly left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 600 Metres, HIT THE BID was hampered when awkwardly placed close to the heels of MARVEL TRIBE.
Passing the 500 Metres, MERION was shifted out away from the heels of TURF SPRINT.
Approaching the 350 Metres, LET US WIN was badly hampered when attempting to improve into tight running between SUPER LEADER and HIT THE BID which was taken out by LINE SEEKER (Z Purton).  As the Stewards were satisfied that LET US WIN had not properly established running between SUPER LEADER and HIT THE BID, Z Purton was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he makes every endeavour to prevent his mounts from shifting ground.  In this incident, SUPER LEADER became unbalanced when bumped on the hindquarters by LET US WIN.  For some distance after this, HIT THE BID raced tight outside LINE SEEKER.
Passing the 300 Metres, MALMSTEEN (S de Sousa) was directed to the outside of CLEVER BEAVER after being disappointed for running between that horse and SUPER LEADER.  When MALMSTEEN shifted out, BORNTOACHIEVE was momentarily steadied away from the heels of that horse.  S de Sousa was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is properly clear when shifting ground in similar circumstances.
Near the 150 Metres, HIT THE BID, which was giving ground, was steadied when crowded for room between HEROIC GURU and LET US WIN, both of which shifted ground.
When questioned, S de Sousa stated that he had been asked to ride MALMSTEEN more patiently as the horse had recently not been finishing off its races when ridden in a forward position.
MR STUNNING and MERION were sent for sampling.

NEWSWIRE FREE began awkwardly and then shortly after the start was bumped by CLOUD NINE which shifted out.
BLAZING PASS shifted out on jumping and bumped PEARL FURU which became unbalanced.
From the outside barriers, TOWERING STORM, GO SANDY GO and AUTUMN GOLD were all steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Near the 900 Metres, TOWERING STORM (O Murphy) shifted out and bumped GO SANDY GO.  O Murphy reported that after this contact, TOWERING STORMâs action shortened noticeably and as he felt that the horse appeared to be sore in front, he elected to ease it out of the race approaching the 800 Metres.  A veterinary inspection of TOWERING STORM immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, TOWERING STORM will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of PEARL FURU and CHOICE EXCHEQUER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
KING BOUNTIFUL, CLOUD NINE and AUTUMN GOLD were sent for sampling.

GAINFULJET was withdrawn on raceday afternoon by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (distressed following transit incident).  Before being allowed to race again, GAINFULJET will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Shortly after the start, PROPEL REPEL shifted in and bumped the hindquarters of MANHATTAN STRIKER.  MANHATTAN STRIKER then became unbalanced and shifted out, resulting in PROPEL REPEL being crowded for room inside FOREVER FUN.
From the outside barriers, TELECOM BOOM and ABLE TALENT were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
When being steadied after the 1000 Metres, NOBLE BUDDIES travelled keenly and after the 900 Metres was allowed to improve into the lead.
After the 800 Metres, HAPPY CENTURY was left racing wide and without cover.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, FOREVER FUN got its head on the side and shifted out towards the heels of SIR JOHN.
Also making the turn after the 600 Metres, TELECOM BOOM shifted out and raced tight inside PROPEL REPEL.
Near the 50 Metres, PROPEL REPEL was crowded for room between NOBLE BUDDIES which shifted out marginally and SIR JOHN which shifted in under pressure.  In this incident, NOBLE BUDDIES and PROPEL REPEL both became unbalanced after bumping.
When questioned regarding the performance of MANHATTAN STRIKER, J Moreira stated that he was able to obtain a good position on the horse from an inside barrier and MANHATTAN STRIKER travelled well until near the 500 Metres.  He said after this point MANHATTAN STRIKER came off the bridle and he had to ride the horse along in order to have it maintain its position.  He said MANHATTAN STRIKER did not respond to his riding and was most disappointing in the manner in which it weakened out of the race after the 300 Metres.  A veterinary inspection of MANHATTAN STRIKER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of MANHATTAN STRIKER, one of the favoured runners of the race and which finished last, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, MANHATTAN STRIKER will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SHOWING CHARACTER and HAPPY CENTURY were sent for sampling.

FRANCE VALOUR was slow to begin.
ISLAND FLYER began awkwardly.
GORGEOUS AGAIN and SWEET BEAN bumped on jumping.
Shortly after the start, GARLIC YEAH got its head on the side and shifted in towards the hindquarters of ROCK THE TREE.
MY FOLKS and HIGH SPEED METRO were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Near the 1550 Metres, SWEET BEAN shifted in and bumped FRANCE VALOUR, causing both horses to become unbalanced.
Passing the 1200 Metres, HIGH SPEED METRO momentarily raced in restricted room inside GARLIC YEAH.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, MY FOLKS was checked away from the heels of SWEET BEAN after getting its head on the side and shifting out away from GARLIC YEAH.  HIGH SPEED METRO, which was following, got its head up when being checked away from the heels of MY FOLKS in consequence.
Rounding the Home Turn, MALAYAN PEARL was steadied away from the heels of SAFARI MAGIC which was taken out by GORGEOUS AGAIN which got its head on the side and lay out.
ROCK THE TREE had some difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Passing the 300 Metres, ISLAND FLYER shifted in and bumped the hindquarters of INNOVATIVE WINNER which became unbalanced.
Near the 250 Metres, MY FOLKS was shifted to the outside of WIN CHANCE after being disappointed in running between that horse and FRANCE VALOUR.  After this, MY FOLKS lay out under pressure.
Throughout the race, FRANCE VALOUR travelled wide and without cover.
After the winning post, O Doleuze dismounted from INNOVATIVE WINNER.  INNOVATIVE WINNER was subsequently examined by the Veterinary Officer who said the horse had lost its left hind plate (approaching the 1400 Metres) with a resultant injury to the outside of the left hind foot.  Before being allowed to race again, INNOVATIVE WINNER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of ROCK THE TREE and SAFARI MAGIC immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ROCK THE TREE, GARLIC YEAH and HIGH SPEED METRO were sent for sampling.

DIAMOND MYSTERIOUS was slow to begin.
PEARL WIN shifted out at the start and bumped GRACYDAD.  GRACYDAD, from the outside barrier, was then steadied and shifted across behind runners.
ISAAC and ROBUST MOMENTUM bumped on jumping.
Passing the 1000 Metres, ROBUST MOMENTUM got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of ROYALE ELEGANCE which was being steadied to allow ISAAC to cross.
Approaching and passing the 1100 Metres, ROCKET LET WIN became unbalanced when crowded for room between WORLD CITY and GENTILIS (K C Leung) which shifted out.  Then making the turn near the 1050 Metres, ROCKET LET WIN was steadied when further tightened for room between GENTILIS which continued to shift out and WORLD CITY which, after being bumped on the hindquarters, became unbalanced and shifted in marginally.  K C Leung was reprimanded and advised that whilst he did not shift a large amount of ground in this incident, nonetheless in the circumstances he should have made more of an effort to prevent his mount from shifting out and crowding ROCKET LET WIN.
After the 600 Metres, ROCKET LET WIN was left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 400 Metres, GRACYDAD momentarily raced in restricted room when placed inside the heels of SPARKLING TALENT and outside ROYALE ELEGANCE which shifted out away from the heels of ISAAC.
Passing the 150 Metres, ROYALE ELEGANCE (C Williams) commenced to shift in under pressure.  For this reason, C Williams changed his whip into his right hand passing the 100 Metres.
For the majority of the race, PEARL WIN travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of PEARL WIN and FIVE STARS AGENT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ISAAC and ROYALE ELEGANCE were sent for sampling.

VICTORY FOLLOW ME shifted in at the start and bumped LIGHTNING AND GOLD.
TRAVEL AMBASSADOR and HELENâS CHOICE bumped at the start.
Shortly after the start, SWEET HOME, when being steadied to shift across behind runners, got its head up and shifted out abruptly.
From a wide barrier, AGIAAL was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
LIGHTNING AND GOLD lost its right front plate passing the winning post on the first occasion.
Despite being hard ridden in the early stages, GLORY STAR failed to muster speed and then after the 1200 Metres was left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 1300 Metres, SWEET HOME commenced to prove difficult to settle and got its head up when awkwardly placed behind HELENâS CHOICE.  Then near the 1150 Metres, SWEET HOME, which continued to prove difficult to settle, was checked away from the heels of HELENâS CHOICE which shifted out abruptly.
For a considerable distance after the 500 Metres, WISKY (C Y Ho) was taken back through the field by HAPPY BEAUTY which came under pressure.  Then rounding the Home Turn, WISKY shifted out away from the heels of HAPPY BEAUTY, resulting in VICTORY FOLLOW ME being crowded for room inside GLORY STAR.  C Y Ho was advised to exercise more care when shifting ground in similar circumstances.  AGIAAL, which was following VICTORY FOLLOW ME, shifted in away from the heels of that horse in consequence, resulting in SWEET HOME, which was being shifted out towards the heels of AGIAAL, being checked away from the heels of that horse.
In the early part of the Straight, LIGHTNING AND GOLD lay in under pressure.
Approaching the 200 Metres, VICTORY FOLLOW ME was crowded for room between GLORY STAR and WISKY, which when attempting to improve to the outside of the heels of SPINNING DANCER, was taken out before being steadied when disappointed for running outside SPINNING DANCER.  In this incident, GLORY STAR became unbalanced after being bumped by VICTORY FOLLOW ME.  In the circumstances, no further action was taken.  When GLORY STAR became unbalanced, that horse shifted out, resulting in LIGHTNING AND GOLD being taken wider.
A veterinary inspection of SWEET HOME immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
TRAVEL AMBASSADOR and WISKY were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE HONG KONG CHINESE AMATEUR ATHLETIC FEDERATION CENTENARY GOLD CUP (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
On arrival at the Start, it was noted that PEACE N PROSPERITY had lost its right front plate.  Following this plate being refitted, the horse was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
As the start was effected, FISH Nâ CHIPS lifted its front feet off the ground, resulting in its rider, N Juglall, becoming unbalanced and FISH Nâ CHIPS being slow to begin.
HARRIER JET shifted out at the start and bumped TRAVEL DATUK which in turn shifted out and bumped DILLY.
FISH Nâ CHIPS lost its left front plate shortly after the start.
BRILLIANT DREAM was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
Despite being vigorously ridden in the early stages, EASY TOUCH and LUCKY DAY failed to muster speed.
For some distance after the 1000 Metres, STARTLING POWER commenced to travel keenly and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of DIEGO KOSTA.
Near the 750 Metres, BRILLIANT DREAM was awkwardly placed close to the heels of FISH Nâ CHIPS.
BUDDY BUNDY travelled wide and without cover until after the 600 Metres.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, FISH Nâ CHIPS lay in, bumped the running rail and became unbalanced.
Passing the 400 Metres, BRILLIANT DREAM was awkwardly placed close to the heels of LUCKY DAY when held up for clear running.
Approaching the 200 Metres, BRILLIANT DREAM was shifted to the inside of BUDDY BUNDY to continue improving.
Over the concluding stages, LUCKY DAY raced tight outside BRILLIANT DREAM.
The performance of STARTLING POWER, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, STARTLING POWER will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the riding of O Murphy (BRILLIANT DREAM), 4th placegetter, over the concluding stages did not affect the horseâs finishing position, he was nonetheless reminded of his obligation to ride his mounts out at least hands and heels to the end of the race where circumstances permit.
After the race, it was reported that SEA JADE had sustained a small cut to the right hind pastern.
A veterinary inspection of PEACE N PROSPERITY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SEA JADE and HARRIER JET were sent for sampling.

CHATER LEGEND began only fairly and shortly after the start was hampered by LOTUS BREEZE which was taken out by INVENTOR.
WAH MAY BABY shifted in at the start and bumped RIGHT CALL.
From the outside barrier, INDUSTRIALIST WAY was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
After the 1300 Metres, FIVE UP HIGH was left racing wide and without cover and near the 1100 Metres was allowed to stride forward to race outside the lead after the 800 Metres.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, CHATER LEGEND raced tight inside ENORMOUS HONOUR.
INVENTOR lost its right front plate near the 850 Metres.
After the 800 Metres, IMPERIAL GALLANTRY was left racing wide and without cover.
After racing tight outside MARVEL HERO approaching and passing the 400 Metres, ENORMOUS HONOUR was steadied near the 350 Metres when disappointed for running between IMPERIAL GALLANTRY and MARVEL HERO which shifted out.
At the point of the Home Turn, CHATER LEGEND brushed the running rail when awkwardly placed close to the heels of INVENTOR.
When questioned regarding the performance of LITTLE ISLAND, C Williams stated that tonightâs race was run at a more genuine tempo than the race in which the horse was successful at its last start.  He said because of this LITTLE ISLAND was not able to show the same turn of foot as it was at its last start off a slower tempo.  A veterinary inspection of LITTLE ISLAND immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of INVENTOR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
MARVEL HERO and LOTUS BREEZE were sent for sampling.

After being loaded into the barriers, SUNNY WIN became fractious and then as the start was effected was slow to begin.
JE PENSE, HARD BALL GET and GOLDEN SLEEP were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
For a considerable distance between the 1200 Metres and the 800 Metres, CLASSIC EMPEROR proved very difficult to settle in the lead.
After the 1200 Metres, GOLDEN SLEEP was left racing wide and without cover.
When travelling keenly in the lead, CLASSIC EMPEROR shifted out making the turn near the 1050 Metres and bumped TRUMP.
Near the 450 Metres, THE SYLPH was shifted out away from the heels of TRUMP which was commencing to give ground abruptly and in doing so bumped GOLDEN SLEEP.
SUNNY WIN was severely checked passing the 400 Metres after striking the heels of TRUMP which continued to give ground abruptly.  JE PENSE, which was following SUNNY WIN, was hampered in consequence.  WINSTONâS LAD, which was racing to the inside of TRUMP, was crowded for room in this incident.
After the race, K C Leung stated that AEROSPEED was unbalanced in its action at various stages of the race and as the horse did not feel comfortable, he eased it down in the Straight.  A veterinary inspection of AEROSPEED immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, AEROSPEED will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned regarding his riding of TRUMP in the early and middle stages, H W Lai stated that he had been asked to ride the horse in about 3rd or 4th position with cover from a wide barrier.  He said after riding his mount positively in the early stages, he looked to position TRUMP behind VICTORY MARVEL approaching the winning post on the first occasion, however, HAPPY SPIRIT had occupied that position which resulted in TRUMP being left racing three wide and without cover passing the winning post on the first occasion.  He said rather than remain racing wide, he allowed his mount to stride forward of VICTORY MARVEL to race outside the leader CLASSIC EMPEROR.  He said after crossing VICTORY MARVEL leaving the 1300 Metres, he shortened his hold in an endeavour to have TRUMP steady the tempo as CLASSIC EMPEROR to his inside was over-racing.  He added when he did this, TRUMP attempted to shift out on a number of occasions and proved very difficult for him to steady.  He said at all stages after the 1200 Metres he had a tight hold of the horseâs inside rein in an endeavour to steady the tempo and prevent TRUMP from shifting out.  He said he was aware that the tempo of the race after the 1200 Metres was quick given the manner in which CLASSIC EMPEROR was racing in the lead and the manner in which TRUMP was proving difficult to settle, however, he was unable to do any more to steady that horse as he was making every endeavour to ease the tempo on TRUMP.  The Stewards were satisfied that H W Lai had made a reasonable attempt to steady TRUMP approaching and passing the 1200 Metres and it was also acknowledged that TRUMP has a prior history of wanting to hang out, however, H W Lai was told that in the circumstances the Stewards would have expected him to make a more concerted effort to steady the horse.  He was advised to ensure that he makes a satisfactory attempt at all times to ensure that horses ridden by him are rated so that they can finish off their race as best as they are able in the circumstances.  A veterinary inspection of TRUMP immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm.  Before being allowed to race again, TRUMP will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of WINSTONâS LAD immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HAPPY SPIRIT and HARD BALL GET were sent for sampling.

At declaration time, K Teetan was declared as the rider of both BORN DRAGON and MIZZEN GREY.  It was established that K Teetan had a firm commitment to ride BORN DRAGON.  As such, the Stewards permitted M Chadwick to be substituted as the rider of MIZZEN GREY.  For this declaration error, Trainer T K Ng was fined $2,000.
FRIENDS FOREVER, which was leaning against the outside of its barrier stall as the start was effected, began awkwardly.  FRIENDS FOREVER then shifted in shortly after the start, resulting in DRAGON BACHELOR being crowded for room.  After this, DRAGON BACHELOR was ridden along, however, failed to muster speed.
LAUGHING LORD shifted out at the start and inconvenienced LUCKY BOLE.
From the outside barrier, CHARITY PLENTY was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, FRIENDS FOREVER became momentarily unbalanced when racing tight inside BORN DRAGON.  After this, FRIENDS FOREVER continued to race awkwardly inside the heels of BORN DRAGON.
After the 1100 Metres, PLANET GIANT was left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 200 Metres, LAUGHING LORD and PERFECT TIMING bumped due to both horses shifting ground.  PERFECT TIMING then became unbalanced and shifted out abruptly, resulting in LAUGHING LORD being crowded for room when taken out onto MIGHTY WONGCHOY.  As MIGHTY WONGCHOY was being shifted out to relieve the tightening to LAUGHING LORD, PLANET GIANT, which was racing outside MIGHTY WONGCHOY, got its head on the side and shifted in away from JIMSON THE FAMOUS before being corrected by its rider.  This resulted in both LAUGHING LORD and MIGHTY WONGCHOY both being checked approaching the 100 Metres.  As the Stewards were satisfied that this incident was due to a number of factors, none of these due to carelessness being exhibited by any rider, no further action was taken.
For the majority of the race, LE PEGASE travelled wide and without cover and subsequently finished tailed out in the Straight.  The performance of LE PEGASE was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, LE PEGASE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the riding of S Clipperton (NOVEL START), 5th placegetter, over the concluding stages did not affect the horseâs finishing position, he was nonetheless reminded of his obligation to ride his mounts out at least hands and heels all the way to the end of the race where circumstances permit.
When questioned, J Moreira (JIMSON THE FAMOUS) stated that it had been intended to take up a forward position on the horse.  He said after being placed in the barriers JIMSON THE FAMOUS was fractious and turned its head on a number of occasions.  He said as the start was effected JIMSON THE  FAMOUS turned its head to the right and at the same time leant on the outside of its barrier stall which resulted in it beginning awkwardly and losing ground.  He said as he believed it was no longer an option to take up a forward position, he elected to shift JIMSON THE FAMOUS across behind runners in the early stages and improve his position along the inside rail.
A veterinary inspection of DRAGON BACHELOR immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, DRAGON BACHELOR will be subjected to an official veterinary examination. 
A veterinary inspection of LUCKY BOLE immediately following the race found that horse to have bled from both nostrils
SOCCER BRAVE and JIMSON THE FAMOUS were sent for sampling.

WINFIELD began awkwardly.
Shortly after the start, MAMBO ROCK and STARSHIP were crowded for room inside WHOOP WHOOP which shifted in.
From wide barriers, RUBY COAST and HAPPY PLACE were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After the 900 Metres, SUNNY WAY was left racing wide and without cover.
Approaching the 600 Metres, WINFIELD and SUNNY WAY raced tight as WINFIELD shifted out away from the heels of LUCKY PROFIT after being awkwardly positioned behind that horse.
Passing the 600 Metres, BABA MAMA was bumped by WHOOP WHOOP (C Williams) which shifted out.  C Williams was advised to exercise more care when shifting ground.
THUNDER STOMP was held up for clear running at the entrance to the Straight.
Passing the 400 Metres, BABA MAMA was shifted out away from the heels of STARSHIP.
Near the 300 Metres, SUNNY WAY (S Clipperton) got its head on the side and shifted in across the heels of LUCKY PROFIT which shifted out marginally.  After the race, S Clipperton stated that SUNNY WAY did not feel comfortable in its action in the Straight.  A veterinary inspection of SUNNY WAY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of SUNNY WAY, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, SUNNY WAY will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
RUBY COAST was held up for clear running passing the 300 Metres and near the 100 Metres was shifted to the inside of THUNDER STOMP after being disappointed for running outside that horse and inside WINFIELD.
In the Straight, UNICRON JEWELLERY lay out under pressure.
When questioned, D Whyte stated that WINFIELD was particularly difficult to manage in todayâs race as the horse was inclined to shift ground on a number of occasions.  He said in the Straight WINFIELD hung out and proved difficult to ride and over the concluding stages he was awkwardly placed between WHOOP WHOOP and THUNDER STOMP which was shifting out under pressure.  He said having regard to the racing manners of WINFIELD, he was reluctant to continue riding the horse out over the concluding stages as WHOOP WHOOP, the eventual 5th placegetter, had already established a margin on WINFIELD.  D Whyte was told that whilst the Stewards acknowledged that WINFIELD had proven difficult to ride out and that THUNDER STOMP was shifting ground to his inside, nonetheless he was reminded of his obligation to ride his mounts out to the end of the race wherever circumstances permit.
After the race, C Williams (WHOOP WHOOP) reported that he had been asked to ride the horse more quietly than was the case at its last start.  He said when ridden from behind midfield today, WHOOP WHOOP closed off the race strongly.
A veterinary inspection of STARSHIP and BEAUTY LOVE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
UNICRON JEWELLERY, HAPPY PLACE and SKY KING were sent for sampling.

race_name: LUKFOOK JEWELLERY LOVE IS BEAUTY COLLECTION HANDICAP
incident_report:
After being loaded into the barriers, EMPIRE OF MONGOLIA became fractious, reared and got its head into the overhead barrier structure.  EMPIRE OF MONGOLIA then momentarily sat down.  EMPIRE OF MONGOLIA was removed from the barrier stalls and examined by the Veterinary Officer who said the horse had blood tinged discharge at its left nostril and accordingly was not suitable to race.  Acting on this advice, EMPIRE OF MONGOLIA was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  Before being allowed to race again, EMPIRE OF MONGOLIA will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
As the start was effected, ACE KING lifted its front feet off the ground and consequently was slow to begin.
HIGH VOLATILITY shifted in on jumping and bumped ENREACHING.
INDIGENOUS STAR was slow to begin and shortly after the start was steadied away from the heels of HEALTHY LUCK which shifted in.
Near the 950 Metres, ART OF SUCCESS got its head on the side and shifted out away from PEACE COMBINATION.
Approaching the 900 Metres, HAR HAR CHARMING was steadied when crowded for room between HURRICANE KID and DASHING POWER which shifted out away from PEACE COMBINATION.
For the majority of the race, ART OF SUCCESS raced with its head on the side and lay out.
The performance of FURLONG DRAGON, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, FURLONG DRAGON will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of ACE KING, FURLONG DRAGON and ART OF SUCCESS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ACE KING, HEALTHY LUCK and PEACE COMBINATION were sent for sampling.

race_name: LUKFOOK JEWELLERY HUGGING FAMILY COLLECTION HANDICAP
incident_report:
SECRET COMMAND began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped the hindquarters of EROICO which became unbalanced.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, HAPPY SURVEYS raced tight between GONNA RUN and HARBOUR MASTER.
When questioned, Apprentice K K Chiong stated that, from the outside barrier, she had been asked to ride HIT THE BID quietly.  She said when steadying the horse in the early stages to shift across behind runners, HIT THE BID initially proved difficult to settle and then after the 1200 Metres came off the bridle and appeared to be resenting the kickback.  She said she had to ride her mount along for some distance in the middle stages in order to have it join the main body of the field.  She said HIT THE BID did not respond to her riding and did not finish off the race.  As Mr A T Millard, the trainer of HIT THE BID was not in attendance of todayâs racemeeting, the Stewards questioned Ms W S Yu, assistant trainer allocated to Mr Millardâs stable.  She said she received instructions from Mr Millard to have HIT THE BID ridden quietly because of the outside barrier in an endeavour to have it close off the race rather than being used up to be ridden in a forward position.  Having regard to the anticipated moderate tempo of the race, the Stewards believed it appropriate to interview Mr Millard upon his return to Hong Kong and prior to HIT THE BID being entered to race again.  A veterinary inspection of HIT THE BID immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of HAPPY SURVEYS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
EROICO and PACKING LLAREGYB were sent for sampling.

race_name: LUKFOOK JEWELLERY PT GRACEFUL COLLECTION HANDICAP
incident_report:
SUNNY ORIENT and VICTORY MUSIC began only fairly.
REGENCY HORSE and NOBLE DE LOVE bumped heavily at the start.
Shortly after the start, DARING FIT shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of MONEY BOY.
Making the first turn near the 900 Metres, NOBLE DE LOVE, when being steadied to obtain cover behind MONEY BOY, got its head in the side and shifted out towards the heels of that horse, resulting in NOBLE DE LOVE having to be checked and lose ground.  As the Stewards were satisfied that this incident was attributable to the racing manners of NOBLE DE LOVE, no further action was taken.
VICTORY MUSIC was not able to obtain clear running until passing the 250 Metres.
Passing the 200 Metres, SUNNY ORIENT was shifted in away from the heels of FOREVER ACCURATE after being held up for clear running behind that horse which was giving ground.
Also passing the 200 Metres, HAPPY SOUND got its head on the side and shifted out away from DARING FIT.
After the 100 Metres, DARING FIT shifted out and passing the 50 Metres was momentarily awkwardly placed behind MONEY BOY which shifted in marginally.
Over the concluding stages, VICTORY MUSIC raced tight between LETSGOFREE and SUNNY ORIENT.
Throughout the race, CHEER WIN travelled wide and without cover.
After the race, C Williams (FOREVER ACCURATE) stated that he had to make some use of the horse in the early stages to cross from a wide barrier, nonetheless it was concerning the manner in which it weakened out of the race in the Straight.  He said FOREVER ACCURATE came under pressure near the 500 Metres and then did not quicken as MONEY BOY did passing the 400 Metres.  He said from this point onwards FOREVER ACCURATE continued to give ground and the early work that he did on the horse to overcome the wide barrier, in his opinion, was not an excuse for the horseâs disappointing run.  A veterinary inspection of FOREVER ACCURATE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of FOREVER ACCURATE, a last start winner, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, FOREVER ACCURATE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned regarding the performance of REGENCY HORSE, N Callan stated that after being bumped heavily at the start, he was able to improve his position in the early stages to obtain a position behind the leaders.  He said after the 800 Metres he had to ride REGENCY HORSE along as it was reluctant to maintain its position between FOREVER ACCURATE and LETSGOFREE.  He said he was surprised by this as REGENCY HORSE had not previously shown this trait either in its races or in its barrier trials when ridden by him.  He said REGENCY HORSE continued to be reluctant to maintain its position and near the 200 Metres got its head on the side and shifted in when continuing to be hesitant to improve into clear running inside CHEER WIN.  He added, due to its racing manners, REGENCY HORSE then did not finish off the race over the concluding stages.  A veterinary inspection of REGENCY HORSE immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of mucus in the horseâs trachea.
MONEY BOY and RADIANT STEED were sent for sampling.
<19/12/2016  Additional Veterinary Report>REGENCY HORSE, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of mucus in the horseâs trachea.  REGENCY HORSE was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer W Y So yesterday morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, REGENCY HORSE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

race_name: LUKFOOK JEWELLERY PT BRIDAL COLLECTION HANDICAP
incident_report:
KINGâS MAN began only fairly and then shortly after the start was steadied away from the heels of TRIUMPHANT LIGHT.  Then passing the 1550 Metres, KINGâS MAN was steadied away from the heels of HIT A HOME RUN which shifted out after being bumped by GOBI STORM which was taken out by TERRIFIC MASTER.  This resulted in KINGâS MAN racing back in the field.
From wide barriers, BONITO and SPEEDY WALLY were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the 1200 Metres, GOBI STORM commenced to prove difficult to settle and shifted out abruptly away from the heels of TERRIFIC MASTER and across the heels of GO BEAUTY GO, resulting in KINGâS MAN being checked.  Then making the turn near the 900 Metres, GOBI STORM got its head on the side and lay out.  After this, GOBI STORM travelled wide and without cover.
Passing the 800 Metres, TERRIFIC MASTER was steadied away from the heels of FRUITFUL LIFE which was awkwardly placed behind CHEERS CONQUEROR which in turn raced close to the heels of DASHING SUPER which was taken out by TRIUMPHANT LIGHT which was laying out.  After this, TRIUMPHANT LIGHT continued to lay out and in the Straight shifted out under pressure.
After the 700 Metres, FRUITFUL LIFE commenced to give ground and subsequently finished tailed out.  The performances of FRUITFUL LIFE and GOBI STORM, which also finished tailed out, were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, FRUITFUL LIFE and GOBI STORM will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  A veterinary inspection of FRUITFUL LIFE and GOBI STORM immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination revealed both horses to have a substantial amount of mucus in the trachea.
In the early part of the Straight, POLYMER LUCK was awkwardly placed outside TRIUMPHANT LIGHT which shifted out.
Also in the early part of the Straight, SPEEDY WALLY got its head on the side and was reluctant to shift to the outside of GOBI STORM.
Passing the 400 Metres, KINGâS MAN raced tight inside GOBI STORM.
Passing the 150 Metres, KINGâS MAN was shifted out away from the heels of GO BEAUTY GO.
Over the concluding stages, BEST REWARD raced tight between BONITO and HIT A HOME RUN which improved to be racing tight inside POLYMER LUCK.
Throughout the race, BEST EFFORT travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of DASHING SUPER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GO BEAUTY GO, TRIUMPHANT LIGHT and KINGâS MAN were sent for sampling.

race_name: LUKFOOK JEWELLERY GOLD CHARISMA COLLECTION HANDICAP
incident_report:
DASHING DART was slow to begin.
SPICY KAKA began only fairly and then shortly after the start was crowded for room between GLACIER BLUE which shifted out after beginning awkwardly and HAPPY WAY WINNER which shifted in.
GOOD FOR YOU was slow to begin.
REGENCY BO BO began awkwardly and on jumping was bumped by BOLSHOI BALLET which shifted out.
From a wide barrier, MASTER STEED was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
From the outside barrier, FURIOUS PEGASUS travelled wide and without cover throughout.
Near the 1300 Metres, REGENCY BO BO was awkwardly placed outside the heels of BOLSHOI BALLET.
Passing the 1200 Metres, GLACIER BLUE raced tight inside SPICY KAKA which lay in when also racing tight inside MAGNETISM.
Approaching the 1000 Metres, MASTER STEED commenced to travel keenly and was checked away from the heels of MAGNETISM.
Making the turn near the 900 Metres, SPICY KAKA raced tight between MAGNETISM which got its head on the side and lay in and DASHING DART which shifted out. 
SPICY KAKA was held up for clear running passing the 350 Metres.
Near the 200 Metres, SPICY KAKA was checked when attempting to improve between BOLSHOI BALLET and MAGNETISM where there was insufficient room.  SPICY KAKA then had difficulty obtaining clear running and near the 100 Metre was steadied away from the heels of DASHING DART which shifted out.
UNBEATABLE GUTS had difficulty obtaining clear running for some distance passing the 200 Metres.
Approaching and passing the 100 Metres, DASHING DART had some difficulty securing clear running.
Over the concluding stages, METALLIC STAR raced in restricted room between GOOD FOR YOU and EVEREST.
A veterinary inspection of BOLSHOI BALLET, MASTER STEED and SPICY KAKA immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
After the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on GOOD METHOD at the request of Trainer C S Shum.
