Before being allowed to race again, GOOD METHOD will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
EVEREST, REGENCY BO BO and GOOD METHOD were sent for sampling.

race_name: LUKFOOK JEWELLERY LOVE FOREVER COLLECTION HANDICAP
incident_report:
CITY WINNER was withdrawn on 16.12.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter HAMMER KING (K C Leung).  Before being allowed to race again, CITY WINNER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
RACING MATE and DIGITAL GENERATION began only fairly.
HAMMER KING shifted out at the start and bumped the hindquarters of BLAZE STAMINA which became unbalanced.
From the outside barriers, TOP SCORE and LANG TAI SING were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
In the early part of the Straight, RACING MATE raced with its head on the side and lay out.
For the majority of the race, LANG TAI SING travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, K Teetan stated that he had been asked to ride LUCKY GUY in about a midfield position if possible.  He said despite being hard ridden for a considerable distance in the early stages, LUCKY GUY did not show as much early speed as he anticipated and making the turn near the 900 Metres was racing outside CONVINCIBLE which shifted out, resulting in LUCKY GUY being awkwardly placed outside the heels of that horse.  He said although it was available for him to steady LUCKY GUY to obtain a trailing position behind CONVINCIBLE, he elected to remain racing outside that horse as he felt that he was already further back in the field than anticipated and he did not want to give up further ground by steadying his mount to take a trailing position behind CONVINCIBLE.  He added although this resulted in LUCKY GUY racing in a three wide position without cover, he believed this was more advantageous than having the horse racing further back in the field than it already was.
After the race, S Clipperton stated that after being ridden along from an outside barrier to take up a forward position, KING MORTAR would not relax and consequently was disappointing in the manner in which it weakened out of the race in the Straight.  A veterinary inspection of KING MORTAR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
When questioned, J Moreira stated that he had been asked to attempt to lead on ORIONIDS as the horse had raced well when ridden in front at its most recent start.  He said due to the tempo of the race, he was not able to lead as hoped, nonetheless he was able to obtain a good run behind the speed.  He said he had to place pressure on ORIONIDS after the 600 Metres, however, the horse finished off the race fairly.  A veterinary inspection of ORIONIDS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
A veterinary inspection of LANG TAI SING immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ORIONIDS, HAMMER KING and RACING MATE were sent for sampling.

HIGH FIVE shifted in abruptly on jumping, resulting in ARCHIPPUS and SANGRIA being hampered and LUCKY EVER being inconvenienced.
ACCEPTED began awkwardly and shifted in at the start, resulting in MOST BEAUTIFUL being crowded for room.
Over the final 300 Metres, MOST BEAUTIFUL raced with its head on the side and lay in under pressure.
Close to the finishing line, ARCHIPPUS shifted out and bumped HIGH FIVE.
When questioned, K C Leung (LUCKY EVER) stated that he rode his mount along for a considerable distance in the early stages to have it maintain its position at the back of the field.  He said after the 600 Metres LUCKY EVER changed lead legs and commenced to hang out.  He said LUCKY EVER continued to hang out and as the horse did not feel comfortable in its action, he eased it down over the latter stages of the race.  He added when pulling up after the race, LUCKY EVER shifted out abruptly towards the outside rail.  He said whilst the horse did not appear to be lame after the race, it did not appear correct in its action.  A veterinary inspection of LUCKY EVER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Before being allowed to race again, LUCKY EVER will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of ADVENTURER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
BAD BOY and MY LITTLE FRIEND were sent for sampling.

race_name: LUKFOOK JEWELLERY CONVERGENCE OF LOVE COLLECTION HANDICAP
incident_report:
BEAUTY KINGDOM began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped TANG FLEMING which became unbalanced.  After this, BEAUTY KINGDOM was ridden along to obtain a forward position, however, throughout the race travelled wide and without cover.
BRING IT ON shifted out at the start and bumped the hindquarters of BIG BANG BONG which became unbalanced.  A short distance later, BRING IT ON was crowded for room between BIG BANG BONG and AGREE, both of which shifted ground.
From the outside barriers, ASSOCIATION FANS and KA YING KID were shifted across behind runners shortly after the start.
Approaching and passing the 1100 Metres, CAPE THE FAITH commenced to travel keenly and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of ROUNDABOUT.  After this, CAPE THE FAITH continued to travel keenly and then hung out until the entrance to the Straight.
Approaching the 700 Metres, KA YING KID was crowded for room inside LE PANACHE which, when being ridden along to maintain its position, shifted in.
SILVERFIELD had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Approaching the 300 Metres, BRING IT ON was struck over the nose by the whip of K C Ng (SILLY BUDDIES).
BEAUTY KINGDOM, JOLLY JOLLY and BRING IT ON were sent for sampling.

At declaration time, S de Sousa was declared as the rider of both INVISIBLE and SUPER FORM.  It was established that S de Sousa had a firm commitment to ride INVISIBLE.  As such, the Stewards permitted J Moreira to be substituted as the rider of SUPER FORM.  For this declaration error, Trainer A T Millard was fined $2,000.
BEST TANGO jumped in at the start, resulting in OSCAR MIRACLE being crowded onto ACCLAIMED LIGHT which in turn shifted in and inconvenienced GOOD CHOICE AHEAD.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, INVISIBLE was steadied when momentarily crowded for room inside SALSA BROTHERS (O Murphy) which shifted in momentarily before being directed back out to relieve the tightening.  O Murphy was reprimanded and advised to exercise more care when shifting ground.
After the 1000 Metres, INVISIBLE was left racing wide and without cover.
N Callan (ACCLAIMED LIGHT) was severely reprimanded for allowing his mount to shift in soon after straightening which resulted in ACCLAIMED LIGHT bumping heavily with OSCAR MIRACLE which became unbalanced.
ACCLAIMED LIGHT and OSCAR MIRACLE again made contact approaching the 200 Metres.
Near the 200 Metres, O Doleuze (LITTLE FANTASY) dropped his whip.
Passing the 200 Metres, SALSA BROTHERS and GOOD CHOICE AHEAD made contact and became unbalanced.
N Callan was warned for permitting ACCLAIMED LIGHT to shift in near the 150 Metres when not quite clear of OSCAR MIRACLE.
Over the final 100 Metres, LITTLE FANTASY was not able to be fully tested when racing in restricted room inside REWARDING FLYER.
Approaching the finishing line, B Prebbleâs (BEST TANGO) right foot momentarily slipped from the stirrup iron, resulting in him losing balance.
REWARDING FLYER had some difficulty obtaining clear running in the Straight.
When questioned regarding his riding after the 1000 Metres, S de Sousa (INVISIBLE) stated that making the turn near the 1000 Metres when racing wide and without cover, INVISIBLE drifted out slightly which permitted ACCLAIMED LIGHT to improve to the inside of his mountâs heels.  He said as he contemplated shifting back in to resume his position, he became aware that ACCLAIMED LIGHT was racing to the inside of the heels of INVISIBLE and had he continued to shift back in, he would likely have caused interference to that horse and therefore he was obliged to have his mount hold its line albeit racing in a four wide position.  S de Sousa was advised to ensure that he rides competitively at all stages and does not give up favourable positions.
A veterinary inspection of SALSA BROTHERS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of REWARDING FLYER immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, REWARDING FLYER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SUPER FORM, ACCLAIMED LIGHT and AGIAAL were sent for sampling.

VIVACIOUS WINNER began awkwardly and lost ground.
From the outside barrier, MAGIC STAR was steadied and shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
FRESH AND FRESH raced wide and without cover until approaching the 800 Metres at which stage it was allowed to improve to race outside the lead.
Approaching the 800 Metres, FAITHFUL BOY got its head up when being steadied away from the heels of MALAYAN PEARL.
GLORY STAR was left racing wide and without cover from the 800 Metres.
Making the Home Turn, YOURTHEWONFORME, when racing in restricted room, became unbalanced when brushed by FRESH AND FRESH which lay in.
At the entrance to the Straight, ATOMIC BLAST was awkwardly placed near the heels of GLORY STAR.
K C Leung reported that when challenged in the lead initially by MALAYAN PEARL and later FRESH AND FRESH, YOURTHEWONFORME would not relax and consequently was not able to finish off the race.  A veterinary inspection of YOURTHEWONFORME immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
When questioned, O Doleuze stated that DUTCH WINDMILL obtained a nice trailing position in midfield and travelled well throughout the early and middle stages.  He said however after shifting his mount out from behind GLORY STAR in an endeavour to improve his position passing the 500 Metres, DUTCH WINDMILL immediately came under pressure, did not respond to his riding and proved disappointing.  He added he was unable to detect anything amiss with DUTCH WINDMILL on pulling up.  A veterinary inspection of DUTCH WINDMILL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of FAITHFUL BOY immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, FAITHFUL BOY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
FAITHFUL BOY, EXCELLENCE and DASHING FORTUNE were sent for sampling.

CONTRIBUTION was slow to begin.
RICHCITY FORTUNE began awkwardly.
GENEROUS BOBO lost its right front plate approaching the 1100 Metres.
After being ridden along to improve inside the heels of UNIQUE JOYFUL approaching the first turn, POWERMAX had to be checked when RICHCITY FORTUNE, which was racing to its inside, improved to be racing to the outside of the heels of CONFUCIUS SPIRIT and UNIQUE JOYFUL, which after initially getting its head up when being steadied to allow WILD BOY (K C Leung) to cross, then was further steadied when taken in slightly by WILD BOY.  K C Leung was advised that whilst there were a number of contributing factors to this incident, nonetheless he was warned and told to ensure that he provides adequate clearance when shifting ground.
Approaching the 800 Metres, GENEROUS BOBO commenced to race keenly and had to be checked away from the heels of ELECTRONIC EMPIRE (N Callan) which was steadied after assuming the lead.  After being checked, GENEROUS BOBO shifted out and was then checked away from the heels of WILD BOY.  SEE ME NOW, which was following, was checked in consequence.  N Callan and K C Leung were advised that whilst their riding on this occasion was not considered to be in breach the Rules, nonetheless they were warned against the practice of easing the tempo unduly after assuming the lead.
Passing the 500 Metres, NEVER BETTER was steadied away from the heels of CONFUCIUS SPIRIT.  NEVER BETTER was then awkwardly placed close to the heels of CONFUCIUS SPIRIT for some distance and was unable to improve its position approaching the Home Turn.
Making the Home Turn, GENEROUS BOBO was awkwardly placed outside the heels of ELECTRONIC EMPIRE which came under pressure and commenced to lose ground.
Near the 250 Metres, SEE ME NOW raced tight inside ELECTRONIC EMPIRE which got its head on the side and lay in when continuing to weaken quickly.
Over the concluding stages, GENEROUS BOBO was awkwardly placed inside the heels of UNIQUE JOYFUL and as a consequence was not able to be fully tested.
When questioned, O Doleuze stated that POWERMAX raced greenly under pressure in the Straight and was inclined to lay out.  He said he used the whip in the left hand on a number of occasions to correct POWERMAXâs tendency to lay out before riding it out in a hands and heels fashion over the concluding stages.
When questioned regarding her riding of RICHCITY FORTUNE approaching the 1000 Metres, Apprentice K K Chiong advised that she was instructed to lead on the horse if possible.  She said however that RICHCITY FORTUNE began only fairly and then had to be steadied soon after the start when WILD BOY shifted out.  She said after racing in an awkward position inside POWERMAX approaching the first turn, she then allowed RICHCITY FORTUNE to improve forward, however, after leaving the 1000 Metres RICHCITY FORTUNE was placed in restricted room due to UNIQUE JOYFUL shifting in slightly to its outside.  She added RICHCITY FORTUNE, which was wearing blinkers for the first time, commenced to race fiercely and as WILD BOY was racing in advance of RICHCITY FORTUNE and was not shifting in towards the rail, she elected to restrain RICHCITY FORTUNE and shift out and then improve around UNIQUE JOYFUL so as to attempt to find a position nearer to the lead in accordance with her instructions.
After the race, it was reported that UNIQUE JOYFUL had sustained a cut to the right hind fetlock.
A veterinary inspection of ELECTRONIC EMPIRE immediately following the race found that horse to have bled from both nostrils.
WILD BOY and NEVER BETTER were sent for sampling.

From wide barriers, LOVE CHUNGHWA and FORZA AVANTI were steadied and shifted across behind runners soon after the start.
After travelling a short distance, STARLIGHT shifted out, resulting in ROYAL SPIRIT being hampered and taken out onto LOVE CHUNGHWA which was also inconvenienced.  Then after passing the 1100 Metres, ROYAL SPIRIT was steadied and shifted to the inside of the heels of STARLIGHT to obtain a position closer to the rail.
Approaching the 900 Metres, GOOD COMPANION was steadied away from the heels of AMAZING FEELING which shifted out.  GOOD COMPANION then shifted in marginally, resulting in GREAT WISDOM being placed in restricted room.  Then as the pace steadied, SPEEDY ACHIEVER and PAKISTAN BABY were checked away from the heels of GREAT WISDOM and GOOD COMPANION respectively and in doing so shifted out abruptly.  STARLIGHT, FORZA AVANTI and LOVE CHUNGHWA which were following, were all hampered in consequence.
After the 800 Metres, GOOD COMPANION was left racing wide and without cover.

He said as the race progressed, due to the circumstances of the race, HAPPY CONTENDER was shuffled back to a midfield position albeit trailing PRAWN BABA which was a favoured runner.  He said along the Back Straight when the winner SHARP SAILOR made a forward move, he attempted to shift out to follow that horse, however, VANILLA improved quickly to his outside which prevented him from being able to follow SHARP SAILOR forward into the race.  He added when the tempo then quickened appreciably HAPPY CONTENDER was left flat-footed and took some time to gather momentum before closing off the race well.
A veterinary inspection of HO HO FEEL and ALLCASH immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
VICTORY BOYS, SHARP SAILOR and PRAWN BABA were sent for sampling.

BLOCKER DEE was withdrawn on 19.12.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter MOLLYâS JADE STAR.  Before being allowed to race again, BLOCKER DEE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
HAPPY METEOR began awkwardly.
From wide barriers, SUPER TURBO, BACK IN BLACK and GOLDEN HARVEST were all steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners to obtain a position closer to the rail.
Approaching the 200 Metres, VERBINSKY hung in under pressure and proved difficult to ride which resulted in its rider, N Callan, dropping his whip.  After passing the 200 Metres, VERBINSKY continued to shift in under pressure, resulting in TEAM FORTUNE being momentarily steadied.  N Callan was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he makes more effort to keep his mounts straight.
Approaching the 100 Metres, SUPER TURBO was shifted out across the heels of CHARITY JOY to obtain clear running.
C Y Ho reported that his instructions were to go forward on MOLLYâS JADE STAR and in accordance with his instructions he rode the horse along vigorously in the first 100 Metres in order to take up a prominent position.  He said however when he realized that he was likely to be caught extremely wide on the first turn, he elected to shift in behind runners to find a position closer to the rail but further back in the field than had been intended.
When questioned regarding his riding of TEAM FORTUNE in the early and middle stages, S de Sousa stated that he was instructed to be positive on TEAM FORTUNE and endeavour to assume a forward position.  He said he rode his mount along in the early stages, however, a number of runners were also ridden to obtain forward positions which left TEAM FORTUNE extremely wide making the first turn.  He said on entering the Back Straight he steadied TEAM FORTUNE for a short distance and gave consideration to shifting across behind DRAGON GENERAL, however, he quickly assessed that even this manoeuvre would have resulted in TEAM FORTUNE being left at least five wide and most likely without cover in the event that DRAGON GENERAL was able to go forward and take up a leading position.  He added therefore he allowed TEAM FORTUNE to stride forward along the Back Straight and eventually shift in at the 500 Metres to race outside CHARITY JOY albeit still three wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of DRAGON GENERAL, TEAM FORTUNE and HAPPY METEOR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
COUNTRY MELODY and SUPER TURBO were sent for sampling.

ALL TIMES LUCKY and FREE NOVEMBER bumped at the start.
HAPPY FIERY DRAGON shifted out on jumping and hampered LEAN JOURNEY.
Shortly after the start, INTELLECTUAL GLIDE, which was being steadied to obtain cover, was awkwardly placed between STARRY STARLIES and BERNARD'S CHOICE which was also being steadied.
Near the 900 Metres, SMART GAIN was crowded for room inside NO LAUGHING MATTER which got its head on the side and shifted in despite the efforts of its rider.
Passing the 900 Metres, BERNARD'S CHOICE was crowded for room inside EVERYONE'S CHOICE which, when improving into tight running inside FREE NOVEMBER, was taken in by that horse.
Making the turn after the 900 Metres, GOLDEN CANNON became unbalanced and shifted out towards the heels of O'SOCOOLE.
Passing the 800 Metres, LUCKY SEBRING became unbalanced when momentarily crowded for room inside BERNARD'S CHOICE which was racing tight inside EVERYONE'S CHOICE which in turn was racing tight inside FREE NOVEMBER.
Near the 650 Metres, LEAN JOURNEY was steadied away from the heels of BERNARD'S CHOICE.

Passing the 400 Metres, EVERYONE'S CHOICE and FREE NOVEMBER raced tight.
Approaching the 200 Metres, FREE NOVEMBER, which was commencing to give ground, was steadied away from the heels of STARRY STARLIES (J Moreira) which shifted in before being corrected.  J Moreira was advised to exercise more care.
K C Leung (GOLDEN CANNON) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 200 Metres he permitted his mount to shift out when not clear of NO LAUGHING MATTER, causing that horse to be checked and to lose the running to which it was rightfully entitled.  K C Leung was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 18 January 2017 and to expire on Monday, 23 January 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, K C Leung was fined $15,000.
Approaching the 100 Metres, INTELLECTUAL GLIDE and EVERYONE'S CHOICE raced tight between HAPPY FIERY DRAGON and STARRY STARLIES which got its head on the side and shifted in away from LEAN JOURNEY as that horse improved to its outside.
Close to the finishing line, GOLDEN CANNON was steadied away from the heels of HAPPY FIERY DRAGON which, after being bumped by INTELLECTUAL GLIDE, shifted in away from that horse.

Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the riding of S Clipperton (O'SOCOOLE), 5th placegetter, over the concluding stages did not affect the horse's finishing position, he was nonetheless reminded of his obligation to ride his mounts out at least hands and heels all the way to the end of the race where circumstances permit.  S Clipperton was advised that as this was the 5th occasion this season that the Stewards had had cause to speak to him for failing to ride his mounts out all the way to the end of the race, he must address this aspect of his riding.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of RUGBY DIAMOND, Z Purton stated that although his mount was inclined to travel keenly in the middle stages after obtaining the lead, it had previously finished off its race after travelling in a similar manner.  He said making the turn after the 900 Metres RUGBY DIAMOND was inclined to lay out away from the rail, however, he believed that the horse would be able to finish off the race.  He added however RUGBY DIAMOND came under pressure in the early part of the Straight and then weakened noticeably over the latter stages.  A veterinary inspection of RUGBY DIAMOND immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of RUGBY DIAMOND, a favourite for today's race, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race, RUGBY DIAMOND will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of NO LAUGHING MATTER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
RUGBY DIAMOND, LEAN JOURNEY and INTELLECTUAL GLIDE were sent for sampling.

Passing the winning post on the first occasion, GOODHEART SUCCESS and LITTLE DRAGON were badly crowded for room inside ULTIMATE GLORY which was taken in by SUPER MAN (B Prebble) which, after initially shifting in with RED MARVEL to its outside, then got its head on the side and shifted in abruptly.  MAJESTIC ANTHEM and DEJA VU, which were following, were inconvenienced in consequence.  As the Stewards were satisfied that B Prebble had made appropriate endeavours to prevent SUPER MAN from shifting in prior to that horse getting into the running of ULTIMATE GLORY, no further action was taken, however, he was warned against the practice of shifting in too abruptly which then can make it difficult for horses to respond in a timely manner.
Passing the 1300 Metres, ELECTRONIC PHOENIX was steadied away from the heels of BEAUTY PRINCE.  After this, ELECTRONIC PHOENIX got its head up on a number of occasions when proving difficult to settle.

Passing the 200 Metres, O Doleuze (GOODHEART SUCCESS) dropped his whip.
Close to the finishing line, LITTLE DRAGON was shifted out away from the heels of ULTIMATE GLORY.
When questioned, S de Sousa stated that after the 600 Metres he attempted to shift out on ELECTRONIC PHOENIX to make his run on the outside of horses.  He said at this time he was racing to the inside of the heels of LITTLE DRAGON and he felt that he would have had to steady ELECTRONIC PHOENIX to come to the outside of that horse which would have had the effect of breaking ELECTRONIC PHOENIX's momentum.  He said he therefore decided to ride his mount along to take advantage of a run to the inside of LITTLE DRAGON and outside DEJA VU.  He said however that at that time BEAUTY PRINCE, which was racing in advance of ELECTRONIC PHOENIX, did not improve into the race as he had hoped and he was held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight.  He added he then attempted to improve between DEJA VU and BEAUTY PRINCE approaching the 250 Metres, however, had to be steadied when disappointed for running between those horses which both shifted ground.  He said ELECTRONIC PHOENIX was then held up for clear running until near the 150 Metres.  A veterinary inspection of ELECTRONIC PHOENIX immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
After the race, O Murphy reported that MAJESTIC ANTHEM was making an abnormal respiratory noise.  A subsequent veterinary inspection of MAJESTIC ANTHEM did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of BEAUTY PRINCE immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, BEAUTY PRINCE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
MAGICAL BEAUTY, TRAVEL FIRST and RED MARVEL were sent for sampling.
<28/12/2016  Additional Veterinary Report>The Clinical Veterinary Surgeon reported that MAJESTIC ANTHEM was lame in its left front fetlock on the morning after racing.  Before being allowed to race again, MAJESTIC ANTHEM will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

When questioned, O Murphy stated that he had ridden SILVER GATSBY in some of its track work and in a barrier trial leading up to today's race and in the barrier trial, the horse had been reluctant to compete and he had had to ride it along for a considerable distance to prevent it from dropping out of the trial.  He said with this in mind, he rode SILVER GATSBY along in the early stages to take up a forward position and after being able to obtain the lead, he was then reluctant to steady the horse as he was concerned that it would come off the bridle and then would not race competitively.  He said although he realized that the race was being run at a faster tempo than what he might have hoped, he believed that this was a better option given his knowledge of the horse.  He added he felt that the best way for the horse to be competitive would be to try and establish a break over the field approaching the Home Turn, however, once IMPERIAL SEAL improved to the outside of SILVER GATSBY passing the 300 Metres, SILVER GATSBY then gave ground abruptly.

ZOOMOOL began only fairly.

ENCHANTED FEELING was withdrawn on 26.12.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter VICTORY HEART (M L Yeung).  Before being allowed to race again, ENCHANTED FEELING will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SUPER SIXTEEN and WIN FOR CHARITY were slow to begin.
CURLING LUXURY shifted out at the start and bumped the hindquarters of JUMBO HAPPINESS.
Making the turn after the 900 Metres, KWAICHUNG BROTHERS got its head up and shifted out towards the heels of WIN FOR CHARITY which was racing tight inside WINNER ST PAUL'S.
SUPER SIXTEEN was held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight and approaching the 250 Metres was shifted in away from the heels of SPRING WIN which hung in under pressure.
Throughout the race, BOSSIEE travelled wide and without cover.
VICTORY DUKE finished tailed out after travelling wide and without cover for the majority of the race.  A veterinary inspection of VICTORY DUKE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.  The performance of VICTORY DUKE was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, VICTORY DUKE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of AUTOPAY, J Moreira stated that after riding his mount along in the early stages to obtain a forward position, AUTOPAY got its head up on a number of occasions approaching the 900 Metres as he attempted to steady the horse to obtain cover behind BOSSIEE.  He said because of the manner in which AUTOPAY was racing, he was not able to obtain a trailing position behind BOSSIEE, however, he was satisfied with the manner in which the horse was travelling during the middle stages.  He added he placed AUTOPAY under pressure in the early part of the Straight, but rather than improve its position the horse gave ground and after riding it along, he eased it down over the final 200 Metres as he was concerned for the horse's welfare.  He said however that after the race he was not able to detect any abnormalities with AUTOPAY.  Mr C S Shum, the trainer of AUTOPAY, said the horse had done well since its last start and he expected it to race competitively today.  He said although the horse had lost some body weight in the lead up to today's race, nonetheless it had eaten up as normal and he was satisfied with the horse's condition for today's race.  He said he was not able to offer any explanation for the horse's disappointing performance as AUTOPAY had appeared to have pulled up well after the race.  A veterinary inspection of AUTOPAY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.  The performance of AUTOPAY, one of the favoured runners for today's race, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, AUTOPAY will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
HOT HOT PEPPER, SUPER SIXTEEN and SPRING WIN were sent for sampling.

He said in accordance with his instructions he rode his mount along in the early stages to take up a forward position and was content to lead the race on the rail, however, after the 1600 Metres HOLMES LEGEND improved from the outside barrier and as it appeared as though that horse was going to continue to challenge for the lead, he elected to take a trailing position behind that horse. He said however that after being placed under pressure rounding the Home Turn BO DUKE then did not finish off the race and was disappointing. A veterinary inspection of FLYING MACHINE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

SHINING CHAMPION was crowded for room on jumping between MEGATRON and HAPPY JOURNEY, both of which shifted ground.

CALL ME AWESOME was badly held up for clear running from passing the 350 Metres until near the 250 Metres at which time the horse was shifted to the outside of BEAUTY CONNECTION to improve.
Approaching the 200 Metres, S de Sousa, the rider of BEAUTY CONNECTION, attempted to shift that horse away from the heels of FAIRY TWINS which commenced to give ground.  BEAUTY CONNECTION remained awkwardly placed behind FAIRY TWINS and near the 100 Metres was checked when unable to improve behind that horse and when racing tight outside WINNING VANGOGH (A Badel) which shifted out under pressure.  A Badel was advised that whilst there were some circumstances to this incident, nonetheless he must make every endeavour to keep his mounts on a straight course.
EXCITING MOMENT was badly held up for clear running until after the 200 Metres.
Over the concluding stages, WINNING VANGOGH was awkwardly placed outside the heels of EXCITING MOMENT.
After the race, B Prebble reported that SMART DECLARATION hung in and proved difficult to ride for the majority of the race.
A veterinary inspection of GALLANT ROCK and BEAUTY CONNECTION immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of FAIRY TWINS immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer".
D B PIN and SUPER WISE were sent for sampling.

SUPER CHIC and AMAZING AGILITY were slow to begin.
From the outside barriers, SERGEANT TITANIUM, RENAISSANCE ART, STAR MAJESTIC and ISHVARA were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
For some distance approaching the 1800 Metres, SUPER CHIC got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of DINOZZO.
Approaching the 1200 Metres, AMBITIOUS CHAMPION was awkwardly placed close to the heels of CALIFORNIA DISEGNO.
After racing wide, SERGEANT TITANIUM was allowed to improve its position passing the 1200 Metres to race outside the lead.
SUPER CHIC lost its left front plate approaching the 1100 Metres.
When the tempo of the race quickened after the 1100 Metres, ISHVARA, despite being ridden along, became detached from the main body of the field.
After the 1000 Metres, SUPREME PROFIT was left racing wide and without cover.
Approaching the 700 Metres, RENAISSANCE ART was awkwardly placed close to the heels of DINOZZO.
Approaching and passing the 400 Metres, AMBITIOUS CHAMPION was reluctant to shift to the outside of AMAZING AGILITY.
After the race, C Williams reported that MCQUEEN travelled satisfactorily in the early and middle stages, however, rounding the Home Turn he became concerned with the horse's action in that it gave ground quickly.  He said that given the manner in which MCQUEEN was giving ground, he eased it down in the Straight fearing there was something amiss with the horse.  A veterinary inspection of MCQUEEN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of MCQUEEN, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, MCQUEEN will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of GREEN DISPATCH immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SUPREME PROFIT and DINOZZO were sent for sampling.

Trainer C W Chang was fined the sum of $3,000 for presenting MY FOLKS in the Parade Ring with a tongue tie which was not part of the horse's declared gear.
Trainer C W Chang pleaded guilty to a charge under Rule 155(5) of inappropriate behaviour, the inappropriate behaviour being that in the vicinity of the saddling stalls located in the Parade Ring prior to this race, he directed inappropriate language and made inappropriate contact with members of his stable staff.  For this offence, Mr Chang was fined the sum of $10,000.
On entering the track, LOYAL CRAFTSMAN made contact with a running rail.  On arrival at the Start, LOYAL CRAFTSMAN was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
MY FOLKS, which was leaning on the outside of its stall when the start was effected, began only fairly.
KERKENI was slow to begin.
SWEET BEAN and GLAMOROUS RYDER bumped at the start.
TELEPHATIA, ROCK THE TREE, HIGH SPEED METRO and LOYAL CRAFTSMAN were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
WIN CHANCE got its head up passing the 1800 Metres.
Approaching the 700 Metres, KERKENI was steadied away from the heels of SWEET BEAN.
Rounding the Home Turn, VIVACIOUS WINNER was awkwardly placed inside the heels of FRANCE VALOUR which was giving ground.
Approaching the 300 Metres, GLAMOROUS RYDER and TELEPHATIA bumped.
Passing the 300 Metres, VIVACIOUS WINNER was momentarily eased away from the heels of LOYAL CRAFTSMAN which shifted out.
SWEET BEAN had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight and approaching the 200 Metres was steadied away from the heels of KERKENI which was eased to avoid the heels of ROCK THE TREE (B Prebble) which shifted in.  B Prebble was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is sufficiently clear when shifting ground.  At the same point, GLAMOROUS RYDER shifted out and bumped TELEPHATIA, resulting in both horses becoming unbalanced.  Then passing the 200 Metres, GLAMOROUS RYDER was momentarily eased away from the heels of LOYAL CRAFTSMAN (S Clipperton) which shifted out to obtain clear running.  S Clipperton was advised to exercise more care when shifting ground.
Approaching the 100 Metres, TELEPHATIA and KERKENI brushed.
Throughout the race, FRANCE VALOUR travelled wide and without cover and in the Straight was eased down.  A veterinary inspection of FRANCE VALOUR immediately following the race found that horse to have bled from both nostrils.
When questioned, A Badel stated that he had viewed some of CHOICE EXCHEQUER's previous races and had noted that when CHOICE EXCHEQUER had been attempted to be steadied, the horse had travelled keenly and he was asked to ensure that the horse travelled comfortably in today's race.  He said after obtaining the lead in the early stages, CHOICE EXCHEQUER was travelling comfortably, however, after the 1600 Metres was racing at a quicker tempo than he had hoped.  He said although he was aware that the tempo he was setting was genuine during this part of the race, he was reluctant to attempt to steady CHOICE EXCHEQUER too much to ensure that the horse remained as relaxed as possible in the circumstances.  He said he was also reluctant to direct CHOICE EXCHEQUER to race on the rail as the horse was travelling in a relaxed manner racing one horse away from the rail.  He added as this principally occurred along the Back Straight, he was not overly concerned about not racing on the rail.  A Badel was cautioned against raising his whip arm above the height of his shoulder.
A veterinary inspection of MY FOLKS immediately following the race found that horse to be distressed and an endoscopic examination also showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, MY FOLKS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
MY FOLKS, ROCK THE TREE and HIGH SPEED METRO were sent for sampling.

WUSHU CHAMPION began awkwardly.
SEASONS BLOOM was slow to begin,
Shortly after the start, MONGOLIAN KING was crowded for room between BEAT THE CLOCK and JOLLY CONVERGENCE which shifted in.  After this, from a wide barrier, MONGOLIAN KING was shifted across behind runners.
LE PANACHE was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After being crossed by JOLLY CONVERGENCE (Apprentice H T Mo) near the 1000 Metres, GO BABY GO proved difficult to settle and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of JOLLY CONVERGENCE for some distance.  Apprentice Mo was warned against the practice of easing the pace of races too abruptly.
After the 1000 Metres, PROUD SKY proved very difficult to settle and was checked away from the heels of WUSHU CHAMPION.
Passing the 900 Metres, BEAT THE CLOCK shifted out away from the heels of GO BABY GO which continued to be awkwardly placed close to the heels of JOLLY CONVERGENCE.  After this, BEAT THE CLOCK became awkwardly placed close to the heels of REGENCY BO BO.
Making the turn after the 900 Metres, PRINCIPAL, which throughout the race travelled wide and without cover, was bumped by THE SUPREME which shifted out when awkwardly placed close to the heels of REGENCY BO BO.  After this, THE SUPREME raced wide and without cover.
Near the 650 Metres, STAR SUPERIOR was crowded for room between PRINCIPAL and EL SHERIF which shifted out away from the heels of BEAT THE CLOCK when that horse was again steadied away from the heels of REGENCY BO BO.
MONGOLIAN KING lay out making the Home Turn.
Passing the 400 Metres, WUSHU CHAMPION was shifted to the inside of EL SHERIF after being held up for clear running behind that horse.
The performance of PRINCIPAL, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, PRINCIPAL will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SEASONS BLOOM and REGENCY BO BO were sent for sampling.

When parading behind the barriers, MIDNIGHT RATTLER was kicked by another runner.  MIDNIGHT RATTLER was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
Just prior to the start being effected, INVINCIBLE DRAGON became fractious and then as the start was effected sat back, resulting in the horse losing a considerable amount of ground.  Before being allowed to race again, INVINCIBLE DRAGON will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.
MARVEL TRIBE and PERPETUAL TREASURE were badly crowded for room on jumping between FLYING MOOCHI and CLEVER BEAVER, both of which shifted ground.
SECRET COMMAND began awkwardly.
From wide barriers, KEY WITNESS and TURF SPRINT were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
For some distance after the 1000 Metres, FLYING MOOCHI, after being crossed by MR STUNNING, proved very difficult to settle and was checked away from the heels of that horse.
Passing the 1000 Metres, SECRET COMMAND raced tight between MERION and TURF SPRINT.
MERION was unable to obtain clear running from on straightening until after the 100 Metres.
CLEVER BEAVER was held up for a run in the early part of the Straight and near the 350 Metres was shifted to the outside of MIDNIGHT RATTLER to obtain clear running.
For some distance after the 200 Metres, PERPETUAL TREASURE and LINE SEEKER were awkwardly placed inside the heels of SO FAST which got its head on the side and shifted in away from MIDNIGHT RATTLER.
PERPETUAL TREASURE was unable to obtain clear running at any stage in the Straight and consequently was not able to be tested.
Throughout the race, MOST BEAUTIFUL travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of LINE SEEKER, Z Purton stated that he had to make use of the horse in the middle stages to prevent SO FAST from improving to his outside.  He said he was reluctant to allow SO FAST to gain an advantage over LINE SEEKER as the tempo of the race had been genuine and he did not want to be caught behind the leaders if they commenced to weaken.  He said because he had to make use of LINE SEEKER, he felt that the horse was then not able to finish off the race as strongly as it might otherwise would have done.  He said although LINE SEEKER was placed in restricted room inside SO FAST after the 200 Metres, in his opinion, the horse was beaten at this stage and had little effect on the horse's finishing position.  A veterinary inspection of LINE SEEKER immediately following the race confirmed the horse to be a "roarer" which had previously been reported.
MR STUNNING, MIDNIGHT RATTLER and INVINCIBLE DRAGON were sent for sampling.

MASSIVE MOVE and BOND ELEGANCE bumped at the start.  MASSIVE MOVE then shifted in and bumped AMAZING MOMENT.  This resulted in all three horses becoming unbalanced.
BELOVED and WINNING CONTROLLER were slow to begin.
GENTILIS shifted out at the start and bumped EMPIRE OF MONGOLIA.
Approaching the 900 Metres, BOND ELEGANCE was bumped by MASSIVE MOVE which was steadied away from the heels of PEACE COMBINATION (M Chadwick) which shifted out.  M Chadwick was reprimanded and warned against the practice of shifting his mounts at too abrupt an angle.
Approaching the 800 Metres, AMAZING MOMENT was momentarily steadied away from the heels of MASSIVE MOVE which shifted in after being bumped by BOND ELEGANCE.
Near the 250 Metres, AMAZING MOMENT was awkwardly placed inside the heels of BOND ELEGANCE.
Approaching and passing the 100 Metres, BOND ELEGANCE was awkwardly placed outside the heels of PEACE COMBINATION and then after the 50 Metres raced in restricted room between EXPONENTS and PEACE COMBINATION which lay out under pressure.
After the race, B Prebble stated that TEN SPEED did not feel comfortable in its action over the latter stages of the race.  A veterinary inspection of TEN SPEED immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Before being allowed to race again, TEN SPEED will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
BOND ELEGANCE, FISH N' CHIPS and LONDON MASTER were sent for sampling.

DANEWIN EXPRESS was bumped shortly after the start by PLAIN BLUE BANNER which shifted out.  In this incident, PLAIN BLUE BANNER became unbalanced.  Then from wide barriers, PLAIN BLUE BANNER, DANEWIN EXPRESS and FANTASTICLIFE were all shifted across behind runners.
ROYAL SPIRIT began awkwardly and bumped the hindquarters of HARMONY PARTNERS.  ROYAL SPIRIT then became unbalanced and stumbled.
PLAIN BLUE BANNER lost its left hind plate shortly after the start.
Passing the 1200 Metres, ROYAL SPIRIT broke down and was retired out of the race.  A veterinary inspection of ROYAL SPIRIT immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its left front fetlock.  Before being allowed to race again, ROYAL SPIRIT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When being steadied approaching and passing the 1100 Metres, POWER DRAGON got its head up and proved difficult to settle.
After the 900 Metres, FUNNY BUDDIES was left racing wide and without cover.
Rounding the Home Turn, WINGOLD got its head on the side and lay out and then in the early part of the Straight was shifted in away from the heels of POWER DRAGON to obtain clear running.
FANTASTICLIFE had some difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight.
T H So (MASSIVE POWER) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that passing the 350 Metres he permitted his mount to shift out when not clear of SPICY DOUBLE, causing that horse to be checked and to lose the running to which it was rightfully entitled.  T H So was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 8 January 2017 and to expire on Thursday, 12 January 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards took into account T H So's good race riding record.
The performance of THUNDERSTROKE, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, THUNDERSTROKE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
J Moreira (SPICY DOUBLE) was reminded of his obligation to ride his mounts out to the best of his ability over the concluding stages where circumstances permit.
After the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on FUNNY BUDDIES at the request of Trainer D J Hall.  The Veterinary Surgeon reported that this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, FUNNY BUDDIES will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
WINGOLD and PLAIN BLUE BANNER were sent for sampling.

DASHING DART began awkwardly and bumped the outside of its barrier.
NEWSWIRE FREE was slow to begin and then from the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners.
TRIUMPHANT LIGHT began awkwardly.
BEST REWARD was crowded for room on jumping between AUDACITY and LIGHTNING AND GOLD which shifted out.
After the 1100 Metres, HAPPY GAINS travelled keenly in the lead.
Rounding the Home Turn, NEWSWIRE FREE and LIGHTNING AND GOLD raced tight as LIGHTNING AND GOLD shifted out to obtain clear running.
Just prior to the 50 Metres, DASHING DART (S Clipperton) shifted out under pressure and bumped VICTORY MASTER.  S Clipperton then directed DASHING DART in to avoid further contact with VICTORY MASTER.
In the Straight, TRIUMPHANT LIGHT drifted out under pressure.
GO BEAUTY GO and TRIUMPHANT LIGHT were sent for sampling.

SMILING GLORY shifted out at the start, resulting in EASTERN PROWESS being bumped and taken out onto ROBUST MOMENTUM which was hampered.
YOU KNOW WHO began awkwardly and then was awkwardly placed outside the heels of INFINITY ENDEAVOUR which shifted out.
From wide barriers, RATTAN, STAR OF PATCH and DON WONGCHOY were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After the 1100 Metres, YOU KNOW WHO travelled keenly when being steadied to obtain cover.
ALL MY GAIN had some difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight.
MASSIVE MILLENNIUM was unable to obtain clear running until after the 300 Metres.
Passing the 250 Metres, ROBUST MOMENTUM was bumped by STAR OF PATCH which got its head on the side and shifted out away from HAPPY SOUND.  This resulted in both STAR OF PATCH and ROBUST MOMENTUM becoming unbalanced.
Near the 150 Metres, PRINCE HARMONY and STAR OF PATCH (Z Purton), which was hanging out, bumped as a result of PRINCE HARMONY shifting in marginally and STAR OF PATCH continuing to hang out.  A short distance later, PRINCE HARMONY was checked when crowded for room between STAR OF PATCH which continued to hang out and INFINITY ENDEAVOUR which shifted in.  Then passing the 100 Metres, STAR OF PATCH continued to hang out and bumped the hindquarters of INFINITY ENDEAVOUR which became badly unbalanced.  STAR OF PATCH continued to lay out over the concluding stages.  Having regard to the racing manners of STAR OF PATCH, the Stewards were satisfied that Z Purton had made reasonable endeavour to prevent that horse from shifting ground.
Throughout the race, HAPPY SOUND travelled wide and without cover.
INFINITY ENDEAVOUR, STAR OF PATCH and DARING FIT were sent for sampling.

When proceeding to the barriers, ENDEARING became fractious, resulting in S de Sousa being dislodged without incident.
BLAZE STAMINA shifted out at the start and bumped the hindquarters of KING MORTAR.
From the outside barrier, OUR FOLKS bounded as the start was effected and then was shifted across behind runners.
Also from wide barriers, FUN MACHINE and DIAMOND LEGEND were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After being crossed by KING MORTAR near the 1100 Metres, BLAZE STAMINA shifted out, resulting in FAVOURITISM being bumped and taken out onto RACING MATE.
When being steadied approaching and passing the 1100 Metres, ENDEARING travelled keenly and got its head up on a number of occasions.
Approaching the 900 Metres, BLAZE STAMINA, which was over-racing, shifted out away from the heels of ENDEARING, resulting in SUPER LEADER being hampered.
ENDEARING got its head on the side and hung out in the middle stages and rounding the Home Turn shifted out, resulting in SUPER LEADER and FOREVER RED being hampered and taken wider.  After this, ENDEARING gave ground abruptly.  A veterinary inspection of ENDEARING immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm.  Before being allowed to race again, ENDEARING will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
BOTH LUCKY had some difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Passing the 350 Metres, RAINBOW FIGHTER, which was commencing to give ground, was steadied when crowded for room between FAVOURITISM and KING MORTAR (S Clipperton) which shifted out.  S Clipperton was severely reprimanded.
FOREVER RED lay in approaching and passing the 200 Metres,.
Over the final 75 Metres, FAVOURITISM shifted out and raced tight inside KEEN VENTURE (B Prebble).  Due to FAVOURITISM shifting out, B Prebble was restricted in the manner in which he could ride his mount out.  Just prior to the winning post, FAVOURITISM faltered.  A veterinary inspection of FAVOURITISM immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, FAVOURITISM will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Over the concluding stages, KING MORTAR shifted out under pressure.
When questioned, C Y Ho stated that after riding FUN MACHINE along rounding the Home Turn, he directed the horse to the outside of runners in the early part of the Straight.  He said near the 150 Metres FUN MACHINE shifted out when struck with the whip and therefore he put the whip away to gather up the reins to prevent FUN MACHINE from shifting out further.  He said after he straightened FUN MACHINE, he resumed riding the horse along after the 100 Metres including using the whip in the right hand on FUN MACHINE.  C Y Ho was advised that his explanation would be reported, however, he must ensure that he rides his mounts with sufficient vigour so as not to come under notice.
A veterinary inspection of SUPER LEADER immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its right front leg and an endoscopic examination also showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, SUPER LEADER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of JADE THEATRE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SUPER LEADER, KING MORTAR and KEEN VENTURE were sent for sampling.

SNOW SLIDER was withdrawn on 31.12.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter RIGHT CALL (Apprentice K K Chiong).  Before being allowed to race again, SNOW SLIDER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
As the start was effected, HAPPY BEAUTY lifted its front feet off the ground, resulting in the horse losing ground.
GOLDEN ACHIEVER began only fairly and shortly after the start was hampered by GREAT TREASURE which shifted out.
GOLDIE FLANKER began awkwardly.
From wide barriers, SWEET HOME and TEAM SWEET were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After the 1000 Metres, AMBITIOUS HEART got its head up when proving difficult to settle.
After initially being taken out by AMBITIOUS HEART approaching the 400 Metres, SMILING CHARM shifted out away from that horse, resulting in TEAM SWEET being hampered and directed out onto GOLDIE FLANKER which became unbalanced when crowded for room inside GOLDEN ACHIEVER.  Then passing the 350 Metres, GOLDIE FLANKER was again crowded for room between GOLDEN ACHIEVER and TEAM SWEET which continued to race in restricted room outside SMILING CHARM.
In the early part of the Straight, SWEET HOME hung in and proved reluctant to shift to the outside of GOLDEN ACHIEVER.
Passing the 300 Metres, MEISTERSTUECK was bumped by AMBITIOUS HEART which shifted out to obtain clear running.
Throughout the race, MEISTERSTUECK travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, O Murphy stated that he was instructed to ride SWEET HOME quietly from a wide barrier.  He said in the early part of the race SWEET HOME proved difficult to settle and was inclined to get its head up on a number of occasions.  He said rounding the Home Turn he attempted to shift SWEET HOME to the outside of GOLDEN ACHIEVER, however, the horse hung in and proved reluctant to shift to the outside of that horse.  He said he was able to shift SWEET HOME out after the 400 Metres and immediately placed the horse under pressure, however, SWEET HOME continued to hang in in the Straight and proved difficult to ride.
A veterinary inspection of GOLDEN ACHIEVER and SMILING CHARM immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
TEAM SWEET, A BEAUTIFUL and GREAT TREASURE were sent for sampling.

MR BOGART was withdrawn on 29.12.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore).  Before being allowed to race again, MR BOGART will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
DASHING FELLOW, which was fractious in the barriers, began only fairly and then was ridden along in the early stages to obtain the lead.
Shortly after the start, JOYFUL TRINITY raced in restricted room between RACING SUPERNOVA and BEAUTY FLAME.
After being crossed by DASHING FELLOW in the early stages, BEAUTY FLAME shifted out from behind that horse, resulting in RACING SUPERNOVA being taken into a three wide position without cover near the 900 Metres.  RACING SUPERNOVA was then allowed to stride forward to race outside the lead after the 700 Metres.
Rounding the Home Turn, SUN JEWELLERY was taken wider by BEAUTY FLAME which, when shifting to the outside of RACING SUPERNOVA, got its head on the side and shifted out further.
Passing the 350 Metres, CONTENTMENT was momentarily awkwardly placed inside the heels of RACING SUPERNOVA which shifted in.
Approaching the 300 Metres, JOYFUL TRINITY raced in restricted room inside DASHING FELLOW when improving into tight running inside that horse.
Passing the 200 Metres, CONTENTMENT was hampered when crowded for room between RACING SUPERNOVA and DASHING FELLOW (A Badel) which shifted out under pressure.  A Badel was advised to exercise more care.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of SUN JEWELLERY, N Callan stated that he was satisfied with the manner in which his mount travelled in the early and middle stages and at the entrance to the Straight he expected SUN JEWELLERY to finish off the race well.  He said SUN JEWELLERY initially quickened satisfactorily, however, after the 300 Metres the horse commenced to give ground and its action deteriorated.  He said he continued to ride the horse along until well after the 200 Metres, however, SUN JEWELLERY continued to give ground and as the horse did not feel comfortable in its action, he eased it down over the final 150 Metres.  He added SUN JEWELLERY trotted back soundly after the race, however, he detected the horse to be making a slight abnormal breathing noise.  A veterinary inspection of SUN JEWELLERY immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of mucopus in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, SUN JEWELLERY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After the race, it was reported that BEAUTY FLAME was lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, BEAUTY FLAME will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
BLIZZARD and DASHING FELLOW were sent for sampling.

CHOICE TREASURE was withdrawn on 31.12.16 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore suspensory) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter CELESTIAL NOVA (Apprentice H T Mo).  Before being allowed to race again, CHOICE TREASURE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Whilst in the saddling stalls, SKY KING had its left hind plate refitted.  SKY KING was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
CLASSIC EMPEROR began awkwardly and lost its left front plate at the start.  CLASSIC EMPEROR then travelled wide and without cover for the majority of the race.
CLUB LIFE began awkwardly.
From wide barriers, CELESTIAL NOVA, SKY KING and HAPPY ROCKY were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
RAZOR QUEST had some difficulty obtaining clear running passing the 200 Metres.
When questioned regarding the improved performance of RAZOR QUEST, Mr C W Chang, the trainer of the horse, stated that he instructed the rider of the horse at its most recent start to take up a forward position if the tempo of the race allowed this to happen without too much use having to be made of RAZOR QUEST.  He said however that RAZOR QUEST did not finish off the race last start when ridden in a forward position from a wide barrier and the horse was able to enjoy a much better run in today's race from barrier 3 when able to be ridden from off the speed.
When questioned, J Moreira stated that, in his opinion, UNICRON JEWELLERY's performance in today's race was not as disappointing as it might have appeared.  He said UNICRON JEWELLERY needs some time to gather momentum and when the tempo quickened at the entrance to the Straight UNICRON JEWELLERY was left flat-footed.  He said passing the 200 Metres UNICRON JEWELLERY commenced to finish off the race well, however, was reluctant to improve into tight running inside CLUB LIFE approaching and passing the 100 Metres.  He said, in his opinion, had UNICRON JEWELLERY obtained clear running, the horse would have finished closer to the placegetters than it did.  A veterinary inspection of UNICRON JEWELLERY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
After the race, it was reported that CLASSIC EMPEROR had sustained an overreach injury to the inside of the left front heel.
UNICRON JEWELLERY, RAZOR QUEST and BOOMING DELIGHT were sent for sampling.

Just prior to the start being effected, CHANS DELIGHT turned its head to the left.  CHANS DELIGHT was consequently slow to begin and travelled wide and without cover throughout the race.
ABLE TALENT began only fairly and shortly after the start was crowded for room between TELECOM BOOM and RICHCITY FORTUNE which shifted in.
OPTIMISM and INTELLECTUAL GLIDE were badly crowded for room on jumping between SIR JOHN and PERFECT SMART which, despite the efforts of its rider, got its head on the side and shifted in abruptly for some distance after the start.
OPTIMISM lay out making the turn after the 1000 Metres.
After the 400 Metres, ABLE TALENT was momentarily crowded for room between TELECOM BOOM and CHANS DELIGHT which shifted in marginally.
Near the 150 Metres, SIR JOHN and RICHCITY FORTUNE raced tight.
TREASURE AND GOLD travelled wide and without cover throughout the race.
TREASURE AND GOLD, INVISIBLE and FOREVER FUN were sent for sampling.

At declaration time, M L Yeung was declared as the rider of PEARL HARBOUR and WORLD CITY.  It was established that M L Yeung had a firm commitment to ride WORLD CITY.  As such, the Stewards permitted T H So to be substituted as the rider of PEARL HARBOUR.  For this declaration error, Trainer A Lee was fined $2,000.
WORLD CITY was withdrawn on 3.1.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter HAYMAKER (M L Yeung).  Before being allowed to race again, WORLD CITY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
GRACYDAD began only fairly.
NOTED PERFORMER was checked on jumping when crowded for room between PEARL HARBOUR and FANTASTIC FABIO which shifted out abruptly.
BREEDERSâ STAR was checked on jumping when crowded for room between PEARL HARBOUR and LUCKY KINGDOM which shifted in.  LUCKY KINGDOM was then shifted out abruptly to relieve the tightening to BREEDERSâ STAR.  After this, from a wide barrier, BREEDERSâ STAR was shifted across behind runners.
Approaching the 1100 Metres, GAME OF FUN was steadied when crowded for room inside HAYMAKER which was taken in by VERY RICH MAN (S de Sousa).  S de Sousa was severely reprimanded and told to ensure that he prevents his mounts from shifting ground when not clear of other horses.
Making the first turn after the 1000 Metres, when racing very wide, PEARL HARBOUR got its head on the side and hung out.  After this, PEARL HARBOUR travelled wide and without cover.  Then after briefly obtaining cover passing the 700 Metres, PEARL HARBOUR again hung out making the turn near the 550 Metres and subsequently finished tailed out.  A veterinary inspection of PEARL HARBOUR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The racing manners and performance of PEARL HARBOUR were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, PEARL HARBOUR will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial around a bend and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After the 800 Metres, LUCKY KINGDOM was left racing wide and without cover.
For some distance passing the 200 Metres, after endeavouring to improve between FANTASTIC FABIO and STARLOT, HAYMAKER was disappointed for running outside STARLOT approaching the 100 Metres when that horse shifted out.
Close to the finishing line, STARLOT was steadied away from the heels of GRACYDAD (J Moreira) which shifted in and consequently was unable to be ridden out all the way to the end of the race.  J Moreira was reprimanded and advised to exercise more care in similar circumstances.
When questioned regarding his riding of HAYMAKER approaching and passing the 500 Metres, M L Yeung stated that at this time he was following SPARKLING TALENT after having raced inside PEARL HARBOUR.  He said although he had noted that PEARL HARBOUR had hung out making the turn after the 550 Metres, he was reluctant to shift HAYMAKER out at this time as he was aware that GRACYDAD was improving between HAYMAKER and PEARL HARBOUR and he felt that shifting out may have caused interference to GRACYDAD.  He said GRACYDAD subsequently improved its position quickly around HAYMAKER and therefore he was unable to shift HAYMAKER out.  He added HAYMAKER was then held up for clear running for a short distance in the early part of the Straight before obtaining clear running to the inside of SPARKLING TALENT near the 250 Metres.  M L Yeung was advised that by not shifting out to prevent GRACYDAD from improving around HAYMAKER at this time of the race, his riding had come under notice.  He was further advised to ensure that he rides his mounts in such a manner so as to afford them the opportunity improve their positions and obtain clear running.
GRACYDAD, VERY RICH MAN and GAME OF FUN were sent for sampling.

As the start was effected, C P POWER bounded in the air and consequently lost ground.
WINNING BOY began awkwardly.
RAY OF GOLD began only fairly.
After initially being ridden along from a wide barrier, GOLDEN DEER was left racing wide and passing the 1100 Metres was then steadied and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 1000 Metres, C P POWER momentarily raced tight between VICTOR EMPEROR and NATURAL TEAM which shifted in before being directed out to relieve the tightening to C P POWER.
At the entrance to the Straight, COUR VALANT was shifted out across the heels of GRACE HEART to obtain clear running.  RAY OF GOLD, which was following COUR VALANT, was held up for clear running behind that horse in consequence.
When questioned regarding the performance of GRACE HEART, J Moreira stated that, from the outside barrier, he had been asked to ride the horse positively in the early stages if it showed sufficient speed to lead or to obtain a position with cover if possible.  He said making the first turn after the 1000 Metres GRACE HEART was left racing in a four wide position after having to be ridden along throughout the early stages to clear runners to its inside.  He said as GRACE HEART did not show sufficient speed to be able to cross three runners to his inside, he elected to steady GRACE HEART approaching the 900 Metres and he was able to obtain a good trailing position behind the eventual winner ISAAC after the 800 Metres.  He added when the tempo of the race quickened rounding the Home Turn, GRACE HEART immediately came under pressure and did not show any turn of foot.  He said, despite being placed under pressure in the Straight, GRACE HEART gave ground and raced disappointingly.  A veterinary inspection of GRACE HEART immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
When questioned, B Prebble (FIVE STARS AGENT) stated that he had anticipated that ISAAC might be able to cross ACE KING in the early stages and lead which would provide FIVE STARS AGENT the opportunity to race outside the lead. He said in accordance with his instructions he rode FIVE STARS AGENT positively in the early stages to obtain a forward position.  He said after the 1100 Metres it became apparent to him that the rider of ACE KING was intent on maintaining his positon to the inside of ISAAC and that the rider of that horse may have been steadying ISAAC to obtain cover.  He said however that, despite being ridden along, FIVE STARS AGENT did not show sufficient speed to be able to cross ISAAC and because of this was left racing wide and without cover throughout the race.  A veterinary inspection of FIVE STARS AGENT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ISAAC and COUR VALANT were sent for sampling.

ROYAL PARTNER was withdrawn on 3.1.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter VICTORY FOLLOW ME.  Before being allowed to race again, ROYAL PARTNER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
DIGITAL PIONEER was slow to begin.
Shortly after the start, MUTUAL JOY raced in restricted room between GO GO WIN and SPINNING DANCER which shifted out.
From the outside barrier, AGIAAL was steadied shortly after the start and shifted across behind runners.
Approaching the winning post on the first occasion, WISKY and GO GO WIN raced tight.
After the 900 Metres, VICTORY FOLLOW ME shifted in and bumped DIGITAL PIONEER.
At the 750 Metres, GO GO WIN and WISKY raced tight as WISKY improved around GO GO WIN.
After the 600 Metres, WIN IT and SPINNING DANCER bumped.
Approaching and passing the 400 Metres, SPINNING DANCER was awkwardly placed close to the heels of METALLIC STAR.
When questioned, Apprentice K K Chiong stated that she had been instructed to take up a forward position on METALLIC STAR and lead if circumstances allowed, however, it would be acceptable to take up a position in 2nd or 3rd place if the tempo was too strong.  She said, from barrier 9, she had to make considerable use of METALLIC STAR to take up a forward position and EMPEROR VICTORY, which was drawn immediately outside METALLIC STAR, showed more speed than her mount without being ridden aggressively in the early stages.  She said, despite being hard ridden, METALLIC STAR was unable to prevent EMPEROR VICTORY from crossing passing the winning post on the first occasion and after that horse obtained the lead on the rail, she was able to shift METALLIC STAR to race outside that horse after the 1200 Metres.  Apprentice Chiong said because of the amount of use she had to make of METALLIC STAR in the early stages, she felt that the best option was to position METALLIC STAR outside EMPEROR VICTORY rather than continuing on to lead.  She added even though the tempo of the race slackened appreciably after the 1200 Metres, she was reluctant to press on into the lead as she felt that it was in the horseâs best interests to be given a breather in the middle stages before again being pressured later in the race.  She said, in hindsight, it would have been better to have allowed METALLIC STAR to improve around EMPEROR VICTORY when the tempo of the race slackened after the 1200 Metres.  Apprentice Chiong was advised that whilst the Stewards acknowledged that she had made considerable use of her mount in the early stages, nonetheless having regard to her riding instructions, the opportunity was available to allow METALLIC STAR to improve around EMPEROR VICTORY of its own accord when that horse steadied the tempo in the lead.
When questioned, C Y Ho (EMPEROR VICTORY) stated that after riding his mount positively in the early stages to obtain the lead approaching the first turn, EMPEROR VICTORY was inclined to lay out making the turn after the 1300 Metres and he had to apply pressure to his right rein in an attempt to have his mount rail.  He said because he had to ride EMPEROR VICTORY in this manner, the pace of the race steadied more abruptly than he had hoped.  He said near the 1100 Metres, for a short distance EMPEROR VICTORY commenced to race more tractably and he allowed the horse to stride along, however, making the turn after the 1000 Metres EMPEROR VICTORY again lay out and once again he was required to apply more pressure to his right rein to help the horse around the turn.  He added because of the manner in which EMPEROR VICTORY was racing, he had to reduce the tempo of the race more than he had hoped as it was his intention to lead at a more genuine speed.  He said after entering the Back Straight he balanced EMPEROR VICTORY in order to have the horse run at a more genuine tempo, however, the horse was unable to increase the tempo which allowed a number of runners to come from behind EMPEROR VICTORY to assume the leading positions.
WISKY, CASA MASTER and SPINNING DANCER were sent for sampling.

ART OF RAW was slow to begin.
CHATER LEGEND shifted out at the start and bumped TEN FLAMES.
