IâM THE WON FOR U and RESPECT were sent for sampling.

TRILLION TREASURE was withdrawn on 16.1.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter HAPPY JOURNEY.  Before being allowed to race again, TRILLION TREASURE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
FORTUNE BROTHERS blundered on jumping and then shortly after the start was bumped by GRADE ONE which shifted out.  FORTUNE BROTHERS then shifted out away from GRADE ONE, resulting in STAR SUPERIOR losing ground when crowded for room inside CURLING LUXURY.
CONFUCIUS SPIRIT and GENEROUS BOBO bumped heavily at the start, resulting in both horses becoming unbalanced.
After initially being ridden along from the outside barrier, HAPPY JOURNEY was steadied shortly after the start and shifted across behind runners.
After the 800 Metres, FORTUNE BROTHERS commenced to travel keenly.
Making the first turn near the 700 Metres, STAR SUPERIOR got its head on the side and hung out across the heels of DRAGON WARRIOR, resulting in FORTUNE BROTHERS being hampered and taken out onto CONFUCIUS SPIRIT (D Whyte) which was severely checked and lost a significant amount of ground when crowded for room inside CURLING LUXURY.  In this incident, DRAGON WARRIOR became unbalanced as STAR SUPERIOR shifted out across its heels.  After the race, D Whyte said that due to the severe nature of the interference, he felt that CONFUCIUS SPIRIT may have suffered an injury and therefore he eased it down for the remainder of the race.  A veterinary inspection of CONFUCIUS SPIRIT and DRAGON WARRIOR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
KIROV was held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Approaching the 200 Metres, GRADE ONE shifted out, resulting in a run developing for a short distance for KIROV to improve between GRADE ONE and BOND ELEGANCE.  As KIROV was attempting to establish running between those horses near the 150 Metres, GRADE ONE shifted back in marginally, resulting in KIROV racing in restricted room for some distance until being steadied over the concluding stages due to GRADE ONE and BOND ELEGANCE both shifting marginal ground.  Because of this, KIROV was not able to be ridden out to the end of the race.  As the Stewards were satisfied that KIROV did not properly establish running to the inside of GRADE ONE prior to that horse shifting in slightly, no further action was taken.
Approaching the 50 Metres, HAPPY JOURNEY was shifted in away from the heels of KIROV to obtain clear running.
Throughout the race, GENEROUS BOBO and GRADE ONE travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of HELENâS CHOICE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
DRAGON WARRIOR, BOND ELEGANCE and GRADE ONE were sent for sampling.
<19/1/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>After the race, CONFUCIUS SPIRIT was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings. CONFUCIUS SPIRIT was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer D E Ferraris this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right hind leg and have sustained a wound to the right front pastern. Before being allowed to race again, CONFUCIUS SPIRIT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

ELECTRONIC PHOENIX and LE PANACHE began only fairly.
From the outside barriers, NOBLE ALPHA and PREMIUM CHAMPION were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, SUPER MAN shifted in and bumped TURIN PEARL, resulting in both horses becoming unbalanced.
Approaching the 400 Metres, BEAUTY PRINCE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of SUPER MAN.
Passing the 400 Metres, ELECTRONIC PHOENIX was shifted in away from the heels of HAPPY CONTENDER to obtain clear running.
Throughout the race, CARE FREE PRINCE travelled wide and without cover and in the Straight gave ground.  A veterinary inspection of CARE FREE PRINCE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of CARE FREE PRINCE, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, CARE FREE PRINCE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
The performances of LE PANACHE and PREMIUM CHAMPION, which finished tailed out, were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, LE PANACHE and PREMIUM CHAMPION will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned, S Clipperton stated that he had been asked to take up a forward position on SUPER MAN.  He said passing the winning post on the first occasion he was left racing in a three wide position with TURIN PEARL and BEAUTY PRINCE to his inside and he had to ride SUPER MAN along for some distance approaching and passing the 1400 Metres to clear TURIN PEARL.  He said as BEAUTY PRINCE was being steadied, he continued on into the lead approaching the 1200 Metres.  He said when being ridden along to cross runners to his inside, SUPER MAN had felt as though it was showing a tendency to run off the track and after reaching the lead continued to âfloatâ and shift ground.  He said he was concerned that if he eased SUPER MAN passing the 1200 Metres, the horse would either drop the bit and lose interest in the race or would shift ground, therefore he continued to niggle at the horse in an endeavour to keep its mind on the race.  He added he had noted in a number of its races when ridden by other riders, SUPER MAN had been ridden along from the 700 Metres which indicated to him that the horse is one-paced and therefore making the turn after the 700 Metres he commenced to ride his mount more vigorously to ensure that it was not left flat-footed when RED MARVEL commenced to improve its position.  He said whilst he was aware that the pace of the race had been strong, he felt that riding the horse in this manner would keep SUPER MAN focussed and not allow it to do anything untoward.  S Clipperton was advised that his explanation would be reported, however, he must ensure that he rides his mounts in such a manner so that they are given the opportunity to close off the race as best as they are able.
The Stewards will question O Doleuze regarding him not using the whip on HAPPY CONTENDER in this race prior to the Sha Tin racemeeting to be conducted on Sunday, 22 January 2017.
A veterinary inspection of RED MARVEL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
RED MARVEL, SKY KING and BEAUTY PRINCE were sent for sampling.

At declaration time, M L Yeung was declared as the rider of both VANILLA and CONSISTENT.  It was established that M L Yeung had a firm commitment to ride VANILLA.  As such, the Stewards permitted M Chadwick to be substituted as the rider of CONSISTENT.  For this declaration error, Trainer T P Yung was fined $2,000.
FLYING MACHINE began awkwardly.
GOLD DRAGON began only fairly.
From wide barriers, DIAMOND FRIENDS, GOOD FIT and DIGITAL PIONEER were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, CONSISTENT was awkwardly placed close to the heels of ENREACHING.
Approaching the 600 Metres, ENREACHING was steadied away from the heels of KITAYA which came under pressure.
Near the 450 Metres, ENREACHING and AUTUMN GOLD raced tight.
For the majority of the race, CONSISTENT travelled wide and without cover.
The performances of AUTUMN GOLD and KITAYA, which finished tailed out, were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, AUTUMN GOLD and KITAYA will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of DRAGON HARMONY, J Moreira stated that the horse travelled strongly in the early and middle stages as it usually does in its races.  He said after being ridden along rounding the Home Turn, DRAGON HARMONY initially quickened satisfactorily, however, passing the 300 Metres came under pressure and after this weakened out of the race.  A veterinary inspection of DRAGON HARMONY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of DRAGON HARMONY, a favourite for tonightâs race, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, DRAGON HARMONY will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of ENREACHING immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
DRAGON HARMONY, VANILLA and GOLD DRAGON were sent for sampling.

After being advised by Trainer P OâSullivan that WHO ELSE BUT YOU had sustained a quarter crack to the right front hoof, that horse was examined in the stables by the Veterinary Officer who subsequently reported that the horse was not suitable to race and accordingly was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  Before being allowed to race again, WHO ELSE BUT YOU will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
GOLDEN SUN and PROUD SKY were badly crowded for room on jumping between HAPPY METEOR and DRAGON MASTER which shifted out abruptly.  DRAGON MASTER then continued to shift out and was checked away from the heels of HAPPY METEOR.  This resulted in DRAGON MASTER, PROUD SKY and GOLDEN SUN all losing ground.  After this, GOLDEN SUN was ridden along to make up lost ground, however, failed to muster speed.
Despite being hard ridden in the early and middle stages, FIGHT HERO failed to muster speed.
DRAGON MASTER lost its left front plate passing the 800 Metres.
Throughout the race, WONDERFUL JOURNEY travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of GOLDEN SUN immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, GOLDEN SUN will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
CALIFORNIA WHIP and LOVE SHOCK were sent for sampling.
<19/1/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>The Veterinary Officer reported that SUNNY DRAGON was lame in its left front leg on the morning after racing. Before being allowed to race again, SUNNY DRAGON will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

PRINCE HARMONY was withdrawn on 21.1.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter BELOVED (C Schofield).  Before being allowed to race again, PRINCE HARMONY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
GENERAL OâREILLY and BELOVED were slow to begin.
MASSIVE MOVE, which began awkwardly, and JOLLY AMBER bumped at the start.
FUN MANAGER shifted out at the start and bumped CITY LEGEND.
Passing the 400 Metres, MERRYGOWIN shifted out away from VITAL SPRING which at this stage was directed to the outside of MASSIVE MOVE.
Over the final 400 Metres, HEALTHY LUCK raced with its head on the side and lay out under pressure and passing the 200 Metres was momentarily awkwardly placed inside the heels of KEEP MOVING which shifted in.
Over the final 150 Metres, CITY LEGEND hung out under pressure and proved difficult to ride.
A veterinary inspection of LUNAR ZEPHYR and MASSIVE MOVE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MERRYGOWIN, KEEP MOVING and CITY LEGEND were sent for sampling.

Prior to the start being effected, HIGH SPIRIT became fractious and as the gates opened lifted its front feet off the ground and consequently was slow to begin.
On jumping, PIKACHU bounded in the air and lost ground.
From wide barriers, TRAVEL SUCCESSOR and AGREE were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
AGREE lost its right hind plate at the 1200 Metres.
After the 700 Metres, CHARITY KINGDOM was left racing wide and without cover.
Near the 200 Metres, MIGHTY MAVERICK was checked when crowded for room inside MONGOLIAN KING (O Murphy) which shifted in abruptly after being struck with the whip.  Whilst this incident was one of some significance, the Stewards were satisfied that Jockey Murphy had corrected his mount as quickly as could be expected of a rider in those circumstances and accordingly no further action was taken.
When questioned, S Clipperton stated that he had been asked to obtain a forward position on JOLLY JOLLY in accordance with the horseâs usual racing pattern.  He said it was anticipated that HOUSE OF FUN and possibly TIME WARP may be ridden to obtain leading positions, however, if it was possible to cross those horses without having to make too much use of JOLLY JOLLY, he should attempt to lead, alternatively, if those horses maintained their position and he felt he would have to make too much use of JOLLY JOLLY to cross runners to its inside, it was permissible for him to take a trailing position.  He said in the early stages he rode his mount along to obtain a forward position, however, TIME WARP, which was drawn immediately to the inside of JOLLY JOLLY, was also being ridden aggressively and as HOUSE OF FUN, which was racing to the inside of TIME WARP, was able to take up a forward position without being ridden along, he judged that he would have had to make too much use of JOLLY JOLLY to cross those horses, therefore he steadied JOLLY JOLLY after the 1300 Metres and was able to obtain a trailing position on the rail behind HOUSE OF FUN.  He said JOLLY JOLLY enjoyed a good run throughout the race, however, the horse was reluctant to improve into tight running inside HOUSE OF FUN after the 300 Metres.  He added near the 200 Metres JOLLY JOLLY became unbalanced when HOUSE OF FUN shifted in marginally, however, at this time JOLLY JOLLY was not responding as he expected it would.  He said he gathered up JOLLY JOLLY after this incident and rode the horse out to the end of the race and, in his opinion, the horse finished off the race satisfactorily.  A veterinary inspection of JOLLY JOLLY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of HOUSE OF FUN, J Moreira stated that the horse, which was stepping up from 1200 Metres to 1400 Metres today, was able to obtain the lead in the early stages without being pressured to do so.  He said he was therefore surprised that after the 1200 Metres HOUSE OF FUN commenced to travel keenly given that he had not had to ride the horse along to be in the forward position.  He said HOUSE OF FUN travelled too keenly in the early and middle stages and consequently was not able to finish off the race as well as he had anticipated.  A veterinary inspection of HOUSE OF FUN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of TIME WARP immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HOUSE OF FUN, MR POTENTIAL and MONGOLIAN KING were sent for sampling.

WINNING VIBE began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped NAMJONG INVINCIBLE.
GENTRY and EASTERN PROWESS began only fairly.
REWARDING FLYER and MASTER STEED bumped at the start.
From wide barriers, CARRY TO WIN, NOTED PERFORMER and GREAT WISDOM were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After the 1000 Metres, EASTERN PROWESS raced with its head on the side and then making the turn after the 900 Metres hung out towards the heels of RATTAN and was checked.  EASTERN PROWESS continued to hang out and passing the 650 Metres was again checked and lost ground after shifting out across the heels of NAMJONG INVINCIBLE.  GENTRY, which was following EASTERN PROWESS, was inconvenienced in consequence.  The racing manners of EASTERN PROWESS were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, EASTERN PROWESS will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial around a bend.
Approaching the 500 Metres, GOOD FOR YOU and RATTAN raced tight as RATTAN shifted to the outside of REWARDING FLYER to obtain clear running.
Passing the 200 Metres, CARRY TO WIN was shifted to the outside of MASTER STEED after being disappointed for running between that horse and GOOD FOR YOU.
Also passing the 200 Metres, GENTRY shifted out under pressure, inconveniencing WINNING VIBE.
When questioned, O Doleuze stated that it had been decided to ride WINNING VIBE more quietly as the horse had not been finishing off its races of late when ridden in a forward position.  He said after being able to enjoy a good run behind midfield in the early and middle stages, he shifted WINNING VIBE to the outside of runners rounding the Home Turn and the horse finished off the race satisfactorily.
When questioned, A Badel stated that it was not anticipated that the race would be run at a fast tempo and therefore, from the outside barrier, he was asked to ride GOOD FOR YOU positively if it began well.  He said, alternatively, he was told that if GOOD FOR YOU were to miss the start, which it had done on occasions, he should shift the horse across behind runners in the early stages.  He said GOOD FOR YOU began fairly and therefore he elected to allow the horse to take up a forward position, however, was obliged to race three wide and without cover throughout.
GENTRY lost its right front plate after the race.
A veterinary inspection of GOOD FOR YOU, NAMJONG INVINCIBLE and REWARDING FLYER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
RIGHT CALL and RATTAN were sent for sampling.

After entering the track, O Doleuze was dislodged from MANHATTAN STRIKER which proceeded a short distance riderless without incident before being recaptured.
FREE NOVEMBER bounded in the air at the start and began only fairly.
SUPERNATURAL began only fairly and shortly after the start was crowded for room between SPICY DOUBLE and KING WINSA which was taken in by GOLDEN CANNON which got its head on the side and shifted in despite the efforts of its rider.  In this incident, SPICY DOUBLE became badly unbalanced when bumped on the hindquarters by SUPERNATURAL and KING WINSA was also hampered when crowded for room inside GOLDEN CANNON.
From wide barriers, MASSIVE POWER, STRIKING STAR and RED HORSE were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the 1200 Metres, STRIKING STAR commenced to prove very difficult to settle and got its head up for some distance when being checked away from the heels of GOLDEN CANNON.
After the 1100 Metres, GOLDEN CANNON was left racing wide and without cover and was allowed to stride forward to race outside the lead.
SPICY DOUBLE and STRIKING STAR both made the turn after the 900 Metres awkwardly.
SUPERNATURAL lay out making the Home Turn.
MANHATTAN STRIKER had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight.
GOLDIE FLANKER was held up for clear running for a considerable distance in the early part of the Straight and after obtaining clear running inside FREE NOVEMBER passing the 200 Metres got its head on the side, hung out and was not able to be properly tested.  The racing manners of GOLDIE FLANKER were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, GOLDIE FLANKER will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.
For some distance approaching and passing the 350 Metres, RED HORSE was held up for clear running when improving into tight running inside SUPERNATURAL.
Passing the 300 Metres, KING WINSA and MASSIVE POWER bumped due to both horses shifting ground.  After this, MASSIVE POWER lay in under pressure and approaching the 150 Metres shifted in and brushed KING WINSA.
RED HORSE was again held up for clear running passing the 250 Metres.
Over the concluding stages, KING WINSA raced tight between MASSIVE POWER and STRIKING STAR, both of which shifted ground.  Consequently KING WINSA was not able to be fully tested.
For the majority of the race, KINGâS STEED travelled wide and without cover.
KING WINSA, STRIKING STAR and MASSIVE POWER were sent for sampling.

DOUBLE DOWN was withdrawn on 20.1.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left hind foot) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter MASSIVE MILLENNIUM (D Whyte).  Before being allowed to race again, DOUBLE DOWN will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
MASSIVE MILLENNIUM began very awkwardly and got its head up on a number of occasions, resulting in the horse losing ground.  A short distance after the start, MASSIVE MILLENNIUM, from a wide barrier, was shifted across behind runners.
FORMULA GALORE began only fairly.
C P POWER and HAPPY BEAUTY lost ground when crowded for room on jumping between NOTHINGILIKEMORE which shifted out and HALL OF FAME which shifted in away from WILD BOY.  After this, C P POWER was hard ridden to make up lost ground, however, travelled wide and without cover throughout the race.  C P POWER also made the Home Turn awkwardly and shifted out.
From the outside barrier, GENTILIS was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
After the 1100 Metres, FOXBAT and EXCEL ONESELF raced tight inside HOT HOT PEPPER which was taken in momentarily by WILD BOY which was then shifted out to relieve the tightening.
Making the turn after the 900 Metres, HIGH VOLATILITY got its head on the side when awkwardly placed close to the heels of FOXBAT.
Rounding the Home Turn, WILD BOY raced tight between HAPPY GAINS and HOT HOT PEPPER which got its head on the side and lay out.
Passing the 350 Metres, FOXBAT was steadied when disappointed for running between HOT HOT PEPPER and WILD BOY.
SUPER EURO STAR was held up for clear running passing the 300 Metres and for some distance after the 250 Metres was awkwardly placed close to the heels of WILD BOY when attempting to improve into tight running between that horse and HAPPY GAINS.  After initially being disappointed for running between those horses, SUPER EURO STAR was shifted away from the heels of WILD BOY near the 150 Metres to obtain clear running, resulting in HAPPY GAINS being crowded for room inside EXCEL ONESELF.
A veterinary inspection of WILD BOY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
NOTHINGILIKEMORE and HIGH VOLATILITY were sent for sampling.

INFINITY ENDEAVOUR was withdrawn on 19.1.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (blood abnormality) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter KWAICHUNG BROTHERS.  Before being allowed to race again, INFINITY ENDEAVOUR will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
KWAICHUNG BROTHERS began awkwardly and shortly after the start was crowded for room between WINNER ST PAULâS and AMAZING MOMENT which shifted out after being bumped by GREAT TREASURE.
GOOD CHOICE AHEAD began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped RED ELYSEES.  After this, GOOD CHOICE AHEAD, together with CATCHMEIFYOUCAN and RED ELYSEES, from wide barriers, were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
DARING HEART began only fairly.
When attempting to improve around AMAZING MOMENT near the 550 Metres, BOLD STITCH became unbalanced when bumped by that horse which shifted to the outside of CONTRIBUTION.  Then rounding the Home Turn, AMAZING MOMENT and BOLD STITCH made further contact and became unbalanced as AMAZING MOMENT attempted to improve into tight running between BOLD STITCH and POLYMER LUCK which was taken out by CONTRIBUTION which in turn was taken out by KWAICHUNG BROTHERS which improved into tight running between CONTRIBUTION and SUNNY ORIENT.
Passing the 400 Metres, CATCHMEIFYOUCAN was steadied and shifted to the outside of DARING HEART after being disappointed for running inside that horse which was awkwardly placed inside the heels of KWAICHUNG BROTHERS.
PENANG HALL had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Passing the 350 Metres, POLYMER LUCK got its head on the side, hung in and proved difficult to ride.
Approaching the 250 Metres, DARING HEART was awkwardly placed close to the heels of KWAICHUNG BROTHERS prior to obtaining tight running between that horse and SUNNY ORIENT which was giving ground.  CATCHMEIFYOUCAN was held up for clear running behind DARING HEART at this time.  SUNNY ORIENT subsequently finished tailed out.  The performance of SUNNY ORIENT was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, SUNNY ORIENT will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Passing the 250 Metres, BOLD STITCH shifted in and inconvenienced AMAZING MOMENT.
Over the concluding stages, BOLD STITCH was awkwardly placed inside the heels of PENANG HALL.
Throughout the race, POLYMER LUCK travelled wide and without cover.
After the race, Z Purton said that over the concluding stages AMAZING MOMENT gave ground noticeably and shifted ground, resulting in him easing it down close to the finishing line.  A veterinary inspection of AMAZING MOMENT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
When questioned regarding the performance of CONTRIBUTION, S de Sousa stated that, as instructed, he rode the horse in a forward position.  He said although the race was run at a quick tempo in the early stages, he was reluctant to steady CONTRIBUTION to allow POLYMER LUCK to cross as CONTRIBUTION is a lazy horse and he felt it would have dropped the bit and lost interest in the race.  He said in the Straight CONTRIBUTION gave ground and was disappointing, however, he believed that the horse at this stage of its career is still quite immature.  A veterinary inspection of CONTRIBUTION immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of SUNNY ORIENT and DARING HEART immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CONTRIBUTION, RED ELYSEES and GREAT TREASURE were sent for sampling.
<23/1/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>After the race, AMAZING MOMENT was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  AMAZING MOMENT was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer P OâSullivan this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, AMAZING MOMENT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

race_name: THE TUNG WAH GROUP OF HOSPITALS CHALLENGE CUP (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
When proceeding to the barriers, the tongue tie fitted to ROMAN ODYSSEY became dislodged, requiring the tongue tie having to be replaced behind the barriers.
BEAUTY MASTER and TRAVEL DATUK began awkwardly.
SUPER WISE and WINNING VANGOGH bumped heavily at the start.
Shortly after the start, ROMAN ODYSSEY, HERE WE COME and ROMAN IMPERO were all badly crowded for room between FOREVER RED and EXCITING MOMENT which got its head on the side and shifted out abruptly despite the efforts of its rider.
After the 500 Metres, BIG FLASH hung in under pressure and proved difficult to ride.
Passing the 200 Metres, FOREVER RED was shifted out away from the heels of ACE KING.
Near the 150 Metres, HERE WE COME was shifted out away from the heels of TRAVEL DATUK after being held up for clear running behind that horse.
Approaching the 150 Metres, MORDICUS was steadied after getting its head on the side and shifting in away from ACE KING which shifted to the inside of THOR THE GREATEST to obtain clear running.  MORDICUS then gave ground abruptly.  A veterinary inspection of MORDICUS immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, MORDICUS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Passing the 150 Metres, BIG FLASH was brushed by ROMAN ODYSSEY which shifted in.
At the 100 Metres, HERE WE COME shifted in and bumped BIG FLASH.
After the race, it was reported that EXCITING MOMENT was lame in its right front leg with a swollen tendon and that HERE WE COME was lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, EXCITING MOMENT and HERE WE COME will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of WINNING VANGOGH immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horseâs trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, WINNING VANGOGH will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of FOREVER RED immediately following the race found the horse to have bled from both nostril and to have sustained a cut to the left hind fetlock.
A veterinary inspection of BEAUTY MASTER and BIG FLASH immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ACE KING and SUPER WISE were sent for sampling.
<23/1/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>WINNING VANGOGH, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horseâs trachea.  WINNING VANGOGH was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer C S Shum this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its left front leg.  As previously advised, WINNING VANGOGH will be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.
BEAUTY MASTER, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  BEAUTY MASTER was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer A S Cruz this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, BEAUTY MASTER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Whilst in the saddling stalls, DINOZZO had its right hind plate refitted.  DINOZZO was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
HAPPY PLACE was crowded for room on jumping between PACKING DRAGON and STAR MAJESTIC which shifted out.  In this incident, PACKING DRAGON became unbalanced when bumped by HAPPY PLACE.
Despite being hard ridden in the early stages, SUPREME PROFIT failed to muster speed.
After the 1100 Metres, DINOZZO was left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 800 Metres, HEROIC GURU was ridden along to maintain its position inside SERGEANT TITANIUM which lay in momentarily.
HAPPY PLACE had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight and approaching the 200 Metres was shifted out away from the heels of PACKING DRAGON in an attempt to obtain clear running.
Passing the 200 Metres, SERGEANT TITANIUM was shifted in away from the heels of TRAVEL FIRST, resulting in HAPPY PLACE being momentarily crowded for room outside PACKING DRAGON.
Passing the 150 Metres, SERGEANT TITANIUM was awkwardly placed when racing in restricted room between TRAVEL FIRST and HAPPY PLACE which shifted out.
When questioned, G Mosse stated that he had been instructed to lead on PACKING DRAGON in accordance with the horseâs established racing pattern.  He said after obtaining the lead in the early stages, TRAVEL FIRST improved to the outside of PACKING DRAGON after the 1400 Metres and he had to ride his mount along to ensure that he was not crossed by that horse.  He said TRAVEL FIRST took some time to be able to clear runners to its inside to race directly outside PACKING DRAGON and as he did not want that horse to improve into the lead, he was required to make more use of PACKING DRAGON than he had hoped in order for the horse to maintain the lead.  He said because of the fast tempo of the race in the early and middle stages, PACKING DRAGON was then not able to finish off the race.  When questioned, T H So stated that he had been instructed to ride TRAVEL FIRST in a forward position as it normally races up on the speed.  He said he had to make some use of TRAVEL FIRST in the early stages in order to cross BASIC TRILOGY which was being ridden along in order to clear runners to its inside.  He said because BASIC TRILOGY had to be ridden along to cross DINNOZO after the 1200 Metres and then STAR MAJESTIC after the 1100 Metres, he was required to make too much use of TRAVEL FIRST to cross BASIC TRILOGY as he felt it was best to continue on in advance of that horse rather than sit three wide.  He added after crossing BASIC TRILOGY near the 1100 Metres, he attempted to steady the tempo and sit off PACKING DRAGON, however, the pace up until that stage had been fast but this was due to the fact that he had to make use of TRAVEL FIRST to cross runners to its inside.  G Mosse and T H So were advised that whilst the circumstances of the race required TRAVEL FIRST to be ridden along to cross runners to its inside, nonetheless they must, in similar circumstances, do their utmost to set a tempo which will allow their mounts to finish off the race as best as they are able.
A veterinary inspection of ANTICIPATION, BASIC TRILOGY and PACKING DRAGON immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
DINOZZO and HAPPY PLACE were sent for sampling.

KEEN VENTURE was crowded for room on jumping between DRAGON GENERAL and MALMSTEEN which shifted out.
ROYAL ELITE was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Also from wide barriers, BACK IN BLACK and WATER DIVINER were steadied in the early stages and shifted across to obtain a position closer to the rail.
After the 1000 Metres, MALMSTEEN commenced to race fiercely and got its head up when being steadied to obtain cover behind PERPETUAL TREASURE.
Near the 700 Metres, BACK IN BLACK and HAMMER KING raced tight.
For some distance approaching and passing the 500 Metres, EXPERTO CREDE raced very tight between WATER DIVINER and KEEN VENTURE which got its head on the side and hung out.  Then at the entrance to the Straight, EXPERTO CREDE was badly crowded for room between WATER DIVINER and KEEN VENTURE which shifted out abruptly when hanging out.  The Stewards were satisfied that B Prebble, the rider of KEEN VENTURE, had taken appropriate measures to prevent his mount from shifting out and accordingly no further action was taken.  When questioned, B Prebble stated that after this KEEN VENTURE continued to give him a difficult ride.  He said after the 300 Metres a run presented itself between HAMMER KING and WATER DIVINER and at this time he was racing to the inside of the heels of WATER DIVINER.  He said having regard to the manner in which KEEN VENTURE hung out during the race, he was reluctant to place his mount under strong riding at this time as it was still hanging out and he was concerned that the horse would shift out abruptly across the heels of WATER DIVINER.  He added near the 250 Metres he was able to have KEEN VENTURE	racing more tractably and placed the horse under pressure to improve between HAMMER KING and WATER DIVINER, however, after the 200 Metres WATER DIVINER drifted in under pressure and he was not able to maintain the position to the inside of that horse.  He said he consequently directed KEEN VENTURE to the outside of WATER DIVINER.  A veterinary inspection of KEEN VENTURE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The racing manners of KEEN VENTURE were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, KEEN VENTURE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial around a bend.
Near the 200 Metres, HAMMER KING, which was giving ground, got its head on the side and shifted in across the heels of BACK IN BLACK.  Then a short distance later, ROYAL ELITE, which was closing off the race fairly, was crowded for room between HAMMER KING which shifted in and SILLY BUDDIES which, when giving ground, was momentarily taken out by DRAGON GENERAL.  In this incident, HAMMER KING was bumped by ROYAL ELITE and shifted out towards the heels of KEEN VENTURE which was awkwardly placed close to the heels of WATER DIVINER.
Throughout the race, SILLY BUDDIES travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, C Schofield stated that after being badly hampered approaching and rounding the Home Turn, he took some time to balance EXPERTO CREDE which was having its first race start in Hong Kong.  He said it required longer than would normally be the case to balance the horse due to the significant interference that it sustained at a critical stage of the race.  He said however that after the 300 Metres he was able to commence to ride EXPERTO CREDE along and the horse then closed off the race fairly.  C Schofield was advised that whilst the Stewards acknowledged that EXPERTO CREDE was badly hampered rounding the Home Turn, nonetheless he would be expected to place his mounts under sufficient pressure at the earliest possible opportunity.
When questioned regarding the improved performance of LUCKY EVER, Trainer C S Shum stated that the horseâs most recent two starts had been very disappointing when it wanted to hang out.  He said although the horse had previously raced successfully with a crossed nose band, the reports that he received from the riders of LUCKY EVER after these two starts indicated to him that the horse may be resenting the crossed nose band and for this reason he removed this piece of equipment when the horse barrier trialed as required in late December.  He said in this barrier trial LUCKY EVER performed particularly well without the crossed nose band applied and in order to improve the horseâs fitness and ensure that A Badel was familiar with the horse, he decided to barrier trial the horse again on 13 January 2017 without the crossed nose band applied.  He added LUCKY EVER again performed particularly well in this barrier trial and, in his opinion, todayâs improved performance was attributable to that piece of gear being removed.
A veterinary inspection of HAMMER KING immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm and an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, HAMMER KING will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
LUCKY EVER and D B PIN were sent for sampling.

WINNERâS WAY began only fairly and shortly after the start was checked when crowded for room between PEOPLEâS KNIGHT which shifted out marginally and CIRCUIT HASSLER which shifted in abruptly.  In this incident, CIRCUIT HASSLER became unbalanced after making heavy contact with WINNERâS WAY.
BABA MAMA shifted in at the stat and bumped PAKISTAN STAR.
When being steadied away from the heels of PAKISTAN STAR at the 1500 Metres, WESTERN EXPRESS shifted in, resulting in EAGLE WAY being hampered when taken in across the heels of BEAUTY GENERATION.
Passing the 1300 Metres, BEAUTY GENERATION got its head up when being checked away from the heels of RAPPER DRAGON.  EAGLE WAY and SUPER CHIC, which were following, were both checked in consequence.
Passing the 1100 Metres, PAKISTAN STAR got its head up and raced ungenerously for some distance when being steadied away from the heels of WINNERâS WAY.  BEAUTY GENERATION, which was racing to the inside of PAKISTAN STAR, was again hampered as were EAGLE WAY and SUPER CHIC.
After the 1000 Metres, HELENE CHARISMA commenced to prove difficult to settle and was checked away from the heels of BABA MAMA which was awkwardly placed behind WESTERN EXPRESS.
After passing the 900 Metres, PAKISTAN STAR was left racing wide and without cover.
Approaching the 800 Metres, BEAUTY GENERATION shifted out, resulting in WESTERN EXPRESS being taken out into a four wide position without cover.
At the entrance to the Straight, PAKISTAN STAR shifted out and bumped BEAUTY GENERATION, resulting in PAKISTAN STAR becoming unbalanced.
Approaching the 100 Metres, HELENE CHARISMA, after racing tight outside BABA MAMA for some distance, was hampered when BABA MAMA shifted out under pressure. 
When questioned regarding the performance of WESTERN EXPRESS, R Moore stated that prior to the race he was confident that WESTERN EXPRESS would perform well as the horse travelled strongly to the barriers.  He said the tempo of the race did not suit WESTERN EXPRESS but more particularly BEAUTY GENERATION was shifting out to its inside in the middle stages and WESTERN EXPRESS at this time, being immature, had to be ridden along to maintain its position.  He said because he had to commence to ride WESTERN EXPRESS along so far from the finish in order for the horse to maintain its position, WESTERN EXPRESS was then not able to finish off the race.  He added, in his opinion, the circumstances of the race resulted in the horse being unable to close off rather than it performing disappointingly.  A veterinary inspection of WESTERN EXPRESS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
RAPPER DRAGON and SEASONS BLOOM were sent for sampling.

After being loaded, A FAST ONE became fractious in the gates.  After standing correctly prior to the start being effected, A FAST ONE then sat down as the gates opened, resulting in D Whyte being dislodged.  As the Stewards were satisfied that the incident was solely attributable to A FAST ONEâs barrier manners and that there were no external influences, A FAST ONE was deemed to be a runner.  Before being allowed to race again, A FAST ONE will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.
DOUBLE MASTER and NOBLE BUDDIES bumped at the start.  Shortly after the start, NOBLE BUDDIES, which was being steadied, was momentarily awkwardly placed inside the heels of KIM GLORY.
PERFECT SMART and TELECOM BOOM were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
After travelling a short distance, GIDDY GIDDY got its head on the side and bumped HIGHLAND DRAGON which was in turn taken out onto DOUBLE MASTER.
Making the first turn after the 600 Metres, POWER DRAGON was awkwardly placed close to the heels of DOUBLE MASTER.
NOBLE BUDDIES lost its right front plate approaching the 500 Metres.
Rounding the Home Turn, PERFECT SMART was awkwardly placed behind KIM GLORY.
Near the 100 Metres, KIM GLORY was inconvenienced when momentarily crowded for room between DOUBLE MASTER and POWER DRAGON which shifted in.
Close to the finishing line, PERFECT SMART shifted out away from the heels of KIM GLORY and bumped GLORY HORSIE which, when under pressure in the Straight, lay in.
Throughout the race, GLORY HORSIE travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned regarding the improved performance of RUGBY DIAMOND, Trainer W Y So stated that at its last start over 1200 Metres at Sha Tin the horse had weakened out of the race after travelling keenly when its rider, Z Purton, attempted to steady the horse after it obtained the lead.  He said it seemed to him that RUGBY DIAMOND had resented being steadied and therefore after consulting Jockey Purton he elected, after the horse barrier trialed as required, to drop it back in distance and allow it to race freely in the lead.  He added it was felt that the shorter distance of tonightâs race at Happy Valley would allow the horse to be ridden in this manner but still be able to finish off the race
A veterinary inspection of GLORY HORSIE and DOUBLE MASTER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GIDDY GIDDY, RUGBY DIAMOND and ALL TIMES LUCKY were sent for sampling.

SAFARI MAGIC was withdrawn on 24.1.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (sore left fore medial suspensory) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter MASTER PINNACLE (A Badel).  Before being allowed to race again, SAFARI MAGIC will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
CHARITY PLENTY shifted out at the start and hampered MEDIC SWORDSMAN.
From a wide barrier, HIGH SPEED METRO was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
From the outside barrier, SPEEDY WALLY was shifted across behind runners in the early stages in order to obtain cover.  Then passing the winning post on the first occasion, SPEEDY WALLY was left racing wide and without cover and after the 1200 Metres was allowed to stride forward into the lead approaching the 1000 Metres.
Approaching the 1300 Metres, MEDIC SWORDSMAN (Apprentice K K Chiong) shifted out when being checked away from the heels of CHARITY PLENTY.  When MEDIC SWORDSMAN shifted out, HIGH SPEED METRO improved its position to be racing tight inside MEDIC SWORDSMAN and outside MONEY MAN.  A short distance later, HIGH SPEED METRO and MONEY MAN were checked when crowded for room inside MEDIC SWORDSMAN which shifted back in.  Apprentice Chiong was given the benefit of the doubt in respect of this incident in that the Stewards were of the view that whilst MEDIC SWORDSMAN did shift out, it was only momentarily and that HIGH SPEED METRO improved its position into tight running inside MEDIC SWORDSMAN.  Nonetheless Apprentice Chiong was reprimanded and advised to ensure that she exercises due care when shifting ground.
The Stewards issued a charge of careless riding against Apprentice Chiong in that passing the 1200 Metres she permitted MEDIC SWORDSMAN to shift in when not clear of HIGH SPEED METRO, causing that horse to be severely checked and to lose the running to which it was rightfully entitled.  Prior to entering a plea, Apprentice Chiong submitted a request for the matter to be adjourned so that her allocated trainer, Mr K W Lui, could be present.  The Stewards acceded to the request and adjourned the matter until prior to the running of the Sha Tin racemeeting to be conducted on Monday, 30 January 2017.
For some distance after the 1200 Metres, ATOMIC BLAST was awkwardly placed close to the heels of CHOICE EXCHEQUER.
Near the 1000 Metres, MIGHTY WONGCHOY was left racing wide and without cover.
After the 600 Metres, MIGHTY WONGCHOY came under pressure, got its head on the side and lay in.
Approaching the 500 Metres, HIGH SPEED METRO was shifted out away from the heels of CHARITY PLENTY and bumped MEDIC SWORDSMAN.
Rounding the Home Turn, MASTER PINNACLE was bumped by HIGH SPEED METRO which shifted out away from the heels of MIGHTY WONGCHOY to obtain clear running.
Near the 250 Metres, BLISS CARTEL momentarily raced tight inside SPEEDY WALLY.
A veterinary inspection of MONEY MAN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of MONEY MAN, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, MONEY MAN will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of CHOICE EXCHEQUER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SPEEDY WALLY, DUTCH WINDMILL and BLISS CARTEL were sent for sampling.

SHARP SAILOR, ACCLAIMED LIGHT and HAPPY CONTENDER were all steadied in the early stages to obtain cover.
Passing the 1800 Metres, INDUSTRIALIST WAY was awkwardly placed close to the heels of EASY HEDGE which got its head up when being steadied in the lead.
After the 1600 Metres, JOLLY GENE was left racing wide and without cover and was allowed to improve its position outside the lead after the 1200 Metres.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, ISTANBUL BEY and JOLLY GENE raced tight as ISTANBUL BEY shifted out when awkwardly placed close to the heels of CLOUD NINE.
Near the 950 Metres, ACCLAIMED LIGHT and HAPPY CONTENDER bumped heavily as HAPPY CONTENDER shifted out when being checked away from the heels of ANDOYAS.
Rounding the Home Turn, ANDOYAS raced tight between SHARP SAILOR and INDUSTRIALIST WAY which was shifted away from the heels of LITTERATEUR which was giving ground.
At the entrance to the Straight, SHARP SAILOR shifted out and bumped ISTANBUL BEY which became unbalanced.
Approaching the 200 Metres, INDUSTRIALIST WAY raced in restricted room inside the heels of CLOUD NINE.
Passing the 200 Metres, EASY HEDGE shifted out and made heavy contact with ANDOYAS, causing both horses to become badly unbalanced and for EASY HEDGE to be taken in onto CLOUD NINE which was checked when crowded for room.  As the Stewards were satisfied that there was no carelessness exhibited by any rider in this incident, no further action was taken.
A veterinary inspection of EASY HEDGE and ACCLAIMED LIGHT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ANDOYAS and HAPPY CONTENDER were sent for sampling.

RADIANT STEED began awkwardly.
Shortly after the start, SPARKLING TALENT was crowded for room between BREEDERS' STAR which shifted out and AMAZING FEELING which shifted in after being bumped by HAYMAKER.  After this, HAYMAKER was steadied and shifted across behind runners from a wide barrier.
Also shortly after the start, GOLDEN ACHIEVER and SMART DELIGHT bumped.
From a wide barrier, NASHASHUK was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Near the 950 Metres, AMAZING FEELING was awkwardly placed close to the heels of RADIANT STEED.
Approaching the 900 Metres, NEVER BETTER, when racing three wide, was steadied and shifted into a position behind GOLDEN ACHIEVER to obtain cover.
Throughout the race, RADIANT STEED travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, H W Lai stated that NATURAL TEAM was inclined to lay out rounding the turns as it had done previously.  He said at the entrance to the Straight NATURAL TEAM shifted out and as he was commencing to test the horse, he received a precautionary call from the rider of the horse positioned outside NATURAL TEAM.  He said he therefore straightened NATURAL TEAM and rebalanced the horse before placing it under full pressure, however, NATURAL TEAM did not finish off the race.
BREEDERS' STAR and CIRCUIT KING were sent for sampling.

IMPERIAL SEAL began awkwardly.
From a wide barrier, LUCKY SEVEN STARS was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, SPINNING DANCER shifted in and bumped the hindquarters of IMPERIAL SEAL.
Near the 1350 Metres, both SPINNING DANCER and SMART SALUTE became unbalanced after bumping.
After the 1200 Metres, SURE PEACE got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of SPINNING DANCER.
WINNING BOY got its head up on a number of occasions approaching the 1000 Metres when being steadied to allow BEST TANGO to cross.
Near the 550 Metres, IMPERIAL SEAL attempted to shift out from behind WINNING BOY as SURE PEACE improved to its outside.  This resulted in IMPERIAL SEAL bumping SURE PEACE and blundering.  For some distance after this, IMPERIAL SEAL was very awkwardly placed close to the heels of WINNING BOY.
Shortly after entering the Straight, BEST TANGO was directed out away from the heels of SEE ME NOW which shifted out.
Near the 300 Metres, CASA MASTER was shifted to the inside of SURE PEACE to continue improving.
GOOD CHOICE was held up for clear running approaching and passing the 200 Metres.
Passing the 100 Metres, WINNING BOY raced in restricted room between SEE ME NOW and WORKS OF ART.
Over the concluding stages, CASA MASTER raced tight inside LUCKY SEVEN STARS.
Close to the finishing line, GOOD CHOICE was awkwardly placed inside the heels of SPINNING DANCER and consequently was not able to be ridden out all the way to the end of the race.
For the majority of the race, WORKS OF ART travelled wide and without cover.
After the race, Z Purton stated that after steadying CASA MASTER to obtain a position closer to the rail, his mount was somewhat lethargic in the early stages and got back further in the field despite being ridden to obtain a midfield position.  He said CASA MASTER travelled only fairly in the run and shortly after entering the Straight he attempted to follow the eventual winner IMPERIAL SEAL through, however, CASA MASTER did not pick up and finish off the race as he anticipated it would.  A veterinary inspection of CASA MASTER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
A veterinary inspection of BEST TANGO immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
IMPERIAL SEAL and SUM WIN DRAGON were sent for sampling.

From wide barriers, CHEER WIN and SPEEDY ACHIEVER were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
GOLDEN DEER shifted in at the start and bumped AMBITIOUS HEART.
JUMBO HAPPINESS and STARLOT bumped at the start.  JUMBO HAPPINESS then shifted in and crowded DESTIN.  In this incident, JUMBO HAPPINESS became unbalanced after being bumped on the hindquarters by DESTIN and shifted in further, resulting in DESTIN being steadied when crowded for room.
After being ridden along in the early stages, UNIQUE JOYFUL got its head on the side and shifted in.  UNIQUE JOYFUL was then steadied when racing wide and shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
Making the turn near the 1000 Metres, DESTIN got its head on the side and shifted out towards the heels of GOLDEN DEER.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, DESTIN again lay out towards the heels of AMBITIOUS HEART.  GOLDEN DEER, which was racing to the outside of DESTIN, was inconvenienced.
Also making the turn after the 600 Metres, CHEER WIN shifted out and raced tight inside the heels of JUMBO HAPPINESS.
Rounding the Home Turn, SPEEDY ACHIEVER became unbalanced after brushing the running rail.
Passing the 300 Metres, YO-YO DA (O Murphy) shifted in, resulting in GOOD COMPANION being momentarily crowded for room.  Then, near the 250  Metres, O Murphy directed YO-YO DA out to relieve the tightening to GOOD COMPANION, resulting in YO-YO DA bumping heavily with VERY RICH MAN which became badly unbalanced when crowded onto GRACYDAD which also became unbalanced when bumped by VERY RICH MAN.  DESTIN, which was following GRACYDAD, was hampered when shifting out away from the heels of GRACYDAD and making contact with AMBITIOUS HEART.  O Murphy was advised that whilst the Stewards acknowledged that the shift out from YO-YO DA was as a result of him correcting the horse so as to prevent causing interference to GOOD COMPANION, nonetheless he was advised to make every endeavour to prevent his mounts from shifting ground and causing interference.
SPEEDY ACHIEVER was held up for clear running from approaching the 200 Metres until approaching the 150 Metres.
CHEER WIN momentarily raced tight inside SPEEDY ACHIEVER near the 150 Metres.
Approaching the 100 Metres, SPEEDY ACHIEVER shifted out and brushed YO-YO DA which in turn was taken out onto VERY RICH MAN.
Over the concluding stages, SPEEDY ACHIEVER and GRACYDAD raced tight.
For the majority of the race, STARLOT travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of VERY RICH MAN and YO-YO DA immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GOOD COMPANION and DESTIN were sent for sampling.
<26/1/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>The Clinical Veterinary Surgeon reported that STARLOT had a sore left eye on the morning after racing.

race_name: THE HONG KONG CLUB CHALLENGE CUP (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
The Stewards tonight interviewed Trainer R Gibson regarding WUSHU CHAMPION (V301) being a pre-declaration withdrawal for this race due to being treated.  Also interviewed was Mr K M Ma, head lad allocated to Mr Gibson's stable for the current season, Dr P Curl, Executive Manager, Veterinary Regulation, Dr P Robinson, Veterinary Surgeon and Dr A Lee, Intern at the Equine Clinical Hospital.  WUSHU CHAMPION was withdrawn from this race on Monday, 23 January 2017.  Mr Gibson pleaded guilty to a breach of Rule 50(2) in that as the trainer of WUSHU CHAMPION, he did fail in his responsibility for all matters pertaining to the running of his stable and that WUSHU CHAMPION was treated with phenylbutazone on Saturday, 21 January 2017 which necessitated the withdrawal of the horse from this race.  Mr Gibson was fined the sum of $10,000.  Mr Ma was advised that a transcript of tonight's inquiry together with a full report would be forwarded to the Stables Department for their consideration.  Dr Lee was informed that, in the opinion of the Stewards, she had fully complied with her professional responsibilities in respect to this matter and accordingly bear no responsibility for the administration of phenylbutazone to the horse within the recommended withdrawal period.
APACHE SPIRIT began awkwardly and lost ground.
HARD BALL GET and HAPPY ROCKY bumped on jumping.
Shortly after the start, NITRO EXPRESS was shifted away from the heels of BIG BANG BONG which was bumped and taken out by BULLISH SMART which got its head on the side and shifted out away from CHEERFUL BOY which shifted out.
From the outside barriers, HARD BALL GET, HAPPY ROCKY and DIGITAL GENERATION were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After being vigorously ridden along to obtain a forward position, THE SHOW was steadied approaching the winning post on the first occasion and shifted across behind CLASSIC EMPEROR to obtain cover.
CLASSIC EMPEROR travelled wide and without cover until after the 900 Metres at which stage THE SHOW was left racing without cover.
Approaching the 900 Metres, APACHE SPIRIT travelled keenly and got its head up when racing behind BULLISH SMART.
Passing the 100 Metres, NITRO EXPRESS raced tight outside BULLISH SMART which shifted out.
When questioned, N Rawiller stated that after obtaining the lead in the early stages, CHEERFUL BOY commenced to travel strongly after the 1300 Metres.  He said he attempted to steady the tempo on CHEERFUL BOY, however, the horse travelled more keenly so he allowed it some rein after the 1100 Metres in the hope that not fighting against the horse may help it relax.  He said when he did this CHEERFUL BOY continued to travel keenly and for this reason approaching the 1000 Metres he again attempted to steady CHEERFUL BOY as he was aware that the horse was setting a fast tempo.  He added when trying to restrain CHEERFUL BOY, he was reluctant to fight against the horse as he felt that this would be counter-productive given the manner in which the horse was travelling.  He said after the race he recommended to connections that they consider adjusting the head gear carried by CHEERFUL BOY in an endeavour to have the horse relax better during its races.
A veterinary inspection of CLASSIC EMPEROR and APACHE SPIRIT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
NITRO EXPRESS and BULLISH SMART were sent for sampling.
<26/1/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>The Clinical Veterinary Surgeon reported that HARD BALL GET had a sore left eye on the morning after racing.

BRILLIANT DREAM began awkwardly and from a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
GIANT STARS began only fairly.
From a wide barrier, LUCKY DOUBLE EIGHT was steadied shortly after the start and shifted across behind runners.
Making the turn near the 1050 Metres, HIGH FIVE lost ground after being crowded for room inside MOST BEAUTIFUL which got its head on the side and shifted in despite the efforts of its rider.
Passing the 1050 Metres, ISAAC and GO BABY GO raced tight inside SO FAST when that horse was steadied to allow DIEGO KOSTA and I'M A WITNESS to cross.  After this, SO FAST travelled wide and without cover.
After being crossed by DIEGO KOSTA near the 1000 Metres, ISAAC proved very difficult to settle and got its head up for some distance when very awkwardly placed behind DIEGO KOSTA.  In this incident, ISAAC shifted out away from the heels of DIEGO KOSTA and bumped GO BABY GO after the 1000 Metres.
Passing the 900 Metres, THE SUPREME commenced to prove very difficult to settle and got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of HARRIER JET.
At the 800 Metres, LUCKY DOUBLE EIGHT was bumped and taken wider by GIANT STARS which, when travelling keenly, shifted out away from the heels of THE SUPREME which continued to prove difficult to settle.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, HIGH FIVE and THE SUPREME raced tight.
Shortly after entering the Straight, BRILLIANT DREAM shifted in abruptly after being checked away from the heels of THE SUPREME and consequently bumped heavily with the hindquarters of HIGH FIVE which became badly unbalanced.
Approaching the 200 Metres, THE SUPREME was held up for a run behind GO BABY GO and passing the 200 Metres was shifted in to obtain clear running.
A veterinary inspection of HIGH FIVE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ISAAC, I'M A WITNESS and HARRIER JET were sent for sampling.
<26/1/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>The Veterinary Officer reported that GO BABY GO was lame in its right front leg on the morning after racing.  Before being allowed to race again, GO BABY GO will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Shortly after the start, DYNAMISM shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of GOODHEART SUCCESS.  DYNAMISM was then shifted across behind runners from a wide barrier.
Also from wide barriers, MR GENUINE, GOODHEART SUCCESS and DUKEDOM were all steadied in the early stages and shifted across to obtain cover.
A short distance after the start, EASTERN EXPRESS and SPEEDY LONGWAH bumped.
Near the 1600 Metres, SPEEDY LONGWAH raced tight between FANTASTIC KAKA and EASTERN EXPRESS which shifted in.  In this incident, FANTASTIC KAKA became unbalanced when bumped by SPEEDY LONGWAH.  FANTASTIC KAKA then shifted out, resulting in SPEEDY LONGWAH being crowded for room and taken out onto EASTERN EXPRESS which also became unbalanced.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, MCQUEEN was left racing wide and without cover.  MCQUEEN was allowed to improve its position to settle outside the lead near the 1000 Metres.
Also passing the winning post on the first occasion, GOODHEART SUCCESS was crowded for room inside MR GENUINE (N Rawiller) which shifted in.  N Rawiller was advised to exercise more care.
Approaching the 700 Metres, DUKEDOM was taken wider by MR GENUINE which improved to the outside of the heels of DYNAMISM.
Near the 550 Metres, GOODHEART SUCCESS momentarily raced tight inside MR GENUINE which lay in.
At the entrance to the Straight, DYNAMISM was shifted out away from the heels of EASTERN EXPRESS.
Approaching the 400 Metres, HAPPY SPIRIT and SPEEDY LONGWAH raced tight as HAPPY SPIRIT attempted to shift out away from the heels of MCQUEEN.
Passing the 150 Metres, DYNAMISM was steadied when disappointed for running between FANTASTIC KAKA and MR GENUINE which, when improving into tight running inside PACKING LLAREGYB, was taken in by that horse before PACKING LLAREGYB was shifted out to relieve the tightening to MR GENUINE.
Close to the finishing line, PACKING LLAREGYB and GOODHEART SUCCESS raced tight.  Because of this, both PACKING LLAREGYB and GOODHEART SUCCESS were not able to be ridden out all the way to the end of the race.
After the race, S de Sousa stated that, in his opinion, EASTERN EXPRESS raced awkwardly at Happy Valley at its first time of asking.  He said the horse was unbalanced when rounding the turns and because of this was not comfortable during the race.  A veterinary inspection of EASTERN EXPRESS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of SANTA FE SUN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MARVEL HERO and HAPPY SPIRIT were sent for sampling.
<26/1/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>SANTA FE SUN, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  SANTA FE SUN was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer P OâSullivan this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, SANTA FE SUN will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

HAPPY FIERY DRAGON began only fairly.
Shortly after the start, DYNAMIC VOYAGE raced tight between HAPPY FIERY DRAGON and MANHATTAN STRIKER which shifted out.

<2/2/2017  30 January 2017 Sha Tin Racemeeting â Race 11 (381)>After reviewing the video footage for the racemeeting conducted on Monday, 30 January 2017 as is usual, the Stewards tonight questioned J Moreira regarding his riding of PRAWN BABA. J Moreira stated that he had been instructed to ride PRAWN BABA positively in the early stages and assume the lead if possible. He said PRAWN BABA began only fairly and he rode his mount along in the early stages to take up a forward position as instructed. He said DEJA VU, which was drawn inside PRAWN BABA, and BRING IT ON, which began from the barrier immediately outside PRAWN BABA, both showed superior speed to PRAWN BABA despite not being ridden along. He said he formed the opinion that both these horses would clearly show more speed than PRAWN BABA and that it would not be in the interests of PRAWN BABA to continue to be hard ridden as he did not feel that the horse was showing the amount of early speed necessary to be able to go forward without having to be unduly used up. He said he therefore elected to discontinue pushing the horse along and obtain cover which he was able to do in the early stages. He said he was able to obtain cover behind JADE FORTUNE after the 1200 Metres and the horse travelled comfortably in this position albeit three wide. He added despite the race being run at a slow tempo, PRAWN BABA relaxed well and did not over-race. He said he was aware that PRAWN BABA is somewhat one-paced and for this reason he shifted the horse to the outside of JADE FORTUNE and commenced to improve his position prior to the 500 Metres so as to prevent the horse from being left flat-footed when the pace quickened. He said PRAWN BABA became unbalanced rounding the Home Turn when bumped by JADE FORTUNE and again made contact with that horse passing the 400 Metres which resulted in PRAWN BABA becoming unbalanced. He said he commenced to ride the horse vigorously hands and heels but was reluctant to use the whip on the horse in the early part of the Straight as PRAWN BABA was unbalanced and JADE FORTUNE was racing tight to the inside of PRAWN BABA which approaching the 300 Metres then had FRIENDS OF NANJING improving around it. He said PRAWN BABA did not initially quicken, however, he used the whip on the horse down the shoulder in the right hand near the 250 Metres on a number of occasions and PRAWN BABA continued to finish off the race at one speed. He said the horse was obliged to race in amongst other runners over about the final 200 Metres which resulted in him not being able to fully test PRAWN BABA with the whip which he otherwise would have done. J Moreira was advised that, in the opinion of the Stewards, he should have persevered for longer than he did in the early stages to take up a forward position given his instructions, the makeup of the field and the likely tempo of the race. He was also advised that his explanations regarding his riding of the horse, particularly in the Home Straight would be noted.
