From wide barriers, EL SHERIF and STAR OF YAN OI were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 800 Metres, MULTIMAX was awkwardly placed close to the heels of FISH Nâ CHIPS.  JOYFUL MOMENTS, which was following, was steadied away from the heels of MULTIMAX in consequence.
Making the turn approaching the 700 Metres, EL SHERIF was bumped and taken wider by STAR OF YAN OI which shifted out away from the heels of AMAZING RACE.  After this, EL SHERIF got its head on the side and lay out making the turns.
Passing the 300 Metres, JOYFUL MOMENTS (Apprentice K K Chiong), which was laying out, attempted to improve into tight running inside FISH Nâ CHIPS which, after shifting in marginally of its own accord, then raced tight inside FIGHT HERO (H W Lai).  Then passing the 200 Metres, as JOYFUL MOMENTS continued to attempt to improve into tight running inside FISH Nâ CHIPS, JOYFUL MOMENTS was checked and blundered, resulting in Apprentice Chiong almost being dislodged.  A short distance after this, FISH Nâ CHIPS was directed out away from the heels of FIGHT HERO  As it was established that JOYFUL MOMENTS had not properly established running inside FISH Nâ CHIPS and was attempting to improve where there was doubtful room, no further action was taken.  Nonetheless H W Lai was advised to exercise more care in respect of FISH Nâ CHIPS being awkwardly placed close to FIGHT HEROâs heels near the 150 Metres.
Passing the 200 Metres, ARIZONA BLIZZARD got its head on the side and lay out under pressure.
Throughout the race, BEAR RAPPER travelled wide and without cover.
After the race, N Callan was not able to offer any reason for the disappointing performance of E-SUPER.  He said the horse was able to obtain a good position behind the speed, however, did not finish off the race.  He said he recommended to connections that they consider altering the gear carried by E-SUPER and, if a suitable race is available, to return the horse to Happy Valley where E-SUPER has a good record.  A veterinary inspection of E-SUPER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Also after the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on EL SHERIF at the request of Trainer D J Hall.  The Veterinary Surgeon reported that this examination showed a substantial amount of blood and mucus in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, EL SHERIF will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
FIGHT HERO and ARIZONA BLIZZARD were sent for sampling.

DANEWIN EXPRESS began awkwardly and lost ground.
ALWAYS WONGCHOY was crowded for room on jumping between MY BLESSING and DOUBLE POINT which shifted in.
From a wide barrier, YOURTHEWONFORME was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Approaching the winning post on the first occasion, MASTER PINNACLE and DASHING FORTUNE raced tight inside DOUBLE POINT which shifted in.
For some distance approaching the winning post on the first occasion, RISING POWER got its head up when proving difficult to settle.
DASHING FORTUNE travelled and without cover until near the 900 Metres at which point DOUBLE POINT was left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 500 Metres, DANEWIN EXPRESS was awkwardly placed close to the heels of GOLDEN PARTNERS.
Near the 275 Metres, DANEWIN EXPRESS was directed out away from the heels of DASHING FORTUNE to obtain clear running.
Approaching the 200 Metres, DOUBLE POINT shifted out and brushed YOURTHEWONFORME.
Over the final 200 Metres, YOURTHEWONFORME got its head on the side and lay in under pressure and over the concluding stages shifted in abruptly.
A veterinary inspection of DOUBLE POINT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MY BLESSING and BLISS CARTEL were sent for sampling.

TREASURE AND GOLD bounded in the air at the start and lost ground.
Shortly after the start, SHINING CHAMPION was steadied away from the heels of MR KOOL which was taken out by SHOW MISSION.
From the outside barriers, MANHATTAN STRIKER and LUCKY FRIENDS were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
S Clipperton (REWARDING FLYER) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 1000 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of TREASURE AND GOLD, causing that horse to be hampered and in turn taken in across the rightful running of SHINING CHAMPION which also lost the running to which it was rightfully entitled.  S Clipperton was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 26 February 2017 and to expire on Thursday, 2 March 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, S Clipperton was fined $25,000.
After being ridden aggressively after the 800 Metres to improve to be racing inside the heels of GREAT SPEED (S de Sousa), MR KOOL was steadied near the 700 Metres to avoid the heels of GREAT SPEED which, after improving into tight running inside SHOW MISSION which had shifted out marginally, then shifted in further as SHOW MISSION resumed its position.  S de Sousa was advised that whilst there were some circumstances to this incident, nonetheless he must ensure that he makes every endeavour to afford runners to his inside comfortable racing room in similar circumstances.
Passing the 700 Metres, HAPPY CENTURY was steadied away from the heels of REWARDING FLYER which shifted in when awkwardly placed close to the heels of SHOW MISSION.
In the Straight, MR KOOL raced with its head on the side and lay in under pressure.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of TREASURE AND GOLD, N Rawiller stated that, in his opinion, TREASURE AND GOLD did not feel completely comfortable in its action and may not have backed up from its last start success.  He said although the horse was left racing three wide and without cover approaching the 700 Metres, nonetheless it was not travelling well at this time and then, despite being placed under pressure rounding the Home Turn and in the early part of the Straight, did not stretch out and accordingly did not finish off the race.  A veterinary inspection of TREASURE AND GOLD immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of TREASURE AND GOLD, a last start winner, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, TREASURE AND GOLD will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After the race, K Teetan stated that, despite being vigorously ridden along in the early stages, HAPPY CENTURY was not able to maintain its position and raced further back in the field than had been intended.  He said HAPPY CENTURY did not travel as strongly during the race as it did at its last start which resulted in him having to commence to ride it along prior to the 500 Metres to maintain its position.  He added, despite being ridden along, HAPPY CENTURY did not respond to his riding and was disappointing.  A veterinary inspection of HAPPY CENTURY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of REWARDING FLYER immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, REWARDING FLYER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
ALL TOGETHER and SHOW MISSION were sent for sampling.
<9/2/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>After the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on ALL TOGETHER at the request of Trainer C S Shum.  The Veterinary Surgeon reported that this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horseâs trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, ALL TOGETHER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

ARM RUNDA and DASHING POWER bumped at the start.
RAY OF GOLD, which was slow to begin, was bumped shortly after the start by G-ONE LOVER which began awkwardly and shifted in.
GRADE ONE shifted in at the start and bumped UNIQUE JOYFUL. 
RAINBOW FIGHTER began awkwardly and, from a wide barrier, was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Also TEN SPEED, from a wide barrier, was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
Approaching the 1100 Metres, G-ONE LOVER raced tight between UNIQUE JOYFUL and BRIGHT STAR, both of which shifted a minimal amount of ground.
Passing the 1000 Metres, GRADE ONE got its head on the side and shifted in abruptly before being shifted back out to relieve the tightening to ARM RUNDA.  After this, ARM RUNDA got its head up and travelled keenly when being steadied to obtain cover behind GRADE ONE.
Passing the 900 Metres, G-ONE LOVER shifted out away from the heels of UNIQUE JOYFUL after being awkwardly placed close to the heels of that horse.  When G-ONE LOVER shifted out, the horse got its head on the side and shifted further, resulting in TEN SPEED being taken wider.
Near the 650 Metres, BRIGHT STAR got its head up on a number of occasions when awkwardly placed close to the heels of RAPIDASH and then making the turn after the 600 Metres got its head on the side despite the efforts of its rider, resulting in DASHING POWER being inconvenienced.  RAY OF GOLD, which was following DASHING POWER, was steadied away from the heels of that horse in consequence and shifted out, resulting in RAINBOW FIGHTER racing in restricted room inside the heels of UNIQUE JOYFUL.
Near the 150 Metres, RAY OF GOLD got its head on the side and shifted in under pressure behind G-ONE LOVER, resulting in its rider, S de Sousa, having to stop riding and direct RAY OF GOLD back out from behind G-ONE LOVER to obtain clear running approaching the 100 Metres.
Passing the 100 Metres, RAY OF GOLD raced tight inside BRIGHT STAR.
Over the concluding stages, G-ONE LOVER got its head on the side and proved difficult to ride.
Throughout the race, SEE ME NOW travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, A Badel (G-ONE LOVER) stated that his mount, which was first up in tonightâs race, travelled greenly in the early and middle stages.  He said after shifting out passing the 900 Metres, G-ONE LOVER improved to be racing behind SEE ME NOW.  He said the pace of the race slackened at this time as SEE ME NOW did not appear to be improving into the race, he felt it was a better option to improve around that horse rather than be awkwardly placed behind SEE ME NOW.  He said after shifting out into a four wide position and improving around SEE ME NOW after the 600 Metres, RAPIDASH, which was racing in advance of SEE ME NOW, shifted out which resulted in G-ONE LOVER being obliged to continue racing four wide rounding the Home Turn.  He added that in hindsight he had erred in not remaining racing behind SEE ME NOW, however, he felt that the pace of the race at this time was the principal reason for shifting out.  A Badel was advised that his explanation would be reported, however, he must not set his mounts too great a task so as to allow them to finish off the race as best as they are able.
GRADE ONE, ARM RUNDA and RAY OF GOLD were sent for sampling.

POWERMAX began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped LOVE CHUNGHWA.  POWERMAX then shifted in and bumped COUR VALANT, causing both COUR VALANT and POWERMAX to become unbalanced.
From wide barriers, VICTORY MUSIC, DONâT MISS and M REBORN were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Making the first turn near the 1000 Metres, after being ridden along in the early stages, HASTA LA VISTA was steadied to obtain a position closer to the rail.
Making the turn approaching and passing the 1000 Metres, COUR VALANT got its head on the side and lay out when awkwardly placed close to the heels of POWERMAX.
Making the turn after the 1000 Metres, LOVE CHUNGHWA got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of ELITE EXPRESS.
Approaching the 500 Metres, POWERMAX momentarily raced in restricted room inside CLEVER SPIRIT which got its head on the side and lay in behind CIRCUIT KING.
Making the Home Turn, LOVE CHUNGHWA was awkwardly placed close to the heels of ELITE EXPRESS.
Throughout the race, NATURAL TEAM travelled wide and without cover and in the Straight gave ground.  A veterinary inspection of NATURAL TEAM immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CIRCUIT KING lost its left front plate after the race.
POWERMAX and CIRCUIT KING were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE CRAIGENGOWER CRICKET CLUB CHALLENGE CUP (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
AUTUMN GOLD shifted out at the start and bumped KING BOUNTIFUL.
From the outside barriers, BLAZING PASS, AGIAAL and BEST REWARD were all steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
GOOD FIT was also steadied to obtain cover shortly after the start.
For the major part of the race, KING BOUNTIFUL travelled wide and without cover and in the Straight gave ground.
The performances of KING BOUNTIFUL and DIGITAL PIONEER, which finished tailed out, were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, KING BOUNTIFUL and DIGITAL PIONEER will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of BO DUKE, KING BOUNTIFUL, HAPPY AND HEALTHY and DIGITAL PIONEER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PREMIUM CHAMPION, BLAZING PASS and SUPER FORM were sent for sampling.

After being placed in the barriers, the start was delayed when NUMERO UNO put its head down and then took some time to correct.  Before being allowed to race again, NUMERO UNO will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.
WAYFOONG VINNIE was slow to begin and shortly after the start was shifted across behind runners.
LANG TAI SING shifted out at the start and bumped DIAMOND LEGEND.
SHARP HUNTER began awkwardly and bumped the hindquarters of LUCKY DAY which became unbalanced after being bumped by TRENDY WIN on jumping.  After this, TRENDY WIN was steadied to obtain cover.
From the outside barrier, NUMERO UNO was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Making the first turn approaching the 1000 Metres, FLYING FORCE got its head up when being steadied to allow IâM A WITNESS to cross.
Passing the 1000 Metres, DIAMOND LEGEND lost ground when reluctant to maintain its position inside FLYING FORCE.  Then making the turn into the Back Straight near the 950 Metres, DIAMOND LEGEND got its head on the side and lay out.
Passing the 700 Metres, FLYING FORCE again got its head up when being steadied away from the heels of MARVEL TRIBE (Apprentice K K Chiong) which steadied the tempo.  Apprentice Chiong was warned against the practice of steadying the tempo in races too abruptly.
After the 700 Metres, LUCKY DAY was left racing wide and without cover.
IâM A WITNESS and OUR HERO brushed passing the 100 Metres.  Then near the 50 Metres, IâM A WITNESS and OUR HERO raced tight due to both horses shifting slight ground.
Close to the finishing line, LANG TAI SING was shifted in away from the heels of IâM A WITNESS after being awkwardly placed inside the heels of that horse.
When questioned, D Whyte stated that he placed TRAVEL SUCCESSOR under heavy pressure rounding the Home Turn and in the early part of the Straight.  He said TRAVEL SUCCESSOR did not quicken as he thought it would and he used the whip in the left hand after the 200 Metres.  He said when the horse did not appear to respond, he then changed the whip into his right hand and again used the whip in that hand after the 100 Metres, however, TRAVEL SUCCESSOR was giving its all at this time and he did not feel there was any need to use the whip any further on the horse.
When questioned regarding the performance of FLYING FORCE, J Moreira stated that after being able to obtain the position behind the leader in the early stages, FLYING FORCE travelled satisfactorily until the pace of the race slackened passing the 700 Metres.  He said when this happened FLYING FORCE got its head up on a number of occasions and became unbalanced.  He said FLYING FORCE was then able to travel more comfortably after the 600 Metres and at the entrance to the Straight he was able to shift the horse into clear running, however, FLYING FORCE came under pressure and then, despite being ridden out, did not respond to his riding.  Mr C H Yip, trainer of FLYING FORCE, stated that, in his opinion, tonightâs performance could be attributed to the manner in which the horse reacted to the tempo of the race after the 700 Metres.  He said FLYING FORCE appreciates a good tempo and a trouble free run and, in his opinion, this was the principal reason for the horseâs disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection of FLYING FORCE immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, FLYING FORCE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of MARVEL TRIBE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FLYING FORCE, OUR HERO and IâM A WITNESS were sent for sampling.

On arrival at the barriers, K Teetan expressed concern regarding the action of DIGITAL GENERATION.  DIGITAL GENERATION was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said after the necessary consultations that the horse was suitable to race.
WHAT MAN HORSE, which was fractious in the barriers, bounded in the air as the start was effected and consequently was slow to begin.
MR PELE was crowded for room on jumping between DIGITAL GENERATION which was taken out by CHATER LEGEND and WORLD RECORD which shifted in after being bumped by UNIQUE HAPPIEST.
YOUNG RANGER lost its right front plate a short distance after the start.
Passing the 800 Metres, VICTORY DAY was awkwardly placed close to the heels of WORLD RECORD which was racing tight outside the heels of BULLISH SMART which shifted out from behind UNIQUE HAPPIEST.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, MR PELE was momentarily crowded for room inside DIGITAL GENERATION which was racing tight inside YOUNG RANGER.
Near the 450 Metres, CHATER LEGEND was awkwardly placed close to the heels of VICTORY MACHINE.
At the entrance to the Straight, UNIQUE HAPPIEST and BULLISH SMART bumped.
In the Straight, VICTORY MACHINE lay out under pressure.
As this was the second occasion from as many starts that WHAT MAN HORSE had finished tailed out, the Stewards ruled that the horse will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a series of consecutive barrier trials and be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.
When questioned, C Schofield stated that WORLD RECORD, which was having its first race start at Happy Valley tonight, hung out throughout the early and middle stages and consequently was not able to muster sufficient speed to be able to cross VICTORY DAY to its inside.  He said he had to continually fight against WORLD RECORD in an endeavour to have it shift in closer to the rail and it was not until near the 700 Metres that he was able to get the horse to shift in to race with cover behind BULLISH SMART.  He said when making the turn after the 600 Metres WORLD RECORD hung out badly and continued to do so until after straightening.  He added WORLD RECORD continued to hang out in the early part of the Straight and because of this he eased the horse down over the concluding stages.  A veterinary inspection of WORLD RECORD immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The racing manners of WORLD RECORD were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, WORLD RECORD will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial around a bend and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of YOUNG RANGER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
BULLISH SMART and BIG BANG BONG were sent for sampling.

On arrival at the barriers, it was noted that SKY MAN had lost its left front plate.  SKY MAN was replated and examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
FANTASTIC FEELING began awkwardly and lost ground.
From the outside barriers, LAMAROSA and GREAT CHARM were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Despite being aggressively ridden along in the early stages, HONEST HORSE failed to muster speed.
Passing the 1100 Metres, PEACE N PROSPERITY momentarily raced tight inside RAGING BULL.
Making the turn approaching the 1000 Metres, FANTASTIC FEELING got its head up when awkwardly placed outside the heels of MOST BEAUTIFUL.
GREEN ENERGY got its head on the side and lay out making the turn after the 1000 Metres and again after the 500 Metres and then in the Straight hung out and proved difficult to ride.
Passing the 900 Metres, LAMAROSA commenced to travel keenly and shifted out after being awkwardly placed close to the heels of FANTASTIC FEELING.  After this, LAMAROSA continued to prove difficult to settle for some distance.
A veterinary inspection of GREAT CHARM immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm and had bled from both nostrils.  Before being allowed to race again, GREAT CHARM will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of FANTASTIC FEELING and LAMAROSA immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
RAGING BULL, VICTORY MARVEL and PEACE N PROSPERITY were sent for sampling.
<9/2/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>GREAT CHARM, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm and had bled from both nostrils.  GREAT CHARM was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer R Gibson this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its left front leg.  As previously advised, GREAT CHARM will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.

EXPEDITE and TRAVEL AMBASSADOR were crowded for room on jumping between SUM WIN DRAGON and INVISIBLE, both of which shifted ground.  After this, EXPEDITE and TRAVEL AMBASSADOR were shifted across behind runners.
EQUITY DOCTRINE shifted out at the start and bumped the hindquarters of ENREACHING which became unbalanced.
THE SHOW began awkwardly.
From wide barriers, SURE PEACE and IMPERIAL CONCORDE were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After momentarily shifting into a one-off position passing the 1200 Metres, LONDON CITY was hampered passing the 1100 Metres when crowded for room between EMPEROR VICTORY and ENREACHING (N Callan) which shifted in.  N Callan was advised that whilst LONDON CITY had only just shifted out into a one-off position, he nonetheless must exercise more care in similar circumstances.
For some distance after the 1200 Metres, SUM WIN DRAGON got its head up on a number of occasions when travelling keenly.  DIAMOND FRIENDS, which was following SUM WIN DRAGON, shifted out away from the heels of that horse passing the 1000 Metres.  After this, DIAMOND FRIENDS was left racing wide and without cover.
For some distance approaching and passing the 900 Metres, THE SHOW became unbalanced when crowded for room inside WINNING BOY which, after being bumped by UNIQUE JOYOUS which was taken in by SURE PEACE (J Moreira), then proved very difficult to settle and improved to be racing inside the heels of INVISIBLE where there was insufficient room.  Whilst there were some circumstances to this incident, J Moreira was nonetheless severely reprimanded and advised that it was his movement inwards on SURE PEACE that commenced the tightening to runners on his inside.  He was further advised to ensure that at all times he leaves comfortable racing room for runners on his inside.
Approaching the 500 Metres, SUM WIN DRAGON and SURE PEACE raced tight as SURE PEACE improved around SUM WIN DRAGON.
In the Straight, SURE PEACE lay out under pressure and near the 150 Metres the whip of J Moreira was knocked from his grasp by the whip of N Callan.
Approaching the 100 Metres, EXPEDITE got its head up when momentarily crowded for room between INVISIBLE and UNIQUE JOYOUS which both shifted ground.  INVISIBLE and UNIQUE JOYOUS were both corrected by their riders shortly after this.
After the race, S de Sousa dismounted from IMPERIAL CONCORDE.  The Veterinary Officer subsequently reported that IMPERIAL CONCORDE had bled from both nostrils.
A veterinary inspection of EXPEDITE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
A veterinary inspection of SUM WIN DRAGON immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ENREACHING and SURE PEACE were sent for sampling.

When proceeding to the track, GLORIOUS PARTNERS became fractious, reared and flipped over, resulting in its rider, T H So, being dislodged and the horse hitting its head on the ground.  GLORIOUS PARTNERS was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was not suitable to race.  Acting on this advice, GLORIOUS PARTNERS was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  GLORIOUS PARTNERS will be required to undergo a satisfactory parade test prior to its next race start and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When proceeding to the barriers, BEAT THE CLOCK slipped over, resulting in J Moreira being dislodged.  BEAT THE CLOCK was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said that after the necessary consultations BEAT THE CLOCK was suitable to race.  J Moreira was also examined by the Clubâs medical officers and passed fit to fulfil his race riding engagement on BEAT THE CLOCK.
ROYAL PERFORMER and CELESTIAL ARROW were slow to begin.
Shortly after the start, BEAT THE CLOCK was checked when crowded for room between DELIGHT EXPRESS which, after shifting in, was then straightened by its rider and ENERGETIC CLASS (S de Sousa) which shifted in.  Whilst the Stewards acknowledged that S de Sousa had made some effort to relieve the tightening to BEAT THE CLOCK, and that DELIGHT EXPRESS had some bearing on the matter, nonetheless S dc Sousa was severely reprimanded and advised that, in the opinion of the Stewards, he should have made a greater effort than he did on this occasion to prevent his mount from shifting in.
Near the 1250 Metres, DELIGHT EXPRESS got its head up on a number of occasions when proving very difficult to settle whilst awkwardly placed close to the heels of ENERGETIC CLASS.
After the 1100 Metres, LUCKY GUY travelled keenly and got its head up on a number of occasions when proving difficult to settle.
Making the turn near the 900 Metres, CELESTIAL ARROW commenced to prove very difficult to settle and got its head up on a number of occasions when being checked away from the heels of ROUNDABOUT.  In this incident, CELESTIAL ARROW shifted in, resulting in PROUD SKY being momentarily crowded for room.  LUCKY GUY, which was following and continuing to prove difficult to settle, was checked away from the heels of CELESTIAL ARROW in consequence.
Near the 900 Metres, BEAT THE CLOCK was left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 900 Metres, ROYAL PERFORMER was crowded for room inside ROUNDABOUT which was taken in by TOP SCORE (N Rawiller).  TOP SCORE was then shifted out to relieve the tightening to ROUNDABOUT and ROYAL PERFORMER and after this travelled wide and without cover.  N Rawiller was reprimanded and advised to exercise more care when shifting ground in similar circumstances.
Approaching the 700 Metres, LUCKY GUY raced in restricted room between PROUD SKY and KA YING KID after improving into tight running between those horses.
Rounding the Home Turn, TOP SCORE was crowded for room between BEAT THE CLOCK which was improving around that horse and ROUNDABOUT (B Prebble) which shifted to the outside of THE JAZZ.  B Prebble was severely reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is properly clear of other runners when shifting ground.  N Rawiller stated that after this TOP SCORE did not feel comfortable in its action in front.  He said he placed the horse under pressure in the Straight, however, after TOP SCORE did not stretch out as he expected, he eased it down over the concluding stages.  A veterinary inspection of TOP SCORE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Before being allowed to race again, TOP SCORE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
DARING FIT and BEAT THE CLOCK were sent for sampling.

CHOICE EXCHEQUER was withdrawn on 10.2.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right hind) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter TELEPHATIA (Z Purton).  Before being allowed to race again, CHOICE EXCHEQUER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
LIGHTNING AND GOLD was very slow to begin and then for some distance in the early stages refused to race.  LIGHTNING AND GOLD then tailed out and raced detached from the field.  A veterinary inspection of LIGHTNING AND GOLD immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The barrier and racing manners of LIGHTNING AND GOLD were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, LIGHTNING AND GOLD will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
On jumping, MY FOLKS stumbled badly, resulting in its rider, D Whyte, being dislodged.  After this incident, D Whyte was examined by the Clubâs medical officers and passed fit to fulfil his remaining race riding engagements.
When questioned, Apprentice H T Mo (FAITHFUL BOY) stated that after having to ride his mount along with the whip for some distance in the early stages to muster sufficient speed to cross runners to his inside, he was able to shift FAITHFUL BOY in to race on the rail and in the lead passing the 1600 Metres.  He said after obtaining the lead he immediately attempted to steady the tempo on FAITHFUL BOY, however, the horse commenced to prove very difficult to settle and travelled keenly.  He said approaching the 1500 Metres as he was continuing to restrain FAITHFUL BOY, his saddle shifted forward which placed him at a significant disadvantage which made it more difficult for him to restrain FAITHFUL BOY.  He added, despite his efforts, FAITHFUL BOY continued to travel very keenly in the early and middle stages and would not settle and because of this the tempo that he set on FAITHFUL BOY was much faster than he had wished.
A veterinary inspection of WEALTHY FORTUNE and MY FOLKS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GORGEOUS AGAIN and TELEPHATIA were sent for sampling.

After being loaded into the barriers, REGENCY HONEY became fractious, reared and got its left front leg into the adjoining stall.  After some time REGENCY HONEY was removed from the barriers and examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was not suitable to race.  Acting on this advice, REGENCY HONEY was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  As REGENCY HONEY was being removed from the barrier stalls, BELOVED lost its right hind plate which required the horse to be replated.  After being replated, BELOVED was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed fit to start.  These incidents resulted in a significant delay to the start of the race.  Before being allowed to race again, REGENCY HONEY will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  BELOVED, which initially proved difficult to load on the first occasion, will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test before being allowed to race again.
GOLDEN DEER began awkwardly.
NOTED PERFORMER was slow to begin.
BELOVED began only fairly, shifted out and brushed the hindquarters of AMBITIOUS HEART.
Shortly after the start, HAPPY HAPPY STAR and ART OF SUCCESS bumped.
After travelling a short distance, BOSSIEE was crowded for room between ART OF SUCCESS and RICHCITY FORTUNE which shifted in after being bumped by CAREFREE LET GO.
Approaching the 800 Metres, AMBITIOUS HEART got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of FOREVER ACCURATE which shifted in.
Passing the 350 Metres, GOLDEN DEER was shifted to the outside of PLANET STAR after being disappointed for running inside that horse.
AMBITIOUS HEART was unable to obtain clear running passing the 300 Metres.
Near the 150 Metres, FOREVER ACCURATE was momentarily crowded for room between CAREFREE LET GO and GOLDEN DEER which shifted out.
Close to the finishing line, PLANET STAR got its head on the side and lay out.

LOTUS STRIKES BACK and ENORMOUS HONOUR bumped at the start.
Despite being aggressively ridden in the early stages, MASTER CERAMIBO and WAH MAY BABY failed to muster speed.
From wide barriers, ASSOCIATION FANS and SILLY BUDDIES were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
MY GIFT was left racing wide and without cover near the 1100 Metres.

Whilst in the saddling stalls, SUPER WISE had its left hind plate adjusted.  SUPER WISE was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
On arrival at the Start, it was noted that TRIUMPHANT JEWEL had lost its right front plate.  After this plate was refitted, TRIUMPHANT JEWEL was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.

After the race, Z Purton stated that after this DIEGO KOSTA did not travel comfortably and had to be ridden along to maintain its position in the early stages. Passing the 800 Metres, MAGIC LEGEND commenced to lay out and then passing the 600 Metres got its head on the side and hung in.  After this, MAGIC LEGEND continued to lay in under pressure.
Near the 650 Metres, INTREPIC was momentarily awkwardly placed close to the heels of DIEGO KOSTA which shifted out away from the heels of MAGIC LEGEND.
Passing the 500 Metres, TRIUMPHANT JEWEL was momentarily crowded for room between SO FAST and DIEGO KOSTA which shifted out marginally.  TRIUMPHANT JEWEL then had some difficulty obtaining clear running until approaching the 400 Metres.

Passing the 200 Metres, TRIUMPHANT JEWEL was again momentarily held up for clear running.
After being shifted to the outside of the heels of BEAUTY MASTER passing the 200 Metres, TRAVEL DATUK raced in restricted room outside that horse and behind GALLANT ROCK.  This resulted in TRAVEL DATUK being unable to obtain clear running until passing the 100 Metres.
When questioned, K Teetan stated that it had been intended for ACE KING to be ridden in a forward position as is normal.  He said it was anticipated that although the horse had drawn to the inside, it would have sufficient natural early speed to be able to race on the speed.  He said after being fractious in the barriers and rearing, ACE KING, despite being urged along to take up a forward position, did not show the same early speed that it did at its last start when ridden by him.  He said ACE KING did not travel on the bridle and was under pressure a long way from the finish.  He added that ACE KING did not respond to his riding in a manner he thought it would and finished off the race only fairly.  A veterinary inspection of ACE KING immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
After the race, J Moreira stated that SUPER WISE travelled well in the early stages, however, commenced to travel keenly passing the 700 Metres.  He said after this SUPER WISE relaxed better, however, when shifted in to obtain clear running near the 500 Metres, the horse did not finish off the race.  A veterinary inspection of SUPER WISE immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, SUPER WISE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of INTREPIC immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of INTREPIC, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, INTREPIC will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of DIEGO KOSTA immediately following the race found that horse to have sustained a laceration to the inside of the left front heel.
SUPER WISE, MAGIC LEGEND and FORTUNE BO BO were sent for sampling.

SUPER DUKE, which was kicked by another runner when parading behind the barriers, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said that after the necessary consultations the horse was suitable to race.
HASTILY FEET and HIT A HOME RUN were slow to begin.
SEVEN LUCK shifted out at the start and bumped the hindquarters of WORKS OF ART which became unbalanced.
Near the 1350 Metres, GENTRY was momentarily crowded for room between C P POWER and KINGâS MAN which was then shifted out to relieve the tightening to GENTRY.
Approaching and passing the 1200 Metres, DASHING DART travelled keenly and got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of SUPER DUKE.
After the 1100 Metres, KINGâS MAN was left racing very wide and without cover and in the Straight gave ground.
Passing the 1000 Metres, WORKS OF ART was left racing wide and without cover.
For the majority of the race, TRIUMPHANT LIGHT raced with its head on the side and lay out and then made the Home Turn awkwardly when continuing to lay out.

When questioned, J Moreira (KINGâS MAN) stated that, from the outside barrier, he was asked to obtain a midfield position with cover if possible. He said he was obliged to direct KINGâS MAN out approaching the 1300 Metres to avoid interfering with GENTRY and after this because of the circumstances of the race he was unable to obtain cover. He said making the turn at the 800 Metres KINGâS MAN came off the bridle and appeared to lose interest in the race, as a result he had to niggle the horse along passing the 700 Metres in order to have it maintain its position.  He added that he was taken wider still by C P POWER after the 600 Metres, however, even at this time KINGâS MAN was already under pressure.  He said KINGâS MAN came under heavy pressure rounding the Home Turn and then, despite being ridden along, commenced to give ground.  He said KINGâS MAN was disappointing in todayâs race in that it never travelled comfortably, nonetheless the fact that the horse was required to race so wide obviously had some bearing on the horseâs finishing position.  A veterinary inspection of KINGâS MAN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of LITTLE FANTASY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GO BEAUTY GO and C P POWER were sent for sampling.

CIRCUIT HASSLER shifted out at the start and bumped LUCKY GIRL.
Shortly after the start, BABA MAMA was crowded for room inside CIRCUIT HASSLER (M Chadwick) which, when being ridden along to obtain a forward position, shifted in.  M Chadwick was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is properly clear of horses when shifting ground.  A short distance after this, CIRCUIT HASSLER was momentarily steadied away from the heels of LUCKY GIRL and despite being ridden along failed to muster speed and raced back in the field.
From a wide barrier, LET US WIN was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the 1100 Metres, CALIFORNIA DISEGNO was awkwardly placed close to the heels of ULTIMATE GLORY which was awkwardly placed behind LUCKY GIRL which shifted out from behind the leader TRAVEL FIRST.
Throughout the race, PEOPLEâS KNIGHT travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned regarding his riding of BABA MAMA in the Straight, K C Leung stated that the horse showed a sharp turn of foot in its previous races and it was his intention shortly after straightening to shift his mount to the outside of ULTIMATE GLORY and make his run with CALIFORNIA DISEGNO on his outside which he considered to be the horse to beat.  He said approaching the 300 Metres CALIFORNIA DISEGNO shifted out which presented a tight run between that horse and ULTIMATE GLORY and he rode his mount along to improve into this run.  He said however that BABA MAMA was laying in and proving difficult to shift out away from the heels of ULTIMATE GLORY.  He said at this time he was unaware that a run had become available to the inside of ULTIMATE GLORY as a result of LUCKY GIRL giving ground, however, he continued to position BABA MAMA to improve between ULTIMATE GLORY and CALIFORNIA DISEGNO as near the 250 Metres a clear run became available between those horses.  He added that as he shifted BABA MAMA out, CALIFORNIA DISEGNO shifted in which resulted in BABA MAMA being disappointed for this run.  He said he then shifted BABA MAMA to the inside of ULTIMATE GLORY and was able to obtain clear running until near the 50 Metres at which time BABA MAMA raced tight to the inside of ULTIMATE GLORY.  K C Leung was advised that whilst the Stewards accepted that a run was available for BABA MAMA to improve into between ULTIMATE GLORY and CALIFORNIA DISEGNO, nonetheless he is to ensure that he remains alert to all possibilities to improve his position at critical times of the race.
When questioned, J Moreira stated that shortly after entering the Straight he angled LET US WIN to the outside of LUCKY GIRL to improve into a potential run between that horse and BABA MAMA.  He said at this time BABA MAMA was racing tight to the inside of CALIFORNIA DISEGNO and as he was unaware of whether BABA MAMA would be directed back to the inside of ULTIMATE GLORY in an attempt to obtain clear running, he elected to shift LET US WIN to the inside of LUCKY GIRL in the hope that that horse would drift out under pressure and provide running between LUCKY GIRL and RAGHU.  He said passing the 300 Metres he committed LET US WIN to obtain clear running to the inside of RAGHU, however, when he became aware that a run had opened up between RAGHU and LUCKY GIRL, he directed his mount back out to improve into this run.  He said when he did this LUCKY GIRL shifted in which resulted in LET US WIN racing tight to that horseâs inside and behind RAGHU.  He added that due to these factors LET US WIN was not able to obtain clear running until the concluding stages and because of this was not able to be tested.
After the race, N Rawiller was not able to offer any explanation for the disappointing performance of LUCKY GIRL which gave ground in the Straight.  A veterinary inspection of LUCKY GIRL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CALIFORNIA DISEGNO and CIRCUIT HASSLER were sent for sampling.

PERPETUAL TREASURE began awkwardly and then was bumped by SANGRIA which shifted out.  Because of this PERPETUAL TREASURE raced back in the field.

CONVINCIBLE lost its right hind plate shortly after the start.

When MR POTENTIAL and PIKACHU were hampered, BRILLIANT DREAM, which was following, was hampered in consequence and in turn shifted in, causing BEAUTY FLARE to become unbalanced and bump THE SUPREME, resulting in both those horses also being hampered.  A Badel was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 22 February 2017 and to expire on Monday, 27 February 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays). SICHUAN BOSS raced greenly in the early and middle stages and then making the turn near the 900 Metres got its head on the side and lay out.  After this, SICHUAN BOSS continued to race greenly and hung out badly and in the Straight was eased down.  The racing manners of SICHUAN BOSS were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, SICHUAN BOSS will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial around a bend.
Near the 900 Metres, WINWIN RUBY was left racing wide and without cover and then in the Straight gave ground.  The performance of WINWIN RUBY, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, WINWIN RUBY will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
In the early part of the Straight, SHINNING MOON got its head on the side and lay in and passing the 400 Metres was checked away from the heels of CONVINCIBLE which, when commencing to shift to the outside of ALL MY GAIN, was required to shift out further away from that horseâs heels as ALL MY GAIN shifted out after being bumped by VOLITATION.  In this incident, CONVINCIBLE shifted out further and bumped MR POTENTIAL.  As the Stewards were satisfied that there were a number of factors surrounding this incident, none of which was attributable to carelessness on the part of any rider, no further action was taken.

MASSIVE MILLENNIUM bounded in the air at the start and lost ground.

In the early part of the Straight, HOT HOT PEPPER lay in and was reluctant to shift to the outside of TRENDIFUL and near the 100 Metres shifted in, resulting in its rider having to stop riding and straighten.

MEGATRON began awkwardly.
FRUITFUL LIFE began awkwardly and, from a wide barrier, was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

The Stewards were of the view that T H So was entitled to shift away from the rail given his position in respect of FLYING MACHINE and the fact that that horse was laying out.  It was further established that when being taken out, the minimal shift from CASA MASTER contributed significantly to FLYING MACHINE being crowded for room.  Given the circumstances, no further action was taken other than to advise T H So to exercise due care when shifting ground and to advise N Rawiller to ensure that he makes every endeavour to prevent his mounts from shifting ground.

Passing the winning post, GRAND HARBOUR became badly unbalanced and made heavy contact with the running rail, resulting in O Doleuze sustaining an injury to his right foot and causing him to have to dismount from GRAND HARBOUR on pulling up.  GRAND HARBOUR was then returned to the unsaddling area whilst O Doleuze underwent medical treatment.  Acting under the powers of Rule 112(5), weighed-in was declared on the numbers semaphored by the Judge without O Doleuze having to weigh in.  The Stewards permitted weighed-in to be declared to prevent an unreasonable delay to the declaration of weighed-in and as they were satisfied that there were no circumstances which suggested that less than the proper weight had been carried by GRAND HARBOUR throughout the race.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of CHEERS CONQUEROR, S Clipperton said when being steadied to obtain cover behind FLYING MACHINE in the early stages, CHEERS CONQUEROR commenced to travel keenly and at this time commenced to make an abnormal breathing noise.  He said CHEERS CONQUEROR continued to make this noise for the remainder of the race and further, he was of the view that the horse did not handle the Happy Valley circuit at its first time of asking in a race.  He added that after the race he suggested to connections that they may wish to consider applying a tongue tie to CHEERS CONQUEROR and to return the horse to Sha Tin as CHEERS CONQUEROR did not travel comfortably at any stage of tonightâs race. Before being allowed to race again, CHEERS CONQUEROR will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of FLYING MACHINE, B Prebble stated that he was able to obtain a good position on the horse in the early stages.  He said FLYING MACHINE travelled only fairly in the early and middle stages and at the 1000 Metres he became concerned with the manner in which the horse was travelling.  He said on entering the Back Straight near the 900 Metre FLYING MACHINE commenced to lay out and was reluctant to maintain its position outside MUTUAL JOY.  He said after sustaining interference passing the 700 Metres, FLYING MACHINE came under heavy pressure and, despite being ridden out, did not finish off the race.  He added that FLYING MACHINE raced âflatâ in tonightâs race.  A veterinary inspection of FLYING MACHINE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of GRAND HARBOUR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PO CHING TREASURE, MEGATRON and GRAND HARBOUR were sent for sampling.

ME PELE, first Standby Declared Starter, was withdrawn on 14.2.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (right fore medial suspensory branch injury).  GOODHEART SUCCESS was also withdrawn on 14.2.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and was replaced by second Standby Declared Starter SPICY SURE (Apprentice K K Chiong).  Before being allowed to race again, MR PELE and GOODHEART SUCCESS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SENSATION, which proved difficult to load, will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test before being allowed to race again.
PERFECT LIFELINE and SPICY SURE bumped at the start.

S de Sousa was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 22 February 2017 and to expire on Monday, 27 February 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, S de Sousa was fined $75,000.
Approaching the 800 Metres, ENSURING got its head up when being checked away from the heels of PERFECT LIFELINE.
Also approaching the 800 Metres, MR GENUINE got its head up when being checked away from the heels of FANTASTIC KAKA.  FRIENDS OF KA YING was hampered in consequence and DIVINE BOY, which was following FRIENDS OF KA YING, was shifted out away from the heels of that horse.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, PERFECT LIFELINE momentarily raced in restricted room inside FRIENDS OF KA YING which was racing tight inside FANTASTIC KAKA which shifted in after being brushed by MR GENUINE.

FANTASTIC KAKA was held up for clear running passing the 300 Metres when awkwardly placed behind DR WIN WIN.

When questioned, N Rawiller stated that he had been asked to ride FRIENDS OF KA YING in about a midfield position.  He said the horse had been ridden quietly in a recent barrier trial and performed well and it was felt that being ridden from off the speed tonight would provide FRIENDS OF KA YING with the opportunity to close off the race.  He said due to the makeup of the field, in the early stages he had to steady FRIENDS OF KA YING to obtain a position behind MR GENUINE after initially racing wide outside that horse.  He said this resulted in FRIENDS OF KA YING racing slightly further back than had been intended.  He said when the tempo of the race slackened approaching the 800 Metres, FRIENDS OF KA YING was shuffled back through the field and then after obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight finished off the race well.  Trainer P OâSullivan confirmed the riding instructions given to Jockey Rawiller and stated that he had been disappointed with the manner in which FRIENDS OF KA YING had been finishing off its races when ridden in a forward position since he commenced training the horse five starts ago.  He said for this reason the horse was ridden from off the speed in a barrier trial on 3 February 2017 and as he was satisfied with the manner in which FRIENDS OF KA YING had performed in this trial, it was decided to ride the horse in about a midfield positon tonight if possible.  He added having regard to the manner in which FRIENDS OF KA YING finished off the race, he was satisfied that the horse may be better suited by these tactics, however, its future positioning would depend on the circumstances of the race.

A veterinary inspection of MAGICAL BEAUTY immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, MAGICAL BEAUTY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
MAGICAL BEAUTY, UNICORN and SPICY SURE were sent for sampling.

<19/2/2017 15 February 2017 Happy Valley Racemeeting â Race 4 (421)>After reviewing the video footage for the Happy Valley racemeeting conducted on Wednesday, 15 February 2017 as is usual, the Stewards today questioned K C Leung regarding his riding of WILD BOY in the early stages of the race. K C Leung stated that it had been anticipated that GRACYDAD and MASTER VIKING, which had drawn immediately to the inside of WILD BOY in gates 1 and 2 respectively, would be ridden to go forward. He said he was aware that GRACYDAD had previously led in some of its races over the course and distance so he was aware that that horse possesses good early speed. He said he was therefore asked to ride WILD BOY in about 3rd or 4th position behind either MASTER VIKING or GRACYDAD. He said WILD BOY began well and was able to take up a forward position and he was aware that GRACYDAD was being ridden along to maintain its position to its inside. He said although the tempo of the race was not overly strong in the early stages, he believed that he would have had to ride WILD BOY along to cross GRACYDAD as he anticipated that that rider would not allow WILD BOY to cross, particularly given that there were horses from wider barriers also being ridden forward. He added making the first turn after the 1100 Metres he received a call from the rider of GRACYDAD to alert him that he was not clear of that horse and for this reason he remained racing in the one-off position. He said in doing this he did not have to make too much use of the horse and he believed that this would provide WILD BOY with the best opportunity to close off strongly. K C Leung was advised that his explanation would be reported.

TRUMP began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of DRAGON GENERAL. <20/2/2017 "AMBITIOUS PINS" INQUIRY>The Stewards today concluded the inquiry into C Schofieldâs handling of AMBITIOUS PINS in the Sing Woo Handicap which was run at Happy Valley Racecourse on Wednesday, 15 February 2017.  Further evidence was today taken from Jockey Schofield and evidence was taken from Mr R Gibson, the trainer of AMBITIOUS PINS, and Mr P C Ma, assistant trainer allocated to Mr Gibsonâs stable for the current racing season.  A written authority for Mr Gibson to represent the interests of Mr Anderson Lam Hin Yue, the owner of AMBITIOUS PINS, at todayâs inquiry was tendered.

C Schofield was found guilty of a breach of Hong Kong Rule of Racing 99 (2) and (5) in that as the rider of AMBITIOUS PINS in the stated race, he failed to take all reasonable and permissible measures throughout the race to ensure AMBITIOUS PINS was given a full opportunity to win or to obtain the best possible placing in the field.

The charge against Jockey Schofield was particularised as follows:-

1.	           That passing the 300 Meres he did direct AMBITIOUS PINS inwards away from clear and uninterrupted running to the outside of MAGNETISM when it was both reasonable and permissible for him to have maintained such clear and uninterrupted running outside MAGNETISM.

2.	           That near the 250 Metres he did further direct AMBITIOUS PINS to the inside of MAGNETISM and in so doing shifted AMBITIOUS PINS further away from clear and uninterrupted running outside MAGNETISM when it was both reasonable and permissible for him to have afforded AMBITIOUS PINS the opportunity of clear and uninterrupted running outside MAGNETISM.

3.	           By directing AMBITIOUS PINS to the inside of MAGNETISM and away from clear and uninterrupted running outside that horse, AMBITIOUS PINS was held up for clear running behind EASY HEDGE approaching and passing the 200 Metres; and, further, AMBITIOUS PINS was unable to obtain clear running over about the final 100 Metres of the race.  As a result of AMBITIOUS PINS being held up for clear running approaching and passing the 200 Metres and then being unable to obtain clear running over about the final 100 Metres of the race, the horse was not able to be properly tested.

4.	           By directing AMBITIOUS PINS to the inside of MAGNETISM and away from clear and uninterrupted running outside that horse he did fail to take all reasonable and permissible measures to ensure that AMBITIOUS PINS was given a full opportunity to win or to obtain the best possible placing in the field.

In the circumstances, the Stewards believed that the appropriate penalty was for Jockey Schofieldâs licence to ride in races to be suspended for a period to commence on Wednesday, 8 March 2017 and to expire on Thursday, 6 April 2017 on which day he may resume race riding.  During this period, there are 9 racemeetings scheduled to be conducted in Hong Kong.  

Mr Gibson was advised that his evidence had been noted.  Further, the Stewards accepted the reasons offered by Mr Gibson for him not being present at the Happy Valley Racecourse for this race.

When questioned, K Teetan stated that it had been intended for HARBOUR NOVA to utilize the horseâs inside draw and obtain a position in midfield or just in advance of midfield.  He said after being placed in the barriers HARBOUR NOVA attempted to sit down which resulted in him having to be assisted by a starting gate handler.  He said then as the start was effected HARBOUR NOVA began awkwardly and lost ground which resulted in the horse racing slightly further back in the field than had been intended.  He said he had also been informed by the connections that HARBOUR NOVA has a limited sprint and therefore he should not expose the horse too early in the Straight as it had not finished off the race when ridden in this manner in the past.  He said after beginning awkwardly he was able to take up a position just off midfield and was following TOP LAURELS which appeared to be travelling well in the middle stages.  He said passing the 500 Metres he directed HARBOUR NOVA to the outside of TOP LAURELS in an endeavour to follow MORETHANLUCKY, however, TOP LAURELS was shifted out to improve to the outside of CALIFORNIA ASPAR passing the 400 Metres.  He said he continued to follow TOP LAURELS as he expected to obtain a run to that horseâs outside and inside MORETHANLUCKY which was available near the 350 Metres.  He said as he positioned HARBOUR NOVA to the outside of TOP LAURELS, that horse was then shifted out further to improve to the outside of CHEVALIER STAR.  He said this resulted in HARBOUR NOVA being held up for clear running behind TOP LAURELS, however, he was not concerned about this at this time given his instructions to ensure that HARBOUR NOVA was not exposed too early in the Straight.  He said as the run had previously been available between TOP LAURELS and MORETHANLUCKY, he was confident that this run would again become available, so he elected to continue to pursue the run to the outside of TOP LAURELS rather than shift to the inside of that horse in an endeavour to improve.  He added that passing the 300 Metres MORETHANLUCKY got its head on the side and shifted out which presented a run that he had been anticipating and he immediately rode HARBOUR NOVA along to take advantage of that run.  He said however that HARBOUR NOVA was disappointed for this run when TOP LAURELS was taken out by CHEVALIER STAR.  He said for this reason he then immediately shifted HARBOUR NOVA to the inside of TOP LAURELS and placed his mount under heavy pressure.  He said passing the 150 Metres he had to direct HARBOUR NOVA in away from the heels of CHEVALIER STAR to continue improving and the horse then finished off the race well.  Trainer P OâSullivan confirmed the riding instructions given to Jockey Teetan.  He said HARBOUR NOVA had previously been reported to have had substantial amount of blood in its trachea following a number of its races and it was for this reason that he brought the horse back in distance for todayâs race and had given it some time off since its most recent run in December last year.  He said he had been disappointed with the manner in which HARBOUR NOVA had finished off some of its races when left in front too early and he believed that the internal issues that HARBOUR NOVA had experienced in its races had been the principal reason for the horseâs failure to finish off its races.  He said he therefore emphasized to Jockey Teetan that he did not want the horse to obtain clear running too early in the Straight as he believed that it would be advantaged by being held up for a short sprint.  He said after viewing the videos he accepted Jockey Teetanâs reasons for pursuing the run to the outside of TOP LAURELS rather than shifting the horse to the inside of TOP LAURELS until after being disappointed for running passing the 300 Metres.  After viewing the videos and considering all the circumstances including the racing history of HARBOUR NOVA, the Stewards advised Jockey Teetan that his explanation would be reported, however, he was told to ensure that he is aware of all opportunities to improve his position as they become available so that his mounts are able to obtain clear running at the earliest opportunity.  Mr OâSullivan was advised that his evidence would be reported.  A veterinary inspection of HARBOUR NOVA immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

The Stewards deferred the declaration of weighed-in as they were of the prima facie view that an incident had occurred approaching the 200 Metres which cast sufficient doubt on whether DR RACE (B Prebble) should be declared the 5th placegetter.  When N Callan, the rider of the 6th placegetter, GOLDEN ACHIEVER, did not enter a formal protest/objection on behalf of the connections of GOLDEN ACHIEVER, the Stewards believed that it was appropriate for the matter to proceed to a formal/objection hearing.  Whilst these placings did not affect betting, it was relevant that there was the issue of prizemoney in respect of the 5th placegetter.  After taking evidence from B Prebble, Mr S K Sit, assistant trainer allocated to Mr D E Ferraris, the trainer of DR RACE, and N Callan, it was found that approaching the 200 Metres DR RACE was shifted to the outside of GAME OF FUN to obtain clear running which resulted in GOLDEN ACHIEVER being checked and losing its rightful running when crowded for room inside CONTRIBUTION.  Having regard to the neck margin between both horses at the end of the race and the manner in which they were finishing off the race, the Stewards were satisfied that had the interference not occurred GOLDEN ACHIEVER would have finished in front of DR RACE.  Accordingly, the protest/objection was sustained and the placings amended to read No. 3, GAME OF FUN, 1st; No. 11, CONTRIBUTION, 2nd; No. 1, VERY RICH MAN, 3rd; No. 9, G-ONE LOVER, 4th; No. 2, GOLDEN ACHIEVER, 5th; and No. 4, DR RACE, 6th.  N Callan was advised that in similar circumstances he must be aware of the placings of horses and to ensure that he has the interests of connections in mind.  At a subsequent inquiry, B Prebble pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] and was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 8 March 2017 and to expire on Monday, 13 March 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays). LUCKY POWER lost its left hind plate near the 1300 Metres.
Near the 950 Metres, TEN SPEED was momentarily crowded for room between CARRY TO WIN and RHODE ASSASSIN which shifted in.  RHODE ASSASSIN was then directed out, resulting in UNBEATABLE GUTS being taken wider.  UNBEATABLE GUTS, which throughout the race travelled wide and without cover, was then allowed to stride into a more forward position after the 900 Metres.
Approaching the 900 Metres, ACTUARIAT (C Schofield) shifted in and bumped RAGING BULL.  FORMULA GALORE, which was following RAGING BULL, was shifted in away from the heels of that horse, resulting in CARRY TO WIN being steadied when crowded for room.  C Schofield was advised to exercise due care when positioning his mounts in future.  After this, CARRY TO WIN proved difficult to settle and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of FORMULA GALORE.
RHODE ASSASSIN lost its left front plate near the 900 Metres.
Approaching the 700 Metres, VICTORY FOLLOW ME commenced to prove very difficult to settle and got its head up when being checked away from the heels of TEAM SWEET.
Near the 550 Metres, SOUL ACHIEVER got its head up when being steadied away from the heels of CARRY TO WIN which was awkwardly placed behind FORMULA GALORE when travelling keenly.
Passing the 500 Metres, LAUGH OUT LOUD shifted out and bumped TEAM SWEET.
CARRY TO WIN was held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight.
SOUL ACHIEVER was unable to obtain clear running from approaching the 300 Metres until near the 200 Metres.
When questioned regarding the performance of RAGING BULL, B Prebble stated that, in his opinion, the horse is best suited when able to have a trouble-free run in a forward position.  He said he had intended to lead on RAGING BULL, however, after being ridden along in the early stages the tempo of the race was genuine and he would have had to make a lot more use of RAGING BULL in an endeavour to take the outright lead.  He said after being bumped by ACTUARIAT approaching the 900 Metres, RAGING BULL then travelled comfortably behind the leaders, however, the horse was reluctant to improve between runners rounding the Home Turn and after being placed under pressure in the early part of the Straight was disappointing in the manner in which it weakened out of the race.  A veterinary inspection of RAGING BULL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of RAGING BULL was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, RAGING BULL will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After the race, TEN SPEED was found to be lame in the right front leg after sustaining an injury during the race.  Before being allowed to race again, TEN SPEED will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of FORMULA GALORE immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, FORMULA GALORE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
FORMULA GALORE, VICTORY MASTER and GOOD FOR YOU were sent for sampling.

THOR THE GREATEST, Standby Declared Starter, was withdrawn on 23.2.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore foot).  Before being allowed to race again, THOR THE GREATEST will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Whilst in the saddling stalls, SUNSHINE UNIVERSE had both hind plates refitted.  SUNSHINE UNIVERSE was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
After being loaded into the barriers, SMART BOY became very fractious and attempted to break through under the front gates.  After this, SMART BOY continued to be fractious and got its head under the front gates.  SMART BOY was removed from the barriers and examined by the Veterinary officer who said in his opinion it was not suitable to race.  Acting on this advice, SMART BOY was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  Before being allowed to rac

At declaration time, J Moreira was declared as the rider of both EASY TOUCH and VITAL SPRING.  It was established that J Moreira had a firm commitment to ride VITAL SPRING.  As such, the Stewards permitted Apprentice H T Mo to be substituted as the rider of EASY TOUCH.  For this declaration error, Trainer C S Shum was fined $2,000.
The Stewards were informed by the Clubâs Racing Laboratory on 24 February 2017 that a stable-submitted elective urine sample taken from RICHCITY FORTUNE was found to show the presence of the prohibited substance clenbuterol.  As the horseâs intended race today was within the recommended withdrawal period for this substance, Mr J Moore, the trainer of RICHCITY FORTUNE, requested for the horse to be withdrawn.  The Stewards acceded to the request and consequently RICHCITY FORTUNE was withdrawn from this race by order of the Stewards and was replaced by first Standby Declared Starter GREAT TOPLIGHT (M Chadwick).  The Stewards today interviewed Mr Moore regarding the circumstances surrounding the horse being entered and declared for this race following it being administered the prohibited substance clenbuterol on 11 February 2017.  Evidence was taken from Mr Moore, Mr C W Wong, assistant trainer allocated to Mr Mooreâs stable for the current racing season, and Dr P Curl, Executive Manager, Veterinary Regulation.  Mr Moore was found to be in breach of Rule 50(2) in that he failed in his responsibility for all matters pertaining to the running of his stable and was fined the sum of $30,000. 
PEARL WIN was withdrawn on 25.2.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (sore right front tendon) and was replaced by second Standby Declared Starter DYNAMIC LIONS (B Prebble).  Before being allowed to race again, PEARL WIN will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
JOLLY AMBER began only fairly and then shortly after the start was crowded for room between MERRYGOWIN and ENCHANTED FEELING which shifted in after being bumped on the hindquarters by JOLLY AMBER.
PERFECT TOUCH began awkwardly and shifted out.  After this, from a wide barrier, PERFECT TOUCH was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Also from a wide barrier, CITY LEGEND was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
After travelling a short distance, GRACIOUS RYDER was steadied away from the heels of COOL BROTHERS which hung in when being ridden along to take up a forward position.
Approaching the 1000 Metres, COOL BROTHERS raced tight between EXPONENTS and MERRYGOWIN which got its head on the side and shifted in away from EASY TOUCH.  Then passing the 1000 Metres, COOL BROTHERS got its head up when proving difficult to settle.
In the early stages, PERFECT TOUCH raced greenly and making the first turn after the 900 Metres got its head on the side and lay out.  After this, PERFECT TOUCH continued to race greenly and again got its head on the side and lay out making the Home Turn.
Making the turn after the 900 Metres, GRACIOUS RYDER was awkwardly placed behind COOL BROTHERS which was reluctant to maintain its position inside VITAL SPRING.
Near the 750 Metres, DYNAMIC LIONS was awkwardly placed inside the heels of COOL BROTHERS which, when continuing to race greenly, shifted in away from the heels of VITAL SPRING.
For the majority of the race, GREAT TOPLIGHT travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, Apprentice H T Mo stated that he had been instructed to obtain the rail and lead on EASY TOUCH if possible.  He said in accordance with his instructions he rode his mount hard for a considerable distance in the early stages and it was not until well after the 1000 Metres that he was able to cross MERRYGOWIN to his inside to race outside CIRCUIT KING.  He said he knew at this time that he would not be able to lead and therefore making the first turn immediately attempted to steady EASY TOUCH and remain racing to the outside of CIRCUIT KING.  He said when he did this EASY TOUCH got its head on the side and hung out whilst also proving difficult to settle.  He added he applied heavy pressure to the right rein in an endeavour to have EASY TOUCH shift back in to race directly outside CIRCUIT KING, however, the horse was reluctant to shift over to race outside that horse.
After the race, it was reported by the Veterinary Surgeon that COOL BROTHERS had sustained an overreach wound to the inside of the left front heel.
A veterinary inspection of REGENCY DARLING immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MERRYGOWIN and VITAL SPRING were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE CITI HONG KONG GOLD CUP
incident_report:
SECRET WEAPON shifted in at the start and bumped FLAME HERO.
From the outside barrier, BEAUTY ONLY was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
FLAME HERO was eased out of the race passing the 900 Metres.  After the race, it was reported that FLAME HERO had bled from both nostrils.
Passing the 600 Metres, as H Bowman attempted to improve on WERTHER to the outside of BLAZING SPEED, WERTHER was taken out marginally by BLAZING SPEED which also shifted a small amount of ground to establish running to the outside of BASIC TRILOGY.  This resulted in WERTHER being checked when unable to improve between BLAZING SPEED and BEAUTY ONLY which improved quickly to the outside of WERTHER and was racing tight to the inside of DESIGNS ON ROME.  As H Bowman attempted to establish his position between BEAUTY ONLY and BLAZING SPEED, WERTHER bumped BEAUTY ONLY, resulting in that horse being taken out onto the hindquarters of DESIGNS ON ROME which was turned in.  This resulted in BEAUTY ONLY becoming unbalanced and shifting in, exacerbating the check sustained by WERTHER.  After this, as BEAUTY ONLY remained unbalanced, it again bumped the hindquarters of DESIGNS ON ROME approaching the 500 Metres, causing both horses to again become badly unbalanced.  As the Stewards were satisfied that WERTHER had not properly established running to the outside of BLAZING SPEED prior to that horse shifting marginally to establish itself to the outside of BASIC TRILOGY, no further action was taken.
In the early part of the Straight, WERTHER got its head on the side and lay in under pressure.
SECRET WEAPON was unable to obtain clear running until passing the 250 Metres.
WERTHER and BLAZING SPEED were sent for sampling.

PERFECT LIFELINE began only fairly.
Shortly after the start, AMAZING AGILITY became unbalanced after being bumped by HOME RUN which was taken out by IMPERIAL GALLANTRY which shifted ground after being bumped by RED ELYSEES.  After this, from wide barriers, IMPERIAL GALLANTRY, HOME RUN and AMAZING AGILITY were all shifted across behind runners.
Near the 900 Metres, AMAZING AGILITY was bumped by THE JAZZ which got its head on the side and shifted out away from the heels of AGREE.
At the 600 Metres, ISHVARA was taken wider by BEAUTY FLARE which shifted out.
Approaching the 200 Metres, BEAUTY FLARE was momentarily awkwardly placed close to the heels of ISHVARA when taken out by UP AND COMING (N Rawiller) which shifted out to obtain clear running.  N Rawiller was advised to exercise more care when shifting ground.
Near the 150 Metres, ISHVARA was brushed by UP AND COMING which shifted out and away from HOME RUN.
Close to the finishing line, UP AND COMING raced tight between ISHVARA and HOME RUN.
Throughout the race, ISHVARA travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of AMAZING AGILITY, B Prebble stated that as is normally the case, the horse travelled back in the field.  He said he had hoped to be able to improve his position after the 1000 Metres, however, THE JAZZ shifted out at this time and because of this he was not able to continue improving.  He said AMAZING AGILITY travelled well rounding the Home Turn and after being shifted to the outside of runners, he expected the horse to finish off the race well, however, the horse came under pressure passing the 300 Metres and then over the final 200 Metres did not finish off the race as he expected.  A veterinary inspection of AMAZING AGILITY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
When questioned, M L Yeung stated that it had been intended for RED ELYSEES, which was stepping up in distance, to be ridden similarly to its only other race start in Hong Kong when the horse was successful when ridden from back in the field.  He said RED ELYSEES began very well and assumed a forward position in the early stages of its own accord and at no time did he ride the horse along.  He said he looked to his inside shortly after the start to establish whether it was reasonable for him to restrain RED ELYSEES to take a position behind runners, however, given the positioning of RED ELYSEES at this time, the pace of the race in the early stages and the manner in which RED ELYSEES had begun, he did not believe that it was reasonable for him to restrain the horse at this time as he would have had to restrain it heavily to ride it as he was instructed.  He added therefore he allowed RED ELYSEES to shift across to race towards the lead but at no stage did he have to push the horse to achieve this position.  He said when placed under pressure in the Straight RED ELYSEES did not respond to his riding and gave ground.  A veterinary inspection of RED ELYSEES immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
After the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on RAZOR QUEST at the request of Trainer C W Chang.  The Veterinary Surgeon reported that this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, RAZOR QUEST will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
RAZOR QUEST, WHAT ELSE BUT YOU and HOME RUN were sent for sampling.

ISTANBUL BEY was slow to begin.
MAMBO ROCK shifted out at the start and bumped GENERAL SHERMAN which began awkwardly.
EASY HEDGE began awkwardly.
MCQUEEN got its head up on a number of occasions shortly after the start.
Approaching the winning post on the first occasion, MCQUEEN got its head up when proving very difficult to settle and then passing the winning post on the first occasion when continuing to race ungenerously was bumped by GORGEOUS KING which was racing tight inside UNIQUE HAPPIEST (H W Lai).  After being bumped by GORGEOUS KING, MCQUEEN shifted in, resulting in LOTUS STRIKES BACK being crowded for room outside CLOUD NINE.  H W Lai was advised that whilst MCQUEENâs racing manners had contributed significantly to this incident, nonetheless he must ensure that he leaves comfortable racing room for runners to his inside in similar circumstances.  After this, MCQUEEN continued to race ungenerously and passing the 1800 Metres raced tight between CLOUD NINE and GORGEOUS KING which shifted in away from UNIQUE HAPPIEST.
Near the 1500 Metres, WILLIE WAY got its head up when being checked away from the heels of GENERAL SHERMAN.
Passing the 1100 Metres, GENERAL SHERMAN got its head up when proving difficult to settle and awkwardly placed close to the heels of EASY HEDGE.  At the same point, ISTANBUL BEY was checked away from the heels of MAMBO ROCK.
Passing the 1000 Metres, EASY HEDGE, which was proving difficult to settle, got its head up when being shifted to the outside of MCQUEEN.
Making the turn after the 900 Metres, MCQUEEN was steadied away from the heels of EASY HEDGE which lay in behind GORGEOUS KING.
After the 900 Metres, GENERAL SHERMAN was left racing wide and without cover.
REDWOOD BABY lost its left front plate after the 900 Metres.
Passing the 800 Metres, HO HO FEEL was awkwardly placed close to the heels of HAPPY CONTENDER.
Approaching the 500 Metres, MCQUEEN was brushed by LOTUS STRIKES BACK which shifted out to obtain clear running.  GENERAL SHERMAN, which was following MCQUEEN, was inconvenienced in consequence.
