At the entrance to the Straight, HAPPY ROCKY was shifted in away from the heels of CLOUD NINE.
MAMBO ROCK was held up for clear running approaching the 400 Metres.
At the 400 Metres, EASY HEDGE was shifted out away from the heels of GORGEOUS KING which shifted out marginally away from WILLIE WAY.
HO HO FEEL was badly held up for clear running from near the 350 Metres until passing the 200 Metres.
For a short distance after the 300 Metres, HAPPY ROCKY was unable to obtain clear running.
Near the 250 Metres, MAMBO ROCK was shifted in away from the heels of GORGEOUS KING to continue improving and shifted in further and bumped CLOUD NINE.
A veterinary inspection of REDWOOD BABY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MAMBO ROCK, LOTUS STRIKES BACK and WILLIE WAY were sent for sampling.

FAITHFUL BOY shifted in at the start, resulting in BEST REWARD being hampered and then, despite being hard ridden along in the early stages, was slow to muster speed.  FAITHFUL BOY subsequently travelled wide and without cover throughout the race and in the Straight gave ground.
HOLY UNICORN began awkwardly.
From the outside barriers, DIGITAL PIONEER and LOYAL CRAFTSMAN were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, GENTLEMEN was steadied away from the heels of VIVACIOUS WINNER (J Moreira) which shifted in when not quite clear.  J Moreira was advised to exercise more care when shifting ground in similar circumstances.
After passing the winning post on the first occasion, when being ridden along to obtain a forward position, COMMANDANT got its head on the side and lay in, resulting in GENTLEMEN being momentarily crowded for room outside SEVEN LUCK.
Passing the 1300 Metres, ATOMIC BLAST was awkwardly placed close to the heels of LUCKY SEBRING.
COMMANDANT travelled wide and without cover until after the 1100 Metres.
Passing the 500 Metres, SEVEN LUCK momentarily raced in restricted room between MIZZEN GREY and SWEET BEAN which shifted to the outside of ATOMIC BLAST to improve its position.
Rounding the Home Turn, THIS IS GLADIATOR and BEST REWARD raced tight.
At the entrance to the Straight, ATOMIC BLAST was checked when disappointed for running between GENTLEMEN and COMMANDANT which shifted out marginally.  In this incident, GENTLEMEN became badly unbalanced after being bumped on the hindquarters by ATOMIC BLAST.  For some distance after this, ATOMIC BLAST had difficulty obtaining clear running and approaching the 200 Metres was shifted out away from the heels of VIVACIOUS WINNER which was commencing to give ground.  Then passing the 200 Metres, ATOMIC BLAST was directed in away from the heels of LUCKY SEBRING to continue improving.
Shortly after entering the Straight, THIS IS GLADIATOR was crowded for room between BEST REWARD and FAITHFUL BOY, both of which shifted minimal ground.  MIZZEN GREY, which was following FAITHFUL BOY, was held up for clear running in consequence.
SWEET BEAN was held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Near the 150 Metres, COMMANDANT, which was giving ground, was momentarily steadied away from the heels of GENTLEMEN.
When questioned, J Moreira stated that he was unable to offer an explanation for the disappointing performance of VIVACIOUS WINNER.  He said although he had to make some use of the horse in the early stages to obtain a forward position, nonetheless VIVACIOUS WINNER travelled quite well in the early and middle stages.  He said he placed the horse under pressure rounding the Home Turn and it initially responded to his riding, however, VIVACIOUS WINNER came under heavy pressure after the 300 Metres and then did not finish off the race.  A veterinary inspection of VIVACIOUS WINNER immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, VIVACIOUS WINNER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of FAITHFUL BOY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
VIVACIOUS WINNER, BEST REWARD and SWEET BEAN were sent for sampling.

OSCAR MIRACLE began awkwardly and lost ground and then shortly after the start was bumped by ZOOMOOL which shifted out.
GREAT TOPLIGHT lost its left front plate at the start.
WINNING BOY, SUPER EURO STAR and THE FULL BLOOM were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Near the 1500 Metres, GRAND HARBOUR got its head on the side, shifted in and bumped EMPEROR VICTORY, resulting in both horses becoming unbalanced.
Approaching the 1200 Metres, WINNING BOY got its head up for some distance when awkwardly placed close to the heels of GLOBAL DOMINATION.
GLOBAL DOMINATION lost its left hind plate near the 1100 Metres.
At the entrance to the Straight, GREAT TOPLIGHT was awkwardly placed outside the heels of SEE ME NOW.
Approaching the 100 Metres, DIAMOND FRIENDS and JE PENSE raced tight.
Throughout the race, EXPEDITE travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned regarding his riding of EMPEROR VICTORY particularly after the 1200 Metres, Apprentice H N Wong stated that as EMPEROR VICTORY was carrying a light weight, he was asked to ensure that he took advantage of the horseâs inside draw and obtain the lead if possible.  He said whilst the connections were aware that GRAND HARBOUR, which had drawn a wide draw, would also be ridden forward, it was hoped that the rider of that horse would be content to race outside EMPEROR VICTORY given each horseâs respective barrier positions and the difference in the weight both horses were carrying.  He said he was further instructed not to restrain EMPEROR VICTORY too heavily as the horse had previously shown a tendency to get its head up in races when too much pressure was applied to its mouth.  He said in accordance with his instructions he rode his mount positively in the early stages to obtain the lead and felt that he had ridden his mount with sufficient purpose to indicate to the rider of GRAND HARBOUR of his intention to lead.  He said however that approaching the 1200 Metres GRAND HARBOUR commenced to improve forward of EMPEROR VICTORY and he therefore allowed EMPEROR VICTORY to stride forward to ensure that he maintained his position in the lead.  He added however that GRAND HARBOUR continued to press forward, but given his instructions, he was reluctant to steady EMPEROR VICTORY despite the knowledge that the race was being run at a faster tempo that had been hoped.  He said ultimately due to the tempo of the race he elected to steady EMPEROR VICTORY approaching the 700 Metres and allowed GRAND HARBOUR to cross as he felt that this would provide EMPEROR VICTORY with an opportunity to finish off the race.  Mr Y S Tsui, the trainer of EMPEROR VICTORY, confirmed his instructions and the reasons given to Apprentice Wong for his insistence that Apprentice Wong maintain the lead if possible.  He said however that he would have been comfortable for Apprentice Wong to have eased EMPEROR VICTORY so that the horse would not be obliged to run at a tempo that it was.  Apprentice Wong was advised that, in the opinion of the Stewards, he had erred after the 1000 Metres in not allowing GRAND HARBOUR to cross EMPEROR VICTORY given the manner in which the race was being run at that time.  He was advised that whilst the Stewards appreciated that he had been given firm instructions on how EMPEROR VICTORY should be ridden, nonetheless it is a requirement of jockeys that they exercise appropriate judgement and initiative so that their mounts are able to finish off the race as best as they are able.
A veterinary inspection of GLOBAL DOMINATION immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, GLOBAL DOMINATION will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
GREAT TOPLIGHT, GRAND HARBOUR and LANSBURY were sent for sampling.
<2/3/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>The Clinical Veterinary Surgeon reported that LANSBURY was lame in its left front leg on the morning after racing.  Before being allowed to race again, LANSBURY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

ORIONIDS began awkwardly.
HORSE SUPREMO began awkwardly and shortly after the start was immediately shifted across behind runners.
HELENâS CHOICE and MONEY MONEY bumped at the start.  Then a short distance after the start, HELENâS CHOICE raced tight inside MONEY MONEY.
Making the turn near the 700 Metres, GRADE ONE momentarily raced tight inside the heels of PEACE COMBINATION.
Throughout the race, FORZA AVANTI travelled wide and without cover and after the 700 Metres got its head on the side and lay out.
Passing the 200 Metres, N Callan (GENEROUS BOBO) dropped his whip.
Mr A T Millard, the trainer of HORSE SUPREMO, stated that as the horse had an embargo placed upon it at its last start for hanging in, he advised H W Lai, the rider of HORSE SUPREMO, to ensure that he obtained cover in order to assist it in making the turns.
After the race, J Moreira stated that HELENâS CHOICE did not travel comfortably at any stage of the race and he was required to ride the horse along throughout in an endeavour to have it maintain its position as close to the main body of the field as possible.  A veterinary inspection of HELENâS CHOICE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of PEACE COMBINATION immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ORIONIDS, FORZA AVANTI and ART OF SUCCESS were sent for sampling.

GOLD DRAGON began only fairly.
GOOD FIT began only fairly and shortly after the start was crowded for room between LUCKY SEVEN STARS and SURE PEACE which was taken in by HIT A HOME RUN which shifted in despite the efforts of its rider.  After this, from wide barriers, GOOD FIT, SURE PEACE and HIT A HOME RUN were all shifted across behind runners.
Shortly after the start, SUM WIN DRAGON and TRAVEL AMBASSADOR bumped on a number of occasions, resulting in TRAVEL AMBASSADOR being taken out onto DIGITAL GENERATION which became badly unbalanced after being bumped by TRAVEL AMBASSADOR.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, GLENEALY PRIZE was hampered and TRUE COMMENT checked when crowded for room inside EQUITY DOCTRINE which got its head on the side and shifted in away from WORKS OF ART.  A short distance later, EQUITY DOCTRINE was shifted out across the heels of WORKS OF ART (M Chadwick) which shifted in when not quite clear.  As the Stewards were satisfied that EQUITY DOCTRINEâs racing manners had contributed significantly to this incident, no further action was taken, however, M Chadwick was advised to ensure that he is properly clear of other runners when shifting ground.  GOLD DRAGON, which was following TRUE COMMENT, was hampered in consequence.  In this incident, EQUITY DOCTRINE became unbalanced after being galloped on by TRUE COMMENT.
Making the turn near the 700 Metres, TRUE COMMENT, which was being ridden along to maintain its position, was momentarily crowded for room between SURE PEACE and TRAVEL AMBASSADOR which shifted out marginally.  After this, TRUE COMMENT gave ground and subsequently finished tailed out.  The performance of TRUE COMMENT was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, TRUE COMMENT will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Rounding the Home Turn, TRAVEL AMBASSADOR raced tight outside GLENEALY PRIZE which shifted out.
For some distance in the early part of the Straight, GOOD FIT was awkwardly placed close to the heels of LUCKY SEVEN STARS when endeavouring to improve into tight running outside that horse and inside GOLD DRAGON.  As GOOD FIT was improving to the outside of LUCKY SEVEN STARS, GOOD FIT was hampered and taken wider when LUCKY SEVEN STARS shifted out abruptly away from TRAVEL AMBASSADOR.  In this incident, LUCKY SEVEN STARS became unbalanced after receiving contact on the hindquarters from GOOD FIT.
Passing the 250 Metres, WINASWEWISH was shifted out away from the heels of EQUITY DOCTRINE to obtain clear running.
For the majority of the race, SUM WIN DRAGON travelled wide and without cover.
After the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on DIGITAL GENERATION at the request of Trainer C W Chang.  The Veterinary Surgeon reported that this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  The performance of DIGITAL GENERATION, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, DIGITAL GENERATION will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of GOLD DRAGON immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
TRAVEL AMBASSADOR, WORKS OF ART and GLENEALY PRIZE were sent for sampling.

RESPECT was withdrawn on 27.2.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter M REBORN.  Before being allowed to race again, RESPECT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
GREAT SKY began only fairly.
After being steadied in the early stages to obtain a position with cover, M REBORN travelled greenly and shifted ground on a number of occasions and near the 1150 Metres was awkwardly placed outside the heels of BORN DRAGON.
Passing the 900 Metres, HURRICANE KID was awkwardly placed close to the heels of BORN DRAGON (J Moreira) which shifted in when not quite clear.  J Moreira was advised to ensure that he provides sufficient clearance when shifting ground in similar circumstances.
For some distance making the turn after the 700 Metres, BOLSHOI BALLET got its head on the side and lay out.
Rounding the Home Turn, BORN DRAGON and BOND ELEGANCE raced tight as BORN DRAGON shifted out to obtain clear running.
Passing the 300 Metres, HEARTS KEEPER was checked when attempting to improve between FLYING GODSPELL and SALSA BROTHERS where there was insufficient room.  HEARTS KEEPER was then shifted to the outside of SALSA BROTHERS passing the 200 Metres to obtain clear running.
Passing the 200 Metres, HURRICANE KID shifted out and brushed SMILING GLORY.
Throughout the race, BOND ELEGANCE and SMILING GLORY travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of FLYING GODSPELL, Apprentice H N Wong stated that he was able to obtain the lead in the early stages without having to place too much pressure on FLYING GODSPELL.  He said after shifting in to race on the rail in the lead passing the 1000 Metres, FLYING GODSPELL travelled comfortably and even when SALSA BROTHERS improved to its outside near the 700 Metres, his mount continued to travel well and he expected it to respond well when placed under pressure rounding the Home Turn.  He said FLYING GODSPELL came under pressure at the 400 Metres and initially responded satisfactorily, however, when SALSA BROTHERS improved outside FLYING GODSPELL near the 300 Metres, FLYING GODSPELL immediately commenced to give ground and then was disappointing in the manner in which it weakened over the concluding stages.  A veterinary inspection of FLYING GODSPELL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of FLYING GODSPELL, a last start winner, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, FLYING GODSPELL will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After the race, it was reported that SALSA BROTHERS had sustained a wound to the right hind cannon.  An endoscopic examination was also conducted on SALSA BROTHERS at the request of Trainer C S Shum.  The Veterinary Surgeon reported that this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, SALSA BROTHERS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SALSA BROTHERS lost its right hind plate during the race.
BORN DRAGON and HURRICANE KID were sent for sampling.

SUPER MAN was slow to begin.
Shortly after the start, ALLCASH became unbalanced after being bumped by RUBY COAST which shifted out away from PACKING GENIUS.  A short distance after this PACKING GENIUS was bumped by KING GENKI which shifted out.
Making the turn near the 1500 Metres, DEJA VU shifted in away from RED MARVEL and made heavy contact with KING GENKI which became badly unbalanced.
Despite being ridden along in the early stages, LITTLE DRAGON failed to muster speed.
Approaching and passing the 1400 Metres, SUPER MAN raced with its head on the side, hung out and was awkwardly placed inside the heels of LITTLE DRAGON.
Throughout the race, CELESTIAL ARROW travelled wide and without cover and near the 700 Metres hung out.  The performance of CELESTIAL ARROW, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, CELESTIAL ARROW will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned, K C Ng stated that as KING GENKI is a long striding horse, he was instructed to ensure that he led from barrier 1 and not restrain the horse so as to ensure that its stride was not broken.  He said KING GENKI does not possess a turn of foot and therefore the connections did not want the horse to be steadied to obtain cover in the early stages and then have to make a second run as this would not be in the best interests of KING GENKI and would suit horses which possess a superior turn of foot.  He said in accordance with his instructions he rode KING GENKI along in the early stages to obtain the lead.  He said near the 1200 Metres KING GENKI lay in and brushed the running rail when EXCEL ONESELF was racing to its outside.  He said he was aware that the tempo of the race was faster than he had hoped and as it appeared as though the rider of EXCEL ONESELF was intent on leading, he attempted to steady KING GENKI and was happy to allow that horse to cross as this would provide him with the opportunity to immediately switch to the outside of EXCEL ONESELF.  He said he was not able to steady KING GENKI sufficiently to allow EXCEL ONESELF to cross on entering the Back Straight and then near the 1100 Metres KING GENKI again became unbalanced after being bumped by EXCEL ONESELF.  He said this resulted in KING GENKI travelling more keenly and him being unable to restrain the horse.  He added passing the 800 Metres he was able to gain the outright lead on KING GENKI and in accordance with his instructions he allowed the horse to stride along to ensure that it maintained its momentum.  After viewing the videos of the race and considering the sectional times, the Stewards in the circumstances advised Jockey Ng that they were satisfied with his riding of KING GENKI until the 800 Metres, however, after the 800 Metres, in the opinion of the Stewards, he should have made more of an attempt to rate KING GENKI when racing in the lead so as to allow that horse to finish off the race as best as it was able. 
A veterinary inspection of RED MARVEL and ALLCASH immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SKY KING and KING GENKI were sent for sampling.

Whilst in the saddling stalls, BRILLIANT DREAM had its left hind plate refitted.  BRILLIANT DREAM was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
STAR OF YAN OI began only fairly and then was bumped by ARIZONA BLIZZARD, resulting in both horses becoming unbalanced.
HIT THE BID shifted out at the start and bumped LANG TAI SING.
Shortly after the start, RUN FORREST was steadied when crowded for room between CALL ME AWESOME and LANG TAI SING which shifted out.
Near the 450 Metres, ARIZONA BLIZZARD shifted out and bumped STAR OF YAN OI.  Then in the early part of the Straight, ARIZONA BLIZZARD and STAR OF YAN OI raced tight as ARIZONA BLIZZARD attempted to shift out from behind STARTLING POWER into clear running.  When unable to improve between STARTLING POWER and STAR OF YAN OI, ARIZONA BLIZZARD was directed to the inside of STARTLING POWER in an endeavour to obtain clear running.  Then passing the 250 Metres, when unable to obtain a run inside STARTLING POWER, ARIZONA BLIZZARD was again shifted to the outside of that horse to improve into tight running between STARTLING POWER and STAR OF YAN OI and bumped STAR OF YAN OI.  After this, ARIZONA BLIZZARD hung out under pressure and proved difficult to ride.
Near the 100 Metres, BRILLIANT DREAM was shifted out away from the heels of ARIZONA BLIZZARD to obtain clear running.
Over the concluding stages, ARIZONA BLIZZARD and STAR OF YAN OI raced tight.
Throughout the race, CALL ME AWESOME travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, M Chadwick stated that it had been intended for BEAR RAPPER, from a wide barrier, to be ridden in about a midfield position if possible.  He said however that BEAR RAPPER began awkwardly and lost ground and therefore he shifted the horse across behind runners.  He said this resulted in BEAR RAPPER racing further back in the field than had been intended.
A veterinary inspection of MR RIGHT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
STAR OF YAN OI, HIT THE BID and MEGA RED were sent for sampling.

On arrival at the Start, BORN IN CHINA was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said that after the necessary consultations the horse was suitable to race.
After being loaded into the barriers, PERPETUAL TREASURE became fractious and reared up before becoming cast.  PERPETUAL TREASURE was removed from the barriers and examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was not suitable to race.  Acting on this advice, PERPETUAL TREASURE was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  Before being allowed to race again, PERPETUAL TREASURE will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
HAPPY SURVEYS began awkwardly and lost ground.
BORN IN CHINA and CALIFORNIA WHIP began only fairly.
MOST BEAUTIFUL began very awkwardly, resulting in its rider becoming badly unbalanced.
Passing the 450 Metres, EROICO and FIGHT HERO raced tight as EROICO attempted to shift out from behind CALIFORNIA WHIP to obtain clear running.  After this, EROICO and FIGHT HERO continued to race tight as EROICO endeavoured to improve between FIGHT HERO and CALIFORNIA WHIP where there was insufficient room.  This resulted in EROICO being checked passing the 300 Metres.  As the Stewards were satisfied that there was not sufficient room for EROICO to improve between CALIFORNIA WHIP and FIGHT HERO, no further action was taken.
When questioned, N Callan stated that due to the delay to the start, CALIFORNIA WHIP became fractious and as the start was effected began only fairly.  He said because of this he had to use the horse up in the early stages to take up a forward position as instructed.  He said whilst CALIFORNIA WHIP was disappointing in the manner in which it closed off the race, he felt that there were valid excuses for the horseâs performance given that it became stirred up in the barriers.  A veterinary inspection of CALIFORNIA WHIP immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of COUNTRY MELODY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of COUNTRY MELODY, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, COUNTRY MELODY will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
CALIFORNIA WHIP, FIGHT HERO and EROICO were sent for sampling.
<2/3/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>The Clinical Veterinary Surgeon reported that LOVE SHOCK was lame in its left front leg on the morning after racing.  Before being allowed to race again, LOVE SHOCK will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Whilst in the saddling stalls, THE CHAMP had its left front plate refitted.  THE CHAMP was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
As the start was effected, CLEVER SPIRIT lifted its front feet off the ground, began awkwardly and consequently lost ground.
RICHCITY FORTUNE shifted in on jumping and bumped RED SUN.
SAKURA FIGHTER and THE CHAMP bumped at the start.
From the outside barriers, YOUNG EMPIRE and SUCH A HAPPINESS were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the 1100 Metres, SUCH A HAPPINESS got its head up when racing tight between CLEVER SPIRIT and YOUNG EMPIRE.
Also passing the 1100 Metres, SAKURA FIGHTER commenced to travel keenly and got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of SHARPMIND.  Then near the 1050 Metres, SAKURA FIGHTER shifted out away from the heels of SHARPMIND and bumped THE CHAMP, causing that horse to become unbalanced.  After this, SAKURA FIGHTER continued to prove difficult to settle.
Passing the 400 Metres, SHARPMIND shifted out and bumped THE CHAMP.
Throughout the race, GREENERY FORTUNE travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of SHARPMIND which was having its first race start today, Z Purton stated that his mount travelled well in the early and middle stages, however, came under pressure rounding the Home Turn and after obtaining clear running near the 400 Metres did not quicken and failed to finish off the race.  A veterinary inspection of SHARPMIND immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
When questioned, K C Leung stated that rounding the Home Turn he shifted SUCH A HAPPINESS to the outside of runners to ensure that the horse obtained clear running.  He said passing the 300 Metres he changed his whip into his right hand and when he went to use the whip passing the 250 Metres, SUCH A HAPPINESS shifted out and for this reason he put the whip away and straightened the horse whilst continuing to ride it hard hands and heels.  He said once he balanced SUCH A HAPPINESS up, he used the whip on the horse passing the 100 Metres and SUCH A HAPPINESS finished off the race strongly.
SHARPMIND, EASY TOUCH and RICHCITY FORTUNE were sent for sampling.
<6/3/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>SHARPMIND, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  SHARPMIND was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer P F Yiu this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, SHARPMIND will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

On arrival at the Start, K Teetan asked for the tongue tie which was fitted to WISKY to be examined to ensure that it was not fitted too tight.
As the start was effected, KING OF MONGOLIA turned its head to the right and then began awkwardly and lost ground.  KING OF MONGOLIA was then shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
CHEVALIER STAR began only fairly.
CITRON SPIRIT and COURAGEOUS BROTHER were crowded for room at the start between WISKY which shifted in marginally and LITTLE DEVIL which shifted out.  After this, CITRON SPIRIT and COURAGEOUS BROTHER were shifted across behind runners.
Near the 1050 Metres, LAND GRANT was steadied away from the heels of CHEVALIER STAR which was racing tight inside SHAMAL.  Then passing the 1000 Metres, CHEVALIER STAR was eased away from the heels of SHAMAL (Apprentice K K Chiong) which shifted in when not quite clear.  Apprentice Chiong was advised to ensure that she is properly clear when shifting ground in future.
After the 900 Metres, THE SUPREME was left racing wide and without cover.
KING OF MONGOLIA lost its left front plate near the 800 Metres.
LITTLE DEVIL lay out rounding the Home Turn.
Passing the 400 Metres, ROMAN IMPERO was shifted in away from the heels of CHEVALIER STAR.
Near the 350 Metres, ROYAL ELITE was checked and LAND GRANT badly hampered when crowded for room between LITTLE DEVIL and CHEVALIER STAR which, after racing tight outside MIGHTY MAVERICK, got its head on the side and shifted out away from that horse despite the efforts of its rider.  After this, CHEVALIER STAR gave ground abruptly and was eased down over the final 250 Metres and finished tailed out.  A veterinary inspection of CHEVALIER STAR immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its right front leg, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.  The performance of CHEVALIER STAR was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, CHEVALIER STAR will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  For a short distance after this, ROYAL ELITE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of THE SUPREME.
A veterinary inspection of WISKY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CITRON SPIRIT, MIGHTY MAVERICK and DARING FIT were sent for sampling.

After being loaded into the barriers, CIRCUIT HASSLER became fractious and lunged at the front gates.  CIRCUIT HASSLER was removed from the barriers and examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.  Before being allowed to race again, CIRCUIT HASSLER will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.
LIMITLESS shifted out at the start and bumped BASIC TRILOGY.  LIMITLESS was then steadied to obtain cover.  After this BASIC TRILOGY, despite being hard ridden, failed to muster speed and raced well back.
HAPPY PLACE was steadied and shifted across behind runners shortly after the start.
Near the 1000 Metres, PRAWN BABA was shifted out away from the heels of STAR MAJESTIC and raced wide and without cover.
HAPPILABABY lost its right hind plate after the 500 Metres.
Rounding the Home Turn, LIMITLESS was awkwardly placed close to the heels of HAPPILABABY.
Passing the 400 Metres, RAGHU raced tight between HAPPILABABY and WHO DAT SINGA which shifted in.
Approaching the 300 Metres, LIMITLESS was awkwardly placed inside the heels of HELENE SUPER STAR.
Passing the 300 Metres, RAGHU was shifted to the outside of WHO DAT SINGA when disappointed for running inside that horse.
Near the 100 Metres, LIMITLESS got its head on the side and shifted in towards the heels of SOLAR HEI HEI, resulting in LIMITLESS having to be checked out away from the heels of that horse to continue improving.
When questioned, Mr J Moore, the trainer of LET US WIN, stated that with a light weight he asked Apprentice K K Chiong to ride LET US WIN in the lead if possible.  He said when the horse was successful prior to arriving in Hong Kong, it had raced up on the speed and he had hoped that it would be able to perform well by being ridden in a forward position today with a light weight.  He said he expected that CIRCUIT HASSLER would also go forward, however, he did not believe that the race would be run at a solid tempo and as such he felt that there was an opportunity for the horse to be ridden in a forward position in today's race to see if it would perform better than it had been.  Apprentice Chiong stated that after having to ride LET US WIN along for some distance in the early stages to cross HELENE SUPER STAR, she had to continue to ride her mount along in order to maintain her position when SOLAR HEI HEI improved to the outside of LET US WIN.  Mr Moore was advised that his explanation would be noted.  Apprentice Chiong was advised that given the tempo between the 1600 Metres and the 1200 Metres, she must ensure that she rides her mounts in such a manner so that they can finish off their races as best as they are able.
PRAWN BABA and SOLAR HEI HEI were sent for sampling.
The Clinical Veterinary Surgeon reported that WHO DAT SINGA was lame in its right front leg on the morning after racing. Before being allowed to race again, WHO DAT SINGA will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

STORM KID began awkwardly and lost ground.
POLYMER LUCK shifted out at the start and bumped SPICY DOUBLE.
HAR HAR CHARMING began only fairly.
After travelling a short distance, RED HORSE shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of AUDACITY which became unbalanced.
Approaching the 1500 Metres, MY FOLKS was awkwardly placed inside the heels of STRIKING STAR.
Approaching and passing the 1400 Metres, STRIKING STAR got its head up when travelling keenly.
U Rispoli (HAR HAR CHARMING) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that approaching the 1200 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of FORTUNE GIGGLES, resulting in that horse being taken in onto STRIKING STAR which in turn was taken in onto MY FOLKS, causing that horse to be crowded for room and checked.  U Rispoli was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 12 March 2017 and to expire on Thursday, 16 March 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards took into account Jockey Rispoli's good race riding record.
After the 1100 Metres, POLYMER LUCK proved difficult to settle and got its head up for some distance when racing without cover.
Passing the 900 Metres, AUDACITY was crowded for room between POLYMER LUCK and DASHING DART which shifted out away from the heels of MY FOLKS.
Passing the 600 Metres, POLYMER LUCK was checked when proving difficult to settle and awkwardly placed behind RED HORSE.
Also passing the 600 Metres, SPICY DOUBLE proved difficult to settle and was checked out away from the heels of DASHING DART.
Near the 300 Metres, DASHING DART was shifted to the outside of RED HORSE after being disappointed for running between that horse and EMPIRE OF MONGOLIA.  When being shifted out further to obtain clear running, DASHING DART was awkwardly placed close to the heels of POLYMER LUCK a short distance later.
Approaching the 200 Metres, SPICY DOUBLE was crowded for room inside AUDACITY by PERFECT TIMING (M Chadwick) which shifted out to obtain clear running.  M Chadwick was advised to exercise more care.
Near the 50 Metres, RED HORSE lay in under pressure. 
Throughout the race, HAR HAR CHARMING travelled wide and without cover and in the Straight gave ground.  A veterinary inspection of HAR HAR CHARMING immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of HAR HAR CHARMING, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, HAR HAR CHARMING will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
DASHING DART and POLYMER LUCK were sent for sampling.

MR STUNNING began awkwardly.
AMBER SKY shifted out at the start and bumped PENIAPHOBIA.
Passing the 600 Metres, NOT LISTENIN'TOME lost ground when racing tight outside PENIAPHOBIA which shifted out marginally.
A veterinary inspection of PENIAPHOBIA and BAD BOY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MR STUNNING and NOT LISTENIN'TOME were sent for sampling.

BERNARD'S CHOICE and FAST ROCKET were crowded for room on jumping between LAUGHING LORD and SHINING CHAMPION, both of which shifted ground.
DYNAMIC VOYAGE was steadied on jumping and shifted across behind runners from a wide barrier.
MR KOOL began awkwardly.
After racing tight between BERNARD'S CHOICE and SHINING CHAMPION passing the 1100 Metres, FAST ROCKET was checked passing the 1050 Metres when crowded for room inside SHINING CHAMPION which was taken in by INTELLECTUAL GLIDE which got its head on the side and shifted in away from SPARKLING TALENT despite the efforts of its rider.  As the Stewards were satisfied that there was no rider error in this incident, no further action was taken.
After initially being ridden along to obtain a forward position, MR KOOL was steadied approaching the 1000 Metres to obtain cover.
Near the 950 Metres, SPARKLING TALENT was awkwardly placed close to the heels of VICTOR EMPEROR.
Passing the 900 Metres, INTELLECTUAL GLIDE was awkwardly placed behind SPARKLING TALENT.
After the 900 Metres, SPARKLING TALENT was left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 400 Metres, FIVE STARS AGENT bumped the hindquarters of O'SOCOOLE which became unbalanced.
Passing the 200 Metres, O'SOCOOLE was eased away from the heels of VICTOR EMPEROR.
Near the 150 Metres, DYNAMIC VOYAGE shifted in under pressure and bumped INTELLECTUAL GLIDE, resulting in U Rispoli, the rider of DYNAMIC VOYAGE, having to stop riding and straighten his mount.
When questioned regarding the performance of MR KOOL, Z Purton stated that the horse was agitated before the start and was then restless in the stalls.  He said it had been hoped for the horse to take up a forward position and, with this in mind, he rode his mount aggressively in the early stages in an endeavour to clear SPARKLING TALENT to his inside.  He said, despite being ridden along, MR KOOL did not show any early speed and passing the 1000 Metres was left racing very wide.  He said he therefore elected to steady MR KOOL making the first turn near the 900 Metres and shift across to obtain cover.  He said MR KOOL came off the bridle after the 700 Metres and then, despite being hard pushed rounding the Home Turn and in the early part of the Straight, did not quicken.  He said MR KOOL then did not respond to his riding after this and was disappointing.  He added that, in his opinion, MR KOOL may be better suited racing at Happy Valley where its performances had exceeded those at Sha Tin.  A veterinary inspection of MR KOOL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of LAUGHING LORD immediately following the race found that horse to have bled from both nostrils.
FIVE STARS AGENT, VICTOR EMPEROR and DYNAMIC VOYAGE were sent for sampling.

DOCTORS DELIGHT was checked on jumping when crowded for room between RAY OF GOLD and DIAMOND MYSTERIOUS which was taken in by CAREFREE LET GO which shifted in on jumping.
Shortly after the start, MI BLANCO shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of RAY OF GOLD.
From a wide barrier, UP TO YOU was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
S Clipperton (EVEREST) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 1000 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of BOSSIEE, resulting in that horse being hampered and losing the running to which it was rightfully entitled.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards were of the opinion that whilst there was a high degree of carelessness exhibited by Jockey Clipperton in this incident, nonetheless the interference suffered by BOSSIEE was moderate and in the circumstances they considered the appropriate penalty was for Jockey Clipperton's licence to ride in races to be suspended for a period to commence on Sunday, 26 March 2017 and to expire on Thursday, 30 March 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).
Making the turn near the 900 Metres, BOSSIEE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of EVEREST. 
For some distance approaching and passing the 700 Metres, BOSSIEE travelled keenly.
RAY OF GOLD had difficulty obtaining clear running approaching and passing the 200 Metres and approaching the 150 Metres was steadied away from the heels of BOSSIEE when disappointed for running between that horse and MI BLANCO.
Passing the 200 Metres, DIAMOND MYSTERIOUS was steadied when held up for clear running behind MI BLANCO.
Over the concluding stages, RAY OF GOLD was awkwardly placed close to the heels of MI BLANCO.
Throughout the race, DON'T MISS travelled wide and without cover and for some distance in the middle stages got its head on the side and hung out.
A veterinary inspection of CAREFREE LET GO and BOSSIEE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FANTASTIC EIGHT and EVEREST were sent for sampling.

VICTORY MUSIC, Standby Declared Starter, was withdrawn on 4.3.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore).  Before being allowed to race again, VICTORY MUSIC will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After being loaded into the barriers, NOBLE DE LOVE became fractious and reared, resulting in K Teetan being dislodged without incident.  NOBLE DE LOVE was removed from the barriers and examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.  Before being allowed to race again, NOBLE DE LOVE will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.
COOL AND NEAT began only fairly and then, from the outside barrier, was shifted across behind runners.
NOBLE DE LOVE was steadied from a wide barrier and taken across behind runners in the early stages.
BOLD STITCH began awkwardly and then when being ridden along to obtain a forward position got its head on the side and lay in onto the hindquarters of BO DUKE which became unbalanced and shifted in, resulting in CHIU CHOW KID and BONITO being crowded for room outside FURLONG DRAGON which shifted out after being brushed by GOOD METHOD.  Then despite being continuously ridden along, BOLD STITCH failed to muster speed.
In the early stages, CHIU CHOW KID got its head up and raced ungenerously.
Despite being hard ridden in the early stages, GOOD METHOD failed to muster speed.
Approaching the 900 Metres, FUN MANAGER became unbalanced of its own accord and for the major part of the race travelled wide and without cover.
FUN MANAGER lost its left front plate near the 850 Metres.
AMBITIOUS HEART was held up for clear running rounding the Home Turn and in the early part of the Straight.
Passing the 400 Metres, COOL AND NEAT was shifted in away from the heels of AMBITIOUS HEART to obtain clear running.
The performance of BONITO, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, BONITO will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of CHIU CHOW KID immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of NOBLE DE LOVE immediately following the race found that horse to have sustained minor lacerations to the left and right front legs.
PLANET STAR, COOL AND NEAT and AMBITIOUS HEART were sent for sampling.

KELOWNA STAR and BOBO SO CUTE were slow to begin.
RIVER BOBO began only fairly.
JOLLY BANNER began only fairly and then, despite being ridden along in the early stages, failed to muster speed.
From a wide barrier, ROMANTIC TOUCH was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the 1100 Metres, LUCKY YEAR shifted in and bumped RACING SUPERNOVA.
Approaching the 400 Metres, JOLLY BANNER was held up for clear running behind PERFECT ALLOY.  Then passing the 400 Metres, JOLLY BANNER was shifted to the inside of PERFECT ALLOY in an endeavour to improve into tight running inside that horse.  JOLLY BANNER was then crowded for room near the 350 Metres when PERFECT ALLOY shifted in marginally away from the heels of SPARTA which also shifted in marginally.  This resulted in both JOLLY BANNER and PERFECT ALLOY becoming badly unbalanced and losing ground.
Passing the 400 Metres, RACING SUPERNOVA was awkwardly placed close to the heels of SPARTA.
Throughout the race, DASHING FELLOW travelled wide and without cover.
JOLLY BANNER, INVINCIBLE DRAGON and SIMPLY INVINCIBLE were sent for sampling.

DUKEDOM began awkwardly and lost ground.
WATER DIVINER began only fairly.
TIME WARP began awkwardly.
Shortly after the start, SILLY BUDDIES and HEALTHY JOYFUL bumped.
After initially being ridden along from a wide barrier, GREEN CARD was steadied shortly after the start and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 1100 Metres, MR GENUINE shifted out and bumped PACKING STONES which was travelling keenly.
Approaching the first turn near the 900 Metres, PACKING STONES, which continued to travel keenly, got its head up when being checked away from the heels of MR GENUINE.
Near the 850 Metres, TIME WARP was awkwardly placed behind TURF SPRINT.
After the 700 Metres, MR GENUINE was left racing wide and without cover.
Shortly after entering the Straight, PACKING STONES got its head on the side and lay in behind MR GENUINE, resulting in PACKING STONES being awkwardly placed close to the heels of that horse.
In the early part of the Straight, TIME WARP raced with its head on the side and lay in.
Near the 175 Metres, WATER DIVINER was shifted away from the heels of SMART DECLARATION which shifted out.
Near the 100 Metres, PACKING STONES got its head up when being checked out away from the heels of MR GENUINE which shifted out away from GREEN CARD as that horse improved to the inside of MR GENUINE.
A veterinary inspection of WATER DIVINER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
BEAT THE CLOCK and TURF SPRINT were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE ASSOCIATION OF HONG KONG RACING JOURNALISTS CHALLENGE CUP (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
From wide barriers, LUCKY DOUBLE EIGHT and RULE THEE were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After the 1000 Metres, CELESTIAL NOVA was awkwardly placed close to the heels of HINYUEN SWIFTNESS.
Approaching the 900 Metres, VOLITATION was left racing wide and without cover.
For some distance passing the 800 Metres, FANTASTIC KAKA was awkwardly placed close to the heels of VICTORY MACHINE and then near the 700 Metres shifted out and bumped VOLITATION.
KINGSFIELD travelled keenly in the lead in the middle stages.
Near the 750 Metres, BEAUTY KINGDOM commenced to prove difficult to settle and was awkwardly placed behind OUTLAWED.
BEAUTY KINGDOM was held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight and approaching the 300 Metres raced in restricted room inside KINGSFIELD when improving into tight running inside that horse.
Near the 250 Metres, LUCKY DOUBLE EIGHT was awkwardly placed outside the heels of VICTORY MACHINE which shifted out under pressure.
Passing the 250 Metres, RULE THEE shifted out away from the heels of LUCKY DOUBLE EIGHT to obtain clear running.
Over the concluding stages, KINGSFIELD got its head on the side, lay out and proved difficult to ride.
When questioned, D Whyte stated that it had been intended for SMILING CHARM to be in about a midfield position if possible.  He said as the start was effected SMILING CHARM turned its head to the left, resulting in the horse beginning awkwardly and losing significant ground.  He said he then rode his mount along vigorously in the early stages, however, SMILING CHARM was reluctant to improve its position.  He said he continued to ride SMILING CHARM aggressively approaching and passing the 1000 Metres in an attempt to maintain a position inside the eventual winner LUCKY DOUBLE EIGHT, however, despite being ridden along, LUCKY DOUBLE EIGHT was unable to maintain this position which resulted in SMILING CHARM racing further back in the field than intended.  He said after being crossed by LUCKY DOUBLE EIGHT after the 900 Metres, SMILING CHARM then commenced to travel more comfortably.  He said near the 500 Metres he commenced to shift out around CONVINCIBLE, however, HINYUEN SWIFTNESS which was racing to that horse's outside was under heavy pressure and he therefore shifted SMILING CHARM back to the inside in the hope that CONVINCIBLE would shift out around BEAUTY KINGDOM in advance of that horse and he would be able to improve into clear running close to the rail.  He said when this did not happen, he shifted SMILING CHARM out away from behind CONVINCIBLE and continued to shift SMILING CHARM out to improve around HINYUEN SWIFTNESS.  He said he placed his mount under pressure, however, was reluctant to use the whip on the horse as there were a line of horses in advance of SMILING CHARM and was unaware where clear running would develop.  He added he commenced to ride the horse with the whip prior to the 200 Metres in order to follow LUCKY DOUBLE EIGHT through before positioning SMILING CHARM to the outside of LUCKY DOUBLE EIGHT passing the 200 Metres in the event that a run developed between that horse and VOLITATION.  He said he was then able to improve between those horses passing the 100 Metres.  He said then over the concluding stages SMILING CHARM raced tight between LUCKY DOUBLE EIGHT and CELESTIAL NOVA and consequently he was not able to ride the horse right out to the winning post.  After considering Jockey Whyte's evidence and after viewing the videos, no further action was taken.  A veterinary inspection of SMILING CHARM immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
VOLITATION, LUCKY DOUBLE EIGHT and CELESTIAL NOVA were sent for sampling.

KING OF SMARTS began awkwardly and lost ground.
FLYING PROSPERITY began awkwardly and was slow to begin.
NOBLE BUDDIES began only fairly.
FANTASTIC FABIO began only fairly and shortly after the start was steadied away from the heels of HIGHLAND DRAGON which shifted out.
GOLDEN GLORY shifted out at the start and bumped PERFECT SMART.
Despite being ridden along in the early stages, ALL TOGETHER was slow to muster speed.
From a wide barrier, ALL TIMES LUCKY was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Approaching the 800 Metres, FLYING PROSPERITY became very unbalanced of its own accord.
Passing the 100 Metres, HIGHLAND DRAGON and NOBLE BUDDIES bumped.
Near the 50 Metres, GOLDEN GLORY shifted out and brushed ALL TOGETHER.
T H So (ALL TIMES LUCKY) was fined $5,000 for excessive use of the whip on a horse out of contention.
When questioned, O Doleuze (GIDDY GIDDY) stated that in the early part of the Straight he intended to shift his mount out away from PROMPT EXPRESS as he had formed the view that the horse responds better when away from other runners.  He said whilst he had intended to shift out marginally, GIDDY GIDDY initially shifted out further than he had intended and then got its head on the side and lay in in the early part of the Straight.  He added GIDDY GIDDY subsequently finished off the race satisfactorily.
After the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on ALL TOGETHER at the request of Trainer C S Shum.  The Veterinary Surgeon said this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, ALL TOGETHER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of PROMPT EXPRESS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SHOW MISSION and GIDDY GIDDY were sent for sampling.
<9/3/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>PROMPT EXPRESS, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  PROMPT EXPRESS was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer P F Yiu this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, PROMPT EXPRESS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

HORSE SUPREMO began very awkwardly and lost ground.
Shortly after the start, TRUMP was steadied to obtain cover.
FOXBAT became unbalanced shortly after the start when bumped on the hindquarters by KWAICHUNG BROTHERS which was taken out by BUMBLE BABY.  In this incident, KWAICHUNG BROTHERS was hampered when crowded for room between FOXBAT and BUMBLE BABY.
After travelling a short distance, HORSE SUPREMO shifted out away from the heels of BEEKELY, resulting in CROWN AVENUE being inconvenienced.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, BEEKELY was hampered when crowded for room between TRENDIFUL which lay in and BUMBLE BABY which got its head on the side and hung out making the turn.
Near the 450 Metres, BEEKELY got its head on the side and lay in away from the heels of TRENDIFUL, resulting in FOXBAT being checked when crowded for room outside PERPETUAL JOYANCE.
In the early part of the Straight, BUMBLE BABY was held up for clear running.
Passing the 250 Metres, BEEKELY shifted out marginally and bumped TRUMP which was inclined to lay in, resulting in TRUMP becoming unbalanced.
Passing the 200 Metres, CROWN AVENUE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of FOXBAT.
Near the 150 Metres, TRUMP shifted in abruptly under pressure, resulting in BEEKELY being momentarily inconvenienced.
Also near the 150 Metres, KWAICHUNG BROTHERS, which was finishing off the race well, was shifted in away from the heels of LUNAR ZEPHYR in an attempt to improve into tight running between LUNAR ZEPHYR and RUGBY DIAMOND.  Prior to being able to establish this run, KWAICHUNG BROTHERS was checked when RUGBY DIAMOND was taken out by BUMBLE BABY which got its head on the side and shifted out further after improving into tight running between RUGBY DIAMOND and BEAUTY CONNECTION.
Throughout the race, LUNAR ZEPHYR travelled wide and without cover.
After the race, J Moreira (TRENDIFUL) reported that after placing his mount under heavy pressure rounding the Home Turn and in the early part of the Straight, TRENDIFUL commenced to give ground and did not feel comfortable in its action.  He said as he was concerned that the horse may have bled, he eased it down over the final 200 Metres.  A veterinary inspection of TRENDIFUL immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  The performance of TRENDIFUL, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, TRENDIFUL will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
BEAUTY CONNECTION, PERPETUAL JOYANCE and TRUMP were sent for sampling.

IMPERIAL SEAL was withdrawn on raceday morning by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (fever).  Before being allowed to race again, IMPERIAL SEAL will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
ELITE EXPRESS shifted out at the start and bumped HASTILY FEET.
SUM WIN DRAGON was badly crowded for room on jumping between LUCKY PROFIT and DON WONGCHOY, both of which shifted ground.  In this incident, LUCKY PROFIT became unbalanced and lost ground after making heavy contact with SUM WIN DRAGON.
From the outside barrier, MUTUAL JOY was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, MUTUAL JOY was awkwardly placed close to the heels of HASTILY FEET.
After passing the winning post on the first occasion, AMAZING FEELING was left racing wide and without cover.  AMAZING FEELING was subsequently allowed to stride forward to assume the lead at the 700 Metres.
After the 900 Metres, LUCKY PROFIT was shifted out in an endeavour to improve its position, however, after this travelled wide and without cover.
After the 800 Metres, HASTILY FEET was left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 600 Metres, DON WONGCHOY was awkwardly placed close to the heels of MIDNITE PROMISE which shifted out.
At the entrance to the Straight, SUM WIN DRAGON and DON WONGCHOY bumped.
Passing the 250 Metres, AMAZING FEELING and MIDNITE PROMISE brushed.
Approaching the 100 Metres, K C Leung (CASH COURIER) dropped his whip.
MIDNITE PROMISE, MUTUAL JOY and SUM WIN DRAGON were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE HONG KONG FOOTBALL CLUB CENTENARY CHALLENGE CUP (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
KIROV was withdrawn on 6.3.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left front foot).  Before being allowed to race again, KIROV will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
ROBUST MOMENTUM and CASA MASTER bumped at the start.
Shortly after the start, SOUL ACHIEVER shifted in and bumped GREAT TREASURE.
From the outside barrier, MEGATRON was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Approaching the winning post on the first occasion, GREAT TREASURE was hampered when crowded for room between EASTERN PROWESS and MEGATRON (K Teetan) which shifted in.  K Teetan was advised to exercise more care when shifting ground in similar circumstances.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, MEGATRON, which was travelling keenly, got its head up when being steadied away from the heels of EXCELLENCE which was steadied to avoid the heels of GOBI STORM.
SPARKLING SWORD travelled wide and without cover until passing the 1100 Metres.
After the 800 Metres, CASA MASTER was left racing wide and without cover.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, ROCKET LET WIN momentarily raced in restricted room inside SPARKLING SWORD which lay in.
Passing the 500 Metres, EXCELLENCE shifted out and bumped GREAT TREASURE.
Approaching the 450 Metres, ROCKET LET WIN got its head on the side and lay in towards the heels of SPARKLING SWORD.  SOUL ACHIEVER, which was following ROCKET LET WIN, was held up behind that horse in consequence.
Near the 150 Metres, ROBUST MOMENTUM was shifted in away from the heels of SPARKLING SWORD which was giving ground.
A veterinary inspection of SPARKLING SWORD and ROBUST MOMENTUM immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
EXCELLENCE and SOUL ACHIEVER were sent for sampling.

COUR VALANT began very awkwardly and blundered shortly after the start, consequently losing ground.
CONTRIBUTION began only fairly.
Despite being ridden along in the early stages, UNLEASHED DRAGON was slow to muster speed.
LEOWL was steadied in the early stages to obtain cover.
Making the turn approaching the 1000 Metres, CONTRIBUTION was awkwardly placed close to the heels of UNLEASHED DRAGON after getting its head on the side and shifting in away from HIGH VOLATILITY.
After racing very wide, SIGHT SEEING was steadied and shifted across behind runners to obtain cover passing the 1000 Metres.
Near the 250 Metres, LEOWL was awkwardly placed close to the heels of SKY TREASURE after being disappointed for running inside that horse.  Passing the 200 Metres, LEOWL was then shifted to the outside of SKY TREASURE to obtain clear running.
Throughout the race, FOREVER ACCURATE travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of SIGHT SEEING immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CONTRIBUTION, ARM RUNDA and HIGH VOLATILITY were sent for sampling.

ALL MY GAIN was slow to begin.
From the outside barrier, HAPPY BAO BEI was slow to begin and then was ridden along to obtain a forward position.
After initially being steadied in the early stages, LAMAROSA was left racing very wide after the 1100 Metres and was then allowed to stride forward into the lead.
FANTASTIC FEELING was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
Passing the 900 Metres, ALL MY GAIN got its head up when awkwardly placed behind GENEROUS HEART.
Despite being hard ridden for some distance passing the 800 Metres, A BEAUTIFUL was unable to maintain its position inside FANTASTIC FEELING.
Approaching the 600 Metres, IRON BOY was left racing wide and without cover.
After the 400 Metres, OUR HERO was taken wider by HAPPY BAO BEI which got its head on the side and lay out under pressure.
At the entrance to the Straight, GENEROUS HEART shifted out and brushed HAPPY BAO BEI.
Near the 150 Metres, IRON BOY shifted in and bumped FANTASTIC FEELING which became unbalanced.
When questioned regarding the performance of IâM A WITNESS, J Moreira stated that in accordance with the horseâs normal racing pattern, he was able to obtain a forward position on IâM A WITNESS in the early stages.  He said he became concerned with the manner in which IâM A WITNESS was travelling approaching the 900 Metres when he initially commenced to ease the horse across towards the rail, it was reluctant to shift in and got its head up for a short distance.  He said it was not until well into the Back Straight that he was able to shift IâM A WITNESS over to race on the rail and because of the effort that he had to make to have the horse race more tractably, he was unable to prevent LAMAROSA from crossing IâM A WITNESS after the 800 Metres.  He said as soon as IâM A WITNESS was crossed by LAMAROSA, the horse immediately came off the bridle and he had to ride it along after the 700 Metres in an attempt to have it maintain its position.  He added he rode IâM A WITNESS along rounding the Home Turn when LAMAROSA was asked for an effort, however, IâM A WITNESS immediately commenced to give ground and, despite being ridden along, weakened noticeably.   He said on pulling up after the race IâM A WITNESS did not feel comfortable in its action, however, he was unable to detect any specific lameness issues with the horse.  A veterinary inspection of IâM A WITNESS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of IâM A WITNESS, a favourite for tonightâs race, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, IâM A WITNESS will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of IRON BOY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
IâM A WITNESS, ALL MY GAIN and GENEROUS HEART were sent for sampling.

MASTER CERAMIBO shifted in abruptly on jumping despite the efforts of its rider, resulting in AMAZING GOLD being crowded for room outside ANDOYAS which became unbalanced after being bumped by AMAZING GOLD.  A short distance later, AMAZING GOLD was again crowded for room between MASTER CERAMIBO and ANDOYAS which was taken out by JOLLY GENE which shifted out after making contact with GIANT TURTLE.  In this incident, MASTER CERAMIBO became badly unbalanced after being bumped on the hindquarters by AMAZING GOLD.
From a wide barrier, THE SYLPH was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 1600 Metres, ANDOYAS was steadied after being crowded for room inside HAPPY ROCKY which got its head on the side and shifted in away from THE SYLPH.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, INDUSTRIALIST WAY was left racing wide and without cover.
Near the 450 Metres, GIANT TURTLE shifted out and bumped PEARL WARM WARM.  GIANT TURTLE was then badly held up for clear running rounding the Home Turn and in the Straight until passing the 150 Metres.  S Clipperton (GIANT TURTLE) explained that after being badly held up for clear running a run appeared outside DR WIN WIN which was giving ground and inside JOLLY GENE passing the 150 Metres.  He said he was reluctant to ride his mount along at this time as he was aware that JOLLY GENE was looking to improve its position outside CLUB LIFE.  He said he felt that had he have ridden GIANT TURTLE at this time, he would have been held up for clear running again behind CLUB LIFE and inside JOLLY GENE and for this reason he waited for JOLLY GENE to shift in and improve to the outside of that horse approaching the 50 Metres and then rode his mount out hands and heels to the winning post.  A veterinary inspection of GIANT TURTLE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
JOLLY GENE was held up for clear running from shortly after entering the Straight until passing the 200 Metres.  Passing the 100 Metres, JOLLY GENE was awkwardly placed inside the heels of INDUSTRIALIST WAY when improving into tight running between that horse and CLUB LIFE.
Passing the 200 Metres, MASTER CERAMIBO, which was making ground, was steadied away from the heels of PEARL WARM WARM (U Rispoli) which shifted to the outside of INDUSTRIALIST WAY to obtain clear running.  U Rispoli was advised to exercise more care when shifting ground in similar circumstances.
Also passing the 200 Metres, AMAZING GOLD was shifted out away from the heels of THE SYLPH to obtain clear running.
Approaching the 100 Metres, ENREACHING and HAPPY ROCKY bumped.
When questioned, C Y Ho stated that, from the outside barrier, he had been asked to ride DR WIN WIN in the lead if possible.  He said after riding his mount positively out of the barriers, he allowed its natural speed to take it to the lead after the 1600 Metres and he was able to cross JOLLY GENE and raced on the rail approaching the winning post on the first occasion.  He said when CLUB LIFE improved to his outside after passing the winning post on the first occasion, DR WIN WIN commenced to travel keenly and would not relax.  He said he tried to steady the tempo on DR WIN WIN as he was aware the race was being run at a fast tempo after the 1200 Metres, however, DR WIN WIN continued to race keenly and he was reluctant to apply more pressure to the horse to steady as he did not want to break its stride.  He said because he was aware that the race had been run at a faster pace than he would have hoped, he attempted to hold his mount together as long as possible rounding the Home Turn when horses improved to his outside to afford DR WIN WIN every opportunity to finish off the race.  He said however that because of the tempo of the race in the early and middle stages, DR WIN WIN was then not able to close off the race and gave ground in the Straight.  C Y Ho was advised that his explanation would be reported, however, in the opinion of the Stewards, he should have made more of an effort to steady DR WIN WIN in the lead so as to provide the horse with the best opportunity to finish off the race.
GIANT TURTLE, ANDOYAS and HAPPY ROCKY were sent for sampling.
<12/3/2017  8 March 2017 Happy Valley Racemeeting â Race 7 (479)>After reviewing the video footage for the Happy Valley racemeeting conducted on Wednesday, 8 March 2017 as is usual practice, the Stewards today questioned J Moreira regarding his riding of ENREACHING in the middle stages of the race. J Moreira stated that approaching the 800 Metres the race was being run at a good tempo and he elected to shift out to race behind INDUSTRIALIST WAY passing the 800 Metres in case the leaders commenced to give ground given the tempo of the race. He said as the tempo continued to be good approaching the 700 Metres and as INDUSTRIALIST WAY had raced wide and without cover throughout the race, he felt there was more likelihood of PEARL WARM WARM being able to take him into the race rather than INDUSTRIALIST WAY and as HAPPY ROCKY was improving its position around ENREACHING at this time, he elected to shift back in to race behind PEARL WARM WARM rather than be taken back through the field by INDUSTRIALIST WAY and pocketed inside HAPPY ROCKY. He said ENREACHING was provided with the opportunity to shift back in behind PEARL WARM WARM as ANDOYAS, which was attempting to improve into that position, was not quick enough to take advantage of that run. He said PEARL WARM WARM initially held its position whilst INDUSTRIALIST WAY was under heavy pressure after the 600 Metres, however, the pattern of the race changed markedly after the 500 Metres as PEARL WARM WARM was unable to continue improving inside CLUB LIFE which was under pressure and he was obliged to wait until after the 400 Metres to be able to shift to the outside of runners to obtain clear running. He added in hindsight he had erred in not maintaining the three wide position behind INDUSTRIALIST WAY, however, he felt at the time that this was the better of the two options available to him. J Moreira was advised that the Stewards agreed that he should have remained racing behind INDUSTRIALIST WAY rather than shifting back in to race amongst runners. He was further advised to ensure that, wherever possible, he rides his mounts in such a manner so that they are afforded the opportunity to improve their position when it arises.

OPEN HOUSE began only fairly and shortly after the start was shifted across behind runners.
LUCKY DAY began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped the hindquarters of PEACE N PROSPERITY, resulting in LUCKY DAY losing ground.
From the outside barrier, SILVER SPUN was steadied in the early stages and shifted across to obtain cover.
When being steadied to obtain cover, PEACE N PROSPERITY got its head up and commenced to travel keenly passing the 1000 Metres.
Approaching the 700 Metres, ENDEARING was left racing wide and without cover.
LOTUS BREEZE lay out making the Home Turn.
Passing the 250 Metres, SHARP HUNTER was shifted out away from the heels of ENDEARING which shifted out away from WHOâSTHEDUDE.
WHOâSTHEDUDE, VICTORY MARVEL and LOTUS BREEZE were sent for sampling.

MIZZEN GREY was slow to begin.
STARRY STARLIES and FIVE STARS AGENT bumped at the start.
From wide barriers, EQUITY DOCTRINE and NO LAUGHING MATTER were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
In the early stages, PLANET GIANT was steadied to obtain cover.
For some distance passing the winning post on the first occasion, ATOMIC BLAST raced tight inside SPEEDY WALLY which got its head on the side and lay in despite the efforts of its rider.
Approaching the 1200 Metres, PLANET GIANT and EQUITY DOCTRINE raced tight.
Passing the 1200 Metres, JIMSON THE FAMOUS was steadied away from the heels of RAINBOW GOLD.
After the 1200 Metres, CIRCUIT FORTUNE was left racing wide and without cover and subsequently finished tailed out.  The performance of CIRCUIT FORTUNE was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, CIRCUIT FORTUNE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination. 
Making the turn near the 700 Metres, PLANET GIANT was crowded for room between EQUITY DOCTRINE and MIZZEN GREY which shifted out marginally.
Making the turn after the 700 Metres, FIVE STARS AGENT commenced to lay out and approaching the 600 Metres bumped RAINBOW GOLD.
Passing the 300 Metres, MIZZEN GREY was crowded for room between JIMSON THE FAMOUS which shifted in when commencing to give ground and PLANET GIANT (N Rawiller) which shifted out to obtain clear running.  N Rawiller was advised to exercise more care when shifting ground in similar circumstances.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that SPEEDY WALLY had bled from both nostrils.
A veterinary inspection of RAINBOW GOLD immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, RAINBOW GOLD will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SPEEDY WALLY, ATOMIC BLAST and FIVE STARS AGENT were sent for sampling.

On arrival at the Start, the tongue tie fitted to CELESTIAL NOVA was adjusted.
As the start was effected, REGENCY BO BO became fractious and commenced to rear.  REGENCY BO BO, which was being assisted by a starting gate handler, then again reared abruptly following the start being effected, resulting in the horse losing a considerable amount of ground.  Before being allowed to race again, REGENCY BO BO will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.
SICHUAN BOSS was slow to begin.
From a wide barrier, KA YING KID was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
For some distance after the 1100 Metres, CELESTIAL NOVA commenced to prove very difficult to settle and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of MR POTENTIAL before shifting out away from the heels of that horse near the 1000 Metres which resulted in RED ELYSEES being taken wider.  CELESTIAL NOVA then continued to prove difficult to settle and was awkwardly placed behind HAY RUN passing the 900 Metres.
Both SICHUAN BOSS and ROYAL PERFORMER made the turn near the 900 Metres awkwardly.
At the entrance to the Straight, REGENCY BO BO momentarily raced tight between HAY RUN and KA YING KID which, after shifting out, was then directed back in to relieve the tightening.  In this incident, REGENCY BO BO bumped the hindquarters of HAY RUN which became unbalanced.
Throughout the race, HAY RUN travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of CELESTIAL NOVA immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
NOTHINGILIKEMORE and HAPPY AGILITY were sent for sampling.

At declaration time, H W Lai was declared as the rider of both REAL DEAL and GOLD TALENT.  It was established that H W Lai had a firm commitment to ride REAL DEAL.  As such, the Stewards permitted M L Yeung (subsequently K C Ng) to be substituted as the rider of GOLD TALENT.  For this declaration error, H W Lai was fined $2,000.
Whilst in the saddling stalls, REAL DEAL had its right hind plate refitted.  REAL DEAL was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
BOSSIEE stood flat-footed at the start and lost a considerable amount of ground.  Before being allowed to race again, BOSSIEE will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.
AH BO and VITAL SPRING bumped heavily at the start, resulting in both horses becoming unbalanced.  In this incident, AH BO shifted in when unbalanced and bumped TORNEY.
PACKING STARCRAFT began awkwardly and shortly after the start was shifted across behind runners.
Also from the outside barrier, ACTUARIAT was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Approaching the 1000 Metres, AH BO was awkwardly placed close to the heels of ENCHANTED FEELING which was also awkwardly placed close to the heels of VICTOR EMPEROR after attempting to improve inside that horse.
Approaching the 800 Metres, PACKING STARCRAFT got its head up when travelling keenly and close to the heels of TORNEY.
Near the 750 Metres, AH BO, which was laying out, was awkwardly placed close to the heels of REAL DEAL after being taken out by ACTUARIAT which got its head on the side and lay out.
Approaching the 250 Metres, RICHCITY FORTUNE was shifted out from behind VITAL SPRING to obtain clear running.
Throughout the race, GOLD TALENT travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of BOSSIEE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SHAMAL and VITAL SPRING were sent for sampling.

HALL OF FAME was withdrawn on 11.3.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter LUCKY POWER (Z Purton).  Before being allowed to race again, HALL OF FAME will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
RHODE ASSASSIN was slow to begin.
JOLLY AMBER began only fairly.
ZOOMOOL began awkwardly, shifted in on jumping and bumped CARE FREE PRINCE, causing both horses to become unbalanced.
From wide barriers, FINE WITH ME and GOOD FOR YOU were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Approaching the 1300 Metres, MEISTERSTUECK was momentarily awkwardly placed inside the heels of STAR SUPERIOR.
Near the 1150 Metres, ZOOMOOL lost ground when crowded for room between GOOD FOR YOU (N Rawiller) which initially shifted in and MEISTERSTUECK which got its head on the side and shifted out after being brushed on the hindquarters by ZOOMOOL.  N Rawiller was advised that whilst MEISTERSTUECK had contributed to this incident, nonetheless he must ensure that he leaves comfortable racing room for runners to his inside in similar circumstances.
For some distance after the 1000 Metres, ZOOMOOL proved very difficult to settle and making the turn near the 900 Metres raced tight between GOOD FOR YOU and RHODE ASSASSIN which shifted out.  Then passing the 900 Metres, GOOD FOR YOU shifted out abruptly away from the heels of MEISTERSTUECK which was proving difficult to settle and awkwardly placed close to the heels of ELECTRIC LIGHTNING, resulting in FINE WITH ME being hampered when taken wider.
Approaching the 900 Metres, CARE FREE PRINCE was left racing wide and without cover.
After the 900 Metres, STAR SUPERIOR proved very difficult to settle and got its head up when awkwardly placed behind DESTIN.
After the 700 Metres, MEISTERSTUECK and GOOD FOR YOU bumped when racing tight as MEISTERSTUECK attempted to improve into tight running between JOLLY AMBER and GOOD FOR YOU.
Approaching the 300 Metres, MEISTERSTUECK (C Y Ho) shifted out and bumped GOOD FOR YOU when attempting to shift to the outside of CARE FREE PRINCE to obtain clear running.  C Y Ho was advised that whilst the Stewards encourage riders to improve their position wherever possible, nonetheless due care must be exercised so as not to place undue pressure on other horses which can result in interference being caused.
When questioned, C Y Ho stated that, from an inside barrier, it had been hoped for MEISTERSTUECK to be ridden behind the leaders and if the race was being run at a slow tempo, it was acceptable for him to lead.  He said after being placed into the barriers MEISTERSTUECK became fractious and attempted to sit down and then as the start was effected was slow to begin, resulting in the horse racing much further back in the field than had been intended.  He said approaching the first turn when the tempo of the race slowed, MEISTERSTUECK got its head up when racing close to the heels of JOLLY AMBER.  He said after this MEISTERSTUECK appeared to resent racing in amongst horses as it was never travelling comfortably.  He added in the Straight he attempted to shift to the outside of CARE FREE PRINCE in the hope that the horse would close off better when being outside of runners, however, MEISTERSTUECK was not travelling well enough to initially improve inside GOOD FOR YOU before closing off fairly over the concluding stages.  He said he was of the view that MEISTERSTUECK did not appreciate racing amongst runners and he felt that had the horse been given the opportunity of clear running, it would have closed off better than it did.  A veterinary inspection of MEISTERSTUECK immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of CARE FREE PRINCE and GOOD FOR YOU immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MEISTERSTUECK, BOLD STITCH and LUCKY POWER were sent for sampling.
<13/3/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>The Clinical Veterinary Surgeon reported that ZOOMOOL had sustained an injury to its left front tendon on the morning after racing.  Before being allowed to race again, ZOOMOOL will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

COOL BROTHERS was difficult to load and then became fractious in the barriers.  Before being allowed to race again, COOL BROTHERS will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.
GENERAL OâREILLY began only fairly.
COOL BROTHERS got its head up for some distance shortly after the start when being steadied to obtain cover.
Shortly after the start, YOUNG DREAMER, which was steadied to obtain cover, became unbalanced when crowded for room between PROUD SKY which shifted out marginally and HURRICANE HUNTER which shifted in.
Passing the 800 Metres, DYNAMIC LIONS was awkwardly placed close to the heels of PENNY LANE.
Passing the 600 Metres, DYNAMIC LIONS was taken wider by PENNY LANE which shifted out after being awkwardly placed behind CHEERS CONQUEROR.
Passing the 400 Metres, PENNY LANE broke down in its right front leg, resulting in its rider, K Teetan, being dislodged.   K Teetan was subsequently examined by the Clubâs doctor and passed fit to fulfil his remaining race riding engagements.
Throughout the race, CHEERS CONQUEROR travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of CHEERS CONQUEROR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
G-ONE LOVER and PENANG HALL were sent for sampling.
