At declaration time, Z Purton was declared as the rider of both GARLIC YEAH and FANCY MUSIC.  It was established that Z Purton had a firm commitment to GARLIC YEAH.  As such, the Stewards permitted N Callan to be substituted as the rider of FANCY MUSIC.  For this declaration error, Trainer P OâSullivan was fined $2,000.
BEST REWARD was withdrawn on 11.3.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore).  Before being allowed to race again, BEST REWARD will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
FANCY MUSIC proved quite reluctant to proceed to the Start.  Trainer P OâSullivan was advised that the Stewards would monitor FANCY MUSICâs pre-race behaviour in the future before deciding if any further action was necessary.
After being loaded into the barriers, the bridle fitted to FANCY MUSIC came loose, resulting in the bridle having to be refitted.
GORGEOUS AGAIN was slow to begin.
From the outside barriers, FANCY MUSIC and TELEPHATIA were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
BLAZING PASS and AMRITSARIA bumped heavily at the start.  A short distance later, KING BOUNTIFUL was severely checked when crowded for room between AMRITSARIA which shifted out after making contact with BLAZING PASS and JE PENSE which was taken in by GARLIC YEAH.  In this incident, both AMRITSARIA and JE PENSE were also badly hampered.
A short distance after the start, AMRITSARIA was awkwardly placed close to the heels of GARLIC YEAH.  After this, AMRITSARIA proved very difficult to settle and approaching the winning post on the first occasion shifted in away from GORGEOUS AGAIN, resulting in BLAZING PASS being crowded for room for some distance.
After being crossed by GORGEOUS AGAIN near the 1800 Metres, AMRITSARIA continued to travel fiercely, resulting in JE PENSE, which was following, being checked away from the heels of AMRITSARIA in consequence.
Approaching the 1700 Metres, AMRITSARIA shifted out away from the heels of GORGEOUS AGAIN, resulting in TELEPHATIA being bumped and taken wider.
After the 1600 Metres, TELEPHATIA was left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 500 Metres, GORGEOUS AGAIN was awkwardly placed close to the heels of GOOD FIT.
Passing the 400 Metres, SUPER FORM was steadied when initially disappointed for running between PREMIUM CHAMPION and GOOD FIT which shifted in.  SUPER FORM was then held up for clear running for a short distance after this.
Also passing the 400 Metres, GARLIC YEAH was awkwardly placed close to the heels of GORGEOUS AGAIN.
At the 300 Metres, BLAZING PASS was checked when disappointed for running between AMRITSARIA and TELEPHATIA which was giving ground abruptly.  In this incident, BLAZING PASS bumped AMRITSARIA.
After the 150 Metres, GORGEOUS AGAIN shifted out under pressure.  GARLIC YEAH, which was racing outside GORGEOUS AGAIN, shifted out and away from that horse.
Approaching the 50 Metres, GOOD FIT was steadied away from the heels of PREMIUM CHAMPION which shifted out.
Close to the finishing line, SUPER FORM and PREMIUM CHAMPION raced tight.
GORGEOUS AGAIN and GARLIC YEAH were sent for sampling.

WUSHU CHAMPION was slow to begin and from a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners.
MY GIFT began only fairly.
APACHE SPIRIT began awkwardly.
When being steadied approaching the first turn, SHINNING MOON proved difficult to settle when travelling keenly and then after the 800 Metres when continuing to prove difficult to settle raced tight inside the heels of MULTIMAX.
After the 700 Metres, TRAVEL DATUK was left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 200 Metres, INTREPIC was shifted out away from the heels of MULTIMAX to continue improving.
Apprentice K K Chiong (MULTIMAX) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that passing the 100 Metres she permitted her mount to shift in when not clear of WUSHU CHAMPION, causing that horse to be severely checked and to lose the running to which it was rightfully entitled.  Apprentice Chiong was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 26 March 2017 and to expire on Monday, 3 April 2017 on which day she may resume race riding (3 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, Apprentice Chiong was fined $10,000.  After this incident, MULTIMAX lost its left hind plate.
After passing the 50 Metres, WHY WHY was shifted out away from the heels of STAR OF JOY.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that STAR OF JOY had sustained a small wound to the inside of the left hind fetlock.
A veterinary inspection of WUSHU CHAMPION immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
STAR OF JOY, APACHE SPIRIT and ALWAYS WIN were sent for sampling.
<13/3/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>The Clinical Veterinary Surgeon reported that SHINNING MOON was lame in its left front leg on the morning after racing.  Before being allowed to race again, SHINNING MOON will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

The start was delayed as BOTH LUCKY had lost its right front plate behind the barriers.  After being replated, BOTH LUCKY was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
Also behind the barriers, it was noted that KING MORTAR had blood in its mouth emanating from a cut.  KING MORTAR was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed fit to start.
FORTUNE BO BO shifted out at the start and bumped KING MORTAR.
DIAMOND LEGEND was crowded for room on jumping between CALIFORNIA ASPAR and GALLANT ROCK which initially shifted out and then was taken out marginally by BRAVO WATCHMAN.
COLOURFUL ACHIEVER stumbled shortly after the start.
BOTH LUCKY lost its right front plate near the 700 Metres.
Passing the 600 Metres, CALIFORNIA ASPAR momentarily raced in restricted room between BOTH LUCKY and TRIUMPHANT JEWEL which, after initially being taken out by DRAGON MASTER, got its head on the side and shifted out further away from that horse.
Approaching and passing the 400 Metres, FORTUNE BO BO got its head on the side and lay out.  After this, FORTUNE BO BO continued to lay out and near the 150 Metres was bumped by GALLANT ROCK which was taken in by ACE KING.  FORTUNE BO BO then continued to lay out over the concluding stages.
BRAVO WATCHMAN and ACE KING were sent for sampling.
<13/3/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>The Veterinary Officer reported that KING MORTAR was lame in its left front leg on the morning after racing.  Before being allowed to race again, KING MORTAR will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

CALIFORNIA JOY was withdrawn on 11.3.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore and mucus on scoping).  Before being allowed to race again, CALIFORNIA JOY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
FRIENDS OF KA YING shifted out at the start and bumped SPEEDY LONGWAH.
Shortly after the start, PACKING LLAREGYB and BIG BANG BONG bumped.
From the outside barrier, BERLINI was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Approaching and passing the 1200 Metres, PEOPLEâS KNIGHT got its head on the side and lay out.
Approaching the 600 Metres, SKY KING raced in restricted room inside BIG BANG BONG.
Passing the 300 Metres, PACKING LLAREGYB was steadied when unable to improve between HIT THE BID and TRAVEL FIRST.  PACKING LLAREGYB was then held up for clear running and passing the 200 Metres after initially being angled to shift to the outside of TRAVEL FIRST was then directed back in to improve between that horse and HIT THE BID as clear running became available between those horses.  This resulted in PACKING LLAREGYB being unable to be tested until after the 200 Metres.
For some distance after the 300 Metres, APOLLOâS CHOICE raced in restricted room when improving into tight running between FLYING MOOCHI and HIT THE BID.
Near the 250 Metres, FRIENDS OF KA YING shifted out and brushed PABLOSKY which became unbalanced.
SKY KING was unable to obtain clear running until over the concluding stages and consequently was not able to be properly tested. 
For the majority of the race, PABLOSKY travelled wide and without cover.
After passing the winning post, Apprentice H T Mo dismounted from FLYING MOOCHI.  The Veterinary Officer subsequently reported that FLYING MOOCHI was lame in the right front leg as a result of a right front tendon injury.  Before being allowed to race again, FLYING MOOCHI will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned, N Rawiller (SPEEDY LONGWAH) stated that it had been anticipated that the race would be run at a good tempo, however, it was felt that the horse had sufficient speed to be able to take up a position just behind the leaders.  He said just prior to the start being effected SPEEDY LONGWAH became fractious and lunged at the front gates.  He said he felt that the horseâs behaviour in the barriers may have affected its performance as SPEEDY LONGWAH did not show the early speed which was anticipated and then did not travel well at any stage of the race which resulted in it racing much further back in the field than had been intended.  He added he rode the horse in a barrier trial in the lead up to todayâs race and the horse had travelled strongly which was not the case in todayâs race.  He said passing the 900 Metres he had concerns regarding the manner in which SPEEDY LONGWAH was travelling and looked down to establish whether the horse may have bled.  He said when this was not the case, he continued to ride SPEEDY LONGWAH, however, the horse did not finish off the race.  A veterinary inspection of SPEEDY LONGWAH immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of PABLOSKY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
A veterinary inspection of SKY KING immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SKY KING, PEOPLEâS KNIGHT and FRIENDS OF KA YING were sent for sampling.

ELUSIVE STATE was slow to begin.
AMBITIOUS PINS was steadied in the early stages and shifted in to obtain cover.
From a wide barrier, AVELLINO was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 1400 Metres, MONGOLIAN KING momentarily raced in restricted room between FRIENDS OF NANJING and FULL GLORY.
N Callan (FRIENDS OF NANJING) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that passing the 1100 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of MONGOLIAN KING (N Rawiller), resulting in that horse being unnecessarily crowded for room and hampered.  N Callan was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 29 March 2017 and to expire on Monday, 3 April 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards took into account Jockey Callanâs good race riding record.  For some distance after this, N Rawiller attempted to re-establish running inside FRIENDS OF NANJING which, after shifting in passing the 1100 Metres, then shifted out marginally when racing inside the heels of ULTIMATE GLORY approaching the 1000 Metres.  This resulted in MONGOLIAN KING racing to the inside of FRIENDS OF NANJING where there was not sufficient room for some distance approaching the 900 Metres at which time MONGOLIAN KING was checked after being unable to maintain its position.  N Rawiller was advised that, in the opinion of the Stewards, he should have desisted in attempting to re-establish his position inside FRIENDS OF NANJING even given that that horse had shifted out marginally approaching the 1000 Metres.
MONGOLIAN KING had some difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Near the 350 Metres, FULL GLORY shifted out and made contact with GREEN DISPATCH.
Passing the 300 Metres, ELUSIVE STATE was shifted out away from the heels of GREEN DISPATCH.
Passing the 250 Metres, FRIENDS OF NANJING was awkwardly placed close to the heels of WHAT ELSE BUT YOU.
Approaching the 200 Metres, GREEN DISPATCH was awkwardly placed outside the heels of FULL GLORY which shifted out under pressure.
Near the 150 Metres, ENERGETIC CLASS shifted in under pressure, resulting in its rider, J Moreira, changing his whip into his right hand.
For the majority of the race, BRING IT ON travelled wide and without cover.
WHAT ELSE BUT YOU and GO BEAUTY GO were sent for sampling.

On arrival at the Start, it was noted that CAREFREE LET GO had lost its right front plate.  After this plate was refitted, CAREFREE LET GO was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
EXCEPTIONAL DESIRE began awkwardly and then was crowded for room between FORTUNE BROTHERS and CAREFREE LET GO which shifted out.  After this, EXCEPTIONAL DESIRE was steadied and shifted across behind runners from a wide barrier.  CAREFREE LET GO was ridden along in the early stages, however, failed to muster speed.
GODSPEED began awkwardly and then became unbalanced after being bumped by JUMBO HAPPINESS which shifted out.
DOUBLE DOUBLE began only fairly and then lost ground after being bumped by GOOD CHOICE AHEAD which shifted out.
From a wide barrier, RAPIDASH was steadied in the early stages and then passing the 900 Metres was left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 600 Metres, DOUBLE DOUBLE was awkwardly placed behind CAREFREE LET GO and then making the turn a short distance later shifted out away from the heels of that horse, resulting in EXCEPTIONAL DESIRE being taken wider.
GODSPEED made the turn after the 600 Metres awkwardly, shifted out and bumped CAREFREE LET GO.
Near the 450 Metres, GODSPEED and CAREFREE LET GO again made contact.  GODSPEED then made the Home Turn awkwardly, shifted out and was awkwardly placed inside CAREFREE LET GO.
Rounding the Home Turn, RAPIDASH and FAIR COMMENT were taken wider by JUMBO HAPPINESS which shifted out to obtain clear running.
Over the concluding stages, GOOD CHOICE AHEAD was awkwardly placed inside the heels of GODSPEED.
A veterinary inspection of CAREFREE LET GO and GOOD CHOICE AHEAD immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
JUMBO HAPPINESS and CHEER WIN were sent for sampling.

GOLDEN PARTNERS was crowded for room on jumping between AUDACITY and BLISS CARTEL which shifted out.
MEDIC SWORDSMAN began only fairly and shortly after the start was steadied away from the heels of SWEET BEAN which shifted in.
From the outside barrier, PRECISIONCRAFTSMAN was steadied and shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
From a wide barrier, WONDERFUL CHASER was steadied in the early stages in an endeavour to obtain cover, however, was left racing wide and without cover until passing the 800 Metres and subsequently finished tailed out.  The performance of WONDERFUL CHASER was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, WONDERFUL CHASER will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Approaching the 1000 Metres, AUDACITY and WONDERFUL CHASER bumped.
At the entrance to the Straight, AUDACITY and GOLDEN PARTNERS brushed.
Passing the 300 Metres, MY FOLKS was disappointed for running between CATCHMEIFYOUCAN and MY BLESSING which shifted in.
Approaching the 200 Metres, MY FOLKS was steadied when disappointed for running between CATCHMEIFYOUCAN and AUDACITY which, after being inclined to shift in away from GOLDEN PARTNERS (J Moreira), was then taken in by that horse a short distance later.  Then passing the 200 Metres, AUDACITY was shifted to the outside of GOLDEN PARTNERS to obtain clear running.  J Moreira was advised that whilst AUDACITY had contributed to this incident, nonetheless he was severely reprimanded and told to ensure that he must make every endeavour to prevent his mounts from shifting ground in similar circumstances.
A veterinary inspection of SWEET BEAN and WONDERFUL CHASER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GOLDEN PARTNERS and AUDACITY were sent for sampling.
<16/3/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>SWEET BEAN, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  SWEET BEAN was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer C Fownes this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, SWEET BEAN will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

race_name: THE EBENEZER SCHOOL & HOME FOR THE VISUALLY IMPAIRED 120TH ANNIVERSARY CUP (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
As the start was effected, STARLOT reared abruptly, resulting in its rider, D Whyte, being dislodged.  STARLOT remained in the barrier stalls and took no part in the race.  Before being allowed to race again, STARLOT will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.
EMPIRE STAR was slow to begin.
ROYALE ELEGANCE was crowded for room on jumping between GOLDEN ACHIEVER and LYRIC ACE which shifted out.
GOLD VELVET and ST YAZIN were shifted across behind runners in the early stages to obtain cover.
After initially being ridden along from the outside barrier, NEVER BETTER was steadied shortly after the start and shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
Making the turn passing the 1000 Metres, CHEERFULJET got its head on the side and lay out.
Passing the 900 Metres, GOLDEN ACHIEVER was steadied away from the heels of CHEERFULJET (O Doleuze) which, when racing greenly, shifted in.  O Doleuze was advised that whilst the Stewards acknowledged that CHEERFULJET was proving somewhat difficult to manage at this time, nonetheless he must ensure that he is properly clear of other runners when shifting ground.  After the 800 Metres, CHEERFULJET continued to race greenly and lay out and then after the 700 Metres hung out.  CHEERFULJET continued to hang out and proved difficult to ride until after straightening.  The racing manners of CHEERFULJET, which travelled wide and without cover throughout the race, were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, CHEERFULJET will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial around a bend.
Rounding the Home Turn, NEVER BETTER was awkwardly placed outside the heels of GOLDEN ACHIEVER which shifted out.
Passing the 200 Metres, EMPIRE STAR, which was having its first race start, shifted out abruptly despite the efforts of its rider, resulting in GOLDEN ACHIEVER being hampered when bumped and taken out onto NEVER BETTER which was also inconvenienced.  After this, EMPIRE STAR continued to lay out under pressure.
Over the concluding stages, GO-GETTER was unable to be properly tested due to being awkwardly placed close to the heels of ROYALE ELEGANCE. 
A veterinary inspection of GOLDEN ACHIEVER and CHEERFULJET immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ROYALE ELEGANCE, NASHASHUK and EMPIRE STAR were sent for sampling.

On arrival at the Start, it was noted that GENTRY had blood at the mouth due to a cut tongue.  GENTRY was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
SUPER CLAN began only fairly and shortly after the start was crowded for room between HAPPY JOURNEY which shifted out after being bumped by CURLING LUXURY and WINASWEWISH which shifted in.
GENTRY, PEARL FURU and DIAMOND FRIENDS were all steadied from outside barriers and shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the 1500 Metres, SPINNING DANCER and GLORY STAR raced tight.
GLORY STAR raced in restricted room passing the winning post on the first occasion due to CURLING LUXURY shifting in away from ROCKET LET WIN.
After being crossed by GO GO WIN near the 1400 Metres, CURLING LUXURY commenced to prove difficult to settle and shifted out away from the heels of that horse passing the 1300 Metres.  SPINNING DANCER then improved its position to be racing inside CURLING LUXURY, resulting in that horse being left racing wide and without cover.  CURLING LUXURY was then allowed to stride forward into the lead near the 1000 Metres.
Approaching the 1200 Metres, HAPPY JOURNEY got its head up when being checked away from the heels of GLORY STAR.
Passing the 900 Metres, SUPER CLAN got its head up when being steadied away from the heels of HAPPY JOURNEY which was also awkwardly placed close to the heels of GLORY STAR which raced close behind ROCKET LET WIN which was steadied after being crossed by CURLING LUXURY.  In this incident, SUPER CLAN shifted out away from the heels of HAPPY JOURNEY and bumped ROCK THE TREE on two occasions, resulting in both horses becoming unbalanced.
Passing the 700 Metres, ROCK THE TREE was taken wider by WINASWEWISH which shifted out to improve.
GLORY STAR lost its right front plate near the 400 Metres.
Passing the 300 Metres, SUPER CLAN was awkwardly placed outside the heels of ROCK THE TREE which shifted out.
Near the 150 Metres, SPINNING DANCER raced tight inside the heels of GO GO WIN.
Close to the finishing line, SUPER CLAN and HAPPY JOURNEY raced tight due to SUPER CLAN shifting out.
GENTRY lost its right front plate after the race.
A veterinary inspection of HAPPY JOURNEY and SUPER CLAN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of GLORY STAR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
WINASWEWISH and GO GO WIN were sent for sampling.

The Stewards tonight interviewed Trainer C S Shum regarding CHARITY GLORY (T302) being a pre-declaration withdrawal for this race due to being treated.  Also interviewed was Mr C Y Kwong, work rider allocated to Mr Shumâs stable for the current season.  CHARITY GLORY was withdrawn from this race on Monday, 13 March 2017.  Mr Shum was found to have breached Rule 50(2) in that as the trainer of CHARITY GLORY, he did fail in his responsibility for all matters pertaining to the running of his stable and that CHARITY GLORY was treated with omeprazole on Monday, 13 March 2017 which necessitated the withdrawal of the horse from this race.  Mr Shum was fined the sum of $10,000.  The Stewards will inform Stables Management of Mr Kwongâs role in this matter.
E-SUPER lost its left front plate at the start.
HONEST HORSE and TRAVEL SUCCESSOR began only fairly.
SILVER SPUN and E-SUPER bumped at the start.  A short distance later, SILVER SPUN was checked when crowded for room between E-SUPER and HAPPY METEOR which was bumped and taken out by BEAUTY MASTER which shifted out abruptly despite the efforts of its rider.  After this, BEAUTY MASTER continued to shift out despite the efforts of its rider, resulting in HAPPY METEOR being checked away from the heels of BEAUTY MASTER approaching the 900 Metres.
From the outside barrier, WAYFOONG VINNIE was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Approaching the 800 Metres, MR RIGHT and HAPPY METEOR raced tight.
Approaching the 700 Metres, BEAUTY MASTER was awkwardly placed close to the heels of MOMENT OF POWER which was racing tight inside OCEAN ROAR.
Passing the 200 Metres, MR RIGHT shifted in away from the heels of MOMENT OF POWER.
When questioned, T H So stated that it had been intended for MR RIGHT to be ridden behind the speed if possible.  He said it was felt that DIAMOND MASTER and TRAVEL COMFORTS, which had drawn inside MR RIGHT, would obtain forward positions and it was hoped that MR RIGHT may be able to obtain a trailing position behind those horses.  He said after steadying MR RIGHT in the early stages to race behind DIAMOND MASTER, MR RIGHT, despite being ridden along, did not show as much early speed as had been anticipated and because of this raced further back in the field than had been intended.
A veterinary inspection of BEAUTY MASTER, MOMENT OF POWER and OCEAN ROAR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
WAYFOONG VINNIE and DIAMOND MASTER were sent for sampling.

MONEY BOY began awkwardly.
LOADED and EXPERTO CREDE began only fairly and from wide barriers were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Shortly after the start, HARRIER JET shifted in and bumped VARA PEARL which became unbalanced.
After initially being ridden along, PAKISTAN BABY was left racing very wide approaching the first turn near the 1000 Metres and was then steadied and shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
OHANA was also steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners to obtain cover and making the first turn near the 1000 Metres was awkwardly placed inside the heels of HAPPY YEAH YEAH.
Near the 850 Metres, HEALTHY LUCK momentarily raced in restricted room inside YOU READ MY MIND which lay in.
Passing the 800 Metres, PAKISTAN BABY got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of HAPPY YEAH YEAH.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, LOADED brushed the running rail and became unbalanced.
Passing the 150 Metres, VARA PEARL raced tight inside YOU READ MY MIND which shifted in away from HARRIER JET.
For the majority of the race, TANG FLEMING travelled wide and without cover.
After the race, it was reported that HAPPY YEAH YEAH had sustained a deep wound above the point of the left hock.  Before being allowed to race again, HAPPY YEAH YEAH will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of TANG FLEMING immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
HARRIER JET and HEALTHY LUCK were sent for sampling.

Shortly after the start, VICTORY BOYS and FULL GLAMOUR bumped.
From wide barriers, THE SUPREME, HIGH AND MIGHTY and MODERN TSAR were all steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
After the 1100 Metres, THE SUPREME got its head up when proving difficult to settle.
After the 500 Metres, MODERN TSAR was eased out of the race.  A veterinary inspection of MODERN TSAR immediately following the race found that horse to have bled from both nostrils.
Passing the 150 Metres, AGREE was awkwardly placed outside the heels of SENSATION which shifted out under pressure.
When questioned, K Teetan stated that, from the outside barrier, he had been asked to obtain cover on GIANT TURTLE and it was hoped that the horse may be able to obtain a position behind midfield.  He said it was felt that were GIANT TURTLE to be ridden to obtain a forward position as is usual, the horse may be left racing wide and without cover as there were a number of runners which were expected to take up a forward position.  He said it was felt that GIANT TURTLEâs best opportunity to finish off the race would be for it to be ridden from off the speed with cover rather than having to be used up to obtain a forward position.  He added the pace of the race was good and GIANT TURTLE finished off the race well in the circumstances.
VICTORY BOYS, PIKACHU and THUNDER STOMP were sent for sampling.

BLOCKER DEE shifted in at the start and bumped MOLLYâS JADE STAR.
GOLDEN HARVEST and PERPETUAL TREASURE bumped heavily at the start.
When being ridden along to obtain a forward position from a wide barrier, CLEVER BEAVER was crowded for room a short distance after the start between SUPER TURBO and DRAGON GENERAL, resulting in CLEVER BEAVER and DRAGON GENERAL becoming unbalanced.  After this, CLEVER BEAVER, DRAGON GENERAL and SUPER TURBO were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Near the 900 Metres, GOLDEN HARVEST was momentarily awkwardly placed inside the heels of PERPETUAL TREASURE.
Passing the 600 Metres, MALMSTEEN was awkwardly placed close to the heels of MOLLYâS JADE STAR.
Approaching the 500 Metres, CLEVER BEAVER was checked when racing behind SUPER TURBO and GOLDEN HARVEST.
Over the final 100 Metres, CLEVER BEAVER was unable to obtain clear running and consequently was not able to be tested.
Over the concluding stages, GOLDEN HARVEST and BACK IN BLACK raced tight.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of SEA JADE, J Moreira stated that he was able to cross runners to his inside without having to ride his mount along vigorously to do so as SEA JADE was travelling strongly.  He said after crossing PREMIERE passing the 700 Metres, SEA JADE would not relax as he expected it to and then after being placed under pressure rounding the Home Turn weakened noticeably over the latter stages of the race.  He added that the veterinary finding that the horse had a substantial amount of blood in its trachea following the race, in his opinion, accounted for its failure to finish off the race.  Before being allowed to race again, SEA JADE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned, K Teetan stated that as PREMIERE was racing over 1200 Metres for the first time tonight, he had been asked to try and settle the horse in the early stages and it was anticipated that PREMIERE may be able to cross BLOCKER DEE to its inside and race outside MOLLYâS JADE STAR, thereby allowing SEA JADE to cross PREMIERE.  He said BLOCKER DEE maintained its position in the early stages and as he steadied PREMIERE to allow SEA JADE to cross, the horse commenced to travel keenly and would not relax. He said when BLOCKER DEE maintained its position, he was obliged to allow PREMIERE to stride forward to clear that horse and when he did this PREMIERE continued to race keenly and would not relax.  He said PREMIERE initially responded well to his riding in the early part of the Straight, however, over the final 200 Metres came under pressure and did not finish off the race.  He added that, in his opinion, the manner in which PREMIERE had over-raced in the early and middle stages was the reason for the horseâs disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection of PREMIERE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PREMIERE, JETWINGS and SUPER TURBO were sent for sampling.

DAZZLE WINNER was slow to begin.
PEARL HARBOUR got its head up when being steadied in the early stages to obtain cover.
INDIGENOUS STAR began only fairly.
From the outside barrier, GOLDEN DEER was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Despite being ridden along in the early stages, FOREVER ACCURATE failed to muster speed.
Making the first turn near the 900 Metres, PADDINGTON raced tight between REGENCY DARLING and INDIGENOUS STAR which shifted in when racing keenly.
VIVA COUNCIL and PADDINGTON lay out making the Home Turn.
REGENCY DARLING was unable to obtain clear running until passing the 200 Metres.
Throughout the race, VIVA COUNCIL and MR ORIOLE travelled wide and without cover.
The performance of PEARL HARBOUR, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  As this was the second occasion that PEARL HARBOUR was tailed out in a race, the horse will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a series of consecutive barrier trials and be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that PEACE COMBINATION had bled from both nostrils.
JUMBO LUCK, MR PICASSO and MR ORIOLE were sent for sampling.

HEALTHY JOYFUL shifted out at the start and bumped MIGHTY MAVERICK.
WATER DIVINER was checked on jumping when crowded for room between BULLISH SMART and GOLD LAND which shifted out abruptly despite the efforts of its rider,
WESTERN EXPRESS began only fairly.

He added PO CHING TREASURE came under heavy pressure prior to the 400 Metres and despite being tested in the early part of the Straight weakened out of contention.  A veterinary inspection of PO CHING TREASURE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of PO CHING TREASURE, a favourite for tonight's race, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, PO CHING TREASURE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of DUTCH WINDMILL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PO CHING TREASURE, GOOD CHOICE and SUM WIN DRAGON were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE HONG KONG EXCHANGES CHALLENGE CUP (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
NOBLE DE BOY was slow to begin.
RAPHAEL and SICHUAN BOSS both began only fairly.
DIEGO KOSTA and OUR FOLKS bumped at the start.
From wide barriers, HAPPY LIFE and VICTORY MACHINE were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the 900 Metres, GENEROUS HEART momentarily raced tight inside the heels of POWERMAX.  MR GENUINE, which was racing to the inside of GENEROUS HEART, was awkwardly placed as a consequence.
STARSHIP made the turn after the 600 Metres awkwardly.
Passing the 300 Metres, STARSHIP was shifted to the outside of WAH MAY BABY to obtain clear running.
Approaching the 250 Metres, MR GENUINE and GENEROUS HEART raced tight as MR GENUINE shifted to the outside of POWERMAX after being disappointed for running between that horse and DIEGO KOSTA.
Passing the 200 Metres, K C Ng (WAH MAY BABY) dropped his whip.
STARSHIP lost its right front plate after the race.
After the race, Apprentice K K Chiong (OUR FOLKS) reported that her saddle shifted back significantly approaching and rounding the Home Turn, placing her at a disadvantage for the remainder of the race.  Because of this, Apprentice Chiong dismounted from OUR FOLKS shortly after passing the winning post.
Also after the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that an endoscopic examination conducted on DIEGO KOSTA showed a substantial amount of mucus in the horseâs trachea.
MR GENUINE and POWERMAX were sent for sampling.

BRILLIANT DREAM was slow to begin.
NAVAS began awkwardly.
Shortly after the start, APACHE SPIRIT was steadied and shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
WILD BOY was crowded for room shortly after the start between LOTUS BREEZE and EXCEL ONESELF which shifted out.
From a wide barrier, AMAZING was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Making the turn near the 1000 Metres, BRILLIANT DREAM got its head up and shifted out abruptly across the heels of NAVAS (N Callan) after racing tight inside that horse.  In this incident, BRILLIANT DREAM bumped the hindquarters of NAVAS, causing that horse to become unbalanced and then struck the heels of NAVAS and blundered.  As the Stewards were satisfied that at the relevant time NAVAS was still racing in a position one horse off the rail and that BRILLIANT DREAM's racing manners had played a significant part in this incident, no further action was taken, however, N Callan was advised to ensure that leaves comfortable racing room for runners to his inside in similar circumstances.  Near the 950 Metres, BRILLIANT DREAM, which was racing ungenerously, was awkwardly placed inside the heels of AMAZING.  K Teetan stated that after this BRILLIANT DREAM continued to lay out and would not shift over to race close to the rail.  He said as he felt that the bit may have pulled through the horse's mouth, he attempted to adjust the bit in an endeavour to have the horse race more tractably.  He said when he was doing this, BRILLIANT DREAM became unbalanced in its action passing the 700 Metres.
Approaching the 500 Metres, CHARITY GLORY (N Rawiller) commenced to over-race and improved to be racing between EXCEL ONESELF and LOTUS BREEZE where there was insufficient room.  CHARITY GLORY then took charge of its rider and continued to improve between those runners, resulting in CHARITY GLORY being severely checked and bumping the hindquarters of LOTUS BREEZE which became unbalanced.  CHARITY GLORY then continued to attempt to shift out across the heels of LOTUS BREEZE, resulting in that horse having to be severely checked for some distance passing the 400 Metres.  In this incident, NAVAS improved into tight running inside CHARITY GLORY and was severely checked passing the 400 Metres when badly crowded inside CHARITY GLORY which at this time was racing untractably despite the efforts of its rider.  N Rawiller stated that he is well acquainted with CHARITY GLORY having ridden the horse previously and its racing manners at this time of the race were uncharacteristic as it had raced tractably when ridden by him previously.  He said the manner in which CHARITY GLORY had reacted concerned him that something may have been amiss with the horse and for this reason he commenced to ease it down rounding the Home Turn, however, in the early part of the Straight it commenced to race more tractably and then finished off the race quite well.  The racing manners of CHARITY GLORY were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, CHARITY GLORY will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial around a bend and must be ridden in amongst horses.  A veterinary inspection of CHARITY GLORY immediately following the race confirmed that horse to be a "roarer" which had previously been reported.  In this incident, AMAZING, which was following CHARITY GLORY and NAVAS, was hampered and forced to shift out abruptly from behind those horses passing the 400 Metres.
A veterinary inspection of NAVAS and EXCEL ONESELF immediately following the race revealed that both horses were displaying an irregular heart rhythm.  Before being allowed to race again, NAVAS and EXCEL ONESELF will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of BRILLIANT DREAM immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
LOTUS BREEZE and BEAUTY KINGDOM were sent for sampling.

BASIC TRILOGY began only fairly.
SUPREME PROFIT and RENAISSANCE ART were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
After the 1300 Metres, when being steadied to allow HORSE OF FORTUNE to cross, PACKING DRAGON got its head up and proved difficult to settle.
Approaching the 1000 Metres, HELENE SUPER STAR was awkwardly placed close to the heels of SPEEDY LONGWAH.
Passing the 1000 Metres, DYNAMISM commenced to prove difficult to settle and was checked away from the heels of CIRCUIT LAND for some distance.  MARVEL HERO, which was following DYNAMISM, shifted out away from the heels of that horse and was then allowed to improve its position.  When MARVEL HERO went forward, SUPREME PROFIT, which was following that horse, also improved its position, however, was forced to travel wide and without cover.  After the race, Z Purton (SUPREME PROFIT) stated that he placed the horse under heavy pressure after the 500 Metres, however, it did not respond and rounding the Home Turn commenced to give ground.  He said for this reason he eased it down over the concluding stages.  A veterinary inspection of SUPREME PROFIT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Near the 600 Metres, ANTICIPATION lay in towards the hindquarters of SPEEDY LONGWAH.
A veterinary inspection of HORSE OF FORTUNE and BASIC TRILOGY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MARVEL HERO and DYNAMISM were sent for sampling.

ENORMOUS HONOUR and NITRO EXPRESS bumped at the start.  After this, ENORMOUS HONOUR was hard ridden, however, failed to muster speed.
UNICORN and ELECTRONIC PHOENIX were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 1200 Metres, FANTASTIC KAKA was awkwardly placed close to the heels of GRAND HARBOUR.  WISKY, which was following, was awkwardly placed behind FANTASTIC KAKA in consequence.
After the 1000 Metres, LITTLE ISLAND was taken into a positon wide and without cover by ISTANBUL BEY which shifted out.  LITTLE ISLAND then commenced to prove difficult to settle despite the efforts of its rider and was consequently allowed to improve its position.
C Y Ho (ISTANBUL BEY) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 800 Metres he directed his mount out away from the heels of MAGICAL BEAUTY and made heavy contact with UNICORN, causing that horse to become unbalanced and be severely hampered when taken wider.  C Y Ho was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 5 April 2017 and to expire on Monday, 10 April 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards took into account Jockey Ho's good race riding record.
Passing the 700 Metres, UNICORN was taken wider by ISTANBUL BEY which shifted to the outside of LITTLE ISLAND.  After this, UNICORN was steadied and shifted back in to regain cover.
Passing the 400 Metres, WISKY and FANTASTIC KAKA raced tight as WISKY improved into tight running between FANTASTIC KAKA and GRAND HARBOUR which was giving ground.
Rounding the Home Turn, UNICORN raced tight between MAGICAL BEAUTY and ISTANBUL BEY and at the entrance to the Straight was shifted to the outside of ISTANBUL BEY to obtain clear running.
Passing the 400 Metres, NITRO EXPRESS was awkwardly placed close to the heels of WISKY.
After passing the 50 Metres, ELECTRONIC PHOENIX was struck across the nose by the whip of N Rawiller (UNICORN).
S Clipperton (LAND GRANT) stated that prior to the Home Turn he improved to be racing to the outside of the eventual winner LITTLE DRAGON and he anticipated that LAND GRANT would close off the race strongly as it was travelling well at this time.  He said however after straightening LAND GRANT commenced to race with its head on the side and hang in badly and at the same time was not finishing off the race as strongly as he thought it would.  He said despite his efforts to have LAND GRANT remain racing to the outside of LITTLE DRAGON, LAND GRANT continued to hang in badly and he was unable to prevent the horse from shifting in from behind LITTLE DRAGON.  He said he was also not able to continue to shift to the inside of that horse as WISKY had improved to be racing to the inside of LAND GRANT.  He added as a result of him not being able to shift LAND GRANT to the outside of LITTLE DRAGON, LAND GRANT was awkwardly placed close to the heels of that horse for the final 100 Metres of the race and as a consequence he was not able to test the horse properly and then over the concluding stages was not able to ride it out.  After reviewing the videos, the Stewards accepted Jockey Clipperton's explanation.
UNICORN lost its left front plate after the race.
The Stewards will interview K C Leung regarding the disappointing performance of GRAND HARBOUR, a last start winner, prior to the Sha Tin racemeeting to be conducted on Sunday, 26 March 2017.  A veterinary inspection of GRAND HARBOUR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
WISKY, LITTLE DRAGON and FANTASTIC KAKA were sent for sampling.
<26/3/2017 22 March 2017 Happy Valley Racemeeting â Race 8 (516) >The Stewards today interviewed K C Leung regarding the performance of GRAND HARBOUR in this race. K C Leung stated that in accordance with his instructions, he was able to obtain the lead in the early stages without having to make too much use of GRAND HARBOUR. He said however that after crossing FANTASTIC KAKA passing the 1300 Metres, GRAND HARBOUR commenced to race keenly and would not relax. He said it was not until after the 1000 Metres that GRAND HARBOUR commenced to travel more generously. He said passing the 600 Metres LITTLE DRAGON improved to be racing directly to the outside of GRAND HARBOUR and GRAND HARBOUR initially responded well, however, when LITTLE DRAGON was able to advance forward of GRAND HARBOUR after the 600 Metres, GRAND HARBOUR immediately came under pressure and did not respond to his riding. He added at the 400 Metres GRAND HARBOUR was already under heavy pressure and was a beaten horse from this point onwards.

When proceeding to the barriers, HIGH SPEED METRO became unbalanced and fell over, resulting in its rider, K C Leung, being dislodged without incident.  After being returned to the barriers, HIGH SPEED METRO was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said that, after the necessary consultations, the horse was suitable to race.
As the start was effected, TELEPHATIA kicked out behind, resulting in the horse being slow to begin.
WIN CHANCE, MEDIC SWORDSMAN and LOYAL CRAFTSMAN were also slow to begin.
Shortly after the start, GENTLEMEN shifted in and bumped FORTUNE GIGGLES.
After the 1500 Metres, AEROLUMINANCE was left racing wide and without cover and was allowed to improve its position to race outside the lead near the 1000 Metres at which time BEST JADE TRIUMPH was left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 1400 Metres, WIN CHANCE got its head up when being checked away from the heels of LOYAL CRAFTSMAN.  TELEPHATIA, which was following, was checked away from the heels of WIN CHANCE in consequence.
Approaching the 1300 Metres, HIGH SPEED METRO commenced to race keenly and was checked away from the heels of GENTLEMEN.
MY FOLKS was held up for clear running from rounding the Home Turn until passing the 300 Metres.
Near the 350 Metres, FORTUNE GIGGLES was bumped by LUCKY SEBRING which, when commencing to give ground, shifted in after being brushed by AEROLUMINANCE.
MEDIC SWORDSMAN was unable to obtain clear running in the Straight and passing the 150 Metres was checked away from the heels of HIGH SPEED METRO.  MEDIC SWORDSMAN continued to be held up for clear running for the remainder of the race and consequently was not able to be tested.
Passing the 100 Metres, MY FOLKS, which was being shifted in to improve inside BEST JADE TRIUMPH (B Prebble), was obliged to be directed in away from the heels of that horse which shifted in.  This resulted in MY FOLKS having to be checked away from the heels of BEST JADE TRIUMPH and shifting in, causing HIGH SPEED METRO to be checked and MEDIC SWORDSMAN to be hampered.  As the Stewards were satisfied that MY FOLKS had not properly established running to the inside of BEST JADE TRIUMPH prior to that horse shifting ground, no further action was taken, however, B Prebble was advised of his obligation to make every endeavour to prevent his mounts from shifting ground.
A veterinary inspection of WIN CHANCE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
AEROLUMINANCE, FORTUNE GIGGLES and BEST JADE TRIUMPH were sent for sampling.

As the start was effected, ULTIMATE GLORY bounded in the air, resulting in H W Laiâs right foot being dislodged from the iron.  H W Lai was unable to regain the use of his right iron until passing the 1500 Metres.  This resulted in ULTIMATE GLORY racing well back in the field.
ISHVARA stumbled at the start.
From the outside barrier, EASY HEDGE was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 750 Metres, SUPER SIXTEEN broke down in its right front leg and was retired out of the race.  MAGNETISM, which was following, was checked and shifted out abruptly away from the heels of SUPER SIXTEEN.
When questioned, U Rispoli stated that he had been asked to ride LOOK ERAS behind the speed if possible.  He said it was anticipated that CHEERFUL BOY and GO BEAUTY GO would lead and he was asked to attempt to obtain a position behind those horses.  He said in accordance with his instructions he immediately commenced to shift LOOK ERAS across in the early stages and restrained the horse approaching and passing the 1500 Metres in an attempt to obtain a trailing position behind GO BEAUTY GO which had been hard ridden out of the barriers to take up a forward position.  He said despite restraining his mount after the 1500 Metres, LOOK ERAS commenced to prove difficult to settle and would not respond to his attempts to steady the horse.  He said passing the 1400 Metres he was aware that the tempo of the race was increasing, therefore he had a look to his inside to establish whether it was still available for him to settle behind GO BEAUTY GO.  He said when he became aware that this position was available, he again attempted to steady LOOK ERAS, however, the horse continued to prove difficult to settle when racing directly to the outside of GO BEAUTY GO and he was not able to restrain the horse.  He added passing the 1300 Metres he directed LOOK ERAS out away from GO BEAUTY GO as he felt that racing directly outside GO BEAUTY GO may have been firing up LOOK ERAS.  He said, despite shifting LOOK ERAS out at this time, the horse would not respond to his attempts to steady and therefore he allowed LOOK ERAS to improve its position forward of GO BEAUTY GO in the hope that that horse would be steadied and take a trailing position behind CHEERFUL BOY which would allow LOOK ERAS to shift out and race outside that horse.  He said however that GO BEAUTY GO continued to hold its position behind LOOK ERAS and CHEERFUL BOY with LOOK ERAS being obliged to race three wide and without cover in a fast run section.  He said it was not until after making the turn passing the 900 Metres that he was able to steady the horse sufficiently to obtain a trailing position, however, by this time LOOK ERAS had already done too much work and therefore was not able to finish off the race.
When questioned, Apprentice H N Wong (GO BEAUTY GO) stated that he had been asked to lead if possible, however, if CHEERFUL BOY was ridden to obtain a forward position as anticipated, he should race outside that horse.  He said in accordance with his instructions he rode his mount positively in the early stages to ensure that he obtained a position outside CHEERFUL BOY which was also being ridden to obtain the lead.  He said passing the 1400 Metres he commenced to steady the tempo on GO BEAUTY GO in order to remain racing to the outside of CHEERFUL BOY as he did not want to improve his position to be racing forward of that horse.  He said however that at this time LOOK ERAS improved to the outside of GO BEAUTY GO which caused GO BEAUTY GO to travel too keenly.  He said for a considerable distance after the 1300 Metres he attempted to steady GO BEAUTY GO to obtain a trailing position as he was aware that the race was being run at too fast a tempo, however, the racing manners of GO BEAUTY GO did not allow him the opportunity to do so.  He added due to his endeavours to restrain the horse, GO BEAUTY GO shifted ground on a number of occasions approaching and passing the 1200 Metres and he believed that he would have had to severely check the horse to be any chance of obtaining a trailing positon.  After considering Apprentice Wongâs explanation and after viewing the videos, the Stewards accepted that GO BEAUTY GO was proving very difficult to settle at this time, however, he was advised that in similar circumstances he should make every endeavour to rate his mounts so that they are given the opportunity to close off the race as best as they are able.
A veterinary inspection of ISHVARA immediately following the race confirmed the horse to be a âroarerâ which had previously been reported.
A veterinary inspection of GO BEAUTY GO immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PENANG HALL and CITRON SPIRIT were sent for sampling.  Samples were also taken from SUPER SIXTEEN.

DASHING DART began only fairly.
ASHKIYR and AMRITSARIA bumped at the start.
ARGENTUM began awkwardly and shortly after the start stumbled after bumping GENERAL OâREILLY which began only fairly.  ARGENTUM was then taken out by AMRITSARIA which shifted out despite the efforts of its rider, resulting in GENERAL OâREILLY being crowded for room inside PREMIUM CHAMPION.
From wide barriers, GOOD CHOICE AHEAD and RUBY COAST were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After the 700 Metres, JOLLY AMBER got its head on the side and lay out.
In the early part of the Straight, RUBY COAST was awkwardly placed close to the heels of HOLMES LEGEND which was giving ground.
After the 200 Metres, CHIU CHOW KID was held up when disappointed for running between DASHING DART and ASHKIYR.  CHIU CHOW KID was then shifted to the outside of DASHING DART passing the 150 Metres to obtain clear running.
Near the 50 Metres, GOOD CHOICE AHEAD was shifted out away from the heels of CHIU CHOW KID.
Passing the 50 Metres, ASHKIYR raced tight outside FINE WITH ME.
For the majority of the race, HOLMES LEGEND raced wide and without cover and gave ground in the Straight.
After the race, B Prebble stated that PREMIUM CHAMPION raced âflatâ and may not have backed up from its run at Happy Valley last Wednesday night.  A veterinary inspection of PREMIUM CHAMPION immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Also after the race, Z Purton was not able to offer any explanation for the disappointing performance of RUBY COAST.  A veterinary inspection of RUBY COAST immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ARGENTUM, DASHING DART and GOLDEN ACHIEVER were sent for sampling.

AGILITY HERO was slow to begin.
JOLLY CONVERGENCE began only fairly and then shortly after the start was steadied when crowded for room between TRIUMPHANT JEWEL and PRIMERO which shifted out.
Near the 450 Metres, CLASSIER was shifted in away from the heels of CALIFORNIA ASPAR.  After this, CLASSIER was awkwardly placed close to the heels of CALIFORNIA ASPAR which shifted out.
When questioned regarding his riding of SUNSHINE UNIVERSE passing the 300 Metres, O Doleuze stated that there were runs available both to the outside and to the inside of GALLANT ROCK (M Chadwick) at this time.  He said he elected not to shift to the outside of GALLANT ROCK as he was aware that that horse had weakened in a number of its recent races and he felt that if this happened, the horse would be more inclined to shift out and therefore he elected to avail himself of the run to the inside of GALLANT ROCK and to the outside of BOTH LUCKY (Apprentice M F Poon).  He added as he was improving into this run, SUNSHINE UNIVERSE was inclined to get its head on the side and he felt that the horse was shy of BOTH LUCKY rather than laying out away from that horse.  He said SUNSHINE UNIVERSE continued to have clear running until passing the 150 Metres at which time the horse was checked when crowded for room between BOTH LUCKY which shifted out marginally and GALLANT ROCK which lay in.  JOLLY CONVERGENCE, which was following SUNSHINE UNIVERSE, was checked and shifted in abruptly away from the heels of that horse and in doing so shifted into the running of TRIUMPHANT JEWEL which was inconvenienced.  As the Stewards were satisfied that the interference occurred as a result of minor shifts from both GALLANT ROCK and BOTH LUCKY, in the circumstances they did not believe that either Apprentice Poon or Jockey Chadwick should face a charge of careless riding, however, both riders were advised that they had an obligation to make every effort to keep their mounts on a straight course.  After considering Jockey Doleuzeâs evidence and after viewing the videos, the Stewards accepted his explanation.
DRAGON GENERAL and PERPETUAL JOYANCE were sent for sampling.

Whilst in the saddling stalls, VICTORY MUSIC had its left hind plate refitted.  VICTORY MUSIC was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
HEARTS KEEPER began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped BOND ELEGANCE.
GREAT SKY shifted out at the start and bumped VICTORY MUSIC which became unbalanced.
Shortly after the start, BOLSHOI BALLET and RADIANT STEED bumped.
From the outside barrier, HELLO KIMBERLEY was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
Approaching the 900 Metres, VICTORY MUSIC got its head on the side, shifted out and raced tight inside HURRICANE KID.  After this, VICTORY MUSIC travelled keenly and making the first turn near the 700 Metres lay out, resulting in HURRICANE KID being inconvenienced.
BOLSHOI BALLET lay out rounding the Home Turn.
Shortly after entering the Straight, BOND ELEGANCE shifted in towards the running rail and became unbalanced.  After the race, J Moreira reported that BOND ELEGANCE did not feel comfortable racing in amongst horses during the race.
MONEY MONEY lay in under pressure in the Straight.
Throughout the race, RADIANT STEED travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of SAKURA FIGHTER and HURRICANE KID immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
RADIANT STEED and BOLSHOI BALLET were sent for sampling.

DRAGON MASTER shifted out abruptly at the start, resulting in ARIZONA BLIZZARD and LITTERATEUR being badly crowded for room inside SWISS WARRIOR which became unbalanced when bumped by LITTERATEUR.  DRAGON MASTER continued to shift out and shortly after the start stumbled.
From wide barriers, BEAR RAPPER and RADIANT BUNNY were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Near the 1150 Metres, LITTERATEUR was steadied away from the heels of SWISS WARRIOR (Z Purton) which shifted in when being ridden along.  Z Purton will be advised to exercise more care when shifting ground in similar circumstances.
Approaching the 900 Metres, SUPER MAN raced tight inside the heels of GOLDEN SUN which, when being ridden along, shifted in when racing tight inside SWISS WARRIOR.
Near the 450 Metres, SUPER MAN shifted out and made contact with ARIZONA BLIZZARD which became unbalanced.
At the entrance to the Straight, SUPER MAN, which had improved into tight running between STARTLING POWER and ARIZONA BLIZZARD, was checked when STARTLING POWER shifted out marginally and ARIZONA BLIZZARD shifted in as its rider, J Moreira, was changing his whip from his left hand into his right hand.  In the circumstances, J Moreira was advised to ensure that he makes every endeavour to prevent his mounts from shifting ground.
Near the 200 Metres, SUPER MAN was hampered when momentarily crowded for room inside ARIZONA BLIZZARD which shifted in.  J Moreira was severely reprimanded and advised that whilst the Stewards accepted that ARIZONA BLIZZARD hung in in the Straight, in future he would be expected to make every endeavour to prevent his mounts from shifting ground.
DEJA VU was held up for clear running approaching and passing the 200 Metres.
Approaching the 100 Metres, RADIANT BUNNY was severely checked away from the heels of SWISS WARRIOR which gave ground abruptly.
In the Straight, DRAGON MASTER lay out under pressure.
Throughout the race, STARTLING POWER travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of SWISS WARRIOR immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea and that it also displaying signs of thumps.  Before being allowed to race again, SWISS WARRIOR will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of ARIZONA BLIZZARD immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SWISS WARRIOR, HAPPY METEOR and GOLDEN SUN were sent for sampling.

ROBUST MOMENTUM began only fairly.
KEEP MOVING shifted out abruptly at the start, resulting in GRACIOUS RYDER being checked and DIAMOND MYSTERIOUS being badly hampered when bumped heavily by GRACIOUS RYDER.
Shortly after the start, PERFECT TOUCH and SUPER TALENT bumped, resulting in PERFECT TOUCH becoming badly unbalanced.
Also shortly after the start, LONDON CITY and SKY TREASURE bumped.
Passing the 1100 Metres, SKY TREASURE shifted in and bumped LONDON CITY.
Near the 1000 Metres, SKY TREASURE (Apprentice H N Wong) lost ground after shifting in away from COMPASSION STAR and being awkwardly placed outside the heels of LONDON CITY which became unbalanced after being bumped on the hindquarters by SKY TREASURE.  When SKY TREASURE lost ground, PERFECT TOUCH, which was following, was checked away from the heels of that horse.  GRACIOUS RYDER, which was following PERFECT TOUCH, was shifted out away from the heels of that horse in consequence, resulting in SUPER TALENT being hampered when bumped by GRACIOUS RYDER.  As Apprentice Wong attempted to shift SKY TREASURE out to relieve the tightening to PERFECT TOUCH, VITAL SPRING, which was racing to the outside of SKY TREASURE, was checked out away from the heels of that horse, resulting in DIAMOND MYSTERIOUS also being hampered.
Passing the 1100 Metres, KEEP MOVING was awkwardly placed inside the heels of RICHCITY FORTUNE (Apprentice M F Poon) which shifted in at an acute angle before being straightened.  Apprentice Poon will be warned against the practice of shifting his mounts in too abruptly.
Approaching and passing the 800 Metres, GRACIOUS RYDER got its head up on a number of occasions when awkwardly placed behind PERFECT TOUCH.
After the 800 Metres, SKY TREASURE was left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 650 Metres, PERFECT TOUCH and VITAL SPRING bumped.
Passing the 600 Metres, PERFECT TOUCH was steadied away from the heels of COMPASSION STAR.
RICHCITY FORTUNE got its head on the side and lay out rounding the Home Turn.
The performance of PERFECT TOUCH, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, PERFECT TOUCH will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned regarding the performance of VITAL SPRING, J Moreira stated that his mount was obliged to race further back in the field that had been anticipated as it did not show sufficient early speed to be able to clear runners to its inside and obtain a more forward position.  He said although VITAL SPRING was hampered near the 1000 Metres, the horse subsequently travelled satisfactorily, however, came under pressure rounding the Home Turn and then, despite being ridden out, did not close off the race and was disappointing.  A veterinary inspection of VITAL SPRING immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of KEEP MOVING and GRACIOUS RYDER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
VITAL SPRING, LONDON CITY and DIAMOND MYSTERIOUS were sent for sampling.

When being mounted, GENERAL IRON, which was fractious in the Parade Ring, took charge of its attendants which resulted in its rider, Apprentice M F Poon, being dragged by GENERAL IRON for a short distance.  GENERAL IRON then proceeded onto the track riderless and galloped for a considerable distance.  Acting on veterinary advice that GENERAL IRON was not suitable to race, the horse was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  Before being allowed to race again, GENERAL IRON will be required to undergo a satisfactory parade test prior to its next race start and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  As a result of this incident, Apprentice Poon was transported to hospital.
TURF SPRINT shifted out at the start and bumped BLOCKER DEE which became unbalanced.  A short distance after this, TURF SPRINT was steadied when crowded for room between BLOCKER DEE and ARCHIPPUS which shifted out.
From the outside barriers, HIGH FIVE and LINE SEEKER were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Making the first turn after the 900 Metres, HOUSE OF FUN, which was inclined to lay out, got its head up after being awkwardly placed close to the heels of MAGIC LEGEND which shifted in marginally.
D Whyte (MAGIC LEGEND) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that after the 800 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of HOUSE OF FUN, resulting in that horse having to be checked.  In the circumstances, D Whyte was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Thursday, 20 April 2017 and to expire on Monday, 24 April 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards took into account Jockey Whyteâs good race riding record.

<29/3/2017 26 March 2017 Sha Tin Racemeeting â Race 9 (525) >The Stewards today interviewed B Prebble regarding the performance of VOLITATION in this race.B Prebble stated that it had been anticipated that VOLITATION would be able to take up a position behind the speed as it had been able to assume this position from inside barriers in some of its previous races. He said however that he was asked not to make use of the horse early as VOLITATION had been inclined to over-race in some of its races. He said he was also asked to obtain inside runs if possible as the horse was carrying top weight. He said in the early stages he felt that the pace of the race was good and VOLITATION was not showing the type of early speed that he anticipated. He said he had intended to follow DARING FIT which was being ridden along to obtain a forward position and he had hoped in those circumstances to race inside MORETHANLUCKY. He said however MORETHANLUCKY was showing more early speed than VOLITATION and he felt that in order to maintain his positon inside that horse he would have had to ride VOLITATION along which would have been contrary to his instructions. He said therefore he elected to follow MORETHANLUCKY which resulted in VOLITATION racing further back in the field than had been intended. He added VOLITATION travelled only fairly in the run and, despite being able to take inside runs in the Straight, the horse was disappointing in the manner in which it failed to close off the race. Mr J Size, the trainer of VOLITATION, confirmed the instructions he gave to Jockey Prebble. He said he had expected that VOLITATION would show natural early speed and as such would not be required to be ridden along to obtain a position behind the speed. He confirmed that because of this he asked Jockey Prebble not to ride the horse along from the start as he did not want it over-racing carrying top weight, however, this instruction was given in the expectation that the horse would show more early speed than it did in this race. He said having regard to his instructions and the manner in which VOLITATION began, he was satisfied with Jockey Prebble's riding of the horse in the early stages.

B Prebble (LUCKY BUBBLES) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that after initially shifting in near the 1000 Metres when not clear of SUN JEWELLERY, causing that horse to be crowded onto BLIZZARD, he failed to make sufficient endeavour to shift LUCKY BUBBLES out in a timely manner for some distance after the 1000 Metres to relieve the tightening which resulted in SUN JEWELLERY, BLIZZARD and THEWIZARDOFOZ all being hampered when unnecessarily tightened for room.  B Prebble was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 12 April 2017 and to expire on Tuesday, 18 April 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards took into account Jockey Prebbleâs good race riding record.
When LUCKY BUBBLES was eventually shifted out to relieve the tightening to SUN JEWELLERY, BLIZZARD and THEWIZARDOFOZ after the 900 Metres, LUCKY BUBBLES became awkward on the heels of DASHING FELLOW and shifted out further.  LUCKY YEAR was awkwardly placed outside LUCKY BUBBLES as a consequence.  LUCKY YEAR, which was racing wide, was then steadied to obtain a position with cover.
Passing the 800 Metres, BLIZZARD raced in restricted room between THEWIZARDOFOZ and SUN JEWELLERY which was awkwardly placed inside the heels of DASHING FELLOW.
After the 700 Metres, LUCKY BUBBLES was left racing wide and without cover.
BLIZZARD had some difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Approaching the 300 Metres, THEWIZARDOFOZ raced in restricted room between DASHING FELLOW and SUN JEWELLERY when improving into tight running between those horses.
The Stewards deferred the declaration of weighed-in as they were of the prima facie view that an incident had occurred near the 200 Metres which cast sufficient doubt as to whether LUCKY BUBBLES should be declared the 3rd placegetter of the race.  Subsequently Mr P F Yiu, the trainer of BLIZZARD, which dead-heated for 4th position, lodged a formal protest/objection on behalf of the connections of BLIZZARD alleging interference near the 200 Metres.  After taking evidence from all parties concerned and after viewing the official videos, the Stewards found that approaching the 200 Metres clear running became available for BLIZZARD between SUN JEWELLERY and LUCKY BUBBLES and at this time BLIZZARD was racing about three quarters of a length behind LUCKY BUBBLES.  It was further established that passing the 200 Metres LUCKY BUBBLES shifted in under pressure, resulting in BLIZZARD being disappointed for running inside that horse and having to be steadied and shifted to the outside of that horse to obtain clear running.  As the Stewards were of the opinion that BLIZZARD was entitled to proceed into the run between SUN JEWELLERY and LUCKY BUBBLES and that the reason for BLIZZARD not being able to so proceed was as a result of LUCKY BUBBLES shifting in and also having regard to the manner in which the horses finished off the race, they were comfortably satisfied that had LUCKY BUBBLES not shifted into the running of BLIZZARD passing the 200 Metres, BLIZZARD would have finished in front of LUCKY BUBBLES.  Accordingly, the protest/objection was sustained and the placings amended to read, No. 4, MR STUNNING, 1st; No. 2, PENIAPHOBIA, 2nd; No. 3, BLIZZARD, 3rd (dead heat); No. 7, THEWIZARDOFOZ, 3rd  (dead heat); and No. 1, LUCKY BUBBLES, 5th.  B Prebble was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he makes every endeavour in similar circumstances to prevent his mounts from shifting ground.  N Rawiller was also advised of his obligation to ensure that he utilizes all available avenues to decide whether to lodge a protest/objection in order to safeguard the interests of his connections.

FUNNY BUDDIES then had difficulty obtaining clear running passing the 150 Metres and approaching the 100 Metres was shifted to the inside of HIGHLAND DRAGON to continue improving.
Over the concluding stages, NOBLE BUDDIES raced tight inside FUNNY BUDDIES.
Close to the finishing line, SEVEN LUCK was awkwardly placed close to the heels of SPARKLING TALENT and consequently was not able to be fully tested all the way to the end of the race.
Throughout the race, SPARKLING TALENT travelled wide and without cover.
The Stewards deferred the declaration of weighed-in whilst they considered if RUGBY DIAMOND (N Rawiller) had been afforded a fair start.  After viewing the official videos, it was established that as the start was effected RUGBY DIAMOND put its head down and to the left which resulted in the horse losing a significant amount of ground.  As the Stewards were of the opinion that RUGBY DIAMONDâs barrier manners had been the sole reason for this incident occurring and that the incident had occurred simultaneous to the start being effected, RUGBY DIAMOND was deemed to have been afforded a fair start and accordingly, the horse was declared a runner.  Whilst it had no bearing on the decision of the Stewards, it should be noted that neither N Rawiller nor Mr W Y So, the trainer of RUGBY DIAMOND, made an application for the horse to be declared a non-runner.  Before being allowed to race again, RUGBY DIAMOND will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.
After the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on FUNNY BUDDIES at the request of Trainer P OâSullivan.  The Veterinary Surgeon said this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, FUNNY BUDDIES will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
RUGBY DIAMOND, ORIENTAL FANTASIA and SPARKLING TALENT were sent for sampling.

GOLDEN CHOPSTICKS was withdrawn on 11.4.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter MANFUL STAR (H W Lai).  Before being allowed to race again, GOLDEN CHOPSTICKS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
WHISTLE UP began awkwardly and then shortly after the start was steadied away from the heels of GOLDEN DEER which shifted in.
CAREFREE LET GO shifted out at the start and bumped CALL ME AWESOME.  When being ridden along, CAREFREE LET GO (Apprentice H T Mo) then shifted out further, resulting in CALL ME AWESOME and MANFUL STAR being crowded for room inside GRACYDAD.  Apprentice Mo was advised that in similar circumstances he would be expected to react quicker than he did on this occasion to his mounts shifting ground and not to be riding them along.
From the outside barriers, GOLDEN DEER and DOUBLE DOUBLE were shifted across behind runners shortly after the start.
Shortly after the start, SUNNY ORIENT was steadied when crowded for room between GRACYDAD and MANFUL STAR which shifted out after beginning awkwardly.
STARLIGHT was steadied and shifted across to obtain cover in the early stages.
Making the turn at the 1000 Metres, STARLIGHT was steadied away from the heels of GOLDEN DEER (K C Leung) which shifted in when not properly clear.  K C Leung was reprimanded.
Passing the 1000 Metres, MANFUL STAR became unbalanced and shifted out towards RAICHU.
After the 1000 Metres, KWAICHUNG BROTHERS got its head up when travelling keenly and awkwardly placed close to the heels of PRINCE HARMONY.
Making the turn near the 550 Metres, RAICHU got its head on the side and shifted out.  After this, RAICHU commenced to give ground abruptly, resulting in GOLDEN DEER, which was racing tight to the inside of RAICHU, being hampered and losing ground.  STARLIGHT, which was following GOLDEN DEER, shifted out abruptly away from the heels of that horse.  RAICHU, which travelled wide and without cover throughout the race, then continued to give ground abruptly and finished tailed out.  The performance of RAICHU was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, RAICHU will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
PRINCE HARMONY lay out rounding the Home Turn.
Passing the 250 Metres, CAREFREE LET GO and KWAICHUNG BROTHERS bumped.
Approaching the 200 Metres, GRACYDAD shifted in and made contact with PRINCE HARMONY.  Then near the 50 Metres, GRACYDAD again shifted in marginally and brushed PRINCE HARMONY.  Over the concluding stages, PRINCE HARMONY and GRACYDAD continued to race tight.
When questioned, K Teetan stated that STARLIGHT travelled reasonably well in the early and middle stages, but after losing momentum near the 500 Metres appeared to lose confidence and then did not finish off the race.  A veterinary inspection of STARLIGHT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
After the race, C Schofield (KWAICHUNG BROTHERS) was unable to offer any explanation for the horseâs disappointing performance.  He said from the inside barrier KWAICHUNG BROTHERS was able to obtain a good run behind the leaders and was shifted to the outside of GRACYDAD into clear running near the 400 Metres.  He said KWAICHUNG BROTHERS came under pressure in the early part of the Straight, did not close off the race and was disappointing.  A veterinary inspection of KWAICHUNG BROTHERS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PRINCE HARMONY and GRACYDAD were sent for sampling.

As the start was effected, GOLDEN ACHIEVER bounded in the air and then landed very awkwardly, resulting in its rider, N Callan, becoming badly unbalanced.  GOLDEN ACHIEVER was then steadied when crowded for room between CASA MASTER and VICTORY FOLLOW ME which was taken in by FORMULA GALORE.
Shortly after the start, FAIR COMMENT raced tight between DON WONGCHOY and CASH COURIER, both of which shifted ground.
From wide barriers, VICTORY FOLLOW ME and EXCELLENCE were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, CASA MASTER got its head up on a number of occasions when awkwardly placed close to the heels of CASH COURIER.
Passing the 900 Metres, CASA MASTER shifted out to improve its position and after this travelled wide and without cover.
When endeavouring to improve into tight running between FAIR COMMENT and NEWSWIRE FREE passing the 700 Metres, CASH COURIER raced tight between those horses and then near the 650 Metres was steadied when unable to maintain its position outside FAIR COMMENT which shifted out marginally when awkwardly placed close to the heels of SMART UNION.
Passing the 500 Metres, GOLDEN ACHIEVER was steadied after attempting to improve between FAIR COMMENT and SCARBOROUGH FAIR where there was insufficient room.
Near the 300 Metres, SPINNING DANCER and SMART UNION raced tight.
Passing the 250 Metres, GOLDEN ACHIEVER was shifted to the inside of SCARBOROUGH FAIR after being disappointed for running between that horse and FAIR COMMENT.
NEWSWIRE FREE lost its right hind plate after the 100 Metres.
Close to the finishing line, SCARBOROUGH FAIR was checked away from the heels of SPINNING DANCER which shifted in marginally.  Consequently SCARBOROUGH FAIR was not able to be ridden out to the end of the race.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that DON WONGCHOY had sustained an overreach wound to the inside of the right front heel.
When questioned regarding the performance of EXCELLENCE, Z Purton stated that after shifting out to follow CASA MASTER when that horse improved after the 900 Metres, he shifted EXCELLENCE out from behind CASA MASTER to continue improving passing the 700 Metres.  He said EXCELLENCE came under pressure after the 600 Metres and then gave ground.  He said whilst EXCELLENCE was disappointing, the horse had to cover some ground during the race.  A veterinary inspection of EXCELLENCE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of NEWSWIRE FREE and CASH COURIER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
VICTORY FOLLOW ME, FORMULA GALORE and SPINNING DANCER were sent for sampling.
<13/4/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>The Clinical Veterinary Surgeon reported that FAIR COMMENT had a sore right eye on the morning after racing.

race_name: THE INDIAN RECREATION CLUB CHALLENGE CUP (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
SMART DELIGHT was withdrawn on 11.4.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter VICTOR EMPEROR (U Rispoli).  Before being allowed to race again, SMART DELIGHT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
As the start was effected, BRIGHT STAR, which was fractious in the barriers, bounded in the air and then became badly unbalanced for a number of strides, resulting in the horse losing a significant amount of ground.  Before being allowed to race again, BRIGHT STAR will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.
ELITE EXPRESS shifted out at the start and bumped FINE WITH ME.  A short distance later, FINE WITH ME was steadied when crowded for room between ST YAZIN and ELITE EXPRESS which was taken out by CONTRIBUTION.
From wide barriers, CONFUCIUS SPIRIT and COUR VALANT were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
SILVER SPUN got its head on the side and lay out making the turn after the 1000 Metres.
VICTOR EMPEROR was badly held up for clear running from on straightening until near the 50 Metres and consequently was not able to be fully tested.
Passing the 150 Metres, FINE WITH ME shifted out and brushed ST YAZIN.
For the majority of the race, BUMBLE BABY travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of SALSA BROTHERS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CONTRIBUTION, FINE WITH ME and GAME OF FUN were sent for sampling.

PERPETUAL JOYANCE and STARTLING POWER bumped at the start.
