LETâS TAKE IT EASY began awkwardly and then was bumped on jumping by OUR HERO which shifted in.
Shortly after the start, VICTORY MACHINE, which was being steadied to obtain cover, was crowded for room between JUMBO HAPPINESS and OUR HERO, both of which shifted ground.
Also shortly after the start, BACK IN BLACK shifted out and bumped SPEEDY ACHIEVER.  SPEEDY ACHIEVER was then awkwardly placed outside BACK IN BLACK for a short distance after this.
From wide barriers, JUMBO HAPPINESS, AMAZING and CITY WINNER were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Making the turn near the 1000 Metres, BACK IN BLACK and SPEEDY ACHIEVER bumped, resulting in SPEEDY ACHIEVER being taken out onto LETâS TAKE IT EASY which was bumped and taken wider.  LETâS TAKE IT EASY was then steadied to obtain cover behind SPEEDY ACHIEVER which for the remainder of the race travelled wide and without cover.
MALMSTEEN got its head up and made the turn near the 900 Metres awkwardly.
Approaching the 250 Metres, MALMSTEEN raced tight inside PERPETUAL JOYANCE.
Approaching the 200 Metres, VICTORY MACHINE was shifted out away from the heels of STARTLING POWER which shifted in when giving ground.
Over the final 100 Metres, YOU READ MY MIND drifted out under pressure.
Close to the finishing line, MALMSTEEN shifted in and was straightened to prevent the horse from continuing to shift in and causing tightening to VICTORY MACHINE.
A veterinary inspection of SPEEDY ACHIEVER immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, SPEEDY ACHIEVER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination..
JUMBO HAPPINESS, PERPETUAL JOYANCE and YOU READ MY MIND were sent for sampling.

THE SYLPH shifted out abruptly at the start and made heavy contact with SHARP SAILOR which was crowded for room inside HAPPY ROCKY.  In this incident, HAPPY ROCKY became unbalanced after being bumped on a number of occasions by SHARP SAILOR.
AMAZING GOLD, ANDOYAS and HAPPY CONTENDER were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
For some distance after the start, RICKFIELD got its head up when being steadied to obtain cover.
Passing the 2100 Metres, WHITE MAGIC got its head up when being steadied to obtain cover.
K C Leung (AMAZING GOLD) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that passing the 400 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of THE SYLPH, causing that horse to be checked and to lose the running to which it was rightfully entitled.  K C Leung was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Thursday, 20 April 2017 and to expire on Monday, 24 April 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards took into account Jockey Leungâs good race riding record.
Passing the 100 Metres, M Chadwick (JOLLY GENE) dropped his whip.
Also passing the 100 Metres, INDUSTRIALIST WAY was steadied when disappointed for running between SHARP SAILOR which initially shifted out and ANDOYAS which shifted in under pressure.
For the majority of the race, ENORMOUS HONOUR travelled wide and without cover and in the Straight gave ground.
After the race, C Y Ho stated that WORKS OF ART came under pressure after the 800 Metres and then, despite being ridden along, continued to give ground for the remainder of the race.  A veterinary inspection of WORKS OF ART immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of WORKS OF ART was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, WORKS OF ART will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of THE SYLPH immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ANDOYAS and HAPPY CONTENDER were sent for sampling.

HEALTHY LUCK shifted in at the start and bumped POWERMAX.
BEAR RAPPER began only fairly.
BLAZE STAMINA was slow to begin and then from a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners shortly after the start.
Also from a wide barrier, TRAVEL DATUK was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Making the turn approaching the 1000 Metres, BEAR RAPPER got its head on the side and lay in away from LOTUS BREEZE, resulting in APACHE SPIRIT being crowded for room.  APACHE SPIRIT was then checked when BEAR RAPPER was taken in further by LOTUS BREEZE (N Rawiller).  When APACHE SPIRIT was checked, that horse shifted out, resulting in LUCKY DAY being crowded for room inside WILD BOY.  As the Stewards were comfortably satisfied that BEAR RAPPER had contributed significantly to the incident by initially shifting in and crowding the racing room of APACHE SPIRIT, they could not be satisfied to the necessary degree that N Rawillerâs action in allowing LOTUS BREEZE to shift in after this had been the principal cause of the incident.  Accordingly, no further action was taken other than to advise N Rawiller to ensure that he leaves comfortable racing room for runners to his inside in similar circumstances.
After the 800 Metres, HO HO HORSE got its head on the side, lay out and was reluctant to shift back in to race closer to the leader HEALTHY LUCK.  HO HO HORSE then made the Home Turn awkwardly, causing LOTUS BREEZE to be taken wider.  After this, HO HO HORSE gave ground.
Passing the 250 Metres, H W Lai (HAPPY LIFE) dropped his whip.
For the majority of the race, LUCKY DAY travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of BLAZE STAMINA, HO HO HORSE and BEAR RAPPER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HEALTHY LUCK and POWERMAX were sent for sampling.
<13/4/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>BLAZE STAMINA, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  BLAZE STAMINA was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer A S Cruz this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to have a swollen right eye.

SANTA FE SUN was withdrawn on 11.4.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and was replaced by first Standby Declared Starter CALIFORNIA DISEGNO (N Callan).  SMART DRAGON was also withdrawn on 11.4.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and was replaced by second Standby Declared Starter WINNIEâS HONEY (M Chadwick).  Before being allowed to race again, SANTA FE SUN and SMART DRAGON will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
INVENTOR shifted out at the start and bumped TWIN DELIGHT.
MIGHTY MAVERICK shifted out at the start and bumped WHAT ELSE BUT YOU.  After this, WHAT ELSE BUT YOU was ridden along, however, failed to muster speed and a short distance after the start was shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.  K Teetan explained that he had been instructed that if WHAT ELSE BUT YOU began well and was able to take up a forward position, then he should do so, however, if the horse did not begin well, having regard that there were a number of horses better drawn than WHAT ELSE BUT YOU which would show speed, he was advised to shift across behind runners to obtain cover.
From the outside barrier, RODRICO was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Also from a wide barrier, SUPER TURBO was steadied in the early stages to obtain cover.
INVENTOR lost its right front plate after the 900 Metres.
Passing the 300 Metres, WINNIEâS HONEY, which was commencing to give ground, was bumped by BABA MAMA which in turn was taken wider by SUPER TURBO which shifted out to improve.  A veterinary inspection of WINNIEâS HONEY immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its right front leg.  The performance of WINNIEâS HONEY, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, WINNIEâS HONEY will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
INVENTOR was held up for clear running behind MIGHTY MAVERICK passing the 250 Metres and after the 200 Metres was shifted to the inside of that horse to improve.
Throughout the race, BABA MAMA travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of CALIFORNIA DISEGNO immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
WINNERâS WAY and JOLLY BANNER were sent for sampling.
<13/4/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>CALIFORNIA DISEGNO, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  CALIFORNIA DISEGNO was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer A S Cruz this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to have sustained a left front tendon injury.  Before being allowed to race again, CALIFORNIA DISEGNO will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

ELEGANCE PROMISE, which proved difficult to load, will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test before being allowed to race again.
LUCKY REIGN began only fairly.
CONFUCIUS WARRIOR was slow to begin and then shortly after the start was steadied away from the heels of LUCKY MASTER which shifted out after being bumped by RIVERSIDE BIRD.
Throughout the race, AMUSING CITY lay in and passing the 400 Metres shifted in and bumped CONFUCIUS WARRIOR, causing both horses to become unbalanced.  CONFUCIUS WARRIOR again shifted out and made further contact with AMUSING CITY passing the 350 Metres.
Passing the 200 Metres, CONFUCIUS WARRIOR and AMUSING CITY raced tight.
A veterinary inspection of LUCKY REIGN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CONFUCIUS WARRIOR, AMUSING CITY and LUCKY MASTER were sent for sampling.

WUSHU CHAMPION bounded in the air as the start was effected, resulting in the horse losing a considerable amount of ground and its rider, D Whyte, becoming unbalanced.  Before being allowed to race again, WUSHU CHAMPION will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.
STARSHIP was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
Near the 1250 Metres, XINJIANG YARN was steadied away from the heels of CONVINCIBLE.
BRING IT ON lost its left front plate after the 800 Metres.
Throughout the race, CONVINCIBLE travelled wide and without cover and passing the 500 Metres got its head on the side and lay out.
Near the 450 Metres, BRING IT ON shifted out and bumped VICTORY DAY.
Passing the 450 Metres, VOLITATION and TOP LAURELS raced tight as VOLITATION shifted to the outside of HIGH AND MIGHTY.
Apprentice M F Poon (CONVINCIBLE) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that passing the 350 Metres he permitted his mount to shift out, resulting in BRING IT ON being crowded for room and taken out onto VICTORY DAY which was severely checked when crowded for room between BRING IT ON and WORLD RECORD.  XINJIANG YARN, which was following VICTORY DAY, was checked and blundered after striking the heels of SUNNY WAY, resulting in its rider, K C Ng, almost being dislodged.  WUSHU CHAMPION, which was following XINJIANG YARN, was shifted out abruptly from behind that horse.  Having regard to the fact that Apprentice Poon is not currently approved to ride at Happy Valley, the Stewards decided that the appropriate penalty was for his licence to ride in races to be suspended for a period to commence on Sunday, 7 May 2017 and to expire on Sunday, 14 May 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  During this period, there are two racemeetings scheduled to be conducted at Sha Tin Racecourse.
SMILING CHARM momentarily raced tight inside HIGH AND MIGHTY near the 250 Metres.
A veterinary inspection of CONVINCIBLE, TOP LAURELS, VICTORY DAY and WUSHU CHAMPION immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
WORLD RECORD, SUNNY WAY and LUCKY DOUBLE EIGHT were sent for sampling.

BRILLIANT MONKEYS began awkwardly and then was crowded for room between SUPERNATURAL and HAPPY BEAUTY, both of which shifted ground.  This resulted in BRILLIANT MONKEYS racing back in the field.  After this, despite being hard ridden, SUPERNATURAL failed to muster speed.
Also despite being vigorously ridden in the early stages, AMBITIOUS SPEEDY was slow to muster speed.
Approaching the 1100 Metres, REWARDING FLYER raced tight between WINNING BOY and YOURTHEWONFORME.
Passing the 1100 Metres, SPARKLING TALENT got its head up when racing keenly and being checked away from the heels of GOLDEN GLORY which travelled wide and without cover throughout the race.  When giving ground in the Straight, GOLDEN GLORY got its head on the side and hung out.  A veterinary inspection of GOLDEN GLORY immediately following the race found that horse to have sustained a small cut to the outside of the left hind pastern.  The performance of GOLDEN GLORY, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, GOLDEN GLORY will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After the 700 Metres, YOUNG DREAMER lay out.  YOUNG DREAMER continued to lay out rounding the Home Turn and in the early part of the Straight drifted out under pressure.
N Callan (AMAZING ALWAYS) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that over the concluding stages he permitted his mount to shift out across the rightful running of YOUNG DREAMER, causing that horse to be hampered and to lose the running to which it was rightfully entitled.  N Callan was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 23 April 2017 and to expire on Thursday, 27 April 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, N Callan was fined $22,500.
Passing the 100 Metres, YOUNG DREAMER raced tight inside the heels of YOURTHEWONFORME.
AMAZING ALWAYS lost its right front plate after the race.
After the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on SPARKLING TALENT at the request of Trainer C S Shum.  The Veterinary Surgeon reported that this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, SPARKLING TALENT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of WINNING BOY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
REWARDING FLYER, AMAZING ALWAYS and YOURTHEWONFORME were sent for sampling.
<18/4/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>GOLDEN GLORY, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time the horse had sustained a small cut to the outside of the left hind pastern.  GOLDEN GLORY was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer T P Yung this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to have sustained a wound to the left hind pastern with associated swelling and lameness.  As previously advised, GOLDEN GLORY will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.

As the start was effected, ELUSIVE STATE lifted its front feet off the ground and consequently was slow to begin.  After this, from a wide barrier, ELUSIVE STATE was shifted across behind runners.
Also from the outside barrier, BEST EFFORT was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Shortly after the start, KING BOUNTIFUL raced tight between GORGEOUS AGAIN and COOL AND NEAT.
FANCY MUSIC shifted out shortly after the start and bumped PO CHING TREASURE.
KING BOUNTIFUL lost its left front plate near the 1750 Metres.
After the 1500 Metres, CHIU CHOW KID was left racing wide and without cover and was consequently allowed to stride forward to race outside the lead near the 1100 Metres.
Passing the 1400 Metres, KINGâS MAN was awkwardly placed close to the heels of PO CHING TREASURE.
Passing the 900 Metres, KINGâS MAN was steadied away from the heels of PO CHING TREASURE.
For the majority of the race, FLYING MACHINE travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, S Clipperton (COOL AND NEAT) stated that in the early stages he was able to obtain a trialing position behind FLYING MACHINE three wide.  He said considering that COOL AND NEAT had drawn barrier 10, he was comfortable with this position and intended to maintain the position behind FLYING MACHINE in the early and middle stages.  He said however that after the 1300 Metres FLYING MACHINE was steadied in an attempt to obtain cover which had the effect of coming back onto COOL AND NEAT.  He said as the tempo of the race at this time was not fast, he formed the view that the race may develop into a âsit sprintâ which would not be in COOL AND NEATâs best interests, therefore he elected to allow COOL AND NEAT to improve around FLYING MACHINE and was able to obtain a position behind the leaders one horse off the rail when ASHKIYR shifted in to race on the rail passing the 1000 Metres.
After the race, N Callan was unable to offer any explanation for the disappointing performance of KINGâS MAN.  A veterinary inspection of KINGâS MAN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of CHIU CHOW KID immediately following the race found that horse to be distressed.  Before being allowed to race again, CHIU CHOW KID will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
KINGâS MAN, GORGEOUS AGAIN and FANCY MUSIC were sent for sampling.
<18/4/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>The Clinical Veterinary Surgeon reported that COOL AND NEAT was lame in its right hind leg on the morning after racing.  Before being allowed to race again, COOL AND NEAT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

CLEVER SPIRIT began awkwardly and lost ground.
BOSSIEE was slow to begin.
LE PANACHE began only fairly.
From the outside barrier, DIAMOND MYSTERIOUS was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 600 Metres, WINNING CONTROLLER was steadied away from the heels of MR ORIOLE which shifted in marginally when racing tight inside VITAL SPRING.  NOBLE DE BOY, which was following, shifted out away from the heels of WINNING CONTROLLER, resulting in BOSSIEE momentarily racing tight inside ADMIRABLE.
Near the 450 Metres, MR ORIOLE broke down in the left front leg and fell, resulting in its rider, N Rawiller, being dislodged.  NOBLE DE BOY, which was following, was severely checked in consequence, resulting in its rider, K Teetan, being dislodged.  CLEVER SPIRIT was unable to avoid the fallen MR ORIOLE and blundered, resulting in its rider, C Y Ho, also being dislodged.  WINNING CONTROLLER, which was following MR ORIOLE, was severely checked in consequence.  Also badly hampered in this incident was BOSSIEE which blundered when unable to avoid the fallen MR ORIOLE.  LE PANACHE and DIAMOND MYSTERIOUS were also badly hampered in consequence.  After this incident, K Teetan was examined by the Clubâs doctors and passed fit to fulfil his remaining race riding engagements.  N Rawiller and C Y Ho were also examined by the Clubâs doctors and stood down from their remaining race riding engagements.
Throughout the race, VITAL SPRING travelled wide and without cover.
The Stewards opened and immediately adjourned an inquiry into the reason for NOBLE DE BOY being checked after the 1100 Metres.  Further, the Stewards opened and immediately adjourned an inquiry into the reason for WINNING CONTROLLER and MR ORIOLE being hampered near the 1050 Metres.  These inquiries were adjourned due to N Rawiller, the rider of MR ORIOLE, being unable to be present to give evidence after being transported to hospital.
A veterinary inspection of NOBLE DE BOY immediately following the race found that horse to be a âroarerâ.
A veterinary inspection of WINNING CONTROLLER, CLEVER SPIRIT and BOSSIEE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
LONDON CITY and MULTIGOGO were sent for sampling.  Samples were also taken from MR ORIOLE.
<24/5/2017  Adjourned Inquiries â 17 April 2017 Sha Tin Racemeeting â Race 4 (574)>
The Stewards tonight concluded two inquiries which were adjourned due to Jockey N Rawiller having to be transported to hospital as a result of a fall from MR ORIOLE rounding the Home Turn.

N Rawiller pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that passing the 1100 Metres he permitted MR ORIOLE to shift in when not clear of WINNING CONTROLLER, resulting in that horse being taken in onto NOBLE DE BOY which was severely checked and lost the running to which it was rightfully entitled. In the unique circumstances of this case, the Stewards, having regard to the fact that Jockey Rawiller has not ridden since this racemeeting and is not likely to resume race riding in the immediate future, believed it appropriate for him to be severely reprimanded rather than any period of suspension or monetary penalty being imposed. N Rawiller was however advised that this was the 7th occasion during this current season that he had breached the careless riding Rule and he was further advised that this aspect of his riding would need to be addressed should it be that he is granted a licence to ride by the Club next season.

A short distance after this incident near the 1050 Metres, as N Rawiller attempted to direct MR ORIOLE out to relieve the tightening to WINNING CONTROLLER and NOBLE DE BOY, MR ORIOLE had to be steadied away from the heels of MULTIGOGO (M Chadwick) which had shifted in to take up the room left as a result of MR ORIOLE shifting inwards. M Chadwick was advised that whilst the circumstances leading up to this incident had been beyond his control, nonetheless he was severely reprimanded and told to ensure that he is properly clear of other runners when shifting ground.

ROMAN IMPERO was withdrawn on 16.4.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (haematoma in right hind) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter UNLEASHED DRAGON (D Whyte).  Before being allowed to race again, ROMAN IMPERO will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
LAUGH OUT LOUD was very slow to begin and consequently lost a considerable amount of ground.  Before being allowed to race again, LAUGH OUT LOUD will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.
As the start was effected, MASSIVE MILLENNIUM, which was fractious in the barriers, reared abruptly, resulting in the horse losing a considerable amount of ground.  Before being allowed to race again, MASSIVE MILLENNIUM will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.
RAGING BULL began awkwardly.
BELOVED and ROBUST MOMENTUM bumped at the start.
WINGOLD began awkwardly, got its head up and then became unbalanced after being bumped by SPICY KAKA which shifted out.  Also at the start, UNBEATABLE GUTS, which was drawn outside WINGOLD, made contact with HAPPY AND HEALTHY (Apprentice M F Poon) which shifted in, causing both horses to become unbalanced and which resulted in HAPPY AND HEALTHY being turned in across UNBEATABLE GUTS as a result of being bumped on the hindquarters by that horse.  A short distance after the start, UNBEATABLE GUTS blundered badly when crowded for room between HAPPY AND HEALTHY and WINGOLD which continued to race tight outside SPICY KAKA.  When UNBEATABLE GUTS blundered, its rider, Apprentice H T Mo, was dislodged.  As the Stewards were satisfied that incident occurred as a result of both WINGOLD and HAPPY AND HEALTHY shifting ground, no further action was taken, however, Apprentice Poon was told to do what he can in similar circumstances to relieve any tightening to other runners.  After this incident, Apprentice Mo was examined by the Clubâs doctors and passed fit to fulfil his remaining race riding engagements.  The Veterinary Officer subsequently reported that UNBEATABLE GUTS had sustained a cut to the outside of the left front heel and lost its left front plate during this incident.
Near the 1350 Metres, CITY LEGEND shifted in and bumped WIN FOR CHARITY.  BELOVED, which was being ridden along to obtain a forward position, was inconvenienced in consequence.
Approaching the 1300 Metres, MERRYGOWIN and ROBUST MOMENTUM raced tight between BELOVED and SPICY KAKA which shifted in.
Passing the 1300 Metres, MERRYGOWIN was awkwardly placed outside the heels of ROBUST MOMENTUM.
Near the 1250 Metres, SPICY KAKA was hampered by the riderless UNBEATABLE GUTS which shifted in.
Making the turn at the 900 Metres, WINGOLD got its head on the side, shifted out and bumped SPICY KAKA.
Passing the 800 Metres, MERRYGOWIN was awkwardly placed close to the heels of RAGING BULL which was steadied to obtain cover behind UNLEASHED DRAGON.  HAPPY AND HEALTHY, which was following MERRYGOWIN, commenced to travel keenly and near the 750 Metres shifted out abruptly away from the heels of MERRYGOWIN and bumped WIN FOR CHARITY, causing both horses to become unbalanced.
Near the 650 Metres, HAPPY AND HEALTHY was bumped by MERRYGOWIN which shifted out.
Passing the 600 Metres, AH BO was awkwardly placed close to the heels of BELOVED.
For some distance approaching and passing the 600 Metres, WINGOLD got its head on the side and shifted out towards the heels of MERRYGOWIN.  Then for some distance approaching and passing the 500 Metres, WINGOLD got its head up when proving very difficult to manage and was checked away from the heels of MERRYGOWIN.  The racing manners of WINGOLD were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, WINGOLD will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial around a bend.
After the 900 Metres, CITY LEGEND was left racing wide and without cover.
MASSIVE MILLENNIUM had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Near the 350 Metres, MERRYGOWIN shifted out and brushed SPICY KAKA.
Passing the 200 Metres, RAGING BULL momentarily raced tight between AH BO which shifted out and WINGOLD which was awkwardly placed inside the heels of MERRYGOWIN.
The performance of ROBUST MOMENTUM, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, ROBUST MOMENTUM will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of RAGING BULL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
HAPPY AND HEALTHY and CITY LEGEND were sent for sampling.

COLOURFUL ACHIEVER shifted out on jumping and bumped SICHUAN BOSS, causing COLOURFUL ACHIEVER to become badly unbalanced.
THOR THE GREATEST shifted out on jumping and took TANG FLEMING out onto MYTHICAL EMPEROR which began awkwardly.
CHUNG WAH SPIRIT began only fairly and then shortly after the start was awkwardly placed close to the heels of WINSTONâS LAD.
From the outside barrier, RAPHAEL was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the 950 Metres, COLOURFUL ACHIEVER was checked when crowded for room between CHUNG WAH SPIRIT and SICHUAN BOSS which got its head on the side and shifted in away from MYTHICAL EMPEROR.  As the Stewards believed the racing manners of SICHUAN BOSS were responsible for this incident, no further action was taken.
Making the turn near the 900 Metres, after being bumped on the hindquarters by COLOURFUL ACHIEVER, CHUNG WAH SPIRIT got its head on the side and shifted out.
K C Leung (THOR THE GREATEST) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 900 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of HAPPY BAO BEI, causing that horse to be checked and to lose the running to which it was rightfully entitled.  DIEGO KOSTA, which was following HAPPY BAO BEI, was hampered in consequence.  K C Leung was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 10 May 2017 and to expire on Sunday, 14 May 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, K C Leung was fined $45,000.
Approaching the 800 Metres, TANG FLEMING was taken wider by IâM A WITNESS which shifted out away from HAPPY BAO BEI when that horse was checked.  After this, IâM A WITNESS and TANG FLEMING raced wide and without cover.
Passing the 650 Metres, WINSTONâS LAD raced tight inside PRIMERO which was awkwardly placed inside the heels of IâM A WITNESS.
Passing the 500 Metres and again in the early part of the Straight, CHUNG WAH SPIRIT was awkwardly placed close to the heels of PRIMERO.
IâM A WITNESS got its head on the side and lay out rounding the Home Turn.
Passing the 250 Metres, CHUNG WAH SPIRIT was momentarily held up for clear running when awkwardly placed outside the heels of WINSTONâS LAD which a short distance later was held up for clear running between DIEGO KOSTA and HAPPY BAO BEI.
A veterinary inspection of DIEGO KOSTA and IâM A WITNESS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MYTHICAL EMPEROR, THOR THE GREATEST and WINSTONâS LAD were sent for sampling.

PAKISTAN BABY lifted its front feet off the ground as the start was effected and consequently was slow to begin.
HAIR TRIGGER began only fairly and was then bumped by THE JUDGE which shifted in.
STAR OF JOY shifted out at the start and bumped MORETHANLUCKY.
THE JUDGE and RIGHT HONOURABLE were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
THE JUDGE lay out making the turn near the 900 Metres.
Passing the 900 Metres, MORETHANLUCKY got its head on the side, shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of MR PICASSO which became unbalanced.
Rounding the Home Turn, LOOK ERAS became unbalanced after being bumped by MOST BEAUTIFUL (Apprentice K K Chiong) which lay in.  STAR OF JOY, which was following, was inconvenienced in consequence.  Apprentice Chiong was reprimanded and advised that she would be expected to make every endeavour to afford horses racing to her inside comfortable racing room.  When MOST BEAUTIFUL was shifted out to relieve the tightening to LOOK ERAS, MONEY BOY was directed out away from the heels of MOST BEAUTIFUL.
As STAR OF JOY was being shifted to the inside of MOST BEAUTIFUL in an attempt to obtain clear running after the 400 Metres, MOST BEAUTIFUL, which was commencing to give ground, shifted in under pressure, resulting in STAR OF JOY having to be checked when disappointed for running between MOST BEAUTIFUL and LOOK ERAS which was also giving ground.  As STAR OF JOY had not established running to the inside of MOST BEAUTIFUL, the Stewards took no further action other than to reprimand Apprentice Chiong and advise her that in similar circumstances she would be expected to do more to prevent her mount from shifting ground than she did on this occasion.  HAIR TRIGGER, which was following STAR OF JOY, was shifted out away from the heels of that horse in consequence after being held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Passing the 250 Metres, MORETHANLUCKY was momentarily held up for clear running behind MR PICASSO which shifted in marginally.
Passing the 200 Metres, STAR OF JOY was again disappointed for running between MOST BEAUTIFUL and LOOK ERAS which were continuing to give ground.  Consequently STAR OF JOY was not able to be tested until passing the 150 Metres.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of MOST BEAUTIFUL, Apprentice K K Chiong stated that as instructed she allowed her mount to stride forward in the early stages. . She said passing the 900 Metres she felt as though LOOK ERAS, which was racing to the inside of MOST BEAUTIFUL, was being steadied and therefore she allowed her mount to improve forward of that horse with a view to crossing to the rail.  She said however that LOOK ERAS continued to maintain its position inside MOST BEAUTIFUL after the 800 Metres and as the tempo of the race at this stage was strong, she desisted in attempting to cross that horse and remained racing to the outside of LOOK ERAS.  She said MOST BEAUTIFUL came under pressure in the early part of the Straight and after the 300 Metres commenced to give ground and weakened over the concluding stages.  A veterinary inspection of MOST BEAUTIFUL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of MOST BEAUTIFUL, a favourite for todayâs race and which finished last, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, MOST BEAUTIFUL will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of MORETHANLUCKY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MOST BEAUTIFUL, LUCKY GUY and PAKISTAN BABY were sent for sampling.

LINE SEEKER shifted out at the start and bumped the hindquarters of BLOCKER DEE.
KEY WITNESS was crowded for room on jumping between MAGIC LEGEND and TURF SPRINT which shifted out despite the efforts of its rider.
Form a wide barrier, RACING SUPERNOVA was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 700 Metres, TURF SPRINT got its head on the side and lay out and then near the 650 Metres was taken wider by LINE SEEKER which shifted out.
Near the 650 Metres, BLOCKER DEE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of MAGIC LEGEND.
HOUSE OF FUN lay out in the middle stages.
Passing the 400 Metres, STRATHMORE and LINE SEEKER raced tight as STRATHMORE shifted out into clear running.
Also passing the 400 Metres, HOUSE OF FUN and VERBINSKY bumped.
RACING SUPERNOVA was held up for clear running until passing the 300 Metres.
Throughout the race, PABLOSKY travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of VERBINSKY and HOUSE OF FUN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MAGIC LEGEND and STRATHMORE were sent for sampling.

ISHVARA shifted out at the start, resulting in FULL GLORY being taken out onto EASY HEDGE which was hampered.  After this, from a wide barrier, EASY HEDGE was shifted across behind runners.
ROYAL PERFORMER was crowded for room on jumping between RAZOR QUEST which shifted out and PENANG HALL which shifted in despite the efforts of its rider.
FULL GLORY lost its left front plate at the start.
Approaching the 1400 Metres, RULE THEE was steadied when crowded for room inside GO BEAUTY GO which was taken in by PENANG HALL which was crowded for room inside RATTAN when that horse was taken in by SUNNY WIN (K C Leung) which, after initially shifting in, was then directed out to relieve the tightening to runners to its inside.  When SUNNY WIN was shifted out to relieve the tightening, it bumped with CHEERFUL BOY which was also shifting in.  K C Leung was severely reprimanded and advised to ensure that he leaves sufficient racing room for other runners in similar circumstances.
CLOUD NINE raced wide and without cover until after the 700 Metres.
PENANG HALL was held up for clear running until passing the 300 Metres.
Passing the 200 Metres, the whip of Z Purton (GO BEAUTY GO) was knocked from his grasp by the whip of Apprentice H T Mo (CHEERFUL BOY).
After the 200 Metres, RATTAN got its head on the side and lay out under pressure.
After the race, K C Leung reported that after having to make use of SUNNY WIN in the early stages to clear runners to its inside, the horse then did not close off the race and weakened in the Straight.  A veterinary inspection of SUNNY WIN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
When questioned, Apprentice K K Chiong stated that she had been asked to take up a forward position on HIGH VOLATILITY as it is somewhat one-paced and was successful when ridden in this manner at its last start.  She said however that HIGH VOLATILITY was slow to begin after being fractious in the barriers and this resulted in the horse settling at the tail of the field in the early stages.  She said after the 1200 Metres she was racing behind LITTLE ISLAND and inside CLOUD NINE and as she did not want HIGH VOLATILITY to be left flat-footed, she elected to improve around CLOUD NINE in the hope that she might be able to obtain a position in advance of that horse with some cover.  She added however that HIGH VOLATILITY was then required to race wide and without cover for the remainder of the event and consequently weakened.  A veterinary inspection of HIGH VOLATILITY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of GO BEAUTY GO immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PENANG HALL, RAZOR QUEST and ROYAL PERFORMER were sent for sampling.

LOYAL CRAFTSMAN began only fairly and then shortly after the start was steadied away from the heels of MY FOLKS which was taken out by STORM KID which shifted out after being bumped by HOLY UNICORN.
From wide barriers, TELEPHATIA and ALWAYS WONGCHOY were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
For some distance approaching the 1800 Metres, MY FOLKS proved very difficult to settle and got its head up when being checked away from the heels of MEDIC SWORDSMAN.  MY FOLKS then shifted out away from the heels of MEDIC SWORDSMAN and bumped CHARITY PLENTY.
Passing the 1700 Metres, CHEERFUL FRAME got its head up when being steadied to obtain cover.
Approaching the 1300 Metres, HOLY UNICORN and AUDACITY were taken wider by SWEET BEAN which shifted out away from the heels of STORM KID.  MY FOLKS, which was following AUDACITY, was awkwardly placed close to the heels of that horse in consequence.
Passing the 1100 Metres, AUDACITY raced tight inside the heels of HOLY UNICORN.
Rounding the Home Turn, AUDACITY was checked away from the heels of CHEERFUL FRAME after attempting to improve between that horse and HOLY UNICORN where there was insufficient room.  AUDACITY then shifted out and brushed HOLY UNICORN when obtaining tight running between those horses a short distance later.
Also rounding the Home Turn, STORM KID got its head up when being checked away from the heels of LUCKY SEBRING.  MEDIC SWORDSMAN and LOYAL CRAFTSMAN, which were following, were held up for clear running in consequence.
At the entrance to the Straight, TELEPHATIA became unbalanced after shifting out abruptly away from the heels of HOLY UNICORN.
Approaching the 250 Metres, SWEET BEAN was shifted out away from the heels of CHEERFUL FRAME which was giving ground.
LOYAL CRAFTSMAN was held up for clear running passing the 250 Metres.
For the majority of the race, HOLY UNICORN travelled wide and without cover.
AUDACITY and TELEPHATIA were sent for sampling.

DANEWIN EXPRESS began only fairly and shortly after the start bumped EASTERN PROWESS.
Shortly after the start, RED SUN shifted out and bumped AGIAAL.  Then from the outside barriers, both RED SUN and AGIAAL were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
PRECISIONCRAFTSMAN was also steadied shortly after the start to obtain cover.
Approaching the 700 Metres, EASTERN PROWESS got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of DANEWIN EXPRESS and shifted out.  EASTERN PROWESS consequently raced wide and without cover.
Passing the 300 Metres, MALAYAN PEARL was shifted in away from the heels of DASHING FORTUNE.
The performance of RED SUN, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, RED SUN will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of DOUBLE POINT immediately following the race found the horse to have blood present at the right nostril.  An endoscopic examination conducted on DOUBLE POINT confirmed the horse to be a bleeder.
MY BLESSING, AGIAAL and EASTERN PROWESS were sent for sampling.

RAINBOW FIGHTER began awkwardly.
SHOWING CHARACTER shifted in at the start and brushed RESPLENDENT GLORY.
HOT HOT PEPPER and NASHASHUK bumped on jumping.
From the outside barriers, GODSPEED, SHARPMIND, SEE ME NOW and PROUD SKY were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Making the turn near the 1050 Metres, RAINBOW FIGHTER raced tight between GREAT SKY and GODSPEED which got its head on the side and shifted in away from SHARPMIND.
N Callan (PACKING STARCRAFT) was fined $7,000 for weighing in 2 lbs overweight after the race.
A veterinary inspection of SHARPMIND immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
NASHASHUK, RESPLENDENT GLORY and SHOWING CHARACTER were sent for sampling.

SAKURA FIGHTER began awkwardly and lost ground.
FISH Nâ CHIPS (Apprentice H T Mo) began awkwardly and then shortly after the start was crowded for room between ROCKET LET WIN and BEST STEP which shifted out.  Apprentice Mo reported that in this incident his saddle shifted to the right, placing him at a significant disadvantage for the remainder of the race.  FISH Nâ CHIPS subsequently travelled wide and without cover throughout the race.
Passing the 500 Metres, JOYFUL FOREVER got its head on the side and lay out.
BEAUTY CONNECTION lost its right front plate after the race.
When questioned, M L Yeung stated that, from the outside barrier, he had been asked to ride LUNAR ZEPHYR in about a midfield position or just worse than midfield with cover if possible.  He said the connections had been somewhat disappointed by the manner in which LUNAR ZEPHYR had been finishing off its races when ridden for speed since arriving in Hong Kong and as the horse was drawn the outside barrier tonight and the race appeared to have a number of horses engaged in it which had previously shown natural early speed, it was felt that riding LUNAR ZEPHYR forward may lead to the horse being left racing very wide and consequently not being able to finish off the race.  He said in the early stages he attempted to obtain a position in midfield, however, passing the 800 Metres was left racing very wide and therefore he elected to steady LUNAR ZEPHYR and obtained a position closer to the rail which resulted in the horse racing well back in the field.  He said ridden more quietly tonight, LUNAR ZEPHYR was able to steadily make ground rounding the Home Turn and in the Straight closed off the race fairly.  He added, in his opinion, LUNAR ZEPHYR finished off the race better tonight than it did when he had ridden it in a prominent position on one previous occasion.
A veterinary inspection of BEAUTY CONNECTION immediately following the race found the horse to have sustained a small overreach wound to the left front heel.
BEAUTY CONNECTION, MR RIGHT and BEST STEP were sent for sampling.

WINASWEWISH lost ground when crowded for room on jumping between AMAZING FEELING and GREAT TREASURE which shifted in when being steadied to obtain cover from a wide barrier.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, GREAT TREASURE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of JOLLY AMBER.
Passing the 1400 Metres, GREAT JOY got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of SOUL ACHIEVER.  Then for some distance after the 1300 Metres, GREAT JOY continued to be awkwardly placed close to the heels of SOUL ACHIEVER.
S Clipperton (HALL OF FAME) pleaded not guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that approaching the 1300 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of GENTRY, resulting in that horse being checked when taken in onto the heels of GREAT JOY.  After having considered further submissions put by S Clipperton in answer to the charge, the Stewards did not believe in the circumstances that it was appropriate for the charge to be sustained.  In arriving at this decision, the Stewards found that HALL OF FAME, which had been racing ungenerously in the lead up to this incident, shifted in marginally and at the same time GREAT JOY, which was racing to the inside of GENTRY, was being steadied away from the heels of SOUL ACHIEVER.  As there were a number of circumstances associated with this incident, the Stewards believed that S Clipperton should be given the benefit of the doubt, however, he was reprimanded and told to ensure that he makes every endeavour to leave comfortable racing room for runners to his inside in similar circumstances.
After the 1300 Metres, HALL OF FAME improved into tight running between GREAT JOY and NEVER BETTER.
After the race, H W Lai (GREAT TREASURE) reported that his mount did not feel comfortable in its action.  A veterinary inspection of GREAT TREASURE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Before being allowed to race again, GREAT TREASURE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of WINASWEWISH immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GREAT JOY, AMAZING FEELING and MR KOOL were sent for sampling.

SWISS WARRIOR was withdrawn on 18.4.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore).  Before being allowed to race again, SWISS WARRIOR will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
HAPPY COOPERATION began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped WAYFOONG VINNIE which was crowded for room outside CIRCUIT KING.  Despite being aggressively ridden along in the early stages, CIRCUIT KING was slow to muster speed.
From the outside barrier, PEARL WARM WARM was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
HAPPY COOPERATION lost its left front plate near the 950 Metres.
Near the 650 Metres, TRIUMPHANT JEWEL was taken wider by HAPPY COOPERATION which shifted out and consequently travelled wide and without cover.
Close to the finishing line, HAPPY COOPERATION improved to be racing close to the heels of TRAVEL COMFORTS (Apprentice H T Mo) and blundered passing the winning post.  Consequently HAPPY COOPERATION was not able to be ridden out all the way to the end of the race.  As the Stewards were satisfied that at no stage had HAPPY COOPERATION improved to be racing outside the heels of TRAVEL COMFORTS, no further action was taken, however, Apprentice Mo was warned against the practice of allowing his mounts to shift ground under pressure.
TRIUMPHANT JEWEL lay out under pressure in the Straight and over the concluding stages raced tight between HAPPY COOPERATION and WAYFOONG VINNIE and consequently was not able to be properly tested.
After the race, B Prebble expressed concern about SMART DECLARATIONâs action.  A veterinary inspection of SMART DECLARATION immediately following the race found the horse to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, SMART DECLARATION will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on TRAVEL COMFORTS at the request of Trainer A T Millard.  The Veterinary Surgeon said this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, TRAVEL COMFORTS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of SMART BOY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
WAYFOONG VINNIE, TRAVEL COMFORTS and CIRCUIT KING were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE HONG KONG RUGBY UNION CUP (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
GENEROUS HEART was withdrawn on 19.4.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and was replaced by first Standby Declared Starter TIMELY ARRIVED (M L Yeung).  SUPER SPRINTER was also withdrawn on 19.4.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and was replaced by second Standby Declared Starter NUMERO UNO (J Moreira).  Before being allowed to race again, GENEROUS HEART and SUPER SPRINTER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Just prior to the start being effected, NUMERO UNO turned its head to the left and consequently was slow to begin.
From a wide barrier, IRON BOY was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Making the turn near the 1000 Metres, SUNNY DRAGON got its head up and shifted out abruptly across the heels of EXPERTO CREDE, resulting in SUNNY DRAGON losing ground.  NUMERO UNO, which was following SUNNY DRAGON, was inconvenienced in consequence.
MOMENT OF POWER raced wide and without cover until passing the 600 Metres.
A BEAUTIFUL had difficulty obtaining clear running approaching and passing the 200 Metres and again passing the 100 Metres.
Passing the 200 Metres, ALL GREAT FRIENDS and MULTIMAX raced tight.  Then passing the 150 Metres, MULTIMAX was inconvenienced when crowded for room between DIAMOND MASTER and ALL GREAT FRIENDS, both of which shifted marginally.
Also passing the 200 Metres, S Clipperton (EXPERTO CREDE) dropped his whip.
Near the 100 Metres, NUMERO UNO, which was closing off the race fairly, was steadied when disappointed for running inside MOMENT OF POWER which was weakening.
Throughout the race, TIMELY ARRIVED travelled wide and without cover and in the Straight gave ground.
A veterinary inspection of TIMELY ARRIVED immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
DIAMOND MASTER, ARM RUNDA and ALL GREAT FRIENDS were sent for sampling.

At declaration time, Z Purton was declared as the rider of both JADE FORTUNE and PHOTON WILLIE.  It was established that Z Purton had a firm commitment to ride JADE FORTUNE.  As such, the Stewards permitted K Teetan to be substituted as the rider of PHOTON WILLIE.  For this declaration error, Trainer P OâSullivan was fined $2,000.
FANTASTIC KAKA began only fairly and then lost ground when crowded for room between MY GIFT and YOUNG RANGER which shifted out.
From the outside barriers, PHOTON WILLIE and HERO LOOK were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
LITTERATEUR was also steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
Passing the 1400 Metres, FANTASTIC KAKA commenced to travel keenly and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of CHATER LEGEND.
YOUNG RANGER lost its right front plate approaching the winning position on the first occasion.
Near the 650 Metres, LAND GRANT was taken wider by WISKY which shifted to the outside of JADE FORTUNE.  After this, LAND GRANT travelled wide and without cover.
YOUNG RANGER made the Home Turn awkwardly.
At the entrance to the Straight, CHATER LEGEND shifted out and brushed LAND GRANT.
Also at the entrance to the Straight, YOUNG RANGER was directed in away from the heels of WISKY.
Approaching the 100 Metres, PHOTON WILLIE was directed out away from the heels of YOUNG RANGER to continue improving.
In the Straight, LAND GRANT lay in under pressure and passing the 100 Metres was awkwardly placed outside the heels of CHATER LEGEND when proving difficult to ride.
When questioned, H W Lai stated that he had been asked to ride THUNDER STOMP in about a midfield position with cover.  He said it was felt that there were a number of horses that would be ridden up on the speed and were he to ride THUNDER STOMP positively, that horse may be left racing wide.  He said in accordance with his instructions he steadied THUNDER STOMP in the early stages as LAND GRANT, which was racing directly to the inside of THUNDER STOMP, was being ridden along to obtain a forward position.  He said as he shifted across to race behind LAND GRANT, MY GIFT maintained its position one horse off the rail, resulting in THUNDER STOMP being left racing three wide.  He said he then steadied THUNDER STOMP further with a view to shifting in behind MY GIFT as he felt that he may be able to manoeuvre LITTERATEUR closer to the rail to allow THUNDER STOMP to obtain cover one horse off the rail behind MY GIFT.  He said however that LITTERATEUR maintained its position one horse off the rail and this resulted in THUNDER STOMP initially being very awkward on the heels of MY GIFT and then being left racing in a three wide position and much further back in the field that had been intended.  Prior to concluding this matter, the Stewards will interview Mr Y S Tsui, the trainer of THUNDER STOMP, prior to the Sha Tin racemeeting to be conducted on Sunday, 23 April 2017.  A veterinary inspection of THUNDER STOMP immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that PHOTON WILLIE was lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, PHOTON WILLIE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of FANTASTIC KAKA and AGREE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
JADE FORTUNE, CHATER LEGEND and WISKY were sent for sampling.
<23/4/2017 20 April 2017 Happy Valley Racemeeting â Race 8 (588)>The Stewards today questioned Mr Y S Tsui, the trainer of THUNDER STOMP, regarding the instructions he provided to H W Lai in this race.  Mr Tsui stated that when THUNDER STOMP was successful on 22 February 2017 when drawn barrier 1, the horse had to be ridden along vigorously to take advantage of its inside draw.  He said this demonstrated to him that THUNDER STOMP would not have sufficient early speed to cross LAND GRANT in this race as he anticipated that that horse would be ridden in a forward position, therefore he instructed Jockey Lai to obtain a position in about midfield if possible.  He said, apart from when THUNDER STOMP had drawn inside barriers, it had always been his instructions to riders for the horse to be ridden in about a midfield position.  He added when Jockey Lai steadied THUNDER STOMP in the early stages with a view to taking a trailing position behind LAND GRANT, this was in accordance with the manner in which he was instructed to ride the horse.  He said however MY GIFT was able to hold its position one horse off the rail in the early stages which resulted in THUNDER STOMP being left racing wide and he therefore accepted Jockey Laiâs decision to further steady THUNDER STOMP with a view to hopefully obtaining a position with cover.

Whilst in the saddling stalls, SHINING CHAMPION had its left front plate refitted.  SHINING CHAMPION was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
THUNDER DASH began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of JIMSON THE FAMOUS which became unbalanced.  This resulted in THUNDER DASH losing ground.
Shortly after the start, HAYMAKER and ALL TIMES LUCKY were crowded for room between CATCHMEIFYOUCAN and FAST ROCKET which began awkwardly and after initially being taken out by SOCCER BRAVE then got its head on the side and shifted out further away from that horse.  In this incident, CATCHMEIFYOUCAN became unbalanced after being bumped on the hindquarters by ALL TIMES LUCKY.
SHINING CHAMPION lost its left front plate shortly after the start.
Near the 650 Metres, FAST ROCKET was momentarily crowded for room inside CATCHMEIFYOUCAN (C Schofield) which shifted in.  C Schofield was advised to ensure that he leaves comfortable racing room for runners to his inside.
At the entrance to the Straight, CATCHMEIFYOUCAN became unbalanced when bumped on the hindquarters by JIMSON THE FAMOUS (Apprentice M F Poon) which shifted out.  Apprentice Poon was advised to exercise more care when shifting ground.
In the early part of the Straight, NO LAUGHING MATTER got its head on the side and hung in under pressure and near the 300 Metres was steadied away from the heels of ALL TIMES LUCKY which shifted out away from THUNDER DASH.
Passing the 300 Metres, CATCHMEIFYOUCAN was brushed by JIMSON THE FAMOUS which improved into tight running between CATCHMEIFYOUCAN and FORTUNE BROTHERS.
T H So (LE PEGASE) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 250 Metres he permitted his mount to shift out when not clear of SHINING CHAMPION, causing that horse to be hampered and to lose the running to which it was rightfully entitled and for HAYMAKER, which was racing to the outside of SHINING CHAMPION, to also be hampered..  T H So was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 30 April 2017 and to expire on Thursday, 4 May 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, T H So was fined $15,000.
Near the 200 Metres, HAYMAKER was steadied away from the heels of LE PEGASE (T H So) which shifted to the outside of CATCHMEIFYOUCAN to obtain clear running.  T H So was reprimanded and advised to exercise more care when shifting ground.  T H So explained that passing the 250 Metres he committed LE PEGASE to shift to the outside of CATCHMEIFYOUCAN because at that time a run did not exist between CATCHMEIFYOUCAN and JIMSON THE FAMOUS.  He said as he committed LE PEGASE to the outside of CATCHMEIFYOUCAN, that horse shifted out, resulting in LE PEGASE being awkwardly placed close to the heels of that horse, however, at this time he was unable to steady LE PEGASE and shift back in to improve between CATCHMEIFYOUCAN and JIMSON THE FAMOUS and for this reason he continued to shift out to obtain clear running.
A veterinary inspection of HAYMAKER and SOCCER BRAVE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SOCCER BRAVE, JIMSON THE FAMOUS and FORTUNE BROTHERS were sent for sampling.

After being loaded into the barriers, SUPER LEADER became fractious and made contact with the front gate.  SUPER LEADER was removed from the barriers and examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
HANGâS DECISION shifted out at the start and bumped SUPER LEADER.
DRAGON MASTER was crowded for room on jumping between NOTHINGILIKEMORE and BULLISH SMART, both of which shifted ground.
HEALTHY JOYFUL began very awkwardly, shifted out abruptly and hampered BIG FLASH.  After this, HEALTHY JOYFUL was ridden along for a short distance, however, when caught very wide was steadied passing the 1300 Metres and shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
From the outside barrier, JOLLY JOLLY was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
WHO DAT SINGA was also shifted across behind runners to obtain cover in the early stages.
Passing the 1300 Metres, GREEN CARD was momentarily steadied away from the heels of SKY HERO.
Approaching the 1200 Metres, GREEN CARD was awkwardly placed between SUPER LEADER and BULLISH SMART, both of which shifted ground.
After the 900 Metres, PACKING LLAREGYB was left racing wide and without cover.
After the race, O Doleuze (BIG FLASH) stated that stepping up in distance to 1400 Metres he allowed the horse to gradually improve in the early stages to take up a forward position, however, BIG FLASH would not settle as he had hoped and then weakened noticeably in the Straight.  A veterinary inspection of BIG FLASH immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of BIG FLASH, a last start winner, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, BIG FLASH will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Also after the race, C Schofield (DRAGON MASTER) reported that his mount did not feel comfortable in its action and became detached from the field.  A veterinary inspection of DRAGON MASTER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of DRAGON MASTER, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, DRAGON MASTER will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
NOTHINGILIKEMORE and JOLLY JOLLY were sent for sampling.

DRAGON DANCE and LE PANACHE were slow to begin.
As the start was effected, A FAST ONE lifted its front feet off the ground and lost ground and then shortly after the start lost further ground when crowded for room between ROYALE ELEGANCE and STRATHCLYDE which shifted out.
Also as the start was effected, NICE FANDANGO put its head down and consequently began awkwardly.
Shortly after the start, ROYALE ELEGANCE was steadied away from the heels of ST YAZIN when momentarily racing in restricted room between that horse and STRATHCLYDE.
Over the final 300 Metres, AUTOPAY lay out under pressure.
Over the concluding stages, KIWI SUNRISE raced tight outside WILD BOY which was awkwardly placed outside AUTOPAY which continued to lay out.
At the 50 Metres, A FAST ONE shifted out and made contact with HAY GO LUCKY.
Close to the finishing line, WILD BOY was shifted in away from the heels of AUTOPAY which was steadied and directed to the outside of NICE FANDANGO.
The performance of DRAGON DANCE, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Having regard to DRAGON DANCEâs previous racing performances, the Stewards ruled that the horse must undergo a series of consecutive barrier trials (not less than three) and be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.
After the race, Apprentice H T Mo (AUTOPAY) reported that his saddle shifted back in the early stages, causing him some inconvenience.
Also after the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that HAY GO LUCKY had bled from both nostrils
A veterinary inspection of WILD BOY immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, WILD BOY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
NICE FANDANGO, KEEP MOVING and STRATHCLYDE were sent for sampling.
<24/4/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>WILD BOY, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horseâs trachea.  WILD BOY was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer T P Yung this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its left front leg.  As previously advised, WILD BOY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.

The start was delayed when GOOD FIT lost its right front plate just prior to horses being loaded into the barriers.  After being replated, GOOD FIT was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
LOVE CHUNGHWA and NOTED PERFORMER were crowded for room on jumping between HURRICANE KID which shifted in and HONG KONG CAPTAIN which shifted out after being bumped by FIVE STARS AGENT which began awkwardly.
From wide barriers, TOP ACE, GOLD DRAGON and THE FULL BLOOM were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After the 1200 Metres, BEST TANGO was left racing wide and without cover.
Near the 250 Metres, NOTED PERFORMER was shifted away from the heels of FIVE STARS AGENT which was giving ground.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of FIVE STARS AGENT, Apprentice K K Chiong stated that although her mount was inclined to travel keenly in the middle stages, it travelled similarly at its most recent start when successful, so this did not concern her.  She said when BEST TANGO improved around FIVE STARS AGENT rounding the Home Turn, FIVE STARS AGENT immediately came under pressure and then, despite being ridden out, weakened noticeably in the Straight.  A veterinary inspection of FIVE STARS AGENT immediately following the race found that horse to have sustained a small wound to the outside of the left hind cannon.  The performance of FIVE STARS AGENT, a favourite for todayâs race and also a last start winner, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, FIVE STARS AGENT will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of HURRICANE KID immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FIVE STARS AGENT, GOOD FIT and TOP ACE were sent for sampling.

GRAN MASTER was slow to begin.
JE PENSE began awkwardly.
CROWN AVENUE began only fairly.
From the outside barriers, SUPER EURO STAR and TERRIFIC MASTER were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Making the turn near the 1400 Metres, CROWN AVENUE shifted out abruptly away from the heels of SUPER TALENT, resulting in IâM THE WON FOR U being severely checked and TRAVEL AMBASSADOR also being checked.  GRAN MASTER, which was following, was severely checked away from the heels of IâM THE WON FOR U and shifted out abruptly and in doing so bumped the hindquarters of SUPER EURO STAR which became unbalanced.
Throughout the race, MEGATRON travelled wide and without cover.
After the race, Z Purton (TRAVEL AMBASSADOR) stated that after his mount was bumped by HELENâS CHOICE making the turn near the 700 Metres, TRAVEL AMBASSADOR came off the bridle and then did not close off the race as he expected.  A veterinary inspection of TRAVEL AMBASSADOR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of IâM THE WON FOR U and SUPER EURO STAR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
TRAVEL AMBASSADOR, IMPERIAL SEAL and SUPER TALENT were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE HONG KONG JOCKEY CLUB COMMUNITY TROPHY (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
INVINCIBLE DRAGON was withdrawn on 21.4.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore with a swollen fetlock).  Before being allowed to race again, INVINCIBLE DRAGON will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
CALIFORNIA WHIP began awkwardly and then was crowded for room between WESTERN EXPRESS and LUCKY GIRL which shifted out.  In this incident, WESTERN EXPRESS became unbalanced after being bumped by CALIFORNIA WHIP.
From the outside barrier, GONNA RUN was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
After the 1100 Metres, LIMITLESS got its head up when proving difficult to settle and being checked away from the heels of WESTERN EXPRESS.
Near the 650 Metres, FIGHT HERO raced tight between WESTERN EXPRESS and LIMITLESS which shifted out to improve.
Passing the 300 Metres, GONNA RUN was shifted to the inside of LUCKY YEAR after being disappointed for running outside that horse and inside PEOPLEâS KNIGHT.  GONNA RUN then had difficulty obtaining clear running for a short distance after the 300 Metres.
After the race, J Moreira (WESTERN EXPRESS) stated that his mount raced âflatâ.  Mr J Size, the trainer of WESTERN EXPRESS, informed the Stewards that following the horseâs disappointing run, it was his intention to spell it.  A veterinary inspection of WESTERN EXPRESS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of LIMITLESS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
WESTERN EXPRESS, MIDNIGHT RATTLER and CALIFORNIA WHIP were sent for sampling.

RICHCITY FORTUNE began awkwardly.
SILVER SPUN was crowded for room on jumping between MONEY MONEY and THE INVINCIBLE which shifted out.  In this incident, MONEY MONEY became unbalanced after being bumped by SILVER SPUN.
From a wide barrier, FOREVER ACCURATE was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After the 900 Metres, SILVER SPUN travelled keenly.
Near the 700 Metres, SMILING GLORY was awkwardly placed when racing tight between STARLOT and SILVER SPUN which got its head on the side and lay in towards the hindquarters of RICHCITY FORTUNE.
THE INVINCIBLE was unable to obtain clear running in the early part of the Straight and then for some distance approaching and passing the 200 Metres was shifted out to improve.
A veterinary inspection of FOREVER ACCURATE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of FOREVER ACCURATE, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, FOREVER ACCURATE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned, Apprentice M F Poon stated that in the early part of the Straight he shifted SMILING GLORY to the inside of RICHCITY FORTUNE to improve into running between that horse and MONEY MONEY.  He said SMILING GLORY did not quicken and took some time to improve its position and near the 200 Metres he was awkwardly placed between RICHCITY FORTUNE and STARLOT.  He said when both those horses shifted ground slightly passing the 200 Metres, he was not able to fully ride his mount along at this time as he was unsure of whether either horse would continue to shift, resulting in SMILING GLORY striking interference.  He said because of this he was not able to test SMILING GLORY in the Straight as much as he would have hoped.
After the race, J Moreira stated that he was obliged to make a lot of use of BORN DRAGON in the early stages to obtain a forward position and then throughout the race was obliged to race very wide and without cover after being unable to clear SILVER SPUN to its inside.  A veterinary inspection of BORN DRAGON immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Also after the race, the Veterinary Surgeon reported that BEAR CHUM had bled from both nostrils.
BORN DRAGON, GOLDIE FLANKER and STARLOT were sent for sampling.

WINFIELD began only fairly and then shortly after the start was bumped by SANGRIA which shifted in.
JADE THEATRE and ROYAL MOJITO bumped on jumping.  JADE THEATRE was then steadied a short distance after the start when crowded for room between NO MONEY NO TALK and ROYAL MOJITO which shifted out.
As the start was effected, RED KYLIN lifted its front feet off the ground and consequently began only fairly.
Passing the 600 Metres, NO MONEY NO TALK raced in restricted room between GALLANT ROCK and BEAUTY MASTER.
When placed under pressure after the 500 Metres, WINFIELD got its head on the side and lay out.  WINFIELD continued to race ungenerously and then over the concluding stages hung out and proved difficult to ride.
Over the final 400 Metres, ROYAL MOJITO, which was having its first race start in Hong Kong, raced greenly and shifted ground on a number of occasions.
Passing the 150 Metres, NO MONEY NO TALK shifted out, resulting in its rider having to stop riding and straighten.  NO MONEY NO TALK continued to hang out for the remainder of the race and prove difficult to ride.
After the race, J Moreira stated that he was unable to offer any explanation for the disappointing performance of BEAUTY MASTER.  He said the horse travelled well in the early and middle stages, however, did not close off the race after being placed under pressure near the 400 Metres.  A veterinary inspection of BEAUTY MASTER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
A veterinary inspection of GALLANT ROCK immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that WINFIELD had sustained a superficial abrasion on the nose.
FORTUNE BO BO and RED KYLIN were sent for sampling.

As the start was effected, PLAY IT turned its head to the left, resulting in the horse losing a considerable amount of ground.  Before being allowed to race again, PLAY IT will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.
ARIZONA BLIZZARD was bumped by JOYFUL MOMENTS shortly after the start.
From wide barriers, ARIZONA BLIZZARD and GOAL FOR GOLD were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Despite being ridden along, SUPER MAN failed to muster speed and raced back in the field.  Then making the turn after the 700 Metres, SUPER MAN got its head on the side and lay out.
Making the turn after the 700 Metres, CHARITY GLORY was awkwardly placed close to the heels of URBAN CHIC.
Passing the 500 Metres, ARIZONA BLIZZARD was awkwardly placed behind URBAN CHIC and for a short distance after this remained held up for clear running.
Near the 450 Metres, URBAN CHIC shifted out and bumped CHARITY GLORY.
Just prior to the winning post, STAR OF YAN OI shifted in and made contact with JOYFUL MOMENTS.  The Stewards were satisfied, prior to the declaration of weighed-in, that having regard to where this incident occurred in relation to the winning post, the contact between STAR OF YAN OI and JOYFUL MOMENTS did not affect their finishing positions.
Throughout the race, BORNTOACHIEVE travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of SUPER MAN and ARIZONA BLIZZARD immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HAPPY METEOR and STAR OF YAN OI were sent for sampling.
<24/4/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>The Veterinary Officer reported that DEJA VU was lame in its left front leg on the morning after racing.  Before being allowed to race again, DEJA VU will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

PACKING GENIUS began only fairly.
TRAVEL FIRST dipped on jumping, shifted in and bumped RED ELYSEES which in turn shifted in and bumped DIVINE BOY.  After this, both RED ELYSEES and DIVINE BOY were shifted across behind runners.
Making the turn just prior to the 700 Metres, GREEN DISPATCH shifted in, brushed the running rail and became unbalanced.  A short distance later, GREEN DISPATCH and RED MARVEL raced tight inside TRAVEL FIRST which shifted in marginally when placed under pressure to maintain its position.
A veterinary inspection of RED ELYSEES immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.  The performance of RED ELYSEES, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, RED ELYSEES will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After the race, O Doleuze stated that SKY KING never travelled on the bridle during the race and consequently did not finish off the race.  He said he was not able to offer any explanation for the horseâs disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection of SKY KING immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of TRAVEL FIRST and RED MARVEL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
VANILLA and GIANT TURTLE were sent for sampling.

On proceeding to the barriers, C Y Ho was dislodged from MANHATTAN STRIKER without incident.
HAR HAR CHARMING began awkwardly and then from an outside barrier was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
DIGITAL PIONEER lost ground on jumping when crowded for room between PERFECT TIMING which dipped at the start and VIVACIOUS WINNER which shifted out.  After this, DIGITAL PIONEER was shifted across behind runners.
Despite being vigorously ridden in the early stages, VIVACIOUS WINNER failed to muster speed.
After the 1200 Metres, FAITHFUL BOY got its head up and travelled keenly when being steadied in the lead.
After the 1000 Metres, SUPER SWEET ORANGE got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of PLANET GIANT when being shifted in behind that horse.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, TREASURE AND GOLD raced tight inside PLANET GIANT which got its head on the side and lay in.
AEROLUMINANCE lost its right hind plate on straightening.
When questioned regarding his riding of AEROLUMINANCE after the 1100 Metres, K Teetan stated that he was instructed to ride AEROLUMINANCE in about a midfield position if possible, however, he was not to ride his mount along as the horse had not been finishing off its races when ridden along in the early part of the race.  He said approaching the 1100 Metres he was racing behind PLANET GIANT and SUPER SWEET ORANGE outside his mount in a three wide position without cover.  He said after the 1100 Metres J Moreira, the rider of SUPER SWEET ORANGE, placed pressure on AEROLUMINANCE by shifting in marginally with a view to obtaining a tight position between PLANET GIANT and AEROLUMINANCE.  He said he felt at this time he would have had to ride his mount along to establish his positon inside SUPER SWEET ORANGE and as his mount was travelling well he was reluctant, given his instructions, to do so at this time.  He said he therefore allowed SUPER SWEET ORANGE to obtain the position in front of AEROLUMINANCE and behind PLANET GIANT to ensure that AEROLUMINANCE remained travelling comfortably.  Having considered the matter, the Stewards accepted Jockey Teetanâs evidence and no further action was taken.
The Stewards questioned Apprentice H N Wong regarding his riding of FAITHFUL BOY over the concluding stages.  Apprentice Wong stated that he had placed FAITHFUL BOY under heavy pressure in the Straight as he had been challenged by PLANET GIANT to his outside for the major part of the Home Straight.  He said just prior to the finishing line he momentarily misjudged where the winning post was, however, very quickly became aware of this fact and recommenced riding his mount out all the way to the end of the race.  The Stewards, having considered the proximity of Apprentice Wong momentarily stopping riding his mount to the winning post and the fact that PLANET GIANT had established a margin over FAITHFUL BOY prior to this occurring, were satisfied that Apprentice Wongâs riding out of the horse over the concluding stages did not jeopardize its final placing.  Accordingly, no further action was taken, however, Apprentice Wong was severely reprimanded and advised to ensure that he rides his mounts out all the way to the end of the race so that his riding is not open to query.
Following this race, W M Lai was stood down by the Clubâs doctors due to a right wrist injury.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that ATOMIC BLAST had sustained a minor wound to the outside of the left front cannon.
A veterinary inspection of SUPER SWEET ORANGE and TREASURE AND GOLD immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SUPER SWEET ORANGE, ATOMIC BLAST and PLANET GIANT were sent for sampling.
<27/4/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>The Clinical Veterinary Surgeon reported that DIGITAL PIONEER was lame in its left front leg on the morning after racing.  Before being allowed to race again, DIGITAL PIONEER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
TREASURE AND GOLD, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  TREASURE AND GOLD was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer C H Yip this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its left front leg with a stiff and restricted action.  Before being allowed to race again, TREASURE AND GOLD will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

BO DUKE began awkwardly.
GARLIC YEAH shifted out on jumping and bumped AMAZING GOLD.
Shortly after the start, AUTUMN GOLD and HAPPY ROCKY bumped.
From the outside barriers, KING BOUNTIFUL and BLAZING PASS were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
C Schofield (GARLIC YEAH) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that in the vicinity to the 2100 Metres, he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of ALLCASH, resulting in that horse being taken in onto HAPPY ROCKY which in turn was taken in onto AUTUMN GOLD, causing AUTUMN GOLD to be crowded onto PREMIUM CHAMPION which was checked and lost the running to which it was rightfully entitled.
