C Schofield was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 17 May 2017 and to expire on Monday, 22 May 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards took into account Jockey Schofieldâs good race riding record.
Passing the 900 Metres, AUTUMN GOLD was awkwardly placed close to the heels of GARLIC YEAH.
Passing the 600 Metres, AUTUMN GOLD was awkwardly placed when attempting to improve into tight running between ALLCASH and KING BOUNTIFUL.  AUTUMN GOLD then raced tight between GARLIC YEAH and KING BOUNTIFUL.  PREMIUM CHAMPION, which was following, was awkwardly placed close to the heels of GARLIC YEAH.
Passing the 500 Metres, ALLCASH and AMAZING GOLD raced tight as ALLCASH attempted to improve to the outside of HAPPY ROCKY.
Approaching the Home Turn, ALLCASH (J Moreira) commenced to shift to the outside of HAPPY ROCKY and raced tight with AMAZING GOLD.  Then passing the 400 Metres, AMAZING GOLD was awkwardly placed close to the heels of ALLCASH and KING BOUNTIFUL which improved quickly around AMAZING GOLD.  AUTUMN GOLD was shifted out away from the heels of AMAZING GOLD in consequence, resulting in PREMIUM CHAMPION and BLAZING PASS being taken wider.  As the Stewards were satisfied that J Moreira was entitled to initially commence to shift to the outside of HAPPY ROCKY given that KING BOUNTIFUL was behind AMAZING GOLD at that time, no further action was deemed necessary as they were of the view that when J Moreira became aware that KING BOUNTIFUL was improving to the outside of AMAZING GOLD, he desisted from continuing to improve to the outside of HAPPY ROCKY.
AUTUMN GOLD and PREMIUM CHAMPION bumped at the entrance to the Straight.
A veterinary inspection of HAPPY ROCKY and INDUSTRIALIST WAY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of AUTUMN GOLD immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, AUTUMN GOLD will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
GARLIC YEAH, KING BOUNTIFUL and BLAZING PASS were sent for sampling.

The Stewards were informed by the Veterinary Officer prior to Race 1 that SUNNY ORIENT became fractious when being transported to Happy Valley from Sha Tin and sustained abrasions to its left hind leg.  The Veterinary Officer reported that at this time SUNNY ORIENT was suitable to race, however, the horse would be reassessed closer to race time.  A subsequent veterinary inspection confirmed SUNNY ORIENT to be suitable to race.
EMPIRE STAR began only fairly and shortly after the start lost ground when crowded for room between GENEROUS BOBO and G-ONE UNION which got its head on the side and shifted in despite the considerable efforts of its rider.
Shortly after the start, CLEVER SPIRIT raced tight between SUNNY ORIENT and BOLSHOI BALLET which shifted in.
Near the 850 Metres, DR RACE raced in restricted room inside REGENCY HONEY which shifted in marginally when also racing tight inside BOLSHOI BALLET.
After the 800 Metres, SIGHT SEEING was left racing wide and without cover.
Approaching the 200 Metres, CLEVER SPIRIT was steadied when disappointed for running between WHISTLE UP and EMPIRE STAR which shifted out.
Approaching the 100 Metres, REGENCY HONEY was shifted in away from the heels of BOLSHOI BALLET.
Passing the 100 Metres, as EMPIRE STAR and WHISTLE UP attempted to improve into tight running between BOLSHOI BALLET (B Prebble) and SIGHT SEEING (Apprentice H N Wong), WHISTLE UP was checked when tightened between EMPIRE STAR which was taken out marginally by BOLSHOI BALLET and SIGHT SEEING which shifted in slightly.  Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the individual shifts of both BOLSHOI BALLET and SIGHT SEEING were marginal, nonetheless B Prebble and Apprentice H N Wong were advised to do their utmost to prevent their mounts from shifting ground.
Close to the finishing line, REGENCY HONEY was awkwardly placed close to the heels of BOLSHOI BALLET which shifted in away from EMPIRE STAR which was awkwardly placed inside the heels of SIGHT SEEING.  As a consequence, REGENCY HONEY was not able to be ridden out to the end of the race.
Also close to the finishing line, G-ONE UNION raced tight between HIGH ENERGY and OCTAL LUCK.
When questioned regarding his riding of WHISTLE UP after the 600 Metres, T H So stated that at this time he had been racing behind REGENCY HONEY which was racing to the inside of SIGHT SEEING which was in a three wide position without cover.  He said passing the 500 Metres he commenced to shift out away from the heels of REGENCY HONEY and at this time received a call from the rider of SUNNY ORIENT which was improving quickly around WHISTLE UP.  He said he therefore remained racing behind REGENCY HONEY and then rounding the Home Turn shifted WHISTLE UP out to improve between SIGHT SEEING and SUNNY ORIENT.  He said when he did this SUNNY ORIENT shifted in and because of this he was then no longer able to improve between those horses.  He added he immediately shifted WHISTLE UP to the inside of SIGHT SEEING and commenced to improve into clear running between that horse and EMPIRE STAR.  He said WHISTLE UP did not quicken but rather was finishing off the race one-paced and because of this EMPIRE STAR was able to improve quickly to the inside of WHISTLE UP which was crowded for room passing the 100 Metres.  T H So was advised that his explanation would be reported, however, he was informed that his riding of the horse after the 600 Metres had come under notice and that he should have made a more concerted effort to shift out from behind REGENCY HONEY to follow SIGHT SEEING rounding the Home Turn which would have afforded WHISTLE UP the opportunity to immediately shift to that horseâs outside on straightening.
A veterinary inspection of BOLSHOI BALLET immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
EMPIRE STAR, DR RACE and SUNNY ORIENT were sent for sampling.

MASTER VIKING (Apprentice K K Chiong) began awkwardly and lost ground.  This resulted in MASTER VIKING racing back in the field.  Apprentice Chiong reported that it had been intended for MASTER VIKING to be ridden in a forward position.
From wide barriers, TORNEY and BORN TO RACE were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
GODSPEED was also steadied in the early stages to obtain cover.
Near the 950 Metres, BORN TO RACE was taken wider by DONâT MISS which shifted out.
Passing the 900 Metres, VICTOR EMPEROR commenced to travel keenly and shifted in abruptly when awkwardly placed close to the heels of STARTLING POWER which was steadied away from the heels of LYRIC ACE which got its head on the side and shifted out.
Passing the 800 Metres, MASTER VIKING was momentarily crowded for room inside CAREFREE LET GO which got its head on the side and shifted in after being awkwardly placed close to the heels of VICTOR EMPEROR.  CAREFREE LET GO was then promptly shifted out to relieve the tightening to MASTER VIKING.
Passing the 600 Metres, TORNEY raced tight inside GODSPEED which improved into tight running inside DONâT MISS.
When questioned, T H So stated that he had been asked to ride DONâT MISS in about a midfield position or slightly behind midfield.  He said DONâT MISS began only fairly and he rode his mount along in the early stages, however, shortly after the start was racing outside CAREFREE LET GO, he therefore steadied DONâT MISS after the 1100 Metres to obtain a trailing position behind that horse.  He said when being shifted in to race behind CAREFREE LET GO, DONâT MISS was awkwardly placed behind that horse after the 1000 Metres and then shifted out abruptly away from the heels of CAREFREE LET GO near the 950 Metres.  He said he then shifted DONâT MISS back in to race behind CAREFREE LET GO and had hoped to remain racing in this position, however, DONâT MISS commenced to travel greenly and got its head up when being checked away from the heels of CAREFREE LET GO near the 850 Metres.  He said when this happened DONâT MISS got its head on the side and shifted out away from the heels of CAREFREE LET GO.  He said he then attempted for some distance after this to shift DONâT MISS back in, however, the horse was reluctant to resume its position behind CAREFREE LET GO and this allowed GODSPEED the opportunity to improve underneath DON'T MISS which resulted in that horse being left racing three wide.  He said for a considerable distance after the 600 Metres he rode DONâT MISS aggressively as the horse was racing greenly and he did not want to be taken wider by GODSPEED.  He said when being hard ridden, DONâT MISS continued to lay out and then made the Home Turn awkwardly.  He said in the early part of the Straight, when placed under pressure, DONâT MISS lay out and for this reason he changed his whip over into his left hand after the 150 Metres.  He said DON'T MISS then finished off the race satisfactorily, however, the horse raced very greenly throughout the race.  A veterinary inspection of DONâT MISS immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, DONâT MISS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of VICTOR EMPEROR and BORN TO RACE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
YOUNG EMPIRE and SMART SALUTE were sent for sampling.
<27/4/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>VICTOR EMPEROR, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  VICTOR EMPEROR was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer C H Yip this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right front leg with a stiff and restricted action.  Before being allowed to race again, VICTOR EMPEROR will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

SOUL ACHIEVER and AMBITIOUS PINS bumped at the start.
GLORY STAR and RUBY COAST bumped at the start.  RUBY COAST was then crowded for room between FORMULA GALORE and GLORY STAR which shifted in.
Shortly after the start, GOOD CHOICE and SUM WIN DRAGON bumped.
From the outside barrier, GOLD VELVET was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, GLORY STAR raced tight between AMBITIOUS PINS and DIAMOND LEGEND which shifted in.  GLORY STAR then shifted in further away from DIAMOND LEGEND, resulting in AMBITIOUS PINS and GLORY STAR racing tight.
GOOD CHOICE lost its left front plate passing the winning post on the first occasion.
Approaching the 1100 Metres, SOUL ACHIEVER shifted in and brushed the running rail when racing tight inside AMBITIOUS PINS which also raced tight inside GLORY STAR (Apprentice H T Mo).  Apprentice Mo was advised to ensure that he leaves comfortable racing room for runners to his inside in similar circumstances.
Passing the 900 Metres, SUM WIN DRAGON commenced to travel keenly and was checked away from the heels of AMBITIOUS PINS.
Passing the 800 Metres, AMBITIOUS PINS was steadied away from the heels of FORMULA GALORE.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, SUM WIN DRAGON was awkwardly placed close to the heels of AMBITIOUS PINS.
Passing the 450 Metres, DIAMOND LEGEND was momentarily awkwardly placed close to the heels of SUM WIN DRAGON (K Teetan) which shifted out to obtain clear running.  K Teetan was advised to exercise more care when shifting ground.
Throughout the race, GLORY STAR travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of SOUL ACHIEVER and LETSGOFREE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
AMBITIOUS PINS, CONTRIBUTION and SUM WIN DRAGON were sent for sampling.

ISTANBUL BEY was slow to begin and then was steadied away from the heels of LAND GRANT which shifted out.
NITRO EXPRESS and ENREACHING bumped on jumping.  NITRO EXPRESS then shifted in, resulting in UNICORN being crowded for room outside CITY WINNER.
From a wide barrier, TEN FLAMES was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, HERO LOOK raced tight inside LAND GRANT which got its head on the side and lay in.
ENREACHING lost its left front plate passing the winning post on the first occasion.
ENREACHING travelled wide and without cover in the early stages and passing the 1200 Metres was allowed to stride forward into the lead.
Passing the 1000 Metres, ACCLAIMED LIGHT was steadied away from the heels of HERO LOOK.  CITY WINNER, which was following, was checked away from the heels of ACCLAIMED LIGHT as a consequence.
HERO LOOK lost its right front plate after the 1000 Metres.
After the 1000 Metres, UNICORN was shifted out and allowed to stride forward to obtain the lead passing the 750 Metres.
Passing the 250 Metres, ACCLAIMED LIGHT was disappointed for running between UNICORN which was commencing to give ground and GOLDEN SLEEP which shifted in.  ACCLAIMED LIGHT was then unable to obtain clear running until passing the 100 Metres and consequently was not able to be properly tested.
Approaching the 200 Metres, TEN FLAMES was momentarily awkwardly placed close to the heels of HERO LOOK which shifted out.  Then passing the 150 Metres, TEN FLAMES was steadied when improving into tight running between NITRO EXPRESS and HERO LOOK which shifted out.  In this incident, TEN FLAMES got its head on the side and shifted out marginally, resulting in NITRO EXPRESS racing tight inside ISTANBUL BEY.
In the Straight, LAND GRANT lay in under pressure and proved difficult to ride.
The declaration of weighed-in was deferred whilst Z Purton, the rider of MAGICAL BEAUTY, second placegetter, viewed the photo finish print.  After viewing the photo finish print, The Stewards concurred with the Judgeâs placings and accordingly weighed-in was notified on the numbers semaphored by the Judge.
A veterinary inspection of NITRO EXPRESS confirmed the horse to be a âroarerâ which had previously been reported.
A veterinary inspection of ENREACHING immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
LAND GRANT, GOLDEN SLEEP and MAGICAL BEAUTY were sent for sampling.

As the start was effected, APACHE SPIRIT lifted its front feet off the ground and was slow to begin.
From an outside barrier, GRACYDAD was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
APACHE SPIRIT made the turn after the 600 Metres awkwardly, shifted out and brushed BEAUTY KINGDOM.
Passing the 300 Metres, APACHE SPIRIT was shifted out across the heels of E-SUPER to continue improving.
Near the 250 Metres, E-SUPER was inconvenienced when momentarily crowded for room between HELLA HEDGE and PERPETUAL JOYANCE which shifted out.
Passing the 200 Metres, APACHE SPIRIT was then disappointed for running between OUR HERO and HELLA HEDGE which shifted out.
Over the final 100 Metres, HELLA HEDGE got its head on the side and lay in under pressure, resulting in APACHE SPIRIT racing tight inside that horse passing the 50 Metres.
Near the 50 Metres, GRACYDAD shifted out and bumped E-SUPER.
Throughout the race, HELLA HEDGE travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of KING MORTAR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
WONDERFUL FIGHTER and PERPETUAL JOYANCE were sent for sampling.

JETWINGS was withdrawn on 25.4.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter TURF SPRINT (D Whyte).  Before being allowed to race again, JETWINGS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
From the outside barriers, MR GENUINE and TURF SPRINT were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
COUNTRY MELODY was also steadied in the early stages and shifted across to obtain cover.
Approaching the 700 Metres, THE GOLDEN AGE was left racing wide and without cover.
Near the 650 Metres, CHARITY GLORY broke down in its left front suspensory.  DRAGON GENERAL, which was following, was severely checked away from the heels of CHARITY GLORY and shifted in, resulting in MR GENUINE being crowded for room.  This resulted in DRAGON GENERAL and MR GENUINE losing ground.
When questioned regarding the performance of SEA JADE, S Clipperton stated that it had been intended for the horse to be ridden in a forward position.  He said it was felt that there was good natural speed with horses such as CHARITY JOY, VICTORY MARVEL and PREMIERE being engaged and if SEA JADE could not lead, the horse would be able to take a position behind the lead if the tempo of the race was sufficient in the early stages.  He said SEA JADE began only fairly and was immediately crossed by VICTORY MARVEL.  He said it was therefore not an option to lead so he obtained a trailing position behind VICTORY MARVEL and after that horse shifted in to race on the rail near the 1050 Metres, he obtained a trailing position behind PREMIERE.  He said PREMIERE then improved its position which provided HIGH FIVE with the opportunity to race outside that horse.  He said although SEA JADE raced slightly further back in the field than had been intended, nonetheless the horse travelled well and initially quickened for him in the early part of the Straight such that he felt it was going to finish off the race strongly.  He said after initially showing a good turn of foot, SEA JADE then came under pressure after the 200 Metres, however, he felt that this was more as a result of the fact that the horse was carrying top weight and the circumstances of the race rather than the horse being disappointing.  A veterinary inspection of SEA JADE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of THE GOLDEN AGE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SEA JADE, VICTORY MARVEL and MR GENUINE were sent for sampling.

HASTILY FEET was withdrawn on 29.4.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right hind) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter GOOD MATE (K C Ng).  Before being allowed to race again, HASTILY FEET will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
BOSSIEE began only fairly and shortly after the start was steadied away from the heels of GOOD MATE.
DANEWIN EXPRESS began awkwardly.
FRIENDS FOREVER shifted out at the start and bumped LUCKY PLACE which in turn shifted out and bumped BE THERE AHEAD.  Then, from the outside barriers, LUCKY PLACE and BE THERE AHEAD were shifted across behind runners.  BE THERE AHEAD subsequently finished tailed out.  A veterinary inspection of BE THERE AHEAD immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of BE THERE AHEAD was considered unacceptable.  Having regard to BE THERE AHEAD being previously tailed out in its races, the Stewards ruled that the horse will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a series of consecutive barrier trials and be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.
Passing the 500 Metres, DANEWIN EXPRESS was shifted in away from the heels of STRIKING STAR.
Near the 150 Metres, WINNER ST PAULâS got its head on the side and shifted out towards the heels of YOUNG DREAMER.  Then approaching the 100 Metres, WINNER ST PAULâS was steadied away from the heels of YOUNG DREAMER (Apprentice H T Mo) which shifted in under pressure.  Apprentice Mo was advised to exercise more care in similar circumstances.
The performance of GOOD MATE, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, GOOD MATE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that DANEWIN EXPRESS had bled from both nostrils.
A veterinary inspection of STRIKING STAR immediately following the race confirmed the horse to be a âroarerâ which had previously been reported.
A veterinary inspection of WINNER ST PAULâS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
REWARDING FLYER, BOSSIEE and DANEWIN EXPRESS were sent for sampling.

At declaration time, M L Yeung was declared as the rider of both HAPPY PLACE and KEEN VENTURE.  It was established that M L Yeung had a firm commitment to ride KEEN VENTURE.  As such, the Stewards permitted C Schofield to be substituted as the rider of HAPPY PLACE.  For this declaration error, M L Yeung was fined $2,000.
DOYENI began only fairly.
HAPPY PLACE and BEAUTY WAY bumped at the start.
From wide barriers, KEEN VENTURE and NASSA were shifted across behind runners to obtain cover in the early stages.
KEEN VENTURE lay out rounding the Home Turn.
For the majority of the race, SEASONS BLOOM travelled wide and without cover.
After the race, Apprentice M F Poon (SIMPLY INVINCIBLE) stated that his mount did not feel comfortable on todayâs surface as it did not quicken when asked and then gave ground over the latter stages of the race.  A veterinary inspection of SIMPLY INVINCIBLE immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, SIMPLY INVINCIBLE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of SEASONS BLOOM immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SEASONS BLOOM, EASTERN EXPRESS and BOOMING DELIGHT were sent for sampling.

race_name: AUDEMARS PIGUET LADY ROYAL OAK HANDICAP
incident_report:
TELECOM TITAN began only fairly and then shortly after the start shifted out abruptly across the heels of BUMBLE BABY and lost ground.
PERFECT TOUCH began awkwardly.
FOXBAT and ALL YOU NEED bumped at the start.
OWNERSâ PRESTIGE began only fairly and shortly after the start shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of CELEBRATION which became unbalanced.  From the outside barrier, CELEBRATION was then steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
OWNERSâ PRESTIGE made the turn after the 900 Metres awkwardly and then raced with its head on the side and lay out.
At the 400 Metres, MONEY BOY and REGENCY DARLING bumped as MONEY BOY was crowded for room between REGENCY DARLING and CALL ME AWESOME (Apprentice H N Wong) which drifted out.  Apprentice Wong was advised to ensure that he is alert to his mounts shifting ground and in similar circumstances to make every endeavour to prevent them from shifting.
In the early part of the Straight, ALL YOU NEED raced greenly under pressure and near the 300 Metres COMPASSION STAR, which was racing behind ALL YOU NEED, was momentarily awkwardly placed close to the heels of that horse.
Near the 350 Metres, REGENCY DARLING shifted in and bumped MONEY BOY.
Approaching the 100 Metres, REGENCY DARLING momentarily raced tight outside MONEY BOY which shifted out marginally.
Passing the 50 Metres, MASTER STEED was shifted out away from the heels of ALL YOU NEED.
Throughout the race, REGENCY DARLING travelled wide and without cover.
Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the riding of T Berry (BUMBLE BABY), 5th placegetter, over the concluding stages did not affect the horseâs finishing position, he was nonetheless reminded of his obligation to ride his mounts out at least hands and heels all the way to the end of the race, where circumstances permit.
RELENTLESS ME and ALL YOU NEED were sent for sampling.

race_name: AUDEMARS PIGUET ROYAL OAK OFFSHORE HANDICAP
incident_report:
SPICY KAKA was slow to begin.
FOREVER POSH began awkwardly and shortly after the start was steadied and shifted across behind runners.
On jumping, DESTIN shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of VICTORY MASTER which became unbalanced.
Shortly after the start, HAPPY AND HEALTHY was steadied away from the heels of CARE FREE PRINCE which shifted in.
For some distance in the early and middle stages, FOREVER POSH raced with its head on the side when inclined to lay out.
Throughout the race, STAR SUPERIOR travelled wide and without cover and passing the 800 Metres was taken wider still by RED HORSE which shifted out away from the heels of CARE FREE PRINCE.  At the same stage, VITAL SPRING was awkwardly placed close to the heels of MORDICUS.
At the entrance to the Straight, GOOD METHOD briefly raced tight between STAR SUPERIOR and AMBITIOUS HEART which shifted out to obtain clear running.  VICTORY MASTER, which was following GOOD METHOD, was shifted out away from the heels of that horse in consequence.
At the 200 Metres, HAPPY AND HEALTHY was steadied when being shifted to the outside of RED HORSE which was giving ground.
Passing the 200 Metres, HURRICANE HUNTER was bumped by SPICY KAKA which shifted out away from the heels of MORDICUS when closing off the race.
Approaching the 50 Metres, VITAL SPRING was shifted in away from the heels of MORDICUS which was taken in by SPICY KAKA.
Close to the finishing line, HAPPY AND HEALTHY was awkwardly placed close to the heels of AMBITIOUS HEART and consequently was not able to be ridden out all the way to the end of the race.
A veterinary inspection of HURRICANE HUNTER and RED HORSE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HURRICANE HUNTER, AMBITIOUS HEART and CARE FREE PRINCE were sent for sampling.

race_name: AUDEMARS PIGUET LADY ROYAL OAK OFFSHORE HANDICAP
incident_report:
As the start was effected, ELUSIVE RAIN lifted its front feet off the ground and began only fairly.
REAL DEAL and SUCH A HAPPINESS bumped shortly after the start.
From wide barriers, DOCTORS DELIGHT, GRADE ONE and VIVA COUNCIL were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Approaching the 1100 Metres, VICTORY MACHINE raced tight inside the heels of REAL DEAL.
Passing the 1100 Metres, SUCH A HAPPINESS was steadied away from the heels of EVEREST (S Clipperton) which shifted in when not properly clear.  S Clipperton was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is sufficiently clear when shifting ground.  After this, SUCH A HAPPINESS raced close to the heels of EVEREST.
O Doleuze, the rider of SUPERIOR BOY, was reprimanded for permitting his mount to shift in when not properly clear of GOLD TALENT near the 1050 Metres, resulting in that horse being awkwardly placed close to the heels of SUPERIOR BOY.  After this, GOLD TALENT travelled wide and without cover.
Near the 900 Metres, SUCH A HAPPINESS commenced to prove very difficult to settle and got its head up when being checked away from the heels of ELECTRIC LIGHTNING.  In this incident, SUCH A HAPPINESS and C P POWER bumped.  After this, SUCH A HAPPINESS continued to travel keenly.
Near the 450 Metres, ELECTRIC LIGHTNING was steadied away from the heels of REAL DEAL which got its head on the side and lay out.
Close to the finishing line, ELECTRIC LIGHTNING was awkwardly placed outside the heels of VICTORY MACHINE which shifted out.
When questioned, M Chadwick stated that as C P POWER had been left racing wide and without cover at its most recent start, it was stressed on him the need to obtain cover in this race and it was hoped that C P POWER might be able to obtain a position in about midfield.  He said because of the makeup of the field in the early stages, he had to settle C P POWER further back in the field than had been anticipated to ensure that the horse obtained cover.
A veterinary inspection of DOCTORS DELIGHT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SUCH A HAPPINESS, METALLIC STAR and VICTORY MACHINE were sent for sampling.

UNIQUE JOYOUS began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped THE SUPREME.  UNIQUE JOYOUS was then ridden along to obtain a more prominent position, however, shortly after the start got its head on the side and shifted in towards the heels of MR POTENTIAL, resulting in UNIQUE JOYOUS being awkwardly placed outside that horse.
SILVERFIELD was crowded for room on jumping between CITRON SPIRIT and PENANG HALL, both of which shifted ground.
Shortly after the start, MR POTENTIAL was shifted out away from the heels of BEAUTY FLARE which was taken out by MISTER MONTE.  After this, MR POTENTIAL was ridden along, however, failed to muster speed.
Near the 1350 Metres, CELESTIAL NOVA was shifted in away from the heels of PENANG HALL (Apprentice M F Poon) which shifted ground when not properly clear of CELESTIAL NOVA.  Apprentice Poon was reprimanded.  After this, PENANG HALL was shifted out to relieve the tightening to CELESTIAL NOVA, however, CELESTIAL NOVA continued to race keenly for some distance.  After the race, Z Purton stated that CELESTIAL NOVA did not feel comfortable in its action and was reluctant to stride out.  A veterinary inspection of CELESTIAL NOVA immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea and also found the horse to have sustained a small cut to the inside of the right front fetlock.  Before being allowed to race again, CELESTIAL NOVA will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Making the turn near the 850 Metres, BEAUTY FLARE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of THE SUPREME.
Passing the 200 Metres, SILVERFIELD was awkwardly placed inside the heels of CITRON SPIRIT.
Near the 75 Metres, HOME RUN shifted out and brushed CITRON SPIRIT.  HOME RUN continued to lay out under pressure and close to the finishing line again shifted out and bumped CITRON SPIRIT.
Throughout the race, OCULIST travelled wide and without cover and in the Straight gave ground.
S Clipperton was questioned regarding his riding of MISTER MONTE in the early part of the Straight.  S Clipperton was advised to ensure that he rides his mounts competitively at all stages.
RULE THEE lost its left front plate after the race.
A veterinary inspection of OCULIST and UNIQUE JOYOUS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PENANG HALL, CITRON SPIRIT and HOME RUN were sent for sampling.

ANTICIPATION, which was kicked by another runner in the Parade Ring, was examined by the Veterinary Officer on arrival at the Start who said the horse was suitable to race.
GOLD MOUNT and HELENE CHARISMA began only fairly.
BEAUTY GENERATION lost its right front plate after the 2300 Metres.
Despite being hard ridden along in the early stages, BASIC TRILOGY failed to muster speed and subsequently travelled wide and without cover for the majority of the race.
In the early stages, ANTICIPATION travelled wide and without cover and after the 1600 Metres was allowed to improve its position to race outside the lead by the 1400 Metres.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, SUPREME PROFIT became unbalanced and lost ground when crowded for room between BASIC TRILOGY (S Clipperton) which shifted in before being shifted back out to relieve the tightening to SUPREME PROFIT and ANDOYAS which shifted out away from the heels of EAGLE WAY which got its head on the side and shifted out marginally.  S Clipperton was advised to ensure that he leaves comfortable racing rom for runners to his inside in similar circumstances.
Near the 650 Metres, PRAWN BABA, which was being ridden along to improve its position around EAGLE WAY, was bumped by that horse which shifted out away from the heels of HELENE SUPER STAR.
Near the 350 Metres, HELENE SUPER STAR was bumped by ANTICIPATION which, when giving ground abruptly, shifted out away from GOLD MOUNT.
In the Straight, HELENE CHARISMA hung in and proved difficult to ride.
The performances of BASIC TRILOGY, ANTICIPATION, HAPPILABABY and HELENE SUPER STAR, which all finished tailed out, were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, BASIC TRILOGY, ANTICIPATION, HAPPILABABY and HELENE SUPER STAR will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of BEAUTY GENERATION, Z Purton stated that although the tempo was good for the majority of the race, BEAUTY GENERATION would not settle and travelled keenly.  He said the horse had been relaxed it its track work in the lead up to todayâs race, however, due to BEAUTY GENERATION racing too keenly it then did not finish off the race.  A veterinary inspection of BEAUTY GENERATION immediately following the race found that horse to have sustained a small overreach cut to the right front heel.
HELENE CHARISMA lost its left front plate after the race.
EAGLE WAY and HELENE CHARISMA were sent for sampling.

After being placed in the barriers, INTREPIC became fractious, reared and momentarily got its left front leg over the barrier partition.  INTREPIC was removed from the barriers and examined by the Veterinary Officer who said when INTREPIC reared, the horse did not struggle and accordingly was suitable to race.  Before being allowed to race again, INTREPIC will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.  WINWIN RUBY, which was in the barrier adjacent to the stall occupied by INTREPIC, was also removed from the barriers and examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.
IMPERIAL GALLANTRY shifted out at the start and bumped HAIR TRIGGER.
ROYAL ELITE began only fairly.
MARVEL TRIBE shifted out at the start and bumped INTREPIC.
Shortly after the start, GREEN ENERGY and JOLLY CONVERGENCE bumped. 
WINWIN RUBY and FIRST FONTEIN were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Approaching the 1200 Metres, VOLITATION was steadied away from the heels of MARVEL TRIBE (Apprentice K K Chiong) which shifted in when not quite clear.  MARVEL TRIBE continued to shift in, resulting in JOLLY CONVERGENCE being momentarily awkwardly placed close to the heels of that horse passing the 1200 Metres.  Apprentice Chiong was severely reprimanded and advised to ensure that she is sufficiently clear when shifting ground.
GREEN ENERGY had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight and passing the 350 Metres was shifted back in across the heels of NONE OTHER after being disappointed for running between that horse and JOLLY CONVERGENCE.  ROYAL ELITE, which was following GREEN ENERGY, was shifted in away from that horse in consequence.
Near the 150 Metres, GREEN ENERGY improved into tight running between NONE OTHER and MARVEL TRIBE.
Near the 50 Metres, JOLLY CONVERGENCE, which was giving ground, was bumped by WINWIN RUBY which shifted out away from GREEN ENERGY.
Over the concluding stage, GREEN ENERGY and WINWIN RUBY raced tight.
Throughout the race, NONE OTHER travelled wide and without cover.
MARVEL TRIBE lost its left front plate after the race.
A veterinary inspection of JOLLY CONVERGENCE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
KINGSFIELD and REGENCY BO BO were sent for sampling.

DICTON was slow to begin.
Shortly after the start, THE UNITED STATES shifted in and bumped PAKISTAN STAR.  After this, PAKISTAN STAR got its head up, travelled keenly, shifted in and bumped WERTHER.
PAKISTAN STAR and THE UNITED STATES again bumped approaching the winning post on the first occasion.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, NEOREALISM got its head up when being steadied to obtain cover behind WERTHER.  After this, NEOREALISM continued to travel keenly for some distance.
For some distance in the middle stages, NEOREALISM was awkwardly placed close to the heels of WERTHER and passing the 1100 Metres was shifted out and allowed to improve into the lead.
Passing the 1200 Metres, WERTHER got its head up when awkwardly placed behind BLAZING SPEED.
After the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on WERTHER at the request of Trainer J Moore.  The Veterinary Surgeon reported that this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, WERTHER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of DESIGNS ON ROME immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
WERTHER, NEOREALISM and PAKISTAN STAR were sent for sampling.

race_name: AUDEMARS PIGUET ROYAL OAK CONCEPT HANDICAP
incident_report:
PRIMERO was withdrawn on 29.4.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter RAPHAEL (C Y Ho).  Before being allowed to race again, PRIMERO will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
DUKEDOM, which was fractious in the barriers, will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test before being allowed to race again. GOLDINGTON HORN and BELOVED began only fairly.
ROCKET LET WIN was crowded for room on jumping between LE PANACHE and DAZZLE WINNER which shifted in.  After this, ROCKET LET WIN was ridden along in an attempt to obtain a more forward position, however, failed to muster speed.

In assessing penalty, the Stewards took into account Jockey Moreiraâs good race riding record.  After the race, M L Yeung (LE PANACHE) stated that after being severely checked, LE PANACHE did not feel comfortable in its action immediately following the incident and for this reason he did not pressure the horse and followed the field.  A veterinary inspection of LE PANACHE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Before being allowed to race again, LE PANACHE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of RAGING BULL and ROCKET LET WIN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
RAGING BULL, STARLIGHT and BORN DRAGON were sent for sampling.

HAPPY FRIENDSHIP, GOLDEN PARTNERS and SWEET BEAN began only fairly.

M L Yeung (INTELLECTUAL GLIDE) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 200 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of SEVEN LUCK, causing that horse to be crowded for room and to lose the running to which it was rightfully entitled.  M L Yeung was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 24 May 2017 and to expire on Monday, 29 May 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, M L Yeung was fined $22,500.
Approaching the 150 Metres, O Doleuze (GIDDY GIDDY) dropped his whip.

As the start was effected, JIMSON THE FAMOUS turned its head to the left and consequently lost a considerable amount of ground.  Before being allowed to race again, JIMSON THE FAMOUS will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.

For a considerable distance approaching and passing the winning post on the first occasion, SCARBOROUGH FAIR proved very difficult to settle and got its head up when being checked away from the heels of ARGENTUM.  After the race, D Whyte stated that due to the racing manners of SCARBOROUGH FAIR, the horse was then not able to finish off the race.  A veterinary inspection of SCARBOROUGH FAIR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GLORY STAR travelled wide and without cover until after the 900 Metres at which time the horse became unbalanced after shifting in and bumping IMPERIAL SEAL.  GLORY STAR was then steadied to obtain a trailing position behind IMPERIAL SEAL.

When questioned, Apprentice H N Wong (IMPERIAL SEAL) stated that approaching the 1000 Metres he was racing behind PACKING GO GO and inside GLORY STAR which was travelling in a three wide position.  He said he looked to his outside to ascertain whether GLORY STAR was being ridden along to improve its position around IMPERIAL SEAL or was travelling strongly enough to do so at that stage.  He said passing the 1000 Metres IMPERIAL SEAL commenced to travel strongly and he therefore shifted out away from the heels of PACKING GO GO to avoid having to be checked away from the heels of that horse.  After viewing the videos, Apprentice Wong agreed that in retrospect he should have made a greater effort to restrain IMPERIAL SEAL and continue to race behind PACKING GO GO rather than shifting to the outside of that horse prior to the 900 Metres which resulted in IMPERIAL SEAL travelling wide and without cover for the remainder of the race.  Apprentice Wong will be advised to ensure that he rides his mounts in such a manner so that they do not cover unnecessary ground.
A veterinary inspection of VICTORY FOLLOW ME immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, VICTORY FOLLOW ME will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

WISKY began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped MAGNETISM.
From wide barriers, AGREE, LITTERATEUR and VARA PEARL were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the 1200 Metres, SUNNY WIN commenced to race ungenerously and shifted out, resulting in BEAUTY LOVE being inconvenienced.  SUNNY WIN then had to be ridden along to re-establish its position outside the lead.
Also passing the 1200 Metres, AGREE got its head up when travelling keenly.

Passing the 200 Metres, AGREE raced in restricted room between STARSHIP and VARA PEARL.
Over the concluding stages, SPICY SURE raced tight inside BEAUTY LOVE which raced with its head on the side and lay in under pressure.
The Stewards deferred the declaration of weighed-in as they were of the prima facie view that an incident occurred between the 250 Metres and the 200 Metres which cast sufficient doubt on whether SUPER SPRINTER should be declared the 4th placegetter of the race.  Subsequently N Callan, the rider of SPICY SURE, 5th placegetter, lodged a protest/objection against SUPER SPRINTER alleging interference prior to the 200 Metres.  After taking evidence from all parties concerned and after viewing the videos, the Stewards found that shortly after entering the Straight SPICY SURE was shifted in away from the heels of SUPER SPRINTER after being awkwardly placed close to the heels of that horse.  SPICY SURE then improved quickly to establish running to the inside of SUPER SPRINTER shortly after the 300 Metres.  SUPER SPRINTER then commenced to shift in, resulting in SPICY SURE being crowded for room passing the 250 Metres and then being checked passing the 200 Metres.  Having regard to the short head margin between the horses at the end of the race and the manner in which they were finishing off the race, the Stewards were satisfied that had the interference not occurred SPICY SURE would have beaten SUPER SPRINTER.  Accordingly, the protest/objection was sustained and the placings amended to read No. 4, LITTERATEUR, 1st; No. 8, BEAUTY LOVE, 2nd; No. 6, WISKY, 3rd; No. 1, SPICY SURE, placed 4th and No. 5, SUPER SPRINTER, 5th.  Subsequently Apprentice Mo pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that for some distance approaching the 200 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of SPICY SURE, causing that horse to be checked and to lose the running to which it was rightfully entitled.  Apprentice Mo was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 24 May 2017 and to expire on Monday, 29 May 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, Apprentice Mo was fined $15,000.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of VARA PEARL, J Moreira stated that although LITTERATEUR was able to win this race from back in the field, he felt that the majority of races tonight appeared to favour horses that were ridden in a prominent position.  He said nonetheless VARA PEARL was very disappointing in that the horse did not close off the race as anticipated.  A veterinary inspection of VARA PEARL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
VARA PEARL, LITTERATEUR and BEAUTY LOVE were sent for sampling.

The Stewards inquired into Apprentice K K Chiongâs riding of CONTRIBUTION in this race.  Called before the Stewards were Apprentice Chiong, Mr A S Cruz, the trainer of CONTRIBUTION and Mr K W Lui, allocated trainer of Apprentice Chiong.  Mr Cruz stated that after establishing with Apprentice Chiong that she had viewed Jockey J Moreiraâs ride on the horse at its most recent start when successful, he had asked her to ride in a similar manner, that was to lead, not to overly restrain CONTRIBUTION and to use the whip sparingly on the horse.  He said at its last start CONTRIBUTION began well and was able to run quick sectionals but still finished off the race strongly to win.  Apprentice Chiong confirmed these instructions, however, as the start was effected CONTRIBUTION lifted its front feet off the ground and consequently began only fairly.  She said having in mind her instructions, she then rode CONTRIBUTION along aggressively in the early stages to make up lost ground and take up a forward position.  She said CONTRIBUTION had to be ridden along for some distance to gather momentum and she was required to slap the horse down the shoulder with the whip in an endeavour to have it take up a prominent position.  When asked by the Stewards as to whether she gave consideration to allowing CONTRIBUTION to settle behind FORMULA GALORE after the 1500 Metres given the manner in which it had begun and the amount of use she had to make of CONTRIBUTION, she said she was aware that SPARKLING SWORD and FORMULA GALORE had occupied the leading positions and further out on the track both DUTCH WINDMILL and MIDNITE PROMISE were also being ridden along to obtain prominent positions, she therefore felt that had she have settled in the position behind FORMULA GALORE, this would have resulted in CONTRIBUTION racing much further back in the field than had been intended.  She added therefore she did not give consideration to this option rather she continued to press forward on CONTRIBUTION to race outside the leader SPARKLING SWORD near the 1200 Metres.  She said she did briefly consider allowing CONTRIBUTION to remain outside SPARKLING SWORD after the 1200 Metres, however, it seemed to her that that horse was being restrained to take up a trailing position and therefore she felt that CONTRIBUTION would be able to advance forward of SPARKLING SWORD into the lead without having to make any further use of the horse.  She said after obtaining the outright lead after the 1100 Metres, she immediately commenced to steady CONTRIBUTION as although the horse had run strong sectionals at its last start, she was aware that she had to make considerable use of it in the early stages and therefore she attempted to have it settle in the lead.  She said however that, despite her efforts, CONTRIBUTION would not settle and opened up a significant margin over the field when again running strong sectionals.  She added however that in tonightâs race the horse commenced to give ground rounding the Home Turn and then weakened in the Straight.  Mr Cruz stated that whilst he had given instructions to lead, these instructions had been predicated on the belief that the horse would begin well.  He said having regard to the manner in which the horse began and the fact that it did not show natural early speed, in his opinion, Apprentice Chiong should have positioned CONTRIBUTION behind FORMULA GALORE approaching the winning post on the first occasion to allow the horse the opportunity to be able to finish off its race.  Mr Lui stated that, in his opinion, Apprentice Chiong should have adapted to the circumstances of the horse beginning badly and should have either obtained a trailing positon behind FORMULA GALORE or remained racing outside SPARKLING SWORD, a horse he trains.  After considering all the evidence, the Stewards informed Apprentice Chiong that whilst riders are given instructions on how a horse should be ridden and that appropriate attempts should be made to comply with these instructions, it is expected that jockeys should show judgement and initiative and ride their horses according to the circumstances.  Apprentice Chiong was advised that her riding of this horse was not up to the standard expected of a jockey in Hong Kong.  She was further advised to ensure that she rides her mounts in such a manner so that they are given the opportunity to finish off the race as best as they are able.  A veterinary inspection of CONTRIBUTION immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

A veterinary inspection of YOUNG EMPIRE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HEALTHY LUCK, FANTASTIC FEELING and AMAZING were sent for sampling.
<11/5/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>BLAZE STAMINA, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings. Before being allowed to race again, BLAZE STAMINA will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

He said because LUCKY YEAR was drawn inside PABLOSKY, he had hoped that PABLOSKY would be able to take up a position behind that horse which if LUCKY YEAR led, this would result in PABLOSKY racing behind the lead and which would assist its chance of getting the 1400 Metres of todayâs event. Apprentice Chiong stated that after this incident she attempted to resume a position one horse off the rail, however, GRAN MASTER improved quickly to be racing inside CROWN AVENUE.  She said because CROWN AVENUE was left racing wide, she then steadied her mount so as to obtain cover behind GRAN MASTER which resulted in CROWN AVENUE racing further back in the field.

A short distance later, NAMJONG INVINCIBLE and SUPER TALENT were crowded for room inside GLORY STAR which got its head on the side and lay in as GRAN MASTER improved to its outside. He said after the 1500 Metres he attempted to steady MEGATRON to obtain a trailing position behind GLORY STAR. He added this resulted in MEGATRON being left racing three wide and without cover, therefore after the 1200 Metres he allowed MEGATRON to improve forward of GLORY STAR so as not to cover unnecessary ground.
A veterinary inspection of FIVE STARS AGENT and CURLING LUXURY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FIVE STARS AGENT, FOREVER POSH and NAMJONG INVINCIBLE were sent for sampling.

HIGH VOLATILITY shifted in at the start, taking MISTER MONTE in onto EASY HEDGE which was hampered and in turn taken in onto RICKFIELD which was steadied away from the heels of ISTANBUL BEY.

K Teetan was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 11 June 2017 and to expire on Thursday, 15 June 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards took into account Jockey Teetanâs good race riding record.  Following this incident, MISTER MONTE commenced to hang out, raced ungenerously for some distance and consequently was left racing wide and without cover.
Approaching the 1000 Metres, BEAUTY LOVE commenced to race keenly and was shifted out off the heels of the leader HIGH VOLATILITY, resulting in EASY HEDGE being hampered and taken wider.

Then rounding the Home Turn, SHARP SAILOR was awkwardly placed between EASY HEDGE and VICTORY BOYS and at the 300 Metres had to be steadied when VICTORY BOYS shifted out slightly to improve.  S Clipperton was advised to exercise more care in similar circumstances.
Passing the 100 Metres, HAPPY CONTENDER was steadied and shifted out across the heels of HIGH VOLATILITY to continue improving.
When questioned regarding his riding of SHARP SAILOR in the middle stages and why he did not avail himself of a position on the rail behind BEAUTY LOVE, N Callan stated that when he had won on SHARP SAILOR over 2200 Metres on 22 December 2016, he had made a mid-race move and the horse had made a long sustained run.  He said therefore in this event he elected to remain racing one horse off the rail behind EASY HEDGE in order to give himself the option of making a similar mid-race move if the pace were to slacken.  He said however that the pace was relatively genuine and he was content to follow EASY HEDGE until making the turn near the 500 Metres where he endeavoured to improve to the outside of that horse.  He said however that SHARP SAILOR was reluctant to shift out from behind EASY HEDGE and when EASY HEDGE shifted out into a three wide position soon afterwards, he then chose to improve inside that horse.  He added however that SHARP SAILOR, which is one-paced, was not able to quicken with VICTORY BOYS which improved to its inside which resulted in SHARP SAILOR being left in an awkward position between those runners soon after straightening.
A veterinary inspection of MISTER MONTE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of EASY HEDGE immediately following the race found that horse to have sustained abrasions to the right hock.  Before being allowed to race again, EASY HEDGE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

After beginning awkwardly, DARING HEART was then steadied and shifted across behind runners from the outside barrier.

<26/5/2017  "DOYENI" INQUIRY>The Stewards today continued their inquiry into Apprentice K K Chiongâs riding of DOYENI in the Home Straight in the Lotus Handicap which was run at Sha Tin Racecourse on Sunday, 21 May 2017.  Further evidence was today taken from Apprentice Chiong with evidence also being taken from Mr K W Lui, allocated trainer of Apprentice Chiong, and Mr A S Cruz, trainer of DOYENI.  A written authority for Mr Cruz to represent the interests of Ms Yeoh Saw Kheng, the owner of DOYENI, at todayâs inquiry was tendered.
Apprentice Chiong was charged with having breached Hong Kong Rule of Racing 99 (2) and (5) in that as the rider of DOYENI in the stated race, she did fail to take all reasonable and permissible measures throughout the race to ensure that DOYENI was given a full opportunity to win or to obtain the best possible placing in the field.
The charge against Apprentice Chiong was particularised as follows:-
1. That after passing the 400 Metres she did direct DOYENI outwards away from clear and uninterrupted running between RODRICO and NASSA when it was both reasonable and permissible for her to have improved into such clear and uninterrupted running.
2. That after directing her mount away from such clear and uninterrupted running between RODRICO and NASSA, DOYENI was held up behind NASSA approaching and passing the 300 Metres.
3. That after being shifted to the outside of the heels of NASSA after passing the 300 Metres, she did fail to improve into clear and uninterrupted running between that horse and SEASONS BLOOM when it was both reasonable and permissible for her to have done so.
4. That after failing to improve between NASSA and SEASONS BLOOM after passing the 300 Metres, she did then permit DOYENI to shift out behind SEASONS BLOOM approaching and passing the 200 Metres, causing DOYENI to be held up and awkwardly placed behind that horse.
5. That by riding DOYENI in the manner in which she did from after passing the 400 Metres until after passing the 200 Metres, she did fail to take all reasonable and permissible measures to ensure that DOYENI was given a full opportunity to win or to obtain the best possible placing in the field.
Apprentice Chiong pleaded not guilty and was granted an adjournment to allow her to prepare a defence to the charge.  Accordingly, the matter was adjourned until a date and time to be fixed.

<7/6/2017  "DOYENI" INQUIRY>The Stewards today concluded their inquiry into Apprentice K K Chiongâs riding of DOYENI in the Home Straight in the Lotus Handicap which was run at Sha Tin Racecourse on Sunday, 21 May 2017.
At the previous hearing on 26 May 2017, Apprentice Chiong pleaded not guilty to being in breach of Rule of Racing 99 (2) and (5) and was granted an adjournment to prepare a defence to the charge.  At todayâs resumption, the Stewards considered further evidence from Apprentice Chiong and from Mr K W Lui, Apprentice Chiongâs allocated trainer, as well as written submissions tendered by Apprentice Chiong.
Having considered all of the evidence, the charge against Apprentice Chiong was sustained and accordingly she was found guilty of the charge issued on 26 May 2017.  In the circumstances, the Stewards considered the appropriate penalty was for Apprentice Chiongâs licence to ride in races to be suspended for a period to commence on Thursday, 8 June 2017 and to expire on Sunday, 2 July 2017 on which day she may resume race riding.  During this period, there are 7 racemeetings scheduled to be conducted in Hong Kong.

BORNTOACHIEVE was inclined to lay in and raced ungenerously in the early part of the Straight.
DEJA VU and SUNNY DRAGON were unable to obtain clear running until the 250 Metres.

MULTIMAX put its head down as the start was effected and lost ground.
WINFIELD refused to jump with the field and lost a considerable amount of ground.  WINFIELD was consequently detached from the field throughout the event.  Before being allowed to race again, WINFIELD will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.
From wide barriers, RADIANT TREASURE and THE JUDGE were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
After passing the 1000 Metres, LOOK ERAS commenced to lay in and raced tight against MULTIMAX.
At the 950 Metres, LOOK ERAS raced in restricted room between MULTIMAX and LUCKY GUY which initially shifted in of its own accord and then approaching the first turn near the 900 Metres was taken in marginally by COLCHESTER (W M Lai) which shifted in.  As a consequence, LOOK ERAS had to be steadied and lost its position.  W M Lai was advised that whilst there were a number of contributing factors to this incident, nonetheless he was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is fully clear when shifting ground in future.
For some distance after the 900 Metres, LUCKY GUY raced ungenerously and got its head up when racing in restricted room between COLCHESTER and ARM RUNDA which shifted out slightly when awkwardly placed close to the heels of FANTASTIC EIGHT which, when being steadied away from the heels of KING MORTAR, got its head up and shifted out abruptly across the heels of that horse.  LOOK ERAS, which was racing behind LUCKY GUY, had to be steadied away from the heels of that horse near the 800 Metres.  RADIANT TREASURE, which was following, also got its head up and shifted out abruptly.
Approaching the 700 Metres, MULTIMAX commenced to race keenly and improved into tight running between ARM RUNDA and LUCKY GUY which resulted in MULTIMAX and LUCKY GUY racing tight for some distance.
COLCHESTER, which raced wide and without cover, made the Home Turn awkwardly and shifted ground.
Soon after straightening, ARM RUNDA improved into tight running between KING MORTAR and FANTASTIC EIGHT.
After leaving the 400 Metres, THE JUDGE, which was making ground on the rail, was steadied when momentarily placed in restricted room inside JADE THEATRE which shifted in before being corrected and directed back out.
When placed under pressure approaching the 150 Metres, FANTASTIC EIGHT (K C Leung) shifted in, resulting in ARM RUNDA being tightened onto KING MORTAR.  After FANTASTIC EIGHT was shifted back out to afford KING MORTAR and ARM RUNDA comfortable racing room, ARM RUNDA got its head on the side and lay in which resulted in KING MORTAR becoming unbalanced when crowded onto the running rail.  K C Leung was advised that whilst the Stewards acknowledged that ARM RUNDA had exacerbated the incident by being inclined to lay in, nonetheless he should have reacted in a more timely manner to correct his mount.
At the 150 Metres, THE JUDGE was severely hampered when crowded for room inside MULTIMAX (K C Ng) which hung in and away from LUCKY GUY which shifted in marginally.  K C Ng was advised that whilst the Stewards accepted that his mount was proving difficult to ride at this stage, in similar circumstances he must do all in his power to prevent his mount from causing interference to other runners. 
A veterinary inspection of LUCKY GUY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
ARM RUNDA and FANTASTIC EIGHT were sent for sampling.

ISHVARA shifted out at the start, tightening WINWIN RUBY onto VOLITATION.

RATTAN began awkwardly.

Trainer P F Yiu confirmed that due to on pace runners appearing to be favoured today, he had asked Apprentice Poon to have CITRON SPIRIT placed a little more prominently than what it normally would be in its races.  A veterinary inspection of CITRON SPIRIT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of FANTASTIC KAKA immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of ISHVARA immediately following the race confirmed the horse to be a "roarerâ which had previously been reported.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that RATTAN had sustained a small overreach wound to the inside of the right front heel.
RATTAN, CHEERFUL BOY and SMILING CHARM were sent for sampling.
<22/5/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>ISHVARA, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time the horse was confirmed to be a "roarerâ which had previously been reported. OPTIMISM began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped AEROLUMINANCE.

As the start was effected, SKY TREASURE put its head down and consequently was slow to begin.
SHARPMIND began awkwardly.
ENCHANTED FEELING was crowded for room on jumping between SECRET AGENT and WINNING VIBE which shifted out.  In this incident, ENCHANTED FEELING became unbalanced, shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of SECRET AGENT which also became badly unbalanced and then shifted out away from that horse which caused FAIR COMMENT to be crowded for room.

Approaching the 600 Metres, FAIR COMMENT and CAREFREE LET GO raced tight.

For some distance after this, FAIR COMMENT got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of SHARPMIND.

When questioned, H W Lai stated that he had been asked to allow UNLEASHED DRAGON to use its natural speed in the early stages and obtain a position with cover where he was able.  He said UNLEASHED DRAGON began well, however, a number of horses which had drawn better barriers than his mount were hard ridden and for this reason he attempted to shift across behind those runners in the early stages to obtain cover.  He said as it took some time to obtain cover, initially behind SHARPMIND, this allowed FAIR COMMENT the opportunity to maintain its position inside UNLEASHED DRAGON and therefore he elected, after riding his mount along making the turn near the 1000 Metres, to steady UNLEASHED DRAGON to obtain a position closer to the rail.  Mr R Gibson, the trainer of UNLEASHED DRAGON, stated that it had been anticipated that the horse would be able to show more speed in the early stages than it did even with the blinkers removed.  He said it was now his intention to consider reapplying the blinkers to UNLEASHED DRAGON in an endeavour to have the horse show more early speed in its races.  Mr Gibson was advised that his evidence was noted.
A veterinary inspection of CAREFREE LET GO immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
BOND ELEGANCE and SKY TREASURE were sent for sampling.

On arrival at the track, it was noted that VERY RICH MAN had sustained an abrasion over the front of its right front fetlock.  VERY RICH MAN was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in in his opinion it was suitable to race.

A veterinary inspection of SEE ME NOW immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

HAPPY ROCKY was crowded for room on jumping between CONTRIBUTION and GO GO WIN, both of which shifted ground.

HEHA BOY and THE JOY OF GIVING were slow to begin.

Approaching the winning post on the first occasion, MAGNETISM raced tight inside SPICY SURE which was taken in by LAND GRANT before that horse was directed out to relieve the tightening.
Approaching the 1300 Metres, APACHE SPIRIT and HEHA BOY raced tight inside TRENDY WIN which shifted in before being directed back out to relieve the tightening.

Near the 100 Metres, GRANITE BELT was steadied when unable to continue improving between SPICY SURE and LAND GRANT (C Schofield) which, when being ridden along, got its head on the side and shifted in.  GRANITE BELT was then unable to be tested over the concluding stages.  C Schofield was advised that whilst the Stewards accepted that LAND GRANT lay in under pressure in the Straight, nonetheless he was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he makes sufficient endeavour to prevent his mounts from shifting ground.
When questioned, Apprentice H N Wong stated that he had been asked to ride SUPER SPRINTER positively and obtain the lead.  He said he was asked to ensure that he rode the horse such that it would not be able to be taken on in the lead as it was felt that the horseâs best opportunity to win the race was for it to obtain an uncontested lead.  He said in accordance with his instructions, from barrier 1, he rode his mount vigorously in the early stages to ensure that he led the race.  He said after passing the winning post on the first occasion he was able to establish the lead with SPICY SURE on his outside and he attempted to steady SUPER SPRINTER to have the race run at a tempo that would allow the horse to finish off the race.  He said passing the 1100 Metres he was aware that SPICY SURE was racing to his outside and marginally behind SUPER SPRINTER and at the 900 Metres he had a glance to his outside to ensure that that horse was not going to improve its position to contest the lead with SUPER SPRINTER.  He added whilst this resulted in the race being run at a more genuine tempo than he had hoped, at the time he believed that it was best for SUPER SPRINTER to be ridden in this manner so as to ensure that it was not challenged in the lead.

THE SYLPH and ACCLAIMED LIGHT were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
Approaching the winning post on the first occasion, UNICORN was crowded for room between TEN FLAMES and LITTERATEUR (Z Purton) which shifted in marginally when travelling keenly.  Z Purton was advised that whilst the Stewards acknowledged that he had made an attempt to remain racing in a three wide position at this time and that he had gone for several holds on the horse in an endeavour to have it race more generously, nonetheless he was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he makes every endeavour to provide his fellow riders with comfortable racing room.

Passing the 850 Metres, LITTLE ISLAND was taken wider by UNICORN which shifted out to improve.

Apprentice Wong was advised that, in the opinion of the Stewards, he had erred at this time by forcing ENERGETIC CLASS into a more forward position given the tempo of the race. CIRCUIT KING shifted out at the start, resulting in KING OF MONGOLIA being crowded out onto DIEGO KOSTA which became unbalanced after being bumped by KING OF MONGOLIA.

GENERAL IRON, which was fractious in the barriers, turned its head to the left just prior to the start being effected and then began very awkwardly and lost ground.

PLAY IT lost ground on jumping after beginning very awkwardly.

MOMENTUM LUCKY was crowded for room on jumping between PABLOSKY and TURF SPRINT which shifted out.  In this incident, MOMENTUM LUCKY bumped the hindquarters of PABLOSKY which became unbalanced.

A FAST ONE, which was fractious in the barriers, was slow to begin and then shortly after the start was crowded for room between FANTASTIC FABIO which was taken out by FLYING NOBLE and WHISTLE UP which was taken in by ZERO HEDGE.  In this incident, A FAST ONE blundered.
TELECOM TITAN was slow to begin.

GOLDEN ACHIEVER began awkwardly.
