He said rather than covering unnecessary ground, he elected to steady AMBITIOUS PINS and trail GOLD VELVET into the Home Straight.  He added after placing his mount under pressure in the early part of the Straight, AMBITIOUS PINS did not quicken and appeared reluctant to improve between VARA PEARL and GOLD VELVET for some distance after the 200 Metres.  He said whilst the pace of the race was not to AMBITIOUS PINSâ advantage, nonetheless the horse was disappointing in the manner in which it failed to close off the race.  A veterinary inspection of AMBITIOUS PINS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of CHEERS CONQUEROR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ELECTRIC LIGHTNING and HAPPY AND HEALTHY were sent for sampling.

DR WIN WIN was withdrawn on 27.5.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (unacceptable action).  Before being allowed to race again, DR WIN WIN will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After leaving the Parade Ring but prior to entering the track, H Bowman was dislodged from SUNNY WAY without incident.
STARLIT KNIGHT was slow to begin.
SIR REDALOT began awkwardly.
DIAMOND DRAGON shifted in at the start and bumped WINNER DONâT MISS.  After this, from a wide barrier, DIAMOND DRAGON was steadied and shifted across behind runners.
Approaching the 900 Metres, SKYROCKETS was steadied away from the heels of SIR REDALOT (J Moreira) which shifted in when not properly clear.  J Moreira was advised to ensure that he is properly clear when shifting ground in similar circumstances.
Approaching the 600 Metres, AGREE raced tight between DUKEDOM and SUNNY WAY which got its head on the side and lay in.
Rounding the Home turn, DIAMOND DRAGON shifted out and bumped STARLIT KNIGHT.
At the entrance to the Straight, WINNER DON'T MISS was shifted out away from the heels of AGREE which was taken out by DUKEDOM.
MIGHTY MAVERICK lay in under pressure in the Straight.
Throughout the race, WINNER DONâT MISS travelled wide and without cover and in the Straight gave ground.
A veterinary inspection of AGREE immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm.  Before being allowed to race again, AGREE will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of CELESTIAL NOVA immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, CELESTIAL NOVA will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on SKYROCKETS at the request of Trainer P F Yiu.  The Veterinary Surgeon reported that this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, SKYROCKETS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SUNNY WAY, DUKEDOM and SIR REDALOT were sent for sampling.

SANTA FE SUN was withdrawn on 27.5.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore).  Before being allowed to race again, SANTA FE SUN will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
As the start was effected, CLEVER BEAVER reared and lost a considerable amount of ground.  After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that CLEVER BEAVER was lame in its right front and right hind legs.  Before being allowed to race again, CLEVER BEAVER will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
HEALTHY JOYFUL and SUPER CHIC bumped at the start.  HEALTHY JOYFUL was then crowded for room a short distance after the start between SUPER CHIC and BULLISH SMART which shifted out.
From the outside barriers, ALL YOU WISH and STAR MAJESTIC were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After the 1200 Metres, MIDNIGHT RATTLER commenced to prove very difficult to settle and approaching the 1100 Metres shifted out away from the heels of MY DARLING and in doing so bumped the hindquarters of CONSORT which became unbalanced.
Passing the 400 Metres, STAR MAJESTIC was bumped by ALL YOU WISH which shifted out to obtain clear running.
Throughout the race, CONSORT (S de Sousa) travelled wide and without cover and in the Straight gave ground.  Prior to leaving the track, S de Sousa dismounted from CONSORT.  A veterinary inspection of CONSORT immediately following the race found that horse to have swelling over the outside of the right front fetlock.  Before being allowed to race again, CONSORT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination. 
Apprentice M F Poon was not able to offer any explanation for the performance of MIDNIGHT RATTLER.  He said although the horse was inclined to over-race in the early stages and was obliged to travel three wide, it at all times had cover, however, did not quicken when placed under pressure and then did not finish off the race.  A veterinary inspection of MIDNIGHT RATTLER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MY DARLING and HANGâS DECISION were sent for sampling.

At declaration time, C Y Ho was declared as the rider of both GOOD FOR YOU and REAL DEAL.  It was established that C Y Ho had a firm commitment to ride GOOD FOR YOU.  As such, the Stewards permitted W M Lai to be substituted as the rider of REAL DEAL.  For this declaration error, C Y Ho was fined $2,000.
BOSSIEE began only fairly.
BRILLIANT DREAM and SUCH A HAPPINESS were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
After being brushed by TEAM SWEET, REAL DEAL shifted in at the start and bumped GOOD FOR YOU.
BRILLIANT DREAM lost its left front plate near the 1300 Metres.
Approaching the 1000 Metres, TEAM SWEET momentarily raced in restricted room between GOOD FOR YOU and SUCH A HAPPINESS which shifted in.
Approaching the 500 Metres, RELENTLESS ME shifted out and bumped SILLY BUDDIES.  SUCH A HAPPINESS, which was racing to the outside of SILLY BUDDIES, was shifted out away from that horse in consequence.
Passing the 400 Metres, SUCH A HAPPINESS was bumped by C P POWER which shifted out to obtain clear running.
BOSSIEE had some difficulty obtaining clear running passing the 300 Metres.
TEAM SWEET was held up for clear running from passing the 200 Metres until near the 150 Metres.
For the majority of the race, AUTOPAY travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, Apprentice M F Poon stated that he had been asked to ride BRILLIANT DREAM quietly in the early stages to ensure that it did not over-race.  He said in a number of its previous starts, BRILLIANT DREAM had proved difficult to settle and he was asked to take the horse back in the field and switch it off if possible.  He said in accordance with his instructions he rode BRILLIANT DREAM quietly in the early stages, however, the horse, despite his best efforts, commenced to prove very difficult to settle after the 1100 Metres and got its head up repeatedly when being checked away from the heels of TEAM SWEET approaching and passing the 1000 Metres.  He said he had been instructed for BRILLIANT DREAM to make its running down the outside of horses to ensure that it had an uninterrupted run.  He said because of this, although there was an opportunity to improve his position closer to the rail, he elected to shift to the outside of TEAM SWEET after the 700 Metres as he saw that SUCH A HAPPINESS, a horse he considered to be a strong chance in the race, commencing to shift out and improve its position at this time.  He said he felt that shifting to the outside of TEAM SWEET at this time would allow him the opportunity to improve to be racing behind SUCH A HAPPINESS with a view to that horse then taking him into the Straight.  He said although this resulted in BRILLIANT DREAM covering more ground than he otherwise would have hoped, nonetheless he felt that this was in the best interests of the horse at that time given that he had been instructed to shift BRILLIANT DREAM to the outside of runners.  Apprentice Poon added that he followed AUTOPAY which was racing to the outside of SUCH A HAPPINESS into the Straight and then immediately on straightening shifted BRILLIANT DREAM to the outside of that runner to ensure that the horse had clear and uninterrupted running.  Mr D J Hall, the trainer of BRILLIANT DREAM, confirmed that he had instructed Apprentice Poon to ensure that the horse was settled in the early and middle stages due to the horseâs previous tendency to over-race.  He said BRILLIANT DREAM had performed well in a recent barrier trial and for this reason he was confident that the horse would race well today.  He also confirmed that he had instructed Apprentice Poon, if possible to shift to the outside, however, he believed that Apprentice Poon had erred by shifting BRILLIANT DREAM wide earlier in the race than had been necessary.  Apprentice Poon was advised that, in the opinion of the Stewards, he had covered unnecessary ground by shifting the horse to the outside of TEAM SWEET near the 700 Metres when there was a clear opportunity for the horse to save ground prior to the Home Turn.  He was further advised to ensure that he rides his mounts in such a manner so that they can finish off their race as best as they are able.  A veterinary inspection of BRILLIANT DREAM immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, BRILLIANT DREAM will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of and REGENCY BABY immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, REGENCY BABY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
C P POWER and SUCH A HAPPINESS were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE STANDARD CHARTERED CHAMPIONS & CHATER CUP
incident_report:
GOLD MOUNT shifted out at the start and bumped the hindquarters of HELENE CHARISMA which became unbalanced.
DESIGNS ON ROME and EAGLE WAY were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
GOLD MOUNT lay out rounding the Home Turn.
EAGLE WAY, WERTHER and BLAZING SPEED were sent for sampling.
<29/5/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>The Veterinary Officer reported that DESIGNS ON ROME had a restricted action and sore and swollen both front fetlocks on the morning after racing.  Before being allowed to race again, DESIGNS ON ROME will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

D B PIN and AMAZING KIDS began only fairly and were then shifted across behind runners.
MAGIC LEGEND shifted out at the start and brushed SUN JEWELLERY.
THEWIZARDOFOZ and STRATHMORE bumped at the start.
Approaching the 1000 Metres, D B PIN got its head up when travelling keenly and then approaching the 900 Metres shifted out away from the heels of NOT LISTENINâTOME, resulting in THEWIZARDOFOZ being taken out onto STRATHMORE.  D B PIN then made the turn near the 850 Metres awkwardly.
Near the 350 Metres, STRATHMORE, which was commencing to give ground, was steadied away from the heels of MR STUNNING which, when improving into tight running outside D B PIN, was taken out marginally by that horse.  MR STUNNING then lay out under pressure for the remainder of the race.
Close to the finishing line, AMAZING KIDS was shifted in away from the heels of MR STUNNING.
Throughout the race, STRATHMORE travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of MR STUNNING immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MAGIC LEGEND, LUCKY YEAR and D B PIN were sent for sampling.

HIGH AND MIGHTY stood flat-footed as the start was effected and consequently lost a considerable amount of ground.  Before being allowed to race again, HIGH AND MIGHTY will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.
As the start was effected, HINYUEN SWIFTNESS lifted its front feet off the ground, began awkwardly and then was bumped by BANK ON RED.
BEAUTY KINGDOM shifted out at the start and bumped WINSTONâS LAD.
EASY TOUCH and OUTLAWED bumped at the start.
CELESTIAL ARROW travelled keenly for some distance after the 1200 Metres.
For some distance passing the 900 Metres, BEAUTY KINGDOM was awkwardly placed close to the heels of OUTLAWED (C Schofield) which shifted in when not properly clear.  C Schofield was severely reprimanded and advised to ensure that he provides sufficient clearance when shifting ground.
Approaching the 800 Metres, HIGH AND MIGHTY raced in restricted room inside WINSTONâS LAD.
After the 800 Metres, CELESTIAL ARROW was left racing wide and without cover.
HIGH AND MIGHTY was crowded for room rounding the Home Turn between CELESTIAL ARROW and SUPER LEADER which was taken out by LUCKY DOUBLE EIGHT which was shifted out away from the heels of PENANG HALL.
Throughout the race, WINSTONâS LAD travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of BEAUTY KINGDOM immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of OUTLAWED immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, OUTLAWED will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
PENANG HALL and GREEN CARD were sent for sampling.

GRAN MASTER shifted in at the start and bumped the hindquarters of PROUD SKY which became unbalanced.
WINASWEWISH, which was being steadied to obtain cover, was crowded for room shortly after the start between COOL BROTHERS and WORKS OF ART, both of which shifted ground.
From a wide barrier, GOOD FIT was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Approaching the 1700 Metres, GRAN MASTER got its head up when racing in restricted room inside SMART UNION which was racing tight inside COOL BROTHERS (O Doleuze) which shifted in.  O Doleuze was advised to exercise more when shifting ground.
After passing the winning post on the first occasion, BEST TANGO was left racing wide and without cover and after the 1200 Metres was allowed to improve its position forward of WORKS OF ART and COOL BROTHERS to assume the lead passing the 800 Metres.
Near the 750 Metres, CROWN AVENUE and SMART UNION raced tight as CROWN AVENUE shifted out to improve.  After this, SMART UNION travelled wide and without cover.
Near the 250 Metres, C Schofield (CROWN AVENUE) dropped his whip.
Close to the finishing line, WINASWEWISH raced tight outside GRAN MASTER which drifted out under pressure.
The performance of SMART UNION, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, SMART UNION will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of WORKS OF ART, N Callan stated that he was able to take up a forward position in the early stages as instructed.  He said passing the 1300 Metres BEST TANGO worked its way forward around WORKS OF ART and as the rider of that horse appeared intent on leading, he elected to allow BEST TANGO to cross and was able to then take up a position to that horseâs outside.  He said during this time of the race WORKS OF ART travelled well and he felt that the horse would finish off the race strongly.  He said however that approaching the 500 Metres he commenced to niggle at WORKS OF ART, but the horse did not respond to his riding and did not show any turn of foot.  He added WORKS OF ART came under heavy pressure rounding the Home Turn and, despite being fully tested, was disappointing in the manner in which it weakened.  He said after the race WORKS OF ART appeared to pull up sound.  A veterinary inspection of WORKS OF ART immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of WORKS OF ART, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, WORKS OF ART will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that PROUD SKY had sustained a small wound to the outside of the right hind cannon.
A veterinary inspection of GOOD FIT and COOL BROTHERS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CROWN AVENUE and GRAN MASTER were sent for sampling.
<1/6/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>COOL BROTHERS, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  COOL BROTHERS was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer C W Chang this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right front leg with a sore fetlock.  Before being allowed to race again, COOL BROTHERS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

SWEET BEAN began only fairly.
HAPPY FRIENDSHIP and GENTLEMEN bumped at the start.
From wide barriers, HOLY UNICORN and ATOMIC BLAST were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 1500 Metres, DRAGON GLORY was awkwardly placed close to the heels of CONSISTENT.
FAITHFUL BOY travelled wide and without cover until passing the 1100 Metres.
Passing the 1100 Metres, VIVACIOUS WINNER was bumped by DIAMOND FRIENDS which shifted in.
Passing the 800 Metres, CHEERFUL FRAME was bumped and taken wider by VIVACIOUS WINNER which shifted out to improve.
Passing the 600 Metres, SWEET BEAN was held up behind DRAGON GLORY.
Approaching the 500 Metres, CHEERFUL FRAME and DIAMOND FRIENDS raced tight outside DRAGON GLORY which was taken out by CONSISTENT.
Passing the 500 Metres, FUN MANAGER raced tight between HAPPY FRIENDSHIP and GENTLEMEN which shifted out.
Near the 400 Metres, CONSISTENT was awkwardly placed close to the heels of FUN MANAGER and then shifted out away from the heels of that horse, inconveniencing DRAGON GLORY.
After the race, J Moreira was not able to offer any explanation for the disappointing performance of NOTED PERFORMER.  He said the horse travelled satisfactorily in the race, however, after being placed under pressure did not finish off its race.  A veterinary inspection of NOTED PERFORMER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of ATOMIC BLAST immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GENTLEMEN and SWEET BEAN were sent for sampling.

FOR YIU POWER UP began only fairly and then throughout the race hung out before finishing tailed out.  The performance of FOR YIU POWER UP was considered unacceptable.  A veterinary inspection of FOR YIU POWER UP immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Before being allowed to race again, FOR YIU POWER UP will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial around a bend and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
HORSE SUPREMO shifted out at the start and bumped MONEY MONEY which in turn shifted out and bumped MASSIVE MILLENNIUM.
FOREVER FUN began only fairly and shortly after the start was steadied away from the heels of STARLOT which shifted in marginally.
From the outside barrier, RAPHAEL was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Despite being hard ridden, LOOK ERAS took a considerable time to muster speed.
Approaching the 1100 Metres, FOREVER FUN raced tight inside MONEY MONEY which got its head on the side and shifted in away from the heels of STARLOT.
Making the turn after the 700 Metres, MASSIVE MILLENNIUM got its head on the side and lay out.
Approaching the 600 Metres, FOREVER FUN was awkwardly placed inside the heels of MONEY MONEY.
For the majority of the race, both MASSIVE MILLENNIUM and OUR FOLKS travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned regarding the performance of STARLOT, C Schofield stated that whilst he was happy with the position that he was able to obtain in the early and middle stages, the horse did not travel as strongly as it did when he rode it at its most recent start.  He said STARLOT came under pressure after the 500 Metres and then did not quicken as he thought it would.  He said after this STARLOT finished off the race one-paced and, in his opinion, was disappointing.  A veterinary inspection of STARLOT immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, STARLOT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After the race, K C Leung stated that MONEY MONEY came under heavy pressure after the 700 Metres and, despite being ridden out, gave ground.  He said after the race MONEY MONEY was reluctant to proceed back to the unplaced saddling area and for this reason he elected to dismount from MONEY MONEY and have the horse led back.  A veterinary inspection of MONEY MONEY immediately following the race found that horse to have sustained a small overreach wound to the outside of the left front heel.  Before being allowed to race again, MONEY MONEY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
STARLOT, KIROV and MASSIVE MILLENNIUM were sent for sampling.
<1/6/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>MONEY MONEY, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time the horse had sustained a small overreach wound to the outside of the left front heel.  MONEY MONEY was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer T P Yung this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its left front leg.  As previously advised, MONEY MONEY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.

IâM THE WON FOR U began awkwardly and shortly after the start was shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
From wide barriers, IMPERIAL CONCORDE and PREMIUM CHAMPION were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
In the early and middle stages, TURIN PEARL travelled wide and without cover and after the 1000 Metres was allowed to improve its position in order to cross CURLING LUXURY to its inside to race outside the leader FIVE STARS AGENT.  As TURIN PEARL established a position outside FIVE STARS AGENT, that horse then shifted out into a one-off position passing the 900 Metres which resulted in TURIN PEARL having to remain racing in a three wide position without cover for the remainder of the race.
Passing the 1300 Metres, FIVE STARS AGENT got its head up on a number of occasions when being steadied in the lead.
FOREVER POSH got its head on the side and made the turn after the 1300 Metres awkwardly.
Approaching the 1000 Metres, CAPE THE FAITH was awkwardly placed close to the heels of CURLING LUXURY.
Passing the 400 Metres, SPICY KAKA was shifted to the outside of FIVE STARS AGENT after being awkwardly placed behind and inside the heels of that runner.
Rounding the Home Turn, EXPEDITE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of CAPE THE FAITH.  IMPERIAL CONCORDE, which was following EXPEDITE, was held up behind that horse in consequence.
After the race, K C Leung advised that EXPEDITE became unbalanced of its own accord near the 100 Metres.
A veterinary inspection of CAPE THE FAITH immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
A veterinary inspection of FOREVER POSH immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FIVE STARS AGENT, SPICY KAKA and TURIN PEARL were sent for sampling.

BORN DRAGON was withdrawn on 30.5.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter BEAR RAPPER (K Teetan).  Before being allowed to race again, BORN DRAGON will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
FLYING GODSPELL began awkwardly and shortly after the start was bumped by SMILING GLORY.
CALIFORNIA ASPAR was crowded for room on jumping between BOLSHOI BALLET and STAR SUPERIOR which shifted in.  After this, CALIFORNIA ASPAR and BOLSHOI BALLET continued to race tight for some distance.
BEAR RAPPER shifted out at the start, resulting in JIMSON THE FAMOUS being hampered.
Passing the 800 Metres, JIMSON THE FAMOUS improved into tight running between BEAR RAPPER and GOLDIE FLANKER.  After this, JIMSON THE FAMOUS raced in restricted room for some distance between those horses and passing the 700 Metres shifted in and brushed the hindquarters of GOLDIE FLANKER which then became unbalanced and shifted out, causing JIMSON THE FAMOUS to be crowded for room inside BEAR RAPPER.
Near the 250 Metres, BOLSHOI BALLET was brushed and taken wider by GOLDIE FLANKER which shifted out to obtain clear running.
Passing the 200 Metres, SMILING GLORY was momentarily held up for clear running behind FISH Nâ CHIPS.
Near the 150 Metres, O Doleuze (GIDDY GIDDY) dropped his whip.
For the majority of the race, SALSA BROTHERS travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of EVEREST and FLYING GODSPELL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
BOLSHOI BALLET, GOLDIE FLANKER and STAR SUPERIOR were sent for sampling.

MEGA TREASURE was withdrawn on raceday morning by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (nasal laceration).  Before being allowed to race again, MEGA TREASURE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
RADIANT BUNNY began only fairly.
Shortly after the start, BORNTOACHIEVE, which was being ridden along to obtain a forward position, was crowded for room between JOYFUL MOMENTS and PRIMERO which was taken out by MR PICASSO which in turn was awkwardly placed outside the heels of DOLLAR REWARD which shifted out.
In the early stages, when being ridden along to obtain a forward position, BIG FLASH (Apprentice M F Poon) hung in and proved difficult to ride.  Then making the turn near the 700 Metres, SUNNY WIN was checked when crowded for room inside JOYFUL MOMENTS which was bumped and taken in by URBAN CHIC which itself was taken in by BIG FLASH which got its head on the side and hung in despite the considerable efforts of its rider.  Apprentice Poon was advised that in the circumstances the Stewards were satisfied that he had made all reasonable endeavours to prevent BIG FLASH from shifting in and accordingly no further action was taken.  RADIANT BUNNY, which was following SUNNY WIN, was steadied away from the heels of that horse in consequence.  Apprentice Poon stated that at no stage of the race did BIG FLASH feel comfortable in its action.  He said whilst he was not able to detect any lameness issues with BIG FLASH, nonetheless the horse did not appear to be striding out fluently and hung in throughout the race.  He added BIG FLASH came under heavy pressure rounding the Home Turn and then, despite being tested, gave ground abruptly to finish at the tail of the field.  A veterinary inspection of BIG FLASH immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of BIG FLASH, one of the favoured runners for tonightâs race, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, BIG FLASH will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
In the early and middle stages, DOLLAR REWARD lay out.
Near the 450 Metres, RADIANT BUNNY became badly unbalanced when momentarily crowded for room inside DOLLAR REWARD which was racing tight inside URBAN CHIC which was awkwardly placed close to the heels of BIG FLASH as that horse commenced to give ground.
JOYFUL MOMENTS and SUNNY WIN were sent for sampling.

From wide barriers, FRIENDS OF KA YING and WHAT ELSE BUT YOU were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Despite being ridden along in the early stages, LITTLE DRAGON failed to muster speed.
After the race, Apprentice M F Poon stated that SOLAR HEI HEI, after having been ridden into a forward position, weakened noticeably over the concluding stages.  He said the only explanation he could find for the performance of the horse was that it was having its first start on the All Weather Track tonight.  A veterinary inspection of SOLAR HEI HEI immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of VANILLA immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, VANILLA will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
PEOPLEâS KNIGHT, KING GENKI and WHAT ELSE BUT YOU were sent for sampling.

ROYAL PERFORMER and BEAUTY LOVE bumped at the start.
GOLDEN SUN was crowded for room on jumping between APOLLOâS CHOICE which was taken in by UNIQUE JOYOUS and OCULIST which was taken out by LUCKY DAY.
ENORMOUS HONOUR began only fairly, shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of DEJA VU which became unbalanced and shifted out onto PACKING GENIUS.  After this, ENORMOUS HONOUR was shifted across behind runners from a wide barrier.
The whip of M L Yeung (PACKING GENIUS) broke shortly after the start.
For some distance after the 1500 Metres, WHITE MAGIC got its head up when proving difficult to settle.
O Doleuze (ROYAL PERFORMER) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 650 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of LUCKY DAY, resulting in that horse being crowded for room, clipping the heels of ROYAL PERFORMER and blundering.  O Doleuze was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 14 June 2017 and to expire on Monday, 19 June 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, O Doleuze was fined $10,000.
Approaching and passing the 400 Metres, APOLLOâS CHOICE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of LUCKY DAY when endeavouring to improve to the outside of that horse.
Near the 150 Metres, WHITE MAGIC was shifted to the inside of RED MARVEL (J Moreira) after being awkwardly placed outside that horse which shifted out when being ridden along.  J Moreira was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he makes more effort than he did on this occasion to prevent his mounts from shifting ground.
Approaching the 100 Metre, OCULIST was momentarily steadied away from the heels of GOLDEN SUN (C Schofield) which shifted out to obtain clear running.  C Schofield was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is properly clear when shifting ground in similar circumstances.
Throughout the race, DEJA VU and PACKING GENIUS travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of BEAUTY LOVE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ROYAL PERFORMER, RED MARVEL and GOLDEN SUN were sent for sampling.
<1/6/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>The Veterinary Officer reported that HAY RUN was lame in its right hind leg on the morning after racing.  Before being allowed to race again, HAY RUN will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

TELECOM SUN and FANTASTIC SHOW began only fairly.
A SHIN HOOF was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
When questioned, C Murray stated that he was asked to ride RIVERSIDE BIRD in a forward position and race outside LUCKY MASTER, a stablemate of RIVERSIDE BIRD which was anticipated to lead the race.  He said in the early stages RIVERSIDE BIRD proved difficult to settle when being steadied to obtain the anticipated position outside LUCKY MASTER.  He said approaching the 900 Metres he shifted in to race outside LUCKY MASTER and in advance of BONUS KING but after the 900 Metres RIVERSIDE BIRD got its head on the side and lay out which resulted in BONUS KING being able to improve its position inside RIVERSIDE BIRD and causing RIVERSIDE BIRD to be left racing wide and without cover for the remainder of the race.  He added RIVERSIDE BIRD again hung out making the Home Turn.  C Murray was advised that his riding of RIVERSIDE BIRD in the early stages had come under notice and he must ensure that he rides his mounts in such a manner so that they do not cover unnecessary ground and that they are given full opportunity to finish off their races.  
LUCKY MASTER and FANTASTIC SHOW were sent for sampling.

WONDERFUL TIGER, which was fractious and reared in the barriers, will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test before being allowed to race again.
WHAT MAN HORSE bounded in the air at the start and consequently was slow to begin.
WONDERFUL TIGER and THE JAZZ began only fairly.
GENERAL DINO shifted out at the start and bumped MONGOLIAN KING which in turn shifted out and bumped LETâSâ TAKE IT EASY.
Approaching the 1100 Metres, SUPER MAN was steadied away from the heels of VICTORY DAY (Apprentice H T Mo) which shifted in when not properly clear.  Apprentice Mo was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is sufficiently clear when shifting ground.
Near the 850 Metres, LUCKY GUY raced tight inside BEAUTY FLARE which lay in despite the efforts of its rider.
TANG FLEMING travelled wide and without cover until passing the 800  Metres.
At the 600 Metres, WONDERFUL TIGER was bumped and taken wider by MONGOLIAN KING which shifted out.
At the entrance to the Straight, WONDERFUL TIGER was bumped by GENERAL DINO which shifted out.  HAPPY CHEERS, which was following, was shifted in away from the heels of WONDERFUL TIGER.
Passing the 300 Metres, GAMECHANGERS and SUPER MAN brushed due both horses shifting ground.
Passing the 200 Metres, SUPER MAN was crowded for room outside GAMECHANGERS (S Clipperton) which shifted out before being corrected by its rider.  S Clipperton was reprimanded and advised that he should have reacted quicker than he did to straighten GAMECHANGERS.  In this incident, SUPER MAN shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of TANG FLEMING which became unbalanced.
A veterinary inspection of TANG FLEMING immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, TANG FLEMING will be subjected to an official veterinary examination. 
A veterinary inspection of GENERAL DINO immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
LUCKY GUY, MONGOLIAN KING and INTREPIC were sent for sampling.
<5/6/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>The Veterinary Officer reported that HAPPY CHEERS was lame in its left hind leg on the morning after racing.  Before being allowed to race again, HAPPY CHEERS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

FINE WITH ME shifted out at the start and made heavy contact with MASTER BERLINI which became badly unbalanced.
M REBORN began only fairly.
MASTER STEED and SOUL ACHIEVER were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
Approaching the 1000 Metres, HAPPY SEA DRAGON got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of NONE OTHER.
Approaching and passing the 900 Metres, AMAZING MOMENT travelled keenly when being steadied in the lead.
Passing the 900 Metres, MASTER BERLINI and HAPPY SEA DRAGON bumped.
Making the turn after the 900 Metres, IVICTORY got its head on the side and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of AMAZING MOMENT.
Approaching the 800 Metres, HAPPY SEA DRAGON was left racing wide and without cover.
For some distance approaching and passing the 700 Metres, MASTER STEED travelled keenly and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of MASTER BERLINI and then near the 600 Metres, when continuing to be awkwardly placed behind MASTER BERLINI, shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of M REBORN.
After initially being shifted to the outside of AMAZING MOMENT approaching the 300 Metres, IVICTORY was then shifted back to the inside of that horse when disappointed for running between AMAZING MOMENT and NOBLE DE BOY.
Over the concluding stages, AMAZING MOMENT and NOBLE DE BOY raced tight.
A veterinary inspection of FINE WITH ME immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
IVICTORY and NOBLE DE BOY were sent for sampling.

THUNDER DASH was withdrawn on 3.6.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and was replaced by first Standby Declared Starter CATCHMEIFYOUCAN (C Williams).  BRILLIANT MONKEYS was also withdrawn on 3.6.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right hind) and was replaced by second Standby Declared Starter SHINING CHAMPION (H W Lai).  Before being allowed to race again, THUNDER DASH and BRILLIANT MONKEYS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
TELECOM BOOM was slow to begin.
YOURTHEWONFORME began awkwardly.
LE PEGASE began only fairly and then shortly after the start was bumped by SHINING CHAMPION.
HAPPY BEAUTY began only fairly and was then crowded for room between SHINING CHAMPION and POWER DRAGON which shifted in abruptly.  After this, SHINING CHAMPION was shifted across behind runners.
Despite being hard ridden in the early stages, SUPER SWEET ORANGE failed to muster speed.  Then for some distance approaching and passing the 1100 Metres, SUPER SWEET ORANGE got its head up when travelling keenly and awkwardly placed close to the heels of BORN TO RACE.
After the 1000 Metres, POWER DRAGON got its head up when steadied away from the heels of HURRICANE KID (S Clipperton) which shifted in when not properly clear.  S Clipperton was advised to ensure that he provides sufficient clearance prior to shifting ground in similar circumstances.
Near the 800 Metres, LE PEGASE was left racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 400 Metres, HAPPY BEAUTY was brushed by SUPER SWEET ORANGE which shifted out to improve into tight running between HAPPY BEAUTY and LE PEGASE.
BORN TO RACE (C Schofield) was held up for clear running from near the 250 Metres until after passing the 200 Metres.  After the race, C Schofield was unable to offer any explanation for the disappointing performance of BORN TO RACE which he said raced "flatâ today.  A veterinary inspection of BORN TO RACE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Passing the 200 Metres, CASH COURIER and SUPERNATURAL bumped.
A veterinary inspection of SUPER SWEET ORANGE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

The Veterinary Surgeon reported that this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, POWER DRAGON will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SUPER SWEET ORANGE, REWARDING FLYER and YOURTHEWONFORME were sent for sampling.

HAPPY HAPPY and SUPER EURO STAR were hampered and MORDICUS (C Williams) checked when crowded for room between MULTIMAX which shifted out and FOREVER ACCURATE which shifted in after being bumped by ENDEARING.  CELEBRATION was hampered shortly after the start by ENDEARING which shifted out to relieve the tightening to FOREVER ACCURATE.  CELEBRATION was then steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners from the outside barrier.  C Williams confirmed that it had been intended for MORDICUS to be ridden in a forward position, however, when MORDICUS was crowded for room, he elected to shift the horse across behind runners rather than attempt to obtain a forward position.  He said making the first turn near the 800 Metres MORDICUS appeared reluctant to follow horses, however, in the Straight closed off the race satisfactorily given that the horse was ridden outside of its normal racing pattern.
EVER LAUGH began awkwardly.
Passing the 1000 Metres, CELEBRATION was checked away from the heels of SUPER EURO STAR when both horses shifted ground.
Making the first turn after the 900 Metres, HAPPY HAPPY shifted out and bumped THE INVINCIBLE which became unbalanced.
Approaching the 500 Metres, CELEBRATION became unbalanced after being bumped by MORDICUS which, after initially shifting out, then became unbalanced itself due to the contact with CELEBRATION.
In the early part of the Straight, SUPER EURO STAR got its head on the side and lay in under pressure.
Approaching the 300 Metres, ENDEARING got its head on the side and shifted out under pressure.
Near the 50 Metres, EVER LAUGH, which was closing off the race strongly, was shifted to the inside of FOREVER ACCURATE to continue improving.  Close to the finishing line, EVER LAUGH was then shifted out away from the heels of MULTIMAX.
Throughout the race, ENDEARING travelled wide and without cover.
JOLLY BOUNTIFUL and HIGH ENERGY were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE HONG KONG YOUNG INDUSTRIALISTS COUNCIL SILVER JUBILEE CUP (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
BEAUTY WAY was withdrawn on 3.6.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore).  Before being allowed to race again, BEAUTY WAY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
From the outside barriers, GENERAL SHERMAN and ENSURING were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
HAPPILABABY lost its right front plate near the 1500 Metres.
Near the 550 Metres, RODRICO raced tight between ANTICIPATION and SUPREME PROFIT.
GENERAL SHERMAN was held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight.
After the race, K Teetan was not able to offer any explanation for the disappointing performance of PRAWN BABA which weakened in the Straight.  A veterinary inspection of PRAWN BABA immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
DINOZZO, ROCKETEER and ANTICIPATION were sent for sampling.

REMARKABLE began only fairly.
Shortly after the start, DYNAMIC LIONS shifted in and bumped AUTOPAY.
 From wide barriers, BOLD STITCH and AMAZING ALWAYS were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
For some distance after the 1200 Metres, AUTOPAY travelled keenly when being steadied to obtain cover.
Passing the 1100 Metres, MY GIFT raced tight between VICTORY MASTER and EXPERTO CREDE which lay in.
At the 1000 Metres, G-ONE UNION was steadied away from the heels of DYNAMIC LIONS which got its head on the side and shifted in away from SAMâS LOVE.  A short distance after this, MY GIFT was crowded for room inside EXPERTO CREDE which shifted in away from the heels of DYNAMIC LIONS which again got its head on the side and shifted in away from SAMâS LOVE.
Approaching the 500 Metres, AUTOPAY got its head up when being checked away from the heels of EXPERTO CREDE.
REMARKABLE made the Home Turn awkwardly.
Rounding the Home Turn, LAUGH OUT LOUD was awkwardly placed close to the heels of MY GIFT.
At the entrance to the Straight, AUTOPAY was awkwardly placed close to the heels of DIAMOND LEGEND.
Passing the 400 Metres, REMARKABLE was bumped by BOLD STITCH which improved into tight running between that horse and G-ONE UNION.
Approaching the 300 Metres, BOLD STITCH was shifted out away from the heels of G-ONE UNION.
Throughout the race, DIAMOND LEGEND travelled wide and without cover. 
When questioned, Trainer C H Yip (SAMâS LOVE) stated that at its first and only race start he instructed the rider of the horse to attempt to take up a forward position if it began well, however, if it jumped on terms with the field, he should ride it for luck.  He said when SAMâS LOVE began only fairly and was then crowded for room, the rider had ridden SAMâS LOVE to his instruction by shifting the horse across behind runners in the early stages.  He said stepping up to 1400 Metres today and from a similarly wide draw, he felt that there was an opportunity for SAMâS LOVE to assume a more forward position than it obtained last start as he did not anticipate that the pace of the race would be strong.  He also added that since last start he had jumped SAMâS LOVE out of the barriers in its track work and given that the horse had begun sharply in these practice sessions, he anticipated that SAMâS LOVE would begin better than it did at its only previous race start.  He said whilst he did not want SAMâS LOVE to lead todayâs race, he had hoped that the horse would be able to obtain a position behind the speed.  He said however that due to the circumstances of the race and given that there were a number of horses that were ridden to obtain a forward position, C Williams, the rider of SAMâS LOVE, was left with no other option but to continue forward into the lead.
A veterinary inspection of MY GIFT and REMARKABLE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
LAUGH OUT LOUD and SAMâS LOVE were sent for sampling.

BLOCKER DEE shifted out at the start and hampered DOYENI.  DOYENI was then shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
A veterinary inspection of ROMANTIC TOUCH immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
BOOMING DELIGHT and EASTERN EXPRESS were sent for sampling.

Shortly after the start, POWER OF PATCH, which was being steadied to obtain cover, was shifted away from the heels of RADIANT TREASURE which was taken in by ROYAL MOJITO.  After this, both ROYAL MOJITO and RADIANT TREASURE were steadied to obtain a position closer to the rail.
Passing the 1100 Metres, OHANA was bumped by RADIANT TREASURE which was shifted in away from the heels of ARM RUNDA.
After the 1000 Metres, LANG TAI SING was steadied when crowded for room inside CHARITY GLORY which got its head on the side and lay in away from FIONESAY.
Approaching the 900 Metres, RADIANT TREASURE was steadied away from the heels of ARM RUNDA (S Clipperton) which shifted in when not properly clear.  S Clipperton was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is properly clear when shifting ground.
Passing the 800 Metres, FLYING MONKEY got its head on the side and lay out.  PINGWU SPARK then improved of its own accord into tight running inside FLYING MONKEY which resulted in both PINGWU SPARK and CHARITY GLORY racing tight for some distance approaching and passing the 700 Metres.  In this incident, PINGWU SPARK lost ground when having to be steadied away from the heels of FLYING MONKEY.
Near the 750 Metres, FIONESAY was awkwardly placed close to the heels of PINGWU SPARK.  ARM RUNDA, which was following, was steadied away from the heels of FIONESAY in consequence.  RADIANT TREASURE then shifted out abruptly away from the heels of ARM RUNDA passing the 700 Metres.
Near the 250 Metres, COLCHESTER was awkwardly placed inside the heels of ARM RUNDA.
Near the 150 Metres, ROYAL MOJITO was shifted out away from the heels of COLCHESTER and over the concluding stages lay in under pressure.
Over the concluding stages, PINGWU SPARK drifted out under pressure.
Throughout the race, COLCHESTER travelled wide and without cover and made the Home Turn awkwardly.
A veterinary inspection of FLYING MONKEY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MARVEL TRIBE and PINGWU SPARK were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE KOWLOON CRICKET CLUB CENTENARY CUP (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
FORTUNE PATROL was slow to begin.
RACING MATE was crowded for room on jumping outside DRAGON MASTER which, after initially being taken out by ACE KING, then got its head on the side and shifted out away from that horse.
BEAUTY MASTER and TRAVEL DATUK bumped on jumping.
SUPER WISE was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
Approaching the 800 Metres, FORTUNE BO BO got its head on the side and shifted out away from KEEP MOVING and in doing so bumped MONEY BOY.  After this, FORTUNE BO BO continued to lay out, resulting in MONEY BOY racing in restricted room between FORTUNE BO BO and BEAUTY MASTER.
Passing the 300 Metres, FORTUNE BO BO was shifted in away from the heels of MONEY BOY as a result of both horses shifting ground.
Passing the 100 Metres, KEEP MOVING was awkwardly placed outside the heels of TRIUMPHANT JEWEL.
When questioned, S Clipperton (TRIUMPHANT JEWEL) stated that it had been intended, from the horseâs outside barrier, to obtain a position behind the speed in about midfield if possible.  He said the race was run at a very quick tempo in the early stages which resulted in TRIUMPHANT JEWEL being further back in the field than has been intended.  He said in the early stages TRIUMPHANT JEWEL was unbalanced in its action and he formed the view that the horse may have been resenting the kickback.  He said for this reason whilst it had been intended for TRIUMPHANT JEWEL to maintain a position towards the outside rail, he felt that it was in the horseâs best interests to shift in away from the kickback and therefore after the 600 Metres he directed TRIUMPHANT JEWEL in considerably and after finding clear running, TRIUMPHANT JEWEL then closed off the race well.  
A veterinary inspection of SUPER WISE and KEEP MOVING immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FORTUNE BO BO, DRAGON MASTER and MONEY BOY were sent for sampling.

SHINING CHAMPION was withdrawn on 6.6.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (restricted action) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter KING OF SMARTS (T H So).
LETSGOFREE began only fairly.
GENTRY and GLORY STAR bumped on jumping.
MIGHTY WONGCHOY began only fairly and then, despite being vigorously ridden along, failed to muster speed.
KING OF SMARTS began awkwardly and shifted out on jumping, resulting in NO LAUGHING MATTER being crowded for room inside UNIQUE JOYFUL which became unbalanced when bumped on the hindquarters by NO LAUGHING MATTER.
O Doleuze (INVISIBLE) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that approaching the winning post on the first occasion he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of UNIQUE JOYFUL, resulting in that horse being taken in onto KING OF SMARTS which lost the running to which it was rightfully entitled and was checked.  O Doleuze was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 12 July 2017 and to expire on Monday, 17 July 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, O Doleuze was fined $30,000.  T H So was spoken to regarding the standard of the evidence he provided at this inquiry.
Near the 1050 Metres, WINNINGLI got its head on the side, shifted in and bumped CARRY TO WIN, resulting in both horses becoming unbalanced.  WINNINGLI then shifted out and inconvenienced LUCKY FRIENDS.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, INVISIBLE, which was improving around GLORY STAR, was bumped by that horses as GLORY STAR shifted to the outside of LUCKY FRIENDS.
Near the 550 Metres, KING OF SMARTS was steadied after improving into tight running inside LETSGOFREE which at this time raced tight inside GENTRY.
Passing the 450 Metres, GLORY STAR momentarily raced in restricted room between PERFECT TIMING and LUCKY FRIENDS which was giving ground.
Passing the 400 Metres, MIGHTY WONGCHOY was shifted to the inside of LUCKY FRIENDS after being awkwardly placed behind that horse which continued to give ground.
KING OF SMARTS was held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Approaching the 250 Metres, NO LAUGHING MATTER got its head on the side, shifted in and bumped LETSGOFREE.  After this, NO LAUGHING MATTER was shifted out away from the heels of GENTRY to obtain clear running.  NO LAUGHING MATTER continued to lay in under pressure for the remainder of the race.
Throughout the race, LUCKY FRIENDS travelled wide and without cover and gave ground in the Straight to finish tailed out.  The performance of LUCKY FRIENDS was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, LUCKY FRIENDS will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After the race, J Moreira was unable to offer any explanation for the disappointing performance of GLORY STAR which gave ground in the Straight.  A veterinary inspection of GLORY STAR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
LETSGOFREE, GENTRY and NO LAUGHING MATTER were sent for sampling.

DON WONGCHOY began only fairly.
SEVEN LUCK and FUNNY BUDDIES bumped shortly after the start due to both horses shifting ground.  After this, FUNNY BUDDIES lay in, resulting in SEVEN LUCK being crowded for room outside FREE NOVEMBER.
From the outside barriers, INTELLECTUAL GLIDE, BRIGHT STAR, GREAT SPEED and BLISS CARTEL were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
FUNNY BUDDIES lay out making the first turn after the 1000 Metres.
Near the 550 Metres, SEVEN LUCK raced tight inside FUNNY BUDDIES which got its head on the side and lay in.
After the 550 Metres, ALL TOGETHER was left racing wide and without cover.
At the entrance to the Straight, NATURAL TEAM was awkwardly placed inside the heels of ALL TOGETHER.
Near the 350 Metres, INTELLECTUAL GLIDE raced tight inside BLISS CARTEL.
Passing the 300 Metres, SEVEN LUCK was shifted to the inside of WINNING BOY to obtain clear running.
A veterinary inspection of DON WONGCHOY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of SEVEN LUCK immediately following the race confirmed the horse to be a "roarerâ which had previously been reported.
SEVEN LUCK, FUNNY BUDDIES and BLISS CARTEL were sent for sampling.
<8/6/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>SEVEN LUCK, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time the horse was confirmed to be a "roarerâ which had previously been reported.  SEVEN LUCK was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer C H Yip this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right hind leg.  Before being allowed to race again, SEVEN LUCK will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

The start was delayed when ADMIRABLE lost its right front plate when parading behind the barriers.  ADMIRABLE was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
TORNEY was slow to begin.
VITAL SPRING began awkwardly.  After this, VITAL SPRING was ridden along to obtain a forward position and passing the 1100 Metres got its head up and became unbalanced when being steadied to allow LONDON CITY to cross.  For some distance after this, VITAL SPRING continued to get its head up when racing ungenerously and awkwardly placed close to the heels of LONDON CITY.  Then near the 850 Metres, VITAL SPRING commenced to take charge of its rider and had to be severely checked away from the heels of LONDON CITY.  VITAL SPRING continued to travel fiercely for some distance after this.
From a wide barrier, MASSIVE POWER was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
When being steadied to obtain cover near the 1150 Metres, PLANET STAR was bumped by VITAL SPRING which shifted out.
MASSIVE POWER lost its left front plate approaching the 1000 Metres.
After the 900 Metres, PLANET STAR was awkwardly placed close to the heels of STARLIGHT.
At the entrance to the Straight, MASSIVE POWER was shifted in away from the heels of STARLIGHT.
Approaching the 200 Metres, SKY TREASURE got its head on the side and shifted in.
For the majority of the race, STARLIGHT travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of VITAL SPRING immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, VITAL SPRING will be subjected to an official veterinary examination..
PLANET STAR, SALSA BROTHERS and LONDON CITY were sent for sampling.

The tongue tie applied to FORMULA GALORE was refitted behind the barriers.
CASA MASTER began only fairly and then was bumped by MIDNITE PROMISE which shifted in on jumping.
RED ELYSEES began only fairly.
Shortly after the start, DARING HEART shifted in and bumped the hindquarters of SPARKLING SWORD.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, DARING HEART was steadied away from the heels of RED HORSE.
After the 1300 Metres, NEVER BETTER lay out and bumped EXCELLENCE, resulting in both horses becoming unbalanced.
After being crossed by RAGING BULL after the 1200 Metres, CONTRIBUTION shifted out away from the heels of that horse near the 1100 Metres, resulting in SPARKLING SWORD being taken wide and without cover.  After this, SPARKLING SWORD continued to race wide and without cover and in the Straight gave ground.
Passing the 1100 Metres, EXCELLENCE got its head up when being steadied away from the heels of MIDNITE PROMISE.
Passing the 900 Metres, RED HORSE became unbalanced when awkwardly placed outside the heels of MIDNITE PROMISE.
Near the 250 Metres, SPARKLING SWORD, which was giving ground, raced tight between MIDNITE PROMISE and DARING HEART which, when endeavouring to shift to the outside of EXCELLENCE, was awkwardly placed close to the heels of that horse which shifted out to obtain clear running.
Approaching the 200 Metres, DARING HEART and MIDNITE PROMISE bumped.
Also approaching the 200 Metres, NEVER BETTER and FORMULA GALORE raced tight.
A veterinary inspection of CASA MASTER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
A veterinary inspection of RED HORSE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CONTRIBUTION, RAGING BULL and DARING HEART were sent for sampling.

EASY HEDGE began awkwardly.
HAPPY CONTENDER and KINGâS MAN bumped at the start.
From wide barriers, RICKFIELD and TRENDY WIN were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, HAPPY CONTENDER raced tight inside LITTERATEUR.
Passing the 1100 Metres, MCQUEEN was awkwardly placed close to the heels of KING OF MONGOLIA.
Passing the 1000 Metres, EASY HEDGE got its head up when awkwardly placed behind ISTANBUL BEY.
After the 1000 Metres, KINGâS MAN was awkwardly placed close to the heels of LITTLE ISLAND.
Passing the 400 Metres, KING OF MONGOLIA was awkwardly placed close to the heels of ISTANBUL BEY.
Rounding the Home Turn, SHARP SAILOR, which was giving ground, was initially crowded for room between MCQUEEN and ISTANBUL BEY which shifted out away from EASY HEDGE.  At the entrance to the Straight, ISTANBUL BEY was then taken out further by EASY HEDGE (C Y Ho), resulting in SHARP SAILOR being hampered when crowded for room.  HAPPY CONTENDER, which was following, was severely checked away from the heels of that horse in consequence.  Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that ISTANBUL BEYâs initial shift had contributed to this incident, nonetheless C Y Ho was advised that his movement outwards had placed further pressure on ISTANBUL BEY and therefore he was reprimanded and told to ensure that he exercises due care when shifting ground.
Near the 250 Metres, MCQUEEN and EASY HEDGE raced tight.
Approaching the 50 Metres, HAPPY CONTENDER was shifted out away from the heels of KING OF MONGOLIA.
When questioned, N Callan (SHARP SAILOR) stated that he had been asked to ride the horse in a similar manner to when he was successful on SHARP SAILOR on 22 December 2016.  He said on that occasion he was able to improve his position from towards the rear of the field after the 1000 Metres and SHARP SAILOR sprinted quickly and sustained its run to win.  He said in tonightâs race he shifted SHARP SAILOR in across behind runners in the early stages and after the 1200 Metres noticed that LITTERATEUR had shifted out into a three wide position without cover.  He said as he expected that horse would improve its position rather than remain racing wide and without cover, he elected to shift out away from the heels of KINGâS MAN after the 1100 Metres to follow LITTERATEUR forward.  He said whilst this was an earlier stage in the race than he had intended to improve his position, he felt that it was best for SHARP SAILOR to be able to follow LITTERATEUR forward with cover as SHARP SAILOR would then be taken into the race by LITTERATEUR as it improved towards the lead.  He added SHARP SAILOR did not quicken as it did when he rode the horse to success previously and he was unable to improve with LITTERATEUR as that horse travelled forward into the lead after the 1000 Metres.  He said he was obliged to ride SHARP SAILOR along for a considerable distance, however, the horse did not show the same turn of foot that it did previously and raced "flatâ.
When questioned, Z Purton stated that it had been intended, from a wide barrier, for LITTERATEUR to be ridden quietly in the early stages and obtain cover.  He said in accordance with his instructions he came out of the barriers quietly on LITTERATEUR and immediately took hold of the horse so as to obtain cover towards the rear of the field.  He said almost immediately LITTERATEUR commenced to prove very difficult to settle and he had to take a number of holds of LITTERATEUR in an endeavour to have it steady and shift across to race behind KINGâS MAN which he was able to achieve near the 1600 Metres.  He said he had intended for LITTERATEUR to remain racing behind KINGâS MAN and he had hoped that by obtaining cover behind that horse would assist LITTERATEUR to settle better.  He said approaching the winning post on the first occasion LITTERATEUR took charge of him and improved its position between KINGâS MAN and HAPPY CONTENDER where there was no room.  He said he was unable to prevent LITTERATEUR from improving at this time and it was only KINGâS MAN shifting out to make room for LITTERATEUR that prevented what could have been a significant incident from occurring.  He said after passing the winning post on the first occasion he continued to try and steady LITTERATEUR, however, the horse continued to improve its position and passing the 1300 Metres improved quickly to be racing close to the heels of LITTLE ISLAND.  He said having in mind the manner in which LITTERATEUR had improved inside KINGâS MAN where there was no room just prior to this, he formed the view that LITTERATEUR was going to race up onto the heels of LITTLE ISLAND and therefore passing the 1250 Metres he directed LITTERATEUR out away from behind that horse.  He said this resulted in LITTERATEUR being left racing in a three wide position without cover.  He added he therefore allowed the horse to improve its position in the hope that this would result in LITTERATEUR settling better.  He said after crossing KING OF MONGOLIA near the 900 Metres to race outside HIGH VOLATILITY, that horse maintained its position inside LITTERATEUR, therefore he allowed the horse to continue to race outside HIGH VOLATILITY rather than continuing into the lead.  He said as a consequence of LITTERATEUR refusing to settle in the early and middle stages, the horse was not able to finish off the race.  A veterinary inspection of LITTERATEUR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of HAPPY CONTENDER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of ISTANBUL BEY immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm and an endoscopic examination also showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, ISTANBUL BEY will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
LITTERATEUR, RICKFIELD and EASY HEDGE were sent for sampling.

VICTORY MACHINE began very awkwardly and lost a considerable amount of ground at the start and then for the majority of the race was detached from the field.  A veterinary inspection of VICTORY MACHINE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of VICTORY MACHINE was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, VICTORY MACHINE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
PACKING STONES began only fairly.
WAYFOONG VINNIE shifted in at the start and bumped PEACE N PROSPERITY.
From the outside barrier, RIGHT HONOURABLE was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Near the 850 Metres, WAYFOONG VINNIE proved very difficult to settle and for some distance approaching and passing the 800 Metres got its head up when being steadied away from the heels of BACK IN BLACK.
Passing the 600 Metres, THE SUPREME was awkwardly placed close to the heels of PACKING STONES.
In the early part of the Straight, PACKING STONES was awkwardly placed outside the heels of BACK IN BLACK which shifted out to obtain clear running.
Passing the 250 Metres, JOLLY CONVERGENCE raced tight inside TIMELY ARRIVED.
For the majority of the race, PACKING STONES travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, C Murray, the rider of MOST BEAUTIFUL, stated that he had been asked to ride the horse quietly in the early stages from barrier 10.  Mr C S Shum, the trainer of MOST BEAUTIFUL, will be interviewed regarding the instructions he provided to Jockey Murray prior to the Sha Tin racemeeting on Sunday, 11 June 2017.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that TIMELY ARRIVED had bled from both nostrils.
A veterinary inspection of PACKING STONES immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PRINCE HARMONY and JOLLY CONVERGENCE were sent for sampling.
<11/6/2017  7 June 2017 Happy Valley Racemeeting-Race 6 (712)>The Stewards today questioned Mr C S Shum, the trainer of MOST BEAUTIFUL, regarding the instructions he provided to C Murray prior to this race. Mr Shum stated that MOST BEAUTIFUL regularly goes forward in its races, however, it had to be ridden along to do so in a number of starts and because of this was not able to finish off its races as well as it had been hoped. He said having drawn barrier 10 in this race and because there were a number of horses which were better drawn than MOST BEAUTIFUL and which had previously shown early speed in their races, he felt that were MOST BEAUTIFUL to be ridden along from the wide barrier, there was a likelihood that the horse would be left racing wide and without cover, therefore he asked Jockey Murray to steady MOST BEAUTIFUL in the early stages and obtain cover. He added whilst it is his preference for MOST BEAUTIFUL to be ridden in a forward position, he believed that the circumstances of this race would have made it difficult for MOST BEAUTIFUL to finish off the race were it to be ridden along in the early stages to obtain a forward position.

LOADED shifted out at the start and bumped the hindquarters of AMAZING, resulting in LOADED being hampered and losing ground.
From a wide barrier, GENERAL IRON was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
Also in the early stages, DR LISTENING was steadied to obtain cover.
At the entrance to the Straight, TRUMP raced tight outside RESPLENDENT GLORY.
Passing the winning post, RED KYLIN and AMAZING bumped.
Throughout the race, FULL GLAMOUR travelled wide and without cover and in the Straight gave ground.
When questioned, C Schofield stated that he had been asked to ride RESPLENDENT GLORY in about a midfield position with cover, similarly to the manner in which it was ridden at its first start this season when successful.  He said on that occasion RESPLENDENT GLORY had shown a very good turn of foot in the Straight which the horse had repeated at its most recent start when able to take up a position behind the leaders from an inside barrier.  He said tonight, from barrier 9, it was felt that if RESPLENDENT GLORY were to be ridden along in the early stages to take up a forward position, the horse may be left racing wide and without cover and it was felt that if the horse showed the same turn of foot as it did at its two most recent starts, the horse would be able to perform well from about a midfield position.  He said although RESPLENDENT GLORY turned its head to the left just prior to the start being effected which resulted in the horse beginning only fairly, RESPLENDENT GLORY was able to quickly make up ground and was then able to obtain the position in midfield following AMAZING.  He said RESPLENDENT GLORY travelled very well in the early and middle stages, however, when shifted to the outside of AMAZING after the 400 Metres, did not quicken as it did at its last two starts and was not able to make ground quickly to the outside of AMAZING.  He added, despite being placed under heavy pressure in the Straight, RESPLENDENT GLORY was disappointing in the manner in which it failed to finish off the race.  A veterinary inspection of RESPLENDENT GLORY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HEALTHY LUCK, RED KYLIN and AMAZING were sent for sampling.

Whilst being saddled, MY LITTLE FRIEND became fractious, reared and hit its head.  Acting on veterinary advice that MY LITTLE FRIEND was not suitable to race, the horse was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  Before being allowed to race again, MY LITTLE FRIEND will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Shortly after the start, VERBINSKY shifted in abruptly when being ridden along and made contact with CONVINCIBLE, causing both horses to become unbalanced.
From the outside barrier, ARCHIPPUS was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
DALRADIAN travelled wide and without cover until the 600 Metres and subsequently weakened to finish tailed out.  The performance of DALRADIAN was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, DALRADIAN will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After the 600 Metres, VERBINSKY was left racing wide and without cover.
Rounding the Home Turn, ROMANTIC CASH was awkwardly placed close to the heels of DALRADIAN which was giving ground.
Also rounding the Home Turn, GOLDEN HARVEST raced tight inside DRAGON GENERAL.
Passing the 250 Metres, CONVINCIBLE shifted out away from the heels of VERBINSKY and bumped MR GENUINE, causing both horses to become unbalanced.
Near the 25 Metres, MOLLYâS JADE STAR went amiss, resulting in its rider, C Schofield, being dislodged.  DRAGON GENERAL, which was following MOLLYâS JADE STAR, was severely checked to avoid that horse.  ROMANTIC CASH and VERBINSKY, which were following DRAGON GENERAL, were checked away from the heels of that horse close to the finishing line.  In this incident, GOLDEN HARVEST, which was improving to the inside of MOLLYâS JADE STAR, was eased by its rider to avoid the fallen C Schofield and because of this was not ridden out to the end of the race.
CONVINCIBLE and ARCHIPPUS were sent for sampling.  Samples were also taken from MOLLYâS JADE STAR.
<11/6/2017  7 June 2017 Happy Valley Racemeeting-Race 8 (714)>The Stewards today interviewed U Rispoli regarding his riding of DRAGON GENERAL passing the 600 Metres. U Rispoli stated that at this time he was following HAPPY METEOR and although he did not believe that the horse would take him into the race, he was reluctant to shift to the outside of that horse to improve to be racing behind VERBINSKY in a three wide position as DRAGON GENERAL had previously made the turns awkwardly in some of its races. He said although he was aware that CONVINCIBLE was improving its position around DRAGON GENERAL, he felt that were he to shift out at this stage of the race, DRAGON GENERAL may make the turn after the 600 Metres awkwardly which would be to the detriment of the horseâs finishing chances. He said he therefore elected to remain racing behind HAPPY METEOR and when that horse shifted out approaching the 500 Metres, he was able to immediately improve his position inside HAPPY METEOR.

AIMING HIGH was withdrawn on 10.6.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter FLYING NOBLE (K C Ng).  Before being allowed to race again, AIMING HIGH will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
LUNAR ZEPHYR began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped COLOURFUL ACHIEVER.  COLOURFUL ACHIEVER was then crowded for room between LUNAR ZEPHYR which continued to shift in and OCEAN ELITE.
LIGHTNING MISSILE began only fairly and shortly after the start was crowded for room between OCEAN ELITE and DAZZLE which shifted out.
GOLDINGTON HORN was slow to begin and on jumping was bumped by BEAUT BEAUT which began awkwardly and shifted in.
FLYING NOBLE lost its left front plate shortly after the start.
TOURBILLON KING lost its right front plate at the 800 Metres and its left front plate near the 700 Metres.
Passing the 800 Metres, LIGHTNING MISSILE raced tight between COLOURFUL ACHIEVER and DAZZLE which was awkwardly placed outside FLYING NOBLE.
Passing the 400 Metres, ENJOY LIFE got its head on the side and hung out and in doing so inconvenienced FLYING NOBLE.  After this, ENJOY LIFE continued to hang out under pressure.
Near the 150 Metres, BEAUT BEAUT, which had been laying in under pressure, was shifted to the outside of LUNAR ZEPHYR.  Then approaching the 50 Metres, BEAUT BEAUT shifted out away from TOURBILLON KING and when racing tight on the hindquarters of LUNAR ZEPHYR, became unbalanced and blundered.  OCEAN ELITE, which was following BEAUT BEAUT, was steadied as a consequence.
A veterinary inspection of LUNAR ZEPHYR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
LUNAR ZEPHYR and ENCORE BOY were sent for sampling.

PLAY IT was slow to begin and subsequently finished tailed out.  A veterinary inspection of PLAY IT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of PLAY IT was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, PLAY IT will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
BULLISH GLORY began awkwardly.
GRANITE BELT and UNICRON JEWELLERY bumped at the start.
FIRST FONTEIN was slow to begin.
Passing the 1500 Metres, BULLISH GLORY was awkwardly placed close to the heels of SMILING CHARM.
Approaching the 1100 Metres, RULE THEE was crowded for room inside BULLISH GLORY which was taken in by SMILING CHARM (U Rispoli).  U Rispoli was severely reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is properly clear when shifting ground in similar circumstances.
GO BEAUTY GO was held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight and passing the 350 Metres made contact with UNICRON JEWELLERY as both horses attempted to improve into an available run between FANTASTIC KAKA and CHEERFUL BOY.
Near the 150 Metres, CHEERFUL BOY and GO BEAUTY GO momentarily raced in restricted room inside FANTASTIC KAKA.
Close to the finishing line, BULLISH GLORY was checked away from the heels of FANTASTIC KAKA.
When questioned regarding his riding of CLUB LIFE, Apprentice M F Poon stated that he had been instructed to attempt to lead on the rail from barrier 5.  He said he was told that after obtaining the lead, if another horse was to be ridden along, it was acceptable for him to allow that horse to cross CLUB LIFE rather than becoming engaged in a speed battle.  He said in accordance with his instructions he rode CLUB LIFE positively in the early stages and slapped the horse down the shoulder with the whip on a number of occasions to have it improve its position to cross UNICRON JEWELLERY to its inside.  He said, despite being hard ridden, CHEERFUL BOY showed more speed than CLUB LIFE in the early stages and passing the 1500 Metres CLUB LIFE raced tight between CHEERFUL BOY and UNICRON JEWELLERY which shifted out.  He said CHEERFUL BOY was showing more speed than CLUB LIFE at this time and he was unable to prevent that horse from crossing CLUB LIFE.  He said when CLUB LIFE was crowded for room, this provided GO BEAUTY GO with the opportunity to improve its advantage over CLUB LIFE and he was unable to prevent that horse from crossing CLUB LIFE passing the 1400 Metres as it was showing far more speed than CLUB LIFE.  He added after being crossed by GO BEAUTY GO, he noted that that horse was being steadied by its rider and he therefore rode CLUB LIFE vigorously for some distance approaching and passing the 1200 Metres so as to cross GO BEAUTY GO and race outside CHEERFUL BOY and in the process prevent FANTASTIC KAKA from being able to cross CLUB LIFE.  He said, despite being ridden along, CLUB LIFE did not respond and this resulted in the horse travelling wide and without cover for the remainder of the race.  Apprentice Poon was advised that, after viewing the videos of the race, his explanation had been accepted.
When questioned regarding the performance of UNICRON JEWELLERY, J Moreira stated that prior to the race the horse sweated up badly and was agitated both in the Parade Ring and behind the barriers.  He said in the early stages he rode his mount along to take up a forward position and he was able to take a trailing position behind the leader CHEERFUL BOY after the 1400 Metres.  He said UNICRON JEWELLERY travelled comfortably in the early and middle stages, however, when the tempo of the race increased near the 550 Metres, UNICRON JEWELLERY was left flat-footed and had to be ridden along in an attempt to maintain its position behind CHEERFUL BOY.  He added after the 400 Metres he shifted UNICRON JEWELLERY out from behind CHEERFUL BOY to improve into running between that horse and FANTASTIC KAKA.  He said however that UNICRON JEWELLERY did not respond to his riding and this resulted in GO BEAUTY GO being able to improve into this run.  He said, despite being disappointed for this run, UNICRON JEWELLERY immediately came under heavy pressure and then did not close off the race and was particularly disappointing over the latter stages of the race.  A veterinary inspection of UNICRON JEWELLERY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of UNICRON JEWELLERY, a favourite for todayâs race, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, UNICRON JEWELLERY will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
UNICRON JEWELLERY, GO BEAUTY GO and SMILING CHARM were sent for sampling.

NOBLE BUDDIES began awkwardly and then shortly after the start was crowded for room between FAIR COMMENT which shifted out and FORTUNE BROTHERS which was taken in by EMPIRE OF MONGOLIA.
MASSIVE MOVE and EMPEROR VICTORY bumped at the start.
Approaching the 800 Metres, NOBLE BUDDIES was awkwardly placed close to the heels of EMPIRE OF MONGOLIA.
After being crossed by GOLDEN CANNON passing the 700 Metres, EMPIRE OF MONGOLIA got its head on the side and lay out.
Making the turn near the 650 Metres, FRIENDS FOREVER lay out, resulting in EMPEROR VICTORY being taken wider.
Near the 250 Metres, FANTASTICLIFE shifted out and bumped GOLDEN CANNON.
Over the concluding stages, NOBLE BUDDIES, which was finishing off the race well, was steadied when improving inside FRIENDS FOREVER (C Murray) which shifted in.  C Murray was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is aware of the circumstances around him and to make every endeavour to keep his mounts on a straight course.
For the majority of the race, EMPEROR VICTORY travelled wide and without cover.
The performance of FAIR COMMENT, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, FAIR COMMENT will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
