After the race, J Moreira reported that after being placed in a good position behind the speed, FORTUNE BROTHERS came under heavy pressure after the 500 Metres and then weakened noticeably in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection of FORTUNE BROTHERS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of FORTUNE BROTHERS, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, FORTUNE BROTHERS will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of EMPEROR VICTORY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ACTUARIAT, MASSIVE MOVE and SNOWHOOVES were sent for sampling.

race_name: HKU FACULTY OF BUSINESS & ECONOMICS HANDICAP
incident_report:
MASSIVE MILLENNIUM was withdrawn on 9.6.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (coughing) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter HORSE SUPREMO (H W Lai).  Before being allowed to race again, MASSIVE MILLENNIUM will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A STAR LUSTER began only fairly.
SPRING WIN blundered at the start.  After this, SPRING WIN was ridden along, however, failed to muster speed.
STARTLING POWER shifted out at the start, hampering CORRE RAPIDO.
Passing the 1100 Metres, A STAR LUSTER, which was travelling keenly, got its head up when awkwardly placed behind SMART BOY.
Making the first turn near the 700 Metres, RESPECT raced tight inside HORSE SUPREMO which shifted in away from SILVER SPUN.
After initially being taken out by RESPECT after the 700 Metres, HORSE SUPREMO got its head on the side and lay out and consequently made the Home Turn awkwardly.
Approaching the 500 Metres, STARTLING POWER raced tight between HORSE SUPREMO and GIDDY GIDDY which shifted out.
Passing the 200 Metres, SILVER SPUN, which was giving ground, was momentarily steadied away from the heels of SILLY BUDDIES which improved into tight running inside ROCHFORD.
Close to the finishing line, GIDDY GIDDY was awkwardly placed close to the heels of RESPECT which was taken out by ROCHFORD (T H So).  T H So was advised to exercise more care in similar circumstances.
For the majority of the race, STARTLING POWER travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of SPRING WIN immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that HORSE SUPREMO was lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, HORSE SUPREMO will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SMART BOY, SILLY BUDDIES and ROCHFORD were sent for sampling.

Whilst in the saddling stalls, AMRITSARIA had its left front plate refitted.  AMRITSARIA was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
FULL GLORY began awkwardly and lost ground.
GARLIC YEAH shifted in at the start and bumped AMRITSARIA.
AUDACITY shifted in abruptly at the start and bumped TELEPHATIA.
Near the 1500 Metres, TELEPHATIA was awkwardly placed close to the heels of KING BOUNTIFUL.
JOLLY AMBER travelled wide and without cover until after the 1400 Metres and was allowed to improve its position to cross into the lead.
Also after the 1400 Metres, GARLIC YEAH was left racing wide and without cover.  GARLIC YEAH was then allowed to improve its position after the 1000 Metres to cross into the lead.
Near the 1000 Metres, BLAZING PASS was taken out to a position four wide and without cover by HAPPY ROCKY which shifted out.
Making the turn at the 900 Metres, ASHKIYR momentarily raced tight between FULL GLORY and AMRITSARIA which shifted out.
Approaching the 450 Metres, KING BOUNTIFUL was shifted out away from the heels of JOLLY AMBER which was giving ground abruptly.  The performance of JOLLY AMBER, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, JOLLY AMBER will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Passing the 400 Metres, INDUSTRIALIST WAY improved into tight running between AMRITSARIA and HAPPY ROCKY which shifted out when giving ground.  Then passing the 350 Metres, INDUSTRIALIST WAY and AMRITSARIA were crowded for room between HAPPY ROCKY which continued to give ground and FULL GLORY which shifted in marginally.
Apprentice H T Mo, the rider of JOLLY AMBER, was spoken to regarding using the whip on three occasions after the 300 Metres on a horse which was clearly out of contention.
Over the concluding stages, CLOUD NINE raced tight inside INDUSTRIALIST WAY.
A veterinary inspection of AMRITSARIA immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
BEST REWARD and GARLIC YEAH were sent for sampling.

After being placed in the barriers, GRADE ONE became very fractious, reared abruptly and then sat down.  In this incident, S Clipperton was caught between the horse and the overhead structure and was then dislodged from GRADE ONE which continued to be very fractious in the barriers.  Acting on veterinary advice that GRADE ONE was not suitable to race, the horse was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  Irrespective, S Clipperton was deemed unfit to fulfil his engagement on GRADE ONE by the Clubâs medical officers and was subsequently stood down from his remaining race riding engagements.  Before being allowed to race again, GRADE ONE will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
JE PENSE began awkwardly and then was crowded for room on jumping between SICHUAN BOSS and BEST EFFORT which was taken out by TEAM SWEET which shifted out abruptly after beginning awkwardly.
CHIU CHOW KID was slow to begin.
GOLDEN ACHIEVER began awkwardly and lost ground.
For some distance approaching and passing the 1300 Metres, TRIUMPHANT LIGHT travelled keenly.
LUCKY SEVEN STARS proved very difficult to settle for some distance approaching and passing the 1100 Metres.
Passing the 350 Metres, BEST EFFORT was shifted out away from the heels of TRIUMPHANT LIGHT and brushed THE SHOW.
When questioned, Apprentice M F Poon (SUCH A HAPPINESS) stated that from the outside barrier he had been asked to obtain a position with cover if possible even if this meant having to race in a three wide position.  He said SUCH A HAPPINESS began well and he immediately commenced to shift across with a view to obtaining a position closer to the rail.  He said the tempo of the race in the early stages was quite good and it appeared as though the field would open up and he briefly felt that there might have been an opportunity for SUCH A HAPPINESS to shift in to obtain cover, however, due to the circumstances of the race he was not able to position SUCH A HAPPINESS behind another runner and SUCH A HAPPINESS was therefore left racing wide and without cover throughout the race.  He added the tempo of the race gradually increased from about the 800 Metres and SUCH A HAPPINESS had to work too hard in order to maintain its position.  He said in the Straight SUCH A HAPPINESS finished off the race one-paced, however, given the circumstances of the race, the run was better than it appeared.  A veterinary inspection of SUCH A HAPPINESS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of JE PENSE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PO CHING TREASURE and INFINITY ENDEAVOUR were sent for sampling.

HAPPY BAO BEI was withdrawn on 10.6.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore).  Before being allowed to race again, HAPPY BAO BEI will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
HO HO HORSE was slow to begin.
HINYUEN SWIFTNESS began only fairly.
From a wide barrier, MASTER ALBERT was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Making the first turn after the 900 Metres, MALMSTEEN shifted out away from the heels of SUPER JUNIOR and bumped LUCKY WAN FENG, causing both horses to become unbalanced.  After this, MALMSTEEN got its head up when travelling keenly and awkwardly placed behind SUPER JUNIOR.
Passing the 700 Metres, LUCKY WAN FENG was awkwardly placed close to the heels of PERPETUAL JOYANCE.
After the 700 Metres, DOUBLE VALENTINE was left racing wide and without cover.
Near the 550 Metres, MALMSTEEN again got its head up when travelling close to the heels of SUPER JUNIOR.
Approaching the 500 Metres, LUCKY WAN FENG was awkwardly placed close to the heels of PERPETUAL JOYANCE.  MASTER ALBERT, which was following, was shifted out away from the heels of LUCKY WAN FENG in consequence.
At the entrance to the Straight, SUPER JUNIOR and PERPETUAL JOYANCE raced tight as SUPER JUNIOR attempted to shift to the outside of SUNSHINE UNIVERSE to obtain clear running.  SUPER JUNIOR was then directed to the inside of SUNSHINE UNIVERSE when unable to improve to that horseâs outside passing the 400 Metres.
Passing the 400 Metres, MASTER ALBERT shifted out and bumped HINYUEN SWIFTNESS.
Throughout the race, CHARITY GLORY travelled wide and without cover and in the Straight hung in under pressure and proved difficult to ride.
A veterinary inspection of CHARITY GLORY immediately following the race confirmed the horse to be a "roarerâ which had previously been reported.
MASTER ALBERT, PERPETUAL JOYANCE and FANTASTIC EIGHT were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE HONG KONG UNIVERSITY ALUMNI ASSOCIATION CHALLENGE CUP (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
LUCKY EVER was slow to begin.
From the outside barriers, CHATER LEGEND and LIMITLESS were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
For some distance after the 1200 Metres, LUCKY EVER commenced to prove very difficult to settle and had to be checked away from the heels of LITTLE DRAGON.  When being checked, LUCKY EVER shifted in abruptly, resulting in ALL YOU WISH being checked when badly crowded for room.
When being shifted across behind MIDNIGHT RATTLER passing the 1150 Metres, HAPPY SPIRIT (H W Lai) clipped the heels of MIDNIGHT RATTLER and blundered.  H W Lai was reprimanded and told to be more attentive when shifting ground in similar circumstances.  A veterinary inspection of MIDNIGHT RATTLER immediately following the race found that horse to have sustained superficial abrasions to both hocks.
Passing the 1100 Metres, LIMITLESS got its head up when proving very difficult to settle.
GOLD LAND was held up for a run in the early part of the Straight and after the 350 Metres was shifted to the outside of horses to obtain clear running.
Approaching the 100 Metres, Apprentice M F Poon (GOLD LAND) dropped his whip.
In the Straight, LIMITLESS hung in under pressure and proved difficult to ride.
For the majority of the race, BEAT THE CLOCK travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of HAPPY SPIRIT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of HAPPY SPIRIT, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, HAPPY SPIRIT will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
BEAT THE CLOCK and LIMITLESS were sent for sampling.

MARQULA began awkwardly.
KING MORTAR began only fairly.
Near the 500 Metres, MARQULA became unbalanced when reluctant to maintain its position between horses.  A veterinary inspection of MARQULA immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of MARQULA, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, MARQULA will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Near the 250 Metres, ARIZONA BLIZZARD, which was closing off the race well, shifted out away from the heels of E-SUPER which was giving ground.  Then passing the 100 Metres, ARIZONA BLIZZARD got its head on the side and shifted out, resulting in AMAZING RACE being inconvenienced and requiring M L Yeung, the rider of ARIZONA BLIZZARD, to straighten that horse.
Approaching the 50 Metres, PAKISTAN BABY was shifted in away from the heels of SUNNY DRAGON.
Throughout the race, PERPETUAL TREASURE travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, U Rispoli (PAKISTAN BABY) stated that the tempo of the race today was quicker than at its last start when the horse performed well.  He said after beginning well, he had to ride PAKISTAN BABY vigorously throughout the race as the horse appeared reluctant to stretch out whilst resenting the kickback.  He said in the Straight PAKISTAN BABY finished off the race only fairly.  A veterinary inspection of PAKISTAN BABY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
A veterinary inspection of BORNTOACHIEVE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PAKISTAN BABY, PERPETUAL TREASURE and ARIZONA BLIZZARD were sent for sampling.

GREEN ENERGY was withdrawn on 9.6.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (inappetence).  Before being allowed to race again, GREEN ENERGY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
CLASSIC EMPEROR and VICTORY DAY bumped at the start.
ENERGETIC CLASS shifted in at the start and bumped REGENCY BO BO.
Shortly after the start, RIGHT CALL was momentarily steadied away from the heels of PRETTY BAUHINIA (C Murray) which shifted in before being directed back out.  C Murray was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is sufficiently clear when shifting ground.
From wide barriers, TOP ACT and MR POTENTIAL were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Approaching the 1300 Metres, ENERGETIC CLASS was crowded for room between SUNNY WAY and REGENCY BO BO (J Moreira) which shifted out when being ridden along. J Moreira was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he makes every endeavour to keep his mounts on a straight course in similar circumstances.
The Stewards interviewed M L Yeung, the rider of VICTORY DAY, in the presence of Mr A Lee, the trainer of that horse, regarding an incident at about the 1050 Metres.  M L Yeung stated that after crossing into the lead approaching the 1100 Metres, VICTORY DAY continued inwards of its own accord and propped prior to making contact with the rail.  When this occurred, VICTORY DAY became badly unbalanced, made heavy contact with the rail and fell, resulting in M L Yeung being dislodged.  Mr Lee stated that VICTORY DAY was having its 14th start in Hong Kong after racing overseas.  He said when trained by him, the horse had never shown an inclination to perform in this manner.  A veterinary inspection of VICTORY DAY immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in the right front leg with wounds to the right front and hind legs.  The Stewards ruled that VICTORY DAY will be required to barrier trial satisfactorily around a bend and close to the rail on no less than three consecutive occasions and in the immediate future the horse must be ridden by a senior jockey and will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Mr Lee was also advised that in track work it will be required for VICTORY DAY to be ridden by no less than a senior work rider.  When VICTORY DAY fell, CLASSIC EMPEROR, which was following, was hampered and shifted out, causing RIGHT CALL to be inconvenienced.  REGENCY BO BO was hampered after having to be shifted out away from the heels of RIGHT CALL.  HARD BALL GET, THE JUDGE, TOP ACT, ENERGETIC CLASS and QUICK RETURN were all severely checked in consequence.  SUNNY WAY was also hampered in this incident.  MR POTENTIAL was unable to avoid the riderless VICTORY DAY which resulted in T H So being dislodged from that horse.  T H So was subsequently transported to hospital.  A veterinary inspection of MR POTENTIAL immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in the left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, MR POTENTIAL will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Making the turn after the 900 Metres, THE JUDGE got its head up when being checked away from the heels of SUNNY WAY.
For some distance after the 750 Metres, SUNNY WAY was severely hampered and taken wider by the riderless MR POTENTIAL.
THE JUDGE lost its right front plate approaching the 600 Metres.
Passing the 500 Metres, HARD BALL GET and REGENCY BO BO raced tight.
Passing the 400 Metres, RIGHT CALL was steadied away from the heels of the riderless MR POTENTIAL which shifted in and collided with PRETTY BAUHINIA which became badly unbalanced and then was taken in further by MR POTENTIAL, causing PRETTY BAUHINIA, REGENCY BO BO and HARD BALL GET to all be severely checked.
A veterinary inspection of RIGHT CALL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
REGENCY BO BO, CLASSIC EMPEROR and ENERGETIC CLASS were sent for sampling.

CLEVER SPIRIT began only fairly.
MEGATRON shifted in on jumping and bumped HAPPY AND HEALTHY.
From wide barriers, RUBY COAST and VARA PEARL were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Approaching the winning post on the first occasion, INDUSTRIALIST WAY was steadied when crowded for room between MEGATRON which shifted out marginally and MR KOOL which got its head on the side and lay in.
MEGATRON got its head up on a number of occasions when being steadied passing the 1300 Metres.  Then approaching and passing the 1200 Metres, MEGATRON continued to travel keenly and again got its head up when awkwardly placed behind MR KOOL.
Passing the 800 Metres, HAPPY AND HEALTHY momentarily raced tight inside MEGATRON which got its head on the side and shifted in of its own accord despite the efforts of its rider.
After the race, B Prebble stated that MR KOOL, which weakened in the Straight, raced like a tired horse.  Mr W Y So, the trainer of MR KOOL, advised the Stewards that it was his intention to spell the horse following tonightâs disappointing run.  A veterinary inspection of MR KOOL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CLEVER SPIRIT and UNIQUE HAPPIEST were sent for sampling.

GREAT JOY began awkwardly and lost ground.
MUTUAL JOY shifted out at the start and bumped ACCLAIMED LIGHT.
G-ONE UNION was crowded for room on jumping between VICTORY FOLLOW ME which began very awkwardly and shifted in abruptly and SPINNING DANCER which was taken out by AMAZING ALWAYS.  In this incident, AMAZING ALWAYS became unbalanced after bumping SPINNING DANCER.  After this, from the outside barrier, VICTORY FOLLOW ME was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.  After being ridden along for a short distance, G-ONE UNION was also steadied from a wide barrier and shifted across behind runners to obtain a position closer to the rail.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, SPINNING DANCER was left racing wide and without cover and after the 1300 Metres was steadied to the rear of the field to obtain cover.
GREAT JOY got its head up on a number of occasions passing the 1200 Metres when awkwardly placed close to the heels of PREMIUM CHAMPION.
Passing the 900 Metres, a number of horses were ridden along to improve their positions which included VICTORY FOLLOW ME which for the remainder of the race travelled wide and without cover.
After initially being directed to the outside of PREMIUM CHAMPION approaching the 800 Metres, GREAT JOY was then shifted back to the inside of that horse a short distance later due to PREMIUM CHAMPION shifting out.
Passing the 800 Metres, G-ONE UNION, which was attempting to improve around ACCLAIMED LIGHT, was bumped by that horse which shifted out.
W M Lai (PREMIUM CHAMPION) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that approaching and passing the 400 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of GREAT JOY, resulting in that horse being crowded for room and being checked after the 400 Metres.  W M Lai was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Saturday, 1 July 2017 and to expire on Monday, 10 July 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards took into account Jockey Laiâs good race riding record.
Approaching the 100 Metres, ACCLAIMED LIGHT shifted in under pressure.
Near the 75 Metres, G-ONE UNION was shifted out away from the heels of VICTORY FOLLOW ME to improve.  G-ONE UNION then raced in restricted room over the concluding stages between VICTORY FOLLOW ME and SPINNING DANCER and passing the winning post had to be steadied when crowded for room inside SPINNING DANCER (U Rispoli) which shifted in.  U Rispoli was advised to exercise more care in similar circumstances.
Approaching the 50 Metres, PREMIUM CHAMPION raced tight inside SEE ME NOW.
At about the 25 Metres, ACCLAIMED LIGHT and AMAZING ALWAYS brushed.
After the race, U Rispoli reported that SPINNING DANCER did not feel comfortable in its action.  A veterinary inspection of SPINNING DANCER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Before being allowed to race again, SPINNING DANCER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Also after the race, Apprentice H N Wong (MUTUAL JOY) stated that the horse was left flat-footed in the middle stages and came under pressure prior to the 500 Metres.  He said, despite being ridden out, MUTUAL JOY gave ground in the Straight and, in his opinion, raced "flatâ.  A veterinary inspection of MUTUAL JOY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GREAT JOY, MY BLESSING and ACCLAIMED LIGHT were sent for sampling.

MASTER VIKING began awkwardly and shifted out, resulting in SHOWING CHARACTER being hampered.  After this SHOWING CHARACTER was steadied to obtain cover.  A short distance after this, MASTER VIKING was awkwardly placed inside the heels of REGENCY HONEY.
Shortly after the start, NONE OTHER shifted in marginally and bumped NICE FANDANGO which in turn shifted in and bumped the hindquarters of OTOUTO, causing that horse to become unbalanced.
HALL OF FAME lost its left front plate shortly after the start.
From the outside barriers, HALL OF FAME and SIGHT SEEING were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Despite being aggressively ridden in the early stages, SALSA BROTHERS failed to muster speed.
Near the 1050 Metres, NONE OTHER, which had been steadied to obtain cover, was bumped by NICE FANDANGO which shifted out.
REGENCY HONEY travelled wide and without cover until approaching the 600 Metres.
Making the turn near the 550 Metres, SHOWING CHARACTER became unbalanced and brushed the running rail when awkwardly placed close to the heels of SALSA BROTHERS.
Approaching the 400 Metres, NUMERO UNO was awkwardly placed close to the heels of SHOWING CHARACTER which shifted out away from the heels of SALSA BROTHERS.
Rounding the Home Turn, SHOWING CHARACTER raced in restricted room between SALSA BROTHERS and GENEROUS BOBO.
Passing the 300 Metres, OTOUTO was awkwardly placed close to the heels of MASTER VIKING after being disappointed for running inside that horse.
A veterinary inspection of NICE FANDANGO and GENEROUS BOBO immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GENEROUS BOBO, MASTER VIKING and REGENCY HONEY were sent for sampling.

At the time of declarations, N Callan was notified as the rider of MR RIGHT as a replacement rider for M L Yeung who was indisposed for this meeting following a race fall at Sha Tin on 11 June 2017.  It was established that Jockey Callan was declared as the replacement for M L Yeung without him being contacted to establish whether or not he was able to ride the horse.  As N Callan was not able to make MR RIGHTâs allocated weight of 119 lbs, U Rispoli was further substituted as the rider of that horse.  Trainer L Ho was fined the sum of $2,000 for failing to contact Jockey Callan regarding this ride prior to declaring him as the rider of MR RIGHT.  In assessing the appropriate penalty, the Stewards took into consideration that Mr Ho was required to obtain the services of another jockey after being made aware at a late stage of M L Yeungâs indisposition.
MAGIC AGILITY was slow to begin.
DIAMOND MASTER and MR RIGHT bumped at the start.
From a wide barrier, RACING MATE was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Despite being vigorously ridden along in the early stages, DIAMOND MASTER failed to muster speed.
Passing the 650 Metres, FLYING FORCE was steadied to avoid the heels of PREMIERE (J Moreira) which shifted in.  The Stewards were satisfied that the crowding to FLYING FORCE was accentuated by PREMIERE subsequently being awkwardly placed close to the heels of HAPPY COOPERATION which was steadied by its rider outside the lead.  Nonetheless J Moreira was advised that, in the opinion of the Stewards, he was not properly clear of FLYING FORCE when initially shifting in and for this he was severely reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is properly clear prior to shifting ground.  After this, FLYING FORCE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of PREMIERE and making the turn near the 550 Metres shifted out, resulting in DIAMOND MASTER being checked when crowded for room inside CIRCUIT KING.
Shortly after entering the Straight, NO MONEY NO TALK shifted out and brushed HAPPY COOPERATION.
Passing the 100 Metres, RACING MATE and CIRCUIT KING brushed as both horses shifted ground.
After the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on NO MONEY NO TALK at the request of Trainer D J Hall.  The Veterinary Surgeon said this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, NO MONEY NO TALK will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of HAPPY COOPERATION and MAGIC AGILITY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
RACING MATE and PREMIERE were sent for sampling.

SUNNY ORIENT began only fairly.
SUPER DUKE shifted out at the start and bumped GRACE HEART.
TRENDIFUL was crowded for room on jumping between GOOD COMPANION and RUMINARE which shifted in.  In this incident, GOOD COMPANION became unbalanced after being bumped by TRENDIFUL.
TRENDIFUL lost its left front plate shortly after the start.
From wide barriers, DR RACE and SCARBOROUGH FAIR were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Throughout the race, OUR HONOUR travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of LOVE CHUNGHWA immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm and an endoscopic examination also showed a substantial amount of mucus in the horseâs trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, LOVE CHUNGHWA will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of RUMINARE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GRACE HEART, GRACIOUS RYDER and GOOD COMPANION were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE SPORTS CLUB DIAMOND JUBILEE CHALLENGE CUP (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
APACHE SPIRIT began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped JADE FORTUNE.
From the outside barriers, TEN FLAMES, UNICORN and GIANT STARS were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Despite being vigorously ridden along in the early stages, BEAUTY LOVE failed to muster speed.
BRING IT ON travelled wide and without cover until passing the 1000 Metres.
Near the 950 Metres, BEAUTY LOVE commenced to prove very difficult to settle and shifted out away from the heels of WISKY, resulting in BEAUTY LOVE racing wide and without cover.
Passing the 900 Metres, TEN FLAMES commenced to prove very difficult to settle and shifted in away from the heels of BEAUTY LOVE.
Approaching the 700 Metres, BEAUTY LOVE raced tight outside THUNDER STOMP.
Rounding the Home Turn, APACHE SPIRIT got its head up when being checked away from the heels of VOLITATION which was giving ground.
Also rounding the Home Turn, SUPER CHIC raced tight outside JADE FORTUNE.
At the entrance to the Straight, GIANT STARS and THUNDER STOMP bumped, resulting in THUNDER STOMP becoming unbalanced.  Then in the early part of the Straight, GIANT STARS raced tight inside the heels of THUNDER STOMP.
After being disappointed for running between THUNDER STOMP and UNICORN, GIANT STARS was shifted to the inside of UNICORN approaching the 100 Metres to obtain clear running.
After the race, B Prebble was unable to offer any explanation for the disappointing performance of VOLITATION which gave ground in the Straight.  A veterinary inspection of VOLITATION immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of BEAUTY LOVE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of APACHE SPIRIT immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, APACHE SPIRIT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
JADE FORTUNE and SUPER CHIC were sent for sampling.

BIG BANG BONG shifted out at the start and bumped DYNAMISM.
GONNA RUN, FRIENDS OF KA YING and KING GENKI were all crowded for room shortly after the start between ANDOYAS and SPEEDY LONGWAH which, after being bumped by PACKING DRAGON, became unbalanced and shifted in.
From the outside barrier, INVENTOR was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
PACKING DRAGON travelled wide and without cover until passing the 1000 Metres.
Passing the 1000 Metres, DYNAMISM raced tight between SPEEDY LONGWAH and LET US WIN which shifted out away from the heels of RENAISSANCE ART.
Passing the 300 Metres, ANDOYAS was shifted in away from the heels of KING GENKI which was giving ground.
Also passing the 300 Metres, GONNA RUN got its head on the side and was awkwardly placed outside the heels of KING GENKI.
When questioned, N Callan stated that he was asked to ride SPEEDY LONGWAH behind the speed if possible in about 3rd, 4th or 5th position from a wide barrier.  He said it was felt that KING GENKI would be able to show speed in the early stages to possibly lead the race and with PACKING DRAGON being drawn to the outside of SPEEDY LONGWAH, it was further anticipated that that horse may be able to race outside KING GENKI which would provide SPEEDY LONGWAH with the opportunity to obtain cover in a forward position.  He said in accordance with his instructions, he rode his mount positively in the early stages to ensure that SPEEDY LONGWAH would be able to assume a forward position.  He said KING GENKI did not show as much speed as he anticipated and PACKING DRAGON took some time to improve its position forward of SPEEDY LONGWAH.  He said having asked SPEEDY LONGWAH for an effort in the early stages, he did not believe that the horse would have sufficient speed to cross KING GENKI and therefore after the 1200 Metres he allowed PACKING DRAGON to improve forward of SPEEDY LONGWAH and attempted to obtain a position behind KING GENKI with cover.  He said passing the 1100 Metres FRIENDS OF KA YING was ridden along to ensure that it maintained its position to the inside of SPEEDY LONGWAH and this resulted in his mount being left racing wide and without cover throughout the race.  He added SPEEDY LONGWAH came under heavy pressure after the 600 Metres and then in the early part of the Straight made an abnormal breathing noise and became unbalanced in its action.  He said as he held concerns over the welfare of the horse, he eased it down in the Straight.   A veterinary inspection of SPEEDY LONGWAH immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of SPEEDY LONGWAH, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, SPEEDY LONGWAH will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After the race, D Whyte stated that, in his opinion, KING GENKI is better suited to races on the All Weather Track as the horse travelled only fairly in the race and gave ground in the Straight.  A veterinary inspection of KING GENKI immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of FRIENDS OF KA YING immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
PACKING DRAGON, TIME WARP and BIG BANG BONG were sent for sampling.

LOTUS BREEZE began only fairly and then was crowded for room between JADE THEATRE and PRIMERO which shifted out.
From wide barriers, IRON BOY and OUR HERO were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Making the first turn near the 1050 Metres, the saddle of Apprentice M F Poon (GRACYDAD) shifted considerably to the right, resulting in him losing the use of initially his left iron and further around the first turn the effective use of his right iron, causing Apprentice Poon to be severely disadvantaged and unable to ride out GRACYDAD for the remainder of the race.
Making the turn approaching the 1000 Metres, CHEER WIN got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of PRIMERO.
Passing the 900 Metres, EXTREMELY FUN raced tight between BEST STEP and YOU READ MY MIND.
At the entrance to the Straight, GRACYDAD shifted out and bumped PRIMERO which became unbalanced.
Passing the 100 Metres, GRACYDAD, which was unable to be ridden out properly, PRIMERO and IRON BOY were all crowded for room between IâM A WITNESS (K C Ng) and OUR HERO (Apprentice H T Mo), both of which shifted ground.  Both K C Ng and Apprentice Mo were severely reprimanded and advised to ensure that they make a greater effort than they did on this occasion to keep their mounts on a straight course.
A veterinary inspection of LOTUS BREEZE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CHEER WIN, JADE THEATRE and EXTREMELY FUN were sent for sampling.

A SHIN HOOF was withdrawn on 17.6.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore).  Before being allowed to race again, A SHIN HOOF will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
BINGO began only fairly.
Passing the 400 Metres, RIVERSIDE BIRD was awkwardly placed outside the heels of CHAPARRAL STAR which shifted out.
HOT KING PRAWN and BINGO were sent for sampling.

SEA JADE was withdrawn on 17.6.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (fever) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter DRAGON GENERAL (Apprentice H N Wong).  Before being allowed to race again, SEA JADE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
On arrival at the Start, LUCKY DOLLAR, which was fractious and kicked a rail after leaving the Parade Ring, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
Also after leaving the Parade Ring, LEAN AMBASSADOR became fractious and made contact with a rail.  LEAN AMBASSADOR was examined by the Veterinary Officer on arrival at the Start who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
DRAGON GENERAL, which was fractious in the barriers, threw its head back as the start was effected and consequently was very slow to begin.  Before being allowed to race again, DRAGON GENERAL will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.  In this incident, Apprentice H N Wong was struck in the face by the head of DRAGON GENERAL.
HOUSE OF FUN began only fairly.
TURF SPRINT shifted out at the start and bumped LITTLE GIANT.
From the outside barriers, LEAN AMBASSADOR and BULB ELITE were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Apprentice H T Mo (SHAMAL) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that approaching and passing the 900 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of LUCKY DOLLAR which was taken in across the running of MOMENTUM LUCKY which was steadied and in turn shifted in, crowding the room of LITTLE GIANT.  In this incident, LUCKY DOLLAR struck the heels of SHAMAL near the 850 Metres and became unbalanced.  Apprentice Mo was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 25 June 2017 and to expire on Thursday, 29 June 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, Apprentice Mo was fined $15,000.
Approaching the 800 Metres, LITTLE GIANT commenced to prove difficult to settle and shifted out away from the heels of MOMENTUM LUCKY, resulting in FLYING TOURBILLON being taken wider.
LUCKY DOLLAR got its head on the side and lay out rounding the Home Turn.
DRAGON GENERAL lost its left front plate after the 400 Metres.
For the majority of the race, FLYING TOURBILLON travelled wide and without cover.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that SHAMAL had sustained an abrasion above the right hock and a small wound to the outside of the right hind fetlock.
A veterinary inspection of FLYING TOURBILLON immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
LITTLE GIANT, SHAMAL and HOUSE OF FUN were sent for sampling.

SUPERNATURAL and CASH COURIER bumped heavily at the start.  SUPERNATURAL, which became unbalanced, then shifted in and bumped the hindquarters of HOLY UNICORN which also became unbalanced.
Shortly after the start, TRUE COMMENT shifted out and bumped AEROLUMINANCE.
From wide barriers, SWEET BEAN and MY FOLKS were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 1500 Metres, GOLDEN PARTNERS was left racing wide and without cover.
After the 1500 Metres, LIGHTNING AND GOLD was steadied away from the heels of DRAGON BACHELOR (H W Lai) which shifted in when not properly clear.  H W Lai was advised to ensure that he provides sufficient clearance when shifting ground in similar circumstances.
HOLY UNICORN lost its left front plate near the 1300 Metres.
Passing the 1200 Metres, HIGH SPEED METRO commenced to travel keenly and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of AEROLUMINANCE.
Near the 1150 Metres, SUPERNATURAL shifted out away from the heels of HIGH SPEED METRO and bumped HOLY UNICORN.
Near the 550 Metres, CASH COURIER was steadied away from the heels of TRUE COMMENT after attempting to improve between that horse and GOLDEN PARTNERS where there was insufficient room.
Passing the 550 Metres, SUPERNATURAL dipped.
After the race, W M Lai reported that TRUE COMMENT came under heavy pressure prior to the Home Turn and in the early part of the Straight commenced to give ground.  He said when placed under pressure in the early part of the Straight, the horseâs head carriage lowered and it did not appear to be comfortable in its action.  A veterinary inspection of TRUE COMMENT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Before being allowed to race again, TRUE COMMENT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that AEROLUMINANCE had sustained a small wound to the outside of the right hock.
A veterinary inspection of CASH COURIER and SUPER SWEET ORANGE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
AEROLUMINANCE and LIGHTNING AND GOLD were sent for sampling.
<19/6/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>CASH COURIER, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  CASH COURIER was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer K L Man this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to have a sore right front fetlock and also have a stiff and restricted action.  Before being allowed to race again, CASH COURIER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

TELECOM TITAN was slow to begin and shortly after the start was steadied away from the heels of PENZANCE which, after being fractious in the barriers, began only fairly and then was bumped by EXPERTO CREDE which shifted in.
AMBITIOUS PINS was crowded for room on jumping between HAR HAR HEART which shifted out and GOOD METHOD (Apprentice H T Mo) which shifted in marginally.  GOOD METHOD then continued to shift in when being ridden along, resulting in HAR HAR HEART being steadied away from the heels of that horse a short distance later.  Apprentice Mo was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he exercises due care when riding his mounts along from the start.  After this, AMBITIOUS PINS was shifted across behind runners.
Also from the outside barriers, VIVA COUNCIL and MONEY WINNER were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners to obtain a position closer to the rail.
At the entrance to the Straight, TELECOM TITAN (H W Lai) shifted out and bumped MONEY WINNER which became unbalanced.  H W Lai was reprimanded and advised that, in the opinion of the Stewards, he should have done more to correct his mount prior to TELECOM TITAN making contact with MONEY WINNER.
Passing the 400 Metres, SUPERIOR BOY was shifted in to obtain clear running after being disappointed for a run between GOOD METHOD and EXPERTO CREDE.
Throughout the race, HAR HAR HEART travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, U Rispoli stated that he was instructed to ride VIVA COUNCIL quietly in the early stages as the horse had previously shown a propensity to hang out in its races.  He said making the turn after the 900 Metres VIVA COUNCIL immediately commenced to get its head on the side and hang out.  He said he followed AMBITIOUS PINS in the middle stages whilst VIVA COUNCIL continued to hang out and he was reluctant to allow the horse to shift to the outside of AMBITIOUS PINS as he felt that it would hang out more.  He said passing the 500 Metres he rode his mount along to have it improve its position and VIVA COUNCIL shifted out a number of horses and proved very difficult to ride.  He said he was unable to change his whip over into his right hand as the horse was hanging to the extent that he was reluctant to loosen the right rein as he believed the horse would shift out abruptly.  He added approaching the 300 Metres VIVA COUNCIL again shifted out a number of horses which resulted in him having to attempt to straighten the horse and then ride it out as best as he was able in the Straight whilst the horse continued to hang out.  The racing manners of VIVA COUNCIL were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, VIVA COUNCIL will be required to perform satisfactorily in a series of consecutive barrier trials around a bend.
After the race, J Moreira (PENZANCE) stated that, in his opinion, the horse, which was having its first race start, did not handle todayâs track conditions.  A veterinary inspection of PENZANCE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of PENZANCE, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, PENZANCE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of SILVERFIELD and GOOD METHOD immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
METALLIC STAR and EXPERTO CREDE were sent for sampling.

BEAUTY FLARE was withdrawn on 17.6.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (right fore tendon injury) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter CAPE THE FAITH (N Callan).  Before being allowed to race again, BEAUTY FLARE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
MY GIFT was slow to begin.
UNIQUE JOYOUS began only fairly and then, despite being ridden along, failed to muster speed.
From a wide barrier, RED HORSE was steadied in the early stages, however, throughout the race travelled wide and without cover.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, UNIQUE JOYOUS and SURE PEACE raced tight.
After the 1400 Metres, IMPERIAL CONCORDE raced tight inside ROCK THE TREE.
In the early stages, BOLSHOI BALLET (Apprentice M F Poon) travelled wide and without cover and after the 1100 Metres was allowed to improve its position to race outside the lead.  Near the 900 Metres, BOLSHOI BALLET was steadied after shifting in to race outside FIVE STARS AGENT, resulting in SUPER TALENT (U Rispoli) and SPICY KAKA, which were following, being hampered.  Apprentice Poon was warned against the practice of slackening the tempo too abruptly which does not allow other riders the opportunity to adjust to the change in tempo.  When questioned, U Rispoli stated that after having to be checked away from the heels of BOLSHOI BALLET, SUPER TALENT shifted out which resulted in SPICY KAKA quickly improving its position inside SUPER TALENT and causing SUPER TALENT to then race wide and without cover for the remainder of the race.  He added SUPER TALENT came under heavy pressure shortly after this incident and, despite being ridden along, did not close off the race.  A veterinary inspection of SUPER TALENT immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its left front leg.  The performance of SUPER TALENT, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, SUPER TALENT will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Passing the 400 Metres, WINASWEWISH was shifted out away from the heels of ROCK THE TREE.
Passing the 200 Metres, FIVE STARS AGENT was momentarily awkwardly placed inside the heels of NAMJONG INVINCIBLE which lay in.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that CAPE THE FAITH had bled from both nostrils.
A veterinary inspection of SPICY KAKA and BOLSHOI BALLET immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
NAMJONG INVINCIBLE and SURE PEACE were sent for sampling.

NOBLE DE BOY, which was fractious in the barriers, began awkwardly and lost ground.
SO GENEROUS began only fairly.
LONDON MASTER shifted out at the start and bumped CAREFREE LET GO.
From a wide barrier, OHANA was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Passing the 600 Metres, CAREFREE LET GO became unbalanced when bumped on a number of occasions by NOBLE DE BOY (Apprentice M F Poon) which improved into tight running between CAREFREE LET GO and SO GENEROUS.  Apprentice Poon was advised that whilst the Stewards encourage riders to improve their position where possible, they must do so whilst exercising due care.
About the 400 Metres, LONDON MASTER (C Schofield) was shifted out to improve into tight running between EVER STRONG and ZERO HEDGE which shifted in marginally.  In this incident, LONDON MASTER and ZERO HEDGE bumped, resulting in ZERO HEDGE, in particular, becoming unbalanced.  C Schofield was advised to exercise more care when shifting ground.
Near the 350 Metres, STARSHIP, when endeavouring to improve into tight running inside OUR FOLKS, was steadied when OUR FOLKS lay in marginally.  STARSHIP was then shifted out across the heels of OUR FOLKS to obtain clear running.
After the race, J Moreira stated that whilst ZERO HEDGE was somewhat disappointing in its failure to finish off the race, he believed that the horse having to race wide and without cover for the majority of the race on a rain affected track and at only its second race start were the factors which impacted upon its finishing effort.  A veterinary inspection of ZERO HEDGE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ZERO HEDGE, STARSHIP and OUR FOLKS were sent for sampling.

MCQUEEN began awkwardly and lost ground.
MISTER MONTE and AMAZING AGILITY bumped at the start.  Then from the outside barriers, MISTER MONTE and AMAZING AGILITY were shifted across behind runners.
ENSURING was crowded for room on jumping between UP AND COMING and LOTUS STRIKES BACK which was bumped and taken out by GORGEOUS AGAIN.
After the 1500 Metres, MISTER MONTE was ridden along to maintain its position inside VICTORY BOYS after being reluctant to remain racing inside that horse.
Passing the 600 Metres, ENSURING and LOTUS STRIKES BACK raced tight as ENSURING shifted out.
Passing the 400 Metres, MCQUEEN and UP AND COMING raced tight.
Approaching the 300 Metres, U Rispoli (MISTER MONTE) dropped his whip.
Throughout the race, AMAZING AGILITY travelled wide and without cover.
Apprentice M F Poon (VICTORY BOYS) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that passing the 50 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of GORGEOUS AGAIN, causing that horse to be checked and to lose the running to which it was rightfully entitled.  Apprentice Poon was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 9 July 2017 and to expire on Thursday, 13 July 2017 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).
When questioned, K C Leung stated that after having to make no use of GORGEOUS AGAIN in the early and middle stages and as the horse had a light weight, he shifted GORGEOUS AGAIN out away from the heels of UP AND COMING passing the 700 Metres as that horse was being niggled along and he did not want GREEN DISPATCH, which had enjoyed a soft lead, to gain too much of an advantage over GORGEOUS AGAIN.  He said although this resulted in GORGEOUS AGAIN racing three wide and without cover, he believed it was in the horseâs best interests to improve at this time so that GORGEOUS AGAIN was able to be as close as possible to GREEN DISPATCH rounding the Home Turn. 
A veterinary inspection of AMAZING AGILITY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
VICTORY BOYS and GREEN DISPATCH were sent for sampling.

TRAVEL FIRST was withdrawn on 17.6.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right hind).  Before being allowed to race again, TRAVEL FIRST will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
HEHA BOY began only fairly and shortly after the start raced tight inside WILLIE WAY which was taken in by WHITE MAGIC.
CELESTIAL ARROW began awkwardly.
From the outside barrier, LUCKY DAY was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, WHITE MAGIC was awkwardly placed close to the heels of GRAND HARBOUR.
CELESTIAL ARROW got its head on the side and lay out for some distance approaching and passing the 1400 Metres.
HEHA BOY lost its right front plate after the 800 Metres.
Near the 450 Metres, GRAND HARBOUR raced tight between DEJA VU and RED MARVEL.
For some distance after the 400 Metres, WILLIE WAY was held up for clear running after attempting to improve between WHITE MAGIC and TURIN PEARL where there was insufficient room.  WILLIE WAY was then shifted to the outside of TURIN PEARL after the 300 Metres to obtain clear running.
When questioned, Apprentice H N Wong stated that after being instructed to go forward on DEJA VU, he was left racing four wide and without cover in the early stages.  He said after the 1000 Metres he rode his mount forward of TURIN PEARL to cross that horse in an attempt to race in a three wide position.  He said he had to ride DEJA VU along for some distance to achieve this as the horse took some time to be in a position to cross TURIN PEARL.  He said after crossing that horse near the 800 Metres he continued to ride DEJA VU along as he did not want that horse, which had taken some riding, to lose ground in front of TURIN PEARL which would result in that horse being awkwardly placed behind DEJA VU.  He said for this reason he continued to niggle at his horse until after making the turn near the 700 Metres at which time he was able to briefly stop riding.  Apprentice Wong was advised that whilst the Stewards took no issue with him riding DEJA VU forward of TURIN PEARL to obtain a position closer to the rail, they were of the view that in the circumstances he should have attempted to steady DEJA VU so that that horse did not have to be continually ridden along.  He was further advised that the Stewards were also of the opinion that there appeared to be no indication that DEJA VU was going to lose ground in front of TURIN PEARL and cause interference to that horse and therefore he must, wherever possible, ride his mounts in such a manner so that they can finish off their race as best as they are able.
After the race, J Moreira reported that RED MARVEL, on the wet slow surface today, was challenged in the lead by GRAND HARBOUR which was unlike at its most recent start when the horse was able to enjoy an easier lead.  He said because of the circumstances of the race RED MARVEL did not finish off the race as expected.  A veterinary inspection of RED MARVEL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of GIANT TURTLE and GRAND HARBOUR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
RED MARVEL, WILLIE WAY and TURIN PEARL were sent for sampling.

ARM RUNDA and PERFECT CHOICE began only fairly.
FIONESAY shifted out at the start and bumped MYTHICAL EMPEROR, resulting in both horses becoming unbalanced and FIONESAY shifting in and hampering WINNING FAITH.  After this, from a wide barrier, WINNING FAITH was shifted across behind runners.
JUMBO LUCK and STAR OF JOY bumped at the start.
Making the first turn near the 900 Metres, ARM RUNDA commenced to prove difficult to settle and got its head up when being checked away from the heels of BRAVE LEGEND.
TRAVEL DATUK was held up for clear running in the early part of the Straight.
Near the 350 Metres, ARM RUNDA was shifted in away from the heels of HAIR TRIGGER.
Throughout the race, MYTHICAL EMPEROR travelled wide and without cover and in the Straight gave ground.  A veterinary inspection of MYTHICAL EMPEROR immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of MYTHICAL EMPEROR, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, MYTHICAL EMPEROR will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of ARM RUNDA immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
JUMBO LUCK and TRAVEL DATUK were sent for sampling.

ALL YOU WISH was withdrawn on 17.6.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore).  Before being allowed to race again, ALL YOU WISH will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
On arrival at the Start, the tongue tie applied to BABA MAMA was replaced.
From the outside barriers, KEEN VENTURE and BABA MAMA were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the 700 Metres, CIRCUIT HASSLER and CALIFORNIA JOY bumped after racing tight.
Passing the 400 Metres, RODRICO was momentarily crowded for room between MAGICAL BEAUTY and KEEN VENTURE, both of which shifted ground.
Passing the 300 Metres, KEEN VENTURE raced tight outside BABA MAMA.
Throughout the race, CIRCUIT HASSLER travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of SERGEANT TITANIUM immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
SEASONS BLOOM and CALIFORNIA JOY were sent for sampling.

PERFECT SMART began awkwardly and lost ground and shortly after the start was steadied away from the heels of HAPPY GAINS which shifted out after beginning only fairly.
ALL TIMES LUCKY was crowded for room on jumping between GLORY HORSIE which shifted out marginally and HURRICANE KID which shifted in and then shifted in further after being bumped by RED SUN which was taken in by NOBLE BUDDIES.
From a wide barrier, MANHATTAN STRIKER was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
GLORY HORSIE lost its right hind plate near the 950 Metres.
Making the first turn after the 650 Metres, KIM GLORY got its head on the side, shifted out and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of SPARKLING TALENT.
Passing the 600 Metres, NOBLE BUDDIES was awkwardly placed outside the heels of HIGHLAND DRAGON which shifted to the outside of RUGBY DIAMOND.
NOBLE BUDDIES made the Home Turn awkwardly and shifted out.
At the entrance to the Straight, HAPPY GAINS was shifted out across the heels of HURRICANE KID to obtain clear running.
Passing the 300 Metres, HURRICANE KID lay in and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of SPARKLING TALENT.
The Stewards deferred the declaration of weighed-in as they were of the prima facie view that an incident occurred in the Home Straight which cast sufficient doubt as to whether HIGHLAND DRAGON (J Moreira) should be declared the winner of the race.  Prior to weighing-in, Z Purton, the rider of RUGBY DIAMOND, 3rd placegetter, lodged a formal protest/objection against HIGHLAND DRAGON being declared the winner alleging interference over about the last 150 Metres.  After taking evidence from all the parties concerned and after viewing the videos, the Stewards found that in the early part of the Straight HIGHLAND DRAGON got its head on the side and commenced to hang in under pressure and near the 175 Metres shifted in and crowded RUGBY DIAMOND before being directed back out away from RUGBY DIAMOND.  During this incident, J Moreira dropped his whip.  The Stewards further found that HIGHLAND DRAGON continued to hang in and at about the 110 Metres shifted in and bumped RUGBY DIAMOND.  HIGHLAND DRAGON then continued to hang in, resulting in RUGBY DIAMOND being badly crowded for room and becoming unbalanced after being bumped on a number of occasions by HIGHLAND DRAGON until near the 30 Metres.  Then close to the finishing line, RUGBY DIAMOND and HIGHLAND DRAGON raced tight as a result of HIGHLAND DRAGON continuing to lay in.  Having regard to the manner in which both horses finished off the race and in particular the margin which separated the two horses at the end of the race, the Stewards were satisfied that had the interference not occurred, RUGBY DIAMOND would have finished in front of HIGHLAND DRAGON.  Accordingly, the protest/objection lodged by Jockey Purton was sustained and the placings amended to read No. 4, SPARKLING TALENT, 1st; No. 1, RUGBY DIAMOND, 2nd; No. 7, HIGHLAND DRAGON, 3rd; and No. 12, NOBLE BUDDIES, 4th.  Subsequently J Moreira was reprimanded and advised that whilst the Stewards accepted that HIGHLAND DRAGON was proving difficult to ride, nonetheless in similar circumstances he must make every endeavour to prevent his mounts from shifting ground and causing interference to other runners.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that GLORY HORSIE had sustained wounds to the right hind fetlock.
HAPPY GAINS, SPARKLING TALENT and RUGBY DIAMOND were sent for sampling.

PLAIN BLUE BANNER and ALWAYS WONGCHOY bumped at the start.
WINNING VIBE, which was being steadied, was crowded for room on jumping between PLANET GIANT and ABLE TALENT which shifted out.
GREAT SKY shifted in at the start and bumped the hindquarters of FUN MANAGER.  After this, from a wide barrier, GREAT SKY was shifted across behind runners.
After travelling a short distance, ABLE TALENT and LETSGOFREE bumped.
Near the 1150 Metres, GOBI STORM and SPICY DOUBLE bumped.
After the 700 Metres, WINNING VIBE travelled wide and without cover.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, GO-GETTER raced tight inside PLANET GIANT which got its head on the side and lay in.
Rounding the Home Turn, FUN MANAGER shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of LETSGOFREE.
When questioned, Apprentice M F Poon stated that he had been asked to ride PLANET GIANT positively in the early stages and lead if possible or if the rider of another horse was intent on leading, to sit outside that horse.  He said, despite being vigorously ridden for a considerable distance in the early stages, PLANET GIANT did not have sufficient speed to prevent GOBI STORM from crossing his mount approaching the 1300 Metres and consequently was not able to lead or sit outside the leader.
When questioned, C Murray stated that he had been asked to ride SPICY DOUBLE in a forward position from the outside barrier and try to obtain a position behind the leaders.  He said when SPICY DOUBLE was left racing wide after the 1300 Metres, he then allowed it to continue forward rather than remaining racing in a three wide position.  He said after obtaining a position outside GOBI STORM near the 1100 Metres, he attempted to steady his mount and race outside that horse, however, SPICY DOUBLE, after being ridden along in the early stages to take up a forward position, travelled keenly.  He said after the 1000 Metres he improved forward of GOBI STORM with a view to crossing that horse and was able to obtain about a three quarter length margin over GOBI STORM.  He said SPICY DOUBLE however was only travelling fairly at this stage and he believed that he would have had to make further use of his mount to go forward of GOBI STORM even though it appeared that the rider of that horse seemed content to take a trailing position behind SPICY DOUBLE.  He said for this reason he remained racing outside GOBI STORM rather than pushing forward into the lead.  He added after the 700 Metres SPICY DOUBLE came under heavy pressure and then finished off the race only fairly in the Straight. 
A veterinary inspection of GOBI STORM immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of GOBI STORM, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, GOBI STORM will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of WINNING VIBE immediately following the race found that horse to have sustained a small wound to the right hind fetlock.
A veterinary inspection of GO-GETTER and ALWAYS WONGCHOY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
LETSGOFREE and PLANET GIANT were sent for sampling.
<22/6/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>GOBI STORM, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  GOBI STORM was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer A S Cruz this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right front leg.  As previously advised, GOBI STORM will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.

JIMSON THE FAMOUS was steadied on jumping and shifted across behind runners.
Also from wide barriers, SUPER CLAN and APPLAUSE were steadied in the early stages to obtain cover.
Shortly after the start, GOLDEN DEER and COLOURFUL ACHIEVER bumped.
In the Straight, PHANTOM FALCON lay out under pressure.
Throughout the race, APPLAUSE travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, K Teetan (CONFUCIUS SPIRIT) stated that, from barrier 7, he had been asked to have the horse travelling where it was comfortable but not to make use of it in the early stages to do so.  He said it was felt that due to the makeup of the field, the horse would be able to obtain a position in about midfield, where it was ridden at its most recent start.  He said on that occasion CONFUCIUS SPIRIT closed off the race well when not asked to do too much in the early stages.  He said at the start prior to the most recent race he had been asked to make use of CONFUCIUS SPIRIT in the early stages because of the horse having drawn barrier 1 and it was felt that it was in CONFUCIUS SPIRITâs best interests on that occasion to take advantage of the inside draw.  He said in todayâs race a number of horses which were drawn to the inside of CONFUCIUS SPIRIT began on terms with the horse and he felt that he would have had to ride his mount quite aggressively to clear those runners and obtain a position closer to the rail which would have been contrary to his instructions.  He said he therefore steadied CONFUCIUS SPIRIT in the early stages and shifted across behind THE INVINCIBLE to obtain cover.  He said this resulted in CONFUCIUS SPIRIT racing further back in the field than had been intended.  He said whilst in the middle stages he was unable to make ground due to horses in advance of CONFUCIUS SPIRIT not being able to improve their position, nonetheless CONFUCIUS SPIRIT was disappointing and did not close off the race.  He added, in his opinion, CONFUCIUS SPIRIT did not appear to travel as comfortably in tonightâs race as it had been at its previous starts when ridden by him.
A veterinary inspection of LEOWL and CONFUCIUS SPIRIT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
NASHASHUK and FOX SUNTER were sent for sampling.

On arrival at the Start, BO DUKEâs right hind plate was adjusted.  BO DUKE was subsequently examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
BO DUKE shifted in on jumping, resulting in KING BOUNTIFUL being crowded for room outside AMAZING GOLD.
KING OF MONGOLIA shifted in at the start and bumped GOLD VELVET.  KING OF MONGOLIA was then ridden along, however, after the 1700 Metres was steadied to obtain cover.
Shortly after the start, PROUD SKY raced tight between CASA MASTER and FANCY MUSIC which was taken in by BALAY BALAY.
From a wide barrier, GOOD CHOICE was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Near the 1600 Metres, KING WINSA shifted in and bumped BALAY BALAY.
For some distance approaching the winning post on the first occasion, AMAZING GOLD got its head up when awkwardly placed behind BO DUKE.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, CASA MASTER commenced to travel keenly and got its head up when racing close to the heels of KING OF MONGOLIA.
Making the turn near the 1000 Metres, KING BOUNTIFUL commenced to travel keenly and got its head up when being steadied away from the heels of AMAZING GOLD.
Near the 850 Metres, AMAZING GOLD and GOLD VELVET raced tight.  Then near the 800 Metres, GOLD VELVET was bumped by AMAZING GOLD which shifted out when awkwardly placed close to the heels of PO CHING TREASURE.
After initially being shifted to the inside of BALAY BALAY passing the 300 Metres to obtain clear running, KING WINSA was then directed out passing the 200 Metres when BALAY BALAY drifted in.
For the majority of the race, PROUD SKY travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, Z Purton stated that he had to ride FANCY MUSIC along when the field commenced to quicken approaching the 900 Metres as a result of BO DUKE being ridden forward.  He said FANCY MUSIC did not respond to his riding and he had to ride the horse aggressively after the 700 Metres in an attempt to have it improve its position.  He said, despite being hard ridden, FANCY MUSIC did not respond and as he felt that something may be amiss with the horse, he eased it down rounding the Home Turn.  A veterinary inspection of FANCY MUSIC immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of FANCY MUSIC, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, FANCY MUSIC will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of CASA MASTER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
KING WINSA, PO CHING TREASURE and KING BOUNTIFUL were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE MANAWATU RACING CLUB CHALLENGE TROPHY (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
FULL GLAMOUR, which was fractious in the barrier stalls, began only fairly and then shortly after the start was crowded for room inside YOUNG EMPIRE.
PACKING STONES began only fairly and then shortly after the start was crowded for room between SHANGHAI MASTER and THOR THE GREATEST, both of which shifted ground.
From the outside barrier, GLORIOUS PARTNERS was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Despite being vigorously ridden along in the early stages, OUTLAWED failed to muster speed.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, SHANGHAI MASTER was awkwardly placed close to the heels of YOUNG EMPIRE.
Passing the 300 Metres, WAYFOONG VINNIE was shifted to the inside of NAVAS to obtain clear running.
Approaching the 100 Metres, GLORIOUS PARTNERS and GENEROUS HEART brushed.
Over the concluding stages, OUTLAWED raced close to the heels of WAYFOONG VINNIE which was racing tight inside YOUNG EMPIRE.
Also over the concluding stages, YOUNG EMPIRE was crowded for room inside SHANGHAI MASTER which was steadied to avoid the heels of FANTASTIC FEELING (Apprentice M F Poon) which, after shifting in under pressure, was then straightened by Apprentice Poon close to the finishing line.  In this incident, Apprentice Poon was required to stop riding his mount in order to straighten it.  Apprentice Poon was severely reprimanded and told that whilst he had straightened his mount to prevent causing interference to his inside, nonetheless, in the opinion of the Stewards, he should have taken the corrective action earlier than he did on this occasion.
The Stewards heard a complaint lodged by Mr J P Ridley, the Clubâs Director of Racing Operations, regarding a matter involving Jockey Z Purton prior to the winning presentation following this race.  After taking evidence from Mr Ridley and Jockey Purton and after viewing the video footage with associated audio coverage of the relevant incident, Z Purton was charged with improper conduct under Rule 155(5), the improper conduct being that when approached by a member of the Clubâs staff to proceed with more haste to the winning presentation following this race, he did use threatening language to the staff member.  Z Purton pleaded guilty to the charge.  After considering all the circumstance of this incident and Jockey Purtonâs prior record in respect of conduct related offences, the Stewards felt it appropriate to fine him the sum of $100,000.
When questioned, C Schofield stated that he had been asked to ride GENEROUS HEART positively in the early stages from a wide barrier and obtain a position behind the leaders with cover if possible.  He said it was explained to him that GENEROUS HEART possesses early speed and had been ridden in a forward position in a recent barrier trial following its last start.  He said in accordance with his instructions he rode GENEROUS HEART along and believed that an opportunity was presenting itself approaching the 1000 Metres to obtain a position with cover behind YOUNG EMPIRE.  He said however that YOUNG EMPIRE did not improve forward as he had hoped and this allowed FULL GLAMOUR to improve its position inside GENEROUS HEART which resulted in GENEROUS HEART racing wide and without cover throughout the race.  A veterinary inspection of GENEROUS HEART immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of PACKING STONES immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
LUCKY WAN FENG and FANTASTIC FEELING were sent for sampling.

On arrival at the Start, it was noted that GENTRY had lost its left front plate.  After this plate was refitted, GENTRY was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said in his opinion it was suitable to race.
VICTORY FOLLOW ME was slow to begin.
HIT A HOME RUN began very awkwardly, shifted in and bumped the hindquarters of BORN TO RACE which also was bumped by WIN FOR CHARITY which shifted out after beginning awkwardly.  A short distance after this, HIT A HOME RUN was crowded for room between EXCELLENCE and BORN TO RACE which shifted out.  Then from wide barriers, HIT A HOME RUN, EXCELLENCE and LETâS TAKE IT EASY were all shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Shortly after the start, WIN FOR CHARITY, after bumping BORN TO RACE, became unbalanced and shifted in and in doing so bumped the hindquarters of CHARITY KINGDOM, resulting in WIN FOR CHARITY (C Murray) blundering.  C Murray said after WIN FOR CHARITY blundered, he then rode his mount along in an attempt to take up a forward position, however, WIN FOR CHARITY did not appear comfortable in its action in front and as he believed that the horse may have suffered an injury when it blundered, he then commenced to ease it out of the race approaching the 1500 Metres.  A veterinary inspection of WIN FOR CHARITY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Before being allowed to race again, WIN FOR CHARITY will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
In the middle stages, CONTRIBUTION travelled keenly in the lead.
GENTRY lost its left front plate near the 700 Metres.
Approaching the 500 Metres, EXCELLENCE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of VICTORY FOLLOW ME.
Near the 450 Metres, HIT A HOME RUN and LETâS TAKE IT EASY raced tight as HIT A HOME RUN shifted out to improve.
BORN TO RACE lost its right front plate near the 300 Metres.
Near the 250 Metres, VICTORY FOLLOW ME was shifted to the inside of GENTRY.  VICTORY FOLLOW ME then raced in restricted room inside GENTRY passing the 200 Metres and then passing the 100 Metres was shifted out away from the heels of CONTRIBUTION after being awkwardly placed behind that horse.
Near the 50 Metres, U Rispoli (CHARITY KINGDOM) dropped his whip.
After the 50 Metres, GENTRY raced tight inside BORN TO RACE.
A veterinary inspection of RAGING BULL immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm and was also lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, RAGING BULL will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
CONTRIBUTION, IMPERIAL GALLANTRY and GO GO WIN were sent for sampling.

HELLA HEDGE was withdrawn on 20.6.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (heart irregularity) and was replaced by first Standby Declared Starter ROYAL MOJITO (W M Lai).  DIEGO KOSTA was also withdrawn on 20.6.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and was replaced by second Standby Declared Starter ALL BEST FRIENDS (H W Lai).  Before being allowed to race again, HELLA HEDGE will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination whilst DIEGO KOSTA will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SHARP HUNTER was slow to begin.
ROYAL MOJITO bounded in the air at the start, shifted in and bumped WHAT MAN HORSE, causing both horses to become unbalanced.  After this, both WHAT MAN HORSE and ROYAL MOJITO were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
ALL GREAT FRIENDS shifted out at the start and bumped AMAZING RACE.
POWERMAX began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped JOLLY CONVERGENCE.
Passing the 900 Metres, COLCHESTER was checked when momentarily crowded for room between ALL GREAT FRIENDS which shifted out marginally and POWERMAX (Apprentice M F Poon) which got its head on the side and shifted in despite the efforts of its rider.  When COLCHESTER was checked, JOLLY CONVERGENCE, which was following, was checked away from the heels of that horse in consequence.  Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that COLCHESTERâs racing manners, after being momentarily crowded for room, had exacerbated this incident, nonetheless Apprentice Poon was advised to exercise more care in similar circumstances.
In the early part of the Straight, POWERMAX lay in and initially proved reluctant to shift to the outside of DOLLAR REWARD.
Over the concluding stages, JOLLY CONVERGENCE raced tight inside DOLLAR REWARD, resulting in JOLLY CONVERGENCE not being able to be ridden out all the way to the end of the race.  SHARP HUNTER, which was racing to the inside of JOLLY CONVERGENCE, was inconvenienced in consequence.
Throughout the race, POWERMAX travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of AMAZING RACE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
The Veterinary Surgeon reported that SHARP HUNTER had sustained a right front suspensory ligament injury after racing.  Before being allowed to race again, SHARP HUNTER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
POWERMAX, ALL GREAT FRIENDS and HARRIER JET were sent for sampling.

GOLDEN SLEEP was withdrawn on 20.6.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (injury to left front foot) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter THE JOY OF GIVING (W M Lai).  Before being allowed to race again, GOLDEN SLEEP will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
THE JOY OF GIVING and FANTASTIC KAKA were slow to begin and then on jumping THE JOY OF GIVING was bumped by FANTASTIC KAKA which was taken in by SUPER SPRINTER which shifted in.
GAMECHANGERS shifted out at the start and bumped STAR MAJESTIC.
From a wide barrier, SUPER MAN was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
For some distance approaching and passing the 1100 Metres, KIRAM travelled keenly and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of BULLISH SMART.
Making the turn after the 600 Metres, FANTASTIC KAKA shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of KIRAM.  KIRAM then became unbalanced and lay in, resulting in FANTASTIC KAKA being crowded for room..
Near the 250 Metres, SPICY SURE raced tight inside SKYROCKETS which shifted in.  After this, SPICY SURE and SKYROCKETS continued to race tight for a short distance.
Passing the 250 Metres, GAMECHANGERS was shifted out away from the heels of LAND GRANT which shifted in.
Also passing the 250 Metres, SUPER SPRINTER was awkwardly placed outside SKYROCKETS.
Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the riding of Apprentice M F Poon (SUPER SPRINTER), 5th placegetter, over the concluding stages did not affect the horseâs finishing position, nonetheless he will be advised to ensure that he rides his mounts out all the way to the end of the race where circumstances permit.
A veterinary inspection of SKYROCKETS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that SUPER SPRINTER was lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, SUPER SPRINTER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
STAR MAJESTIC, KIRAM and BULLISH SMART were sent for sampling.

KING OF SMARTS began awkwardly and shortly after the start was awkwardly placed outside the heels of VICTORY DUKE which shifted out.
LE PEGASE and WINNINGLI bumped at the start.
Shortly after the start, LE PEGASE was steadied away from the heels of INVISIBLE which shifted out.
From a wide barrier, ACTUARIAT was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Making the turn passing the 900 Metres, WINNINGLI shifted in and bumped YOURTHEWONFORME.  KWAICHUNG BROTHERS, which was following, was eased away from the heels of YOURTHEWONFORME in consequence.
