race_name: TUEN MUN PUBLIC RIDING SCHOOL HANDICAP
incident_report:
GREENERY FORTUNE began only fairly.
JOLLY BOUNTIFUL shifted in at the start and bumped INDIGENOUS STAR.  JOLLY BOUNTIFUL then became unbalanced and shifted out and in doing so made heavy contact with COOL AND NEAT, resulting in JOLLY BOUNTIFUL being buffeted for some distance between INDIGENOUS STAR and COOL AND NEAT.
From wide barriers, TELECOM TITAN and VARA PEARL were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Near the 1050 Metres, GREENERY FORTUNE became unbalanced of its own accord and lost ground.  INDIGENOUS STAR, which was following GREENERY FORTUNE, was shifted out away from behind that horse which resulted in INDIGENOUS STAR becoming awkwardly placed close to the heels of MASSIVE POWER.  For a short distance after this, INDIGENOUS STAR raced keenly and making the turn near the 900 Metres got its head on the side and lay out and in doing so raced tight inside EXPERTO CREDE.
Approaching and passing the 800 Metres, JOLLY BOUNTIFUL commenced to travel keenly and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of EXPERTO CREDE, resulting in the horse being shifted out away from behind EXPERTO CREDE after the 800 Metres and then travelling wide and without cover.
Near the 750 Metres, CHIU CHOW KID was awkwardly placed outside the heels of COOL AND NEAT which shifted out from behind INDIGENOUS STAR.
Passing the 700 Metres, as JOLLY BOUNTIFUL improved to its outside, EXPERTO CREDE commenced to travel keenly and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of MASSIVE POWER.
Near the 650 Metres, INDIGENOUS STAR was steadied away from the heels of GREENERY FORTUNE.
Approaching the 600 Metres, EXPERTO CREDE and WUSHU CHAMPION raced tight.
Passing the 400 Metres, CORRE RAPIDO was awkwardly placed close to the heels of LOOK ERAS.
Near the 350 Metres, VARA PEARL was steadied and shifted to the outside of GREENERY FORTUNE after being disappointed for running inside that horse.
CHIU CHOW KID lost its right front plate near the 100 Metres.
From a wide barrier, WUSHU CHAMPION travelled wide and without cover for the majority of the race.
A veterinary inspection of COOL AND NEAT immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm and an endoscopic examination conducted on COOL AND NEAT also showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, COOL AND NEAT will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of CHIU CHOW KID immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, CHIU CHOW KID will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
COOL AND NEAT, GREAT TREASURE and EXPERTO CREDE were sent for sampling.
<10/7/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>The Clinical Veterinary Surgeon reported that WUSHU CHAMPION was lame in its right front leg on the morning after racing.  Before being allowed to race again, WUSHU CHAMPION will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
COOL AND NEAT, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm and an endoscopic examination conducted on the horse also showed a substantial amount of blood in its trachea.  COOL AND NEAT was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer D J Hall this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right hind leg.  As previously advised, COOL AND NEAT will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.

race_name: POK FU LAM PUBLIC RIDING SCHOOL HANDICAP
incident_report:
GOKO was slow to begin.
MASSIVE MILLENNIUM began awkwardly.
VICTORY FOLLOW ME began only fairly and shifted in towards the heels of GIDDY GIDDY.
LIGHTNING MISSILE began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped RESPECT.
Shortly after the start, LIGHTNING MISSILE was tightened for room between RESPECT and BOLSHOI BALLET (B Prebble) which shifted in.  B Prebble was reprimanded.
Passing the 1000 Metres, OHANA raced tight between MASSIVE MILLENNIUM and VICTORY FOLLOW ME (J Moreira) which got its head on the side and lay in.  As J Moreira was attempting to direct VICTORY FOLLOW ME out to relieve the tightening to OHANA, VICTORY FOLLOW ME got its head up and shifted in away from the heels of BOLSHOI BALLET (B Prebble) which shifted in.  This resulted in OHANA being crowded for room and VICTORY FOLLOW ME losing ground.  B Prebble was reprimanded and advised that whilst there were some circumstances associated to this incident, nonetheless he must ensure that he is clear of other runners when shifting ground in future.
BOLSHOI BALLET lost its right front plate near the 900 Metres.
Passing the 800 Metres, GOKO became unbalanced when being steadied away from the heels of STAR SUPERIOR.
Passing the 500 Metres, LIGHTNING MISSILE was shifted out away from the heels of BOLSHOI BALLET which got its head on the side and lay out.
Close to the finishing line, B Prebble dropped his whip.
Throughout the race, both BOLSHOI BALLET and LIGHTNING MISSILE travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of GOKO, RESPECT and VICTORY FOLLOW ME immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GIDDY GIDDY and STAR SUPERIOR were sent for sampling.

race_name: LEI YUE MUN PUBLIC RIDING SCHOOL HANDICAP
incident_report:
WINFULL PATROL was withdrawn on 8.7.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter CREME BRULEE (U Rispoli).  Before being allowed to race again, WINFULL PATROL will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
MAGICAL CHAMPION began awkwardly and lost ground.
PEACE COMBINATION began awkwardly and shifted in at the start, bumping with ENCORE BOY which also shifted out.  ENCORE BOY then became unbalanced after being bumped by GALLANT ROCK which shifted out.  In this incident, ENCORE BOY shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of PEACE COMBINATION, causing that horse to become unbalanced and in turn shift out and inconvenience BRAVE KNIGHT.  After this, ENCORE BOY, when being ridden along, lay out and raced tight inside PEACE COMBINATION.
Passing the 300 Metres, SUNSHINE UNIVERSE was shifted in across the heels of HOT HOT PEPPER in an attempt to obtain clear running.
 Near the 250 Metres, SUNSHINE UNIVERSE shifted in and bumped PEACE COMBINATION (J Moreira).  When this occurred, J Moreira dropped his whip.  After this, SUNSHINE UNIVERSE and PEACE COMBINATION raced tight and passing the 100 Metres SUNSHINE UNIVERSE and PEACE COMBINATION again bumped on a number of occasions as SUNSHINE UNIVERSE attempted to improve into tight running between PEACE COMBINATION which was laying out and ENCORE BOY which also shifted out under pressure.
Close to the finishing line, SUNSHINE UNIVERSE was awkwardly placed close to the heels of ENCORE BOY which was straightened by its rider.  This resulted in SUNSHINE UNIVERSE and PEACE COMBINATION again making contact as PEACE COMBINATION continued to lay out.  Consequently SUNSHINE UNIVERSE was not able to be properly tested all the way to the end of the race.  PEACE COMBINATION also proved difficult to ride out over the final 200 Metres when laying out.
Passing the 50 Metres, BRAVE KNIGHT was momentarily awkwardly placed close to the heels of BEEKELY.
When questioned, Apprentice H T Mo (FISH Nâ CHIPS) stated that he was instructed to ride the horse in a forward position.  He said in the early stages FISH Nâ CHIPS was able to race prominently to be positioned inside GALLANT ROCK.  He said however FISH Nâ CHIPS did not feel comfortable in its action and passing the 700 Metres got its head on the side and lay out towards the heels of GALLANT ROCK when ENCHANTED FEELING improved to its inside.  He said after this FISH Nâ CHIPS was reluctant to maintain its position when racing tight outside ENCHANTED FEELING.  He added FISH Nâ CHIPS continued to be reluctant to stretch out after being shifted away from the heels of the tiring GALLANT ROCK near the 250 Metres and subsequently finished off the race only fairly.  A veterinary inspection of FISH Nâ CHIPS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
After the race, S Clipperton stated that after being vigorously ridden along in the early stages from the inside barrier to take up a forward position, ZERO HEDGE travelled only fairly in the middle stages and then came under pressure passing the 500 Metres.  He said after this ZERO HEDGE was disappointing in the manner in which it gave ground.  A veterinary inspection of ZERO HEDGE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
When questioned, Apprentice H N Wong stated that in the middle stages TOURBILLON KING appeared reluctant to maintain its position when racing tight outside BEEKELY.  He said he had to ride his mount along after the 600 Metres in an endeavour to have it maintain its position, however, TOURBILLON KING would not stretch out fully and then after BEEKELY was able to establish a margin over TOURBILLON KING, his mount weakened and was disappointing.  A veterinary inspection of TOURBILLON KING immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
A veterinary inspection of GALLANT ROCK immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ENCORE BOY and HOT HOT PEPPER were sent for sampling.

race_name: POK FU LAM RESERVOIR ROAD HANDICAP
incident_report:
Shortly after the start, OPEN HOUSE was crowded for room between ART OF RAW and SILLY BUDDIES which shifted out after being brushed by URBAN CHIC.  In this incident, ART OF RAW became unbalanced after being bumped on the hindquarters by OPEN HOUSE.
From a wide barrier, WAYFOONG VINNIE was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
WAYFOONG VINNIE lost its right front plate near the 650 Metres.
Passing the 250 Metres, the whip of J Moreira (SUNNY WIN) was knocked from his grasp by the whip of Z Purton (SUPER WISE).
Approaching the 200 Metres, M L Yeung (GOLDEN KID) dropped his whip.
Near the 100 Metres, E-SUPER and KHAKI bumped.
WAYFOONG VINNIE lay in under pressure and proved difficult to ride in the Straight.
A veterinary inspection of KHAKI and ELITE SPIRIT immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SUNNY WIN and WAYFOONG VINNIE were sent for sampling.

race_name: THE HONG KONG RIDING FOR THE DISABLED ASSOCIATION CUP (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
UNIQUE JOYOUS was slow to begin.
SUCH A HAPPINESS began only fairly.
From wide barriers, COOL BROTHERS and GOLDEN ACHIEVER were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Despite being hard ridden in the early stages, THE SHOW failed to muster speed.
For some distance approaching and passing the 1300 Metres, SICHUAN BOSS got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of SUCH A HAPPINESS.
At the entrance to the Straight, COOL BROTHERS shifted out and bumped the hindquarters of ELECTRIC LIGHTNING which became unbalanced.
GOLDEN ACHIEVER had some difficulty obtaining clear running from passing the 200 Metres until approaching the 100 Metres at which time the horse was shifted to the inside of THE SHOW in an attempt to obtain clear running.
Close to the finishing line, UNIQUE JOYOUS was awkwardly placed close to the heels of TEAM SWEET.
Also close to the finishing line, ELECTRIC LIGHTNING was awkwardly placed close to the heels of SUCH A HAPPINESS.
Throughout the race, LETâS TAKE IT EASY travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, D Whyte stated that it had been intended for ELECTRIC LIGHTNING to be ridden in a forward position from a wide barrier.  He said in accordance with his instructions he rode ELECTRIC LIGHTNING positively in the early stages, however, the tempo of the race in the early stages was quicker than its most recent start when the horse was able to obtain a forward position.  He said when ELECTRIC LIGHTNING was left racing wide after the 1500 Metres, he elected to steady the horse and obtain cover rather than continuing to ride it along in an endeavour to clear runners to its inside and obtain a forward position.  He added this resulted in ELECTRIC LIGHTNING racing further back in the field than had been intended, however, the horse performed well and finished off the race strongly when ridden in this manner.
After the race, the Veterinary Officer reported that SICHUAN BOSS was lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, SICHUAN BOSS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of GOLDEN ACHIEVER immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
INFINITY ENDEAVOUR, SUCH A HAPPINESS and ELECTRIC LIGHTNING were sent for sampling.

race_name: POK FU LAM RESERVOIR ROAD HANDICAP
incident_report:
On arrival at the barriers, MR RIGHT, which had made contact with a rail when proceeding to the Start, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and found to be suitable to race.
HAPPY SURVEYS and GORGEOUS KING began only fairly.
PERFECT CHOICE shifted out at the start, resulting in HAPPY COOPERATION being taken out onto ARIZONA BLIZZARD.  ARIZONA BLIZZARD then shifted out and bumped HAPPY HAPPY STAR.  After this, PERFECT CHOICE was steadied to obtain cover.
Approaching the 700 Metres, HARBOUR ALERT commenced to travel keenly and was awkwardly placed close to the heels of MR RIGHT.
Making the turn near the 700 Metres, BORNTOACHIEVE was steadied away from the heels of MR RIGHT (U Rispoli) which shifted in when not properly clear.  U Rispoli was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he provides sufficient clearance when shifting ground in similar circumstances.  After this, BORNTOACHIEVE commenced to prove difficult to settle and got its head up when being steadied away from the heels of MR RIGHT.
For some distance approaching and passing the 600 Metres, HARBOUR ALERT, which was continuing to travel keenly, was awkwardly placed close to the heels of HAPPY COOPERATION.
From shortly after the 300 Metres until near the 150 Metres, PAKISTAN BABY was held up for clear running.
After the 200 Metres, ARIZONA BLIZZARD lay in under pressure.
Near the 100 Metres, PERFECT CHOICE was awkwardly placed outside the heels of PAKISTAN BABY when racing tight inside MOST BEAUTIFUL.
BORNTOACHIEVE was held up for clear running over the concluding stages and approaching the winning post shifted out away from the heels of HAPPY COOPERATION, resulting in GORGEOUS KING and PERFECT CHOICE being placed in restricted room.
Throughout the race, MOST BEAUTIFUL travelled wide and without cover.
HAPPY COOPERATION, HARBOUR ALERT and ARIZONA BLIZZARD were sent for sampling.

race_name: POK FU LAM COUNTRY PARK HANDICAP
incident_report:
DYNAMISM was withdrawn on 8.7.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (sore left fore fetlock).  Before being allowed to race again, DYNAMISM will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
ANDOYAS was slow to begin.
GENERAL SHERMAN began awkwardly and then was crowded for room with RENAISSANCE ART between PRAWN BABA which shifted in marginally and ROCKETEER which shifted out.
Passing the 1700 Metres, ANDOYAS raced tight between HAPPILABABY and HELENE CHARISMA.
Approaching the winning post on the first occasion, SUPREME PROFIT shifted out marginally and made heavy contact with the hindquarters of BASIC TRILOGY which was laying in.  This resulted in BASIC TRILOGY becoming badly unbalanced and being turned in across the running of SUPREME PROFIT, causing that horse to be checked.  When SUPREME PROFIT was checked, that horse shifted in and bumped PRAWN BABA which in turn shifted in and bumped RENAISSANCE ART.  GENERAL SHERMAN, which was racing to the inside of RENAISSANCE ART, was steadied when crowded for room between RENAISSANCE ART and ROCKETEER and in doing so became badly unbalanced.  After being turned in across SUPREME PROFIT, BASIC TRILOGY was then awkwardly placed inside the heels of GREEN DISPATCH (Apprentice H T Mo) which, when being ridden along, got its head on the side and lay in.  In this incident, Apprentice Mo stopped riding GREEN DISPATCH and attempted to shift that horse out to relieve the tightening to BASIC TRILOGY.  Apprentice Mo was advised that whilst the primary reason for SUPREME PROFIT being checked was as a result of contact on the hindquarters by BASIC TRILOGY, nonetheless in similar circumstances he must ensure that he makes every endeavour to prevent his mounts from shifting ground
HAPPILABABY lost its right hind plate near the 450 Metres.
Passing the 400 Metres, DINOZZO was shifted out away from the heels of DOYENI which shifted in when awkwardly placed inside the heels of PRAWN BABA.  DINOZZO was then held up for clear running from near the 350 Metres until passing the 300 Metres.  DOYENI also had difficulty obtaining clear running until near the 250 Metres.
DINOZZO was again badly held up for clear running over the final 150 Metres and consequently was not able to be tested.
PRAWN BABA raced in restricted room between DOYENI and ROCKETEER over the concluding stages and was not able to be fully tested.
HELENE CHARISMA hung in badly in the Straight and proved difficult to ride and passing the 200 Metres shifted in and bumped the hindquarters of GENERAL SHERMAN which became unbalanced.  HELENE CHARISMA continued to hang in and raced tight outside GENERAL SHERMAN for some distance and then passing the 100 Metres hung in further, resulting in GENERAL SHERMAN being crowded onto ROCKETEER which became unbalanced after being bumped by GENERAL SHERMAN.  During this incident, Z Purton was not able to properly test HELENE CHARISMA due to the horseâs racing manners which were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, HELENE CHARISMA will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.
BASIC TRILOGY lost its right front plate after the race.
When questioned regarding the tempo he set on GREEN DISPATCH, particularly between the 1600 Metres and the 1200 Metres, Apprentice H T Mo stated that he was able to cross DOYENI after the 1700 Metres and then immediately took hold of his mount in an endeavour to steady the tempo.  He said when BASIC TRILOGY improved to be racing outside GREEN DISPATCH after the 1500 Metres, his mount commenced to travel keenly, however, he did not realize that he was setting as fast a tempo as he was at this time.  He said after having been made aware of the sectionals of the race after the 1600 Metres, he believed that in retrospect he had erred in not making more of an effort to steady the tempo during this part of the race.  Apprentice Mo, in the presence of his allocated trainer, Mr C S Shum, was told that as an apprentice who has had a good deal of experience both in Hong Kong and overseas, he should have been more aware of the tempo that he set on GREEN DISPATCH.  He was advised to ensure that he rides his mounts in such a manner so that they are able to finish off their race to the best of their ability.
The Stewards will interview S Clipperton, the rider of PRAWN BABA, regarding his riding of that horse from the 600 Metres prior to the Happy Valley racemeeting on Wednesday, 12 July 2017.
A veterinary inspection of BASIC TRILOGY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of BASIC TRILOGY, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, BASIC TRILOGY will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
GENERAL SHERMAN and ROCKETEER were sent for sampling.
<12/7/2017 9 July 2017 Sha Tin Racemeeting â Race 9 (787)>The Stewards tonight questioned S Clipperton regarding his riding of PRAWN BABA, particularly approaching and passing the 600 Metres. S Clipperton stated that it had been explained to him that PRAWN BABA is one-paced and benefits from a truly run race. He also stated that he was instructed to ride PRAWN BABA positively in the early stages to take up a prominent position and to ensure that the horse was provided with clear and unimpeded running from straightening. He said the middle stages of the race were run at a good tempo, however, the pace of the race slackened after the 1200 Metres. He said passing the 800 Metres when racing behind GREEN DISPATCH and inside BASIC TRILOGY, PRAWN BABA appeared to come off the bridle and he had to ride it along from the 800 Metres to ensure that PRAWN BABA maintained its position behind GREEN DISPATCH. He said as PRAWN BABA is one-paced, he did not wish to be left racing behind GREEN DISPATCH and BASIC TRILOGY after the 600 Metres as he felt that the horse would have its best chance if he were to make the race into a staying test as he did not believe he could outsprint ROCKETETEER if PRAWN BABA was not able to establish a margin over that horse. He said for these reasons he commenced to ride PRAWN BABA aggressively from the 600 Metres to ensure that the principal chances in the race would have to make ground on PRAWN BABA whilst also ensuring the race did not become a sit and sprint race. He added whilst this resulted in PRAWN BABA having to be ridden along earlier in the race than would normally be the case, he believed that riding the horse in this manner would give it the best opportunity to finish in front of the principal chances in the race. Mr J Size, the trainer of PRAWN BABA, confirmed the instructions given to Jockey Clipperton and stated that, after reviewing the race and all the circumstances of the race, he was satisfied with Jockey Clippertonâs riding of PRAWN BABA.

A STAR LUSTER began awkwardly and lost ground and then raced greenly throughout the event.
DR RACE was slow to begin and then was hampered by TRENDIFUL which was taken out by YOU KNOW WHO which, after beginning awkwardly, got its head on the side and shifted out further despite the efforts of its rider.
RUGBY DIAMOND shifted out on jumping and hampered TRIUMPHAL TRUMPET.
From the outside barrier, SNOW HAWK was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
In the early and middle stages, TRIUMPHAL TRUMPET raced greenly.
C Murray (DOUBLE MASTER) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 850 Metres he permitted his mount to shift in when not clear of ACCESSION YEARS, causing that horse to be hampered and taken in and ultimately to be steadied away from the heels of DOUBLE MASTER.  C Murray was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Monday, 17 July 2017 and to expire on Thursday, 27 July 2017 on which day he may resume race riding.
Approaching the 800 Metres, TRENDIFUL was momentarily awkwardly placed close to the heels of DOUBLE MASTER.
Passing the 800 Metres, SILVER SPUN was steadied away from the heels of RUGBY DIAMOND (C Schofield) which shifted in when not properly clear.  C Schofield was severely reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is properly clear when shifting ground in similar circumstances.
After the 800 Metres, ACCESSION YEARS was left racing wide and without cover and making the turn near the 550 Metres got its head on the side, lay in and brushed TRENDIFUL which became unbalanced.  TRENDIFUL then hung out, resulting in ACCESSION YEARS being taken wider and both horses then racing wide and without cover.
Also making the turn near the 550 Metres, SILVER SPUN became unbalanced after being bumped by OCEAN ROAR which made the turn awkwardly.
Near the 450 Metres, CALIFORNIA ASPAR was awkwardly placed close to the heels of OCEAN ROAR when racing tight inside DOUBLE MASTER.
Passing the 200 Metres, DR RACE drifted out under pressure.
A veterinary inspection of OCEAN ROAR immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of mucus in the horseâs trachea.
DR RACE, SILVER SPUN and CALIFORNIA ASPAR were sent for sampling.

FRIENDS FOREVER shifted in at the start and bumped GOLD TALENT.
PLANET GIANT shifted in at the start and bumped DUTCH WINDMILL.
From wide barriers, LUCKY FRIENDS, SPEEDY WALLY and DUTCH WINDMILL were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
In the middle stages, FRIENDS FOREVER proved difficult to settle in the lead and travelled keenly.
Passing the 1200 Metres, LUCKY FRIENDS got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of ATOMIC BLAST.
After the 800 Metres, SPEEDY WALLY was awkwardly placed close to the heels of EASTERN PROWESS.
Shortly after entering the Straight, ATOMIC BLAST was shifted to the outside of EASTERN PROWESS to obtain clear running and passing the 300 Metres bumped SPEEDY WALLY which became unbalanced.
Approaching the 250 Metres, NOVEL START and PLANET GIANT raced tight due to both horses shifting ground.
Over the concluding stages, ATOMIC BLAST was hampered when awkwardly placed inside SPEEDY WALLY (Z Purton) which shifted in under pressure.  Z Purton was severely reprimanded and advised that in similar circumstances he would be expected to stop riding and straighten his mount.
Also over the concluding stages, LUCKY FRIENDS raced tight between KIM GLORY and NOVEL START which shifted in.
The performance of FRIENDS FOREVER, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, FRIENDS FOREVER will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of DUTCH WINDMILL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GOLD TALENT, EASTERN PROWESS and SPEEDY WALLY were sent for sampling.

IMPERIAL SEAL began awkwardly and shifted out, inconveniencing GREAT JOY.
SPINNING DANCER and AMBITIOUS HEART bumped shortly after the start.
From the outside barriers, GIANT STARS and AMAZING GOLD were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Approaching the winning post on the first occasion, PEARL WARM WARM was awkwardly placed outside the heels of GOOD METHOD.
Approaching the 1300 Metres, THE JAZZ got its head up when being steadied to allow GOOD METHOD to cross.
In the early part of the Straight, SPINNING DANCER was held up behind WORKS OF ART which was giving ground.
GREAT JOY was held up for a run in the early part of the Straight and was shifted to the outside of IMPERIAL SEAL to obtain clear running passing the 250 Metres.
Approaching the 250 Metres, AMBITIOUS HEART was bumped by WAH MAY BABY which shifted in marginally.
Over the final 150 Metres, AMBITIOUS HEART lay out under pressure.
Throughout the race, WAH MAY BABY travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, Apprentice H N Wong (GIANT STARS) stated that he had been instructed to attempt to give the horse clear galloping room in the Home Straight.  He said as tonightâs race was being conducted on the A course, he felt that he may have difficulty securing uninterrupted running were he to continue to make a run on the inside of horses at the entrance to the Straight and as GREAT JOY, which he expected to be a strong chance, was being shifted to the outside of runners to make its finishing run, he elected to shift out with that horse so that GIANT STARS would be able to make its run towards the outside of the field.  He said this resulted in GIANT STARS only momentarily having difficulty obtaining clear running shortly after the 300 Metres.
After the race, B Prebble stated that WORKS OF ART became unbalanced in its action shortly after entering the Straight when giving ground abruptly.  He said for this reason he eased the horse down over the latter stages of the race.  A veterinary inspection of WORKS OF ART immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Before being allowed to race again, WORKS OF ART will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
AMBITIOUS HEART, IMPERIAL SEAL and GREAT JOY were sent for sampling.

WONDERFUL TIGER was slow to begin.
MANFUL STAR stumbled at the start and then a short distance later was crowded for room inside FOX SUNTER which was taken in by GOOD COMPANION.
HAPPY SOUND shifted in at the start, resulting in FUNNY BUDDIES being hampered.
From wide barriers, STARLIGHT and EMPIRE STAR were steadied and shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After being ridden along to obtain the lead, HAPPY SOUND travelled keenly and proved difficult to settle for some distance in the early and middle stages.
Rounding the Home Turn, FUNNY BUDDIES was bumped by GOOD COMPANION which raced tight outside TRAVEL SUCCESSOR which was taken out by HAPPY SOUND (M L Yeung) which got its head on the side and lay out.  M L Yeung was advised to ensure that he makes every endeavour to prevent his mount from shifting ground wherever possible.
Approaching the 100 Metres, HAPPY SOUND shifted out and was awkwardly placed inside the heels of TRAVEL SUCCESSOR.
Close to the finishing line, FUNNY BUDDIES was shifted out away from the heels of GOOD COMPANION which raced tight outside FOX SUNTER.
Throughout the race, FUNNY BUDDIES travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned regarding his riding of EMPIRE STAR over the concluding stages, C Y Ho stated that he had been required to ride his mount continuously throughout the race to ensure that it was able to be as competitive as it could.  He said in the early part of the Straight he shifted EMPIRE STAR to the outside of runners and immediately commenced to place the horse under pressure including using the whip on the horse whilst at times riding it along vigorously hands and heels.  He said EMPIRE STAR worked home satisfactorily in the Straight and as the horse was giving its all, he did not believe that it was necessary to use the whip vigorously over the concluding stages.  C Y Ho was advised that his explanation would be reported, however, he must ensure that he rides his mounts out with sufficient vigour all the way to the end of the race.
A veterinary inspection of REGENCY HONEY immediately following the race found that horse to have a small amount of blood at the right nostril.  An endoscopic examination of REGENCY HONEY deemed that horse not to have bled.
STARLIGHT and FOX SUNTER were sent for sampling.

TRAVEL COMFORTS was withdrawn on 10.7.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left hind) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter ALL MY GAIN.  Before being allowed to race again, TRAVEL COMFORTS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination. 
RACING MATE and BIG TIME BABY began only fairly and shortly after the start were crowded for room outside SWEETIE BARLEY which shifted out.
TRIUMPHANT JEWEL and MOST BEAUTIFUL bumped at the start.
From a wide barrier, ALL MY GAIN was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the 950 Metres, BEAUTY MASTER shifted out abruptly.
Approaching the 900 Metres, MONEY BOY shifted in and bumped the hindquarters of WHO ELSE BUT YOU.
BIG TIME BABY lost its left front plate passing the 800 Metres.
Making the turn near the 550 Metres, BEAUTY MASTER got its head on the side and lay out.
When questioned, K Teetan (ACE KING) stated that he was instructed to attempt to lead if ACE KING began well having regard to the horseâs prior history of being fractious in the barriers.  He said he was also told that if ACE KING did not show sufficient early speed to lead, it was acceptable for him to take a position with cover behind the leaders.  He said, as is often the case, ACE KING was fractious in the barriers and reared and then as the start was effected began only fairly.  He said as there were a number of horses, which were drawn better than ACE KING, being vigorously ridden to obtain forward positions, he did not believe that ACE KING would have sufficient early speed to be able to lead, therefore he elected to shift the horse across and obtain cover albeit further back in the field than had been intended.
TRIUMPHANT JEWEL and MONEY BOY were sent for sampling.

DOLLAR REWARD began only fairly and shortly after the start was crowded for room between FLYING QUEST and JOLLY CONVERGENCE which was taken out by GENERAL IRON which began awkwardly.
From wide barriers, HERO LOOK and LANG TAI SING were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Approaching the 1100 Metres, IâM A WITNESS got its head on the side and shifted out.
Passing the 900 Metres, GENERAL IRON got its head up when travelling keenly and awkwardly placed close to the heels of GRACE HEART.
Also passing the 900 Metres, IâM A WITNESS and DIAMOND MASTER bumped.
At the entrance to the Straight, JOLLY CONVERGENCE was bumped by IâM A WITNESS which was momentarily steadied away from the heels of FLYING QUEST which shifted out to obtain clear running.
Passing the 200 Metres, DOLLAR REWARD got its head on the side and shifted out and was momentarily awkwardly placed inside the heels of GRACE HEART.
Near the 75 Metres, DOLLAR REWARD raced tight inside GRACE HEART.
Passing the winning post, DIAMOND MASTER became badly unbalanced and shifted out across the heels of EXTREMELY FUN.
Throughout the race, IâM A WITNESS travelled wide and without cover and in the Straight gave ground.
When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of JOLLY CONVERGENCE, N Callan stated that after beginning well, his mount did not show as much early speed as he anticipated despite being hard ridden.  He said JOLLY CONVERGENCE was left racing in a three wide position with cover after being unable to cross GENERAL IRON to its inside and the horse travelled only fairly in the middle stages.  He added rounding the Home Turn and in the early part of the Straight JOLLY CONVERGENCE did not quicken as it had when ridden by him in the past and then did not finish off the race.  A veterinary inspection of JOLLY CONVERGENCE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of BOND ELEGANCE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
JOLLY CONVERGENCE, FLYING QUEST and GREEN CARD were sent for sampling.

M L Yeung dismounted HAPPY LIFE after that horse became fractious in the Parade Ring.
GOOD CHOICE was crowded for room on jumping between LOTUS STRIKES BACK and TEN FLAMES, both of which shifted ground.  After this, both GOOD CHOICE and TEN FLAMES were shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
Shortly after the start, KIRAM was awkwardly placed outside THUNDER STOMP which shifted out when being ridden along.
Passing the winning post on the first occasion, MCQUEEN jumped a shadow, became badly unbalanced and shifted out when racing with its head up.
Also passing the winning post on the first occasion, LITTLE ISLAND was awkwardly placed close to the heels of EASY HEDGE.
Passing the 1300 Metres, EASY HEDGE was steadied away from the heels of MCQUEEN.  When awkwardly placed behind MCQUEEN, EASY HEDGE shifted in and bumped KIRAM approaching the 1200 Metres.
Passing the 1200 Metres, TEN FLAMES was checked away from the heels of LOTUS STRIKES BACK which was awkwardly placed behind HAPPY CONTENDER.
A veterinary inspection of EASY HEDGE immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
DR LISTENING and MCQUEEN were sent for sampling.

DRAGON GENERAL was slow to begin.
From a wide barrier, SUPER TURBO was steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Near the 1150 Metres, COUNTRY MELODY and VERBINSKY were crowded for room inside HIGH FIVE (C Murray) which shifted in before being directed back out to relieve the tightening to runners on its inside.  C Murray was advised to exercise more care when shifting ground.
Throughout the race, FLYING TOURBILLON travelled wide and without cover.
A veterinary inspection of RACING SUPERNOVA, HOUSE OF FUN and DRAGON GENERAL immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SOUTHERN LEGEND and SUPER TURBO were sent for sampling.

DYNAMIC VOYAGE, Standby Declared Starter, was withdrawn on 15.7.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore).  Before being allowed to race again, DYNAMIC VOYAGE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
GAINFULJET, which was difficult to load, will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test prior to its next race start.
HAYMAKER began only fairly.
On jumping, JIMSON THE FAMOUS became unbalanced and was steadied when crowded for room between FURIOUS PEGASUS and HAPPY GAINS which shifted out.  HAPPY GAINS continued to shift out despite the efforts of its rider, resulting in FURIOUS PEGASUS, ORIENTAL FANTASIA, KWAICHUNG BROTHERS and HURRICANE KID all being hampered.  After this, KWAICHUNG BROTHERS and HURRICANE KID were steadied to obtain cover.
Near the 1050 Metres, KWAICHUNG BROTHERS was awkwardly placed outside the heels of FURIOUS PEGASUS.
Approaching and passing the 800 Metres, STARRY STARLIES got its head up when being steadied away from the heels of HAPPY FIERY DRAGON.
Passing the 800 Metres, FURIOUS PEGASUS shifted out when awkwardly placed close to the heels of HAPPY GAINS which was racing close to the heels of NATURAL TEAM.
Near the 750 Metres, HURRICANE KID got its head up and lost ground when awkwardly placed close to the heels of FURIOUS PEGASUS.
Near the 550 Metres, NATURAL TEAM was bumped by HAPPY GAINS which improved into tight running between that horse and STARRY STARLIES.
Passing the 200 Metres, KWAICHUNG BROTHERS was awkwardly placed outside the heels of HAYMAKER.
When questioned regarding the performance of KWAICHUNG BROTHERS, J Moreira stated that it had been intended for the horse to be ridden in about a midfield position if possible, however, after being hampered on jumping the horse was required to race further back in the field than was planned.  He said nonetheless KWAICHUNG BROTHERS did not travel well at any stage of the race and was disappointing.  A veterinary inspection of KWAICHUNG BROTHERS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HAPPY GAINS, HAPPY FIERY DRAGON and LE PEGASE were sent for sampling.

NUCLEAR POWER was withdrawn on 15.7.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right hind) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter FIFTY FIFTY (K Teetan).  Before being allowed to race again, NUCLEAR POWER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When about to enter the track after leaving the Parade Ring, ALL YOU NEED slipped, resulting in its rider, C Schofield, being dislodged without incident.  On arrival at the Start, ALL YOU NEED was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said the horse had sustained a superficial abrasion inside the left hind fetlock, however, after the necessary consultations was suitable to race.  A veterinary inspection of ALL YOU NEED immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ALL YOU NEED lifted its front feet off the ground as the start was effected and consequently was slow to begin.
HINYUEN SWIFTNESS began only fairly.
ALL BEST FRIENDS shifted in at the start and bumped FIONESAY.  After this, FIONESAY was ridden along, however, took some time to muster speed.
Shortly after the start, SHANGHAI MASTER was awkwardly placed outside THOR THE GREATEST which shifted out.
From a wide barrier, STARSHIP was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Passing the 1150 Metres, IVICTORY was steadied away from the heels of SO FAST (B Prebble) which shifted in when not properly clear.  ALL BEST FRIENDS, which was following, was inconvenienced in consequence.  B Prebble was reprimanded and advised to ensure that he is sufficiently clear when shifting ground in future.
SO FAST lost its right hind plate near the 250 Metres.
Near the 150 Metres, ALL YOU NEED was shifted out from behind SHANGHAI MASTER to obtain clear running.
Approaching the 150 Metres, STARSHIP was awkwardly placed inside the heels of THOR THE GREATEST.
Near the 100 Metres, IVICTORY and FIFTY FIFTY brushed.
Passing the 100 Metres, Apprentice K K Chiong (SHANGHAI MASTER) dropped her whip.
Throughout the race, FIFTY FIFTY travelled wide and without cover.
IVICTORY and FIFTY FIFTY were sent for sampling.
<17/7/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>ALL YOU NEED, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  ALL YOU NEED was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer R Gibson this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to have sustained a cut to the inside of the left hind fetlock.  Before being allowed to race again, ALL YOU NEED will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

race_name: THE HONG KONG RACEHORSE OWNERS ASSOCIATION TROPHY (HANDICAP)
incident_report:
MONGOLIAN KING was slow to begin.
PIKACHU began very awkwardly and lost ground.
CHIMBORAA shifted out at the start and bumped DUKEDOM.  DUKEDOM was then crowded for room between CHIMBORAA and BULB ELITE.
HEALTHY JOYFUL shifted in at the start and bumped MIDNIGHT RATTLER.
From wide barriers, DUKEDOM and CIRCUIT HASSLER were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
When being steadied to obtain cover, BULB ELITE proved difficult to settle in the early stages.
Passing the 800 Metres, CIRCUIT HASSLER shifted out abruptly away from the heels of SICHUAN DAR.
Also passing the 800 Metres, TURF SPRINT was awkwardly placed close to the heels of SOLAR HEI HEI.
Near the 550 Metres, BIG BANG BONG got its head up when awkwardly placed behind of HEALTHY JOYFUL.
TURF SPRINT lay out making the Home Turn.
Approaching the 150 Metres, BIG BANG BONG and TURF SPRINT bumped.
For the majority of the race, DRAGON MASTER travelled wide and without cover.
After the race, A Sanna stated that CHIMBORAA did not travel comfortably at any stage of the race and despite being ridden along after the 1000 Metres became detached from the field.  A veterinary inspection of CHIMBORAA immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of CHIMBORAA, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, CHIMBORAA will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
MONGOLIAN KING, SOLAR HEI HEI and BABA MAMA were sent for sampling.

HALL OF FAME was withdrawn on 15.7.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter LUCKY SEBRING (Apprentice H N Wong).  Before being allowed to race again, HALL OF FAME will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
STORM KID was withdrawn from the race by order of the Stewards after that horse was fractious in the saddling area and was unable to be saddled.
PERFECT TIMING blundered badly on jumping, resulting in its rider, K Teetan becoming badly unbalanced and losing the use of his right stirrup iron for some distance.  In this incident, PERFECT TIMING lost a considerable amount of ground and then in the early and middle stages raced detached from the field.  A veterinary inspection of PERFECT TIMING immediately following the race found the horse to have sustained overreach wounds to both heels of its right front leg.
BEST TANGO and SWEET BEAN began only fairly.
Despite being hard ridden in the early stages, FORTUNE GIGGLES failed to muster speed and throughout the race travelled wide and without cover.
Approaching the 1400 Metres and again passing the 1300 Metres, BEST TANGO got its head up when awkwardly placed close to the heels of PROUD SKY.
Passing the 350 Metres, PROUD SKY race tight inside LIGHTNING AND GOLD which shifted in.  FLYING PROSPERITY was hampered in this incident.
BEST TANGO had some difficulty obtaining clear running approaching and passing the 300 Metres.
Close to the finishing line, JE PENSE shifted in and bumped PROUD SKY.
B Prebble (FORTUNE GIGGLES) was fined $5,000 for improper use of the whip in that he raised weal marks over the horseâs right hindquarters.
After the race, J Moreira was not able to offer any explanation for the disappointing performance of LIGHTNING AND GOLD.  He said the horse travelled satisfactorily in the early and middle stages, however, after being placed under pressure in the Straight did not finish off the race.  A veterinary inspection of LIGHTNING AND GOLD immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of AMRITSARIA immediately following the race did not show any significant findings, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.
A veterinary inspection of HIGH SPEED METRO immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
BEST TANGO, PROUD SKY and JE PENSE were sent for sampling.
<17/7/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>HIGH SPEED METRO, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  HIGH SPEED METRO was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer L Ho this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, HIGH SPEED METRO will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

VERY RICH MAN was withdrawn on 15.7.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and was replaced by first Standby Declared Starter JOLLY BOUNTIFUL (J Moreira).  AIMING HIGH was also withdrawn on 15.7.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and was replaced by second Standby Declared Starter RICHCITY FORTUNE (B Prebble).  Before being allowed to race again, VERY RICH MAN and AIMING HIGH will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SO GENEROUS began only fairly.
From the outside barriers, GREAT TOPLIGHT and MY GIFT were steadied and shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Near the 750 Metres, JOLLY BOUNTIFUL was awkwardly placed close to the heels of OUR FOLKS.
Passing the 400 Metres, JOLLY BOUNTIFUL was directed in from behind PHANTOM FALCON and OUR FOLKS to obtain clear running.
JOLLY BOUNTIFUL had difficulty obtaining clear running from passing the 200 Metres and approaching the 150 Metres was shifted out away from the heels of RUMINARE.  JOLLY BOUNTIFUL was then badly held up when disappointed for running between RUMINARE and RICHCITY FORTUNE.  Then passing the 100 Metres, JOLLY BOUNTIFUL was shifted to the outside of RICHCITY FORTUNE to obtain clear running.
JOLLY BOUNTIFUL, OUR FOLKS and PHANTOM FALCON were sent for sampling.

SMART BOY was withdrawn on 14.7.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (right front capped elbow) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter ASSOCIATION FANS (Z Purton).  Before being allowed to race again, SMART BOY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
ASSOCIATION FANS began awkwardly and then shortly after the start was crowded for room along with HAPPY HAPPY between VARA PEARL and NOBLE DE BOY, both of which shifted ground.  After this, both HAPPY HAPPY and ASSOCIATION FANS were shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.
From the outside barriers, RED ELYSEES and ROCK THE TREE were steadied in the early stages and shifted across behind runners.
Making the turn near the 900 Metres, SPRING WIN was brushed by WINGOLD which lay out.
Approaching the 300 Metres, SILVERFIELD was shifted in away from the heels of SALSA BROTHERS to improve.  Then passing the 200 Metres, SALSA BROTHERS was brushed by SILVERFIELD which improved into tight running between that horse and WINGOLD.
Throughout the race, NOBLE DE BOY travelled wide and without cover. 
N Callan (RED ELYSEES), 5th placegetter, was spoken to regarding his failure to ride the horse out all the way to the end of the race.  Having regard to the half length margin behind the 4th placegetter, WINGOLD and the proximity to the finishing line that Jockey Callan stopped riding, the Stewards were satisfied that his riding did not affect the horseâs final placing, nonetheless he was told to ensure that he rides his mounts out all the way to the end of the race wherever circumstances permit.  A veterinary inspection of RED ELYSEES immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
After the race, Apprentice H N Wong expressed concern regarding the action of SALSA BROTHERS during the race.  A veterinary inspection of SALSA BROTHERS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
After the race, U Rispoli reported that NOBLE DE BOY, which had previously been recorded as being a "roarerâ, had made an abnormal respiratory noise during the race.
FIVE STARS AGENT, THE FULL BLOOM and SILVERFIELD were sent for sampling.

COOL BROTHERS lifted its front feet off the ground as the start was effected and consequently lost ground.
ASHKIYR and HAPPY ROCKY bumped at the start.  ASHKIYR then shifted in and bumped WIN FOR CHARITY, resulting in both horses becoming unbalanced.
LUCKY SEVEN STARS began awkwardly.
For some distance approaching and passing the 1200 Metres, GARLIC YEAH got its head up when being steadied away from the heels of MIDNITE PROMISE.
KING BOUNTIFUL lost its left front plate after the 600 Metres.
Rounding the Home Turn, KING BOUNTIFUL was held up when awkwardly placed behind SEMPITERNAL which was giving ground.
HAPPY ROCKY was awkwardly placed close to the heels of HIT A HOME RUN rounding the Home Turn.
At the entrance to the Straight, SEMPITERNAL and AEROLUMINANCE bumped.
ASHKIYR had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the Straight.
HIT A HOME RUN had difficulty obtaining clear running from on straightening until after the 200 Metres.
Near the 50 Metres, ASHKIYR raced tight inside PO CHING TREASURE which lay in under pressure.
Throughout the race, PO CHING TREASURE travelled wide and without cover.
After the race, Z Purton stated that after pulling up, GARLIC YEAH became unbalanced in its action.  A veterinary inspection of GARLIC YEAH immediately following the race including an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse's trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, GARLIC YEAH will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of MIDNITE PROMISE and COOL BROTHERS immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GARLIC YEAH, KING OF MONGOLIA and HIT A HOME RUN were sent for sampling.
<17/7/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>COOL BROTHERS, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  COOL BROTHERS was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer C W Chang this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, COOL BROTHERS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

When being saddled, HAPPY AND HEALTHY was noted to be lame in the right front leg.  Acting on advice from the Veterinary Officer that HAPPY AND HEALTHY was not suitable to race, that horse was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  Before being allowed to race again, HAPPY AND HEALTHY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
As the start was effected, ROYALE ELEGANCE became fractious and lunged at the front gate, resulting in the gate opening momentarily prior to the remaining gates.
EXPERTO CREDE began awkwardly and bumped ROYALE ELEGANCE.
SUPERIOR BOY shifted out at the start and bumped GOOD FOR YOU.
AUTOPAY stumbled at the start.
From wide barriers, UNLEASHED DRAGON and REAL DEAL were shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
CHARITY KINGDOM, which travelled wide and without cover throughout the race, lost its right front plate passing the 1000 Metres.
GOOD FOR YOU got its head up on a number of occasions when awkwardly placed close to the heels of MONEY WINNER passing the 700  Metres.
For some distance passing the 700 Metres, ROYALE ELEGANCE (A Sanna) proved very difficult to settle and got its head up when being checked away from the heels of REMARKABLE.  REAL DEAL, which was following ROYALE ELEGANCE, was awkwardly placed close to the heels of that horse in consequence.  ROYALE ELEGANCE continued to race close to the heels of REMARKABLE and near the 550 Metres shifted out away from behind that horse, resulting in MONEY WINNER becoming badly unbalanced when crowded for room between ROYALE ELEGANCE and JOLLY GAINS which also became unbalanced after being bumped by MONEY WINNER.  A Sanna was advised that whilst the Stewards accepted that ROYALE ELEGANCE was proving difficult to settle, nonetheless in the opinion of the Stewards, he should have made more effort than he did on this occasion to prevent ROYALE ELEGANCE from shifting out away from the heels of REMARKABLE.  A Sanna was severely reprimanded and advised that he would be expected to make a greater effort to prevent his mounts from shifting ground in similar circumstances.
Passing the 400 Metres, REMARKABLE was shifted to the outside of AUTOPAY after being disappointed for running between that horse and GENEROUS BOBO.
For some distance approaching and passing the 300 Metres, MONEY WINNER had difficulty obtaining clear running when improving between CHARITY KINGDOM and SUPERIOR BOY which shifted out.
Over the final 300 Metres, AUTOPAY lay out under pressure.
Throughout the race, JOLLY GAINS travelled wide and without cover.
The performance of ROYALE ELEGANCE, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, ROYALE ELEGANCE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of JOLLY GAINS and SUPERIOR BOY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
EXPERTO CREDE, GENEROUS BOBO and GOOD FOR YOU were sent for sampling.
<17/7/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>SUPERIOR BOY, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  SUPERIOR BOY was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer C W Chang this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, SUPERIOR BOY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

ISHVARA was withdrawn on 15.7.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter DEJA VU (Apprentice H N Wong).  Before being allowed to race again, ISHVARA will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
FIRST FONTEIN was slow to begin.
UNICORN shifted out at the start and bumped SMILING CHARM.
GREEN ENERGY was crowded for room on jumping between PRETTY BAUHINIA and LET US WIN which shifted out.
From the outside barrier, AMAZING AGILITY was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
After the 1400 Metres, UNICORN got its head on the side and lay out towards the heels of SMILING CHARM.  After this, UNICORN lost its left front plate.
After the 1000 Metres, WINWIN RUBY was checked away from the heels of GREEN ENERGY which was steadied to allow GOLD LAND to cross.  DEJA VU, which was following, got it head up when being steadied away from the heels of WINWIN RUBY in consequence.
Throughout the race, LET US WIN travelled wide and without cover.
When questioned, Apprentice K K Chiong (UNICORN) stated that she had to ride her mount hard, particularly in the early stages, in an attempt to make up ground.  She said UNICORN did not appear to be stretching out comfortably and she again had to ride the horse vigorously rounding the Home Turn in an attempt to have it improve its position.  She said UNICORN did not finish off its race and was reluctant to improve between runners passing the 250 Metres despite being ridden along.  She added after this UNICORN failed to close off.
When questioned, U Rispoli (PRETTY BAUHINIA) stated that, from the wide barrier, he was asked to shift the horse across behind runners so as not to be caught wide.  He said after shifting across to race behind SMILING CHARM approaching the 1000 Metres, he had to ride his mount for a considerable distance throughout the middle stages, however, PRETTY BAUHINIA would not improve its position.  He said when PRETTY BAUHINIA was taken wider by AMAZING AGILITY after the 500 Metres, PRETTY BAUHINIA commenced to make an abnormal breathing noise and as he had concern regarding the horseâs welfare, he eased it down in the early part of the Straight.  He added after the race PRETTY BAUHINIA appeared to be trotting soundly, however, was not completely balanced in its action.  A veterinary inspection of PRETTY BAUHINIA immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of PRETTY BAUHINIA, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, PRETTY BAUHINIA will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
A veterinary inspection of LET US WIN and WINWIN RUBY immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GREEN ENERGY and APOLLOâS CHOICE were sent for sampling.

Passing the 1500 Metres, SUPREME PROFIT was bumped by HORSE OF FORTUNE (C Murray) which shifted in.  C Murray was advised to exercise more care when shifting ground.
Near the 75 Metres, KING GENKI got its head on the side and shifted out towards the heels of BEAT THE CLOCK.
A veterinary inspection of ANTICIPATION immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
BEAT THE CLOCK, TIME WARP and BOOMING DELIGHT were sent for sampling.
<17/7/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>ANTICIPATION, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  ANTICIPATION was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer A S Cruz this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, ANTICIPATION will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

WINSTONâS LAD was withdrawn on 13.7.17 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (swollen left front fetlock) and was replaced by Standby Declared Starter MIGHTY BOY.  Before being allowed to race again, WINSTONâS LAD will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
When parading prior to the race, the tongue tie applied to DOUBLE VALENTINE became dislodged with this gear being reapplied behind the barriers.
Just prior to the start being effected, HEHA BOY became very fractious and lunged at the front gates, resulting in its rider, Apprentice H N Wong, being dislodged and HEHA BOY leaving the barrier stalls riderless.  Before being allowed to race again, HEHA BOY will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.
HIGH AND MIGHTY was very slow to begin.  A veterinary inspection of HIGH AND MIGHTY immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its right front leg, however, the horse was unable to be scoped due to being fractious.  Having regard to HIGH AND MIGHTYâs previous record of having been slow to begin, the horse will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.
SUNNY WAY began very awkwardly and shifted in abruptly, resulting in DOUBLE VALENTINE being badly hampered.
MIGHTY BOY and FANTASTIC KAKA began only fairly.
Passing the 1200 Metres, MIGHTY BOY was momentarily crowded for room inside INTREPIC (Apprentice M F Poon) which shifted in before being directed back out to relieve the tightening to MIGHTY BOY.  Apprentice Poon was advised to exercise more care when shifting ground in similar circumstances.
Approaching the 1000 Metres, CHUNG WAH SPIRIT was awkwardly placed close to the heels of WORLD RECORD and shifted out away from the heels of that horse.  SUNNY WAY, which was racing to the outside of CHUNG WAH SPIRIT, was hampered in consequence.
Near the 250 Metres, CHUNG WAH SPIRIT commenced to shift in under pressure, resulting in its rider, Z Purton, momentarily having to stop riding and straighten his mount.
Passing the 100 Metres, WORLD RECORD was shifted in away from the heels of SUNNY WAY which lay in under pressure.
Throughout the race, SUNNY WAY travelled wide and without cover.
S Clipperton pleaded guilty to a breach of Rule 100(2) in that he failed to ride SUNNY WAY, 6th placegetter, out all the way to the end of the race to the satisfaction of the Stewards.  S Clipperton was fined $15,000.
CHUNG WAH SPIRIT lost its right front plate after the race.
When questioned regarding the performance of INTREPIC, Apprentice M F Poon stated that the horse travelled well in the early and middle stages and rounding the Home Turn he anticipated the horse would finish off the race strongly after being shifted to the outside of RIGHT HONOURABLE.  He said however that passing the 400 Metres INTREPIC did not quicken as it had when ridden by him in the past.  He added after this INTREPIC did not finish off the race as he expected and was disappointing over the concluding stages.  A veterinary inspection of INTREPIC immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection of WORLD RECORD immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
INTREPIC, CALCULATION and CHUNG WAH SPIRIT were sent for sampling.
<17/7/2017  Additional Veterinary Report>WORLD RECORD, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings.  WORLD RECORD was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer A T Millard this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, WORLD RECORD will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
